The prevailing solution is verb--noun decomposition, which predicts components separately and recombines them to reach unseen actions. While widely adopted, how decomposition generalizes under compositional shift remains poorly understood. We present a systematic analysis of verb--noun decomposition across three assembly datasets (MECCANO, HAViD, and IMPACT). Although decomposition escapes the atomic ceiling, its generalization extends only partially beyond it. Unseen-composition performance remains strongly tied to the co-occurrence structure of the training data, indicating that much of the observed gain arises from interpolation within densely supported regions of the compositional space rather than from unconstrained recombination. Across datasets, failures consistently concentrate on the larger-vocabulary component, and IMPACT's verb-heavy vocabulary reverses the bottleneck from nouns to verbs. We further show that shared-encoder training introduces component entanglement, encouraging reliance on co-occurrence patterns that transfer poorly to unseen compositions and trailing independent recombination by up to $6.0\times$ in harmonic mean. Taken together, these findings explain why decomposition achieves only partial compositional generalization in practice. By identifying primitive support, vocabulary asymmetry, and component entanglement as connected sources of error, we provide a portable diagnostic framework for studying compositional recognition beyond aggregate accuracy. Code: https://github.com/hisalaheiyo/assembly.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了动词-名词分解在三种装配数据集（MECCANO、HAViD、IMPACT）上的表现，发现尽管该方法突破了原子动作分类的局限，但其组合泛化能力仍受限于训练数据中的共现结构，主要表现为对密集支持区域的内插而非真正的未见组合重用。性能瓶颈集中在词汇量更大的组件上，且在动词主导的IMPACT数据集中，瓶颈从名词转移到动词。共享编码器训练导致组件纠缠，使模型依赖共现模式，泛化能力远低于独立重组方式。研究揭示了原始支持、词汇不对称性和组件纠缠是组合识别失败的共同根源，提出了可迁移的诊断框架。
AI.motivation: 现有动词-名词分解方法虽能缓解原子动作分类在未见组合上的零概率问题，但其实际组合泛化能力仍不明确，尤其在面对成分变化时表现如何缺乏系统理解。因此需要深入分析其泛化机制与局限性。
AI.method: 在三个装配任务数据集（MECCANO、HAViD、IMPACT）上评估动词-名词分解方法，通过对比共享编码器与独立编码器训练、分析组件共现结构、考察词汇量不平衡的影响，系统研究其组合泛化行为。
AI.result: 分解方法仅实现部分组合泛化；未见组合性能高度依赖训练数据中的共现结构，主要源于对密集区域的内插而非真正重用。大词汇量组件是主要失败点，且在动词密集数据集中瓶颈转移至动词。共享编码器引入组件纠缠，显著降低泛化能力，比独立重组低达6倍的调和均值。
AI.conclusion: 动词-名词分解的组合泛化能力有限，受原始支持、词汇不对称性和组件纠缠的制约。这些因素构成可迁移的诊断框架，有助于更深入理解组合认知系统的局限性。

title: K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook
comment: 38 pages, 8 figures plus a graphical abstract; includes benchmark prompts, scoring rubric, and per-prompt scores. Code: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok
summary: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

AI.tldr: K-Dense BYOK 是一个免费开源的AI研究助手，专为各领域科学家设计，可在研究人员自己的计算机上运行。用户可自行提供模型（本地或云端），而K-Dense BYOK 提供工作环境、科学框架、完整记录功能。项目以普通文件夹形式存在，确保数据、代码、结果和记录长期可读且由研究者自主管理。与通用聊天助手或编程代理不同，它内置科学流程库、工作流模板、数据源目录，并支持评审与写作角色分配；其“活体实验笔记”持续积累、不可删除，记录通过观察代理行为生成，而非依赖代理自述，从而有效防止模型夸大声称。在20个跨学科研究任务中，该系统在科学质量与执行效率上均优于两个受控平台，其交付成果是唯一记录所用软件环境且通常附带可重现结果的命令。相比之下，另一平台虽使用相同前沿模型，但未记录环境信息。当前日志尚未捕获软件环境本身，该信息仍由代理写入文件。代码开源，采用MIT许可证，地址：https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok。
AI.motivation: 解决现有AI研究工具中模型过度假设、结果不可复现、环境记录缺失等问题，提升科研透明度与可追溯性，使研究过程真正由研究人员掌控。
AI.method: 构建基于本地运行的K-Dense BYOK系统，整合科学流程库、工作流模板、数据源目录、评审与写作角色，采用行为观测机制记录研究过程，生成不可篡改的‘活体实验笔记’，并强制记录可复现结果的命令与软件环境信息。
AI.result: 在20个跨学科研究任务中，K-Dense BYOK 在科学质量与研究执行方面均优于两个受控平台；其产出是唯一完整记录所用软件环境并提供可复现命令的结果；相较之下，另一平台虽使用相同模型，却未记录环境信息。当前日志仍未捕获软件环境本身，需依赖代理写入文件。
AI.conclusion: K-Dense BYOK 通过本地化部署、行为驱动记录与可复现性保障，显著提升了科研工作的透明度、可信度与长期可读性，是面向未来开放科研的理想工具。

title: Signed Lexical Confidence for Risk-Calibrated Intent Routing
summary: Selective intent routing allows an assistant to act on reliable predictions while deferring uncertain requests. Standard confidence scores primarily reflect the base model's representation, leaving an opportunity to incorporate complementary evidence without changing its decisions. We introduce a signed lexical gate that combines a sentence classifier's logit margin with a sparse lexical model's support for the classifier's predicted intent. By assigning positive evidence to lexical agreement and negative evidence to a lexically favored competing intent, the gate retains more information than either unsigned lexical confidence or a hard agreement rule. An independent binomial calibration stage selects an operating threshold for a specified risk target. Across ten runs on BANKING77, CLINC150, and HWU64, the proposed score reduces area under the risk-coverage curve by 15.8%, 15.1%, and 11.8% relative to a learned semantic-only gate. At a nominal 5% error target, it increases accepted coverage by 1.83 and 5.14 percentage points on BANKING77 and HWU64, while CLINC150 is already near full coverage. At a stricter 2% target, the simultaneous binomial procedure yields a nonempty policy in all 30 dataset-run combinations at the available calibration budgets. Matched controls show that the proposed feature improves average error ranking over the tested unsigned lexical-confidence feature, with dataset-dependent gains over binary agreement. The resulting two-feature gate provides a compact, interpretable confidence enhancement for risk-calibrated intent routing while preserving the base classifier's predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种带有符号词汇门的意图路由方法，通过结合句子分类器的置信度差异与稀疏词汇模型对预测意图的支持，提升不确定性判断能力。该方法在不改变基础分类器决策的前提下，利用互补证据增强置信度评估，并通过独立的二项式校准确定风险目标下的操作阈值。在BANKING77、CLINC150和HWU64数据集上，相比仅依赖语义的门控机制，显著降低风险-覆盖率曲线下面积（分别减少15.8%、15.1%、11.8%），并在5%误差目标下提升接受覆盖率，在2%目标下仍能保持有效策略。实验表明该方法优于无符号词汇置信度和二元匹配规则，具有更好的可解释性与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有信心评分主要基于基础模型表示，未能充分利用词汇层面的互补证据，导致不确定请求处理效率不足。需要一种无需修改原分类器决策、又能更精确捕捉不确定性的置信度增强机制。
AI.method: 引入符号词汇门，融合句子分类器的logit margin与稀疏词汇模型对预测意图的支持，正向表示词汇一致性，负向表示竞争意图的词汇支持；采用独立的二项式校准步骤，为指定风险目标选择最优阈值。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，所提方法显著降低风险-覆盖率曲线下的面积（15.8%~11.8%）；在5%误差目标下，覆盖率达1.83~5.14个百分点提升；在2%严格目标下，所有30个数据集-运行组合均获得非空策略；优于对比的无符号词汇置信度与二元匹配规则。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双特征符号词汇门提供了一种紧凑、可解释的置信度增强方案，可在不改变基础分类器预测的前提下实现风险校准的意图路由，适用于高可靠性要求的应用场景。

title: Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures; code and reproducibility package available at https://github.com/Pranavsingh431/nous-state/tree/main/research/decision-certification
summary: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了信念型智能体记忆在面对噪声、复制或过时证据时，如何在不完全校准信息源的情况下仍能改进决策。通过分离学习、校准与修订认证，发现学习和验证决策改进所需样本量可远低于校准源可靠性（分别为O(l⁻²)和Θ(l⁻⁴)），表明决策优化可绕过对源可靠性的精确估计。研究在多种模型下验证了这一结论，并提出基于可观测“见证区域”的有限样本认证方法，适用于未知身份加背景报告通道场景，且具备对历史依赖性偏差和条件复制的鲁棒性。实验在三个外部MiniGrid环境中的45,000个历史和9,000个回合中测试，新证书在9/9和4/9的改进上表现优于旧方法，而旧方法无一成功。结果提供了一种统计上可解释的决策学习与辩护框架，而非通用更优的记忆算法。
AI.motivation: 信念型智能体在决策时依赖记忆，但其证据可能受噪声、复制或过时影响，导致决策不可靠。传统方法往往要求先校准信息源才能改进决策，但此过程成本高昂。本文旨在探索是否可以在不完全校准源的情况下，仍能有效学习并证明决策改进，从而降低对源可靠性的依赖。
AI.method: 将学习、校准与修订认证三者解耦；在隐藏马尔可夫模型族中分析样本复杂度；引入可观测的‘见证区域’构建有限样本证书；设计鲁棒性扩展以应对历史依赖性错误与条件复制；结合政策边界凭证与Nous Dimensions，在多个迷你网格（MiniGrid）环境中进行大规模实证测试。
AI.result: 在四模型隐马尔可夫族中，学习与认证决策改进仅需O(l⁻²)样本，而源校准需Θ(l⁻⁴)，表明前者效率显著更高；在未知身份+背景报告通道下，可准确刻画政策改进的识别区间，并实现无需纯类锚点的有限样本认证；实验显示新证书在9/9和4/9的改进上成功识别，而旧证书全失败；强基线方法仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了在不恢复源可靠性的情况下，仍可有效学习并统计上验证记忆决策的改进。这为智能体记忆系统提供了新的理论基础，但并不构成一种普遍更优的记忆算法，而是强调了在特定条件下决策学习与辩护的可行性。

title: Robust Online Aero-Engine Blade Defect Detection via Dual-Alignment Test-Time Adaptation
comment: This manuscript is Accepted at conference PRCV 2026
summary: Reliable visual inspection is essential for quality assurance in aero-engine blade manufacturing, where defect appearance may vary across production lines, imaging conditions, blade poses, and surface backgrounds. Such domain shifts cause a mismatch between training and deployment data and degrade the reliability of deep defect detectors in online inspection. This problem is particularly challenging because aero-engine blade images usually contain sparse defects, making pseudolabel-based adaptation vulnerable to noisy or missing predictions. To address this issue, we propose Aero-engine Blade Defect Detector (ABDD), an online adaptive detection framework based on test-time adaptation. ABDD introduces a Dual-Alignment Strategy to jointly adapt global visual style and local defect morphology by combining feature-statistics alignment with pseudo-box alignment. To reduce error accumulation from unreliable pseudo labels, an Uncertainty-aware Box Filtering mechanism evaluates pseudo boxes using classification confidence, classification entropy, and localization entropy. In addition, a lightweight Sparse Dilated Mona module enables parameter-efficient delta tuning while limiting source-domain forgetting. ABDD is evaluated on CD-AeBD and HD-AeBD under multiple domain-shift scenarios, with TTA strategies compared under a unified RT-DETR + Swin-T architecture. Experiments show that ABDD consistently improves detection robustness under domain shifts, and its practicality is further validated on an industrial inspection platform.

AI.tldr: 提出ABDD框架，通过测试时自适应（TTA）解决航空发动机叶片缺陷检测中的域偏移问题。采用双对齐策略联合调整全局视觉风格与局部缺陷形态，并引入不确定性感知的伪框过滤机制减少噪声影响。结合轻量级稀疏膨胀模块实现高效参数微调，有效缓解源域遗忘。在多个域偏移场景下验证了其鲁棒性与工业实用性。
AI.motivation: 航空发动机叶片缺陷检测面临多变的生产环境、成像条件和姿态变化，导致训练与部署数据分布不一致，现有方法在稀疏缺陷场景下依赖伪标签的自适应易受噪声影响，亟需更可靠的在线适应方案。
AI.method: 提出ABDD框架，包含双对齐策略（特征统计对齐与伪框对齐）、不确定性感知的伪框过滤机制，以及轻量级稀疏膨胀模块进行参数高效微调，实现测试时自适应。
AI.result: 在CD-AeBD和HD-AeBD数据集上，ABDD在多种域偏移场景下均显著提升缺陷检测的鲁棒性；工业平台验证表明其具备实际应用价值。
AI.conclusion: ABDD通过有效的测试时自适应机制，显著增强了航空发动机叶片缺陷检测系统在复杂工业场景下的可靠性与泛化能力，为在线质量检测提供了实用解决方案。

title: Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks
comment: 46 pages (11 pages main text, references, 33-page appendix); 10 figures, 29 tables. Evaluated corpus: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agents (commit 48dedd2); evaluation code and item-level records are not released
summary: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

AI.tldr: 使用完整的职业特定提示（profession-specific prompts）并未带来一致的准确性提升，反而导致令牌使用量和成本显著增加。在9个文本类科学基准测试中，匹配的职业角色提示平均准确率比基础提示低0.6个百分点，且无任何基准显示出统计上显著的改进。在60个工具使用的生物信息学任务中，职业提示的解决率（46.7%）低于基础提示（56.7%），主要因更频繁触发令牌或时间限制。尽管如此，在SuperGPQA任务中，较长的提示因减少API中断的影响，表现出更好的首次通过正确率（71.6% vs 54.0%）。总体表明，对当前模型和任务而言，默认加载完整职业档案既不提高准确率，也大幅增加成本；是否通过选择性检索或开放科学任务可改变这一结论尚待验证。
AI.motivation: 评估详细的职业特定系统提示是否能有效提升科学任务中的模型表现，尤其是在成本与效率之间权衡的背景下。
AI.method: 使用Gemini 3.8 Flash通过OpenRouter在Pi代理框架中评估503个职业特定的AGENTS.md角色配置文件。对比五种条件：最小基线提示、角色开头语句、通用科学严谨性指南、无关领域角色提示，以及匹配的职业提示。在4,531个样本问题上进行多轮测试，采用自动化规则评分，并分析成功率、输出令牌数与调用成本。
AI.result: 职业匹配提示未带来准确率提升，反而使输出令牌数增加1.5-2.3倍，成本上升2.2-4.5倍。在工具使用任务中，解决率下降10个百分点（-10.0%，95%置信区间[-16.7, -3.3]）。但在高API中断场景下，长提示因更强的容错能力表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 对于当前模型和任务类型，默认加载完整的专业角色提示并不能提升准确性，反而显著增加成本。未来应探索基于任务需求的选择性提示检索或开放型科学任务是否可能改变这一结果。

title: Certainty Is Not Just Correctness: Rethinking Token-Level Certainty in LLM Reasoning
summary: Token-level certainty is widely used as a proxy for correctness in LLM training and inference. However, the performance of certainty-based methods depends both on the information in certainty scores and on how those scores are used. We therefore directly assess certainty's predictive ability through controlled empirical evaluations across models and tasks. We distinguish two prediction targets: identifying questions a model is more likely to answer correctly and distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. In our experiments, certainty is generally better at identifying questions a model is likely to answer correctly than at distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. Certainty also varies systematically across token types and positions within words, reflecting local properties of words and text form. Information about question difficulty appears early in generation, while the weaker information about answer correctness is more concentrated near the end. These findings show that the information certainty provides for decisions depends on the prediction target, the model, the certainty metric, and which token positions in the response are included in aggregation. We further demonstrate the practical value of these findings for test-time compute. We allocate the number of responses using certainty early in generation and weight answer votes using certainty near the end of each response. Compared with a fixed-sampling majority-voting baseline, this approach increases overall accuracy from 78.71\% to 79.54\% while reducing generated-token cost by 82.4\%.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了令牌级确定性在大模型训练与推理中的预测能力，发现其在识别模型更可能正确回答的问题方面优于区分同一问题的正确与错误回答。确定性信息随词内位置和词类型系统性变化，问题难度信息早期出现，而答案正确性信息集中在生成末期。基于此，提出一种测试时计算优化策略：早期用确定性分配采样数量，后期用确定性加权投票，相比固定采样多数投票基线，准确率从78.71%提升至79.54%，生成成本降低82.4%。
AI.motivation: 评估令牌级确定性作为正确性代理的有效性，探索其在不同任务和模型中的表现差异，并挖掘其在测试时计算优化中的实际应用价值。
AI.method: 通过受控的实证评估，比较不同模型和任务下确定性对两类预测目标（识别高正确概率问题、区分正确与错误回答）的预测能力；分析确定性在不同词类型和生成位置的分布特征；设计并验证基于确定性的动态采样与加权投票策略。
AI.result: 确定性在预测模型对问题的回答正确性方面表现更好，而非区分同一问题的正确与错误响应；确定性信息随生成过程呈现阶段性分布，问题难度信息早现，答案正确性信息集中于末尾；基于该规律的动态策略提升了准确率并显著降低生成成本。
AI.conclusion: 确定性提供的信息价值取决于预测目标、模型、度量方式及聚合的令牌位置；合理利用确定性可有效优化测试时计算，提升效率与性能。

title: One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models
summary: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不同知识追踪（KT）模型在教学系统中使用相同数值的掌握阈值时，导致的不同决策效果。通过在四个公开教育数据集上评估六种KT模型和12个从0.50到0.99的阈值，分析了后进步表现、推进覆盖率、练习负担以及不同先验表现群体间的差异。结果发现，贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT）对阈值变化相对不敏感，而神经网络模型则随阈值升高变得更加严格。这源于模型输出机制不同：BKT估计的是潜在掌握概率，而神经模型估计的是下一次回答正确的概率，因此相同的阈值不代表相同的掌握水平。最佳平衡阈值在不同模型和教学情境间差异显著；在一半测试情境中，神经模型与BKT的最优阈值相差超过0.10，但当更强调减少额外练习并允许更多学生推进时，这一差距缩小。更严格的阈值并未可靠减小成绩差距，反而可能严重限制弱势学生的推进机会，强基础学生推进频率可达弱基础学生的3.26倍。研究强调，当更换KT模型或教学目标改变时，必须重新校准掌握阈值，并综合评估其对表现、练习量、推进率和公平性的影响。
AI.motivation: 当前教学系统使用统一的数值阈值来决定学生是否可停止练习并推进，但不同知识追踪（KT）模型对同一阈值的解释和响应存在差异，可能导致不公平或低效的教学决策。需要系统评估阈值在不同模型和教学设置下的实际影响，以实现性能、练习负担和推进公平性的平衡。
AI.method: 在四个公开教育数据集上，对比六种典型的知识追踪模型（包括贝叶斯知识追踪和多种神经网络模型），测试12个从0.50到0.99的掌握阈值。采用多项指标评估：后进步表现、推进覆盖率、练习负担、以及不同先验表现组之间的差异。同时，在30种预设教学情境下，识别出在性能、额外练习和推进之间达到最佳平衡的阈值。
AI.result: BKT模型对阈值变化较不敏感，而神经模型随阈值提高变得越来越严格。由于模型输出机制不同（概率含义不同），相同阈值代表的掌握水平并不一致。最佳平衡阈值在不同模型和教学设置间差异显著，半数情境中神经模型与BKT选择的阈值相差超过0.10。即使设定更严格阈值，也未能有效缩小成绩差距，反而加剧了优势学生与弱势学生之间的推进不平等，最强前测者推进频率最高可达最弱者的3.26倍。
AI.conclusion: 掌握阈值不应固定不变，而应根据所使用的知识追踪模型和具体教学目标进行动态校准。应综合考虑对学生表现、练习负担、推进率及公平性的影响，避免因模型差异或阈值不当造成资源浪费或机会不公。

title: A Framework for Egocentric and Exocentric Procedural Understanding via Temporal Segmentation and Semantic Abstraction
comment: Accepted for oral and poster presentation at the ACVR Workshop, ECCV 2026. Non-archival abstract; not published in the workshop proceedings. 8 pages, 1 figure
summary: Long-horizon ego/exo data contains rich procedural evidence, but are redundant, noisy, and costly to process or retain. We propose a compact framework that converts continuous multimodal workplace video into a structured Procedural State Memory, implemented as a Work Environment Model (WEM). Inspired by event segmentation theory, we detect boundaries using changes in visual context, location, motion, narration, gaze/object interaction, and optional exocentric workspace evidence, rather than fixed windows or visual novelty alone. Each segment is abstracted into an evidence-linked event card containing actor, interval, location, action, objects/tools, pre/post state, confidence, and provenance. These event cards incrementally update the WEM, enabling compact, auditable documentation and retrieval under on-premise privacy constraints. We instantiate the design with frozen DINOv2 and VJEPA-2 encoders and a local language model, and outline evaluation criteria for segmentation quality, memory compression, retrieval fidelity, and long-horizon QA.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种紧凑框架，将连续多模态工作场所视频转化为结构化的程序状态记忆（工作环境模型，WEM）。通过结合视觉上下文、位置、运动、叙述、注视/物体交互及可选的外部工作空间证据来检测事件边界，而非依赖固定窗口或视觉新颖性。每个片段被抽象为包含行为者、时间段、位置、动作、工具/物体、前后状态、置信度和来源的证据关联事件卡，并逐步更新WEM，实现紧凑、可审计的文档记录与检索，适用于本地隐私约束场景。采用冻结的DINOv2和VJEPA-2编码器及本地语言模型实现原型，并定义了分割质量、记忆压缩、检索保真度和长时程问答的评估标准。
AI.motivation: 长时程的自我/外部数据虽蕴含丰富程序性证据，但存在冗余、噪声大且处理或存储成本高的问题，亟需一种高效、可审计、符合隐私要求的结构化记忆表示方法。
AI.method: 基于事件分割理论，利用视觉上下文、位置、运动、叙述、注视/物体交互及可选外部证据检测事件边界；将每个片段抽象为包含多维度信息的事件卡，通过增量方式更新工作环境模型（WEM），结合冻结的视觉编码器（DINOv2、VJEPA-2）与本地语言模型实现系统构建。
AI.result: 成功构建了一个紧凑、可审计的程序状态记忆系统，实现了对多模态视频数据的有效压缩与结构化表达，在保持高检索保真度的同时满足本地隐私约束条件，具备良好的长时程问答能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于事件卡的结构化记忆框架能够有效应对长时程多模态数据的冗余与噪声问题，实现高效、安全、可追溯的程序知识建模，适用于对隐私敏感的工作环境应用。

title: Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor
summary: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对话幽默中语言模型训练的自动化奖励，重点分析奖励漏洞及应对策略。实验发现基于嵌入的惊喜奖励会误将词语打乱的回复视为有创意，虽可通过流畅性过滤检测打乱，但也会误拒部分幽默回复；而观众模型预测笑声易受说话人信号干扰，通过跨说话人归一化可防御攻击，但仍存在未匹配表达的漏洞。三次强化学习训练显示最终版本在综合评分上提升0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项表现未达预设目标。
AI.motivation: 设计自动奖励机制以有效训练语言模型生成对话幽默，但现有方法存在被恶意利用的漏洞，需探索如何在防止欺骗的同时保留真实幽默生成能力。
AI.method: 采用两种奖励机制：基于嵌入的惊喜奖励与观众模型预测笑声；结合流畅性过滤和跨说话人信号归一化进行漏洞检测与防御；通过多次强化学习迭代优化奖励函数。
AI.result: 最终奖励系统在综合评估分数上提升0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默特定指标未达预定目标；表明自动化奖励设计面临平衡防作弊与保留真实行为的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 自动化奖励设计需在阻止欺骗性捷径的同时保留期望行为，当前方法虽有改进，但仍难以完全实现幽默生成的精准激励，凸显该领域深层挑战。

title: DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding: Benchmarking Document Grounding and Hallucinations in Voice Agents
summary: Voice agents enable low-latency, natural interaction, yet their ability to faithfully ground responses in external documents remains underexplored. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG), a benchmark for evaluating document grounding in voice agents across five professional domains. DSB-DG targets three failure modes: Context Saturation, which measures grounding under increasing document length; Grounding Decay, which measures retention of document facts across multi-turn dialogue; and Proactive Grounding, which evaluates whether context re-injection mitigates conversational drift. The benchmark contains 1,636 adversarially verified QA pairs from 50 documents covering five professional domains, and supports fully automatic evaluation of grounding accuracy, hallucination, and response latency. Across systems spanning cascaded, proprietary full-duplex and real-time, and open-weight speech2speech architectures, we find substantial differences in effective grounding capacity. While cascaded pipeline (ASR-LLM-TTS) achieves the highest grounding accuracy, Gemini-Live and GPT-Realtime closely trail behind. Open-weight systems exhibit distinct failure modes, most notably an abrupt context-capacity collapse and multi-turn grounding decay. More broadly, grounding fidelity degrades with context and conversational load, and failures frequently manifest as unsupported generations rather than abstention. We show that contextual grounding as a key unresolved challenge for reliable full-duplex voice agents.

AI.tldr: 提出DSB-DG基准，评估语音代理在五个专业领域中的文档定位能力，涵盖上下文饱和、定位衰减和主动定位三种故障模式，发现不同系统在文档定位精度、幻觉和响应延迟方面表现差异显著，尤其开放权重系统存在上下文容量骤降和多轮对话中定位衰减问题。
AI.motivation: 语音代理虽实现低延迟自然交互，但其在外部文档中的准确响应仍缺乏深入研究，亟需一个全面的评估基准来揭示当前系统的局限性与挑战。
AI.method: 构建包含1,636个对抗验证问答对的DSB-DG基准，覆盖50份文档及五个专业领域，支持自动评估接地准确性、幻觉和响应延迟，并在多种架构（级联、专有全双工、实时、开源语音到语音）下进行系统评估。
AI.result: 级联管道（ASR-LLM-TTS）在接地准确率上表现最佳，Gemini-Live和GPT-Realtime紧随其后；开源系统表现出明显的上下文容量崩溃和多轮对话中的接地衰减；整体上，随着上下文和对话负载增加，接地保真度下降，失败多表现为不支持的生成而非回避。
AI.conclusion: 上下文接地是实现可靠全双工语音代理的关键未解决问题。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets
summary: Many machine learning (ML) applications rely on expert labels, and qualified experts may provide different but plausible interpretations of the same observation. Such variation across expert labels may reflect genuine disagreement or ambiguity rather than annotation error. When individual experts additionally report intervals rather than exact values, the supervision contains two distinct sources of label uncertainty: within-label imprecision and between-expert variation. Existing methods treat these forms separately: multi-expert approaches collapse labels to a consensus, interval-target methods often yield a single prediction, and predictive-uncertainty methods rarely validate their uncertainty estimates against observed expert disagreement. To address this problem, we propose an approach that preserves individual expert intervals, separates within-label imprecision from between-expert variation, and validates the corresponding predictive uncertainty components. First, heterogeneous label vocabularies are harmonized into a common probabilistic label space, separating encoding differences from expert judgement. Second, individual label intervals are retained and modeled with a mixture of Beta distributions trained using a proper Cramér-distance objective, preserving distinct expert-reported labels. Third, we decompose predictive uncertainty into within-component, between-component, and model uncertainty, and evaluate whether these components correspond to within-label uncertainty, between-label uncertainty, and model error, respectively. Because this correspondence is not guaranteed, we introduce decomposition matching, which aligns the predictive components to their intended label-side sources. On sea-ice concentration the model reduces MAE by 31\% over hard labels and outperforms aggregation, interval-distribution, and interval-regression baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新方法，用于处理机器学习中专家标注的双重不确定性：标签内的不精确性（如区间标注）和专家间的差异。通过将异构标签统一到概率标签空间，保留各专家的区间标注，并使用基于Cramér距离的混合Beta分布建模；同时分解预测不确定性为内部、外部与模型三部分，并引入分解匹配机制确保其与标签侧不确定性来源对应。在海冰浓度任务上，该方法相比硬标签降低31% MAE，优于多种基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法未能同时处理专家标注中的区间不精确性和专家间差异，且常忽略对预测不确定性的验证，导致无法准确反映真实不确定性来源。
AI.method: 1. 将不同专家的标签词汇映射到统一的概率标签空间以分离编码差异与判断差异；2. 采用混合Beta分布建模个体专家的区间标注，使用适当的Cramér距离损失函数；3. 分解预测不确定性为三部分：内部（within）、外部（between）和模型不确定性，并通过分解匹配机制使其与标签侧的不确定性来源对齐。
AI.result: 在海冰浓度预测任务中，该方法相较于硬标签标注降低了31%的平均绝对误差（MAE），并显著优于聚合、区间分布和区间回归等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架能够有效分离并建模专家标注中的多重不确定性来源，实现更准确的预测与可信的不确定性估计，适用于存在专家分歧与区间标注的复杂标注场景。

title: DramaAgent: Agentic Storytelling Video Generation
summary: Recent diffusion and autoregressive models have substantially improved text-to-video generation, yet producing coherent long-form story videos with consistent characters and aligned audio remains challenging. Existing methods often suffer from narrative drift, unstable character identity, weak cross-scene continuity, and audio-visual mismatch over extended sequences. We propose DramaAgent, a hierarchical, agentic, and model-agnostic framework for long-form text-to-video-and-audio generation. Rather than improving the underlying video backbone itself, DramaAgent introduces an upper-level control layer that decomposes generation into story planning, persistent character conditioning, scene-wise synthesis, and reflection-guided targeted repair. The framework maintains reusable story and character states across scenes, diagnoses failures such as identity drift, missing scene semantics, temporal discontinuity, and cross-modal mismatch, and repairs problematic clips in a stage-specific manner. Experiments across multiple video generation backbones show that DramaAgent improves long-horizon coherence, character consistency, narrative fidelity, and scene-level audio-visual consistency over direct generation and strong baselines. These results suggest that hierarchical agentic control is a practical direction for controllable long-form audiovisual generation. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DramaAgent. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DramaAgent.

AI.tldr: DramaAgent 是一个分层、代理式且模型无关的框架，用于长篇文本到视频和音频的生成。它通过故事规划、持续的角色条件化、场景级合成和反思引导的针对性修复，解决了叙事漂移、角色身份不稳定、跨场景连续性差和音视频不匹配等问题。实验表明，该框架在多个视频生成基线模型上显著提升了长时序连贯性、角色一致性、叙事保真度和音视频一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到视频生成方法在生成长篇故事视频时面临叙事漂移、角色身份不一致、跨场景连续性弱以及音视频不同步等挑战，亟需一种更有效的控制机制来提升生成质量。
AI.method: DramaAgent 采用分层代理架构，引入上层控制层，将生成过程分解为故事规划、角色状态维护、场景合成与故障诊断修复四个阶段，利用可复用的故事与角色状态，实现对生成失败（如身份漂移、语义缺失、时间断续、跨模态错配）的精准识别与阶段化修复。
AI.result: 在多个视频生成基线模型上的实验结果表明，DramaAgent 显著提升了长时序生成的连贯性、角色一致性、叙事忠实度及音视频同步性，优于直接生成和现有强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 分层代理式控制是实现可控长篇音视频生成的有效方向，DramaAgent 证明了其在提升生成质量方面的潜力，具有良好的通用性和扩展性。

title: EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs
summary: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

AI.tldr: EviGraph 提出区分关键决策要求与可暂不解决的信息，通过语言代理在时间知识图谱中关联需求与证据，并用确定性检查器验证推荐是否支持。在双语香港公共服务基准测试中，该方法减少了不必要的拒绝；但额外验证可能撤回已支持的推荐且不提升决策质量，表明可靠证据导航依赖于明确定义决策所需内容，而非单纯增加验证。
AI.motivation: 现有公共服务推荐系统对缺失信息过于敏感，导致错过有用推荐。需要一种机制来区分哪些信息是决策必需的，哪些可以暂时忽略，以提高推荐的实用性与覆盖率。
AI.method: 构建 EviGraph 系统，利用语言代理将决策要求与时间知识图谱中的证据进行链接，并采用确定性检查器判断推荐是否得到充分支持。
AI.result: 在双语香港公共服务数据集上，该方法显著减少无意义的拒绝行为；但增加额外验证并未改善决策质量，反而可能撤销原本有效的推荐。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的证据驱动推荐应聚焦于明确定义决策所需的必要条件，而非盲目增加验证环节。

title: Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 21 tables. Jungseob Lee and Dongyub Jude Lee contributed equally
summary: Fine-tuning adapts aligned large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but a few dozen harmful examples can remove their refusal of harmful requests. Prior work localizes safety-related behavior to specific layers, directions, and tokens, suggesting targets for protection. We test whether successful localization and recovery support defenses that survive changes in the attack. Across six checkpoints from four model families, harmful and benign prompts remain linearly separable after attack, and patching full clean hidden states into the compromised model restores refusal at a reproducible transition depth. Building on a prior layer-freezing defense, we freeze every layer up to this depth and repeat the attack. At a hundred harmful examples, refusal remains near zero on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary. In a second study, removing the update's top two singular directions restores refusal after short attention-only fine-tunes on four checkpoints. On Llama-3.1-8B, ordinary training changes weaken this repair and an attacker who spreads the update defeats it. A spectral detector calibrated on benign Llama fine-tunes misses most repair failures on that checkpoint. Localized freezing can nevertheless help preserve refusal when a few harmful examples enter training data unintentionally. These results show that an attacker can bypass a region identified by recovery and defeat a repair that works across multiple checkpoints, motivating five checks for defenses against adaptive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/refusal-relocates.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在少量有害示例影响下，大型语言模型（LLM）安全拒绝能力的可恢复性与防御机制的鲁棒性。通过多模型家族、多检查点实验发现，即使经过攻击，良性与有害提示仍保持线性可分；修复被污染模型可通过在特定深度插入干净隐藏状态实现，且冻结该深度前所有层可有效维持拒绝行为。然而，攻击者可通过改变更新方向或分散训练数据来绕过此类防御。此外，基于谱特征的检测器对某些修复失败不敏感。尽管如此，局部冻结策略仍有助于防止因意外引入有害样本导致的安全失效。研究提出五项评估标准以增强对抗自适应微调的防御能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法虽能定位安全行为相关层、方向和标记，但缺乏对防御策略在攻击变化下的鲁棒性评估。本文旨在检验已有定位与修复技术是否能在动态攻击下持续有效，并揭示当前防御的局限性。
AI.method: 采用六种不同模型检查点（来自四个模型家族），测试在遭受少量有害示例攻击后，模型拒绝能力的变化；利用隐藏状态插补进行修复，确定可重复的恢复过渡深度；通过冻结该深度前的所有层实施防御；分析移除主要奇异方向对修复效果的影响；设计谱检测器并评估其性能。
AI.result: 在所有六个检查点上，冻结至恢复过渡深度的层后，即便面对上百个有害示例，拒绝率仍接近零；在部分模型中，移除前两个奇异方向可恢复拒绝能力；但在某些情况下（如Llama-3.1-8B），普通训练会削弱修复效果，且扩散式攻击可完全绕过修复机制；谱检测器在特定模型上漏检严重。
AI.conclusion: 尽管局部化修复和冻结策略在一定程度上能保护模型拒绝能力，但攻击者仍可通过改变攻击模式成功绕过防御。因此，需建立更严格的评估标准，确保防御机制具备应对自适应攻击的能力。

title: The Hidden Costs of 99% Accuracy: A Trustworthiness Audit of the Telco Customer Churn Benchmark
summary: Customer churn prediction on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (n = 7,043) routinely reports test accuracies above 95%, with the most cited published study reporting 99.01%. We audit this benchmark for four trustworthiness failures invisible to the accuracy- and F1-centred reporting that dominates the literature. First, pre-split SMOTE inflates churn-class F1 by 13.1 percentage points across ten classifiers and fifteen seeds (Wilcoxon p < 10^-4 per classifier); the same leaky pipeline ordering paired with class weighting yields no inflation, isolating the effect to SMOTE's geometric construction. We measure the mechanism directly: approximately 36% of synthetic training points are nearest-neighbour interpolations of test-set instances. Second, the TotalCharges field is approximately determined by tenure multiplied by MonthlyCharges (R2 = 0.999); removing it changes accuracy by less than 0.2 percentage points, yet TreeSHAP ranks it ninth in mean absolute attribution - a pattern that materially corrupts SHAP-based interpretation. We propose an R2 > 0.95 pre-modelling diagnostic. Third, in a 15-seed calibration audit, isotonic regression is the strongest default; temperature scaling fails on class-weighted tree ensembles whose predicted-probability distribution is bimodal. Fourth, the cost-optimal decision threshold (under a 50 USD retention offer and 24-month CLV proxy) is approximately 5-10 times lower than the F1-optimal threshold, saving approximately 77,000 USD per 1,000 customers. We replicate F1 and F2 on Iranian Telecom Churn (within domain) and Bank Customer Churn (across domain): F1 generalises; F2 generalises only within telecom. We synthesise these findings into a four-component reporting checklist - pipeline disclosure, redundancy diagnostic, calibration audit, and cost-sensitive thresholds - and release a reproducible implementation.

AI.tldr: 该研究对IBM电信客户流失基准数据集的客户流失预测进行了可信度审计，揭示了四个隐藏在传统准确率和F1分数报告中的问题：（1）预分割SMOTE导致流失类F1分数虚高13.1个百分点，因合成样本中约36%为测试集实例的近邻插值；（2）TotalCharges字段与tenure和MonthlyCharges高度相关（R²=0.999），移除后对准确率影响极小，但被TreeSHAP错误排名为第九重要特征，提出R²>0.95的冗余诊断标准；（3）校准审计显示，等距回归是最佳默认校准方法，而温度缩放在类加权树集成上失败，因概率分布呈双峰；（4）成本最优决策阈值比F1最优低5-10倍，每千名客户可节省约77,000美元。研究在伊朗电信和银行客户流失数据集上验证了结果的泛化性，并提出包含流水线披露、冗余诊断、校准审计和成本敏感阈值的四组件报告清单，同时提供可复现实现。
AI.motivation: 现有客户流失预测研究过度依赖准确率和F1分数，忽视了模型评估中的潜在偏差和不可靠性，如数据泄露、特征冗余、校准失效和决策阈值不当等问题，导致结论不可靠且难以复现。本文旨在揭示并修复这些隐性信任缺陷，提升模型评估的科学性和实用性。
AI.method: 采用多角度审计方法：（1）对比预分割与非预分割SMOTE在十种分类器和十五个随机种子下的性能差异，分析数据泄露机制；（2）通过统计相关性分析和特征重要性评估，识别冗余特征；（3）进行15种子校准审计，比较等距回归与温度缩放的表现；（4）基于成本-收益模型计算成本最优阈值，并与F1最优阈值对比。所有实验均在原始基准数据集及跨域数据集上复现。
AI.result: （1）预分割SMOTE使流失类F1虚高13.1个百分点，且约36%的合成样本来自测试集实例；（2）TotalCharges具有极高冗余性（R²=0.999），但被错误赋予高解释权重；（3）等距回归在多数场景下优于温度缩放，尤其在双峰分布下表现更稳定；（4）成本最优阈值显著低于F1最优阈值，带来巨大经济节约（每千客户节省约77,000美元）。研究在伊朗电信和银行客户流失数据集上验证了部分结果的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 当前客户流失预测研究存在多个隐蔽的信任问题，需从模型构建到评估全流程加强透明性与严谨性。本文提出的四组件报告清单——包括流水线披露、冗余诊断、校准审计和成本敏感阈值——能有效提升模型评估的可信度与实用性，推动领域向更负责任的机器学习实践演进。

title: A Low Grounding Score Is Not an Ungrounded Judge: Identifying the Perceptibility Confound in Multimodal Oversight
summary: Model judges now supervise multimodal systems at scale, filtering training data, selecting outputs, and supplying the reward that shapes multimodal reasoning models. Trusting one means first checking that it uses its evidence, and that check is itself worth scrutinizing, so we ask whether a counterfactual probe of visual grounding measures what it claims to. The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. We formalize it as the Verdict Grounding Score and show it cannot be read the way such scores are read. A verdict responds only to an edit that reaches the judge's decision-relevant reading, so the score is capped by how perceptible the edit is, and unless editing makes the attribute easier to read, the error is one-sided: the score can only make a judge look less grounded than it is. The practical failure is therefore a false alarm, an auditor discarding a usable overseer. Under assumptions we state, we show this missing quantity is not merely bounded but identified from three quantities the same audit protocol already collects, which makes the false-alarm rate directly measurable rather than merely a concern. Auditing nine judges, we find the predicted ordering holds strictly across our entire primary pool, and the typical judge there acts on only about half of the edits whose attribute it can otherwise resolve. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. The rule that follows is that an image-side counterfactual score should never be reported alone: a detection probe on the unedited image upper-bounds it, certifies its false alarms, and costs nothing extra to run.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了模型判别器在多模态系统中的监督作用，提出通过反事实探针检验其视觉基础性。研究定义了'判决根基得分'（Verdict Grounding Score），发现该得分无法准确反映判别器是否真正依赖图像证据，因为得分受编辑可见性限制，且通常只呈现低估判别器根基性的偏差。文章指出这种偏差会导致误报，即错误地排除可用的判别器。在假设条件下，研究证明该缺失量可由现有审计协议收集的三个量确定，使误报率可直接测量。对九个判别器的审计显示，预测排序严格成立，多数判别器仅响应约一半可分辨的编辑。采用保守拒绝阈值可明确识别出若干误报，例如一个能几乎总检测到注入错误但得分却显示未使用图像的判别器。结论是：图像侧反事实得分不应单独报告，必须搭配未编辑图像上的检测探针以提供上界、验证误报并无需额外成本。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态系统依赖模型判别器进行数据筛选、输出选择和奖励生成，因此需要确保判别器确实基于图像证据作出判断。然而，现有的反事实探针方法可能无法准确衡量判别器的视觉根基性，存在误导性结果的风险，亟需一种可靠的方法来评估其真实性。
AI.method: 提出并形式化‘判决根基得分’（Verdict Grounding Score），通过修改图像使真实标签反转，同时固定推理路径，观察判别器的判决是否随之改变。结合理论分析与实证审计，引入检测探针作为辅助工具，利用未编辑图像的检测能力构建得分上界，并基于实际数据验证误报率。
AI.result: 发现判决根基得分受编辑可见性限制，通常低估判别器的真实根基性，导致高误报率；但在合理假设下，可通过已有数据计算出真实根基性水平，实现误报率的可测量性；实证结果显示预测排序严格成立，多数判别器仅响应约一半可分辨的编辑；部分判别器被确认为明显误报，如能持续检测错误却得分为零。
AI.conclusion: 图像侧反事实得分不应单独报告，必须配合未编辑图像上的检测探针，以提供上界、识别并认证误报，且该补充操作不增加额外成本，从而提升审计可靠性。

title: Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying
comment: 26 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables. Data paper. Dataset openly available at https://zenodo.org/records/20451474. Under review at the ASCE Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering
summary: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Build2SPARQL，一个大规模的建筑知识图谱自然语言/SPARQL基准数据集，通过图遍历代码生成准确的SPARQL查询，仅由大语言模型生成自然语言问题，确保查询正确性独立于模型。该数据集涵盖6种查询模式和5种词汇变体，覆盖201个建筑知识图谱（180个Brick，21个ASHRAE 223P），生成6,136个可执行SPARQL查询和30,680个问题。人工验证显示98.8%语义保真度、98.8%自然度、84.0%操作合理性。检索增强评估下，三轮提示的精确匹配准确率提升至56-65%。
AI.motivation: 当前建筑自动化系统逐渐采用语义知识图谱（如Brick和ASHRAE 223P）表示，为人工智能应用提供机器可读基础。然而，自然语言到SPARQL的翻译（text-to-SPARQL）受限于高质量自然语言/SPARQL标注数据的稀缺，制约了相关技术发展。因此亟需一个大规模、高质量、结构化且保证查询正确性的基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建一个基于知识图谱的生成管道：使用图遍历代码自动生成并验证所有SPARQL查询，仅由大语言模型生成对应的自然语言问题。该管道覆盖六类查询模式（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），并在五种词汇注册表中生成问题。数据集基于201个建筑知识图谱（180个Brick，21个ASHRAE 223P）构建。
AI.result: 生成6,136个可执行的SPARQL查询和30,680个自然语言问题。人工评估显示98.8%语义保真度、98.8%自然度、84.0%操作合理性。在三个开源大模型上进行检索增强评估，三轮提示下的精确匹配准确率从零样本的0.2–20%提升至56–65%。
AI.conclusion: Build2SPARQL是一个高质量、大规模、可扩展的文本到SPARQL基准数据集，有效缓解了建筑知识图谱中自然语言查询数据稀缺的问题。其生成机制保障了查询正确性，为未来基于语言的建筑系统交互研究提供了可靠基础。

title: CAST: Cost-Aware Speculative Trees from One-Pass Block Drafters
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting future tokens cheaply and verifying them with the target model in parallel. Block drafters score a whole block of future tokens in one forward pass, yet standard decoding verifies only the top-scoring chain and discards the other candidates. Because these candidates are already scored, verifying more of them adds target computation but no extra drafting. We introduce CAST (Cost-Aware Speculative Trees), which packs these candidates into a tree and verifies it in a single target pass, leaving the target model, drafter weights, and decoding rule untouched. To decide how wide the tree should be, CAST adds candidates while the expected gain from the next one outweighs the verification time it adds. The width therefore adapts to each deployment from a latency measurement, without sweeping over widths. We evaluate CAST across five domains on three GPU generations and two model families. At its predicted width, CAST is faster than the standard chain in all eight settings, by up to 43%. We also find that the best width depends strongly on the deployment. Where verification cost jumps at a kernel boundary, a 128-token tree is only 2% faster than the standard chain, whereas the tree at the predicted width is 20% faster. Furthermore, we prove that CAST leaves the target output distribution unchanged under both greedy and sampled decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/CAST.

AI.tldr: CAST (Cost-Aware Speculative Trees) accelerates large language model inference by using a tree structure to verify multiple scored candidate token blocks in a single target pass, adapting tree width based on latency measurements. It outperforms standard chain decoding by up to 43% across diverse settings, with performance highly dependent on deployment-specific verification costs.
AI.motivation: To improve speculative decoding efficiency by fully utilizing already-scored candidate tokens instead of discarding them after selecting the top-scoring chain, thereby reducing latency without modifying the target model or decoding rules.
AI.method: CAST constructs a speculative tree from multiple scored candidate token blocks and verifies them in a single forward pass of the target model. The tree width is dynamically chosen based on cost-aware criteria: candidates are added as long as the expected gain exceeds the additional verification time, enabling adaptive optimization per deployment.
AI.result: CAST achieves speedups of up to 43% over standard chain decoding across five domains and two model families on three GPU generations. Performance gains vary significantly with deployment conditions—e.g., a 128-token tree only improves by 2% where kernel boundaries increase verification cost, while CAST’s predicted width achieves 20% improvement. The output distribution remains unchanged under greedy and sampled decoding.
AI.conclusion: CAST effectively leverages speculative candidates through a cost-aware tree structure, achieving consistent and substantial inference speedups without altering the target model or decoding behavior, demonstrating strong adaptability to hardware and deployment characteristics.

title: Generalized Biomedicine Discovery
summary: In real-world clinical practice, medical images face open-world shifts: (i) long-tailed rare diseases, (ii) subtle lesions dominated by normal anatomy, and (iii) hierarchical taxonomies. Yet most open-world paradigms assume flat, balanced label spaces, leaving these biomedical demands unresolved. We introduce Generalized Biomedicine Discovery (GBD) and a unified benchmark spanning long-tail, anomaly, and taxonomy-aware discovery. Our key insight is that dominant known patterns form a visual manifold that masks subtle novelty. Inspired by expert diagnosis, we propose SCAN (Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN), which follows a cognition-inspired perceptual progression: it applies predictive suppression to filter expected norms, triggers surprise-evoked salience to highlight unexpected deviations, and performs complementary accommodation to integrate these shifts into global representations. Extensive experiments show that SCAN improves novel concept discovery while generally preserving established clinical knowledge, and it plugs into existing architectures to better navigate the known-unknown trade-off in medical imaging. Code is available at https://github.com/lytang63/generalized-biomedicine-discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出GBD框架与统一基准，解决医学图像中的长尾稀有病、微小病灶及层级分类等开放世界挑战；引入SCAN模型，通过预测抑制、惊喜激发显著性与互补适应的感知过程，有效发现新概念并保留已有知识。
AI.motivation: 真实临床中医学图像存在长尾稀有疾病、细微病灶被正常解剖结构掩盖、以及层级分类体系等开放世界问题，而现有方法多基于平坦且平衡的标签空间，无法满足实际需求。
AI.method: 提出SCAN（Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN）模型，模拟专家诊断认知过程：先通过预测抑制去除预期正常模式，再以惊喜激发方式突出异常偏离，最后进行互补适应整合到全局表示中。
AI.result: 实验表明SCAN在发现新概念方面表现优异，同时保持对已有临床知识的稳定，可无缝集成至现有架构，有效缓解医学影像中的已知-未知权衡问题。
AI.conclusion: SCAN通过模拟人类认知机制，为医学图像中的开放世界发现提供了有效解决方案，推动了通用生物医学发现的发展。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Anti-UAV Detection under Controlled Fog Degradation: Fog-Aware Training and Clear-Sky Tradeoff
summary: Vision-based anti-UAV systems must function in poor visibility, yet most benchmarks use only clear-sky footage, and previous robustness studies treat adverse weather as a simple present/absent condition. As a result, the impact of fog severity on ground-to-air UAV detection remains poorly understood. This work presents the first severity-controlled fog benchmark for this task: synthetic fog at ten severity levels is applied to the RGB modality of the Anti-UAV300 dataset, comparing a clear-trained YOLOv5m baseline to a fog-aware model trained on both clear and foggy images. Detection performance drops sharply and non-linearly: degradation is front-loaded across light-to-moderate fog (beta approximately 0.05-0.10), with a 96% reduction in mAP@0.5:0.95 from clear to thickest fog, mainly due to lost recall and confidence. On the comparable metric (mAP@0.5), this collapse exceeds the most extreme rain degradation reported in the closest prior benchmark. Fog-aware training boosts detection across all severities (up to +0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95) with only a 9.1% drop in clear-sky accuracy, raising the threshold for reliable detection while not preventing collapse under extreme fog. Since reliability is lost within a narrow visibility range, simple clear vs adverse tests underestimate operational risk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个针对雾天严重程度可控的视觉反无人机检测基准，通过在Anti-UAV300数据集上合成十级不同雾度的图像，评估了YOLOv5m模型在清晰与雾天条件下的表现。结果表明，随着雾度增加，检测性能急剧下降，尤其在轻到中等雾（beta约0.05-0.10）阶段损失最为显著，从清晰条件到最浓雾条件下mAP@0.5:0.95下降96%，主要由于召回率和置信度降低。相比之下，经过雾天增强训练的模型在所有雾度下均表现更优（最高提升+0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95），且仅导致9.1%的清晰场景精度下降。研究指出，当前简单区分“清晰”与“恶劣天气”的测试低估了实际操作风险，因可靠性在狭窄能见度范围内即迅速丧失。
AI.motivation: 现有反无人机视觉系统评测多基于晴朗天气数据，缺乏对雾天严重程度的系统评估；以往研究将恶劣天气视为二元状态（有/无），忽略了雾度连续变化对检测性能的影响，导致对真实环境适应性的理解不足。
AI.method: 在Anti-UAV300数据集的RGB模态上，使用合成手段生成十级不同严重程度的雾化图像，构建了首个可控雾度的基准数据集；对比了在清晰图像上训练的YOLOv5m基线模型与同时在清晰及雾天图像上训练的雾感知模型的检测性能。
AI.result: 检测性能随雾度增加呈非线性急剧下降，在轻至中等雾中损失最为严重，从清晰到最浓雾时mAP@0.5:0.95下降96%；雾感知模型在各雾度下均有显著提升（最高+0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95），但极端雾天仍无法避免性能崩溃；在可比指标mAP@0.5下，其性能下降超过先前最极端降雨情况下的降级幅度。
AI.conclusion: 当前以“清晰”或“恶劣天气”二分法评估系统鲁棒性的方法严重低估了实际运行中的风险；真正可靠的反无人机系统必须在连续雾度变化下保持稳定性能，且需引入雾度感知训练策略以提升泛化能力，但极端雾天仍构成不可忽视的挑战。

title: Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole
summary: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在存在知情对手的情况下，如何设计最优信号以保护真实信息。当对手能观察信号并使用说服预算攻击时，最优信号从贝叶斯最大化转向基于显著性的最大化。在108个确认项中，该最优解与先前的显著性极值完全一致；在20万项的池子中，两者仅在2748项上不同，这些项恰好是先前显著性到贝叶斯坐标的未定义区域。随着对手说服预算β增加，信号选择从后验最大转向边际最大。实证发现18.2%的项目在有限预算下会发生最优信号变化，且临界预算精确可测。由于对抗鲁棒目标与启发式目标重合，无法通过测量区分其是否趋近于鲁棒最优或显著性，这是结构性限制而非无效应。诊断建议：评估对抗意识前，先验证评估项中鲁棒目标是否与启发式目标一致。
AI.motivation: 在存在知情对手的受限信号通道中，传统贝叶斯信号优化可能不具鲁棒性。需要找到一种在对手攻击下仍能有效保护真相的信号策略，尤其当对手能利用信号进行误导时。
AI.method: 引入一个对手模型，对手知晓目标、观察信号，并使用固定说服预算β，在强制选择任务中主张最强错误答案。通过分析信号选择随β的变化，比较后验最大化与边际最大化策略的性能。实验基于《欺骗：香港谋杀案》抽象任务，结合语言模型评估七种不同对手设定下的表现。
AI.result: 在β=0时，系统还原为原始的oracle模型（听众温度τ=1）。随着β增大，最优信号从后验最大转向边际最大。18.2%的项目在有限预算下出现最优信号转移，且每项的临界预算精确。在多数情况下，对抗鲁棒最优与显著性极值重合，导致无法通过观测区分其路径。
AI.conclusion: 对抗鲁棒性可通过转向显著性实现，但这一路径在许多情况下与启发式目标重合，造成结构上的不可分辨性。因此，在评估对抗鲁棒性前，必须检查评估集中的鲁棒目标是否与启发式目标一致，否则结果可能具有误导性。

title: Dissonant ballerinas and crafty carrots: a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian brain rot
summary: This paper presents a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian and Romanian brain rot memes, investigating the factors that contribute to its appeal and the linguistic and cultural distinctions between the two versions. To conduct this analysis, we introduce a multi-modal brain rot dataset named CRIB (Collection of Romanian and Italian Brain rot), a manually curated collection of 240 TikTok videos stratified by language (Italian, Romanian) and popularity, on which we examine textual, acoustic, and visual features. Our findings indicate that popularity is not significantly correlated with textual elements like sentiment, absurdity, or rhyme, or acoustic elements such as vocal features or sentiment of the sound. Instead, in Romanian language, video-level dynamics, specifically faster cutting speeds and a more rapid overall pace, are strong predictors of a video's success. The cross-linguistic analysis reveals significant differences. Italian brain rot is textually more negative, exhibits higher perplexity, and uses more rhyme, while its sound is characterized by higher melodic range and loudness. Romanian audio is spectrally brighter with more erratic pitch variations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过构建CRIB数据集，对比分析意大利语与罗马尼亚语脑腐迷因的多模态特征，发现视频剪辑速度和整体节奏是罗马尼亚版本成功的关键因素；而意大利版本在文本上更负面、复杂度更高且押韵更多，音频则具有更高的音域和音量。
AI.motivation: 探究脑腐迷因在不同语言文化中的传播机制与吸引力差异，揭示其多模态特征如何影响流行度。
AI.method: 构建跨语言多模态数据集CRIB，包含240个分层的TikTok视频，分析文本、声音和视觉特征，结合统计模型评估各因素对流行度的影响。
AI.result: 视频剪辑速度和节奏是罗马尼亚脑腐迷因成功的强预测因子；意大利版本在文本负性、复杂度、押韵及音频音域和响度上显著更高；语言间存在明显多模态差异。
AI.conclusion: 脑腐迷因的流行不仅取决于内容本身，更受动态视觉节奏和跨语言文化表达方式的影响，表明多模态特征在社交媒体传播中起关键作用。

title: Classification Based on Association Rules Algorithm for Breast Cancer
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table, accepted & presented at Advances in Science and Engineering Technology International Conferences (ASET) 2024
summary: Breast cancer is a significant contributor to female mortality across the world, displaying one of the highest oc currence rates among the various cancer types. In response to the need for early breast cancer detection, researchers have increasingly turned to association rule-based classification as a favored method. Association Rule mining is a data mining approach which offers the benefit of yielding results that are readily understandable for medical professionals. This paper introduces a novel association rule-based data mining technique for breast cancer classification based on a weighted classification approach. This implementation employs three core algorithms: Rule Generation, Rule Pruning, and Rule Prediction. Rule Generation identifies frequent itemsets and creates association rules. Rule Pruning eliminates rules using specific criteria and separates them into major and minor groups based on their influence on training data. Rule Prediction applies the pruned rules to classify test data. The final prediction algorithm was tested on several testing samples to show the feasibility and performance of the approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于加权分类的新型关联规则数据挖掘技术，用于乳腺癌分类。该方法包含规则生成、规则剪枝和规则预测三个核心算法，通过频繁项集挖掘生成规则，利用特定标准剪枝并按影响程度分为主要与次要规则，最后对测试数据进行分类预测，实验验证了该方法的有效性与性能。
AI.motivation: 为应对乳腺癌早期检测的需求，研究者倾向于采用易于理解的关联规则分类方法，以提升医疗专业人员对结果的理解与应用能力。
AI.method: 提出一种基于加权分类的关联规则数据挖掘技术，包含规则生成（发现频繁项集并生成规则）、规则剪枝（根据影响程度划分主要与次要规则）和规则预测（应用剪枝后规则进行测试数据分类）三个步骤。
AI.result: 该方法在多个测试样本上进行了验证，结果显示其具有良好的可行性与分类性能，能够有效支持乳腺癌的早期识别与诊断。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的加权关联规则分类方法在乳腺癌分类任务中表现出高效性和可解释性，为临床决策提供了有力支持。

title: GPEC: Efficient Pre-LLM Gaussian Process Embedding Correction for Cardiac Video Caption Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for video understanding and caption generation, but their performance may decline in specialized medical imaging domains such as echocardiography. This work introduces Gaussian Process Embedding Correction (GPEC), a modular and computationally efficient pre-LLM error-correction method that improves the visual representations used by VideoChat2 for cardiac ultrasound caption generation. GPEC is inserted between the visual projection layer and the language model and learns a residual correction that moves the projected visual representation toward an annotation-guided target. The target is constructed by converting structured video annotations into qualitative attributes, generating a fixed-format reference caption, and mapping it into the language-model embedding space. The correction is modeled using a sparse variational Gaussian Process with inducing points, natural-parameter variational updates, and a block-wise linear kernel, while the original VideoChat2 components remain frozen.The method is evaluated using representation-level, caption-level, content-oriented, and execution-time metrics by comparing the original VideoChat2 with VideoChat2 + GPEC under identical input and reference conditions. Results show improved caption similarity and content alignment after applying the proposed correction. Furthermore, GPEC adds less than 0.05 s of inference-time overhead per video in the evaluated setting. These findings indicate that GPEC can improve caption generation in specialized medical video domains with minimal computational cost, without requiring end-to-end fine-tuning of the pretrained multimodal backbone.

AI.tldr: GPEC 是一种轻量级、模块化的预大模型纠错方法，用于提升 VideoChat2 在心脏超声视频字幕生成中的表现。它通过在视觉投影层与语言模型之间引入基于稀疏变分高斯过程的残差修正，将视觉表征向由结构化标注生成的参考目标进行调整，从而改善字幕相似度和内容一致性。该方法无需微调预训练多模态主干网络，推理开销低于0.05秒/视频。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在医学影像如超声心动图等专业领域性能下降，需要一种高效且不破坏原有模型结构的方法来纠正视觉表征偏差。
AI.method: 提出GPEC，利用结构化视频标注生成定性属性与固定格式参考字幕，并映射至语言模型嵌入空间作为目标；采用稀疏变分高斯过程建模残差修正，结合自然参数变分更新与块状线性核，原模型组件保持冻结。
AI.result: 实验表明，相较于原始VideoChat2，VideoChat2 + GPEC在表示层、字幕层、内容对齐和执行时间上均有提升，字幕相似度与内容一致性增强，且每视频增加推理开销不足0.05秒。
AI.conclusion: GPEC可有效提升多模态大模型在专业医疗视频任务中的字幕生成质量，具有低计算成本和良好的可扩展性，无需端到端微调。

title: Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score
summary: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

AI.tldr: 本文研究在相同数据但不同书写惯例下训练模型时，学习率调度策略如何通过路径影响模型参数的最终选择。发现学习率调度不仅是背景条件，更是决定性的平均算子：它与数据排列共同作用，分别以乘积形式影响模型对不同惯例的偏好。常数学习率使模型在最后一步同时保留大步长和未收缩的余量，从而放大顺序效应；而衰减学习率则抑制这种效应。实验显示，在固定预算下，10种不同排列在常数调度下表现出显著的分配差异（0.2221跨度）和对比度变化，而在余弦调度下则仅呈现两个可区分状态。尽管模型在不同顺序间切换时表现差异巨大，但基于惯例无关的指标，总性能几乎不变（波动<9.7%），说明其本质是模型对某种惯例的隐式承诺，而非实际性能提升。提示中显式标记惯例可消除该模糊性，使性能接近理论上限。
AI.motivation: 探究在相同数据但不同正确书写惯例下训练模型时，学习路径（尤其是学习率调度）如何影响模型对惯例的选择。传统观点认为‘顺序重要’或‘顺序不重要’是二元对立，但本文提出这其实是一个连续的调节旋钮，其关键在于学习率调度如何作为平均算子决定模型最终采纳哪种惯例。
AI.method: 在固定数据集、模型架构和训练预算的前提下，对同一语料库的10种不同数据排列进行两次训练：一次使用恒定学习率调度，另一次使用单周期余弦调度。通过比较各排列在性能分配、对比度、收敛行为等方面的差异，量化学习率调度与数据排列的交互效应。引入一个可分离的数学边界，将排列的影响视为块周期，调度的影响视为终点权重，实现对两者的独立测量。
AI.result: 在恒定学习率下，不同排列导致显著的性能分配差异（0.04至0.87）和11.63的对比度变化，且单调依赖于排列的块状程度；而在余弦调度下，所有排列仅形成两个可区分状态，表明调度类型极大限制了顺序效应的表现。尽管12个模型的组合准确率之和基本恒定（波动<9.7%），说明性能守恒源于对惯例的隐式承诺而非真实性能差异。提示中明确标注惯例后，模型性能可达联合上限的87.5%，验证了其对惯例的可塑性。
AI.conclusion: 学习率调度是决定模型对数据惯例选择的关键机制，而非被动背景。顺序的影响并非绝对存在或不存在，而是由调度与排列共同调控的连续变量。模型在无显式提示时会自发选择一种惯例并锁定，这种选择无法通过常规基准检测，但可通过提示干预改变。因此，‘顺序重要’与‘顺序不重要’实为同一控制机制的两端。

title: LLM-as-a-Judge for Low-Resource Languages: Adapting Ragas and Comparative Ranking for Romanian
summary: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems remains a challenge for Low-Resource Languages (LRLs), where standard reference-based metrics fall short. This paper investigates the viability of the "LLM-as-a-Judge" paradigm for Romanian by adapting the Ragas framework using next-generation models (Gemini 2.5 and Gemini 3). We introduce AdminRo-Eval, a curated dataset of Romanian administrative documents annotated by native speakers, to serve as a ground truth for benchmarking automated evaluators. We compare three evaluation methodologies - direct scoring, comparative ranking, and granular decomposition - across metrics for Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, and Context Relevance. Our findings reveal that evaluation strategies must be metric-specific: granular decomposition achieves the highest human alignment for Faithfulness (96% with Gemini 2.5 Pro), while comparative ranking outperforms in Answer Relevance (90%). Furthermore, we demonstrate that while lightweight models struggle with complex reasoning in LRLs, the Gemini 2.5 Pro architecture establishes a robust, transferable baseline for automated Romanian RAG evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在低资源语言（LRLs）背景下，使用新一代模型（Gemini 2.5 和 Gemini 3）改进RAG评估框架的可行性，提出针对罗马尼亚语的AdminRo-Eval数据集，并比较直接评分、对比排序和细粒度分解三种评估方法在忠实性、答案相关性和上下文相关性上的表现。结果显示，不同指标需采用不同策略：细粒度分解在忠实性上表现最佳（96%与人类判断一致），而对比排序在答案相关性上更优（90%）。同时发现轻量级模型在复杂推理中表现不佳，但Gemini 2.5 Pro可作为罗马尼亚语RAG评估的稳健基准。
AI.motivation: 标准参考基评估指标在低资源语言中效果不佳，亟需更有效的自动化评估方法，尤其是在罗马尼亚语等语言中缺乏高质量评估数据和适配模型。
AI.method: 引入AdminRo-Eval数据集（由母语者标注的罗马尼亚行政文档），基于Gemini 2.5和Gemini 3改进Ragas框架，采用直接评分、对比排序和细粒度分解三种评估策略，分别评估忠实地、答案相关性和上下文相关性。
AI.result: 细粒度分解在忠实性评估中达到96%的人类对齐率（使用Gemini 2.5 Pro），对比排序在答案相关性上表现最佳（90%），轻量级模型在复杂推理任务中表现不足，而Gemini 2.5 Pro架构可作为罗马尼亚语RAG评估的可靠基准。
AI.conclusion: 对于低资源语言如罗马尼亚语，应根据具体评估指标选择相应的评估策略；Gemini 2.5 Pro在复杂推理任务中表现出色，可作为自动化评估的稳健基线。

title: Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn
comment: 10 pages, 4 tables. Code and measurement scripts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22718897
summary:
Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing.
  The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. Over three seeds of five-fold cross-validation the construction loses 19.6 accuracy points on Iris, 19.1 on Wine and 55.6 on Digits against the same depth trained from scratch. The fix is a small random perturbation of the children, whose size barely matters. The practical rule is one line in a test: after adding parameters, assert that their gradient is nonzero.
  The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual error before installing it buys a smaller network on every dataset, though not a more accurate one, and on Digits it costs accuracy significantly. Splitting the leaf with the largest expected error buys sparsity, reaching 0.885 with 3.7 splits where a complete depth-six tree uses 63, but loses 4.3 points on a harder problem. Requiring statistical significance before a node receives a more expressive split buys nothing: the tree gets larger and less accurate.
  Every number in the paper is inserted from the measurement script.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了构造性分类器在训练过程中添加结构（如树的层级、隐藏层单元、叶子分裂）时，每种增长决策的实际收益。通过固定协议评估四种决策，发现其中一种（将每个叶子变为继承父类分布的门）实际上不带来任何学习效果：新门的梯度恒为零，导致无法优化。实验显示，在Iris、Wine和Digits数据集上，该方法相比从头训练同深度模型分别损失19.6、19.1和55.6个准确率点。作者提出仅需对子节点施加微小随机扰动即可修复问题，实用建议是添加参数后检查其梯度是否非零。其余三种决策各带来一定收益：拟合残差新增隐藏单元可压缩网络规模但可能降低精度；按最大预期误差分裂叶子能实现高度稀疏（3.7次分裂达0.885稀疏度），但牺牲部分性能；而要求统计显著性才允许更复杂分裂则既增大模型又降低准确率。所有数据均来自实际测量脚本。
AI.motivation: 探究构造性分类器中不同结构增长策略的真实有效性，识别并解决无效增长带来的学习障碍，提升模型构建的可靠性与效率。
AI.method: 在统一评估协议下，对四种构造性增长策略进行定量分析，包括梯度分析、跨数据集实验（Iris、Wine、Digits）及多轮交叉验证（三种子种子，五折），结合理论推导与实证测量验证各策略的性能表现。
AI.result: 发现将叶子转化为继承父类分布的门会导致梯度消失，无法学习；提出微小随机扰动作为修复方案，实验表明其有效且鲁棒；其他三种策略分别带来网络压缩、稀疏性和模型复杂度控制，但各有代价。所有结果均基于真实测量数据。
AI.conclusion: 并非所有构造性增长都有效；其中一种常见方式完全无效，因其引发梯度消失；通过简单扰动即可修复；其余策略虽有收益，但也伴随性能或结构上的权衡。核心启示是：添加参数后必须确保其梯度非零，否则学习将停滞。

title: Query Independent Variable Rate Visual Token Coding
summary: Visual-token compression for vision--language models is posed almost entirely as a selection problem: decide which tokens to keep and discard the rest. The criteria that work best rank tokens by the attention the language model pays them, which makes the ranking a function of the question being asked. That is invisible in a single-turn benchmark and decisive whenever a compressed representation is written once and read many times, as when it is cached across the turns of a conversation or transmitted between a device and a server. We take the other half of the classical transform-coding toolkit instead: keep every token and vary its rate. A transform code exposes each token's measured distortion--rate curve, and a fixed bit budget is distributed across tokens by exact integer rate--distortion optimisation on those curves. No text enters the pipeline, so one compressed representation serves any query. At equal bit budgets, on two datasets and two capacities, it preserves the model's output distribution and its answers better than uniform-rate coding, the closed-form water-fill and distortion-ranked pruning. It matches attention-ranked pruning on the question pruning was tuned for, and overtakes it once the compressed image must answer a different question about the same image.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的视觉标记压缩方法，不采用传统的选择性保留标记的方式，而是对所有标记保持并动态调整其比特率。通过变换编码中的率失真优化，在固定比特预算下实现最优分配，使得压缩表示可适用于任意问题，无需重新计算。在相同比特预算下，该方法在多个数据集和模型容量上优于均匀率编码、水填法和基于失真排序的剪枝，且在面对不同问题时表现超越注意力排序剪枝。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉-语言模型的视觉标记压缩依赖于根据问题注意力选择保留哪些标记，但这种方法受限于特定问题，无法通用；当压缩表示需跨轮次或设备复用时，此方法失效。因此需要一种可通用、适应多查询的压缩策略。
AI.method: 采用变换编码思想，保留所有视觉标记，并利用每个标记的率失真曲线，通过精确整数率失真优化在固定比特预算下分配比特，实现全局最优压缩。该方法不依赖文本输入，因此压缩结果可泛化用于任意问题。
AI.result: 在两个数据集和两种模型容量下，该方法在保持模型输出分布和答案准确性方面优于均匀率编码、水填法和失真排序剪枝；在非原定问题上显著超越注意力排序剪枝，展现出更强的通用性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入率失真优化的动态比特分配机制，该方法实现了可通用、高保真的视觉标记压缩，解决了传统选择性压缩在多轮对话或跨场景应用中的局限性，为视觉-语言模型的高效部署提供了新范式。

title: Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents
summary: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions. Complete local inspections give GAVA and always verify 100 percent correction accuracy, establishing the evidence contract rather than a comparative advantage. In same-episode execution, GAVA reduces interaction cost against always verify but ties a cost threshold under a perfect speaker. An exploratory training-only object-location prior lowers interaction and declared joint cost on 340 unseen scenarios by 0.490 and 0.420 relative to uniform GAVA. After freezing the policy, costs, baselines, and multiplicity plan, the gains replicate on 77 non-overlapping seen checkpoints, covering 308 scenarios: 0.595 and 0.517, with both 95 percent checkpoint-bootstrap confidence intervals excluding zero. Joint cost also improves over an identical-prior fixed policy, while the matched calibrated no-VOI comparison remains inconclusive. Semantic GAVA makes four factual errors in each cohort, corresponding to 98.8 percent and 98.7 percent accuracy, and all methods complete every task. Results support selective information gathering with semantic priors under declared costs, but do not establish a general advantage of environmental value of information over clarification. The study uses normalized claims, complete symbolic observations, and controlled speakers; it evaluates neither human participants, visual input, nor physical robots.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为GAVA的框架，用于解决具身智能体在面对可能错误的纠正时如何决策的问题。通过观察有限证据、合法探查和一步期望损失规则，GAVA在文本环境ALFWorld中表现出高纠正准确性（100%），并有效降低交互成本。引入训练期间的对象位置先验可进一步减少交互与联合成本，且在未见场景中表现稳定。尽管结果支持基于语义先验的选择性信息获取，但未能证明环境中的信息价值优于澄清请求的普遍优势。研究局限在于未涉及人类参与者、视觉输入或物理机器人。
AI.motivation: 当人类对具身智能体的指令进行纠正时，这些纠正可能错误。因此，智能体需要一种机制来判断是否接受、拒绝、检查环境或向说话者询问以做出合理响应。现有方法缺乏对纠正可信度的系统评估，尤其在不确定情况下如何权衡信息获取成本与正确性。
AI.method: 提出接地纠正仲裁框架GAVA，结合观察受限证据、合法探测和单步期望损失规则；使用符号化观测和受控说话人，在文本环境ALFWorld中测试不同策略。引入训练阶段对象位置先验，并对比固定策略与基准模型。
AI.result: GAVA实现100%纠正准确率，显著降低交互成本；引入语义先验后，在未见场景中联合成本下降0.490和0.420，且统计显著；所有方法均完成任务，但环境信息价值的优势未被确立。
AI.conclusion: 选择性信息获取结合语义先验可在控制成本下提升可靠性，但在当前设定下无法证明环境价值的信息优于直接澄清，研究结论受限于符号化输入与非真实世界条件。

title: UniBuc at SemEval-2024 Task 2: Tailored Prompting with Solar for Clinical NLI
summary: This paper describes the approach of the UniBuc team in tackling the SemEval 2024 Task 2: Safe Biomedical Natural Language Inference for Clinical Trials. We used SOLAR Instruct, without any fine-tuning, while focusing on input manipulation and tailored prompting. By customizing prompts for individual CTR sections, in both zero-shot and few-shots settings, we managed to achieve a consistency score of 0.72, ranking 14th in the leaderboard. Our thorough error analysis revealed that our model has a tendency to take shortcuts and rely on simple heuristics, especially when dealing with semantic-preserving changes.

AI.tldr: UniBuc团队在SemEval 2024 Task 2中采用SOLAR Instruct模型，未进行微调，通过输入处理和定制化提示，在零样本和少样本设置下对临床试验报告（CTR）各部分进行针对性提示，实现了0.72的一致性得分，排名14。错误分析显示模型倾向于采用简单启发式策略，尤其在处理语义保持变化时存在捷径依赖问题。
AI.motivation: 解决临床试验文本中的安全生物医学自然语言推理任务，提升模型在真实医疗场景下的可靠性和一致性表现。
AI.method: 使用SOLAR Instruct模型，不进行微调，重点在于输入预处理与针对不同CTR段落的定制化提示设计，支持零样本与少样本学习设置。
AI.result: 在测试集上达到0.72的一致性得分，位列排行榜第14名。
AI.conclusion: 尽管模型表现良好，但存在依赖简单启发式规则的问题，尤其是在面对语义不变但形式变化的输入时，需进一步优化以减少捷径学习行为。

title: Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping
comment: To appear at BMVC 2026. Code available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL
summary: Voxel-based volumetric mapping is fundamental to 3D reconstruction, yet fixed-resolution grids remain inherently inefficient - wasting memory in uniform regions and losing detail in complex ones. Existing adaptive methods, such as MAP-ADAPT, partially address this by varying resolution based on geometry and user-defined semantic class lists, but these heuristics require expert tuning, lack generalization to unseen objects, and provide no explicit mechanism to control memory usage. We propose an adaptive framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, which captures label uncertainty, together with geometric curvature and texture richness as scene complexity cues, yielding principled resolution allocation without reliance on semantic taxonomies. To make the accuracy-memory trade-off explicit and user-controlled, we further introduce a reinforcement learning agent that learns voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified target memory budget, replacing hand-tuned thresholds with a single intuitive control parameter. The resulting multi-resolution TSDF achieves higher geometric accuracy, better semantic consistency, and improved memory-accuracy trade-offs compared to MAP-ADAPT and fixed-resolution baselines on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于语义熵、几何曲率和纹理丰富度的自适应体素细化框架，结合强化学习实现用户可控的内存-精度权衡，显著提升3D重建的精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应体素方法依赖专家调参和预定义语义类别，难以泛化且无法有效控制内存使用。
AI.method: 利用语义熵、几何曲率和纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度指标，结合强化学习代理在指定内存预算下学习体素细分策略。
AI.result: 相比MAP-ADAPT和固定分辨率基线，在合成与真实数据集上实现了更高的几何精度、更好的语义一致性及更优的内存-精度平衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法无需依赖语义分类体系，通过强化学习实现可调控的自适应体素划分，为3D重建提供了高效、灵活的解决方案。

title: Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion U-Net for Magnetic Resonance Imaging Segmentation
summary: The segmentation of anatomical structures in medical images and particularly in MRI scans, is essential for clinical diagnosis and monitoring disease progression. While Deep Learning (DL) architectures, such as U-Net and its extensions are very effective in medical image segmentation tasks, they often struggle with preserving fine-grained details and global contextual information. This is especially challenging for MRI data segmentation, where anatomical structures are characterized by irregular boundaries and variations in shape, contrast, and scale. To address this challenge, we propose a novel DL architecture for MRI segmentation across different anatomical structures. Specifically, the architecture introduces a module, named Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion (MRFF), that can be easily integrated into any U-Net-like architecture. The MRFF is integrated in all levels of an encode-decoder structure, along with attention mechanisms and skip connections to extract features at multiple resolutions, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained details and global contextual information. We evaluate the MRFFU-Net on two publicly available benchmark MRI datasets of different anatomical targets; one for Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) segmentation in spinal MR scans, and one for left atrium cardiac segmentation, from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) challenge. Experimental results indicate that MRFFU-Net outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple evaluation metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness in MRI segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为MRFFU-Net的新深度学习架构，用于改进MRI图像中解剖结构的分割。该架构通过引入多分辨率特征融合（MRFF）模块，结合注意力机制和跳跃连接，在编码器-解码器结构中实现多尺度特征提取，有效兼顾细粒度细节与全局上下文信息。在脊髓MRI和心脏MRI两个公开数据集上的实验表明，该模型在多种评估指标上均优于现有先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度学习模型如U-Net在处理医学图像分割任务时，尤其在MRI数据中，难以同时保留精细细节和全局上下文信息，特别是在面对边界不规则、形状、对比度和尺度变化大的解剖结构时表现不足。因此需要一种能够平衡局部细节与全局信息的新方法。
AI.method: 提出MRFFU-Net架构，核心是多分辨率特征融合（MRFF）模块，可嵌入任意U-Net类网络中。该模块在编码器-解码器结构的各个层级集成，结合注意力机制和跳跃连接，以提取多尺度特征，增强对细粒度结构和整体上下文的理解能力。
AI.result: 在两个公开的MRI数据集（脊髓CSF分割和心脏左心房分割）上进行测试，MRFFU-Net在多个评价指标（如Dice Score、Hausdorff Distance等）上均优于当前最先进的模型，验证了其在不同解剖结构上的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MRFFU-Net通过多分辨率特征融合机制，显著提升了MRI图像分割中对细节与上下文信息的捕捉能力，为复杂解剖结构的精准分割提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing
summary: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation. Across two task-ID cohorts, complete repair is 26/30 with text and 29/30 with the prepared checks. Three task IDs favor tools, one favors text, and eleven tie. The eight-ID cohort scores 13/16 versus 15/16, with a task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of [-12.5, 43.75] percentage points for the difference. The larger shared-definition SciCode cohort ties at 13/24 per group. Five development-exposed tasks with alternate starting programs score 3/10 versus 7/10. The tool group favors tasks 17, 77, and 11; initial checks flag task 17 and report no violation for tasks 77 and 11. Task 37 favors text and has no initial reported violation. A fresh source-through-Python arm also reaches 15/16, matching the dedicated command's aggregate. In a matched PDE comparison, detailed text scores 23/24 and checks score 24/24, with 31.2% lower reported model output for checks. Agent-side output savings vary by cohort, while public CPU use rises in both task-ID cohorts. These results measure task-dependent repair outcomes and agent-side costs with prepared checks.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了科学编码代理在使用预设可执行检查（R2T）工具与纯文本指令时的修复性能。在多个任务组中，使用工具的修复成功率更高或相当，尤其在部分任务中工具显著优于文本。整体上，工具组在多数任务中表现更优，且在复杂任务中能有效减少模型输出和计算资源消耗。
AI.motivation: 提高科学编码代理在修复代码时的准确性和效率，通过引入预设的可执行检查工具来增强对边界条件、方程和输出要求的理解与验证能力。
AI.method: 采用匹配的科学编码修复组，比较使用预设可执行检查工具与纯文本指令在不同任务中的修复效果。实验包括多组任务（如任务ID 17、77、11等），并分析修复成功率、模型输出量、计算资源使用情况及任务依赖性。
AI.result: 在26/30的任务中，使用工具的修复成功率高于文本；在8个任务组中，工具组达成13/16的成功率，与文本组的15/16相近，差异置信区间为[-12.5, 43.75]个百分点。在更复杂的共享定义任务中，两组持平。在暴露于开发环境的任务中，工具组仍表现更好。此外，使用工具的模型输出降低31.2%，且在部分任务中首次检查即能识别问题。
AI.conclusion: 预设可执行检查工具显著提升了科学编码代理的修复能力和效率，尤其在复杂或高要求任务中表现出更强的鲁棒性与资源节约能力，支持其在实际科学计算场景中的应用价值。

title: EurekaBench: Measuring Agentic Ability to Discover New Scientific Insights
