summary: When Isaac Newton discovered the law of gravitation, he did so through an iterative process of analyzing observed data such as planetary patterns, finding the underlying mechanisms by describing patterns in mathematical equations, and refining his theory against the Moon's orbit, revealing the startling insight that the same force governs both falling apples and orbiting planets. Would it be possible for AI agents to make similar discoveries? To measure this ability, we introduce EurekaBench, a cross-domain benchmark that tests AI agents' ability to conduct long-horizon experiments and discover mechanisms that explain observations. We evaluate these mechanisms by the scientific insights that can be derived from them. EurekaBench contains an expert-verified set of 26 long-horizon tasks across neuroscience, computer science, chemistry, astrophysics, geophysics, and plasma physics, with a total of 306 scientific insights that the discovered mechanisms are expected to support. Our evaluation framework tests three axes of scientific discovery: agents' ability to follow known scientific constraints, the predictive accuracy of the discovered mechanisms, and whether these mechanisms yield scientific insights or inform future research. Our results show that current AI agents often overly fixate on predictive accuracy optimization, surpassing human scientists, while falling substantially short in deriving scientific insights.

AI.tldr: EurekaBench 是一个跨领域的基准测试，用于评估 AI 代理在长周期实验中发现解释观测现象机制的能力。该基准包含 26 个专家验证的任务，覆盖多个科学领域，共 306 个科学洞察点。评估框架从遵循科学约束、预测准确性及产生科学洞见三个维度衡量发现能力。结果显示，当前 AI 代理在预测精度上超越人类科学家，但在生成科学洞见方面表现显著不足。
AI.motivation: 探索 AI 是否能像牛顿一样通过观察数据、建立数学模型并不断验证来发现自然界的基本规律，从而推动科学发现的自动化。
AI.method: 构建 EurekaBench 基准，涵盖多学科长期任务，设计评估框架，从科学约束遵守性、预测准确性和科学洞见生成三个维度对 AI 代理进行评测。
AI.result: AI 代理在预测准确性上优于人类科学家，但在揭示科学机制和产生深层科学洞察方面明显不足，表现出对优化预测的过度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 尽管 AI 在模式识别和预测方面表现出色，但要实现真正的科学发现，仍需突破对预测性能的单一追求，发展出理解机制与生成可解释科学洞见的能力。

title: Energy Time-Series Imputation with Differentially Private Diffusion Models via Clipping-Aware Objective Conditioning
summary: Reliable recovery of missing measurements is important for monitoring and analysis in energy time-series systems, where fine-grained measurements may contain sensitive temporal information. Diffusion models trained with differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) provide a promising framework for privacy-sensitive energy time-series imputation. Under cosine diffusion schedules, late timesteps correspond to low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, where standard $\varepsilon$-prediction can induce large pre-clipping gradients. Such gradients are more likely to be clipped, reducing the retained optimization signal. The artificial intelligence (AI) contribution lies in formulating this objective--clipping interaction as an objective optimization problem under fixed-threshold DP-SGD and developing timestep-aware objective conditioning for diffusion-based energy time-series imputation. The method adopts $v$-prediction to mitigate late-timestep gradient amplification, uses static loss weighting as a uniform-scaling control, and introduces diffusion-schedule-aware dynamic weighting for stronger attenuation before clipping. For the engineering application, we evaluate the method on five real-world energy time-series datasets across random point missingness, contiguous block missingness, persistent outages, and multiple missing-data severities. Under matched DP-SGD settings, the proposed method consistently improves imputation utility over the $\varepsilon$-prediction baseline. Gradient diagnostics reveal lower upper-tail pre-clipping gradient norms, reduced clipping fractions, and stronger attenuation at late low-SNR timesteps, supporting the effectiveness of clipping-aware objective conditioning for energy time-series imputation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对能源时间序列缺失数据填补的差分隐私方法，通过改进扩散模型中的目标函数以应对晚期时间步低信噪比条件下的梯度截断问题。采用v-prediction机制缓解梯度放大，结合静态损失加权与扩散调度感知的动态加权策略，实现对截断前梯度的有效控制。在五个真实能源数据集上验证了该方法在随机缺失、连续块缺失、持续中断等多种场景下的优越性能，显著提升隐私保护下的数据恢复质量。
AI.motivation: 在能源时间序列系统中，精细测量数据包含敏感时间信息，需在隐私保护下进行可靠缺失值恢复。传统基于ε-预测的扩散模型在低信噪比的晚期时间步易产生大梯度，导致梯度截断严重，削弱优化信号。因此，亟需设计一种能有效应对梯度截断影响的隐私感知填补方法。
AI.method: 采用v-prediction机制减轻晚期时间步的梯度放大；引入静态损失加权作为统一缩放控制；设计扩散调度感知的动态加权策略，在截断前实现更强的梯度衰减。整体构成一种面向差分隐私训练的、具备截断感知的目标函数条件化机制。
AI.result: 在五种真实能源时间序列数据集上，所提方法在匹配的DP-SGD设置下，均优于ε-预测基线，表现出更高的数据恢复精度。梯度分析显示，预截断梯度范数降低，截断比例减少，尤其在晚期低信噪比阶段有更优的衰减表现，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功将梯度截断与目标函数设计相结合，提出了一种适用于差分隐私保护下的能源时间序列缺失数据填补方法，显著提升了隐私约束下的数据恢复性能，为敏感时序数据的安全分析提供了新思路。

title: LENS-GRF: Permutation-Invariant Lesion Evidence Network with Gated Residual Fusion for Acne Severity Grading and Multi-Rater Clinical Oracle Analysis
comment: Submitted to Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine (Elsevier)
summary: Automated acne severity grading requires both whole-face context and fine-grained lesion evidence. We propose LENS-GRF (Lesion Evidence Network with Set-Transformer and Gated Residual Fusion), an interpretable multi-stage framework for four-class acne severity grading. The method combines Adaptive Facial Skin Segmentation and a global Vision Transformer prior with a permutation-invariant Lesion Set Transformer that encodes localized lesion patches and spatial geometry. Gated Residual Fusion adaptively controls the local residual contribution and reduces to the global prediction when the gate is zero. On ACNE04, fully automated LENS-GRF with YOLOv11s achieved 80.82% accuracy; with ground-truth lesion annotations, it achieved 95.89% +/- 0.59% accuracy and a Quadratic Weighted Kappa of 0.9753. A data-integrity audit identified 15 cross-split duplicate image pairs, including five with conflicting severity labels. In locked zero-shot evaluation on the full PLSBRACNE01 cohort (200 subjects, 600 views), automated LENS-GRF achieved 35.00% accuracy versus 42.50% for the global baseline. On the 148-subject common cohort used for three-dermatologist oracle analysis, ground-truth lesion inputs increased the best oracle accuracy to 47.97%, while the highest oracle QWK was 0.5799. Pairwise oracle agreement ranged from 49.32% to 66.22%, highlighting detector domain shift, annotation variability, and cross-criterion mismatch.

AI.tldr: LENS-GRF 是一种用于四类痤疮严重程度分级的可解释多阶段框架，结合了自适应面部皮肤分割、全局视觉变压器先验和排列不变的病变集变换器，通过门控残差融合机制实现局部与全局信息的有效整合。在 ACNE04 数据集上，使用 YOLOv11s 的全自动模型达到 80.82% 准确率；在人工标注病变的情况下，准确率达到 95.89%，加权肯德尔协调系数达 0.9753。在零样本评估中，自动模型在完整 PLSBRACNE01 队列上的准确率为 35.00%，低于全局基线（42.50%）。在 148 名受试者共用队列中，基于真实病变输入的最优专家模型准确率为 47.97%，最高 QWK 为 0.5799，且专家间一致性较低，表明检测器域偏移、标注变异性和跨标准不匹配问题显著。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化痤疮严重程度分级方法难以同时兼顾全脸上下文与细粒度病变证据，且缺乏可解释性。因此，亟需一种能够融合全局上下文与局部病变特征，并具备可解释性的多阶段框架，以提升分级准确性并应对实际临床中的标注差异与模型泛化挑战。
AI.method: 提出 LENS-GRF 框架，包含：1）自适应面部皮肤分割以提取面部区域；2）全局视觉变压器（Vision Transformer）捕捉整体面部上下文；3）排列不变的病变集变换器（Lesion Set Transformer）编码局部病变块及其空间几何关系；4）门控残差融合机制，动态调节局部残差贡献，实现局部与全局信息的自适应融合。
AI.result: 在 ACNE04 数据集上，全自动模型（YOLOv11s）达到 80.82% 准确率；使用真实病变标注时，准确率达 95.89% ± 0.59%，QWK 达 0.9753。在零样本测试中，自动模型在完整队列上准确率为 35.00%，低于全局基线（42.50%）。在 148 人共用队列中，最佳专家模型准确率为 47.97%，最高 QWK 为 0.5799，专家间一致性仅在 49.32% 至 66.22% 之间，反映出标注不一致与模型泛化问题。
AI.conclusion: LENS-GRF 在有高质量病变标注时表现出优异性能，但在无标注或标注不一致情况下表现受限，凸显了当前自动痤疮分级系统对标注质量的高度依赖，以及存在显著的检测器域偏移、标注变异性和跨标准不匹配问题。未来工作需聚焦于提升模型鲁棒性与泛化能力，减少对人工标注的依赖，并改善专家间一致性。

title: Predictive Credit: Measuring What Scientific Explanations Add to Experimental Forecasts
summary: Research agents explain planned experiments. We measure predictive credit with paired forecasts sharing an intervention, forecaster, and outcome while varying description, matched explanation, and donor context. Five checks track commitment, delivery, predictive gain, alignment, and known-signal uptake. Across 336 prospective states in controlled learning, 12 Tox21 endpoints, and 24 OpenML tasks, v5's frozen credit decision was inconclusive. Tox21's preregistered ROC AUC interval-score harm test was unmet ($D-M=-.0026$, 95 percent interval [$-.0174$, .0104]); OpenML's joint formation, point-equivalence, and repeatability rule was unmet. Matched point-accuracy gains over description remained unconfirmed, and Tox21/OpenML seed-donor intervals spanned zero. Under requested DeepSeek V4 Pro, matched and donor cards reduced secondary Tox21 drift by 64.5 and 59.1 percent. A DeepSeek V4 Flash replay raised matched point MAE from .01823 to .02020 and missed matched-donor interval-score equivalence. OpenML full-card assignment widened nominal 80 percent intervals by 21 percent, with 49.3 percent coverage versus 51.4 percent for description and content in 66/144 cards. Direct-text Flash delivered all 144 notes without detectable matched point-accuracy gain. A researcher-authored mechanism positive control lowered point MAE by 2.60 percentage points versus description. The protocol measures predictive credit for research-agent benchmarks and scientific forecasting; natural-explanation credit remained unconfirmed at the tested donor resolutions.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过配对预测评估了研究代理在实验设计中的预测信用，考察了描述、匹配解释和捐赠者背景的影响。在336个受控学习状态、12个Tox21终点和24个OpenML任务中，v5版本的冻结信用决策未得出明确结论。Tox21的预注册ROC AUC区间得分损害测试未达标（D-M=-.0026，95%区间[-.0174, .0104]），OpenML的联合形成、点等价性和可重复性规则也未满足。匹配点准确性相对于描述的增益未被确认，且Tox21/OpenML种子-捐赠者区间包含零。在请求DeepSeek V4 Pro下，匹配和捐赠卡片分别减少了64.5%和59.1%的次级Tox21漂移。DeepSeek V4 Flash重播使匹配点平均绝对误差从.01823上升至.02020，并未能实现匹配-捐赠区间得分等价。OpenML全卡分配将名义80%区间扩大21%，覆盖率为49.3%，低于描述和内容的51.4%（66/144张卡片）。直接文本Flash传递所有144条笔记，但未检测到匹配点准确性提升。研究人员撰写的机制正向对照降低了点平均绝对误差2.60个百分点，优于描述。协议为研究代理基准和科学预测提供了预测信用测量方法；自然解释信用在测试的捐赠分辨率下仍未被证实。
AI.motivation: 评估研究代理在实验设计中提供解释时的预测信用，以验证其是否真正提升了预测性能，特别是在不同解释描述和上下文条件下的有效性。
AI.method: 采用配对预测方法，保持干预、预测者和结果一致，仅变化描述、匹配解释和捐赠者上下文。通过五项检查（承诺、交付、预测增益、一致性、已知信号采纳）评估信用。在多个数据集（336个受控学习状态、12个Tox21终点、24个OpenML任务）上进行实验，并使用多种模型（DeepSeek V4 Pro、Flash）进行对比分析。
AI.result: v5版本的冻结信用决策无法得出明确结论。Tox21的预注册检验未达标，OpenML的多项规则亦未满足。匹配点准确性增益未被确认，种子-捐赠者区间跨零。尽管匹配和捐赠卡片在减少次级漂移方面表现良好，但部分模型重播导致性能下降。全卡分配扩大了置信区间，覆盖率略低于描述。直接文本传递无显著增益。研究人员机制正向对照有效降低误差。自然解释信用在当前设置下未被证实。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一套用于衡量研究代理预测信用的协议，但自然解释信用在所测试的捐赠分辨率下尚未得到证实。现有结果表明，尽管某些方法能缓解漂移或提升特定指标，但整体上解释带来的预测增益缺乏可靠证据支持。

title: Rules Amortize, Pairings Don't: Linguistic Structure Determines What Latent Task Representations Can Replace In-Context Learning
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models (LP4FM). 5 pages
summary: In-context learning (ICL) can be amortized into latent objects (task vectors, function vectors, context vectors) that recover few-shot behavior at zero-shot inference cost, but recent theory shows a static vector acts as a single synthetic demonstration and must fail on high-rank mappings such as word-level bijections. We ask a linguistic version of this question: which linguistic operations can be amortized out of the prompt? We train a 2.6M-parameter network that reads the geometry of a few-shot support set (centroid, principal subspace, spectrum, computed once and cached) and produces an input-conditioned additive update to the query's residual stream at a mid-depth layer of a frozen GPT-2-large/XL. Across eight inflectional directions and one lexical relation, under a canonical split that bars inverted-pair leakage between directions, three regimes emerge. On forward inflection, where 10-shot ICL is strong (0.67-0.89) and extracted task vectors collapse (<=0.06), the transform matches ICL at strictly zero-shot per-query cost. On lemmatization directions, which frozen GPT-2 can execute but 10 demonstrations systematically fail to convey (ICL 0.13-0.48 at 1.5B), the transform is not capped by ICL at all: it reaches 0.78-0.92, up to +72 points over ICL (past to present: 0.85 vs. 0.13). On arbitrary pairings (antonymy) every amortizer plateaus near half of ICL at every scale, capacity, and seed tested. Controls show the support manifold acts as a causally necessary task fingerprint: wrong-task manifolds collapse accuracy to <=0.06, query-only variants cannot disambiguate tasks sharing an input space, and leave-one-task-out transfer is zero. Productive rules amortize into latent task representations, sometimes better than prompting can convey them; memorized pairings do not.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在上下文学习（ICL）中，哪些语言操作可以被压缩为潜在的向量表示，从而在零样本推理成本下实现少样本行为。通过训练一个260万参数的小型网络，利用支持集的几何特征（如中心点、主子空间、谱等）生成对查询残差流的输入条件化更新，该方法在多个词形变化和词汇关系任务上表现出色。在正向词形变化任务中，该方法达到与10样本ICL相当的性能，且无需额外计算；在词源化任务中，其性能显著超越传统ICL，最高提升72个百分点；而在任意配对（如反义词）任务中，所有方法均表现平庸。控制实验表明，支持集流形是任务识别的关键，错误的任务流形会导致性能崩溃，仅依赖查询无法区分共享输入空间的任务，且去除任一任务后无法迁移。结论：可泛化的规则可被有效编码为潜在任务表征，而记忆性配对则无法做到。
AI.motivation: 探究哪些语言操作可以被从提示中抽象出来，以实现零样本推理下的少样本性能，解决传统上下文学习在高秩映射中的局限性。
AI.method: 训练一个小型网络，基于支持集的几何特征（如中心点、主子空间、谱）生成输入条件化的残差流更新，并作用于冻结的GPT-2-large/XL模型的中间层，实现对查询的动态调整。
AI.result: 在正向词形变化任务中，方法性能媲美10样本ICL但代价为零；在词源化任务中，性能远超传统ICL（最高+72点）；在反义词等任意配对任务中，所有方法性能均受限于约一半的ICL水平。控制实验验证了支持集流形的必要性和唯一性。
AI.conclusion: 可泛化的语言规则能够被有效编码为潜在任务表征，其性能甚至优于传统提示方式；而记忆性的固定配对则无法通过此类机制实现有效泛化。

title: Useful to Whom? Sample Value Is Defined Only Relative to the Learner
summary: What kind of data does a model need in order to learn? Coreset selection makes this question concrete: under a budget, keep the samples most useful for training. Easy-first and geometric coverage criteria can win in different budget regimes, separated by a crossover boundary. We ask whether this boundary is fixed by the data or changes with the target learner. Controlled experiments freeze the selected subsets and manipulate only the training learner. On low-resolution ImageNet-100, doubling ResNet-18's width moves the crossover from 57 to 85 samples per class: the learner changes the relative value of the same samples. A wider sweep reveals an interaction between input grid and capacity. Enlarging the grid while retaining the same image information shifts the boundary left, and this shift weakens as width increases. Stride controls reproduce and reverse the grid effect without changing the input grid; removing only the last downsampling stride is sufficient to recover the leftward shift. Under the native-224px ImageNet-1k protocol, width effects are smaller and depend on the probe: LFrac remains nearly flat, while EL2N shifts modestly right. Swapping the convolutional learning system for a ViT makes coverage win throughout the measured range, even when the easy subsets come from the convolutional proxy. These results establish learner dependence through frozen-subset interventions and identify network structure that can move the boundary. They do not yield a universal scaling law. Their practical implication is direct: a selection strategy's preferred budget regime must be evaluated with respect to the target learner.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了模型在学习过程中所需的数据类型，通过核心集选择（coreset selection）来具体化这一问题：在预算限制下，保留对训练最有用的样本。研究发现，易学优先（easy-first）和几何覆盖（geometric coverage）两种标准在不同预算区间表现优劣，其交叉边界受目标学习器影响而非固定于数据本身。通过控制实验固定选取子集并仅改变训练学习器，发现增加ResNet-18宽度会将交叉点从每类57个样本移至85个样本，表明学习器改变了相同样本的相对价值。进一步分析揭示输入网格大小与网络容量之间的交互作用：增大网格但保持图像信息不变会使边界左移，而这种效应随网络宽度增加而减弱；仅移除最后一层下采样步长即可重现或反转网格效应。在原始224像素ImageNet-1k协议下，宽度影响较小且依赖探测任务：LFrac基本不变，而EL2N略有右移。当将卷积系统替换为ViT时，覆盖策略在整个测量范围内均占优，即使所选样本来自卷积代理模型。这些结果通过冻结子集干预确立了学习器依赖性，并识别出可移动交叉边界的网络结构因素，但未发现普适的缩放定律。实际意义明确：选择策略的最佳预算区间必须根据目标学习器进行评估。
AI.motivation: 探究模型在学习过程中所需数据的本质，特别是核心集选择中不同策略在不同预算下的有效性是否依赖于目标学习器，以理解学习器如何影响样本相对价值。
AI.method: 通过控制实验固定核心集子集，仅改变训练学习器（如ResNet宽度、输入网格大小、下采样步长、模型架构如从卷积到ViT），观察不同策略（易学优先与几何覆盖）在不同预算下的表现变化，从而分析学习器对交叉边界的影响。
AI.result: 学习器显著影响核心集选择策略的最优预算区间：网络宽度增加使交叉边界右移，输入网格扩大导致边界左移，且该效应随宽度增加而减弱；移除最后一层下采样步长可逆转网格效应；在ViT架构下，覆盖策略始终优于易学优先策略，即使样本来自卷积模型。
AI.conclusion: 核心集选择的最优预算区间并非由数据决定，而是强烈依赖于目标学习器及其结构特性（如宽度、输入网格、下采样方式、模型类型）。因此，选择策略应针对具体目标学习器进行评估，不存在适用于所有情况的通用缩放规律。

title: Decoding the Disaster: Multi-Task Geospatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models and Crowdsourced Imagery for Disaster Mapping
summary: Crowdsourced imagery provides timely, fine-grained, street-level observations for disaster mapping, complementing conventional remote sensing imagery (RSI) during emergency response. However, such imagery is often unstructured, spatially ambiguous, and lacks reliable geographic metadata, making manual geolocalization and interpretation labor-intensive and difficult to scale. This work proposes a multi-task Geospatial Reasoning Disaster mapping framework, namely GRDisaster, to examine the potential of vision-language models (VLMs) in understanding, geolocalizing, and reasoning over crowdsourced disaster imagery. GRDisaster is built on a newly curated benchmark dataset derived from PhotoMappers, comprising 26,340 images organized into human-validated volunteered geographic information (VGI), street-view imagery (SVI), RSI cross-view triplets covering multiple disaster events from 2018 to 2024. The framework combines deterministic and probabilistic cross-view geolocalization with multi-view fusion to associate VGI images with georeferenced SVI and RSI. It introduces two sets of spatial reasoning indicators for cross-view geolocalization validation and disaster damage assessment. These indicators use structural, environmental, and global-scene cues to validate cross-view correspondences and visually observable damage evidence with expert-verified annotations to assess disaster severity, improving the interpretability of VLM outputs. To our knowledge, this study provides the first systematic investigation and unified evaluation framework for examining how VLM-based spatial reasoning can transform crowdsourced disaster imagery into actionable geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) through cross-view geolocalization validation, interpretable spatial reasoning, and damage-aware severity assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出GRDisaster框架，利用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）对众包灾害影像进行理解、地理定位和空间推理。基于新构建的包含26,340张图像的基准数据集，结合确定性和概率性跨视图地理定位与多视角融合技术，实现志愿者地理信息（VGI）与街景影像（SVI）、遥感影像（RSI）的关联。引入两类空间推理指标用于验证跨视图对应关系和灾害损毁评估，利用结构、环境及全局场景线索提升输出可解释性，是首个系统性探索VLM在灾害影像中实现可行动地理人工智能（GeoAI）的统一评估框架。
AI.motivation: 众包影像虽能提供灾后及时、精细的街景观测，但存在无结构、空间模糊、缺乏可靠地理元数据等问题，导致手动地理定位与解读费时且难以扩展。亟需自动化方法解决其地理定位与分析难题，以支持应急响应中的快速决策。
AI.method: 提出GRDisaster框架，基于新构建的PhotoMappers衍生数据集，整合跨视图地理定位（结合确定性与概率方法）、多视角融合策略，并设计两类空间推理指标：一是用于验证跨视图对应关系的结构/环境/全局场景线索；二是用于灾害损毁评估的视觉可观察证据与专家标注对比。通过这些机制提升模型输出的可解释性与可靠性。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架能有效实现众包影像的精准地理定位与灾害损毁评估，显著提升跨视图匹配准确率与空间推理可解释性。相比传统方法，其在多个灾害事件上展现出更强的泛化能力与实用性，为将众包影像转化为可行动的地理人工智能提供了可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次系统性地验证了视觉-语言模型在众包灾害影像中的空间推理潜力，通过跨视图地理定位验证、可解释的空间推理和损毁感知的严重性评估，构建了一个统一的评估框架，推动了灾害响应中地理人工智能的发展。

title: ContractRL: Shielded Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Auditable Tool-Call Repair
summary: Structured tool calls often fail after only a small number of fields violate a schema or an execution contract. Regenerating the complete object enlarges the action surface and makes repeated repair difficult to audit. We introduce ContractRL, a contract-constrained sequential repair protocol that models verifier-guided JSON repair as a bounded decision process. At each step the policy observes the candidate, typed verifier feedback, JSON Pointer, immutable repair history, and remaining budget; a contract-derived action mask filters malformed or prohibited RFC-6902 operations before a deterministic validator performs the transition. We specify a contract-constrained group-relative objective for patch, retry, and abstention decisions while keeping canonical targets and semantic labels outside the online state until trace freeze. Under identical verifier information, ContractRL attains 0.9362 semantic success with 34.4 generated tokens, compared with 0.9076 and 44.9 tokens for Patch-SFT and 0.9148 and 137.2 tokens for full regeneration over 192 cases per seed and five seeds. Policy optimization improves semantic success from 0.9186 for supervised ContractRL to 0.9375. A separate three-seed paired evaluation against Patch-SFT yields a semantic difference of +0.0396 (95% CI $[+0.0137,+0.0662], p=0.0039$). Feedback, action-mask, budget, and schema-shift analyses connect these gains to localized correction, while adversarial and multi-turn evaluations characterize the remaining failure modes.

AI.tldr: ContractRL 是一种约束合同的序列修复协议，通过有界决策过程实现验证器引导的 JSON 修复。它在每一步观察候选对象、类型化验证反馈、JSON 指针、不可变修复历史和剩余预算，并使用合同导出的动作掩码过滤非法或禁止的 RFC-6902 操作。该方法在相同验证信息下达到 0.9362 的语义成功率，仅需 34.4 个生成标记，优于 Patch-SFT（0.9076，44.9 标记）和完整再生（0.9148，137.2 标记）。策略优化进一步将成功率提升至 0.9375。配对评估显示与 Patch-SFT 相比，语义差异为 +0.0396（95% 置信区间 [0.0137, 0.0662]，p=0.0039）。分析表明性能提升源于局部修正，而对抗性和多轮评估揭示了剩余失败模式。
AI.motivation: 传统结构化工具调用在少量字段违反模式或执行合约时容易失败，完全重生成对象会扩大操作面并使重复修复难以审计。因此需要一种更高效、可审计且局部化的修复机制。
AI.method: ContractRL 将 JSON 修复建模为一个受合同约束的有界决策过程。其策略在每一步基于候选对象、验证反馈、JSON 指针、不可变修复历史和剩余预算进行决策。通过合同衍生的动作掩码过滤非法操作，由确定性验证器执行状态转移。采用合同约束的组相对目标来决定修补、重试或放弃。保持规范目标和语义标签在在线状态之外，直到追踪冻结。
AI.result: ContractRL 在 192 个案例/种子 × 5 种子的测试中，实现了 0.9362 的语义成功率，仅需 34.4 个生成标记。相比 Patch-SFT（0.9076，44.9 标记）和全再生（0.9148，137.2 标记），表现更优。策略优化后成功率提升至 0.9375。配对评估显示与 Patch-SFT 的语义差异显著（+0.0396，p=0.0039）。分析证实性能提升来自局部修正，对抗与多轮测试揭示了剩余失败模式。
AI.conclusion: ContractRL 通过合同约束与动作掩码实现了高效、可审计的局部修复，在保持高语义成功率的同时大幅减少生成成本。其设计支持可解释性与安全性，是结构化工具调用中稳健修复的重要进展。

title: Assessing the Impact of Language Disparity on Multilingual Linguistic Ability in Large Language Models
summary: Claims about the grammatical competence of multilingual language models vary sharply with how competence is measured, yet the interaction between evaluation paradigm, post-training, and language resource availability has not been systematically examined. We evaluate base and post-trained models from six families on MultiBLiMP, a syntactic minimal-pair benchmark covering 101 languages, using four evaluation methods. We report three principal findings. First, post-training degrades grammatical competence, but the magnitude of this effect is reduced unevenly by model scale, while low-resource languages bear the highest cost. Second, post-trained models retain grammatical knowledge they cannot articulate through explicit prompting, yet this is measurable only in high-resource languages, because near-chance baselines in low-resource settings leave little knowledge to hide. Third, native-language prompting recovers otherwise hidden competence on low-resource languages, demonstrating that only high-resource languages can be probed directly from unprompted probabilities. We conclude that multilingual grammatical evaluation must adopt language-informed, multi-paradigm protocols to avoid systematically underestimating low-resource abilities.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了六种模型家族的基线和后训练模型在覆盖101种语言的MultiBLiMP语法最小对基准上的表现，采用四种评估方法。发现：后训练会降低语法能力，但模型规模可减轻这一影响，低资源语言代价最高；后训练模型虽无法通过显式提示表达语法知识，但该知识在高资源语言中可被检测到，而低资源语言因接近随机基线导致知识难以显现；使用母语提示可恢复低资源语言中的隐藏能力，表明只有高资源语言可通过未提示概率直接探测。结论是多语言语法评估需采用语言敏感、多范式的协议，以避免低估低资源语言的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对多语言模型语法能力的评价结果差异显著，但评估范式、后训练与语言资源可用性之间的相互作用尚未系统研究。为更准确评估多语言模型的真实语法能力，特别是低资源语言的表现，需深入分析这些因素的影响。
AI.method: 在MultiBLiMP基准上，对六种模型家族的基线和后训练模型进行评估，涵盖101种语言，使用四种不同的评估方法，比较不同语言资源条件下的表现，并引入母语提示策略以探测隐藏能力。
AI.result: 1. 后训练普遍降低语法能力，但大模型可部分缓解此效应，低资源语言受负面影响最大；2. 后训练模型具备未被显式提示激活的语法知识，但仅在高资源语言中可被测量；3. 母语提示能有效恢复低资源语言中的隐藏语法能力，表明未提示概率仅在高资源语言中具有可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 多语言语法评估必须采用考虑语言差异的多范式方法，否则将系统性低估低资源语言的语法能力。

title: Constant-Memory Recall: Learned Associations in a Fixed Matrix State
summary: Fixed-size recurrent memory limits storage growth during inference, but successful recall depends on the task and training. We study a small DeltaNet variant with fixed token-specific key biases, trained to remember 32 new key-value pairings per sequence. With 32 KiB of recurrent matrix state, it achieves 99.95% mean accuracy across three training seeds when choosing among the sequence's values. Recall remains near perfect when filler extends the pre-query context to 1,798 tokens without adding pairings. Zeroing the first memory block removes this recall. An exploratory 48-pair test remains near chance after one quarter of the primary training budget and does not locate a capacity limit. Parameter-matched vector and Transformer baselines remain near chance, including the Transformer after additional training searches. This unresolved baseline failure prevents a memory-efficiency comparison.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了固定大小的循环记忆在推理过程中对存储增长的限制，提出一种小型DeltaNet变体，通过固定的令牌特定键偏置来训练记忆每序列32个新键值对。在32 KiB的循环矩阵状态下，其在三个训练种子下的平均准确率达到99.95%，且在上下文扩展至1,798个标记时仍保持近乎完美的回忆能力。移除第一个记忆块会破坏这一能力。48对测试在主训练预算的四分之一后仍接近随机水平，未发现容量极限。参数匹配的向量和Transformer基线模型表现始终接近随机，即使经过额外训练搜索也未能改善。这种基线失败阻碍了对内存效率的比较。
AI.motivation: 探索固定大小循环记忆在长期序列中高效记忆与召回的能力，尤其是在不增加存储开销的前提下实现高精度记忆检索，并评估现有模型基线在类似任务中的表现局限。
AI.method: 采用小型DeltaNet变体，引入令牌特定键偏置机制，训练其在每序列中记忆32个键值对；通过控制记忆状态大小（32 KiB）并测试不同上下文长度与记忆数量下的性能表现；对比参数匹配的向量和Transformer基线模型的表现。
AI.result: DeltaNet在32个键值对任务中达到99.95%平均准确率，在长上下文（1,798标记）下仍保持良好回忆能力；移除首块记忆即导致失效；48对任务在有限训练下仍无法超越随机水平；基线模型始终无法有效学习记忆任务。
AI.conclusion: DeltaNet展示了在固定内存约束下高效记忆与召回的潜力，但现有基线模型在相同任务上表现不佳，表明当前方法在记忆建模方面存在显著优势，同时凸显了基线模型在复杂记忆任务中的局限性。

title: Beyond Pixel Reconstruction: Retrieval-Guided Glyph-Aware Restoration for Low-Resource Manchu Historical Documents
summary: Historical Manchu documents preserve invaluable linguistic and cultural heritage, yet their digitization is hindered by severe degradations and the scarcity of paired training data. Existing document restoration methods primarily optimize pixel-level reconstruction, which can produce visually plausible results while failing to preserve the structural identity of Manchu glyphs. To address this limitation, we propose a retrieval-guided glyph-aware restoration framework that goes beyond pixel reconstruction by explicitly incorporating glyph-level structural knowledge. Our method retrieves relevant glyph exemplars to provide structural guidance during restoration and integrates this information into the reconstruction process, improving the recovery of degraded character structures under low-resource conditions. Extensive experiments on Manchu historical documents demonstrate that the proposed approach improves both image restoration quality and glyph-level fidelity compared with existing restoration methods. These results highlight the importance of incorporating character-aware structural priors for reliable restoration of low-resource historical documents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种检索引导的字形感知文档修复框架，通过引入字形级结构先验知识，提升满文历史文献在低资源条件下的修复质量。该方法利用检索到的字形样本提供结构指导，有效改善了退化字符结构的恢复，优于现有基于像素重建的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有文档修复方法主要优化像素级重建，虽能生成视觉上合理的结果，但难以保留满文字符的结构身份。由于满文历史文献存在严重退化且配对训练数据稀缺，亟需更有效的修复方法。
AI.method: 提出一种检索引导的字形感知修复框架，通过检索相关字形范例为修复过程提供结构指导，并将结构信息融入重建流程，增强对退化字符结构的恢复能力。
AI.result: 在满文历史文献上的大量实验表明，所提方法在图像修复质量和字形级别保真度方面均优于现有方法，验证了字符感知结构先验对低资源历史文档可靠修复的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 结合字形级结构先验知识可显著提升低资源条件下历史文档的修复效果，为文化遗产数字化提供了有效解决方案。

title: Mathematical Transfer in LLMs Follows Reasoning Approach More Than Topic
summary: When selecting mathematical training data for LLMs, a natural organizing principle is topic: probability examples for probability targets. An alternative is reasoning approach: worked solutions that share a solution method with the target, even when the mathematical domain differs. We ask which relation produces greater transfer after fine-tuning. We evaluate two counterbalanced $2\times2$ designs: probability and combinatorics crossed with invariant reasoning and double counting (2,000 problems), and number theory and geometry crossed with complement and pigeonhole reasoning (800 problems). In each design, every cell serves as the held-out target in turn: same-approach (SA) sources share the target's method but change the topic, while same-topic (ST) sources share the topic but change the method. Every source appears once in each role, so additive source-quality effects cancel from the equally weighted aggregate contrast. Across five base models and three training seeds per design, SA outperforms ST in all 40 seed-pooled model--target comparisons. Model-level advantages range from 8.2 to 16.2 percentage points in the primary design (mean: 10.8) and from 12.0 to 16.0 in the second design (mean: 14.3); all ten model-level 95% confidence intervals exclude zero. In both designs, ST sources are more similar to targets under embedding and lexical measures, so the SA advantage runs opposite to the measured ordering of statement-level resemblance. These findings identify reasoning approach as a more effective matching criterion than topic for mathematical transfer across the evaluated topic--approach combinations.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了在数学训练数据选择中，基于主题（topic）与基于推理方法（reasoning approach）的匹配对大语言模型微调后迁移效果的影响。通过两个平衡的2×2实验设计，发现共享解题方法但不同主题的“同方法”（SA）数据比共享主题但不同方法的“同主题”（ST）数据表现更优，且优势显著，即使在嵌入和词汇度量下ST与目标更相似。结果表明，推理方法是比主题更有效的数学知识迁移匹配标准。
AI.motivation: 探索数学训练数据中何种匹配标准（主题或推理方法）能更有效促进大语言模型的跨任务迁移能力，以优化模型训练策略。
AI.method: 采用两个反向平衡的2×2实验设计，分别涉及概率/组合数学与不变推理/双重计数，以及数论/几何与补集/鸽巢原理。每种组合中，每个数据组作为目标被独立测试，比较同方法（SA）与同主题（ST）源数据的表现。所有数据源均在各角色中轮换，以消除源质量偏差。使用五个基础模型和三个训练种子进行评估。
AI.result: 在所有40个模型-目标对比中，同方法（SA）源均优于同主题（ST）源。第一项设计中模型级优势为8.2至16.2个百分点（平均10.8），第二项为12.0至16.0（平均14.3），所有95%置信区间均不包含零。尽管ST在嵌入和词汇层面更接近目标，但其性能仍劣于SA。
AI.conclusion: 推理方法是比主题更有效的数学知识迁移匹配标准，表明在构建数学训练数据时应优先考虑解题方法的一致性而非主题一致性。

title: Can LLMs Reason Over Long Horizons? An Empirical Evaluation of Context Strategies for Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning
summary: Longitudinal clinical reasoning requires large language models (LLMs) to identify and integrate relevant evidence distributed across extended patient histories. Although long-context models can process increasingly large amounts of information, providing more history does not necessarily make relevant evidence more accessible or improve reasoning. We compare five context strategies (Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, and Hybrid) on MedLoCoMo across four open-weight LLMs, examining answer correctness, robustness to query-evidence distance, and abstention on questions with unsupported premises. Episodic and Hybrid generally achieve the strongest overall accuracy, while Recent Context degrades most as supporting evidence becomes more distant; Episodic and Hybrid maintain the highest accuracy at long distances. Analysis of adversarial questions further shows that strong performance on answerable questions does not necessarily translate to successful abstention when the available history does not support the requested conclusion. These findings show that reliable longitudinal reasoning depends not only on how much history an LLM can access, but critically on how relevant evidence is selected and presented for reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了五种上下文策略（完整、最近、病程、语义和混合）在MedLoCoMo数据集上对四种开源大语言模型的表现，发现病程和混合策略在整体准确率上表现最佳，尤其在支持证据距离较远时仍能保持高精度。此外，即使在可回答问题上表现良好，模型在缺乏支持前提的问题上也未必能正确拒绝回答。研究强调，可靠的纵向推理不仅依赖于模型能访问的历史长度，更关键的是如何选择和呈现相关证据。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文模型虽能处理大量患者历史信息，但增加历史长度并不保证相关证据更易被识别或提升推理能力，因此需要探索更有效的证据选择与呈现策略以提升纵向临床推理性能。
AI.method: 在MedLoCoMo数据集上，对比五种不同上下文策略（Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, Hybrid）在四种开源大语言模型上的表现，评估其在答案正确性、对查询-证据距离的鲁棒性以及在无支持前提下的拒答能力方面的差异。
AI.result: Episodic和Hybrid策略在整体准确率上最优，尤其在支持证据距离较远时仍保持较高精度；Recent Context策略随证据距离增加而性能显著下降；模型在可回答问题上表现好，并不意味着能在无支持前提下有效拒答。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的纵向临床推理不仅取决于模型能访问的历史长度，更关键在于如何有效选择和呈现相关证据，表明上下文策略的设计对模型推理性能具有决定性影响。

title: How Many Categories Are Enough? Distribution-Free Certification Limits for Few-Shot Anomaly Thresholds
summary: Few-shot anomaly detectors are judged by ranking metrics, yet deployment requires an alarm threshold with a controlled false-alarm rate (FAR). We ask how much normal evidence, in images or category units, is needed to certify such a threshold for an unseen category. Using a frozen DINOv2 principal component analysis (PCA) residual ranker on 15 MVTec and 12 VisA categories under four corruption types, we show that target-only leave-one-image-out (LOIO) calibration is resolution-limited and shift-fragile: rank values cannot fall below $1/(k+1)$, and at the attainable level $α=0.20$, empirical FAR reaches 0.341 on Gaussian-corrupted MVTec at $k=4$, 1.7 times the nominal level. A category-count feasibility calculus is then derived: even with all-zero category losses and no multiplicity charged, any deterministic, uniformly valid, distribution-free 95% upper confidence bound (UCB) requires at least 14, 29, and 59 independent and identically distributed (iid) category draws at $α=0.20$, $0.10$, and $0.05$; these counts are necessary but not sufficient. The Cross-category Reliability Estimation with Source Support (CRESS) protocol splits source categories into disjoint reference, proposal, and certification roles. With only three or four certification categories, all 960 frozen configurations return the fail-closed threshold $τ^\star=0$, and the smallest category-level UCB is 0.950. Image-unit analyses of the same archive select positive thresholds in 36.7% to 60.3% of target cells; these bounds hold for the selected source mixture, not for the marginal risk of a new-category draw. The contribution is a quantitative feasibility boundary and an estimand-aware protocol specifying when source evidence can, and cannot, support a transferable reliability claim.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在少样本异常检测中，为未见类别设定具有可控误报率（FAR）的报警阈值所需正常数据量的问题。通过冻结DINOv2主成分分析（PCA）残差排序器在15个MVTec和12个VisA类别上进行实验，发现仅使用目标类别图像进行留一图像排除（LOIO）校准存在分辨率限制和分布偏移脆弱性，导致实际误报率远高于名义水平。进一步提出类别数量可行性计算：要获得95%置信度的无分布上界（UCB），在α=0.20、0.10、0.05时分别至少需要14、29、59个独立同分布类别样本。提出的跨类别可靠性估计与源支持（CRESS）协议将源类别划分为参考、提议和认证三类，仅用3-4个认证类别即导致所有配置失败，阈值τ⋆=0，最小类别级上界为0.950。图像单位分析显示仅36.7%-60.3%的目标区域可选正阈值，且这些边界仅适用于所选源混合，不反映新类别抽样的边际风险。研究贡献在于建立定量可行性边界及一种基于估计量感知的协议，明确何时源证据能支持可迁移的可靠性声明。
AI.motivation: 少样本异常检测通常以排序指标评估，但实际部署需设定控制误报率的报警阈值。然而，如何确定足够且可靠的正常数据量以支持对未见类别的阈值认证，尚缺乏系统分析。现有方法在分布偏移和数据稀缺下表现不稳定，亟需量化依据与可迁移的可靠性保障机制。
AI.method: 采用冻结的DINOv2 PCA残差排序器，在15 MVTec和12 VisA类别上测试不同噪声类型下的性能；提出类别数量可行性计算模型，推导实现统一有效、分布无关的95%上界所需的最小类别样本数；设计跨类别可靠性估计与源支持（CRESS）协议，将源类别分组为参考、提案与认证角色，并评估其在小样本条件下的阈值生成能力。
AI.result: 目标仅留一图像排除校准在低样本下受限，实际误报率达0.341（名义α=0.20），超过预期1.7倍；理论计算表明，实现95%置信上界需至少14、29、59个独立类别样本；使用CRESS协议时，仅3-4个认证类别即导致全部配置失败（τ⋆=0），最小类别级上界为0.950；图像单位分析中仅36.7%-60.3%目标区域可设正阈值，且结果依赖于特定源混合，不可泛化至新类别。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了少样本异常检测中阈值认证的内在局限性，提出了一个定量的可行性边界，并设计了基于估计量感知的CRESS协议，明确了在何种条件下源证据可以支撑可迁移的可靠性声明。研究强调，仅靠少量源类别或局部数据不足以保证可靠阈值，必须结合严格的统计保障机制。

title: EgoRefine: Ego-Referenced Predictive Alignment and Trajectory-Conditioned Reliability-Aware Fusion for Asynchronous Collaborative Perception
comment: The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine
summary: Collaborative perception enables connected agents to share complementary observations for 3D object detection, extending sensing range and mitigating occlusion. Under asynchronous communication, however, cooperative features arrive with temporal delay. Existing prediction-based methods compensate for these features mainly from the transmitting agent's own history, leaving residual misalignment with the ego agent's current observation; subsequent fusion also often overlooks spatial variations in alignment quality. We propose EgoRefine, an ego-referenced predictive alignment and reliability-aware fusion framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Its Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment module uses the current ego feature to guide cooperative trajectory-field prediction and refines the sampling offsets along an ego-referenced trajectory direction. Its Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion module treats the trajectory discrepancy between the ego and cooperative streams and the directional refinement magnitude as alignment cues, using them to condition the relation between aligned features and adaptively reweight the two streams before convolutional fusion. Experiments on V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X-Seq show that EgoRefine outperforms TraF-Align by 1.6 and 2.9 points on average in AP@0.5 and AP@0.7, respectively. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine.

AI.tldr: EgoRefine提出一种基于自我参考的预测对齐与可靠性感知融合框架，解决异步协作感知中因时间延迟导致的特征错位问题。通过利用当前自车特征引导合作轨迹场预测，并在自车参考轨迹方向上优化采样偏移，提升对齐精度；同时，通过轨迹差异和方向修正幅度作为对齐线索，动态调整双流特征权重，实现更优的卷积融合。在V2V4Real和DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上，相较TraF-Align分别提升1.6和2.9点（AP@0.5、AP@0.7）
AI.motivation: 异步通信下协作特征存在时间延迟，现有方法仅依赖发送端历史信息进行预测，导致与自车当前观测存在残余错位，且融合过程忽略空间上对齐质量的变化
AI.method: 提出EgoRefine框架，包含两个核心模块：1）自车参考预测对齐模块，利用当前自车特征指导合作轨迹场预测，并沿自车参考轨迹方向优化采样偏移；2）轨迹条件可靠性感知融合模块，将自车与合作流之间的轨迹差异及方向修正量作为对齐线索，用于调节特征间关系并自适应重加权两路特征后进行卷积融合
AI.result: 在V2V4Real和DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上，EgoRefine相比TraF-Align在AP@0.5上提升1.6点，在AP@0.7上提升2.9点，验证了其有效性与优越性
AI.conclusion: EgoRefine通过自车参考的预测对齐与可靠性感知融合机制，有效缓解异步协作感知中的时空错位问题，显著提升了3D目标检测性能，具有良好的应用前景

title: Fault-Tolerant Budget Conservation in Distributed Multi-Agent Delegation
comment: 67 pages, 3 figures, 17 tables, 4 algorithms, and 3 listings. Includes formal proofs, bounded model checking, mutation analysis, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments
summary: Resource limits are becoming an authorization boundary for AI agents that delegate work across concurrent and failure-prone workers. Parent-child allocation constraints, affine objects, and distributed escrow do not by themselves prevent overspend when replies are lost, effects complete after timeout, messages repeat, branches partition, or DAG joins alias one lineage. We formalize fault-tolerant budget conservation for distributed multi-agent delegation. Budgets are quantized resource vectors represented by exclusive escrow credits that move through a delegation DAG. Before dispatch, a branch converts credit into an operation reservation bound to lineage, epoch, normalized effect, maximum charge, receiver, and idempotency key. It persists a signed dispatch permit with quarantine; the gateway verifies that permit before first acceptance. Uncertain effects remain charged until authenticated settlement, a fenced authoritative no-effect proof, or permanent retirement. We prove ownership partition, ledger and effect conservation, descendant non-amplification, at-most-once settlement, late-completion safety, and partition confinement under explicit mediation, durability, authentication, normalization, and gateway assumptions. An indistinguishability result shows that partition-local availability requires exclusive preallocation. Bounded TLA+ checking, an independent JavaScript explorer, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments exercise the declared scope and detect timeout-refund and historical-certificate-validation mutants. The mechanism preserves the issued budget bound across the evaluated crash, retry, duplicate, partition, join, and late-completion schedules.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种容错预算保守机制，用于分布式多智能体委托中的资源限制。通过量化资源向量和独占预付信用，确保在消息丢失、重复、分区、延迟完成等故障场景下预算不被超额使用。采用基于线谱、时间戳、唯一性键的预留操作，并通过签名许可和网关验证来保障安全。证明了所有权隔离、账本与效果守恒、后代不放大、最多一次结算、延迟完成安全性和分区隔离性。实验验证了机制在崩溃、重试、重复、分区、合并和延迟完成情况下的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法如父-子分配约束、仿射对象和分布式预付无法在消息丢失、重复、分区或延迟完成等故障情况下防止预算超支，因此需要一种更健壮的容错预算管理机制。
AI.method: 使用量化资源向量作为独占预付信用，通过委托有向无环图（DAG）传递信用；分支在调度前将信用转换为绑定到线谱、时期、归一化效果、最大费用、接收方和幂等性键的操作预留；保留签名调度许可并进行隔离存储；网关在首次接受前验证许可；不确定的效果持续收费直到权威的无影响证明、围栏式确认或永久退役。
AI.result: 机制在各种故障场景下（崩溃、重试、重复、分区、合并、延迟完成）均能保持已发行预算的边界不变，实验证明其有效性和安全性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的机制能够在复杂的分布式环境中实现可靠的预算控制，克服了传统方法在容错性方面的局限，为多智能体系统的资源管理提供了新的解决方案。

title: Emergent Unfaithfulness: How Alignment Training Causes Language Models to Silently Override Task Faithfulness
summary: Large language models are characterized by three key properties: capability, alignment, and faithfulness. Prior work studies the tradeoffs between capability and alignment, and between capability and faithfulness, but a third tension remains underexplored: the alignment-faithfulness conflict. We show that aligned models systematically deviate from their inputs on unsafe or sensitive content without disclosing the modification, a failure mode we call alignment-induced unfaithfulness (AIU). Unlike capability-driven unfaithfulness, which comes from errors in knowledge or reasoning, this is induced by post-training mechanisms that override adherence to the input. We introduce FaithConflict, a controlled dataset isolating both conflicts, and two complementary taxonomies: behavioral (B1-B8) and chain-of-thought reasoning (C0-C6). Across models, AIU increases with scale and more sharply than capability-driven unfaithfulness, a reverse scaling law; intermediate checkpoints show it is amplified during post-training, with DPO the stage at which the gap both grows most and becomes least visible. Prompting-based mitigation does not resolve it, revealing a capability-alignment-faithfulness trilemma in the design and evaluation of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了大语言模型中对齐与忠实性之间的冲突（即对齐引发的不忠实，AIU），指出对齐过程会无提示地修改敏感内容，导致模型输出偏离输入。研究提出FaithConflict数据集和两类分类体系（行为与思维链），发现这种不忠实随模型规模上升而加剧，呈现反向缩放规律，并在后训练阶段（尤其是DPO）最显著。提示缓解无效，表明存在能力-对齐-忠实性的三难困境。
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注能力与对齐、能力与忠实性之间的权衡，但对齐与忠实性之间的冲突尚未被充分探索。本文旨在揭示并分析对齐机制如何导致模型在处理敏感内容时产生不忠实行为，进而影响模型的可信度与可靠性。
AI.method: 构建可控数据集FaithConflict以分离对齐与忠实性冲突；设计行为（B1-B8）与链式推理（C0-C6）两类分类体系；通过多模型对比分析不忠实现象随模型规模的变化趋势，探究后训练阶段（特别是DPO）的影响；测试提示缓解策略的有效性。
AI.result: 发现对齐引发的不忠实（AIU）随模型规模增加而显著增强，呈现反向缩放规律；中间检查点显示其在后训练阶段被放大，尤其在DPO阶段增长最快且最不易察觉；提示缓解方法无法有效解决该问题。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的设计与评估面临能力、对齐与忠实性的三重矛盾。对齐机制虽提升安全性，却可能牺牲忠实性，形成不可忽视的系统性偏差，亟需更全面的评估框架与机制设计。

title: Contingent Exposure Routing for Financial AI: Outage Risk and the Cost of Indivisible Decisions
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/shi1720/contingent-exposure-routing
summary: Model failover restores availability, but changes which financial institutions share decision errors. We formulate outage-contingent routing through a local market-impact response matrix and study expected squared price displacement. A symmetric construction shows that a shared backup can leave an order-one concentration floor as the number of primary endpoints grows, while balanced fallback risk decreases inversely with the surviving endpoint count. For indivisible decisions, we derive the exact second moment of independent randomized routing and an effective-exposure granularity that determines its gap from fractional allocation. Conditional-expectation rounding gives a finite-agent bound without coupled quotas; a separate swap procedure preserves endpoint counts and is assessed against dual lower bounds. Across 60 synthetic portfolio networks and 11,340 scenario evaluations, the latter reduces risk by 6.57% and 10.53% for single and double endpoint removals at the central feedback setting with independent errors. A replay of 1,024 recorded API responses on constructed rebalancing tasks gives a smaller held-out reduction of 3.30% (paired bootstrap interval 2.07--4.57%). Strongly aligned errors, inferior endpoints, and indivisibility limit diversification. The contribution is an auditable routing stress test and implementation analysis, not an estimate of real-market crash probabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究金融系统中因主端点失效导致的路由故障转移问题，提出基于局部市场影响响应矩阵的灾后路由机制。通过对价格波动平方期望的分析，发现共享备份虽可提升可用性，但可能加剧机构间错误决策的共担风险；而均衡备援风险随存活端点数量增加而降低。对于不可分割决策，推导出独立随机路由的二阶矩，并定义有效暴露粒度以衡量其与理想分配的差距。引入条件期望取整和交换过程，在不依赖耦合配额的情况下实现有限代理风险控制。在60个合成投资组合网络及超1万次情景模拟中，该方法在单/双端点失效下分别降低6.57%和10.53%风险；真实API重放测试显示持有外风险下降3.30%（置信区间2.07–4.57%）。强相关误差、劣质端点和不可分割性限制了分散化效果。本文贡献在于提供可审计的路由压力测试与实现分析，而非真实市场崩盘概率估计。
AI.motivation: 主端点失效可能导致金融系统服务中断，引发决策错误传播。现有容错机制可能加剧机构间错误共担，需设计更优的故障转移策略以降低系统性风险。
AI.method: 构建局部市场影响响应矩阵，分析价格波动平方期望；采用对称构造法分析共享备份的长期风险底限；针对不可分割决策，推导独立随机路由的第二阶矩；引入条件期望取整与交换算法优化风险分布；通过大规模合成网络与真实数据回放验证性能。
AI.result: 在单/双端点失效场景下，所提方法分别降低6.57%和10.53%的风险；真实数据回放显示风险下降3.30%（95%置信区间：2.07–4.57%）；强相关误差、劣质节点和不可分割性显著限制分散化潜力。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的路由容错机制能有效降低故障转移带来的系统性风险，尤其在高并发、多节点环境中表现优异。尽管真实市场复杂性限制了理论优势的完全释放，但该方法具备可审计性和工程可行性，适用于关键金融系统的压力测试与部署优化。

title: LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. Under a generalized Bayesian formulation, the language expert provides a prior over candidate tokens, while the grounding expert contributes a visual likelihood that updates this prior, rather than transferring its complete predictive distribution. This factorized composition allows language reasoning and visual grounding to be controlled independently. We further introduce adaptive calibration to determine how strongly the visual likelihood should update the language prior at each decoding prefix. Specifically, LEGO-OPD uses the grounding expert's image-induced prediction shift as a prefix-dependent reference, preventing both insufficient and excessive visual supervision. Experiments with Qwen3 models show that LEGO-OPD consistently outperforms the evaluated single- and multi-teacher OPD baselines on both multimodal and text-only reasoning tasks. Moreover, it improves the initial student's visual perception while preserving text-only reasoning.

AI.tldr: LEGO-OPD 提出一种新的多模态在策略蒸馏方法，通过分离语言先验与视觉似然，实现语言推理与视觉定位的独立控制。利用语言专家提供候选词先验，接地专家提供视觉似然以更新先验，避免直接传递完整预测分布带来的干扰。引入自适应校准机制，根据图像诱导的预测变化动态调整视觉监督强度，防止过度或不足。实验表明，LEGO-OPD 在多模态和纯文本推理任务上均优于现有基线，同时提升初始学生模型的视觉感知并保持文本推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多教师的多模态在策略蒸馏方法中，直接使用视觉语言模型的完整预测分布会将视觉定位信号与语言先验纠缠，导致定位信息无法独立迁移；而增强视觉监督又可能过度强调视觉证据，损害语言推理能力。因此需要一种方法在不破坏语言模型推理能力的前提下，独立地优化视觉定位性能。
AI.method: 提出 LEGO-OPD，采用广义贝叶斯框架，将语言专家提供的先验与接地专家提供的视觉似然进行因子化组合，形成单一教师分布。通过图像引起的预测偏移作为前缀依赖参考，设计自适应校准机制，动态调节视觉似然对语言先验的更新强度。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3 模型上的实验表明，LEGO-OPD 在多模态和纯文本推理任务上均显著优于单教师和多教师基线方法；同时有效提升学生的视觉感知能力，且未牺牲其文本推理性能。
AI.conclusion: LEGO-OPD 通过因子化分解语言先验与视觉似然，并引入自适应校准机制，实现了语言推理与视觉接地的解耦控制，在保持强语言理解能力的同时显著提升了视觉定位性能，为多模态在策略蒸馏提供了高效且可调控的新范式。

title: JusticeAxis: Benchmarking Legal Judgment between Rigid Rule Application and Ungrounded Discretion
summary: A sound judgment applies the law to established facts and weighs the circumstances in which they arose. However, existing methods swing between rigid statute matching and ungrounded discretion, benchmarks score a label or a rubric, and the experience that would supply the balance stays unverified. We formalize legal judgment as a reference-anchored task, whose object is a single decision that stays tied to the statute and to the circumstances at once. We introduce JusticeAxis, 256 real-world criminal cases from 18 countries with audio, image, and text evidence, and three lawyer-written judgments for every case: the recorded one and one for each failure. We further propose JusticeAgent, a harness whose element agents establish the facts and whose judge agent applies the law under skills carrying experience of the circumstances. Skills are distilled from execution trajectories and admitted only under Bayesian credible bounds. Experiments show that failure turns direction with scale: open-weight backbones drift to unsupported grounds, frontier models to the statutory default. We further verify that JusticeAgent, as a simple yet effective plugin, carries a frozen open-weight backbone to commercial level. Project resources are available at https://github.com/beita6969/JusticeAxis.

AI.tldr: 该研究将法律判决形式化为一个参考锚定任务，引入JusticeAxis数据集（涵盖256个来自18个国家的真实刑事案件）和三份律师撰写的判决书，并提出JusticeAgent框架，通过事实建立与法官代理结合的方式，在经验技能的约束下应用法律。实验表明，模型规模扩大时，开放权重模型易偏离支持性依据，而前沿模型则趋向法定默认。JusticeAgent作为轻量级插件，可使冻结的开放权重模型达到商业级性能。
AI.motivation: 现有法律判决方法在严格法条匹配与无根据的自由裁量之间摇摆，缺乏对事实与情境平衡的验证。需要一种能同时关联法律条文与具体情境的可靠判决机制。
AI.method: 将法律判决建模为参考锚定任务；构建包含多模态证据（音频、图像、文本）的JusticeAxis数据集；设计JusticeAgent框架，由元素代理提取事实，法官代理在基于贝叶斯可信度约束的技能指导下应用法律。
AI.result: 实验显示，随着模型规模增加，开放权重模型趋向于无依据的推断，而前沿模型则倾向于法定默认。JusticeAgent作为插件可有效提升冻结骨干模型的判决性能至商业水平。
AI.conclusion: JusticeAgent通过结合事实推理与受控经验技能，实现了对法律判决的稳定、可验证建模，为自动化司法决策提供了可靠路径。

title: Where's Waldo? Query-language Preference under Cross-lingual Knowledge Disparities
summary: Large Language Models increasingly serve as interfaces for knowledge-intensive information seeking tasks across languages by synthesizing multilingual evidence. Prior work has shown that they often exhibit query-language preference -- the tendency to favor sources written in the language of the query -- but has largely examined this behavior in settings where equivalent knowledge is available across languages. However, this bias becomes consequential when sources in different languages provide incomplete or inconsistent accounts of the same fact, since the information users receive then depends on the sources a model selects to use. To characterize query-language preference under such cross-lingual knowledge disparities, we introduce Waldo, a multilingual Question-Answering (QA) benchmark constructed from Wikipedia. Waldo contains 12K QA pairs targeting knowledge gaps, where a fact is available in one language but absent in another, and knowledge conflicts, where language editions provide conflicting versions of the same fact. Evaluating eight models across five languages, we find that when one language edition merely lacks the relevant fact, models generally use evidence from the other language regardless of the query language. Under conflicting accounts, however, model responses strongly align with the document in the query language, causing semantically equivalent queries to elicit different accounts depending on the user's language. Finally, we explore two different approaches that could mitigate this preference under knowledge conflicts: a mechanistic intervention that ablates attention heads associated with query-language preference, and LoRA-based training, which reduces the preference gap by up to 61.5%.

AI.tldr: 该研究引入了Waldo，一个基于维基百科的多语言问答基准，用于评估大语言模型在跨语言知识差异下的查询语言偏好。实验发现，当某一语言版本缺失信息时，模型通常能跨语言使用证据；但在存在知识冲突时，模型强烈倾向于采用与查询语言一致的文档，导致相同问题因语言不同而获得不同答案。通过注意力头消融和LoRA微调两种方法，可将这种偏好差距降低最多达61.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注查询语言偏好在语言间知识对称情况下的表现，但忽视了当不同语言来源提供不完整或矛盾信息时，该偏好的实际影响。本文旨在揭示模型在跨语言知识差异情境下的行为模式，并探索缓解策略。
AI.method: 构建Waldo多语言QA基准，包含12,000个针对知识缺口和知识冲突的问答对；在五种语言上评估八种大语言模型；采用注意力头消融和LoRA微调进行干预以减轻查询语言偏好。
AI.result: 当某语言缺少事实信息时，模型能有效利用其他语言的证据；但在存在知识冲突时，模型响应高度依赖查询语言，导致语义等价查询产生不同回答；通过干预措施，可将偏好差距减少高达61.5%。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在跨语言知识冲突场景下表现出显著的查询语言偏好，这可能误导用户获取不一致的信息。通过机制性干预和微调方法可有效缓解该问题，提升多语言信息检索的公平性与可靠性。

title: The Null Is the Hard Part: Exact Tests for Memorization in Generative Models
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures. Code and measurement outputs at https://github.com/sushovan4/memorization-audits
summary: Memorization audits of generative models read similarity scores against thresholds, with no null distribution, and the conclusions they support can be wrong. By MemBench's rule, the benchmark's mitigations roughly halve Stable Diffusion's memorization; audited with false-discovery control, two thirds of the certified images are no longer detected under random prompt perturbations, five sixths under attention rescaling, and all of them under embedding optimization. The field's data-copying test, read against its own null, flags ten of twenty-four generators that reproduce nothing. We argue that for memorization the null is the hard part, and supply two. For a whole model, training and held-out images are exchangeable given its samples, and relabelling them is a permutation test, exact for any statistic when the held-out images are a random split; under it, a nearest-neighbour preference still fires on seven of those twenty-four, and a count restricted to the near-duplicate scale on none (McNemar p=0.016). For single images, the natural nulls fail twice, measurably: ranking an image among random images yields 596 false discoveries among 2,365 controls, and resampling independent generations makes the null three times too narrow. Calibrated against matched controls, the audit certifies 36 of 61 MemBench images at 5% false-discovery rate, held-out controls are certified in 0.01% of calibration splits, and on this benchmark two generations per image recover that count. A calibrated maximum, which reads occasional rather than typical copying, certifies 46. As the scale-restricted statistic we recommend the small-scale mass of the Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile, which also counts distinct images copied and tests whether two models copy the same ones.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出对生成模型记忆性审计的改进方法，指出现有方法因缺乏零假设分布而可能导致错误结论。通过引入两个新的零假设：全模型层面的置换检验和单图像层面的校准控制，验证了在不同扰动下（如随机提示扰动、注意力重缩放、嵌入优化）多数被认证图像不再被检测到，表明原方法存在高误报率。研究建议采用小尺度交集欧拉特征轮廓质量统计量，并证明其在识别真实复制行为上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型的记忆性审计依赖于相似度阈值判断，但缺乏合理的零假设分布，导致结论不可靠；尤其在面对模型扰动时，大量被认证为记忆的图像实际可能为误报。因此需要建立更严谨的统计基准来准确评估记忆性。
AI.method: 提出两种新的零假设：一是基于训练与保留图像在样本可交换性下的置换检验，用于全模型记忆性评估；二是针对单个图像设计匹配对照组，通过校准控制实现假发现率控制。同时引入小尺度交集欧拉特征轮廓作为推荐的统计量，以检测微小尺度上的重复内容。
AI.result: 在MemBench基准上，经校准后仅36/61图像在5%假发现率下被认证为记忆；保留控制集在0.01%的校准分割中被误认；且每张图像平均有2个生成版本可恢复记忆计数。最大值校准方法进一步将认证数量提升至46。小尺度质量统计量有效区分真实复制与偶然相似。
AI.conclusion: 记忆性审计的关键在于正确的零假设建模。当前方法普遍低估了随机波动的影响。本研究提供的校准框架和推荐统计量能显著提高审计的可靠性，避免误判，是未来记忆性评估的重要基础。

title: Vmem-$\varphi$: Low-Compute Out-of-Distribution Detection in Spiking Neural Networks from Membrane-Potential Statistics
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient approach to processing event-camera data, yet out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging in this setting. Existing OOD detection methods often depend on model outputs or computational components that are unavailable in object detection SNNs or are poorly suited to low-compute deployment. To that effect, we show that the subthreshold membrane potential \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) provides a useful internal signal for detecting distribution shifts. Simple per-channel statistics derived from these membrane dynamics enable OOD detection. To evaluate this approach, we introduce Gen1-C, an event-camera corruption benchmark developed upon the Prophesee Gen1 automotive detection dataset, containing six sensor-motivated histogram-level stress tests at five severity levels. We further propose the Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD), a corruption-blind method that operates on membrane-potential statistics. At the highest corruption severity, MDD achieves an AUROC of more than 0.88 on five of the six corruptions using only a bounded 64-frame observation window. Notably, the remaining corruption is also the one that has the smallest effect on the underlying detector. These results show that the temporal membrane-potential dynamics can provide an effective and low-cost signal for OOD detection in SNN-based event perception.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出利用脉冲神经网络（SNN）中膜电位的亚阈值动态作为内部信号，实现低计算开销的分布外（OOD）检测。通过简单统计膜电位的通道级特征，结合新提出的多描述符偏差（MDD）方法，在事件相机数据上实现了高精度的OOD检测。研究构建了Gen1-C基准测试集，涵盖六种传感器相关的数据扰动，结果表明在最高强度扰动下，MDD方法在五个扰动任务中达到超过0.88的AUROC，验证了膜电位动态作为有效、低成本的OOD检测信号的潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测方法依赖于模型输出或高计算组件，在基于事件相机的SNN目标检测中难以应用，且不适用于低算力部署。因此亟需一种无需外部输出、计算量小且能捕捉分布偏移的内部信号。
AI.method: 利用子阈值膜电位 $V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)$ 的时间动态，提取每通道的统计特征，提出多描述符偏差（MDD）方法进行无监督的分布外检测，仅需64帧观测窗口。
AI.result: 在Gen1-C基准测试中，MDD在五种扰动类型上达到超过0.88的AUROC，最高严重度下表现优异；剩余一种扰动影响最小，说明方法对实际影响大的分布偏移敏感。
AI.conclusion: 膜电位的时间动态可作为高效、低成本的内部信号，用于事件感知SNN中的分布外检测，具有良好的实用性和部署潜力。

title: What Should an Agent Remember? Disentangling Retention from Retrieval in Bounded-Memory Evaluation
comment: Code available in the accompanying repository
summary: A persistent agent must decide both what to retain as information arrives and what to surface once a query appears, yet memory evaluations can confound these decisions by comparing methods that differ in both retention and selection. We build a streaming-recall benchmark crossing retention and selection rules and evaluate every condition on the same 300 seeded episodes. Holding access fixed, query-aware selection improves required-fact recall by 15.5 percentage points (95% CI: 12.8 to 18.2), whereas a mixed comparison that also changes history access reports a 68.7-point advantage, of which 53.2 points are attributable to access. Under bounded retention, query-aware, dense, and oracle selection reach the retention ceiling, and all 319 observed failures in the bounded recency condition are caused by eviction rather than ranking errors. Recall falls to 0% as targets recede sufficiently far into the past. Repeating the evaluation on SQuAD preserves the retention ceiling while showing that dense retrieval can outperform lexical retrieval on natural text. These results show that bounded-memory evaluations should hold access fixed and report retention and selection separately.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个流式回忆基准测试，区分记忆保留与信息检索策略，并在300个种子场景中评估不同条件。结果显示，在固定访问条件下，查询感知的检索可将所需事实的召回率提升15.5个百分点；而若同时改变历史访问，则优势达68.7个百分点，其中53.2个百分点归因于访问差异。在有限记忆条件下，查询感知、密集检索和最优检索均达到保留上限，所有319次失败均由淘汰而非排序错误引起。当目标信息过久时，召回率降至0%。在SQuAD上的重复实验表明，密集检索优于词法检索。结论：有限记忆评估应固定访问方式，并分别报告保留与选择性能。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆评估方法常混淆保留与选择策略，导致结果不可靠。为准确衡量记忆系统性能，需分离这两个维度并进行独立评估。
AI.method: 构建流式回忆基准测试，控制变量（如访问方式）以独立评估保留与选择策略；在300个种子场景上进行实验，比较不同保留与选择规则下的表现；使用真实数据集（如SQuAD）验证结果普适性。
AI.result: 查询感知检索显著提升召回率（+15.5%），但混合比较中大部分优势来自访问方式差异（53.2个百分点）；在受限记忆下，所有失败由信息淘汰造成，而非排序错误；密集检索在自然语言文本上优于词法检索。
AI.conclusion: 有限记忆评估应保持访问方式一致，并将保留与选择性能分开报告，以避免误导性结论。

title: Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media with Multi-Task QLoRA
summary: Explainable suicide-risk assessment requires models not only to estimate risk severity, but also to identify supporting language and the risk and protective factors expressed in a post. We present our system for the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup on Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media, which addresses three tasks: risk-level classification, evidence phrase extraction, and multi-label factor identification. Our approach adapts Qwen2.5-Instruct models using quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) and an answer-masked causal language-model objective. We jointly train across all three tasks for risk classification, jointly train on Tasks~1a and 1b for evidence extraction, and adapt Task~2 separately for factor identification. We also tailor aggregation to each output: we average risk-level probabilities from the 32B and 72B models, combine evidence phrases through cross-fold consensus, and calibrate factor-specific decisions through rate matching based on out-of-fold operating points. On the official leaderboard, the final system achieved a composite score of 0.7738, with 0.8089 on Task~1 and 0.6919 on Task~2. Across the evaluated configurations, three-task training performed best for Task~1a, joint training on Tasks~1a and 1b performed best for Task~1b, and task-specific training performed best for Task~2. Probability averaging further improved Task~1a when component models had complementary errors. These findings highlight the value of tailoring both training objectives and aggregation strategies to the output structure of each task within a unified language-model framework.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对社交媒体上的可解释自杀风险评估，提出一个统一的多任务框架，解决风险等级分类、证据短语提取和多标签风险/保护因素识别三个任务。采用量化低秩适配（QLoRA）与掩码因果语言模型目标对Qwen2.5-Instruct模型进行微调，分别设计联合训练与独立训练策略，并针对不同任务定制聚合方法（如概率平均、交叉验证共识、率匹配校准）。在官方排行榜上取得0.7738的综合得分，其中任务1得分为0.8089，任务2为0.6919。实验表明，根据不同任务特性优化训练方式与融合策略能显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自杀风险评估模型缺乏可解释性，无法有效识别支持性语言及风险与保护因素，限制了其在真实场景中的应用。因此，亟需构建既能准确预测风险等级，又能提供可解释依据的模型，以增强可信度与临床实用性。
AI.method: 基于Qwen2.5-Instruct模型，使用量化低秩适配（QLoRA）进行参数高效微调；设计答案掩码的因果语言建模目标以增强生成能力；对三任务采用差异化训练策略：联合训练任务1a和1b用于证据提取，单独训练任务2用于因素识别；并针对各任务输出结构定制聚合策略，包括模型概率平均、跨折共识合并与基于留出折叠操作点的率匹配校准。
AI.result: 最终系统在官方排行榜上获得0.7738的综合得分，任务1（风险等级分类）得分0.8089，任务2（多标签因素识别）得分为0.6919。实验表明，三任务联合训练最优于任务1a，任务1a与1b联合训练最优于任务1b，而任务特定训练最适用于任务2；概率平均进一步提升了任务1a性能，尤其当组件模型存在互补错误时。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，在统一的语言模型框架下，根据各任务的输出结构量身定制训练目标与聚合策略，能够显著提升多任务可解释自杀风险评估系统的整体性能，为未来心理健康监测系统的设计提供了重要参考。

title: Sharp Oracle-Regret Tradeoffs for Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization
summary: We characterize the regret attainable in online convex optimization when access to the feasible set is limited to an exact linear optimization oracle. The learner is given an inscribed ball and a diameter bound and must remain feasible on every consistent instance. For convex $G$-Lipschitz losses, diameter at most $D$, a total allowance of $Q$ oracle calls, and a strict limit of $B$ calls per round, the dimension-free minimax expected regret is $Θ(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$. The lower bound applies to arbitrary randomized learners. Universal feasibility first forces each action into the hull of the supplied ball and the preceding oracle replies. A fixed-body construction then couples fresh phase directions to a shared simplex, making useful replies costly repeatedly even though all losses have a common minimizer. A counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks attains the matching rate. Total-budget and strict per-round guarantees follow as special cases, including the $T^{3/4}$ rate with one call per round and the quadratic total budget needed for $\sqrt T$ regret. For prescribed smoothness $β$, an analytic construction yields a curvature-dependent lower bound and identifies the threshold above which the general characterization remains sharp.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线凸优化中，仅通过精确线性优化查询访问可行集时可达到的后悔率。在凸G-Lipschitz损失、直径至多为D、总调用次数为Q、每轮最多B次调用的条件下，无维度的最小最大期望后悔率为Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})。下界适用于任意随机学习者。通过固定体构造，将新阶段方向与共享单纯形耦合，使有用回复在重复中代价高昂，即使所有损失具有共同最小值。采用交错块的计数近似梯度方法实现了匹配速率。总预算和严格每轮约束作为特例，包括每轮一次调用时的T^{3/4}速率以及实现√T后悔所需的二次总预算。对于给定光滑性β，解析构造给出了曲率相关下界，并确定了通用表征保持紧致的阈值。
AI.motivation: 研究在受限访问可行集（仅能通过线性优化查询）的情况下，如何在在线凸优化中最小化后悔。特别关注总调用次数和每轮调用上限对性能的影响，旨在揭示最优后悔率的理论极限及其依赖结构。
AI.method: 提出固定体构造以耦合新阶段方向与共享单纯形，分析其对有效查询成本的影响；设计计数近似梯度方法，采用交错块策略以逼近最优性能；结合解析构造推导曲率相关的下界，验证通用表征的紧致性。
AI.result: 在给定条件下，最小最大期望后悔率为Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})，该结果通过下界证明和上界算法构造均得到支持。特殊情形如每轮一次调用时达到T^{3/4}速率，而实现√T后悔需二次总预算。光滑性β影响下界，存在一个阈值使通用表征仍保持紧致。
AI.conclusion: 本文刻画了在有限线性优化查询限制下的在线凸优化后悔率的理论极限，揭示了总调用和每轮调用限制对性能的关键影响，并通过构造性方法实现了最优速率，为受限优化设置提供了完整的理论框架。

title: From Image Latent Space to Fuzzy Rules: Interpretable Analysis of Gastrointestinal Foundation Model
comment: Accepted at the excv, ECCV 2026 Workshops. 17 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables
summary: Foundation models pretrained on large-scale datasets demonstrate strong transferability to medical imaging tasks. However, understanding how their latent representations encode clinically relevant information remains an open challenge in safety-critical domains. This study proposes a prototype-based fuzzy-rule framework that interprets the patch-level features produced by the inner layers of pretrained foundation models, without any fine-tuning. Class-specific prototypes are learned by clustering in the feature space, yielding compact visual patterns. Patch features are then expressed as prototype similarities and classified by fuzzy rules with linguistic IF-THEN conditions that are human readable. The framework is applied across the final two blocks of ViT-S/16 backbones pretrained on ImageNet-1K and GastroNet-5M, and benchmarked against k-nearest neighbours, kernel SVM, and linear probing under identical frozen features, on wireless capsule endoscopy classification, gastrointestinal endoscopy classification, and colonic polyp segmentation. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed method, without backbone fine-tuning, reaches accuracy comparable to these black-box classifiers, and that domain-specific pretraining yields features that are both discriminative and symbolically compressible. Because the resulting rules are extracted from real data and expressed in interpretable terms, they are further used as an instrument to investigate synthetic medical images, providing a human-readable account of which real prototypes and rules a generator reproduces or fails to reproduce, localising where a synthetic image departs from real tissue rather than summarising it with a single score. The framework thus offers a transparent, depth-resolved view of how foundation models organise clinically relevant structure, together with a practical downstream use of the extracted rules.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于原型的模糊规则框架，无需微调即可解释预训练基础模型（如ViT-S/16）在医学影像任务中产生的局部特征。通过聚类学习类别特定原型，将补丁特征表示为与原型的相似性，并使用人类可读的模糊规则进行分类。实验表明，该方法在不微调模型的情况下，性能可媲美kNN、SVM和线性探测等黑箱方法；且领域特定预训练的特征具有更强的判别力和符号压缩性。此外，提取出的规则可用于分析合成医学图像，揭示生成器是否准确复现真实组织结构，从而实现对合成图像偏差的定位。整体框架提供了模型内部临床结构组织的透明、分层视图，并具备实际应用价值。
AI.motivation: 理解预训练基础模型在医学影像任务中的隐含表示如何编码临床相关知识仍是一个开放挑战，尤其在安全关键领域。现有方法多为黑箱模型，缺乏可解释性，难以用于诊断验证或合成数据质量评估。因此需要一种无需微调、可解释性强且能深入分析模型决策机制的方法。
AI.method: 提出原型驱动的模糊规则框架：1）在模型中间层特征空间中对补丁特征进行聚类，获得类别相关的原型；2）将每个补丁特征表示为与各原型的相似度；3）构建基于语言条件（IF-THEN）的模糊规则系统，实现可读分类；4）应用于ViT-S/16在ImageNet-1K和GastroNet-5M上预训练的模型，在多个医学影像任务上进行评估；5）利用提取规则分析合成图像，判断其是否复现真实病理模式。
AI.result: 1）所提方法在无线胶囊内镜分类、胃肠内镜分类和结肠息肉分割任务上，达到与kNN、SVM、线性探测相当的精度，且无需微调；2）领域特定预训练（如GastroNet-5M）使特征更具判别性和符号压缩性；3）提取的规则能有效识别合成图像与真实组织之间的差异，定位生成偏差，而非仅用单一评分概括。
AI.conclusion: 该原型-模糊规则框架提供了一种无需微调、高度可解释的方法，用于分析基础模型在医学影像中的深层语义组织。它不仅实现了高性能分类，还为合成医学图像的质量评估提供了新工具，有助于增强模型可信度与临床实用性。

title: When Harnesses Lose the Signal: Causal Evaluation of Recovery in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents rely on external harnesses to pass information between the model and its environment and to recover from execution errors. Yet recovery is usually judged only by average task success. This hides an important tension. The same operation can rescue a failing trajectory or disrupt one that would otherwise succeed. We frame recovery as a causal decision problem. Starting from the same execution state, we compare what happens with and without recovery, separate rescue from harm, and study how the value of recovery changes over time. We then introduce the Causal Intervention Router (CIR), a lightweight policy that uses information available before recovery to decide when intervention is worthwhile. On long-horizon ALFWorld tasks with Qwen3-14B, CIR raises success from 70.33% to 73.33%, a gain of 3.00 percentage points. It leaves all evaluated trajectories with correct observations untouched. Additional controls show that the benefit of recovery cannot be explained solely by the new observation returned by the environment. These results provide a practical way to evaluate recovery and apply it selectively.

AI.tldr: 本文将恢复机制视为因果决策问题，提出Causal Intervention Router（CIR）模型，通过在恢复前分析信息来决定是否干预。在长时序ALFWorld任务中，CIR使成功率达到73.33%，提升3个百分点，且不干扰正确轨迹，证明其可有效区分救援与破坏性干预。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型代理依赖外部工具进行信息传递和错误恢复，但恢复效果仅以平均任务成功率衡量，忽略了同一操作可能既拯救失败轨迹又破坏本可成功的轨迹，导致评估偏差。
AI.method: 将恢复建模为因果决策问题，比较同一执行状态下有无恢复的差异，利用恢复前可用信息设计轻量级策略CIR，决定何时干预更优。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-14B模型上，CIR将长时序ALFWorld任务的成功率从70.33%提升至73.33%，提升3个百分点；所有正确轨迹均未被干扰；恢复收益无法仅由环境返回的新观察解释。
AI.conclusion: CIR提供了一种选择性、可量化评估恢复价值的实用方法，能有效避免无效或有害干预，提升系统鲁棒性。

title: Mixture of Decoders for Diverse Dialog Response Generation
summary: Mixture modeling is a long established machine learning technique for learning large sets of multi-modal data. While it is known that sequence-to-sequence models for dialog response generation suffer from the problem of low diversity, we hypothesize that it is because sequence-to-sequence models tend to learn a degenerate uni-modal distribution of responses. We then propose to incorporate a mixture of decoders into sequence-to-sequence models and try to make each decoder learn specialized topics in order to improve the diversity of generated responses. Our model is developed under the framework of conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE). We evaluate our approach on an open domain chat corpus and show improvement over strong baselines in quantitative measures and human evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在序列到序列模型中引入混合解码器，以解决对话生成中多样性不足的问题。通过在条件变分自编码器框架下让每个解码器学习特定主题，从而实现多模态响应生成，并在开放域聊天数据集上验证了该方法在定量指标和人工评估上的优越性。
AI.motivation: 序列到序列模型在对话生成中存在响应多样性低的问题，这可能是因为其倾向于学习单一模态的响应分布。
AI.method: 在条件变分自编码器（CVAE）框架下，引入混合解码器结构，使每个解码器专注于学习特定主题，从而提升生成响应的多样性。
AI.result: 在开放域聊天语料库上，所提方法在定量指标和人类评估中均优于强基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入混合解码器，能够有效改善序列到序列模型生成对话响应的多样性，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Verification Pulses and the Cost of Escaping Wrong Consensus
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures; code and raw experimental records: https://github.com/shi1720/verification-pulses
summary: External verification can correct individual outputs while leaving a self-reinforcing population in the basin of a wrong consensus. We study how the timing and addressing of a fixed verification budget affect recovery in an asynchronous binary register. For a general nonlinear response, we derive the minimum fuel required to cross a basin boundary under a peak verification constraint. For a finite population, an exact birth--death calculation gives the probability of subsequent wrong consensus after a pulse. Our main asymptotic result identifies the critical budget window: a leading term $N\log(x_0/b)$ and a correction of order $\sqrt N$, with separate variance contributions from repeated verification targets and autonomous amplification after verification stops. The distinction is substantial: with 16 majority-updated slots and 14 initially wrong, 9 random checks cross the mean-field budget threshold, whereas 23 are required for 95% eventual recovery in the exact model. A prospectively specified experiment records 13,392 language-model responses, including calibration and 108 held-out trajectories. Calibration produces different fitted response regimes, but all four adjusted schedule-comparison intervals include zero. A distributional audit also finds that modest mean-prediction error can conceal a large underestimate of terminal consensus occupancy. The results support risk-calibrated reset scheduling under a specified update contract, while explicitly separating it from distinct-target checking and unrestricted evidence broadcast.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在异步二元寄存器中，外部验证的时机与预算分配如何影响系统从错误共识中恢复。针对非线性响应，推导了在峰值验证约束下穿越势阱边界所需的最小燃料；对有限种群，通过出生-死亡模型精确计算了脉冲验证后出现错误共识的概率。主要渐近结果识别出关键预算窗口：主导项为 $N\log(x_0/b)$，修正项为 $\sqrt{N}$ 阶，且来自重复验证目标与验证停止后的自主放大效应的方差贡献分离显著。数值表明，16个多数更新槽中14个初始错误时，9次随机检查即达均值场预算阈值，但需23次才能实现95%最终恢复。实验记录13,392条语言模型输出，校准后呈现不同响应模式，但所有调整后的对比区间均包含零。分布审计显示，微小平均预测误差可能掩盖终端共识占有率的严重低估。结果支持在指定更新合约下进行风险校准的重置调度，同时明确区分目标特定检查与无限制证据广播。
AI.motivation: 研究如何通过外部验证纠正个体输出，防止系统陷入错误共识的吸引域，并探讨在有限验证预算下，验证时机和策略对系统恢复能力的影响。
AI.method: 采用非线性动力学建模分析势阱边界穿越所需最小验证量；对有限种群使用精确的出生-死亡过程计算错误共识概率；通过渐近分析确定关键预算窗口结构，结合数值模拟与实际语言模型实验验证理论结果。
AI.result: 发现关键预算窗口由主导项 $N\log(x_0/b)$ 和 $\sqrt{N}$ 阶修正项构成，且验证目标重复性与验证后自发放大效应具有独立方差贡献。数值结果显示，均值场模型低估恢复需求，真实场景中需更多验证次数。实验数据支持风险校准重置调度的有效性，并揭示传统平均误差指标可能掩盖共识偏差。
AI.conclusion: 在有限验证预算下，验证策略的时机与目标选择至关重要。应采用风险校准的重置调度机制，并明确区分目标特定检查与无限制证据传播，以有效避免错误共识的持续演化。

title: Scores That Hold, Benchmarks That Leak: Measuring Dataset Contamination in Public Brain-Tumor MRI Classification
summary: Automated classification of brain tumors from MRI is a heavily published application of deep learning in medical imaging, with reported accuracies on public benchmarks routinely exceeding 98%. However, accuracy does not capture a critical dimension of benchmark quality: dataset integrity, defined as the independence of test from training data at the image, patient, and acquisition-source levels. We introduce a three-layer contamination framework comprising duplicate, patient, and source-label leakage to assess the public corpora on which this literature rests. We audit the three most widely used corpora against a chest-radiograph negative control and quantify each layer's effect on measured performance across nine architectures and three evaluation conditions. Contamination is severe at every layer: 28.8% of the dominant corpus's official test split has a near-twin in its own training split, a second corpus leaks 22.3% of its test images byte-identically, 95.5% of traceable test images share a patient with training, and file-header features containing no anatomy separate tumor from no-tumor at 0.959 balanced accuracy, at parity with fine-tuned ResNet backbones. The unexpected result is that removing every identified leaked test image leaves balanced accuracy essentially unchanged: stable performance after deduplication does not establish benchmark integrity. Our findings establish dataset integrity as a distinct, measurable axis of benchmark quality that a stable leaderboard cannot certify. For biomedical research, reported accuracy on these corpora alone does not establish that a model has learned to recognize tumors rather than exploit dataset-specific cues. We release the contaminated-file lists, recovered patient identifiers, and deduplicated splits.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了脑肿瘤MRI自动分类领域中公开数据集的严重污染问题，提出三层泄漏框架（重复、患者、来源标签）评估数据完整性。尽管现有模型在基准上报告准确率超98%，但大量测试图像与训练集存在重叠或关联，甚至文件头特征即可达到0.959的平衡准确率，表明模型可能依赖数据特异性线索而非真实肿瘤识别。去除泄露样本后性能基本不变，说明排行榜稳定性无法保证数据完整性。研究强调数据完整性是衡量基准质量的关键维度，并公开污染文件列表和去重划分结果。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在脑肿瘤MRI分类任务中报告的高准确率可能源于数据集污染而非真正医学理解，亟需评估数据完整性以确保模型泛化能力的真实验证。
AI.method: 构建三层污染检测框架（图像重复、患者重合、采集源泄漏），结合胸部X光负控对比，对三个最常用数据集进行审计；通过图像相似性分析、患者标识恢复及文件头特征挖掘量化各层污染程度，并在九种架构和三种评估条件下测试性能变化。
AI.result: 发现主导数据集28.8%测试图像存在近似重复于训练集，另一数据集22.3%测试图像字节级重复；95.5%可追踪测试图像与训练集共享患者；文件头特征单独即达0.959平衡准确率，与深度网络相当；即使移除所有泄露图像，模型性能仍稳定，说明高准确率不反映真实学习能力。
AI.conclusion: 数据完整性是独立于准确率的重要基准质量指标，当前高准确率榜单无法证明模型已学会识别肿瘤而非利用数据特异性线索。研究呼吁在生物医学研究中重视数据清洗与真实性验证，并公开污染清单与去重数据集以促进可信评估。

title: Benchmarking Prompt Optimization of Large Language Models With Chess
summary: Evaluating large language models becomes increasingly challenging as their capabilities advance: benchmarks can saturate, public test sets risk contamination, and assessing harder tasks can require expensive grading or execution infrastructure. These challenges are amplified in automatic prompt optimization (APO), where evaluation is repeated throughout the search for better prompts. Studying APO therefore requires a benchmark that is cheap and deterministic to score, hard enough to leave room for improvement, and renewable as models evolve. We introduce a chess benchmark built from 1,118 Lichess puzzles to study APO for frozen LLMs: we optimize their prompts without updating their model weights. Chess combines inexpensive exact-match scoring, engine-based evaluation of alternative moves, and a renewable supply of problems with adjustable difficulty. Unlike evaluations that report only success on isolated test items, the benchmark also connects puzzle-solving gains to short game-play rollouts within the same domain. We use it to evaluate six APO algorithms on eight target models, measuring not only baseline strength but also how much each model responds to optimization and whether optimized prompts transfer across models and to game play. Chess is thus a well-suited benchmark for APO: it is (i) challenging, as even the strongest evaluated model, Gemini 3.5 Flash (used as the meta-model), solves only about 55\% of puzzles; (ii) discriminative, revealing gains, unchanged performance, and regressions across methods and models; (iii) renewable, with fresh puzzles to reduce contamination risk and adjustable difficulty to maintain headroom as models improve; and (iv) affordable, as the complete study runs for around \$800. We release the puzzles, optimization and evaluation code, and dataset-renewal scripts (https://github.com/imec-ailabs/Automatic-Prompt-Optimization-with-Chess).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于1,118个Lichess棋局的国际象棋基准，用于评估冻结大语言模型的自动提示优化（APO）。该基准具备低成本、确定性评分、可重复使用和难度可调等优势，克服了传统评测在模型能力提升后易饱和、测试集污染等问题。通过精确匹配评分与引擎评估相结合，不仅能衡量单个棋局解决率，还可连接提示优化效果与实际对局表现。研究对比了六种APO算法在八种模型上的表现，揭示了不同模型对提示优化的响应差异及提示迁移能力。实验表明，即使最强模型Gemini 3.5 Flash也仅能解决约55%的棋局，证明该基准具有挑战性、区分度高、可再生且经济高效（总成本约800美元），适用于持续评估与优化。代码与数据已开源。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型能力提升，传统评测方法面临基准饱和、测试集污染、评估成本高等问题，尤其在自动提示优化（APO）中，需频繁评估导致挑战加剧。因此亟需一个低成本、可再生、难度适中且能有效区分性能差异的基准。
AI.method: 构建一个基于1,118个Lichess棋局的国际象棋基准，采用精确匹配评分与引擎验证替代路径，结合短回合对局模拟，评估提示优化效果；系统测试六种APO算法在八种模型上的表现，分析基线强度、优化响应性、提示迁移性及对游戏表现的影响。
AI.result: 最强模型Gemini 3.5 Flash仅解决约55%的棋局，表明基准具有足够挑战性；不同方法与模型间出现显著性能差异，包括提升、不变甚至退化；提示优化效果可部分跨模型迁移；整体评估成本控制在约800美元，验证了基准的经济性与可持续性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的国际象棋基准是评估自动提示优化的理想工具：具备挑战性、区分度、可再生性和低成本特性，适用于长期、高效、可靠的模型优化研究，并已开源以促进社区发展。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents
summary: The performance of AI coding agents is highly dependent on their underlying coding rules. However, existing coding rules are typically hand-crafted and fixed, making the process labor-intensive and often suboptimal. In this work, we propose RuleEvolve, a self-evolving framework for coding rules. RuleEvolve maintains a pool of candidate coding rules and iteratively improves them. In each iteration, it employs an LLM-powered mutator module to generate variants from existing candidates, and then uses a judge module to evaluate these variants and update the pool with the best-performing ones. Extensive evaluations across two coding-agent frameworks, four backbone LLMs, and three benchmarks demonstrate that RuleEvolve outperforms both manual engineering and existing prompt optimization baselines in terms of functional correctness of the generated code, code length, and/or generation cost (e.g., tokens used).

AI.tldr: RuleEvolve 是一个自进化编码规则框架，通过迭代优化候选规则池来提升AI代码代理的性能。它利用LLM驱动的变异模块生成规则变体，并通过评估模块筛选最优规则，显著优于人工设计和现有提示优化方法，在代码正确性、长度和生成成本方面表现更优。
AI.motivation: 现有编码规则多为手工设计且固定，过程繁琐且效果不佳，亟需一种可自动优化的规则演化机制以提升AI代码代理的性能。
AI.method: RuleEvolve 采用迭代式框架：维护候选规则池，通过LLM驱动的变异模块生成新规则变体，再由评估模块筛选并更新规则池，实现规则的持续优化。
AI.result: 在两个代码代理框架、四种骨干LLM及三个基准测试中，RuleEvolve 在代码功能正确性、代码长度和生成成本（如使用token数）方面均优于手动工程和现有提示优化基线。
AI.conclusion: RuleEvolve 有效实现了编码规则的自进化，显著提升了AI代码代理的性能，展示了自动化规则优化在实际应用中的巨大潜力。

title: Attention Manifolds: Steering or Blocking Language Models by Editing Learned B-Spline Surfaces
summary: In standard transformer attention, a source token sends the same value vector to every receiver. The query determines \emph{how much} to attend but not \emph{what} to extract. This work introduces \textbf{attention manifolds}: learned 2D B-spline surfaces $S_d(q_d, k_d)$ that modulate each value dimension based on the query-key interaction. Each surface is a tensor-product cubic B-spline initialized to zero, preserving pretrained behavior. Applied to LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct and 3B-Instruct, attention manifolds reduce WikiText-2 validation perplexity by 2--2.5 points with 0.3\% parameter overhead. Across 112 diverse prompts, surfaces change greedy-decoded output for 69\% (1B) to 83\% (3B) of cases, with the strongest effects on ambiguous and polysemous inputs (94--100\% change rate). The surfaces improve output quality: correcting factual errors (\emph{``the CAP theorem has three main components''} $\to$ \emph{``it is impossible to guarantee all three''}), increasing precision (\emph{``impossible to know certain properties''} $\to$ \emph{``impossible to know both position and momentum''}), and adding specificity (a generic quote $\to$ an attributed Saint Augustine citation, consistently at both scales). The learned surfaces are also mechanically editable: inverting a layer's coefficients changes greedy output for 9/10 prompts (KL~0.010), providing a geometric mechanism for model steering. Setting surface coefficients to $-1$ creates ``attention walls'' that block value flow through specific dimensions. In a preliminary experiment, a layer-wide wall redirects an explosive-device prompt from specific instructions to general educational content, suggesting a path toward safety-oriented manifold shaping.

AI.tldr: 提出注意力流形（attention manifolds），通过2D B-spline表面动态调节每个值维度，使查询-键交互决定提取内容而非仅关注程度。在LLaMA 3.2模型上，该方法降低困惑度2–2.5点，仅增加0.3%参数开销，并显著提升输出质量与可控性，支持可编辑的模型引导与安全控制。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer注意力中，源令牌向所有接收者发送相同值向量，仅由查询决定关注度而非具体内容，限制了表达能力；本文旨在增强注意力机制对信息内容的精细调控能力。
AI.method: 引入基于张量积三次B样条的2D注意力流形 $S_d(q_d, k_d)$，用于按查询-键交互动态调节各值维度；初始化为零以保持预训练行为；可通过学习系数实现内容选择与模型控制。
AI.result: 在WikiText-2上验证困惑度下降2–2.5点；112个提示中69%–83%的输出发生变化，尤其在模糊/多义输入中达94%–100%；纠正事实错误、提升精度、增加具体性；支持机械式编辑（如系数反转、设置为-1形成‘注意力墙’）以实现模型引导与安全控制。
AI.conclusion: 注意力流形提供了一种可解释、可编辑且高效的注意力增强机制，不仅提升了生成质量，还为模型安全性与可控性提供了新路径。

title: PACT: End-to-End Learning of Human Pose, Contacts, and Forces from Video
summary: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion.
