Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. To address the scarcity of force annotations, we develop a data annotation pipeline that combines contact labeling with physics-based motion and force optimization, producing training supervision from synthetic and real-world videos. We also introduce a real-world climbing benchmark ForceWall with climbing videos and corresponding ground-truth contact forces obtained from the force sensors. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art contact and force estimation, outperforming staged reconstruction approaches and generalizing to interactions beyond the training distribution. These results support end-to-end joint learning as an effective approach to recovering human motion and physical interactions from video.

AI.tldr: PACT 是一个端到端模型，联合估计单目视频中的人体姿态、接触点和接触力。通过引入可学习的接触力标记和时序变换器，结合视觉特征与世界空间运动，实现对人体运动与物理交互的统一建模。利用物理约束监督提升一致性，并通过合成与真实视频构建数据标注流程以缓解力标签稀缺问题。提出真实攀岩基准 ForceWall 提供带传感器测量的真实力数据。实验表明该方法在接触与力估计上达到先进水平，优于分阶段方法并具备良好泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将姿态重建与接触/力估计分开处理，导致推理不连贯且误差传播严重；需一种能联合建模人体运动、接触及力的端到端框架以提升整体性能与物理一致性。
AI.method: PACT 在人体重建基础模型基础上添加可学习的接触力令牌，采用时序变换器融合视觉特征与世界空间运动，通过联合预测头优化姿态并估计接触与力；引入基于物理的监督机制确保运动与受力的一致性；设计数据标注流水线结合接触标注与物理优化生成训练标签；构建真实场景基准 ForceWall 用于评估。
AI.result: PACT 在接触和力估计任务上均超越现有分阶段方法，在多种交互场景下表现出更强的泛化能力；验证了端到端联合学习在恢复视频中的人体运动与物理交互方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 端到端联合学习是恢复视频中人体运动与物理交互的有效途径，通过整合视觉、物理先验与可学习表示，显著提升了接触与力估计的精度与鲁棒性。

title: JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces
summary: LLM agents generate intermediate reasoning and actions token by token, making extended interactions slow and computationally expensive. Jev-style models offer fast probabilistic predictions over finite fields, but require those fields to be specified in advance. This requirement limits autonomous task solving, where the available actions must be derived from natural language instructions and adapted through interaction. We introduce JevSpawn, a compositional policy that connects natural language task specifications to finite probabilistic exploration. Parallel action spawning is coupled with feedback driven branch selection, representation revision, and recovery from retained alternatives. Shared action structure and model prefixes reduce repeated generation and context computation without additional training. Evaluations on eight benchmark tasks against seven agent baselines and a TypeSafe Jev variant establish JevSpawn as a promising approach to structured agentic inference, with improved task performance and faster navigation.

AI.tldr: JevSpawn 提出一种组合策略，将自然语言任务描述与有限概率探索相连接，通过并行动作生成和反馈驱动的分支选择、表示修订及从保留选项中恢复，实现高效结构化智能体推理。相比基线方法，在8个基准任务上表现出更快的导航速度和更高的任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在生成中间推理和动作时逐词进行，导致交互时间长且计算成本高；而传统Jev模型虽能快速预测但需预先指定有限域，限制了自主任务求解能力。因此需要一种能够动态推导可用动作并适应交互的高效方法。
AI.method: JevSpawn采用并行动作生成机制，结合反馈驱动的分支选择、表示修订与保留备选方案的恢复策略；利用共享动作结构和模型前缀减少重复生成与上下文计算，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在八个基准任务上的评估显示，JevSpawn优于七种代理基线和一种类型安全的Jev变体，在任务完成率和推理速度方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: JevSpawn为结构化智能体推理提供了一种有前景的新范式，能够在不增加训练负担的前提下实现高效、自适应的任务求解。

title: Lingtai: What Concept Geometry Reveals--and Does Not Reveal--About LLM Inference
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. An earlier version was publicly released on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23068698)
summary: Observing what a large language model computes during autoregressive inference--online and without training probes--remains difficult. We introduce Lingtai, a training-free concept telemetry layer: at each generation step, residual states are projected onto a domain-specific bank of named concept anchors, constructed without labeled concept examples, outcome labels, gradient fitting, or activation-space optimization, producing a structured per-step concept-coordinate signal. Across code generation and grade-school mathematical reasoning, this signal exhibits a robust association with predictive uncertainty: the association survives problem-identity and token-position controls and is not attributable to a single token type, is not explained by a simple correct/incorrect mixture on GSM8K, and is not reproduced by matched random anchors; it is markedly weaker or direction-inconsistent in K-means and PCA projections. Two structures emerge: a recurring uncertainty-linked activity signal whose functional geometry is task-conditioned (distinct activity-entropy shapes on HumanEval, MBPP, and GSM8K), and an execution-specific trajectory identity with strong local inertia but weak re-instantiation invariance--under completion-only elastic alignment, corruption at k=32 (approximately a median quarter of the completion) on the matched re-execution subset still retrieves the archived episode at 62.0%, while a fresh execution retrieves it only 11.7-16.0% of the time. Finally, a matched audit finds no evidence that the scalar concept-activity signal used here supplies a stable correctness coordinate under the tested protocol; we therefore treat correctness as externally supplied. Telemetry adds 0.7-1.6% per-token decode overhead for the 161-anchor code implementation, with unchanged generated tokens.

AI.tldr: Lingtai是一种无需训练的概念遥测层，可在自回归推理过程中实时、无训练地观测大语言模型的计算过程。通过将残差状态投影到无监督构建的领域特定概念锚点库中，生成每步的概念坐标信号。该信号在代码生成和小学数学推理任务中与预测不确定性显著相关，且不受问题身份、词元位置等因素影响，非随机锚点或主成分分析等方法可复现。信号表现出任务依赖的功能几何结构与执行轨迹的局部惯性特征，但缺乏重执行一致性。遥测引入0.7-1.6%的每词元解码开销，不影响生成结果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以在不使用训练探针的情况下在线观测大语言模型在自回归推理过程中的内部计算。需要一种无需训练、能实时提供结构化概念信号的机制，以理解模型的推理过程及其不确定性。
AI.method: 提出Lingtai框架：利用无监督方式构建领域特定的概念锚点库，将每步的残差状态投影至这些锚点，生成结构化的概念坐标信号。不依赖标注数据、标签、梯度优化或激活空间调整。
AI.result: 概念活动信号与预测不确定性有强关联，且在多种控制条件下保持稳健；不同任务下呈现不同的活动熵形状；执行轨迹具有局部惯性但缺乏重执行稳定性；随机锚点或降维方法无法复制该现象；遥测增加少量解码开销（0.7-1.6%），生成内容不变。
AI.conclusion: Lingtai为理解大语言模型的推理过程提供了无训练、实时的遥测能力，揭示了不确定性与概念活动之间的深层关联，但其信号不能作为稳定正确性的代理，需外部判定。

title: Large Language Bayes Is Not Reparameterisation-Invariant
summary: Large Language Bayes (LLB) answers an informal modelling question by sampling candidate probabilistic programs from a language model, running approximate inference on each, and averaging them with weights proportional to an exponentiated evidence bound. We show that this weighting depends on how a model is written. The log marginal likelihood is invariant to reparameterisation; the evidence bound is not. On eight schools the centered and non-centered programs are the same measure to $5.7\times10^{-14}$, yet their weights differ by $6.1\times$; importance weighting reduces this only to $2.2\times$, and reproducing the inference LLB actually runs, a full-covariance Gaussian matched to the posterior moments, still leaves $1.9\times$ on eight schools and $8.9\times$ in $64$ dimensions. Across likelihood families, dimensions and funnel severities the discrepancy reaches $31.9\times$ and reverses sign, so no single writing is uniformly preferable. It inverts Bayes factors against eight natural competitors, and the induced error in the model posterior, and in any downstream target, is controlled by the spread $Δ$ of the bound shortfalls through a known sharp Hilbert-distance bound. Across $360$ programs from six language models the parameterisation written ranges from $0\%$ to $100\%$ centered and is stable within a model. Detecting equivalent programs statistically can falsely merge genuinely different models at practical sample budgets; verifying reparameterisations we generate ourselves cannot, and closes the window.

AI.tldr: Large Language Bayes (LLB) samples probabilistic programs from a language model, weights them by evidence bounds, but these weights depend on parameterization—despite log marginal likelihood being reparameterization-invariant. On the eight schools example, centered and non-centered versions differ in weight by 6.1× despite being mathematically equivalent to 5.7×10⁻¹⁴ precision. Importance weighting reduces this to 2.2×, and even full-covariance Gaussian matching leaves a 1.9× discrepancy in 8D and 8.9× in 64D. Across various settings, differences reach up to 31.9× and even reverse Bayes factors. The error is controlled by the spread Δ of bound shortfalls via a sharp Hilbert-distance bound. Analysis of 360 programs across six models shows parameterization ranges from 0% to 100% centered, stable within models. Statistical detection of equivalent programs may falsely merge distinct models at practical sample sizes; verified reparameterizations close this gap.
AI.motivation: To understand how the choice of parameterization affects model selection and inference in Large Language Bayes (LLB), particularly when using language models to generate probabilistic programs. The core motivation is that while log marginal likelihood is invariant under reparameterization, the evidence bounds used in LLB are not, leading to potentially misleading model weights and posterior estimates.
AI.method: The paper evaluates LLB's behavior across different parameterizations (centered vs. non-centered) using benchmark problems like the eight schools model. It compares weights derived from evidence bounds, applies importance weighting, and uses full-covariance Gaussian approximations to match posterior moments. A theoretical bound based on Hilbert distance is derived to quantify error due to bound shortfall spread Δ. Empirical evaluation spans 360 programs from six language models.
AI.result: Centered and non-centered parameterizations yield significantly different weights (up to 31.9× difference), even when they represent the same underlying model. This leads to reversed Bayes factors and substantial errors in posterior estimation. Even advanced corrections like importance weighting or moment-matching fail to fully eliminate discrepancies. The induced error is tightly bounded by the spread Δ of evidence bound shortfalls.
AI.conclusion: No single parameterization is uniformly optimal in LLB due to sensitivity to program formulation. The reliance on evidence bounds introduces systematic bias tied to implementation style. Correcting for this requires explicit verification of reparameterizations rather than statistical equivalence detection. Theoretical bounds provide control over inference error, but practical robustness demands careful handling of program representation.

title: PixelDense: Dense Prediction as Representation Alignment for Pixel Diffusion
summary: Representation alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training, but its alignment targets are almost exclusively semantic encoders such as DINOv2 and CLIP. Recent analysis points to spatial structure, not global semantics, as the carrier of the alignment effect, yet dense-prediction foundation models trained to predict that structure remain overlooked as REPA targets. In pixel-space diffusion, SAM2, Depth Anything v2, and Metric3D v2 each outperform the DINOv2-only GenEval baseline, with the two geometric teachers leading the segmentation teacher. A flat sum of all four teachers, however, lands below the best single geometric teacher, as semantic and geometric gradients compete for one denoiser projection. We introduce PixelDense, which routes DINOv2 and SAM2 through a semantic projection stream, routes Depth Anything v2 and Metric3D v2 through a geometric projection stream, and adds a weight-space orthogonality penalty that keeps the two streams in disjoint subspaces. All four teachers are frozen during training and dropped at inference. Applied to PixelGen and DeCo with a single recipe, PixelDense improves GenEval, DPG-Bench, and HPS v2.1, raises PixelGen-XXL's GenEval Overall from 0.7927 to 0.8093, and beats every single-teacher and unfactored multi-teacher variant. In partial-noise reconstruction, independent panoptic, depth, and surface-normal probes show up to 53.1% PQ gain and 36.0% depth AbsRel reduction at $τ=0.5$ across COCO and Flickr30K. From random initialization, PixelDense also reaches the baseline's peak GenEval 1.23x faster. In SDEdit editing on PIE-Bench, PixelDense keeps more of the source background and layout at every edit strength, raising background PSNR by up to 2.2 dB.

AI.tldr: PixelDense提出一种新的表示对齐方法，通过分离语义与几何投影流，并引入权重空间正交性惩罚，有效融合多个基础模型（DINOv2、SAM2、Depth Anything v2、Metric3D v2）的优势，在扩散模型训练中显著提升性能。该方法在GenEval、DPG-Bench、HPS v2.1等任务上超越单教师和未分解的多教师方案，且在部分噪声重建和图像编辑任务中表现优异，同时加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有表示对齐方法主要依赖语义编码器（如DINOv2、CLIP），但研究表明空间结构才是对齐效果的关键载体。然而，针对空间结构的密集预测模型（如深度、分割、表面法向）仍被忽视。此外，多教师融合时语义与几何梯度相互竞争，导致性能下降。因此需要一种能有效解耦并协同利用不同模态信息的新方法。
AI.method: PixelDense将语义教师（DINOv2、SAM2）送入语义投影流，几何教师（Depth Anything v2、Metric3D v2）送入几何投影流，并引入权重空间正交性惩罚，确保两流在特征空间中不重叠。所有教师在训练中冻结，推理时移除。采用统一训练配方应用于PixelGen和DeCo。
AI.result: PixelDense在GenEval、DPG-Bench、HPS v2.1等基准上全面超越现有方法；在PixelGen-XXL上将GenEval Overall从0.7927提升至0.8093；在部分噪声重建中，实例分割（PQ）最高提升53.1%，深度估计（AbsRel）降低36.0%；在图像编辑任务中，背景保留能力更强，背景PSNR最高提升2.2 dB；从随机初始化开始，达到基线峰值速度提高1.23倍。
AI.conclusion: PixelDense通过结构化分离语义与几何表示路径，实现更高效、稳定的多教师对齐，显著提升扩散模型的生成质量与训练效率，为密集预测模型在扩散学习中的应用提供了新范式。

title: Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation
summary: Can a text-to-3D leaderboard change when every generated scene stays fixed? We audit this question for rendered-image evaluation, where camera settings and caption wording become part of the measurement protocol. Across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, we vary eight render and caption factors for 19 alignment evaluators plus one perceptual-quality control, then test four targeted scene degradations. Peak configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17/19 alignment evaluators, with prompt-bootstrap lower bounds above 1 for 11/19. Rankings are more stable than scores, yet 18/19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration. Pairwise protocol margin envelopes show which comparisons keep their direction across the tested settings. Selected pairs have opposite pointwise intervals, but no reversal survives simultaneous inference over the full search. Thus the observed winner changes are descriptive, not confirmed changes in generator superiority. Sensitivity remains separate: no evaluator, even the prompt-free control, exceeds 67% tie-adjusted directional discrimination on layout scrambling, which is diagnostic rather than human-validated ground truth. The audit separates score stability, decision uncertainty, and targeted sensitivity, and recommends reporting (generator, score, card ID) with protocol-dependent comparisons and selection-aware uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文通过固定生成场景，研究渲染和描述参数对文本到3D评估排行榜的影响。在300个固定场景上，测试8种渲染与提示变量，发现17/19个对齐评估器的配置方差超过生成器间的差异，且11/19评估器的提示引导下界高于1。尽管排名相对稳定，但18/19评估器在特定配置下改变了胜者。成对比较的区间显示部分对比方向相反，但无反转在全搜索中同时成立。因此，观察到的胜者变化是描述性的，非生成器优劣的真实改变。敏感性分析表明，即使无提示控制评估器，布局打乱的定向判别率也未超过67%，说明其为诊断性而非人类验证的真值。研究区分了得分稳定性、决策不确定性与目标敏感性，建议报告（生成器, 得分, 卡片ID）并附带协议依赖比较与选择感知不确定性。
AI.motivation: 评估文本到3D生成模型时，排行榜可能受渲染设置和提示词表述影响，而这些因素常被忽视。本文旨在检验当生成场景固定时，排行榜是否仍会因评估协议变化而改变，从而揭示评估系统的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 在6个生成器的300个固定场景上，系统性地改变8种渲染和提示因素，使用19个对齐评估器及1个感知质量控制，测试4种目标退化，并分析配置对评分和排名的影响。通过点估计、成对区间和敏感性分析，评估评估器的稳定性与判别能力。
AI.result: 17/19对齐评估器的配置方差大于生成器间方差；11/19评估器的提示引导下界高于1；18/19评估器在不同配置下更换胜者；成对比较存在方向冲突，但无全局反转；敏感性最高仅达67%定向判别力，不足以作为人类验证的真值。
AI.conclusion: 当前文本到3D评估排行榜受协议细节显著影响，胜者变化多为描述性而非真实性能提升。建议报告时明确标注生成器、得分、卡片ID，并提供协议依赖的比较与选择感知的不确定性度量。

title: PhysicsMate: A Curriculum-Grounded Bengali Benchmark for Secondary Physics QA with Small-Model Adaptation
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at 11th IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Computer Science and Data Engineering (IEEE CSDE 2026)
summary: Bengali secondary education lacks curriculum-grounded benchmarks for STEM question-solving, and general-purpose language models struggle with the precise terminology, unit conventions, and derivations that physics problems demand. We introduce PhysicsMate, a benchmark of 1834 question-answer pairs built from the National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB) Grade 9-10 physics syllabus and grounded in a multi-relational knowledge graph of 1760 nodes and 2600 edges across ten ontological types. We Low-Rank Adapt at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B parameters, with a unified recipe and demonstrate a significant increase in closed-book accuracy in all scales (+5.5, +15.0, and +23.3 percentage points). A node-type analysis shows that the most benefited by adaptation is the structured curricular knowledge, which consists of physical quantities and named laws, while the least benefited is the loosely specified entity-level knowledge. The 4B model has been adapted and quantized to a small offline binary that can be used for local inference in resource constrained environments and offers a viable path to curriculum aligned physics support in environments with limited connectivity and hardware.

AI.tldr: PhysicsMate 是一个基于孟加拉国9-10年级物理课程的1834个问答对基准，构建于包含1760个节点和2600条边的多关系知识图谱之上。通过在0.6B、1.7B和4B参数规模上进行低秩适配，所有规模均显著提升闭卷准确率（分别+5.5、+15.0、+23.3个百分点）。结构化课程知识（如物理量和定律）受益最大，而实体级知识受益最小。4B模型已适配并量化为小型离线二进制文件，适用于资源受限环境中的本地推理，为缺乏网络和硬件支持的场景提供可行的课程对齐物理学习支持。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国中学阶段的STEM问题解决缺乏与课程一致的评估基准，通用语言模型难以应对物理问题中精确的术语、单位规范和推导要求。
AI.method: 构建基于NCTB课程的PhysicsMate基准，使用多关系知识图谱整合课程知识；在不同规模的语言模型上采用统一的低秩适配策略，并进行量化以实现本地部署。
AI.result: 所有规模的模型在闭卷测试中准确率均有显著提升，其中4B模型适配后可量化为小体积离线二进制文件，适用于资源受限环境。
AI.conclusion: PhysicsMate为孟加拉国中学物理教育提供了可靠、可落地的课程对齐评估基准，低秩适配与量化使大模型在有限资源下实现高效本地推理，具备实际应用价值。

title: MOVE: Multimodal Open-world Verification and Expansion for Graph Learning
summary: Multimodal graph learning faces a fundamental challenge: new classes may emerge after deployment, while models are trained with a fixed label space. Existing approaches typically detect unknown nodes and use LLMs to generate candidate class descriptions, but they do not determine whether existing classes are insufficient to cover these nodes or whether a generated class is reliable enough to expand the class space. Our empirical study reveals three challenges: multimodal information beyond individual modalities is required for unknown-node identification, LLM-generated class descriptions may not fully capture multimodal class characteristics, and directly adding candidate classes can introduce redundant categories. Based on these observations, we propose MOVE, a multimodal open-world class verification and expansion framework. MOVE identifies nodes that cannot be assigned to existing classes by jointly considering visual tokens, textual attributes, and graph context, leverages a multimodal LLM to generate candidate classes, and selectively expands the class space only when candidates are consistently supported by multimodal evidence without introducing unnecessary categories. Experiments demonstrate that MOVE achieves an average improvement of 11.87\% across unknown recognition, open-domain annotation, and downstream graph learning tasks.

AI.tldr: MOVE提出了一种多模态开放世界类别验证与扩展框架，通过联合视觉、文本和图上下文识别未知节点，利用多模态大模型生成候选类别，并仅在多模态证据一致支持时才选择性扩展类别空间，有效避免冗余类别引入。实验表明，该方法在未知识别、开放域标注和下游图学习任务上平均提升11.87%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在新类别出现后无法有效判断现有类别是否不足或生成的类别是否可靠，且依赖单一模态信息进行未知节点检测，导致误判和冗余类别。
AI.method: MOVE联合使用视觉令牌、文本属性和图上下文识别无法归属现有类别的节点；利用多模态大模型生成候选类别描述；通过多模态一致性验证决定是否扩展类别空间。
AI.result: 在未知识别、开放域标注和下游图学习任务中，MOVE平均性能提升11.87%，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: MOVE能够有效应对多模态图学习中的开放世界挑战，通过多模态证据的一致性验证实现可靠类别扩展，减少冗余，提升模型泛化能力。

title: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

AI.tldr: Memorizon 提出一种高效训练流式世界模型的方法，通过共享的潜在向量银行实现跨多次访问的一致性渲染。该方法在长跨度监督中无需对所有中间帧进行密集注意力计算，而是仅关注最后 k 个片段，并通过相机共视性检索每个片段的 top-K 潜在表示，形成一个大小为 kK 的固定大小共享银行。此设计使长跨度训练成本几乎不变，仅增加少量计算开销（如从100到400秒仅增加12%步时间），同时显著提升重访一致性（相比滑动窗口基线提升24%-30%），且模型依赖于检索内容而非记忆。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在训练流式世界模型时需对长时间跨度的重复访问进行监督，但全序列密集注意力导致二次复杂度，计算成本高昂。如何在不增加注意力负担的前提下实现长跨度监督并保持渲染一致性，是核心挑战。
AI.method: Memorizon 使用一个可扩展的潜在向量银行机制：对于每个训练样本，只评估其最后 k 个片段；每个片段通过相机共视性独立检索 top-K 潜在表示，这些检索结果构成一个共享银行，其大小被限制为 kK。这样，无论输入跨度多长，注意力计算始终仅限于固定大小的银行，从而避免了长序列带来的计算膨胀。
AI.result: 实验表明，与滑动窗口基线相比，使用检索机制可显著提升重访一致性（+24%~30%）；当跨度足够覆盖首次返回的访问时，性能提升最大；进一步延长跨度无额外收益。若用其他场景的潜在表示填充银行，则重访相关性下降83%，说明模型确实依赖于检索到的内容。
AI.conclusion: Memorizon 成功解耦了长跨度监督与高成本注意力之间的关系，通过共享的、有限大小的潜在向量银行实现了高效且一致的流式世界模型训练，为大规模连续场景建模提供了可行路径。

title: Before Agents Decide: Epistemic Action in LLM-Based Systems
comment: Accepted at the Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Before a difficult decision, people often act simply to understand the situation better. We turn an object to see another side, place alternatives next to each other, or change one condition and observe what happens. These actions may not complete the task, but they improve the evidence needed for the next choice. LLM-based agents can search and explore, yet agent design gives less attention to an earlier question: is the available evidence ready for the decision? Sometimes necessary evidence is missing. In other cases, the evidence is present but its form hides what matters, or the comparison needed to judge it does not yet exist. Cognitive science calls actions that improve the basis for a later choice epistemic actions. We bring this idea to LLM-based agents and distinguish three modes: acquiring missing evidence, transforming available evidence, and probing a system to create a revealing response. We use the term epistemic scaffolding for the interfaces, tools, and environments that make these actions possible and auditable. This paper argues that agent design must address how decision-ready evidence is produced.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在复杂决策前，智能体通过认知性行动（epistemic actions）来改善决策依据的重要性。这些行动包括获取缺失证据、转换现有证据以及探查系统以生成有揭示性的响应。作者提出‘认知支架’（epistemic scaffolding）的概念，强调设计应关注如何生成可供决策的证据，并将这一思想引入基于大语言模型的智能体中。
AI.motivation: 在复杂决策前，人们常通过探索行为来理解情境，但当前基于大语言模型的智能体设计较少关注决策所需证据是否已准备就绪。有时证据缺失，有时证据形式不清晰或缺乏可比性，因此需要一种机制来主动提升证据的质量和可用性。
AI.method: 提出并定义三种认知性行动模式：获取缺失证据、转换已有证据、探查系统以生成关键响应；引入‘认知支架’概念，用于支持和记录这些行动，使它们在智能体系统中可实现且可审计。
AI.result: 研究表明，将认知性行动纳入智能体设计有助于提高决策质量，确保证据在关键时刻是充分且可用的；同时，认知支架为智能体的行为提供了结构化支持与透明度。
AI.conclusion: 未来智能体的设计必须超越单纯执行任务的思维，转向如何主动构建和优化决策所需的证据基础，而认知支架为此提供了理论框架和技术路径。

title: Closing the Loop: Practical Training Recipes for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block of layers, but existing large-scale recipes require multi-stage training over trillions of tokens, while the benefits of recurrence remain difficult to separate from differences in data and training. In this work, we establish practical training recipes for looped language models, with three main results. (1) We develop a compute-efficient from-scratch pipeline that reduces the training budget from 7.7T tokens in Ouro to 310B tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Pretraining followed by high-quality mid-training, together with learning-rate warmup and stronger exit-gate regularization, enables stable recurrent training without prior multi-stage schedules. (2) Under controlled comparisons, our 1.4B LoopLM outperforms a parameter-matched dense model trained on the same data and token budget on all 12 evaluated benchmarks, including +14 points on GSM8K, +10 on MATH, and +22 on DROP. At matched inference compute, it approaches a 3.9B dense model on mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension while using only 36\% as many parameters. (3) We introduce a minimal recipe for converting pretrained dense models into looped ones: a single learned input-mixing scalar and a smoothed exit loss, with no step-specific parameters. Applied to Qwen3-1.7B-Base, Looped Qwen improves over an identically continued dense baseline on every evaluated benchmark across two data regimes, with statistically clear gains on GSM8K, MATH, and MMLU-Pro on the curated mixture. Together, these results make looped language models substantially cheaper to train from scratch and practical to introduce into existing pretrained checkpoints, while isolating the gains due to recurrence itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套实用的循环语言模型训练方案，显著降低训练成本并验证了循环结构本身的收益。通过高效从零训练流程，将训练量从7.7万亿标记降至3100亿标记，同时保持强推理性能；在控制条件下，1.4B参数的循环模型优于同等规模的密集模型，在多个基准上表现更优，且在相同推理计算量下接近3.9B密集模型的表现；此外，提出仅需一个可学习输入混合标量和光滑退出损失的极简转换方法，即可将预训练密集模型转为循环模型，并在多个任务上实现统计显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有循环语言模型训练依赖多阶段、超大规模数据（如数万亿标记），难以区分循环结构带来的收益与数据或训练方式差异的影响。本文旨在建立高效的训练方案，使循环模型更易训练和应用，同时准确评估循环机制本身的价值。
AI.method: 提出一种计算高效的从零训练管道，包含预训练后高质量中段训练、学习率预热和更强的退出门控正则化；设计极简转换方法，仅用一个可学习输入混合标量和光滑退出损失，将预训练密集模型转化为循环模型。
AI.result: 1.4B LoopLM在12个基准测试中全面超越参数匹配的密集模型，尤其在GSM8K（+14）、MATH（+10）、DROP（+22）上表现突出；在相同推理计算量下，其性能接近3.9B密集模型，但仅使用36%参数；基于Qwen3-1.7B-Base的循环版本在两种数据设置下均优于基准，且在多个任务上取得统计显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 本研究使循环语言模型的训练成本大幅下降，具备从零训练和向现有模型迁移的可行性，且能有效分离出循环结构带来的真实性能增益，推动其在实际场景中的应用。

title: Coupling Perception and Reasoning in Federated Multimodal Graph Foundation Models
summary: Federated multimodal graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to adapt pretrained multimodal models to decentralized graph data, where each client owns a private multimodal graph and cannot share raw information. These models typically combine a multimodal Encoder that extracts semantic evidence from heterogeneous modalities and a graph neural network (GNN) that performs relational reasoning over graph structures. However, existing federated GFM adaptation methods mainly update graph-side modules while keeping the multimodal Encoder frozen, limiting adaptation to \emph{how information is propagated} while fixing \emph{what information is extracted}. Through empirical studies, we reveal that Encoder and GNN adaptations are not independent: Encoder adaptation is affected by graph relations, while cross-client module swapping reveals substantial pairing sensitivity between separately parameterized Encoder and GNN updates. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{FedCORE}, a federated adaptation framework that represents Encoder and GNN updates through a shared low-dimensional latent state. FedCORE jointly optimizes this core from multimodal and structural signals and performs federated evolution directly in the shared state space, preserving compatibility between perception and reasoning adaptations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedCORE reduces the Encoder--GNN pairing gap from $30.6$ to $5.9$, corresponding to an $80.7\%$ reduction over independent joint adaptation.

AI.tldr: FedCORE是一种联邦适应框架，通过共享低维潜在状态联合优化多模态编码器和图神经网络的更新，解决了现有方法中编码器与图神经网络适配不兼容的问题，显著降低了编码器-图神经网络配对差距。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦多模态图基础模型方法主要只更新图侧模块而冻结多模态编码器，导致只能调整信息传播方式而无法灵活提取信息；实证研究发现编码器与图神经网络的适配存在相互影响和配对敏感性，因此需要一种能协同优化两者的机制。
AI.method: 提出FedCORE框架，将编码器和图神经网络的更新表示为共享的低维潜在状态，在该共享状态空间中进行联邦演化，从而联合优化多模态与结构信号，保持感知与推理适配的一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，FedCORE将编码器-图神经网络配对差距从30.6降至5.9，相比独立联合适配降低了80.7%。
AI.conclusion: FedCORE通过在共享潜在空间中联合优化多模态编码器与图神经网络，有效缓解了两者之间的适配不匹配问题，提升了联邦多模态图模型的整体性能与兼容性。

title: PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably evaluate the physical authenticity of emerging generative models. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: PhysVista是一个旨在评估视觉-语言模型（VLMs）物理智能的基准，通过模拟人类‘感知-推理-评估’的闭环认知过程，全面考察模型在物理状态感知、动态推理和真实性判断方面的能力。该基准区分事件级与尺度级推理，涵盖真实与AI生成视频，揭示了当前VLMs在物理理解上的显著不足，凸显视觉识别与真实物理认知之间的差距，呼吁更扎实的多模态物理智能设计。
AI.motivation: 现有基准在评估视觉-语言模型时存在碎片化问题，未能系统考察感知、推理与物理判断之间的协同关系，难以准确诊断模型对生成内容物理真实性的评估能力。
AI.method: 提出PhysVista基准，采用闭合认知回路框架，整合物理状态感知、物理动态推理与物理合理性评估，并引入事件级与尺度级推理的细粒度分析，覆盖真实与AI生成视频数据。
AI.result: 实验表明，各类VLMs在物理推理与可解释性评估方面存在明显缺陷，反映出视觉识别能力与真正物理理解之间存在显著鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLMs虽具备强大多模态推理能力，但在物理一致性理解上仍严重不足，亟需更注重物理基础的模型设计以实现真正的多模态智能。

title: Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluations (OB-CAIE) Methodology
summary: The ontology-based contextual AI evaluation (OB-CAIE) methodology was developed to address a lack of scientific rigor that arises from unclear testing coverage, to balance human expertise and automations, and to address a lack of reproducibility of AI evaluation testing environments. OB-CAIE strengthens the current state of AI evaluations by addressing the first step in the scientific method by clearly defining what will be tested. Two ontologies represent the tractable problem space in the OB-CAIE methodology: the Domain-Specific Ontology (DSO) and the Evaluation Process Ontology (EPO). The DSO is the what; the EPO is the how. An OB-CAIE problem space can be used for one or multiple AI evaluations. The OB-CAIE methodology allows for human judgment at specific points, in scientifically grounded ways, and in complex subject areas where human feedback is genuinely irreducible or machine irreplaceable. A key advantage of the OB-CAIE methodology is that failure points can be traced, visualized and analyzed within the canonical OB-CAIE methodology problem space.

AI.tldr: OB-CAIE是一种基于本体的上下文人工智能评估方法，旨在解决AI评估中测试覆盖不清晰、人类专家与自动化平衡不足以及评估环境不可复现等问题。该方法通过领域特定本体（DSO）和评估过程本体（EPO）明确界定评估范围，分别表示‘什么’和‘如何’，支持多轮评估并保留人类判断在关键环节的作用，同时可追踪、可视化和分析失败点。
AI.motivation: 当前AI评估存在测试覆盖不清晰、人类与自动化难以平衡、评估环境缺乏可复现性等问题，导致科学严谨性不足。
AI.method: 引入领域特定本体（DSO）和评估过程本体（EPO），构建结构化问题空间，明确评估内容与流程，并在关键节点融入科学化的人类判断机制。
AI.result: OB-CAIE方法能够提升评估的透明度与可追溯性，实现失败点的定位与分析，增强评估的科学性与可复现性。
AI.conclusion: OB-CAIE通过本体建模为AI评估提供了系统化、可扩展且可追溯的框架，显著提升了评估的科学性和实践价值。

title: Bayesian Fine-tuning Yields Language Models that are as Bayesian as their Beliefs Allow
summary: Language models (LMs) are increasingly used for tasks that require reasoning about hidden variables from a few observations, for which Bayesian inference is the normatively correct solution. While supervised fine-tuning of an LM on the outputs of an optimal $\textit{Bayesian}$ model leads to near-Bayesian behavior, standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the true answers for the task falls short of it. But behavior alone does not tell us $\textit{why}$ tuning on a $\textit{Bayesian}$ or an $\textit{oracle}$ (true answers) signal differs: whether the resulting LM represents Bayesian beliefs, acts on them, or turns them into a choice the way Bayes' rule does. To compare them, we formulate increasingly demanding requirements for an LM to count as a Bayesian decision maker, spanning its behavior, representations, and computations, and test them on a flight recommendation task. The Bayes-trained LM acts Bayesian, encodes quantities of Bayes' rule in its middle layers, and uses the encoded belief for the recommendation to a certain extent. The oracle-trained LM differs from it both in the beliefs it holds and whether it reads beliefs out into recommendations. Exchanging beliefs between the LMs transfers a part of the Bayesian advantage. Bayes fine-tuning thus installs usable Bayesian beliefs in an LM for reasoning under uncertainty in a way standard SFT on oracle answers cannot, highlighting the advantage of nuanced supervision.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了语言模型在推理隐藏变量时，通过贝叶斯微调与标准监督微调的差异。结果表明，基于贝叶斯信号的微调能使语言模型表现出接近贝叶斯的行为，编码贝叶斯规则中的关键量，并将其用于决策；而基于真实答案的微调则无法实现类似效果。交换信念可部分转移贝叶斯优势，说明精细监督对提升模型不确定性推理能力具有重要价值。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型在面对需要从少量观测中推断隐藏变量的任务时，为何基于贝叶斯信号的微调比标准监督微调更有效，以及其背后机制是否涉及真正的贝叶斯信念表示与计算。
AI.method: 提出一系列递进式要求来评估语言模型是否为贝叶斯决策者，涵盖行为、表征和计算三个层面；在航班推荐任务中对比贝叶斯微调与真实答案微调的语言模型表现，并进行信念交换实验以验证因果关系。
AI.result: 贝叶斯微调的语言模型在中间层编码了贝叶斯规则相关量，能将信念用于推荐，表现出贝叶斯行为；而真实答案微调的语言模型不仅持有的信念不同，且不会将信念读出用于决策。信念交换实验显示部分贝叶斯优势可转移。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯微调能够有效在语言模型中植入可使用的贝叶斯信念，从而提升其在不确定性下的推理能力，而标准监督微调无法做到这一点，凸显了精细化监督的重要性。

title: Stable and Counterfactually Robust Physical World Models from Imposed Structure and Learned Physics
summary: A world model learns to forecast how a physical system evolves from recorded trajectories, yet the systems it imitates obey physical laws that are neither fully supplied nor reliably respected. The model may create energy, drift or diverge over long rollouts, and answer a changed law query using the law observed during training. We ask how much general physical structure must be hard coded into a world model, and how much system-specific physics can then be learned from data, for four properties to hold simultaneously: second law compatible dissipation, correct responses to interventions on physical parameters, stability out to one hundred times the training horizon, and robustness to disturbances. The imposed structure is general: dynamics are generated from the gradient of a learned energy through a fixed reversible operator, the energy is restricted to a confining class, a one way port can remove energy but never inject it, the drive channel is known, and the intervened parameter enters through a separable map. The model learns the energy functional, constitutive relations, dissipation rate, and couplings. Across an electromagnetic cavity, a particle in cell grid, and a shallow-water fluid, models with roughly nine thousand parameters recover constitutive functions with unit slope, separate conserving from dissipating worlds by four orders of magnitude using a single set of weights, and transfer changes in sign, magnitude, rate, and gravity to unseen values, where equal-capacity models without the same structure perform at chance or worse. A nonlinear constitutive law is recovered with its curvature preserved and predicts a held-out intervention $2$-$17\times$ better than a converged linear model.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在世界模型中需要硬编码多少通用物理结构，以实现四个关键性质：符合热力学第二定律的耗散、对物理参数干预的正确响应、长达训练时间100倍的稳定性以及对扰动的鲁棒性。通过采用固定可逆算子生成动力学、学习能量函数并限制其为约束类、单向能量出口、已知驱动通道及可分离的参数映射等结构，模型仅用约9000个参数即可在电磁腔、粒子网格和浅水流体系统中成功学习能量泛函、本构关系、耗散率和耦合关系。与无结构的同等容量模型相比，该方法在未见参数变化下表现显著更优，且非线性本构关系的曲率得以保留，预测性能优于线性模型2-17倍。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型虽能从轨迹中学习系统演化，但常违背物理规律（如能量不守恒、长期漂移），无法正确响应参数干预或处理外部扰动。因此需明确哪些物理结构必须显式编码，以确保模型兼具物理合理性与泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建基于能量梯度的动力学框架，使用固定可逆算子生成演化；能量函数受约束类限制，引入单向能量端口实现不可逆耗散；驱动通道已知，干预参数通过可分离映射进入；模型联合学习能量泛函、本构关系、耗散率与耦合系数。
AI.result: 在多个复杂系统中，该结构化模型仅用约9000参数即实现了高精度建模，准确区分保守与耗散系统（相差4个数量级），对未见参数变化具备强泛化能力，非线性关系曲率保持良好，预测性能较线性模型提升2-17倍。
AI.conclusion: 将关键物理结构（如能量框架、可逆/不可逆分解、参数可分离性）硬编码至世界模型中，可在极低参数量下实现高稳定性、强泛化与物理一致性，表明部分核心物理规律应作为先验结构嵌入模型，而非完全依赖数据学习。

title: FORTE: Adaptive Scoring and Exact Keyframe Selection for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Query-aware keyframe selection enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process long videos using only a small set of question-relevant frames. Existing score-based methods, however, typically search within a fixed, uniformly sampled candidate pool, preventing evidence outside this pool from ever being selected. Given a limited relevance-scoring budget, the key challenge is to allocate evaluations adaptively to promising frames while continuing to explore underrepresented temporal regions. We introduce FORTE, a training-free framework that addresses this challenge through two stages: adaptive relevance scoring and global keyframe optimization. Starting from sparse, uniformly distributed observations, our efficient Gaussian-process relevance predictor estimates relevance for unscored frames, exploiting temporal locality and the approximately banded kernel structure to reduce the core computation from cubic to linear time in the number of frames for fixed bandwidth. The scoring stage then selects which frames to score next by balancing predicted relevance with temporal coverage, prioritizing promising regions while also exploring less-represented parts of the video. The optimization stage selects the final keyframes by maximizing an objective that jointly captures measured relevance and temporal coverage. We derive an exact algorithm that leverages the logarithmic coverage structure to identify the optimal subset of the scored candidate pool in time linear in the pool size, for a fixed final-frame budget. Experiments on four long-video question-answering benchmarks show that FORTE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the compared selectors under every tested scoring budget. Further evaluations demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across different relevance scorers and downstream MLLMs.

AI.tldr: FORTE 是一种无需训练的框架，通过自适应相关性评分和全局关键帧优化两阶段方法，解决长视频中关键帧选择的挑战。它利用高斯过程预测未评分帧的相关性，结合时间局部性和带宽固定的核结构，将核心计算从立方级降低到线性时间；在评分阶段平衡预测相关性与时间覆盖度，优先探索高潜力区域并兼顾低覆盖区域；在优化阶段则基于测量的相关性和时间覆盖度联合目标，精确求解最优关键帧子集，计算复杂度为线性。实验表明，在多个长视频问答基准上，FORTE 在所有测试评分预算下均达到最高平均准确率，并对不同相关性评分器和下游 MLLM 具有强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于评分的方法通常在固定、均匀采样的候选帧池中搜索，无法捕捉该池外的证据，导致信息遗漏。在有限的评分预算下，如何自适应分配评估资源以兼顾高相关性区域和未充分覆盖的时间段，是核心挑战。
AI.method: FORTE 采用两阶段设计：1）自适应相关性评分：基于稀疏均匀观测，使用高效的高斯过程相关性预测器估计未评分帧的相关性，利用时间局部性和近似带状核结构，将计算复杂度从 O(n^3) 降至 O(n)；2）全局关键帧优化：构建联合考虑测量相关性和时间覆盖度的目标函数，提出精确算法利用对数覆盖结构，在线性时间内确定最优关键帧子集（固定最终帧数预算）。
AI.result: 在四个长视频问答基准上，FORTE 在所有测试评分预算下均实现最高的平均准确率。其性能优于对比方法，且在不同相关性评分器和下游 MLLM 上表现稳定，验证了其有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FORTE 提供了一种高效、可扩展且无需训练的关键帧选择框架，能够有效应对长视频中相关性评估与时间覆盖之间的权衡，显著提升 MLLMs 处理长视频的能力。

title: Science or Slop?: Benchmarking and Mitigating Scientific Slop in AI-Generated Papers
summary: AI-generated content, often called AI slop, is increasingly common everywhere, particularly in academia. Slop in AI-generated scientific papers, however, has more complex patterns that cannot be easily detected by existing token-based AI detectors. Each part of such a paper looks plausible while the scientific reasoning that connects the parts breaks down, which can mislead how readers assess the work. We benchmark these failures as scientific slop through six measures across Structure, Argument, and Artifacts. We construct SciSlopBench with 390 AI-generated papers, mostly in computer science but spanning the life, social, and natural sciences, each paired with a human-written paper matched by research problem and contribution type. Our measures identify the AI paper in each pair with 85.9% accuracy, compared with 68.7% for Binoculars. Higher scientific slop accompanies lower ICLR ratings and distinguishes rejected from accepted papers above chance in every year from 2017 to 2025. Reducing these patterns, however, is not as simple as directly optimizing the measures. We therefore propose SciSlopHarness, a harness-level framework that guides a fixed LLM to revise slop only where the experiment records support the change. While standard revisions leave residual slop and direct slop-aware prompting triggers reward hacking, SciSlopHarness reduces the remaining AI-human gap by 63% over the strongest revision baseline without requiring human reference targets. Overall, we demonstrate that AI-generated scientific papers leave fundamental traces in their global reasoning, and that responsible mitigation demands strict evidentiary grounding rather than mere prose refinement.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出SciSlopBench和SciSlopHarness，用于检测和减轻AI生成科学论文中的复杂“科学垃圾”（scientific slop）问题。通过六项跨结构、论证与成果的指标，实现85.9%的识别准确率，显著优于现有方法。研究发现，高科学垃圾水平与低ICLR评分及拒稿率相关，并揭示直接优化难以消除残余问题。SciSlopHarness通过基于实验记录的证据驱动修订，将AI与人类论文差距减少63%，强调需以实证为基础而非仅修辞优化。
AI.motivation: AI生成内容在学术领域泛滥，其产生的‘科学垃圾’虽各部分看似合理，但整体推理断裂，难以被传统基于标记的检测工具识别，威胁学术可信度。亟需系统化评估与缓解机制。
AI.method: 构建包含390篇AI生成论文的SciSlopBench数据集，每篇匹配人类撰写论文；设计六项衡量标准（结构、论证、成果等维度）评估科学垃圾；提出SciSlopHarness框架，基于实验证据指导固定大模型进行针对性修正。
AI.result: 所提方法在识别AI生成论文上达到85.9%准确率，优于Binoculars（68.7%）；科学垃圾水平与论文接受度显著相关（2017–2025年均有效）；SciSlopHarness相比最强基线减少63%的AI-人类差距，且避免奖励劫持。
AI.conclusion: AI生成科学论文存在深层推理缺陷，其痕迹可被系统检测。负责任的缓解必须依赖严格证据支持，而非仅表面语言润色。

title: Towards Robust Numerical Claim Verification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for claim verification, yet remain brittle for numerical reasoning: even small changes in value can sharply degrade accuracy. We show that this brittleness persists in frontier LLMs, but can be mitigated through adversarial fine-tuning on numerically perturbed examples. Using parameter-efficient fine-tuning, small Qwen3 models (0.6B$\unicode{x2013}$8B) reach 98.7% accuracy on label-flipping perturbations, outperforming larger zero-shot models and frontier systems (GPT-5.4 Pro (74.0%) and Gemini 2.5 Flash (73.9%)). The gains generalise to unseen perturbation types, indicating robust numerical decision boundaries rather than memorised edits. Robustness also transfers without target-domain data, significantly improving cross-lingual performance in Spanish. We further show that the same fine-tuning recipe confers robustness to evidence-side perturbations, using the VitaminC dataset.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现大语言模型在数值推理上存在脆弱性，即使微小的数值变化也会显著降低准确率。通过在数值扰动样本上进行对抗性微调，可有效缓解这一问题。使用参数高效微调，小型Qwen3模型（0.6B–8B）在标签翻转扰动下达到98.7%的准确率，优于更大的零样本模型及前沿系统（如GPT-5.4 Pro和Gemini 2.5 Flash）。性能提升具有泛化能力，适用于未见扰动类型，并能迁移至跨语言场景（如西班牙语），同时对证据侧扰动也有效，验证了方法的广泛适用性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在数值推理任务中表现脆弱，微小的数值变化会导致性能急剧下降，亟需提升其对数值扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 采用对抗性微调策略，在数值扰动数据上对小型Qwen3模型进行参数高效微调，并评估其在多种扰动类型和跨语言场景下的泛化能力。
AI.result: 小型模型在标签翻转扰动下达到98.7%准确率，显著优于大型零样本模型和前沿系统；鲁棒性可泛化至未见扰动类型和跨语言任务，且对证据侧扰动同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过对抗性微调，可显著提升大语言模型在数值推理中的鲁棒性，且该方法具有良好的泛化性和迁移能力，为构建更可靠的自动验证系统提供了有效路径。

title: Partial AUC Maximization from Positive-unlabeled Data
summary: The partial area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (pAUC) is an important performance metric for binary classification that summarizes true positive rates within a specific range of false positive rates (FPRs). Classifiers that achieve high pAUC need to be obtained in many real-world applications such as cybersecurity, medical care, and advertising. Although many methods for maximizing the pAUC have been proposed, they typically require both labeled positive and negative data for training. However, in practice, labeled negative data are often difficult to collect due to privacy concerns or the need for high expertise to annotate them. In this paper, we propose a method for maximizing the pAUC from positive and unlabeled (PU) data without negative data. Within an empirical risk minimization framework, we show that the pAUC, including its FPR-dependent thresholds, can be represented using only the positive and marginal densities, and derive an empirical estimator from PU data. A classifier is then trained by maximizing the derived smoothed empirical pAUC estimator. We experimentally demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method with ten real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从正样本和未标记样本（PU）数据中最大化部分AUC（pAUC）的方法，无需负样本。通过经验风险最小化框架，推导出仅依赖正样本和边际密度的pAUC估计器，并基于该估计器训练分类器。实验在十个真实数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在实际应用中，如网络安全、医疗和广告领域，高pAUC分类器至关重要，但获取标注的负样本往往困难，因隐私或标注成本高。因此，亟需一种仅使用正样本和未标记样本即可优化pAUC的方法。
AI.method: 在经验风险最小化框架下，将pAUC表示为仅依赖正样本和边际密度的形式，并基于PU数据构建其经验估计器；随后通过最大化平滑后的经验pAUC估计器来训练分类器。
AI.result: 在十个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，所提方法能够有效提升pAUC性能，且在缺乏负样本的情况下仍具备良好的分类表现。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功提出了一个无需负样本即可最大化pAUC的PU学习方法，为实际中难以获取负样本的场景提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Gestalt: Large Multimodal Interplay Model
summary: In this paper, we propose Gestalt, a new paradigm of large multimodal model built around multimodal interplay. Despite rapid advances, large multimodal models are reaching a bottleneck: existing approaches focus primarily on accommodating additional modalities while overlooking the distinct characteristics of each modality and the relations among them. Motivated by the multistage property of human multisensory perception, we propose a multimodal interplay pyramid that organizes multimodal modeling as a progression from modality-specific processing, through cross-modal alignment, to deeper multimodal integration. Guided by this pyramid, Gestalt adopts a unified discrete diffusion framework and an interplay-partitioned architecture, with learnable interplay tokens mediating cross-modal exchange and integration. The pyramid also structures its data organization and training strategy. Strong performance across image generation, multimodal understanding, and text-only evaluation shows that Gestalt significantly improves cross-modal integration while preserving modality-specific information, effectively harnessing the strengths of diffusion-based multimodal models and offering a promising path toward unified multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: Gestalt提出了一种基于多模态交互的新范式，通过多阶段感知的类比构建了多模态交互金字塔，实现了从模态特异性处理到跨模态对齐再到深层融合的渐进式建模。采用统一的离散扩散框架与分层交互架构，利用可学习的交互令牌促进跨模态信息交换，并优化数据组织与训练策略。在图像生成、多模态理解及纯文本评估中均表现优异，显著提升了跨模态整合能力，同时保留了各模态的特性，为统一多模态智能提供了新路径。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模多模态模型面临瓶颈，主要聚焦于增加模态数量，而忽视了各模态的独特性及其相互关系。人类多感官感知具有多阶段特性，启发了更系统化的多模态建模思路。
AI.method: 提出多模态交互金字塔，采用统一离散扩散框架与交互分块架构，引入可学习的交互令牌实现跨模态信息交换与整合，并据此设计数据组织与训练策略。
AI.result: 在图像生成、多模态理解及文本评估任务中均取得优异表现，显著增强跨模态整合能力，同时保持模态特异性信息，展现出强大的多模态建模潜力。
AI.conclusion: Gestalt通过结构化多模态交互，有效克服了传统方法的局限，为实现统一的多模态智能提供了一个高效且可扩展的新范式。

title: Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams
comment: 63 pages, 22 Figures, 10 Tables, Code: https://github.com/safety-research/MAMUBench (will be released after review)
summary: People are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, and those agents are increasingly encountering other people's agents over shared resources such as a codebase, a calendar, or a budget. When each agent acts for a different user with different goals, coordination often fails, and the group ends up worse off than if a single agent had acted for everyone. We study this multi-user, multi-agent setting across five frontier models and 77 scenarios in four environments: an API key environment in which agents share a compute budget, a clinic in which they share a calendar, a personal assistant environment in which they share a group order or booking, and a merge queue in which they share a release cutoff. In each scenario, we compare a single agent that serves every user (a coordinator) to a team in which each agent serves one user, with and without a communication channel between the agents. Teams deliver worse group outcomes than the coordinator in every environment: without a channel, they completely collapse in two environments, and even with one, coordination overhead creates substantial gaps. For example, in the personal assistant environment, the coordinator fulfills a targeted user request about twice as often as teams. We identify distinct behaviors associated with this poor group-level performance, including stalling as teams grow, overriding each other's actions, and fabricating claims. We find effective but environment-specific mitigations, such as a team lead, explicit procedural instructions, and a platform check that makes an agent read its peers' messages before committing. We will release the API key, clinic, and personal assistant environments as MAMUBench, comprising 74 scenarios for evaluating multi-user, multi-agent coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多用户、多智能体在共享资源（如计算预算、日程表、预订、发布截止）环境下的协作问题。通过对比单一协调者代理与多个独立代理团队的表现，发现团队在所有环境中均表现更差，尤其在缺乏通信时几乎完全失效。即使有通信，协调开销仍导致显著性能下降。例如，在个人助理场景中，协调者达成目标的次数是团队的两倍。文中识别出拖延、互相覆盖操作、虚构声明等负面行为，并提出针对不同环境的有效缓解策略，如指定团队负责人、明确流程指令和平台检查机制。研究将发布包含74个场景的MAMUBench基准测试集。
AI.motivation: 随着人们越来越多地将任务委托给AI代理，这些代理在共享资源（如代码库、日历、预算）上频繁与其他用户的代理发生交互。当各代理代表不同用户、目标不一致时，协调困难导致整体表现低于由单一代理统一管理的情况。因此，亟需理解并改善多用户多代理环境中的协作效率。
AI.method: 在五个前沿模型上，评估了四种环境中的77个场景：API密钥环境（共享计算预算）、诊所环境（共享日程）、个人助理环境（共享订单/预订）、合并队列环境（共享发布截止）。比较单一协调者代理与多代理团队的表现，团队分为有无通信通道两种情况。通过定量分析任务完成率、冲突频率、响应延迟等指标，识别协作失败模式。
AI.result: 在所有环境中，团队的表现均劣于协调者；无通信时，两个环境中系统完全崩溃；有通信时，仍存在显著性能差距。例如，在个人助理场景中，协调者完成目标的频率约为团队的两倍。观察到的行为包括：随团队规模增长而出现的拖延、互相覆盖操作、伪造信息等。提出多种环境特定的缓解措施，如设置团队领导、提供明确规程、引入消息读取检查机制，可有效提升协作效果。
AI.conclusion: 多用户多代理协作在缺乏统一协调的情况下普遍存在严重问题，导致群体绩效下降。有效的解决方案需结合具体环境设计，如角色分工、流程规范和强制信息同步机制。研究构建并公开了MAMUBench基准测试集，为未来多代理协作研究提供标准化评估平台。

title: How Divergence Becomes Decision Flips in Compressed Language Models
summary: Compression reports summarize how far a compressed language model moved from the dense one, usually by a KL divergence; a deployment that relies on the dense model's outputs needs to know how many of its decisions changed. We show that total variation, not KL, answers this directly. Across 802 compressed and perturbed copies of 19 open models on five corpora and nine mechanically unrelated perturbation families, the rate at which the arg-max token changes (the \emph{flip rate}) tracks total variation at a ratio with median $1.05$, with no fitted constant. KL converts into flips only through its square root and a factor that varies fourfold across models and corpora, because KL averages over tokens before the root is taken; first-order statistics averaged per token, such as Hellinger distance, avoid this, but reports rarely give them. As a result, of two compressors reported on different models and corpora whose flip rates differ by at least $10%$, KL assigns the smaller divergence to the one that changes more decisions in $11%$ of cases, total variation in $1%$. Two pre-registered tests mark the limits: on a held-out code corpus the ratio held for all eight models while three predictions about KL each failed for half of them or more, and on three new models with real kernels it stayed in its band for 37 of 38 checkpoints but fell below one on code for two models. In vLLM speculative decoding, total variation measured under teacher forcing predicts greedy draft acceptance with a mean relative error of $1.1$--$2.4%$, without the task-specific calibration that KL needs.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出，在评估压缩语言模型与原始密集模型之间的差异时，总变差（Total Variation）比KL散度更直接准确地反映决策变化情况。通过跨19个开源模型、5个语料库和802个压缩/扰动版本的实验发现，总变差与最大概率词元变化率（翻转率）的比率中位数为1.05，无需拟合常数；而KL散度需经过平方根处理且受模型和语料影响大，导致其在比较不同场景下的模型变动时出现错误判断。在预注册测试中，总变差表现稳定，而KL散度有超过一半预测失败。此外，在vLLM推测解码中，总变差在教师强制条件下可精准预测贪婪草稿接受率，误差仅1.1%–2.4%，无需任务特定校准。
AI.motivation: 现有压缩报告多依赖KL散度衡量模型差异，但其无法直接反映模型输出决策的变化程度，尤其在部署依赖原始模型输出的场景下存在偏差。需要一种能直接量化决策改变的指标，以提高压缩模型评估的准确性与可靠性。
AI.method: 通过分析802个压缩和扰动版本的语言模型在五种语料库上的表现，计算总变差与KL散度，并对比其与最大概率词元翻转率的相关性；进行两轮预注册实验验证结果的稳健性；在vLLM推测解码中测试总变差对贪婪草稿接受率的预测能力。
AI.result: 总变差与翻转率的比率中位数为1.05，无须调整；而KL散度因平均方式问题，常导致误判——在11%的情况下将实际变化更大的模型误判为差异更小；预注册测试显示总变差一致性高，而KL散度预测失败率超50%；在推测解码中，总变差预测误差仅为1.1%–2.4%，无需额外校准。
AI.conclusion: 总变差是衡量压缩模型与原始模型之间决策变化的更优指标，相比KL散度更具直接性、一致性和泛化能力，建议在模型压缩评估和部署中优先采用。

title: Bellman-Certified Rounding for Sparse Policy Deployment in MDPs
summary: Continuous policy optimization may spread an update across many states, even when deployment permits only a few complete state-level changes. We study how much discounted return can be retained when continuous row mixtures are rounded to sparse binary policies in finite MDPs. Policy-dependent visitation couples the row edits, while long horizons make global curvature bounds conservative. From $2d+2$ Bellman solves, we derive reusable envelopes that support uniform and candidate-specific guarantees before rounding. A rank-two rational representation of each exchange further permits weighted curvature integration along the realized trajectory. We prove that linear dimension dependence is unavoidable when the budget scales, and that exact global curvature thresholding is hard. Candidate-specific bounds raise pre-rounding certification coverage from $48.2\%$ to $74.1\%$ on the structured suite. At $γ=0.95$, local integration lowers the median bound-to-loss ratio from $402.3$ to $2.08$ on coupled instances.

AI.tldr: 研究在有限马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中，将连续策略更新舍入为稀疏二值策略时，能保留多少折扣回报。通过2d+2次贝尔曼求解，构建可复用的包络以支持统一和候选特定的保证；利用秩二有理表示实现轨迹上的加权曲率积分。证明了当预算增加时，线性维度依赖不可避免，且精确全局曲率阈值化是困难的。候选特定边界将预舍入认证覆盖率从48.2%提升至74.1%，在γ=0.95时，局部积分将中位数界限-损失比从402.3降至2.08。
AI.motivation: 连续策略优化可能影响大量状态，但部署仅允许少量完全的状态变更。如何在舍入为稀疏二值策略时保持尽可能多的折扣回报，是核心问题。
AI.method: 通过2d+2次贝尔曼求解生成可复用的包络，结合秩二有理表示进行加权曲率积分，实现候选特定与统一的性能保证。
AI.result: 证明了线性维度依赖不可避免，精确全局曲率阈值化困难；候选特定边界显著提升认证覆盖率（48.2% → 74.1%），局部积分大幅降低界限-损失比（402.3 → 2.08）。
AI.conclusion: 在策略舍入过程中，通过设计高效的包络与曲率积分机制，可在保证性能的同时有效提升认证覆盖率并降低保守性，为稀疏策略优化提供了理论支撑。

title: Discrete Annotation, Continuous Preference: Rethinking Supervision for Accurate and Generalizable Aesthetic Image Cropping
comment: Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC
summary: Aesthetic image cropping aims to identify the optimal crop of an image in terms of aesthetics and composition. While supervision based on annotated data is fundamental, the field has been hindered by a long-standing problem: existing datasets suffer from (1) human subjectivity and (2) rigid discreteness confined to fixed sampling grids. These flawed annotations not only limit the accuracy and generalization of trained models but also severely distort fair evaluation. To overcome this, we propose to model human cropping preference as a multi-peaked, continuous, and sharp field over the crop space. We introduce the Continuous Preference Field (CPF), which recovers a dense preference landscape from discrete annotations through (1) peak clustering, (2) off-lattice refinement, (3) negative shaping, and (4) field assembly. Based on this, we train CPIC, a VLM-based cropping model optimized via GRPO with the CPF reward, which overcomes template collapse, achieving state-of-the-art performance and exceptional out-of-domain generalization. Finally, to resolve the long-standing benchmark evaluation crisis, we introduce CPICD, a comprehensive recalibration of existing ground-truth boxes. By leveraging the CPF to correct grid-bound artifacts across mainstream benchmarks, CPICD establishes a rigorous and reliable foundation for future cropping research. Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate the superiority of our CPF, CPIC, and CPICD. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出连续偏好场（CPF）来建模人类图像裁剪偏好，克服现有数据集因主观性和固定网格带来的局限。通过峰聚类、非格点优化、负向修正和场组装，构建密集偏好图，并基于此训练了CPIC模型，实现卓越的性能与跨域泛化能力。同时引入CPICD对基准数据集进行校准，解决长期存在的评估难题。实验与用户研究验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有图像裁剪数据集存在人类主观性强和裁剪区域受限于固定网格的问题，导致模型训练不准确、泛化能力差，且评估标准失真，亟需更精确、连续的偏好建模方式。
AI.method: 提出连续偏好场（CPF），通过峰聚类识别偏好峰值，进行非格点精细调整，实施负向形状修正，并最终整合为连续偏好场；在此基础上，使用视觉语言模型（VLM）构建CPIC模型，采用GRPO优化并以CPF作为奖励信号，避免模板坍缩；同时设计CPICD对现有标注进行重构，消除网格偏差。
AI.result: CPIC在多个基准上达到顶尖性能，具备出色的跨域泛化能力；CPICD有效修正了主流数据集中的网格伪影，建立了更可靠、公平的评估基础；大量实验和用户研究证实了所提方法的优势。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入连续偏好场（CPF）和相应模型（CPIC）与评估框架（CPICD），系统性解决了图像裁剪领域长期存在的标注偏差与评估失真问题，为未来研究提供了更准确的建模与评价范式。

title: Legal Research Bench: Measuring End-to-End Reliability in Long-Horizon Legal Research Agents
summary: Legal research is a core and time-consuming legal workflow. Lawyers must identify controlling authority, verify that it remains valid, reconcile statutes and cases, and synthesize a grounded answer. Language model agents are a natural fit for this retrieval-intensive workflow, and automating even part of it would be valuable. But that value depends on reliability: a single missing authority, stale citation, or wrong legal conclusion can make an otherwise plausible answer unusable. We introduce \textbf{Legal Research Bench} (LRB), a benchmark of 413 open-ended U.S. legal research questions written by experts, each paired with a gold answer, supporting authorities, and a binary grading rubric. We evaluate thirteen frontier models in a harness with web search, case-law search, page parsing, and retrieval tools. We score agent responses through all-pass grading with source verification, where a response is correct only if every required criterion is satisfied and its cited authorities verify. We also validate the LLM judge against expert attorneys ensuring that benchmark scores track attorney judgment. Agents remain far from reliable: among the models we tested, the strongest, Claude Opus 4.8, is fully correct on 42.9\% of questions. Performance also varies substantially by task setting: all-pass rates differ across areas of law and are lower on questions requiring reconciliation of conflicting authorities. Across models, more turns, tool calls, and inference cost do not predict higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为Legal Research Bench (LRB)的基准测试，包含413个由专家设计的开放式美国法律研究问题，每个问题配有黄金答案、支持性权威和二元评分标准。通过结合网络搜索、判例搜索、页面解析和检索工具，评估了13个前沿语言模型代理在真实法律研究任务中的表现。采用全通过评分与来源验证机制，只有当所有要求均满足且引用的法律依据可验证时才算正确。结果显示，最强模型Claude Opus 4.8仅在42.9%的问题上完全正确，且性能因法律领域和需调和冲突权威的任务而异；增加推理轮次、工具调用或计算成本并未显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 法律研究是法律工作中核心且耗时的环节，涉及识别有效判例、验证其时效性、协调法规与判例，并得出有根据的结论。尽管语言模型代理适合此类信息密集型任务，但其价值取决于可靠性——任何遗漏权威、过时引用或错误法律结论都会使答案失效。因此需要一个可靠、全面的基准来评估模型在真实法律场景下的表现。
AI.method: 构建了包含413个专家设计的开放性美国法律问题的LRB基准，每题附带黄金答案、支持性法律依据及二元评分规则。使用网页搜索、案例库检索、页面解析和信息检索工具构建自动化工作流，评估13个先进语言模型代理的表现。采用全通过评分机制（all-pass grading）并结合来源验证，确保回答中每一项要求都正确且引用的权威可查证。同时通过与执业律师对比验证大模型判断的可信度。
AI.result: 所测试模型整体表现仍不理想，最强模型Claude Opus 4.8在全通过标准下仅能正确解答42.9%的问题。不同法律领域间表现差异明显，尤其在需要调和冲突判例的问题上准确率更低。增加推理轮次、工具调用次数或计算开销并未带来一致的性能提升，表明当前模型在复杂法律推理上的能力仍有巨大局限。
AI.conclusion: 当前语言模型代理在法律研究任务中尚未达到实用可靠性水平，尤其在处理复杂、矛盾的法律问题时表现不佳。构建严格、可验证的评估基准（如LRB）对于推动法律AI的发展至关重要，未来需在准确性、可解释性和系统鲁棒性方面进行深入改进。

title: Sequential Functional Structured Tucker Compression for Large Language Model Attentions
summary: Post-training compression of LLM attention is often formulated as independent matrix approximation, ignoring both the shared structure among attention projections and the representation shift introduced by earlier compression. We propose FTC, a sequential structured compression framework that adapts the approximation to the current compressed model while jointly exploiting the native Q/K/V head structure under a fixed storage budget. The output projection is handled separately to account for the changed post-attention representation. FTC requires neither fine-tuning nor gradient-based recovery. Across seven decoder-only LLMs from 6B to 32B parameters, FTC achieves the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity among the compared methods at every tested keep ratio on five modern GQA models, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. The improvements transfer to downstream tasks and remain substantial at the 32B scale.

AI.tldr: FTC is a sequential structured compression framework for LLM attention that jointly exploits Q/K/V head structure and adapts to compressed models without fine-tuning or gradients, achieving state-of-the-art performance on WikiText-2 and downstream tasks.
AI.motivation: Existing post-training compression methods treat attention matrix approximation independently, ignoring shared structures among projections and representation shifts from prior compression, leading to suboptimal performance.
AI.method: FTC sequentially compresses attention matrices while preserving the native Q/K/V head structure, adaptively adjusting approximations based on the current compressed model and handling output projection separately.
AI.result: FTC achieves the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity across seven decoder-only LLMs (6B–32B) at all keep ratios, especially under aggressive compression, with strong transfer to downstream tasks.
AI.conclusion: FTC provides an effective, efficient compression method that preserves model quality through structured, adaptive approximation without requiring additional training.

title: Beyond Diagonal State Space Models: Exact Non-Abelian Group Tracking, Solvability Barriers, and Geometric Physical Manifolds
comment: 26 pages, 1 table, 5 theorems. Source code and reproducible benchmarks available
summary: Selective state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, S4D, and LRU, are bounded by transition matrix commutativity (A_t A_t' = A_t' A_t) and solvable affine transformation groups (Aff_D of derived length <= 2). Consequently, stacked multi-layer diagonal networks face severe optimization degradation on non-solvable simple groups such as A_5 due to the exponential circuit emulation depth required to simulate non-abelian commutators. We propose Non-Commutative State Space Models (NC-SSM), their real-orthogonal counterpart SO(3)-SSM, and arbitrary-dimension Cayley-SSM, lifting state transitions to compact Lie groups SU(2), SO(3), and SO(N). Via closed-form Euler-Rodrigues maps and rational Cayley transforms, NC-SSM achieves exact norm-preserving isometry (||U_t|| = 1). We introduce pure Hopf-fibration Bloch projective readouts (S^3/{+-1} =~ S^2 =~ SO(3)) to eliminate sign ambiguity, true quaternion parallel prefix scans (9.06x speedup at T=2048), and Identity-Gated Lie SSMs to eliminate sparse syntax phase drift. Extensive benchmarks across 14 experimental regimes show: (1) NC-SSM achieves 100% tracking on S_3, D_4, Q_8 and simple group A_5, where a 3-layer deep diagonal baseline collapses to 6.60% (p = 8.81e-4); (2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM breaks Klein's 1884 ceiling on symmetric group S_5 (50.92% vs diagonal 5.25%, p = 0.0015, delivering 7.8x variance reduction over SO(3)); (3) SO(3)-SSM preserves Riemannian manifolds across 300 steps (< 3.12e-6 drift, > 580,000x advantage), achieving 0.04 deg dead-reckoning error and active tangent denoising; (4) NC-SSM achieves 74.36% on Dyck-2 and 30.26% on deep AST scope tracking (p = 0.0081); and (5) ablation confirms strict isometry is mathematically necessary for lossless long-range associative memory.

AI.tldr: 提出非交换状态空间模型（NC-SSM）及其正交版本SO(3)-SSM和任意维度的Cayley-SSM，通过紧致李群提升状态转移，利用欧拉-罗德里格斯映射和有理卡利公式实现精确保范同构。引入纯霍普夫纤维化布洛赫投影读出消除符号歧义，实现9.06倍加速的四元数并行前缀扫描，并设计身份门控李群SSM消除稀疏语法相位漂移。在14个实验场景中验证：NC-SSM在S_3、D_4、Q_8和简单群A_5上实现100%跟踪性能，而三层数对角基线仅达6.60%；Cayley-SO(5)-SSM突破克莱因1884年对称群S_5的上限（50.92% vs 5.25%），方差降低7.8倍；SO(3)-SSM在300步内保持黎曼流形稳定性（<3.12e-6漂移），死区推算误差仅0.04度；NC-SSM在Dyck-2和深层AST作用域跟踪任务分别取得74.36%与30.26%准确率；消融实验证明严格保范性是实现无损长程关联记忆的数学必要条件。
AI.motivation: 现有选择性状态空间模型受制于转移矩阵可交换性与可解仿射变换群限制，在处理非可解单群如A_5时面临严重优化退化，因模拟非阿贝尔对易子需指数级电路深度。为突破此瓶颈，需从代数结构层面重构状态转移机制，以支持更复杂的群对称性建模。
AI.method: 将状态转移提升至紧凑李群SU(2)、SO(3)和SO(N)，采用闭式欧拉-罗德里格斯映射与有理卡利变换保证精确保范同构；引入纯霍普夫纤维化布洛赫投影读出消除符号歧义；设计四元数并行前缀扫描实现高速计算；提出身份门控李群SSM抑制相位漂移。
AI.result: NC-SSM在多个非阿贝尔群（如S_3、D_4、Q_8、A_5）上实现100%跟踪性能，显著优于传统对角模型；Cayley-SO(5)-SSM打破历史上限，对称群S_5性能提升近10倍；SO(3)-SSM在长时间演化中保持极低几何漂移（<3.12e-6），具备高精度死区推算与主动切向去噪能力；在复杂语言结构任务中表现优异，且消融实验确认保范性为无损长程记忆的数学必需条件。
AI.conclusion: 通过将状态空间模型提升至非交换李群结构，本研究实现了对复杂非阿贝尔对称性的精确建模，突破了传统可交换性约束，显著提升模型在长程依赖、复杂群结构与高维流形上的表达能力与稳定性，证明了严格保范同构在构建鲁棒长程记忆系统中的根本重要性。

title: Just Align $\bm{x}$: Aligning Predictions, Not Representations
summary: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion training, but its benefits do not transfer reliably to pixel-space clean-image prediction. In JiT, we find that auxiliary feature alignment can improve access to semantic features while reducing access to image variation needed for clean-image prediction, creating a mismatch between the auxiliary objective and the denoising task. This suggests a different principle: auxiliary supervision should improve the prediction target itself rather than impose a separate representation target. We introduce JAx (Just Align x), a prediction-supervision method that aligns clean-image predictions across noise levels. JAx couples a noisier student observation with a cleaner observation through a Markov degradation that preserves the original JiT input distribution. Under this coupling, the oracle prediction from the cleaner state has the same conditional mean as the optimal JiT target, while its conditional target covariance is no greater. Thus, oracle prediction alignment preserves the population JiT objective up to a constant while providing a lower-variance training target. To make this construction practical with an imperfect EMA teacher, JAx combines ground-truth supervision with a reliability-gated coupling band that selects nearby teacher states based on prediction risk. On ImageNet 256x256, JAx consistently improves FID and accelerates convergence across JiT-B/16, L/16, and H/16, without an external encoder or changes to the architecture or sampling procedure. Gradient diagnostics further show reduced minibatch gradient variance, while ablations demonstrate that the gains cannot be explained by time reweighting alone. These results show that prediction-space supervision provides a simple and principled alternative to representation alignment for pixel-space generative models.

AI.tldr: JAx (Just Align x) 是一种新的预测监督方法，通过在不同噪声水平下对干净图像预测进行对齐，提升扩散模型训练效率。它利用马尔可夫退化过程耦合较噪学生观测与较清观测，使更清洁状态的最优预测具有与JiT目标相同的条件均值且方差更小，从而保留原始目标并降低训练方差。为应对不完美EMA教师的问题，引入基于可靠性门控的耦合带选择邻近教师状态。在ImageNet 256x256上，JAx在JiT-B/16、L/16和H/16模型中一致提升FID并加速收敛，无需外部编码器或架构修改，且梯度诊断显示批内梯度方差降低，消融实验表明性能提升不能仅由时间重加权解释。结果表明，预测空间监督是像素空间生成模型的一种简单而原则性的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 现有表示对齐方法虽能加速扩散训练，但在像素空间干净图像预测中效果不稳定，因辅助特征对齐导致语义特征访问增加而图像变化信息减少，造成辅助目标与去噪任务之间的不匹配。因此需要一种更直接作用于预测目标本身的监督机制。
AI.method: 提出JAx方法，通过马尔可夫退化过程将较噪的学生观测与较清的观测耦合，使得更清洁状态的预测具有与最优JiT目标相同条件均值且更低方差；结合真实标签与可靠性门控耦合带，仅选择预测风险较低的邻近教师状态以应对不完美教师问题。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，JAx显著提升FID得分并加快收敛速度，在JiT-B/16、L/16、H/16多种配置下表现一致；无需外部编码器或改变架构与采样流程；梯度分析显示批次内梯度方差下降；消融实验排除了时间重加权作为唯一解释的可能性。
AI.conclusion: 预测空间监督（如JAx）提供了一种比表示对齐更简单且更符合原理的像素空间生成模型训练方法，有效提升了训练效率与生成质量。

title: Spatial Strategies, Not Actions: Vector-Quantized Geodesics as Tools for LLM-Driven Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) based agents are often criticized for lacking spatial understanding and mainly exploiting statistical text patterns. We investigate their spatial comprehension through an architecture combining geometrical tools with a LLM serving as a high-level orchestrator in grid-world environments. The agent first collects geodesic trajectories, which are then vector-quantized to extract a representative subset. Offline, the LLM associates a natural language description of the underlying behavioral patterns to each selected trajectory, making it a tool. Online, the LLM chooses the appropriate tool conditioned on the current state and goal. Low-level control is handled by primitive actions that execute the trajectory associated with the tool. From an agentic AI perspective, this approach separates learning into two levels: tool discovery is handled through unsupervised quantization of trajectories, while reasoning and decision-making are handled by the LLM. We test the approach in a partially observable dynamic 2D grid environment with an open vision-language model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Pairing the geometry-derived tool library with an agent-centered zoom tool and a collision detection tool lets a fast, non-reasoning configuration match the goal-reaching rate of a much more costly chain-of-thought version, while cutting the cost of a decision from minutes to seconds.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过将几何工具与大语言模型（LLM）结合，在网格世界环境中提升代理的空间理解能力。代理首先收集测地线轨迹并进行向量量化以提取代表性子集，离线时由LLM为每个轨迹分配自然语言描述作为‘工具’；在线时，LLM根据当前状态和目标选择合适工具，低层控制由执行轨迹的原始动作完成。该方法将学习分为两个层次：工具发现通过轨迹的无监督量化实现，而推理与决策由LLM负责。实验在部分可观测动态2D网格环境中进行，使用Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型，结合几何生成的工具库、代理中心缩放工具和碰撞检测工具，使一个无需复杂推理的配置在目标达成率上媲美更昂贵的思维链版本，同时将决策成本从分钟级降至秒级。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型代理常因缺乏空间理解能力而依赖统计文本模式，本文旨在提升其在空间任务中的表现，通过引入几何工具与LLM协同的方式增强空间认知与决策效率。
AI.method: 构建一个双层架构：利用几何工具提取测地线轨迹并进行向量量化以生成工具库；离线阶段，用LLM为每个轨迹赋予自然语言描述作为可调用工具；在线阶段，由LLM基于状态与目标选择工具，低层执行对应轨迹动作。工具发现通过无监督量化完成，推理与决策由LLM承担。
AI.result: 在部分可观测动态2D网格环境中，该方法使非推理型配置达到与高成本思维链版本相当的目标达成率，同时将单次决策时间从分钟级缩短至秒级，显著提升效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将几何工具与大语言模型结合，实现了高效且具空间理解能力的智能体设计，验证了分层学习机制在提升代理性能方面的有效性。

title: Reason in Style: Discovering and Controlling Style in Language Models
summary: Language models learn content and style jointly, making stylistic variation in their outputs difficult to identify and control. We study whether recurring styles in model responses can be discovered without supervision and explicitly controlled. We design an algorithm that learns to separate representations of content and style from language models' outputs and validate its effectiveness on math questions in a controlled setting. By applying this method to over 100K verified traces from nine distinct teacher models, we discover six recurring yet imbalanced styles. We then fine-tune smaller student models to follow these styles when explicitly conditioned on them, using importance weighting to balance the contribution of the styles represented in the corpus. This approach improves Pass@$k$ over standard fine-tuning on the same data across six math reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that we can diversify the style of answers effectively. We confirm that this also results in strong correspondence between requested and realized styles. We find that style affects correctness: the probability of solving a problem depends on the style we condition on, and different problems benefit from different styles. In summary, our results show that stylistic variation in model-generated data can be discovered in an unsupervised way, and made explicit, providing a source of both control and improved reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种无监督算法，从语言模型输出中分离内容与风格表示，并在数学问题上验证其有效性。通过分析超过10万条来自九个教师模型的验证轨迹，发现六种重复但不平衡的风格。通过重要性加权对小型学生模型进行微调，使其在条件控制下遵循特定风格，结果在六个数学推理基准上优于标准微调，证明风格控制可提升生成多样性与推理性能。同时发现风格影响正确率，不同问题适合不同风格。总体表明，模型生成数据中的风格可被无监督发现并显式控制，从而增强可控性与性能。
AI.motivation: 语言模型联合学习内容与风格，导致输出风格难以识别和控制。本文旨在探索是否能无监督地发现并显式控制模型输出中的重复风格，以提升生成多样性与推理性能。
AI.method: 设计一种无监督算法，从语言模型输出中分离内容与风格表示；利用重要性加权对小模型进行微调，使其在条件控制下遵循特定风格；在数学推理任务上评估效果。
AI.result: 发现六种重复但不平衡的风格；在六个数学推理基准上，基于风格控制的微调方法在Pass@$k$指标上优于标准微调；风格与正确率相关，不同问题受益于不同风格；风格控制显著提升生成多样性与性能。
AI.conclusion: 模型生成数据中的风格可通过无监督方式发现并显式控制，为生成过程提供新的控制维度，并有效提升推理表现。

title: The Weakest Link: Distilling LLM Reasoning with Worst-Case Constrained Reinforcement Learning
summary: Distilling the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) into smaller students is a central challenge for efficient deployment. Current approaches face a fundamental tension: optimizing purely for verifiable task rewards (e.g., via GRPO) leads to reward hacking, where students arrive at correct final answers through flawed intermediate logic, while regularizing with soft divergence penalties against a teacher (e.g., KL-based distillation) dilutes task performance and, critically, allows the student to compensate for severe logical violations at one step with high teacher agreement at others. We argue that this averaging is fundamentally misaligned with the nature of reasoning: a chain-of-thought is only as valid as its weakest link. Motivated by this observation, we formulate reasoning distillation as a constrained reinforcement learning problem in which the task reward is maximized subject to a worst-case constraint on the teacher log-likelihood along every prefix of the trajectory. To avoid the prohibitive cost of dual Lagrangian solvers and the test-time teacher dependence of state-augmented methods such as Saute, we derive an unaugmented constrained MDP whose reward transformation preserves the hard-constraint semantics, admits a low-variance policy gradient decomposition into single-step and long-term terms, and provably satisfies the worst-case constraint almost surely in the penalty limit. Through extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks, we demonstrate that our method significantly expands the accuracy-fidelity Pareto front. By matching the high Final Answer Correctness of pure RL and drastically reducing teacher constraint violations, we ultimately achieve the highest rigorous Reasoning Success Rate across all evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的推理蒸馏方法，通过将推理过程建模为带有最坏情况约束的强化学习问题，确保学生在每一步推理中都与教师保持一致，避免因平均化导致的逻辑漏洞。该方法无需依赖测试时教师，且能有效防止奖励黑客行为，在数学推理和代码生成任务上显著提升了准确率与推理严谨性，实现了更高的推理成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在优化任务奖励时易产生奖励黑客，而使用软约束（如KL散度）又会因平均化效应掩盖严重逻辑错误，无法保证推理链中每一步的可靠性。由于推理链条的可靠性取决于最弱一环，因此需要更强的约束机制来确保每一步的正确性。
AI.method: 将推理蒸馏建模为一个无增强的受限马尔可夫决策过程（constrained MDP），通过奖励变换实现硬约束语义，支持低方差策略梯度分解，并在惩罚极限下几乎必然满足最坏情况下的教师对数似然约束。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上，该方法显著提升了准确率与推理一致性，相比纯强化学习方法大幅减少教师约束违反，同时保持高最终答案正确率，实现了最高的严格推理成功率。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的受约束蒸馏方法能够有效平衡任务性能与推理过程的严谨性，克服了现有方法在推理链完整性上的缺陷，为高效部署小型推理模型提供了新范式。

title: HAWK: Rethinking Multimodal Drafting for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding has achieved substantial lossless speedups for LLMs, but remains less effective for large vision-language models (LVLMs), where lightweight drafters struggle to use rich multimodal information. A second limitation is that standard distillation supervises the drafter only along the original training trajectory, without modeling how target predictions shift after the drafter's own proposals. As drafting moves away from this trajectory, the drafter can increasingly disagree with the target, reducing acceptance in later steps. We propose HAWK to address both limitations. HAWK uses representation similarity to select informative target layers and learns how to combine their hidden states. For visual information, it directly provides the drafter with compressed visual hidden states from the target model instead of raw visual tokens, making the visual information easier for a shallow drafter to use. HAWK also trains the drafter to capture how target predictions change after its own proposals, improving its agreement with the target during multi-step drafting. On SmolVLM-256M across ten multimodal benchmarks, HAWK raises average acceptance length from 3.32 to 4.08 and speedup from 2.19x to 2.60x over EAGLE-3 under greedy decoding, and from 2.89 to 3.41 and 1.92x to 2.19x under sampling.

AI.tldr: HAWK improves speculative decoding for large vision-language models by enhancing drafter use of multimodal information and modeling prediction shifts after drafts, leading to higher acceptance lengths and speedups.
AI.motivation: Standard speculative decoding struggles with LVLMs due to limited use of multimodal info by lightweight drafters and lack of adaptation to prediction shifts caused by drafts.
AI.method: HAWK uses representation similarity to select informative target layers, combines their hidden states, and provides compressed visual hidden states to the drafter; it also trains the drafter to predict how target outputs change post-draft.
AI.result: On SmolVLM-256M across ten benchmarks, HAWK increases average acceptance length from 3.32 to 4.08 (greedy) and 3.41 (sampling), and boosts speedup from 2.19x to 2.60x (greedy) and 1.92x to 2.19x (sampling) over EAGLE-3.
AI.conclusion: HAWK effectively enhances speculative decoding in LVLMs by better leveraging multimodal representations and adapting to dynamic prediction shifts, enabling significant performance gains.

title: CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science
summary: Evaluating AI agents on scientific research tasks is constrained by the time and resources required for the underlying experiments or calculations. In computational materials research, repeating the same expensive simulations across agents and trials can make evaluation impractical. We introduce CompMat-Bench, a benchmark of 94 tasks derived from recently published computational materials studies, each asking agents to complete a step toward achieving the study's scientific goal. We reproduce the research steps in advance and assess agents on preparing inputs and analyzing outputs for expensive simulations, so expensive simulations can be avoided during evaluation. The reproduced inputs and results serve as ground truth for grading agents with fixed rules, without an LLM judge. The benchmark supports four evaluation conditions: single tasks and workflows composed of related tasks, each with full or reduced methodological guidance. With full guidance on single tasks, agents based on three LLMs demonstrate the ability to complete individual materials research steps, with pass rates of 66.0-90.4% across 94 tasks. Both longer workflows and reduced guidance can limit agent performance, but in different ways for different agents: they lower the pass rates of the weaker agents, whereas the strongest agent falls only when a long workflow is combined with reduced guidance. Failure analysis attributes most failures to scientific errors rather than to errors in software usage. CompMat-Bench provides a basis for comparing agents on the steps of real materials research and for analyzing agent failure modes.

AI.tldr: CompMat-Bench 是一个包含 94 个任务的基准测试，源自近期发表的计算材料研究，旨在评估 AI 代理在科学科研任务中的表现。通过预先复现研究步骤，避免在评估过程中重复昂贵的模拟，使用固定规则和真实结果作为评分标准，无需依赖 LLM 判官。支持四种评估条件：单任务与工作流、完整或减少的方法指导。基于三个 LLM 的代理在完整指导下的单任务中表现良好（通过率 66.0%-90.4%），但更长的工作流和减少指导会降低性能，尤其对弱代理影响更大；最强代理仅在长工作流+少指导时下降。失败分析显示主要错误为科学性错误而非软件操作错误。该基准为比较代理在真实材料研究步骤中的表现及分析失败模式提供了基础。
AI.motivation: 现有评估 AI 代理在科学科研任务中的方法受限于昂贵实验或计算资源，难以重复进行大规模评估。在计算材料研究领域，频繁重复高成本模拟使评估不切实际。需要一种高效、可复现且无需昂贵计算的评估机制。
AI.method: 构建 CompMat-Bench 基准，从近期计算材料研究中提取 94 个真实科研任务，预先复现每个任务的研究步骤，生成输入和输出结果作为真实答案。评估时仅需检查代理是否能正确准备输入和分析输出，避免运行实际模拟。采用固定规则评分，无需人工或 LLM 判官。支持四种评估场景：单任务/工作流，配合完整或减少的方法指导。
AI.result: 在完整指导下的单任务评估中，基于三个 LLM 的代理通过率在 66.0% 至 90.4% 之间。较长的工作流和减少指导会降低代理表现，尤其对较弱代理影响显著。最强代理仅在长工作流结合少指导时出现明显性能下降。失败原因主要为科学理解错误，而非软件使用错误。
AI.conclusion: CompMat-Bench 提供了一种高效、可扩展且基于真实研究步骤的评估框架，适用于比较不同 AI 代理在计算材料研究中的能力，并有助于深入分析其失败模式，推动智能科研代理的发展。

title: Effective Synthetic Data Curation Requires Group-Level Signals
summary: Synthetic data now is essential to LLM training, used to strengthen advanced capabilities such as autonomous and long-horizon task execution. Yet recent work shows that training on it at scale can degrade model generation, making it important to decide what synthetic data is worth training on. While current data curation practices do so with individual-level signals (i.e., estimates of each data sample's training utility in isolation), across pre-training and post-training settings we show that this is insufficient for synthetic data, and that group-level signals (i.e., estimates of utility that account for interactions among data samples) are necessary for effective data curation. First, we show that individual-level signals are blind to how samples jointly affect training: synthetic datasets with different compositions can be indistinguishable under individual-level influence yet differ sharply under group-level influence, and curating by the latter yields better downstream performance, particularly in generative capability. Second, we find that group-level signals matter more as training pipelines become increasingly synthetic: among widely used data curation methods, only those incorporating them improve over baseline, with gains increasing when weights capturing relations among samples are amplified. Finally, we translate these findings into practice -- for model developers under a compute budget, we offer a cheap diagnostic that prioritizes which groups of synthetic data most need group-level estimation, recovering much of the benefit of full group-level scoring at a fraction of the compute cost.
