AI.tldr: 该研究指出，尽管合成数据在大语言模型训练中至关重要，但仅依赖个体样本的训练效用评估（如单个数据样本的贡献度）不足以有效筛选高质量合成数据。研究发现，样本间的相互作用对训练效果有显著影响，因此必须引入群体层面的信号来衡量数据价值。实验表明，基于群体层面信号的数据筛选能显著提升生成能力，尤其在高度依赖合成数据的训练流程中表现更优。此外，研究提出一种低成本诊断方法，帮助开发者在计算资源有限的情况下，高效识别最需进行群体级评估的数据组，从而以极低的成本获得接近全量群体评估的收益。
AI.motivation: 当前合成数据在大语言模型训练中广泛应用，但其大规模使用可能导致模型生成质量下降。现有数据筛选方法多依赖于个体样本的独立评估，但这种做法忽略了样本间的交互影响，无法准确反映数据组合对训练的整体效果，因此亟需更有效的数据筛选机制。
AI.method: 通过对比个体层面与群体层面的数据效用评估方法，分析不同数据集组合在预训练和后训练阶段的表现差异；设计并测试多种数据筛选策略，包括仅使用个体信号、结合群体信号以及增强样本间关系权重的方法；开发一种低成本诊断工具，用于识别需要高精度群体评估的关键数据组。
AI.result: 群体层面信号显著优于个体层面信号，在提升模型生成能力和下游任务表现方面效果更佳；特别是在合成数据占比高的训练流程中，采用群体信号的方法性能持续领先；所提出的诊断方法可在大幅降低计算成本的前提下，恢复大部分群体评估的收益。
AI.conclusion: 对于合成数据的高效利用，仅依靠个体级信号是不足的，必须引入群体级信号以捕捉数据样本间的复杂交互。为此，本文提出了一个实用且高效的诊断框架，使模型开发者能够在有限算力下实现接近最优的数据筛选，为大规模合成数据训练提供重要指导。

title: Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates
summary: Software that hands branching decisions to a model needs a declared option and a probability it can threshold. Typed decision models, also called System One models, return such probabilities without generating text, while supervised classifiers and generative language models are the established alternatives. Under matched conditions, one harness sends eight decision-model checkpoints from six families, including the hosted model Jev, and two generative comparators the same semantic requests, and scores supervised and zero-shot classifiers on the same workflow, intent and social-science items. The ranking of the model classes depends on the conditions. With the task's own labels, small trained classifiers are the most accurate on intents and not significantly different from the best decision models on workflows. Without labels, every decision model except the encoder-based checkpoints exceeds a zero-shot entailment classifier on workflows and intents. Read through option-key likelihoods, a larger generative model is level with Jev on workflows and intents and accepts more workflow decisions at five percent risk, and fine-tuned decision checkpoints gain intent accuracy over their untuned backbones. Stored temperatures fitted on few options raise calibration error with many options, and a held-out threshold for five percent in-scope risk still lets Jev accept 0.310 of out-of-scope requests. Swapping yes and no flips 50.5 answers per hundred for Jev, while fine-tuned checkpoints cut their backbones' social-science flips. An intent-trained first stage escalating to Jev matches its accuracy at 0.43 of its cost at full graphics-processor utilization. The results yield condition-dependent design rules for automated decision gates.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了不同类型决策模型在自动化决策任务中的表现，包括小型训练分类器、决策模型（如Jev）和生成式模型。在有标签的情况下，小型分类器在意图识别上最准确；在无标签情况下，除基于编码器的模型外，其他决策模型均优于零样本蕴含分类器。大型生成模型性能接近Jev，且在5%风险下可接受更多工作流请求。微调后的决策模型在意图识别上优于原始模型。温度校准在选项增多时导致校准误差上升，而5%风险阈值下Jev仍能处理31%的非范围请求。对调“是/否”回答导致约50.5%的错误，但微调模型减少了社会科学研究中的此类错误。采用先验意图模型再升级至Jev的设计，在仅43%成本下达到与Jev相当的准确率。结果表明决策系统设计需根据具体条件调整。
AI.motivation: 开发高效、准确且可信赖的自动化决策系统，探索不同模型在不同条件下的表现差异，以指导实际部署中的模型选择与设计。
AI.method: 通过对比八种决策模型（来自六个家族，含Jev）与两种生成式模型，在相同语义请求下评估其在工作流、意图和社科类任务上的表现；使用监督分类器、零样本分类器及生成模型进行测试，并分析不同设置下的准确率、风险控制和鲁棒性。
AI.result: 有标签时，小规模训练分类器在意图识别上最优；无标签时，多数决策模型优于零样本分类器。大型生成模型性能接近Jev，且在5%风险下可处理更多请求。微调模型提升意图识别准确率，但温度校准在多选项场景中降低校准精度。对调答案导致显著错误，但微调缓解此问题。采用两阶段设计可在较低资源消耗下达到与Jev相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 自动化决策系统的最佳模型选择取决于具体应用场景与条件，应结合任务标签可用性、风险容忍度和计算成本综合设计，提供条件依赖的设计原则。

title: VisionQ: VLM-as-a-Judge Taxonomy, Dataset and Benchmark for Qualitative Analysis in Computer Vision
summary: Qualitative comparison figures are central evidence in computer vision papers, and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to judge them. Yet existing benchmarks score only scalar quality or overall preference, so a judge can be rewarded for picking the preferred image for the wrong visual reason. We introduce VisionQ, the first benchmark built from peer-reviewed CV comparison figures that grounds every judgment in a named visual criterion: each question states the criterion, and a judge is credited only when it selects the output the authors identify as best on that criterion. We call this task criterion-conditioned visual discrimination. VisionQ comprises (1) a corpus of 1,409 CVPR and ICCV papers with 1,800+ validated comparison figures and 3,911 hand-annotated data points linking method crops to author-stated visual claims; (2) a six-axis, 51-leaf taxonomy of the visual criteria behind qualitative judgment; (3) a criterion-conditioned evaluation protocol that hides method names, captions, and paper identity and reports accuracy per criterion; and (4) VisionQ-Judge, a DPO-tuned Gemma-4-E4B judge trained on symmetric evidence pairs, which reduces last-option predictions by 7.0pp and improves accuracy by 2.5pp on a held-out test set. Evaluating 20 open- and closed-source VLM judges, we find that the strongest reach only 63.1% accuracy (chance 32.2%) and that reliability varies sharply across criteria. Code: https://github.com/ReML-AI/visionq. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/visionq-anon-2026/VisionQ-1k.

AI.tldr: VisionQ 是首个基于同行评审计算机视觉论文中比较图像构建的基准，强调在具体视觉标准下进行判断。它通过将每项判断与特定视觉标准关联，确保评估更准确、可解释。该基准包含1,409篇CVPR和ICCV论文中的1,800+张验证过的对比图，3,911个手工标注的数据点，一个六轴51叶的视觉标准分类体系，以及一种隐藏方法名称、标题和论文身份的准则条件评估协议。此外，还引入了经过DPO微调的VisionQ-Judge（Gemma-4-E4B模型），显著降低最后选项偏差并提升准确率。在20个开源与闭源VLM判官中测试发现，最强模型准确率仅63.1%（随机水平32.2%），且不同标准间表现差异显著。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅评估整体质量或偏好，导致判断可能因错误的视觉原因而被奖励。为解决这一问题，需要一种能将判断与具体视觉标准绑定的评估方式，以提高评估的准确性和可解释性。
AI.method: 构建包含真实论文对比图的基准数据集；设计六轴51叶的视觉标准分类体系；提出准则条件评估协议，隐藏方法标识信息；训练基于对称证据对的DPO-tuned VisionQ-Judge模型。
AI.result: VisionQ-Judge相比基线减少7.0个百分点的最后选项偏差，准确率提升2.5个百分点；20个VLM判官中最强者准确率为63.1%（高于随机32.2%）；不同视觉标准下的可靠性差异明显。
AI.conclusion: VisionQ 提供了一种更精细、可解释的视觉判断评估范式，揭示了当前VLM在细粒度视觉推理上的局限性，并为未来模型改进提供了基准和方向。

title: Incident-Arena: Getting agents to the last nine of reliability
summary: AI coding agents are ubiquitous in engineering workflows amongst industry and academia. Yet, despite their use in app coding, relatively less attention has been paid to their ability to execute on production incident response. This emerging field, termed agentic site-reliability-engineering (SRE) contains benchmarks limited by (1) unrealistic environments, typically toy repositories (2) non-standard framework implementations and (3) simple static verifiers. We introduce Incident-Arena, a human-built benchmark of 20 carefully selected tasks grounded in real-world deployed open source software. Each task deploys a production application to an ephemeral Kubernetes cluster, injecting a fault from the config layer through underlying images, and a sustained load profile given the task requirements. We also present a novel verification method, going beyond static checks to functional verifiers, holding systems level metrics stable, while ensuring repairs are done safely. Agent trials run an average of 2.81M tokens and 41 turns, going beyond existing benchmarks, demonstrating agentic long horizon reasoning. Across 20 tasks and 3 application substrates, frontier models score below 64.3%, with failures extending from diagnosis/localization errors, through incomplete repairs and unsafe regressions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Incident-Arena，一个基于真实开源软件的20个生产级故障响应任务基准，用于评估AI编码代理在站点可靠性工程（SRE）中的表现。该基准通过部署应用至临时Kubernetes集群、注入配置层至镜像层的故障，并施加持续负载，构建真实环境。引入新型功能验证方法，超越静态检查，确保系统指标稳定且修复安全。实验显示，前沿模型平均仅达64.3%成功率，失败原因包括诊断错误、修复不完整及不安全回归。
AI.motivation: 现有AI编码代理在生产事件响应中的能力研究不足，现有基准存在环境不真实、框架实现不标准、验证方式简单等问题，限制了对代理长期推理与实际运维能力的评估。
AI.method: 构建Incident-Arena基准，包含20个真实世界开源软件任务；每个任务在临时Kubernetes集群中部署应用，注入多层级故障并施加负载；采用功能验证机制，结合系统级指标监控，确保修复的安全性与有效性；通过大规模代理试运行（平均281万token，41轮交互）评估模型表现。
AI.result: 前沿模型在20个任务和3种应用底座上平均成功率低于64.3%；主要失败模式包括诊断/定位错误、修复不完整以及引入不安全的回归。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI编码代理在复杂生产环境下的事件响应能力仍有限，亟需提升其长期推理、准确诊断与安全修复能力。Incident-Arena为未来研究提供了真实、可扩展、高挑战性的评估平台。

title: Can large language models unlock discrete data in ophthalmic diagnostic reports?
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Presented at the Association for Research in Vision and Ophthalmology (ARVO) Annual Meeting, Denver, Colorado, May 4, 2026
summary: Objective: To assess the accuracy and efficiency of a large language model (LLM) using two prompt strategies to extract structured data from ophthalmic diagnostic PDF reports. Methods: Twenty deidentified reports across four types (Visual Field, OCT Glaucoma Overview, OCT retinal nerve fiber layer Single Exam, and OCT Thickness Map; n = 5 each) were processed using two GPT-4o-assisted pipelines and compared with a reconciled manual ground truth. Schema-Constrained used Structured Output mode with a predefined JSON Schema; Prompt-Only used a detailed instruction prompt followed by Python conversion to JSON. Outcomes were value accuracy, formatting accuracy, and extraction time. Results: Schema-Constrained value accuracy was 100.00% for Visual Field and RNFL Single Exam, 97.45% for Glaucoma Overview, and 98.00% for Thickness Map; Prompt-Only achieved 100.00% across all four report types. Formatting accuracy was 100.00% for Schema-Constrained across all report types and 100.00% for Prompt-Only except RNFL Single Exam (90.14%). Mean extraction time was 56.51 s per report for manual review versus 5.04 s for Schema-Constrained and 4.70 s for Prompt-Only, an approximately 92% reduction. Conclusions: In this small proof-of-concept dataset, general-purpose LLM-assisted pipelines extracted structured data from ophthalmic diagnostic PDFs with high accuracy and substantially reduced processing time. Prompt-Only achieved the highest value accuracy, while Schema-Constrained produced schema-compliant output with 100% formatting accuracy. These complementary strengths support further evaluation of hybrid, validation-aware workflows for research and clinical data abstraction.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了两种提示策略在从眼科诊断PDF报告中提取结构化数据时，使用大语言模型（LLM）的准确性和效率。采用GPT-4o的两种处理流程（基于模式约束和仅提示）与人工校对的基准结果进行比较。结果显示，仅提示策略在所有报告类型中达到100%的值准确性，而基于模式约束的方法在格式准确性上表现优异（100%），且两者均显著缩短了处理时间（平均约5秒/份报告，相比人工的56.51秒减少92%）。结论表明，这两种方法各有优势，支持未来探索结合验证机制的混合工作流用于科研与临床数据提取。
AI.motivation: 当前眼科诊断报告多以非结构化PDF形式存在，人工提取结构化数据耗时费力，亟需高效、准确的自动化方法。本研究旨在探索大语言模型在该任务中的潜力，并比较不同提示策略的表现，为临床与研究中的数据抽象提供技术支持。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4o构建两个数据提取管道：一是基于预定义JSON Schema的结构化输出模式（Schema-Constrained），二是通过详细指令提示后用Python转换为JSON（Prompt-Only）。选取20份去标识化的四类眼科报告（每类5份）进行测试，对比两种方法在值准确性、格式准确性和提取时间上的表现，并与人工校对的基准结果比较。
AI.result: Schema-Constrained在视觉场和RNFL单次检查报告中实现100.00%的值准确性，在青光眼概述中为97.45%，在厚度图中为98.00%；而Prompt-Only在所有报告类型中均达100.00%。格式准确性方面，Schema-Constrained在所有类型中均为100.00%，Prompt-Only除RNFL单次检查外（90.14%）也均为100.00%。平均提取时间分别为5.04秒（Schema-Constrained）和4.70秒（Prompt-Only），相比人工的56.51秒降低约92%。
AI.conclusion: 在小规模概念验证数据集中，通用大语言模型辅助的管道能高效且高精度地从眼科诊断PDF中提取结构化数据。尽管两种方法各有优势——Prompt-Only在值准确性上更优，Schema-Constrained在格式合规性上更佳——但二者互补，支持进一步开发融合验证机制的混合工作流，适用于科研及临床数据抽象场景。

title: Deep Learning for Anomaly Detection in Railway Systems: A Structured Survey
comment: Survey paper. Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence (EAAI), 2026
summary: Ensuring safe and reliable operation of modern railway systems increasingly relies on data-driven monitoring and intelligent fault detection. Deep learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for railway anomaly detection, driven by the growing availability of heterogeneous sensor data from rolling stock and infrastructure. This paper presents a structured survey of deep learning-based anomaly detection approaches for railway systems. The surveyed methods are organized using a unified taxonomy covering anomaly location, data representation and manifestation, sensing modality, and temporal characteristics. Existing approaches, including convolutional, recurrent and attention-based architectures, autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, and transformers, are structured into classification-based, prediction-based, reconstruction-based, and hybrid learning paradigms. The survey also examines data-centric challenges, evaluation practices, performance metrics, and practical deployment aspects, including edge-cloud architectures, computational constraints, and hardware-aware optimization. Finally, a decision-oriented framework links anomaly characteristics, data properties, and operational constraints to suitable detection paradigms and deployment configurations. This work provides a structured reference for selecting and deploying deep learning solutions for railway anomaly detection and highlights open challenges toward reliable and scalable intelligent monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了基于深度学习的铁路系统异常检测方法，按异常位置、数据表示与表现形式、传感模态和时间特性进行分类，并将现有方法归纳为基于分类、预测、重建和混合学习范式。同时探讨了数据挑战、评估实践、性能指标及实际部署中的边缘-云架构、计算约束与硬件优化等问题，提出一个决策导向框架以匹配异常特征、数据属性与运行约束，指导检测范式与部署配置的选择。
AI.motivation: 现代铁路系统的安全可靠运行日益依赖于数据驱动的监控与智能故障检测，深度学习在处理异构传感器数据方面表现出色，但缺乏系统性综述来指导方法选择与部署。
AI.method: 采用统一分类体系对现有深度学习方法进行组织，涵盖异常位置、数据表示、传感模态和时间特性；将方法归类为分类、预测、重建和混合学习范式；分析数据挑战、评估标准、性能指标及部署相关问题，构建决策导向框架。
AI.result: 提出了一套结构化参考体系，支持深度学习解决方案在铁路异常检测中的选型与部署，并揭示了实现可靠、可扩展智能监控系统的关键开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为铁路异常检测中深度学习技术的应用提供了系统性指导，有助于推动智能监测系统的工程落地与持续发展。

title: Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Perceptual Quality Assessment and Autonomous Content Adjustment in Augmented Reality
comment: To be published in VRST 2026. Main Manuscript: 12 pages, 5 figures; Supplemental Materials: 7 pages, 10 figures. The accompanying public repository can be accessed by visiting https://github.com/Duke-I3T-Lab/RateAR
summary: Advancements in augmented reality (AR) continue to foster innovative solutions, facilitating novel methodologies within educational systems, healthcare delivery, and risk-mitigation protocols. However, optimizing for end-user immersion and comfort remains challenging, as AR head-mounted displays contend with constrained scene geometry, spatial jitter, and temporal instability. User studies are the standard AR evaluation method for visual quality, but their cost, diminishing scalability, and inflexibility pose bottlenecks during iterative application design. To address this problem, we present an automated framework for AR content evaluation and refinement, built on vision-language models (VLMs), to evaluate and predict the visual fidelity of AR scenes as perceived by users. First, we introduce RateAR, a benchmark of AR images and videos collected across diverse scenes and environmental conditions, with good-to-excellent reliability (ICC(2,5) >= .90) across perceptual factors, including object placement, scale, and shadow consistency. Subsequently, we evaluate eleven commercial VLMs on the crafted benchmark. Results support that VLM-based quality predictions strongly correlate with human subjective judgments, achieving Spearman's rank-order correlations of up to 0.8695. An ablation study further suggests that, compared to other prompting strategies, our contextual prompting yields better alignment with human ratings while balancing introduced complexity cues. Building on these findings, we construct an automated AR content adjustment system and conduct a 21-participant user study. More than 90% of participants found that the system improved placement and size coherence of virtual content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的自动化AR内容评估与优化框架，旨在解决传统用户研究在成本、可扩展性和灵活性上的局限。作者构建了名为RateAR的AR图像与视频基准数据集，具有高可靠性（ICC(2,5) ≥ 0.90），并评估了11个商用VLMs在该数据集上的表现，结果显示VLM预测与人类主观评价高度相关（斯皮尔曼相关系数最高达0.8695）。通过消融实验发现，上下文提示策略能更好对齐人类评分。基于此，研究进一步构建了自动化AR内容调整系统，并通过21名参与者的研究验证，超过90%的用户认为该系统提升了虚拟内容的位置与尺度一致性。
AI.motivation: 传统AR评估依赖用户研究，存在成本高、可扩展性差和灵活性不足的问题，难以支持迭代设计。需要一种高效、自动化的评估方法来提升AR内容质量。
AI.method: 构建RateAR基准数据集，收集多样场景下的AR图像与视频；评估11个商用视觉-语言模型在该数据集上的表现；采用上下文提示策略进行质量预测；基于模型输出构建自动化内容调整系统，并进行用户实验验证。
AI.result: VLM在预测AR视觉质量方面与人类主观判断高度相关（最高Spearman相关系数0.8695）；上下文提示优于其他提示策略；自动化系统被超过90%的参与者认为有效提升了虚拟内容的放置与尺度一致性。
AI.conclusion: 基于视觉-语言模型的自动化评估框架能够有效替代传统用户研究，实现对AR内容视觉质量的高效、准确预测与优化，为AR应用的快速迭代设计提供了可行路径。

title: Agent Evaluation Reliability: More Tasks Won't (Always) Fix An Agent Leaderboard
summary: Agent evaluations are increasingly used to compare LLMs and inform deployment decisions, yet ranks can reflect not only the model but also the effects of the evaluation conditions such as the scaffolds or tasks. This makes reliability claim-dependent: an evaluation that reliably ranks deployed systems may not reliably rank underlying models. We ask which conclusions current agent evaluations reliably support and what additional evaluation would improve them. We develop a Bayesian variance-decomposition framework for sparse, imbalanced agent leaderboards and apply it to 22 benchmarks from the Holistic Agent Leaderboard and Harbor Index. The framework separates signal, performance differences relevant to the intended claim, from noise, irrelevant variation that can still change rankings. We find: (1) Reliability depends on the measurement goal. Fixed model-scaffold systems are ranked reliably (0.935-0.994), while underlying-model reliability is substantially lower (0.148-0.841). (2) Scaffold choice can change conclusions. Inter-scaffold reliability measures whether scaffolds preserve model rankings, showing that scaffold effects vary substantially across evaluations. (3) More tasks cannot resolve all uncertainty. Even infinitely many similarly constructed tasks improve model-ranking reliability of a benchmark by at most 0.097 when uncertainty is dominated by limited scaffold coverage. (4) Pooling diverse benchmarks can improve cross-task rankings at lower cost. For rankings across diverse agentic tasks, pooling benchmarks raises projected reliability from 0.44 to 0.75 at the same task budget and can reduce projected cost by up to 83\%. Evaluation design should follow the intended claim: identify what a score or ranking should mean, diagnose what limits its reliability, and spend evaluation budget on the sources of uncertainty that matter.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种贝叶斯方差分解框架，用于分析稀疏、不平衡的智能体排行榜，以评估不同评价条件对模型排名可靠性的影响。研究发现：固定模型-支架系统排名可靠（0.935-0.994），而底层模型排名可靠性较低（0.148-0.841）；支架选择显著影响结论；增加任务数量对提升可靠性有限；整合多样基准可更高效提升跨任务排名可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体评估中，排名可能受评价条件如支架或任务设计的影响，导致结论依赖于具体评估设置，难以真实反映模型性能。因此需要明确评估目标并识别限制可靠性的因素。
AI.method: 开发贝叶斯方差分解框架，应用于22个来自Holistic Agent Leaderboard和Harbor Index的基准测试，分离信号（与目标相关的性能差异）与噪声（无关变异）。
AI.result: 1. 评估目标决定可靠性：固定系统排名可靠，底层模型则不一致；2. 支架选择显著改变结论；3. 增加相似任务对提升可靠性帮助有限；4. 池化多样化基准可显著提高跨任务排名可靠性并降低成本。
AI.conclusion: 评估设计应根据预期结论来制定：明确评分或排名的意义，诊断其可靠性瓶颈，并将评估预算投入到真正影响结果的不确定性来源上。

title: Verbalized and Internal Probabilities Are Coupled in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models carry an internal notion of uncertainty in their sampling distribution, i.e., the probabilities they place on generating one answer rather than another. They can also be asked to state a confidence, in words or as a number: a verbalized uncertainty. Prior work suggests that internal probabilities track relative frequencies in the training data, and that verbalized probabilities track explicit probabilistic assertions in the training data. However, we do not know whether these two readouts are aligned, except when frequencies and probabilistic assertions in the training data happen to align. This limits our understanding of when we can use verbalized uncertainties as a proxy for either training data frequencies, or a model's internal distribution. We resolve this gap by systematically exploring how LLMs probability readouts are impacted by training and in-context data, via intervening on the underlying uncertainty sources in the data. We find that both internal and verbalized probability readouts are impacted by both distributional and asserted uncertainty in the training data. Further, we find that verbalized and internal probabilities are aligned beyond what would be expected by independently tracking the same uncertainty sources, suggesting that verbalized probabilities can be used to probe a model's internal distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）内部概率分布与口头表达的不确定性之间的关系，发现两者均受训练数据中分布性和陈述性不确定性的共同影响，并且二者表现出超出独立追踪同一不确定性来源的对齐程度，表明口头表达的不确定性可作为探测模型内部分布的有效工具。
AI.motivation: 当前对大语言模型内部不确定性与其口头表达的不确定性是否一致缺乏系统理解，尤其在训练数据中的频率与概率陈述不一致时，难以判断口头不确定性是否可作为内部分布的可靠代理。
AI.method: 通过干预训练数据和上下文数据中的不确定性来源，系统地考察大语言模型在不同条件下的内部概率读出和口头概率读出表现，分析其对分布性和陈述性不确定性的响应。
AI.result: 内部概率和口头概率读出均受到训练数据中分布性和陈述性不确定性的显著影响；更重要的是，两者表现出强于独立追踪同一来源预期的对齐性，说明口头表达的不确定性可有效反映模型内部状态。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的口头不确定性读出不仅反映了训练数据中的概率陈述，还能与内部概率分布高度对齐，因此可作为探查模型内部不确定性的有效手段。

title: Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment
summary: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. Here, we introduce ZeNOVA, a stable and efficient initial noise alignment method in a gradient-free manner. Specifically, we address existing algorithms' major challenge in black-box scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Extensive experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA outperforms all evaluated zeroth-order baselines by optimizing the initial noise toward higher rewards substantially more stably while exploiting the geometry of the Gaussian prior, demonstrating its practical applicability to various black-box reward alignment.

AI.tldr: ZeNOVA 是一种在无梯度情况下稳定高效优化初始噪声的方法，通过退火软值引导、流形约束的超球面 Langevin 动力学和 Metropolis-Hastings 跳跃，在图像和视频生成模型上显著优于现有零阶基线方法，适用于多种黑箱奖励对齐场景。
AI.motivation: 现有基于初始噪声优化的方法依赖一阶梯度信息，在黑箱奖励场景中不适用或不稳定、低效，亟需一种无需梯度信息的稳定高效方法。
AI.method: 采用退火软值引导、流形约束的超球面 Langevin 动力学以及 Metropolis-Hastings 跳跃机制，实现无梯度条件下的初始噪声优化。
AI.result: 在图像和视频生成模型上的实验表明，ZeNOVA 在黑箱奖励对齐任务中显著提升了初始噪声优化的稳定性与效率，有效利用了高斯先验的几何结构。
AI.conclusion: ZeNOVA 为黑箱奖励对齐提供了一种高效且稳定的初始噪声优化方案，具有广泛的实际应用潜力。

title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
comment: 29 pages, 22 figures, including references and appendix; 9 pages of main text
summary: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.

AI.tldr: SemanTok是一种灵活的视频分词器，通过将冻结的DINO特征输入编码器，并添加轻量级头来从保留的令牌前缀中重建这些特征，实现了高语义对齐和视频保真度。相比现有方法，SemanTok在不同规模的自回归模型中均表现出色，201M参数的SemanTok模型性能超过3.4倍大小的VideoFlexTok模型，且在分布外类别上仍保持良好语义对齐，生成质量更优，同时预测成本更低。
AI.motivation: 现有灵活视频分词器仅在解码器早期隐藏状态上应用表示对齐损失，但解码器可能从噪声输入中部分满足该目标，导致语义对齐不足。因此需要一种能更有效实现语义对齐并提升视频保真度的新分词器。
AI.method: SemanTok采用冻结的DINO特征作为输入，通过轻量级头部从每个保留的令牌前缀中重建这些特征，以增强语义对齐；其灵活的粗到细结构使早期令牌携带全局语义，后期令牌细化细节。
AI.result: SemanTok在各种自回归模型规模下均表现优异：201M模型性能优于3.4倍大小的VideoFlexTok模型，更大的模型进一步提升保真度；在分布外类别、不同噪声水平下均保持高语义对齐；重建与生成任务表现良好，短令牌前缀预测成本低，生成细节更清晰。
AI.conclusion: SemanTok通过引入基于DINO特征的重建机制，显著提升了视频分词器的语义对齐能力和生成质量，同时保持高效性，是当前视频世界模型中极具潜力的分词方案。

title: When More Data Is Not Enough: The Context-Sufficiency Frontier in Generative AI Personalization
comment: PREPRINT - SUBMITTED TO JOURNAL OF SERVICE RESEARCH (JSR)
summary: Personalization has long relied on customer data to infer what an individual is likely to value. We call this customer evidence: the customer's historical behavior and preferences. Generative AI extends personalization by allowing providers to supply changing situational information at the moment a response is produced, without encoding every condition in advance. We define this provider-side context as information about what is possible, permitted, or advisable now. This flexibility creates a new problem: once context becomes easy to supply, more is not necessarily better. We develop a theory of context sufficiency in which the relevance of context to the customer's current intent matters more than its volume. The theory identifies four states, insufficiency, sufficiency, saturation, and interference, and introduces the Context-Sufficiency Frontier to locate the minimal relevant set. In a full-factorial experiment with a generative recommender at a large home-furnishing retailer, relevant context improved appropriateness, while irrelevant context reduced it and destabilized retrieval. The framework shifts personalization from supplying more context toward identifying what the current interaction actually requires and enforcing constraints throughout the service process.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了生成式AI如何改变个性化推荐，提出context sufficiency理论，强调相关性比数量更重要。通过实验发现，相关上下文提升推荐恰当性，无关上下文则降低效果并扰乱检索。研究提出上下文充分性边界，指导在服务过程中识别并约束所需信息。
AI.motivation: 传统个性化依赖客户数据，而生成式AI使提供实时情境信息成为可能，但过多或不相关的上下文反而影响效果，因此需要新理论来界定何时‘足够’，避免冗余与干扰。
AI.method: 提出上下文充分性理论，定义四种状态（不足、充足、过载、干扰），构建上下文充分性边界框架，并通过大规模家居零售商的全因子实验验证其有效性。
AI.result: 实验证明，相关上下文显著提升推荐的恰当性；无关上下文则降低恰当性并导致检索不稳定。框架有效指导个性化系统从追求更多上下文转向精准识别当前交互所需信息。
AI.conclusion: 个性化应从增加上下文转向识别必要且相关的上下文，通过约束机制确保服务过程的高效与稳定。该理论为生成式AI时代的个性化提供了新的设计原则。

title: VERITYGATE: A Four-Gate Schema-Level Faithfulness Framework and Paired Benchmark for Grounded LLM Narrations over Structured Evidence
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/sachinkg12/yukti/releases/tag/veritygate-groundlm-2026-v1.0.0 Supplementary artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22668710
summary: Fluent LLM explanations may not follow the evidence from a structured system. We present VERITYGATE, a four-gate checker for declared evidence IDs, entities, numbers, and claim types. It checks a fixed schema; it does not verify every fact in the prose. At r=0 and r=1, we test 900 instances per setting (450 grounded-ungrounded pairs) with GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.3-70B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Under this schema-level contract and before repair, 80.3% of mini claims and 47.9% of Sonnet claims fail. These are verifier rejection rates, not prose-hallucination rates. One repair pass raises claim survival from 19.7% to 28.0% for mini and from 52.1% to 54.3% for Sonnet. Verified claims per example change by +0.14 for mini, -0.71 for Llama, and -0.47 for Sonnet, so survival and output volume must be reported together. A second Sonnet pass gives no clear gain. At r=1, Gate 4 covers 97.0%, 98.7%, and 100% of failing claims for mini, Llama, and Sonnet. Small human studies support the rules but show gaps between schema checks and correct prose. A domain-specific GPT-4o judge test shows an order effect, so it is only a usefulness check. We release the code and data.

AI.tldr: VERITYGATE 是一个四门检查器，用于验证声明中的证据ID、实体、数字和声明类型是否符合预定义模式。在未修复的情况下，GPT-4o-mini 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 的验证失败率分别为80.3%和47.9%。一次修复后，GPT-4o-mini 的声明存活率从19.7%提升至28.0%，Sonnet 从52.1%提升至54.3%。但输出数量变化不一，需同时报告存活率与输出量。二轮修复对 Sonnet 无明显增益。门4覆盖了绝大多数失败案例（97%-100%）。小规模人工研究支持规则有效性，但发现模式检查与正确叙述之间仍存在差距。领域特定的 GPT-4o 判定测试显示顺序效应，仅作为有用性参考。代码与数据已公开。
AI.motivation: 确保大语言模型生成的解释遵循结构化系统的证据，防止因脱离证据而产生误导性陈述，提高可信度与一致性。
AI.method: 提出 VERITYGATE 四门检查系统，分别验证证据ID、实体、数值和声明类型是否符合固定模式；通过多轮修复与评估，分析不同模型在验证失败后的表现，并结合人工与自动评估进行综合分析。
AI.result: 在 r=0 和 r=1 条件下，未经修复时多数声明被拒绝；一次修复可提升存活率，但效果有限且模型间差异显著；第二轮修复对 Sonnet 无效；门4能覆盖绝大多数失败案例；人工研究显示模式检查与正确叙述间存在差距。
AI.conclusion: VERITYGATE 能有效识别并部分修复基于结构化证据的生成错误，但需同时监控声明存活率与输出量。其有效性依赖于严格模式约束，且需进一步优化修复机制以弥合模式与自然语言表达之间的鸿沟。代码与数据已开源，供后续研究使用。

title: MoRA: MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable parameter scaling with limited per-token computation by activating only a small subset of experts for each token, but deploying them still requires loading the complete expert pool into memory. Structured expert pruning can effectively reduce the memory usage by removing experts. However, existing pruning methods either use expert ranking criteria that are not well aligned with model performance or rely on effective expert subset searching that is computationally expensive. Moreover, these methods typically overlook the routing-behavior redundancy among the retained experts. In this paper, we propose MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation (MoRA), a framework for structured MoE expert pruning. We introduce a learnable router bias for each expert and optimize these biases by minimizing the language-modeling loss and a routing-diversity regularizer. The learned router biases sharpen the routing probability distributions to identify experts critical to model performance while encouraging the selection of experts with diverse routing preferences. In addition, we introduce an expert approximation mechanism as a post-pruning enhancement. It leverages the remaining experts to approximate the outputs of pruned experts by affine transformation, further improving the performance of the pruned model. We evaluate MoRA on Qwen3-30B-A3B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Moonlight-16B-A3B, removing 25\% and 50\% of the routed experts in each MoE layer. Extensive experiments on nine zero-shot benchmarks show that MoRA outperforms state-of-the-art pruning algorithms. Our code will be released.

AI.tldr: MoRA提出一种新的结构化MoE专家剪枝框架，通过可学习的路由器偏置和专家近似机制，在减少内存占用的同时保持模型性能。该方法优化路由器偏置以增强路由多样性并识别关键专家，并在剪枝后利用剩余专家通过仿射变换近似被剪除专家的输出，从而提升模型表现。在多个大模型上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE专家剪枝方法存在路由行为冗余未考虑、剪枝标准与模型性能不一致或搜索最优专家子集计算开销大的问题，亟需更高效且性能更优的剪枝方案。
AI.method: 引入可学习的路由器偏置，联合语言建模损失与路由多样性正则项进行优化；设计专家近似机制，利用剩余专家对剪除专家进行仿射变换近似输出。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Moonlight-16B-A3B上剪除25%和50%专家后，于九个零样本基准测试中均优于现有先进剪枝算法，显著提升性能与效率平衡。
AI.conclusion: MoRA通过路由偏置学习与专家近似有效实现了高效且高性能的结构化专家剪枝，为MoE模型部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio
summary: Recent joint audio-video generative models can synthesize realistic videos with synchronized sound, but typically generate audio as a single mixed track. This limits source-level control and differs from practical audiovisual workflows, where speech, music, sound effects, and ambient sounds are represented as separate editable tracks. We introduce Soundwich, a training-free framework that transforms a frozen joint audio-video flow-matching model into a generator of multiple synchronized, independently editable audio stems coupled to a shared video. Soundwich generates separate audio stems with explicit control over their temporal activity. To keep separately generated sounds coherent, we introduce a shared scene representation that communicates global audiovisual context across stems while preserving their source-level separation. We further route cross-modal interactions between each audio stem and its corresponding visual source, improving audiovisual consistency. The resulting stems remain synchronized with the video and can be independently retimed, muted, replaced, or remixed. Experiments and human evaluations show improved temporal control, source separation, and naturalness, while enabling flexible source-level editing within coherent audiovisual generation. Code is available at https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich.

AI.tldr: Soundwich 是一个无需训练的框架，将现有的联合音视频生成模型转变为可生成多个同步、可独立编辑的音频音轨（如语音、音乐、音效等）并匹配同一视频的系统。它通过共享场景表示来保持音轨间的协调性，并在每个音轨与对应视觉源之间进行跨模态交互，从而实现时间上的精确控制和自然的音视频一致性。实验和人类评估表明，该方法在源分离、时间控制和自然度方面表现优异，支持灵活的音轨级编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型通常只输出单一混合音频轨道，缺乏对声音来源的独立控制，无法满足实际音视频制作中对语音、音乐、音效等分轨编辑的需求。因此需要一种能够在不重新训练模型的前提下，实现多音轨生成与独立编辑的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Soundwich 框架，利用冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型，通过引入共享场景表示来传递全局音视频上下文，同时保持各音频音轨的源级分离；并通过跨模态路由机制，使每条音频音轨与其对应的视觉内容进行交互，确保音视频一致性。
AI.result: 成功生成了多个与视频同步、可独立调整时间、静音、替换或混音的音频音轨；在主观评测中表现出更高的自然度、更好的源分离效果和更强的时间控制能力。
AI.conclusion: Soundwich 实现了在不训练模型的情况下，对音视频生成过程中的多音轨进行灵活且一致的源级编辑，为实际应用中的音视频创作提供了强大的工具支持。

title: Backdoor Containment via Expert Quarantine and Shutdown in LLMs
summary: Backdoored large language models (LLMs) can behave normally on benign inputs while producing attacker-specified outputs under hidden triggers. Existing defenses span four stages--prior-training, in-training, post-training, and inference-time--and share one of two underlying strategies: either suppress backdoor learning (by filtering poisoned data or interrupting its acquisition during optimization) or learn, then purify (by repairing model weights or gating inputs after a fully backdoored model has formed). We propose a third strategy, learn, but channel: allow backdoor formation during training but route it into a designated, quarantined component that can be disabled at deployment. To this end, we propose Quarantined Expert Shutdown QES, a computationally efficient containment strategy built in a regularization-steered MoE-like setting. Specifically, given a poisoned dataset, QES augments a Transformer-based language model with routed expert-specific LoRA branches and lightweight routers, and uses auxiliary routing objectives to attract trigger-conditioned behavior into a designated expert while preserving benign capability elsewhere. At deployment, mitigation reduces to a single constant-time operation: zeroing the quarantined expert's routing weight, without trigger screening or further updating model weights. Empirically, our methods reduce the attack success rate ASR from 100% to 0-10% on most settings across two tasks, three attacks, and four model families, while downstream utility is often preserved or only modestly affected. These results establish learn, but channel as a previously unexplored regime for backdoor containment in generative LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为QES（Quarantined Expert Shutdown）的新策略，允许后门在训练期间形成，但将其引导至一个指定的隔离组件中，可在部署时通过简单操作禁用，从而实现高效防御。该方法基于类似MoE的结构，引入专家级LoRA分支和轻量级路由器，并通过辅助路由目标将触发条件下的行为吸引到特定专家，同时保持正常功能。部署时仅需将隔离专家的路由权重置零，无需触发筛选或模型权重更新。实验表明，该方法在多种任务、攻击类型和模型家族中将攻击成功率从100%降至0-10%，且对下游任务性能影响较小。
AI.motivation: 现有后门防御策略主要集中在抑制后门学习或训练后修复，但存在效率或效果局限。本文旨在探索一种新范式：允许后门形成，但通过机制将其隔离并可快速关闭，以提升防御灵活性与效率。
AI.method: 提出QES框架，基于Transformer架构，引入专家级LoRA分支与轻量级路由器，利用辅助路由目标引导触发行为进入指定专家；部署时通过置零该专家的路由权重实现快速防御。
AI.result: 在多个任务、攻击方式和模型上，攻击成功率为0-10%，显著降低；下游任务性能基本保持或仅有轻微下降，证明该方法有效且高效。
AI.conclusion: learn, but channel 是一种全新的后门防御范式，在生成式大语言模型中具有可行性与优势，为后门防护提供了更灵活、高效的解决方案。

title: Contextual trajectory and incremental contextual displacement: Towards using LLMs to understand dynamic, utterance-specific meaning construction
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) such as RoBERTa represent text using contextual word embeddings (CWEs), which alter the embeddings associated with each token based on surrounding context. We construct token-wise incremental trajectories by repeatedly recomputing a token's CWE as successive words are added to a sentence, yielding a representation of how contextualized embeddings evolve as the utterance unfolds. We evaluate this approach using garden-path sentences as a test case with characteristic features. Token-wise trajectories reproduce known features of garden-path processing, including disruption around the critical region, and reliably distinguish garden-path sentences from matched disambiguated controls. We introduce several metrics for quantifying representational displacement across contextual increments and show that trajectory information can be highly predictive of sentence type. We find that ambiguity-related information is recoverable not only from the sentence-level CLS representation but also from ordinary vocabulary tokens, suggesting that utterance-level information is distributed across multiple representational scales. In exploratory analyses, we find qualitatively similar trajectory structures in other ambiguity- and misdirection-related linguistic phenomena. Together, these results establish token-wise incremental trajectories as a promising framework for studying utterance-specific meaning construction using LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过重复计算句子中逐个添加词语时的上下文词嵌入（CWE），构建词汇级别的增量轨迹，以研究语言模型在语句展开过程中表示的演变。该方法在花园路径句等具有典型特征的句子中表现良好，能有效区分歧义句与消歧对照句，并揭示了歧义信息不仅存在于句级表示，也分布于普通词汇标记中。探索性分析显示该轨迹结构在其他歧义和误导性语言现象中也存在。
AI.motivation: 为了理解大型语言模型如何动态构建语句意义，特别是处理歧义和误解情境下的表示演化过程，需要一种能够追踪上下文变化对词嵌入影响的方法。
AI.method: 通过逐步向句子中添加词语并重新计算每个词的上下文词嵌入（CWE），生成词汇级别的增量轨迹；利用这些轨迹分析花园路径句等复杂句式的表征变化，并引入多种量化指标评估表示位移。
AI.result: 增量轨迹能准确反映花园路径处理中的认知中断现象，可靠区分歧义句与对照句；轨迹信息对预测句子类型具有高度预测力；歧义相关的信息可从普通词汇标记中恢复，表明语境信息分布在多个表示层级上。
AI.conclusion: 词汇级别的增量轨迹为研究基于大语言模型的语句特定意义构建提供了一个有前景的新框架，有助于深入理解语言理解和推理的动态机制。

title: M$^2$Weather: A Benchmark for Joint Multi-Station and Multi-Variable Weather Forecasting
summary: Station weather forecasting is fundamentally shaped by both complex spatial dependencies across stations and strong physical coupling among weather variables. However, existing studies often consider these relationships separately and use different datasets and experimental settings, hindering systematic assessment of their individual and joint contributions. In this paper, we introduce $M^2$Weather, a benchmark for joint multi-station and multi-variable weather forecasting. Through multi-criteria quality control and station stratification, we collect 2,809 high-quality stations with 5 physically coupled weather variables across three spatial scales: France, Europe, and Global. This multi-scale design lets us examine whether conclusions persist from national to global station networks. We also introduce unified training and evaluation protocols to enable fair comparison of different station-variable modeling paradigms. To further examine the benefits of modeling station-variable relationships, we design a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter. With a trained weather forecasting model, this adapter can introduce missing station or variable relationships without retraining the model. This enables fair and efficient investigation of station-variable relationships. Systematic evaluation of 16 representative models shows the benefits of jointly modeling station and variable relationships. Completing missing relationships further reduces MSE for all adapted models on all three datasets. Together, these results identify the complementary information across stations and variables as an important resource for improving station weather forecasting. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/hnu-vis/M2-Weather.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M²Weather基准，用于联合多站多变量天气预报。通过多标准质量控制和站点分层，收集了2,809个高质量站点的5个物理耦合气象变量，覆盖法国、欧洲和全球三个空间尺度。统一训练与评估协议支持不同建模范式的公平比较，并引入轻量级可插拔适配器，无需重新训练即可引入缺失的站点或变量关系。16个代表性模型的系统评估表明，联合建模站点与变量关系能显著提升预报性能，填补缺失关系后所有模型在三组数据上的均方误差均降低，证明站点与变量间互补信息对提升预报精度至关重要。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将站点间复杂空间依赖和气象变量间的强物理耦合关系分开处理，使用不同数据集和实验设置，难以系统评估其单独及联合贡献。为克服这一局限，需要一个统一、多尺度、多变量的基准平台来公平评估不同建模方法的性能。
AI.method: 构建M²Weather基准数据集，涵盖2,809个高质量站点，5个物理耦合气象变量，覆盖法国、欧洲、全球三个空间尺度；采用多标准质量控制与站点分层策略；设计统一训练与评估协议；提出轻量级可插拔适配器，可在不重训模型的前提下引入缺失的站点-变量关系，实现高效、公平的对比分析。
AI.result: 16个代表性模型的系统评估显示，联合建模站点与变量关系显著提升预报性能；通过适配器补全缺失关系后，所有模型在三个数据集上的均方误差（MSE）均进一步下降，验证了站点与变量间互补信息的价值。
AI.conclusion: 站点间空间依赖与变量间物理耦合所蕴含的互补信息是提升站点天气预报性能的重要资源，联合建模二者关系具有显著优势，且可通过轻量适配器高效实现。该研究为未来天气预报模型的设计提供了重要参考。

title: FedMAD: Modulation-Aware Directional Aggregation for Federated Learning in Remote Sensing Image Classification
summary: Federated learning (FL) has recently attracted increasing attention in remote sensing (RS) since it enables collaborative model training across decentralized RS image archives without requiring direct access to local data. However, FL performance significantly degrades when the data distributions between clients are heterogeneous, which often occurs due to geographical differences, seasonal changes, and varying image acquisition and atmospheric conditions. To address this challenge, in this letter, we propose a novel personalized FL framework (denoted as FedMAD) for RS image classification problems. The proposed framework separates globally shared representation parameters from client-specific adaptation parameters to preserve client-specific features while maintaining globally transferable representations. This is achieved by integrating lightweight modulation modules and local batch normalization layers into the backbone network. Although globally shared parameters are collaboratively optimized between clients, client-specific parameters remain local to preserve domain-specific feature characteristics. In addition, FedMAD introduces a modulation-aware directional aggregation strategy that dynamically adjusts the importance of aggregation for each client according to the alignment of local modulation updates. This allows the global optimization process to suppress conflicting client updates originating from heterogeneous data distributions while enhancing the contribution of clients with consistent adaptation behaviors. The experimental results obtained on the BigEarthNet-S2 and EuroSAT datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedMAD compared to state-of-the-art FL algorithms under heterogeneous RS data distributions. The code of the proposed framework will be publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/fedmad.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为FedMAD的新个性化联邦学习框架，用于解决遥感图像分类中因数据分布异质性导致的性能下降问题。该框架通过分离全局共享参数与客户端特定适应参数，并引入轻量级调制模块和局部批量归一化层，保留客户端特有特征的同时保持可迁移的全局表示。此外，采用调制感知的方向聚合策略，动态调整各客户端在聚合中的权重，抑制来自异质数据分布的冲突更新，增强一致适应行为客户端的贡献。实验表明，在BigEarthNet-S2和EuroSAT数据集上，FedMAD优于现有先进联邦学习算法。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像数据在地理、季节、成像条件等方面存在显著差异，导致联邦学习中数据分布异质性严重，影响模型性能。现有方法难以有效处理此类异质性，因此需要一种能兼顾全局协作与个性化表达的新型联邦学习框架。
AI.method: 提出FedMAD框架，将模型参数分为全局共享表示参数与客户端特定适应参数；在主干网络中嵌入轻量级调制模块和本地批量归一化层以实现特征解耦；设计调制感知的方向性聚合策略，根据本地调制更新的一致性动态调整客户端贡献权重。
AI.result: 在BigEarthNet-S2和EuroSAT数据集上的实验结果表明，FedMAD在异质遥感数据分布下显著优于现有主流联邦学习方法，提升了模型准确率与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FedMAD通过分离全局与局部参数并引入智能聚合机制，有效应对遥感图像联邦学习中的数据异质性挑战，为个性化建模提供了高效解决方案。代码已公开，便于复现与应用。

title: A Simple Doxastic Deontic Logic for Norm-Guided Decision Making
comment: Manuscript accepted at PRIMA 2026. Includes an additional appendix with proofs
summary: Making decisions despite conflicting norms and incomplete or unreliable information is a fundamental challenge for autonomous systems. We introduce a simple doxastic deontic logic for this setting: a classically reducible fragment of Chellas' Minimal Deontic Logic, extended with explicit conditional norms and combined with multi-agent KD45, so that norms can depend on agents' beliefs about both facts and norms. On this logic we define the Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem, where an agent chooses a decision minimizing weighted norm violations. We distinguish subjective optimization (relative to the agent's beliefs) from objective optimization (relative to the actual facts). We give conditions under which (i) the two coincide and (ii) optimal decision-making can be reduced to weighted partial MaxSAT in polynomial time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种简化的信念道义逻辑，用于处理自主系统在规范冲突、信息不全或不可靠情况下的决策问题。该逻辑是Chellas最小道义逻辑的可经典归约片段，扩展了条件规范，并与多智能体KD45结合，使规范依赖于智能体对事实和规范的信念。在此基础上定义了信念规范合规优化问题，即智能体选择最小化加权规范违反的决策。区分主观优化（基于智能体信念）与客观优化（基于实际事实），并给出两者一致的条件，以及将最优决策简化为多项式时间内的加权部分MaxSAT的条件。
AI.motivation: 自主系统在面对冲突规范、不完整或不可靠信息时难以做出合理决策，需要一种能够融合信念与规范的逻辑框架来支持决策优化。
AI.method: 提出一种可经典归约的信念道义逻辑，结合条件规范与多智能体KD45模型，构建规范依赖于信念的系统；定义信念规范合规优化问题，并分析主观与客观优化的关系；通过形式化条件将问题转化为加权部分MaxSAT求解。
AI.result: 给出了主观与客观优化一致的充分条件，并证明在特定条件下，最优决策问题可在多项式时间内通过加权部分MaxSAT求解。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的逻辑框架有效支持了在不确定性与规范冲突情境下的智能体决策，实现了从复杂道义推理到可计算优化问题的转化，为自主系统提供了理论与实践基础。

title: Child-Adapted Structured Phonological Representations for Interpretable Speech Sound Analysis
summary: Structured phonological representations provide an interpretable alternative to generic speech embeddings, but existing models are largely trained on adult speech. We adapt PhonoQ-2.0 to child speech using CHILDES-Aligned data and compare three alignment-supervision conditions (Adult, Adult+Child, and Child-only) across two initialization strategies (Adult PhonoQ and scratch). Generalization is evaluated against manual child-speech annotations. On 1,352 consonant targets from 58 typically developing children, child-speech adaptation improves voicing recognition across all supervision conditions, from 0.922 macro-F1 for Adult PhonoQ to 0.972--0.987 after adaptation. Manner is more sensitive to alignment supervision: Adult+Child MFA reaches 0.804 and 0.796, compared to approximately 0.70 under Adult MFA supervision. Place remains comparatively strong across systems (0.871--0.902), although per-class performance varies substantially. The velar-fronting contrast is preserved across all seven model variants. Longitudinal UltraPhonix analysis further reveals speaker-specific velar and post-alveolar changes that are largely preserved across models and broadly consistent with reported clinical progress.

AI.tldr: 该研究将PhonoQ-2.0模型适应于儿童语音，利用CHILDES-Aligned数据，在三种对齐监督条件下（成人、成人+儿童、仅儿童）评估其在两种初始化策略（成人PhonoQ和随机初始化）下的表现。在58名典型发育儿童的1,352个辅音目标上，儿童语音适应显著提升了发音识别性能，尤其在声带振动识别方面，从0.922的宏平均F1提升至0.972–0.987。发音方式对对齐监督更敏感，成人+儿童监督下达到0.804和0.796，而仅成人监督下约为0.70。发音部位表现相对稳定（0.871–0.902），但类别间差异明显。所有模型均保持了软腭音与前部音的对比。纵向UltraPhonix分析显示，各模型均能捕捉到个体发声者在软腭和齿龈后音上的变化，与临床进展基本一致。
AI.motivation: 现有语音表示模型多基于成人语音训练，缺乏对儿童语音的有效建模；为提升儿童语音识别的准确性与可解释性，需专门针对儿童语音进行模型适应与评估。
AI.method: 采用CHILDES-Aligned数据对PhonoQ-2.0模型进行儿童语音适应，比较三种对齐监督条件（成人、成人+儿童、仅儿童）与两种初始化策略（成人PhonoQ、随机初始化）的表现，并通过人工标注的儿童语音数据评估泛化能力。
AI.result: 儿童语音适应显著提升声带振动识别性能（0.922 → 0.972–0.987），发音方式在成人+儿童监督下表现最佳（0.804/0.796），发音部位整体稳健（0.871–0.902），软腭-前部音对比得以保留，纵向分析显示模型可有效捕捉个体语音发展变化。
AI.conclusion: 通过儿童语音数据的适配，PhonoQ-2.0在儿童语音识别任务中表现出更强的泛化能力与可解释性，尤其是结合成人+儿童对齐监督时性能最优，且能反映真实语言发展的个体差异。

title: When Do Attention-Head Ablations Support Causal Claims? Projection-Level Confounds, Floor Effects, and Matched Controls
comment: Code available in the accompanying repository. 2 figures
summary: Attention-head ablation, zeroing a head and measuring the resulting change in task performance, is a common method for inferring which components of a language model are causally responsible for a behavior. We show using GPT-2 small that this inference can be fragile unless the intervention semantics, evaluation metric, and controls are carefully validated. A natural post-projection implementation of "zeroing a head" is nearly uncorrelated with a corrected pre-projection ablation (Pearson r = 0.057) and selects a completely disjoint top-5 set of important heads. We also show that binary accuracy can hide effects at behavioral floors and near ceilings, whereas gold-token log-probability remains graded. Using a discovery/held-out split and 1,000 matched random-head and layer-matched-head control draws, the corrected per-head effect ranking is highly stable across splits (Spearman rho = 0.974), and the top-5 selected heads significantly exceed both control distributions (Monte Carlo p = 0.001). However, evidence for task specificity is not robust on GPT-2. Replication on DistilGPT2 preserves the intervention-semantic and matched-control findings. These results show that single-head ablation does not by itself justify a causal claim; defensible interpretation requires correct intervention placement, a non-saturated continuous metric, and matched held-out controls.

AI.tldr: 单头消融实验在推断语言模型行为因果成分时可能不可靠，除非干预语义、评估指标和控制条件经过仔细验证。研究发现，后投影的‘置零’实现与修正的前投影消融相关性极低（皮尔逊r = 0.057），且选出的重要头完全不同。二元准确率会掩盖行为基线或接近饱和时的效果，而黄金标记对数概率则保持连续变化。通过发现/保留分割和1000次随机头及层匹配控制抽样，修正后的每头效应排名具有高度稳定性（斯皮尔曼ρ = 0.974），且前五重要头显著优于控制分布（蒙特卡洛p = 0.001）。但在GPT-2上任务特异性证据并不稳健。在DistilGPT2上的复现验证了干预语义和匹配控制的结果。
AI.motivation: 评估注意力头在语言模型中的因果作用时，现有单头消融方法可能存在误导性，需验证其可靠性。
AI.method: 使用GPT-2 small和DistilGPT2进行注意力头消融实验，比较后投影与前投影置零实现的差异；采用发现/保留分割、1000次随机头与层匹配控制抽样，分析不同评估指标（二元准确率与黄金标记对数概率）下的结果稳定性与显著性。
AI.result: 后投影置零与修正前投影消融相关性极低，所选重要头完全不重合；二元准确率无法有效捕捉极端情况下的性能变化，而对数概率表现更稳定；修正后排名高度稳定，前五重要头显著优于控制组；任务特异性证据在GPT-2上不稳健。
AI.conclusion: 单头消融不能单独支持因果推断，可靠的解释必须依赖正确的干预位置、非饱和的连续评估指标以及匹配的保留控制组。

title: Personalized Image Generation with Reasoning and Reflection
summary: Personalized image generation has remained narrowly focused on conditional synthesis from curated visual exemplars, rather than capturing who a user is. In practice, however, a user's personal context is much richer, comprising reviews, posts, images, captions, and metadata accumulated over time. A truly personalized generator should leverage this history to produce images aligned with the user's lifestyle and aesthetic preferences. To this end, we introduce the first unified benchmark for personalized image generation from user histories. The benchmark comprises two complementary tasks and a multi-axis evaluation protocol that assesses target fidelity, visual quality, user distinguishability, semantic alignment with the user's history, and task-specific utility. Grounded in real-world e-commerce and social media settings, the benchmark includes: (1) Personalized Scene Generation, which places a given object in a scene that reflects a user's preferences and lifestyle, motivated by personalized product presentation; and (2) Personalized Creative Generation, which generates a novel image on a specified topic that is faithful to a user's aesthetic and visual identity, motivated by social media content creation. We further propose PEARL, which couples a multimodal reasoner with a frozen image generator in an interleaved reason-reflect loop optimized with differential data reward. Across both tasks, PEARL outperforms strong baselines, achieving an average improvement of 15% across personalization metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个基于用户历史的个性化图像生成统一基准，包含两个互补任务：个性化场景生成（将指定物体放置在反映用户偏好和生活方式的场景中）与个性化创意生成（生成符合用户审美和视觉身份的新图像）。该基准采用多维度评估协议，涵盖目标保真度、视觉质量、用户可区分性、语义一致性及任务特定效用。研究还提出PEARL模型，通过多模态推理器与冻结图像生成器的交替推理-反思循环，结合微分数据奖励进行优化，在两项任务上均显著优于基线，平均提升15%的个性化指标。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化图像生成主要依赖于精心挑选的视觉样本，未能充分捕捉用户的个人特征。实际中，用户的历史数据（如评论、帖子、图片、标题、元数据等）蕴含丰富的个人上下文信息。因此，需要一种能利用这些长期积累的数据来生成与用户生活方式和审美偏好一致的图像的生成方法。
AI.method: 提出一个统一基准，包含个性化场景生成与个性化创意生成两个任务，并设计多轴评估体系；引入PEARL模型，结合多模态推理器与冻结图像生成器，采用交替推理-反思循环并以微分数据奖励进行优化。
AI.result: PEARL在两个任务上均优于强基线模型，平均在个性化相关指标上提升15%，验证了其在真实电商与社交媒体场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次构建了基于用户历史的个性化图像生成基准，提出的PEARL模型能够有效融合用户长期行为数据，生成更贴近用户真实审美的图像，为个性化内容生成提供了新范式。

title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the AI Data Readiness for Scientific Discovery (AIDaR) Workshop at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Paris
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly underpin scientific AI applications that reason over structured knowledge, from biomedical question answering to materials informatics. However, their logical reasoning often falls short, producing factual inaccuracies unacceptable in these settings. Reliable evaluation remains challenging: manual dataset construction scales poorly, and LLM-based generation risks embedding the very flaws it aims to measure. High-quality benchmarks must ground both correct and incorrect labelled examples in explicit background knowledge, formally verifiable by a standard reasoner. We propose a pipeline that automatically generates ontology-grounded multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks from any sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontology, with correct answers grounded in the ontology by design. Distractors are generated by perturbing the right-hand-side class expressions of class definition axioms, and their incorrectness is formally verified by an OWL reasoner via entailment checks. We evaluate the pipeline on three ontologies: Pizza (small, academic), PMDco (complex, materials science), and DOID (large, biomedical), generating 112, 2,491, and 15,216 MCQs respectively. Distractors span four semantic categories from class unsatisfiability to weakened subsumptions, enabling diagnostic evaluation of specific reasoning failures. Items meet natural language quality standards: mean LLM judge scores of 4.02, 4.36, and 3.36 out of 5 confirm fluency, and correct-answer-to-distractor similarity above 0.8 shows that wrong options cannot be dismissed on surface form alone. Six LLMs evaluated zero-shot achieve 41.1-76.8% accuracy, well above the 25% random-guessing baseline, indicating the benchmarks are challenging and discriminative. This work is a step towards more reliable benchmarks for assessing logical reasoning in scientific AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动从已充分公理化的OWL 2本体生成基于本体的多选题（MCQ）基准测试的流水线，通过扰动类定义公理的右端表达式生成错误选项，并利用OWL推理机进行逻辑蕴含验证以确保其错误性。该方法在三个本体（Pizza、PMDco、DOID）上分别生成了112、2,491和15,216道题目，覆盖四类语义错误类型，具有高自然语言质量与诊断能力。六种大语言模型零样本评估准确率在41.1%-76.8%之间，显著高于随机猜测基线，表明基准具有挑战性和区分度。
AI.motivation: 现有科学AI应用中大语言模型的逻辑推理常出现事实性错误，而高质量评估基准难以构建：人工标注成本高，基于LLM生成又可能引入固有缺陷。因此需要一种能基于显式背景知识、可形式化验证的可靠评测机制。
AI.method: 提出一个自动化流水线，从任意充分公理化的OWL 2本体生成多选题；正确答案由本体直接推导，错误选项通过扰动类定义公理的右部表达式生成，并用OWL推理机进行蕴涵检查以形式化验证其错误性。
AI.result: 在三个不同规模和领域的本体上成功生成了总计17,819道高质量多选题；错误选项涵盖类不一致、弱化子类关系等四种语义类别；自然语言质量评分均超过3.3/5，正确与错误选项间语义相似度高于0.8；六种大语言模型零样本表现优于随机猜测，证明基准具有挑战性与诊断价值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为科学领域中大语言模型的逻辑推理能力评估提供了一种可扩展、可验证且可靠的基准生成方法，是迈向更可信科学AI评测的重要一步。

title: DeBERTa-ConPara: Attack-Aware and Deployment-Realistic Detection of AI-Generated Text
comment: Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (main conference). 9 pages plus appendix. Code and checkpoint: https://github.com/MohamedMady19/deberta-conpara, https://huggingface.co/mohamedmady/deberta-conpara
summary: Robust detection of AI-generated text under deployment conditions is challenging: distribution shifts across domains and generators, adversarial perturbations of the input surface, and the absence of target-domain labels for threshold calibration all degrade detectors that perform well in-domain. We present DeBERTa-ConPara, a deployment-oriented detector combining attack-aware Unicode preprocessing with a contextual transformer encoder trained over HC3 Plus, M4, MAGE and RAID. Our central finding is that preprocessing acts in opposite directions depending on where it is applied: normalising the training corpus deduplicates it, collapsing 35.4% of RAID rows into copies of their clean siblings and deleting the adversarial supervision, whereas normalising at inference is an effective defence. A factorial varying the two placements independently identifies raw training with normalised inference as the best configuration, reaching 99.61% AUROC, 99.01% TPR@5% FPR and 96.57% TPR@1% FPR on the official RAID hidden test, alongside 93.14% average balanced accuracy across HC3 Plus and MAGE under a fixed threshold. The gain is confined to two of twelve attack classes: homoglyph and zero-width-space insertion rise from 11.05% and 1.12% to 96.98%. The same signature reproduces in a zero-shot detector of different architecture, showing the effect belongs to the attacks rather than to our model. We additionally report two negative results: semantic-invariance augmentation through paraphrasing and supervised contrastive learning (ConPara) does not improve the best configuration, and the handcrafted feature-fusion branch is inert in distribution and harmful outside it.

AI.tldr: DeBERTa-ConPara 是一种面向部署的 AI 生成文本检测器，结合了攻击感知的 Unicode 预处理与在 HC3 Plus、M4、MAGE 和 RAID 数据集上训练的上下文变换器编码器。研究发现，预处理的位置至关重要：在训练时标准化会破坏对抗性监督并导致数据重复，而在推理时标准化则能有效防御攻击。最优配置为原始训练 + 推理时标准化，在 RAID 隐藏测试集上达到 99.61% AUROC、99.01% TPR@5% FPR 与 96.57% TPR@1% FPR，且在 HC3 Plus 与 MAGE 上平均平衡准确率达 93.14%。该策略仅显著提升两类攻击（同形异义符和零宽空格插入）的检测性能，从 11.05% 和 1.12% 提升至 96.98%。该效果在不同架构的零样本检测器中可复现，表明其源于攻击特性而非模型设计。此外，语义不变增强与对比学习未带来增益，手工特征融合分支在分布内无效且在分布外有害。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 生成文本检测器在实际部署中表现不佳，受限于领域间分布偏移、输入表面的对抗扰动以及目标域标签缺失导致的阈值校准困难。亟需一种鲁棒性强、适应性强的检测方法以应对真实环境挑战。
AI.method: 提出 DeBERTa-ConPara 检测器，采用攻击感知的 Unicode 预处理策略，并在多源数据集（HC3 Plus, M4, MAGE, RAID）上训练上下文变换器编码器。通过因子实验独立控制预处理在训练与推理阶段的应用，系统评估不同配置的性能。引入语义不变增强与对比学习（ConPara）尝试提升泛化能力，同时构建手工地特征融合分支进行探索。
AI.result: 最优配置（原始训练 + 推理时标准化）在 RAID 隐藏测试集上实现 99.61% AUROC、99.01% TPR@5% FPR 与 96.57% TPR@1% FPR；在 HC3 Plus 与 MAGE 上平均平衡准确率达 93.14%。同形异义符与零宽空格插入攻击的检测率分别从 11.05% 和 1.12% 提升至 96.98%。该优势在零样本检测器中可复现，验证其归因于攻击特性。但语义不变增强、对比学习及特征融合分支均未提升性能，甚至在某些场景下有害。
AI.conclusion: 预处理位置对检测性能具有决定性影响：训练时标准化有害，推理时标准化有效。最佳实践是保留原始训练数据，仅在推理阶段应用标准化。该策略显著提升了对特定对抗攻击的鲁棒性，且不依赖特定模型架构。其他增强方法如对比学习与特征融合未能带来收益，提示应谨慎设计复杂模块。本研究为部署环境中 AI 生成文本检测提供了实用且高效的设计范式。

title: A First Glance at Jev for Network Traffic Classification: Accuracy, Processing Time, and Cost
summary: We evaluate Jev on ten dataset-defined application labels in CESNET-QUICEXT-25 using only the first ten packets' sizes, directions, and inter-packet times. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first empirical study of general-purpose decision models, represented here by Jev, for application classification of network flows. Across 52,000 records from 26 collection weeks following the training period, 40 fixed labeled examples raise Jev's accuracy from 9.80% to 28.42%. Random Forest and Extra Trees trained on 8,000 records achieve 69.95% and 66.80% and outperform Jev in every week. Increasing Jev's context to 150 examples yields 34.50% on the first test week. On a paired 100-record subset, Jev with 40 examples achieves 29% accuracy at a median request time of 0.750 s, versus 37% and 6.036 s for the generative language model OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol with high reasoning effort through Azure; Jev also incurs lower API charges. The paired subset does not establish an accuracy advantage for either service, and the timing reflects different service configurations. Thus, labeled examples substantially improve Jev, but the tested Jev configurations remain less accurate than trained tree ensembles; unequal supervision budgets and fixed configurations prevent attributing the gap to a single cause.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次对通用决策模型Jev在应用分类任务中的表现进行了实证分析，仅使用前10个数据包的大小、方向和间隔时间。结果显示，引入40个标注样本可将准确率从9.80%提升至28.42%，但其性能仍低于随机森林和极端梯度提升树（分别达69.95%和66.80%）。增加上下文至150个样本后，首周准确率为34.50%。在100条记录的配对子集上，Jev以29%准确率和0.75秒中位请求时间表现优于GPT-5.6 Sol（37%准确率，6.036秒），且成本更低。然而，由于监督预算不均与配置固定，无法归因于单一因素。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对通用决策模型在应用分类任务中性能的实证评估，尤其在仅依赖少量初始数据包特征的情况下。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索基于有限信息的模型有效性及其与传统机器学习方法的比较。
AI.method: 采用Jev模型，在CESNET-QUICEXT-25数据集上仅使用前10个数据包的大小、方向和时间间隔进行应用分类；通过引入不同数量的标注样本（40或150）测试其性能变化，并与随机森林、极端梯度提升树及GPT-5.6 Sol进行对比，评估准确率、响应时间和成本开销。
AI.result: 引入40个标注样本使Jev准确率从9.80%提升至28.42%，增加至150个样本时首周准确率达34.50%。在100条记录的子集上，Jev达到29%准确率，中位请求时间为0.75秒，优于GPT-5.6 Sol（37%准确率，6.036秒），且API费用更低。但总体而言，训练好的树集成模型仍显著优于所有Jev配置。
AI.conclusion: 尽管引入标注样本能显著提升Jev的性能，但其当前配置下的准确率仍低于成熟的树集成模型。性能差距由多重因素共同导致，包括监督资源分配不均和模型配置限制，尚不能归因于单一原因。

title: What Builds the Scene? Luminance Dominates Geometry Formation in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) learns geometry and appearance jointly from RGB supervision, making it difficult to isolate how luminance and chroma contribute to the learned representation. We study this by training models under different channel supervision, freezing their non-appearance parameters (position, scale, rotation, and opacity), and re-estimating appearance with the same solver before comparing held-out reconstruction. Across eleven benchmark scenes with four independent runs each, geometry learned from luminance alone supports held-out reconstruction 0.085 dB below RGB-trained geometry on average. If chroma is deleted from a trained model, a sufficiently expressive solver can re-fit it on the frozen geometry to the original quality or slightly better. Higher-order spherical harmonics contribute much more reconstruction quality to luminance than to chroma, improving PSNR by 1.44 dB versus 0.19 dB on average, although on mirror-like surfaces hue does still change with viewpoint. The luminance advantage is even larger when geometry is being formed. Chroma-only supervision produces geometry 3.9-5.5 dB worse than luminance-only supervision after the same appearance solve; densification explains part of this gap. Overall, geometry formation in standard 3DGS is strongly luminance-dominated but not luminance-exclusive, and much of the chromatic appearance can be recovered after spatial support has formed.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在不同通道监督下训练模型，冻结非外观参数，在相同求解器下重新估计外观并比较保留重建效果，发现亮度信息在几何形成中占主导地位，但色度信息仍可恢复。
AI.motivation: 标准3D高斯点云（3DGS）联合学习几何与外观，难以分离亮度和色度对表示的贡献，因此需要探究两者各自的作用。
AI.method: 在不同通道监督（如仅亮度、仅色度）下训练模型，冻结位置、尺度、旋转和不透明度等非外观参数，使用相同求解器重新估计外观，并通过保留重建质量进行对比分析。
AI.result: 亮度单独监督下的几何支持重建平均比RGB训练低0.085 dB；删除色度后，用强表达能力求解器可在冻结几何上重新拟合至原始质量或略优；高阶球谐函数对亮度提升更大（平均PSNR提升1.44 dB vs 0.19 dB），但在镜面表面色调仍随视角变化；色度监督生成的几何质量比亮度监督差3.9-5.5 dB，部分归因于密集化过程。
AI.conclusion: 标准3DGS中的几何形成以亮度为主导而非完全依赖亮度，大部分色度外观可在空间结构建立后被恢复。

title: Backdoor Purification for LoRA-Tuned LLMs via Null-Space Projection
summary: With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, the risk of backdoor attacks has become more severe. Existing backdoor purification methods typically rely on at least one of the strong assumptions, such as prior knowledge of triggers, access to clean references, or aggressive retraining, and they often lack comprehensive evaluations. These constraints substantially limit their practical applicability. To overcome these challenges, our work proposes purifying LoRA-tuned LLMs without these assumptions and even without post-hoc retraining of the suspect parameters. Our objective is to significantly reduce the attack success rates (ASR) while preserving both (i) the base model's general capabilities and (ii) the new downstream skills learned through the adapter. Through a series of ablation studies, we progressively scale our approach from a single layer in a text classification setting to a full-parameter LLM in the generative task. Through careful data curation and feature approximation, we extract high-fidelity backdoor directions and, for each layer or head, construct orthogonal null spaces in both the input and output channels, onto which the LoRA updates are projected. Empirically, our null-space projection method reduces the ASR from nearly 100% to less than 10%, while preserving the base model's benign performance and the adapter's learned abilities during downstream task adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需强假设（如触发词先验知识、干净参考数据或激进重训练）的LoRA微调大语言模型后门净化方法，通过构建输入与输出通道的正交零空间对LoRA更新进行投影，有效降低攻击成功率（ASR）至10%以下，同时保持基础模型的通用能力与适配器学习的下游技能。
AI.motivation: 现有后门净化方法依赖于强假设（如触发词先验知识、干净参考数据或重训练），限制了实际应用；随着LLM和PEFT广泛应用，后门风险加剧，亟需更实用、无假设的净化方案。
AI.method: 通过数据精炼与特征近似提取高保真后门方向，为每一层或注意力头构建输入与输出通道的正交零空间，并将LoRA更新投影至该空间，实现不重训练的后门净化。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法可将攻击成功率从接近100%降至低于10%，同时保持基础模型的良性性能及适配器在下游任务中的学习能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在无需额外假设或重训练的前提下，实现了高效且鲁棒的后门净化，显著提升了大语言模型在安全场景下的实用性与可信度。

title: The Geometry of Contextual Relations: Language Models Address Facts by Order of Mention
summary: Human reasoning depends on how objects are related within propositions. \textit{How do relations organize the language representations of contextual contents?} We give an LLM a list of facts in its context (e.g., \emph{Alice eats an apple. Bob eats a pear.}) and measure how its hidden state changes when the question switches from what Alice eats to what Bob eats. Averaged over many lists, this change is a steering vector, which we call the \emph{ordinal vector}. It points to a fact by its \emph{order of mention}, the order in which the facts were stated in the context. We find that LLMs represent the fact a question asks about by its order of mention, not by the name the question contains. We state this as the \textit{ordinal addressing hypothesis}: each order of mention has a \emph{fact address} in the model's state, shared by all contexts, and a question moves the state to the fact address of the fact it asks about, while the context supplies what that fact says. Across Qwen, Gemma, and Llama, fact addresses are (1) \emph{ordered by mention}: query states are organized by the order of facts, not of names, even when one fact has multiple subjects; (2) \emph{steerable}: added to a question about the first fact of a new list, the ordinal vector makes the model answer with the second fact of that list; (3) \emph{low-rank}: they span a low-rank subspace in which the first-mentioned fact is the easiest to reach, surprisingly similar to human recall; and (4) \emph{emergent}: they are shared in late-middle layers, hold from 1.5B to 32B parameters, and form early in pretraining. Language models reach a stated fact by where it was mentioned, deepening our understanding of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了语言模型如何通过事实的提及顺序来组织上下文信息。通过分析模型在不同问题下的隐藏状态变化，提出‘序数向量’概念，发现模型根据事实在上下文中的提及顺序而非具体名称来定位所问事实，支持‘序数寻址假设’。该假设表明，每个提及顺序对应一个共享的‘事实地址’，模型通过此地址进行推理。研究发现这些地址具有有序性、可操控性、低秩性和涌现性，且在多个大模型中普遍存在，揭示了语言模型推理机制中对顺序依赖的本质。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型如何基于上下文中的事实顺序进行推理，揭示其内部表示机制是否依赖于事实的提及顺序而非名称。
AI.method: 通过给大语言模型提供一系列事实，并测量当问题从一个事实切换到另一个时模型隐藏状态的变化，计算出平均状态变化向量（即序数向量），进而分析这些向量在不同模型和参数规模下的特性。
AI.result: 发现模型通过事实的提及顺序来定位所问内容，序数向量具有有序性、可操控性、低秩性和涌现性；这些特征在Qwen、Gemma和Llama等模型中一致存在，且在预训练早期形成，与人类记忆的顺序依赖特性相似。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在推理过程中依赖于事实的提及顺序，而非具体内容名称。这一现象支持‘序数寻址假设’，表明模型内部存在一种共享的、基于顺序的事实地址系统，有助于深化对大语言模型推理机制的理解。

title: STCFormer: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Modeling with Dynamic Cluster Transformer for Station-based Weather Forecasting
summary: Station-based weather forecasting supports daily life and economic activity, yet accurate forecasts require modeling complex spatial dependencies among stations. Recent clustering-based selective modeling offers a promising alternative to dense inter-station interactions. However, a grouping shared across an observation window may obscure local changes in station relationships, while intra-cluster interactions alone may miss important global context. The theoretical advantages of selective interactions over dense connectivity also remain insufficiently understood. We therefore propose STCFormer, an adaptive spatio-temporal Transformer that dynamically groups stations according to their local evolution within each temporal patch. Its Cluster-Guided Attention Block combines fine-grained local attention within clusters and global attention over regional state summaries, allowing each station to access information beyond its own cluster. We further show that a derived Lipschitz upper bound for cluster-conditioned local attention is no larger than its fully connected counterpart, explaining a potential robustness benefit and motivating the design of InfoLoss. Experiments on three real-world weather datasets spanning eight temperature and wind forecasting tasks show that STCFormer achieves the lowest 24-hour mean squared error on all eight tasks and ranks first or second in 47 of 48 comparisons across metrics and forecasting horizons. Ablations and case studies further confirm the benefits of locally adaptive grouping and complementary local-global interactions. Our code can be obtained at https://github.com/hnu-vis/STCFormer.

AI.tldr: STCFormer 是一种自适应时空 Transformer，通过动态分组站点以捕捉局部演化，在局部聚类内使用细粒度注意力，并结合区域状态摘要的全局注意力，实现局部与全局信息的互补。理论分析表明其局部注意力的 Lipschitz 上界小于全连接结构，解释了潜在的鲁棒性优势。在三个真实天气数据集上的实验表明，STCFormer 在 8 个温度和风速预测任务中均取得最低 24 小时均方误差，并在 48 次比较中 47 次排名第一或第二。消融实验和案例研究验证了自适应分组和局部-全局交互的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于聚类的稀疏建模方法在观测窗口内采用固定分组，难以捕捉站点间关系的局部变化；而仅依赖聚类内交互会忽略全局上下文。此外，选择性交互相比密集连接的理论优势尚不明确。因此需要一种能动态适应局部演化、同时兼顾局部与全局信息的建模方法。
AI.method: 提出 STCFormer，一种自适应时空 Transformer。其核心是根据每个时间片段内站点的局部演化动态分组。采用 Cluster-Guided Attention Block，结合聚类内的细粒度局部注意力和基于区域状态摘要的全局注意力，使每个站点可获取跨集群信息。同时引入 InfoLoss 损失函数，基于理论推导的 Lipschitz 上界设计，增强模型鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界天气数据集上的八项温度与风速预测任务中，STCFormer 在所有任务中 24 小时均方误差最低；在 48 次不同指标与预测时长的对比中，有 47 次排名第一或第二。消融实验显示自适应分组和局部-全局交互显著提升性能，案例研究进一步验证其有效性。
AI.conclusion: STCFormer 通过动态聚类与局部-全局注意力机制，有效建模站点间的复杂时空依赖。其理论分析支持选择性交互的鲁棒性优势，实证结果表明该方法在多任务天气预测中具有优越性能，为站基气象预报提供了高效且稳健的新范式。

title: Video Evidence Indexing: Learning Where to Look from Video Previews for Token-Budgeted Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Long-video question answering is limited by the high cost of visual tokens and by the fixed context width of current VLMs. A long-video question may require broad temporal coverage, but the answer is often supported by only a compact set of moments. To locate these moments efficiently, we propose token-budgeted Video Evidence Indexing (VEI): given a dense low-resolution Video Preview, the model constructs a compact high-resolution Evidence Set for final reasoning. We treat VEI as a policy that must jointly solve \textit{evidence localization}, which finds question-relevant moments, and \textit{budget planning}, which decides where to spend the limited high-resolution frame budget. We implement this idea with an inference pipeline: the Video Preview provides cheap global coverage, Video Evidence Indexing constructs the Evidence Set, and Answer Generation combines both inputs for final VQA. To address missing frame-level supervision, we adopt privileged self-distillation, where an answer-aware teacher guides the normal test-time policy on student-generated indexing traces. We explore previews at 1, 6, 12, and 24 visual tokens per frame, training a single policy that supports all four resolutions. Experiments show that Video Evidence Indexing improves accuracy under limited visual budgets, and self-distillation further improves both QA accuracy and temporal evidence localization.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为视频证据索引（VEI）的方法，用于在有限视觉预算下高效定位长视频中与问题相关的关键片段。该方法通过低分辨率视频预览提供全局覆盖，再利用高分辨率证据集进行精确推理，并结合自蒸馏技术提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 解决长视频问答中视觉令牌成本高和现有视觉语言模型上下文宽度固定的问题，尤其是当问题需要广泛的时间覆盖但答案仅依赖少数关键时刻时的效率挑战。
AI.method: 采用基于策略的推理流程：利用低分辨率视频预览进行全局覆盖，通过视频证据索引构建紧凑的高分辨率证据集，最后结合两者生成答案；引入答案感知的教师-学生自蒸馏机制以弥补帧级监督缺失。
AI.result: 实验表明，视频证据索引在有限视觉预算下显著提升了问答准确率，自蒸馏进一步优化了问答准确率和关键时间片段的定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 视频证据索引是一种高效且可扩展的长视频问答方法，能够有效应对视觉预算限制，同时通过自蒸馏实现更好的性能表现。

title: R-GroundBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for R-Group Groundingin Markush Molecular Editing
summary: Recent advances in AI for scientific discovery enable molecular understandingand design, yet reasoning over incomplete chemical representations remainsunclear.Markush structures, which encode molecular families through variable R-groupplaceholders (\textit{R\textsubscript{1}}, \textit{R\textsubscript{2}}, \textit{X}, etc.), are ubiquitous in pharmaceutical patents and requiregrounding across molecular, textual, and chemical information.However, existing molecule-language benchmarks focus on fully specifiedmolecules, leaving R-group grounding largely unevaluated.We introduce R-GroundBench:, a diagnostic benchmark built from real patent Markushstructures, featuring a Multiple-Choice (VQA) track with controlled difficultyand modality splits, and an open-ended Generation track.Our results reveal a substantial gap between recognition andmolecular grounding.While models achieve over 90\% accuracy on Easy VQA, performance drops to56--66\% on Hard VQA when shortcuts are controlled.Chemical-domain VLMs also remain unreliable, achieving only 25.7--46.2\% on HardVQA despite domain-specific pretraining.Moreover, Generation Exact Match remains below 20\% for most models and below8\% when visual input is required.These findings reveal that current AI systems lack reliable grounding andexecution for Markush editing, highlighting challenges for AI-drivenscientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R-GroundBench，一个基于真实专利Markush结构的诊断基准，包含多选（VQA）和开放生成两个任务。结果显示，现有模型在简单任务中表现良好，但在复杂任务中性能显著下降，尤其在化学领域视觉语言模型上表现不佳，表明当前AI系统在Markush结构的语义接地与编辑方面仍存在严重不足。
AI.motivation: Markush结构在药物专利中广泛存在，但现有分子-语言基准大多针对完整分子，缺乏对R基团接地的评估，限制了AI在科学发现中的应用。
AI.method: 构建R-GroundBench，包含控制难度和模态分割的多选任务及开放生成任务，用于评估模型在分子、文本与化学信息间的跨模态理解能力。
AI.result: 模型在简单VQA任务中准确率超90%，但在复杂VQA任务中降至56–66%；化学域视觉语言模型在硬任务中仅达25.7–46.2%；生成任务精确匹配率普遍低于20%，视觉输入下低于8%。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI系统在Markush结构的语义接地与执行方面仍不可靠，凸显AI驱动科学发现面临的重大挑战。

title: Efficient Task Adaptation in Large Language Models: A Survey of Weight-Based, Prompt-Based, and Embedding-Based Adaptations
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed across diverse downstream tasks, efficient task adaptation has emerged as a central challenge. In response, a wide range of task adaptation methods have been proposed, spanning parameter-efficient fine-tuning, in-context learning, and embedding-injection approaches. However, these lines of work have largely evolved within individual paradigms, leaving their cross-paradigm relationships and trade-offs underexplored, especially for recently emerging embedding-based adaptations. This survey presents a unified framework that categorizes task adaptation methods by where and how task information is encoded: model weights, input prompts, or injected task embeddings. We provide a comprehensive taxonomy that integrates these paradigms, analyze their key strengths and limitations to explain how different adaptation paradigms have evolved, clarify relationships across paradigms, and highlight open problems for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，将任务适配方法按任务信息的编码位置和方式分类：模型权重、输入提示或注入的任务嵌入。通过综合分类法，分析了不同范式的优势与局限，阐明了适配范式的演进路径，厘清了跨范式关系，并指出了未来研究的开放问题。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在多样化下游任务中的广泛应用，高效的任务适配成为核心挑战。现有方法多局限于单一范式，缺乏对跨范式关系与权衡的深入探索，尤其是新兴的基于嵌入的适配方法。
AI.method: 提出一个统一框架，根据任务信息的编码位置（模型权重、输入提示、注入嵌入）对任务适配方法进行分类，构建涵盖参数高效微调、上下文学习和嵌入注入等范式的综合分类体系。
AI.result: 建立了跨范式的统一分类体系，揭示了不同适配方法之间的内在联系与演进逻辑，明确了各类方法的优缺点，并为未来研究指明了方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为理解任务适配方法的多样性提供了系统视角，强调了跨范式整合的重要性，推动了高效任务适配技术的发展。

title: Fusion techniques of time frequency-based images to predict the outcome of rTMS depression therapy
comment: Published in the Biomedical Signal Processing and Control
summary: Depression is a mental condition that can lead to suicide and self-harm. Predicting the outcome of depression treatment is one of the most difficult tasks for clinicians. Among various treatment options, repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) is a widely used non-invasive method. Predicting rTMS response using Electroencephalogram (EEG) data is difficult because of high inter-subject variability and limited features from single-domain analysis. We introduce two fusion techniques, montage and blending, to overcome these limitations and extract richer features from EEG-derived Time-Frequency (TF) images. We then propose a lightweight custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained on fused TF representations. \textcolor{black}{We use a primary dataset of 15 patients and a secondary dataset of 46 patients. We run two sets of experiments. The first set uses segment-level 10-fold cross-validation. In this setup segments from the same patient can appear in both training and testing. The Montage CWT\_ST fusion reaches 99.90\% accuracy on the primary dataset and 91.90\% on the secondary dataset. The second set uses strict subject-disjoint cross-validation. All segments of a patient stay in one fold and no patient appears in both training and testing. Performance collapses. We test four time-frequency methods, six fusion mechanisms, and fourteen model architectures. With one exception, every configuration on both cohorts falls between AUC 0.31 and 0.54 and every 95\% confidence interval contains 0.5. A patient-level permutation test on the best standalone method returns $p = 0.703$. The best subject-level result is Montage CWT\_ST on the primary cohort, which reaches AUC $0.874 \pm 0.183$ and 82.7\% accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于EEG时间-频率图像融合的轻量级CNN模型，用于预测抑郁症患者对rTMS治疗的反应。通过蒙太奇和混合两种融合技术增强特征提取，但在严格患者独立的交叉验证下性能显著下降，表明模型可能过拟合。
AI.motivation: 抑郁症治疗反应预测困难，尤其在使用rTMS时，传统EEG分析受限于个体差异和单一域特征不足，需更有效的特征融合与建模方法。
AI.method: 采用蒙太奇与混合融合策略处理EEG时间-频率图像，结合轻量级自定义CNN模型，在15名患者主数据集和46名患者次级数据集上进行实验，对比多种时间-频率变换方法、融合机制与网络架构。
AI.result: 在段落级10折交叉验证中，蒙太奇CWT_ST融合达到主数据集99.90%准确率、次级数据集91.90%；但在严格的患者级独立交叉验证下，所有配置的AUC均在0.31至0.54之间，置信区间包含0.5，且最佳模型的p值为0.703，表明无统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管在非独立验证下表现优异，但模型在真实临床场景（患者独立）下无法稳定预测治疗反应，提示当前方法存在严重过拟合问题，需进一步改进特征泛化能力与模型鲁棒性。

title: VTV-FM: Flow Matching through Variational Terminal-Velocity Closure
summary: Flow matching (FM) learns generative transport by fitting continuous-time motion from a simple source distribution to the data distribution. Most existing methods use first-order bridges: once a source and a target sample are paired, the path is a straight motion with constant velocity. FM with optimal transport (OT) improves the pairing, but the bridge itself remains linear, limiting its ability to model curved motion, acceleration, and changing directions. A natural remedy is to use second-order phase-space dynamics; however, learning the bridge requires target-side terminal-velocity information that static datasets do not provide. We propose Variational Terminal-Velocity Flow Matching (VTV-FM), a second-order FM framework that derives the missing velocity by minimizing acceleration energy, yielding a closed-form closure for static data. The same minimum-acceleration variational construction also defines the OT pairing cost and the acceleration targets used for training. Experiments on low-dimensional datasets, PDE-governed physical fields, and CIFAR-10 show that VTV-FM improves transport geometry and generation quality over first-order and high-order FM baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出VTV-FM，一种基于最小加速度变分原理的二阶流匹配框架，通过闭式解推导缺失的速度信息，实现对静态数据的曲率运动建模，在低维数据、物理场和CIFAR-10上优于一阶与高阶基线。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配方法多采用一阶桥接，路径为直线匀速运动，难以建模曲线轨迹、加速或方向变化；虽有最优传输改进配对，但桥接仍为线性，限制表达能力；使用二阶相空间动力学可改善，但需目标端速度信息，而静态数据不提供该信息。
AI.method: 提出变分终端速度流匹配（VTV-FM），通过最小化加速度能量来推断缺失的目标侧终端速度，实现对静态数据的闭式解；该最小加速度变分构造同时定义了最优传输配对代价和训练中的加速度目标。
AI.result: 在低维数据集、由偏微分方程控制的物理场以及CIFAR-10上，VTV-FM在运输几何结构和生成质量方面均优于一阶及高阶流匹配基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VTV-FM通过引入最小加速度变分原理，成功解决了静态数据中缺失终端速度的问题，实现了更自然的非线性运动建模，显著提升了生成质量和运输效率。

title: Meta-Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Fast Adaptation of Interactive Policies with Applications to Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper develops a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning (meta-MARL) framework to enable fast adaptation of interactive policies in a multi-agent system (MAS). Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to rapidly adapt to new tasks/environments using a bi-level optimization mechanism. However, existing meta-RL generally focuses on single-agent systems. Extending these frameworks and algorithms to multi-agent systems poses additional challenges, as tasks are characterized by not only the environment but also agents' strategic interactions. To address these challenges, we model multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems as Markov games (MGs) and develop a meta-MARL framework for rapid interactive policy adaptation across a distribution of MGs. A new concept, called meta-NE, is defined to describe the desired solution concept in a meta-MARL problem. Sufficient conditions for the equivalence between a meta-NE and a stationary point of the gradient-play-based meta-MARL algorithm are established. Our evaluation on autonomous-driving tasks demonstrates that the proposed meta-MARL method achieves faster adaptation than pretrained MARL baselines, validating the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种元多智能体强化学习（meta-MARL）框架，旨在实现多智能体系统中交互策略的快速适应。通过将多智能体强化学习问题建模为马尔可夫博弈（MGs），并引入新的元-纳什均衡（meta-NE）概念，该框架在分布式的MG任务中实现了快速策略适应。研究建立了meta-NE与基于梯度博弈的元MARL算法稳定点之间的等价条件，并在自动驾驶任务上验证了其优于预训练MARL基线方法的适应速度，证明了框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有元强化学习主要针对单智能体系统，难以直接扩展到多智能体系统，因为多智能体任务不仅依赖环境，还涉及智能体间的策略互动。因此，亟需一种能够快速适应复杂交互环境的元多智能体学习框架。
AI.method: 将多智能体强化学习问题建模为马尔可夫博弈（MGs），提出元-纳什均衡（meta-NE）作为目标解概念，并设计基于梯度博弈的元多智能体强化学习算法，建立其与meta-NE的等价条件，以实现跨任务的快速策略适应。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶任务上的实验表明，所提出的meta-MARL方法在新任务上的适应速度显著快于现有的预训练MARL基线方法，验证了该框架在快速适应方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的meta-MARL框架有效解决了多智能体系统中交互策略快速适应的挑战，通过定义meta-NE并建立理论等价关系，实现了在多样化任务分布中的高效学习与适应，具有良好的应用前景。

title: ReHoPER: Receding-Horizon Planning for Enhanced Reasoning
summary: We propose ReHoPER, an inference-only, zero-shot method that improves large language models' reasoning by generating and answering intermediate questions along multiple paths before the final answer.
