AI.tldr: 本文提出ActiveSaddler，一种自动课程学习方法，用于动态优化LLM代理的测试场景选择，以提升其性能。通过将失败模式抽象为可重用的“臂”，并根据其潜在学习收益动态调整优化目标，实现对训练场景的自适应选择。实验表明，该方法在GAIA2和Terminal-Bench 2.0上分别提升Pass@1达4.4和7.5个百分点，优于固定场景顺序的方法。结果证明动态构建优化目标、估计其演化效用以及平衡探索与利用至关重要。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化测试框架优化主要关注如何更新提示、工具接口和控制逻辑，但忽视了训练场景（即反馈来源）应随框架演进而动态调整。随着框架改进，原先有效的测试场景可能不再适用，因此需要一个能够自适应调整训练课程的机制。
AI.method: 将课程学习建模为非平稳多臂赌博机问题，将重复出现的失败模式抽象为可重用的‘臂’，实时估计每个失败模式的潜在学习收益，并在探索新场景与重访已知弱点之间进行动态平衡。优化过程持续更新失败模式集合及其优先级，实现课程与框架的协同进化。
AI.result: 在GAIA2和Terminal-Bench 2.0上的实验显示，ActiveSaddler显著提升了测试通过率，Pass@1分别提高4.4和7.5个百分点；消融实验证明，动态构建优化目标、评估其效用及探索-利用平衡是关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 自动化课程学习是提升LLM代理测试框架优化的重要维度，ActiveSaddler通过动态调整训练场景选择，实现了更高效、更智能的优化路径。

title: Sentence Specificity Scores for Collaborative Technical Documentation: A Domain-Transfer Study
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE 12th International Conference on Collaboration and Internet Computing (CIC)
summary: Collaboration depends on shared context, and technical documentation is one way that context persists across people and AI teammates. Specificity, the amount and exactness of detail expressed in language, shapes what information documentation captures and how precisely that information is communicated. This work audits sentence-specificity scoring artifacts on technical documentation and tests whether scores applied only after generation help choose among fixed LLM-generated revisions. Across Wikipedia and three technical-documentation corpora, the fixed general-domain predictor SpeciTeller and the pinned post-publication author-repository implementation of Ko et al.'s target-adapted predictor produce different corpus orders and same-sentence rank agreement from -0.066 to 0.510. Strict filtering and token-length adjustment change these patterns without reconciling them. In the Gemma set, SpeciTeller ranking raises direction-valid selection from 71.7% to 83.3% (+11.7 points; 95% source-case bootstrap interval +1.7 to +21.7); in the GPT-OSS-120B set, SpeciTeller ranking raises direction-valid selection from 51.7% to 56.7% (+5.0 points; 95% source-case bootstrap interval -6.7 to +16.7), and every primary single-score GPT-OSS-120B interval includes zero. These findings tie score interpretation and decision value to the predictor and candidate set.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了特定性评分工具在技术文档中的表现，发现不同预测器对文档句子的排序存在显著差异，且特定性分数在选择最优LLM生成版本时具有一定的决策价值，但其效果依赖于具体预测器和候选集。
AI.motivation: 技术文档中的共享上下文对协作至关重要，而语言的具体性影响信息捕捉与传递的精确度。本文旨在评估现有特定性评分工具在技术文档中的有效性，并测试其在生成后选择最佳版本时的实用性。
AI.method: 在维基百科及三个技术文档语料库上，使用固定通用领域预测器SpeciTeller和针对目标调整的Ko等人的预测器进行句子特定性评分，比较其排序一致性，并通过严格过滤和词元长度调整分析其影响。进一步在Gemma和GPT-OSS-120B数据集上测试特定性评分对选择方向正确版本的效果。
AI.result: SpeciTeller在Gemma数据集上将方向正确选择率从71.7%提升至83.3%（+11.7点），在GPT-OSS-120B上从51.7%提升至56.7%（+5.0点），但后者置信区间包含零；不同预测器产生的排序不一致，且调整策略未能完全统一结果。
AI.conclusion: 特定性评分的解释和实际决策价值高度依赖于所使用的预测器和候选文本集合，不能一概而论。

title: WIPSNet: Deep Learning for Paediatric Wheeze Detection from Overnight Impedance Pneumography
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Structured Data for Health, ICML 2026. Code: https://github.com/felix-oury/WIPSNet
summary: Overnight impedance pneumography (IP) is used to monitor paediatric respiratory health. Its current clinical readout, the Expiratory Variability Index (EVI), compresses each IP recording into a single scalar and achieves an AUC of 0.633 for night-level wheeze classification. We introduce Wheeze Impedance Pneumography Scalogram Network (WIPSNet), a 3D ResNet operating on stacked continuous wavelet transform scalograms of overnight IP signals. On a 15-patient cohort (60 nights, 281 hours), WIPSNet achieves an AUC of $0.783 \pm 0.026$, outperforming EVI, a state-space model (Mamba), and two modern sleep-staging architectures. Performance peaks at a volumetric depth corresponding to 32 minutes of temporal context, suggesting that multi-scale temporal aggregation is important for modelling nocturnal respiratory dynamics. Overall, these results indicate that structured time-frequency representations combined with 3D convolutional architectures provide an effective approach for learning from long, irregular physiological time series.

AI.tldr: WIPSNet, a 3D ResNet on wavelet scalograms of overnight impedance pneumography signals, improves wheeze classification AUC to 0.783 ± 0.026, outperforming EVI and other models, with optimal performance at 32-minute temporal context.
AI.motivation: Current clinical readout (EVI) compresses IP data into a single scalar, limiting its predictive power for night-level wheeze classification; there's a need for better methods to analyze long, irregular physiological time series.
AI.method: WIPSNet uses stacked continuous wavelet transform scalograms as input and applies a 3D ResNet architecture to model multi-scale temporal dynamics in overnight impedance pneumography signals.
AI.result: WIPSNet achieves an AUC of 0.783 ± 0.026 on a 15-patient cohort (60 nights, 281 hours), significantly outperforming EVI (AUC 0.633), Mamba, and sleep-staging models, with peak performance at 32 minutes of temporal context.
AI.conclusion: Structured time-frequency representations combined with 3D convolutional networks are effective for modeling nocturnal respiratory dynamics in long, irregular physiological signals.

title: Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation Quantization with Classifier-Free Guidance
summary: Post-training quantization for diffusion models increasingly exploits timestep, feature, and layer structure. While recent work has begun incorporating CFG structure into diffusion quantization, activation quantization still operates independently across conditional and unconditional coordinates, leaving cross-activation structure unexploited. We show that matched CFG activations form a strongly correlated two-dimensional source and that, under a fixed bit budget, the choice of branch coding basis materially affects quantization fidelity. Motivated by this observation, we introduce branch-space transform coding, which rotates matched CFG branches via an offline derived 2x2 orthogonal matrix, requiring minimal modifications to model parameters or the quantization pipeline. We further derive the Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT), which jointly incorporates the CFG guidance direction and cross-branch second moments. Under an equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate, GCBT admits a closed-form per-layer solution without gradient optimization or angle search. Applied on top of existing diffusion PTQ methods, GCBT yields statistically significant fidelity gains in most evaluated comparisons with no statistically significant degradation, while leaving the underlying host quantization pipeline unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为GCBT（Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform）的新型量化方法，用于改进扩散模型后训练量化（PTQ）中的条件与无条件分支激活之间的相关性利用。通过引入基于CFG引导方向和跨分支二阶矩的2×2正交变换，GCBT在不改变原有量化流程的前提下，显著提升了量化精度。该方法具有闭式解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索，且在多数实验中实现了统计上显著的性能提升，同时无明显退化。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型量化方法虽已考虑时间步、特征和层结构，但对条件与无条件分支间的激活相关性仍处理不足，导致跨激活结构未被充分利用。特别是，在固定比特预算下，分支编码基的选择对量化保真度影响显著。因此，亟需一种能有效挖掘并利用匹配CFG激活之间强相关性的方法。
AI.method: 提出分支空间变换编码（Branch-Space Transform Coding），通过离线计算的2×2正交矩阵旋转匹配的CFG分支；进一步设计了指导-相关分支变换（GCBT），联合利用CFG引导方向与跨分支二阶矩信息，实现最优编码基选择，并在等率量化噪声近似下获得每层的闭式解，无需迭代优化。
AI.result: 在多种主流扩散模型后训练量化方法上应用GCBT，均取得统计上显著的性能提升，且无显著退化；方法仅需微小改动，兼容性强，可无缝集成到现有量化流程中。
AI.conclusion: GCBT通过有效建模条件与无条件分支间的高阶相关性，显著提升扩散模型量化质量，为高效低精度推理提供了新范式，且实现简单、无需额外训练或复杂调优。

title: OR for AI That Does OR: Routing LLMs up the Escalator inside the OSCAR Framework
summary: Large language models can translate business descriptions into optimization models, but executable code may misrepresent constraints or objectives. A solver can then return an optimal solution to the wrong problem. Even when the solution satisfies the intended operating rules, a better plan may exist. For organizations that repeatedly use optimization modeling, an LLM-based framework should produce accurate formulations at low cost and, ideally, run locally. We study how to verify improvements and allocate attempts across LLMs that differ in price and capability. We develop OSCAR (Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer), which uses an offline Simulator certified against labeled decision examples to compare candidates and continues searching beyond feasibility. We model the search for the next certified improvement as sequential decisions under unobserved difficulty: which LLMs to call and when to stop. In a simplified known-prior setting, we give conditions under which cost-ordered escalation is optimal. For general menus, we derive a prior-free competitive guarantee. On five benchmark problems, OSCAR achieves 95% to 100% accuracy at the reported settings using two small open-weight LLMs, each deployable locally on a single GPU. Their single-attempt accuracies average 29% and 48%. In five runs per problem, Codex and Claude Code incur average token costs 3.1 and 5.8 times OSCAR's, respectively. OSCAR supports open-weight models locally or in the cloud, depending on budget and confidentiality requirements. Firms should maintain labeled decision examples of feasible and infeasible decisions to clarify plain-language operating rules. OSCAR follows these labels when an LLM's interpretation conflicts with them. As LLM capabilities and prices change, OSCAR's simple operating rules and adjustable settings help firms adapt their model choices and benefit from these advances.

AI.tldr: OSCAR 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的优化建模框架，旨在将业务描述准确转化为可执行的优化模型。它通过离线模拟器对比候选方案，持续搜索超越可行性的改进，并在未知难度下以序列决策方式决定调用哪个 LLM 及何时停止。在低成本、本地部署的前提下，OSCAR 使用两个小型开源权重模型，在五个基准问题上实现了 95%~100% 的准确率，显著优于单次尝试的原始模型（平均准确率仅 29% 和 48%），且令牌成本仅为 Codex 和 Claude Code 的 1/3.1 和 1/5.8。该框架支持灵活配置，适应不同预算与隐私需求，并依赖企业维护的标注决策数据来校准模型解释，具备良好的可扩展性与适应性。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 在将业务描述转为优化模型时可能错误表达约束或目标，导致求解器优化的是错误问题；即使解满足规则，也可能非最优。对于频繁使用优化建模的企业，需要一种低成本、高精度且可本地运行的框架。因此，亟需一种能验证改进并智能分配计算资源的方法。
AI.method: 提出 OSCAR 框架，包含离线模拟器（用于验证和比较候选模型）、编码器（生成模型）与评审器（判断是否继续搜索）。采用序贯决策机制建模搜索过程，根据未观测到的难度动态选择调用哪些 LLM 并决定终止时机。在已知先验情况下证明成本有序升级策略最优，在一般场景下提供无先验的竞争性保证。
AI.result: 在五个基准问题上，使用两个小型开源模型，OSCAR 实现了 95% 到 100% 的准确率，而单次尝试的准确率仅为 29% 和 48%。相比 Codex 与 Claude Code，OSCAR 的平均令牌消耗分别降低至 1/3.1 和 1/5.8。系统支持本地或云端部署，适应不同预算与保密要求。
AI.conclusion: OSCAR 提供了一种高效、可靠、可本地部署的优化建模方法，能够克服 LLM 建模误差，显著提升准确性与经济性。企业应积累标注的可行/不可行决策数据以增强模型对齐能力。随着 LLM 能力与价格变化，OSCAR 的简单规则和可调参数使其易于适应新技术发展。

title: Capturing In-Context Learning Dynamics with Task Operators
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to perform new tasks from demonstrations without weight updates. However, every ICL inference requires processing the full set of examples, resulting in inefficient deployments, and how ICL works mechanistically is not fully understood. Prior work compresses ICL into fixed activation vectors extracted from specific layers or positions, but these input-independent interventions fail on complex tasks where the output depends on fine-grained interactions with the input. By analyzing the ICL forward pass, we show that each attention head's output is an affine transformation of its context-masked counterpart, and that the parameters of this transformation are empirically stable across samples for a given task. Building on this, we introduce Task Operator (TO), which replays this transformation as an analytically derived update to the attention output projection. Across lexical, algorithmic, and reasoning tasks, TO achieves the best overall performance among prior methods and substantially narrows the gap between zero-shot inference and ICL. We further show that the extracted knowledge concentrates in a task-specific sparse circuit across layers and positions, and that averaging operators from disjoint demonstration batches enables effective many-shot scaling without expanding the context window. Our code is available at https://github.com/gzxiong/task_operator.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Task Operator (TO)，一种通过分析In-context learning (ICL)前向传播中注意力头输出的仿射变换特性，实现对ICL的高效压缩与加速的方法。TO利用任务特定的稳定参数，将演示样本的上下文信息转化为可复用的更新操作，显著提升推理效率并缩小零样本与ICL之间的性能差距。实验表明，该方法在词汇、算法和推理任务上优于现有方法，且知识集中在稀疏的跨层-位置电路中，支持无需扩展上下文窗口的多示例扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有ICL方法因需处理全部示例而效率低下，且对ICL机制理解不足。特别是输入无关的压缩方式难以应对依赖精细输入交互的复杂任务。因此亟需一种既能保持性能又可高效部署的ICL压缩机制。
AI.method: 通过分析ICL前向传播，发现每个注意力头的输出是其上下文掩码版本的仿射变换，且变换参数在给定任务下对不同样本具有稳定性。基于此，提出Task Operator (TO)，将该变换作为解析更新应用于注意力输出投影，实现高效的示范信息编码。同时，通过分析知识分布，识别出任务特定的稀疏电路，并利用不相交示例批次的平均算子实现无上下文扩展的多示例缩放。
AI.result: TO在多种任务（词汇、算法、推理）中均达到最优性能，显著缩小了零样本与ICL之间的差距；知识集中于稀疏的跨层-位置电路；通过平均多个批次的算子，实现了有效得多示例扩展而无需增加上下文长度。
AI.conclusion: Task Operator (TO) 提供了一种高效、可解释且可扩展的ICL压缩框架，不仅提升了推理效率，也深化了对ICL工作机制的理解。其稀疏性与模块化设计为后续模型优化与轻量化部署提供了新路径。

title: Metacognitive Reasoning in Energy Based Models using Instance Based Learning Theory
summary: Metacognition involves reasoning about cognitive processes themselves. An example is in resource allocation where we choose how much time and effort to put into a reasoning task before we begin based on our confidence. Current Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems that rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) cannot estimate their uncertainty about an output without first responding, and cannot dynamically allocate resources to producing an output, making this type of metacognitive process difficult. A recently proposed alternative to classic transformer architectures that addresses these two concerns is the Energy Based Model (EBM) which allows for interpretable uncertainty modeling and dynamic allocation of compute resources. While EBMs can allow for control of these two processes, the actual metacognitive task of determining compute allocation based on uncertainty is not directly addressed. Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) provides an approach to modeling human-like decisions from experience that has previously been applied to predicting human metacognitive reasoning. In this paper we introduce a framework for MEtacognitive Reasoning with Instance-based Learning Theory and Energy Dynamics (MERITED). Grounded in IBLT, this framework allows for control of the computational effort allocated in an EBM to allow for metacognitive control over reasoning effort based on uncertainty while remaining computationally efficient. This work has two main contributions, the training and open weight sharing of a 191M parameter reasoning EBM, and an implementation of the MERITED framework for dynamic compute allocation using an IBL model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MERITED框架，结合实例基础学习理论（IBLT）与能量模型（EBM），实现基于不确定性的动态计算资源分配，解决大语言模型在元认知推理中的局限性。该框架支持高效计算和可解释的不确定性建模，主要贡献包括训练并开放共享一个191M参数的推理型EBM，以及实现基于IBL模型的动态计算分配机制。
AI.motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的AI系统无法在响应前估计不确定性，也无法动态分配计算资源，缺乏元认知能力。为解决这一问题，需要一种既能建模不确定性又能动态控制计算资源的新方法。
AI.method: 提出MERITED框架，基于实例基础学习理论（IBLT）与能量模型（EBM），通过学习历史经验来指导计算资源的动态分配，并利用EBM实现可解释的不确定性评估与计算效率的平衡。
AI.result: 成功训练并公开共享了一个191M参数的推理型能量模型，实现了基于不确定性的动态计算资源分配，在保持计算效率的同时增强了模型的元认知能力。
AI.conclusion: MERITED框架有效融合了人类元认知决策机制与现代能量模型的优势，使AI系统具备类似人类的推理努力调节能力，为构建更具自主性和适应性的智能系统提供了新路径。

title: A Matched-Budget Audit Framework for Recaptioned Image-Text Supervision Distributions
summary: Recaptioned image-text corpora are now standard for text-to-image (T2I) training, with vision--language model (VLM) captioners replacing sparse alt-text by dense descriptions. A recaptioned corpus is a supervision distribution induced by a documented captioning policy ($π$), captioner ($V_c$), and source corpus ($C$). Length-correlated proxies miss caption-register artifacts and downstream T2I benchmarks entangle the corpus with training choices, so this distribution is hard to audit at corpus scale. We introduce a reusable matched-budget audit framework for recaptioned supervision distributions $D_{π,V_c,C}$: at a fixed text budget of $B = 64$ it reports a five-axis profile spanning prompt-side coverage, image-conditioned faithfulness, and caption-surface health, with claimed controllable basic units (CBU) as the common claim unit. We instantiate the framework on seven paired comparisons over five public source corpora. Across the four cross-corpus pairs, the released surface raises supported CBU per caption by $+3.39$ to $+6.36$ under both Qwen and Gemma Judges, and on CC12M the same framework exposes a long-vs-dense frontier that is consistent across both judges and four budgets. We release the audited multi-source recap corpus ($\approx$ 490M) together with the audit-artifact bundle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可复用的匹配预算审计框架，用于评估基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）生成的图像-文本语料库的监督分布。该框架在固定文本预算下，通过五维指标（如提示覆盖度、图像条件下的忠实度、描述表面健康度等）分析生成内容质量，并以可控基本单元（CBU）作为统一评估单位。作者在五个公开数据集上进行了七组对比实验，结果显示新释放的语料库在多个维度上显著提升CBU数量；同时揭示了长描述与密集描述之间的性能边界。研究还发布了约4.9亿条经过审计的多源重描述语料及配套审计工具包。
AI.motivation: 现有图像-文本语料库的重构依赖于视觉-语言模型生成的密集描述，但其监督分布难以规模化审计，因长度相关代理指标忽略关键生成偏差，且下游评估常混淆语料与训练策略的影响。因此需要一种标准化、可复用的审计方法来准确评估生成语料的质量与一致性。
AI.method: 提出一个匹配预算审计框架，设定固定文本预算B=64，采用五轴评估体系：提示侧覆盖度、图像条件下的忠实度、描述表面健康度等；引入可控基本单元（CBU）作为统一评估单位；在多个公共数据集上进行成对比较，结合Qwen与Gemma双判别器验证结果稳健性。
AI.result: 在四个跨数据集对中，新发布的语料库在两种判别器下均使每条描述的CBU数提升3.39至6.36；在CC12M数据集上，框架揭示了长描述与密集描述之间的一致性前沿，且在四种不同预算下表现稳定。整体结果表明该框架能有效识别生成语料中的结构与质量特征。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的审计框架为大规模重描述语料提供了可复用、可扩展的评估机制，能够精准揭示生成质量差异并支持跨数据集比较。研究释放的多源重描述语料库与审计工具包将推动文本到图像生成领域的透明化与可审计发展。

title: Finding the Right Fit: Model-Harness Interactions across Agent Tasks
summary: Choosing an agent system means choosing both a language model and the harness through which it acts. We ask whether a strong model, harness, or pairing stays strong when the setting changes. We evaluate 66 configurations: four configurable harnesses (OpenHands, DeepSeek Harness, PI, and openJiuwen) paired with five models on TUA-Bench, ALE-CLI, and Terminal-Bench 4, plus the native Codex-GPT and Claude Code-Claude pairings. Model rankings reverse across harnesses. On Terminal-Bench 4, Claude leads GPT by 7.94 points in OpenHands but trails it by 30.16 points in PI. For four of the five models, the best harness changes from one benchmark to another, yet some pairings hold: openJiuwen gives Kimi its highest score on all three benchmarks, by 5.61 to 11.11 points. A model's own vendor harness is not reliably its best, and higher cost does not reliably buy a higher score. On Terminal-Bench 4, GPT scores higher under PI than under DSH at less than a quarter of the cost per task. Matched trajectories suggest why fit varies. Models start almost all repairs themselves, so much depends on whether the harness hands failures back in a form the model can use. GPT does best with PI's lean scaffold, while Kimi, which often issues malformed tool calls, does best in openJiuwen. We argue that the model, the harness, and the task should be evaluated together, and we release the harness adapters, evaluation code, and all 6,204 scored trajectories at https://github.com/liyix/finding-the-right-fit and https://huggingface.co/datasets/yixuanli97/finding-the-right-fit.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了66种语言模型与控制框架（harness）的组合在不同基准测试中的表现，发现模型排名随框架变化而反转，且最佳组合因任务而异。例如，Claude在OpenHands中优于GPT，但在PI框架下则落后30.16分。Kimi在所有三个基准上均在openJiuwen框架下表现最佳，差距为5.61至11.11分。研究强调模型、框架与任务应协同评估，并指出厂商自带框架不一定是最佳选择，高成本也不保证高绩效。通过分析修复轨迹，发现模型初始自主修复能力很强，框架能否以可理解形式反馈失败至关重要。研究开源了全部代码、适配器和6204条评分轨迹。
AI.motivation: 探索在不同任务环境下，语言模型与控制框架的搭配是否保持性能优势，揭示模型-框架匹配的重要性，避免仅依赖单一指标或默认配置做出决策。
AI.method: 构建并评估66种模型与框架的组合，在TUA-Bench、ALE-CLI和Terminal-Bench 4三个基准上进行实验，使用多种可控框架（OpenHands、DeepSeek Harness、PI、openJiuwen）与五种模型及原生对（Codex-GPT、Claude Code-Claude）对比，结合轨迹分析探究性能差异原因。
AI.result: 模型排名在不同框架间显著反转；多数模型的最佳框架随基准变化；仅有部分组合（如Kimi+openJiuwen）在多个基准上持续领先；高成本框架未必带来更高性能；框架对错误反馈的形式影响模型表现，尤其在处理工具调用错误方面。
AI.conclusion: 模型、框架与任务之间存在复杂匹配关系，应联合评估，而非孤立看待。选择最优代理系统需考虑三者协同效应，研究结果支持开放共享数据与工具以推动更科学的选型。

title: JoinGR: Learning to Traverse Join Graphs for Table Retrieval
summary: Retrieving the right tables is a prerequisite for Text-to-SQL over realistic databases. Dense table retrievers rank schema elements independently, but this ignores a key source of evidence: some required tables are not mentioned in the question and become identifiable only through their join relationships to already relevant tables. We introduce JOINGR, a join-aware table retrieval method that treats the database join graph as the retrieval space. Columns are represented as graph nodes, while intra-table and foreign-key relationships are represented as typed edges. Given a question, JOINGR selects semantically similar anchor tables, traverses join edges with a query-conditioned scorer, and aggregates the resulting edge deposits into table scores. The scorer is a lightweight MLP on top of frozen query, node, and edge embeddings, trained with a pairwise margin loss over gold tables. On BIRD and Spider datasets, JOINGR is competitive with the strongest retrieval baselines. On BEAVER, a challenging enterprise benchmark with multi-hop table requirements, JOINGR substantially improves recall over dense retrieval and re-ranking baselines. Cross-domain experiments show that the learned scorer transfers across benchmarks, indicating that the method captures reusable joingraph traversal behavior.

AI.tldr: JOINGR is a join-aware table retrieval method for Text-to-SQL that models the database as a join graph, using semantic similarity and query-conditioned scoring to traverse relationships between tables. It improves recall on complex benchmarks like BEAVER by leveraging implicit table connections via joins.
AI.motivation: Existing dense table retrievers treat schema elements independently, ignoring the fact that some required tables are not mentioned in the question but can be identified through their join relationships with relevant tables. This limits performance on complex, multi-hop queries.
AI.method: JOINGR represents the database as a graph where columns are nodes and relationships (intra-table and foreign-key) are typed edges. It selects anchor tables based on semantic similarity, then traverses join edges using a lightweight MLP scorer conditioned on query, node, and edge embeddings. The scorer is trained with pairwise margin loss over gold tables.
AI.result: On BIRD and Spider, JOINGR matches top retrieval baselines. On BEAVER, it significantly improves recall compared to dense retrieval and re-ranking methods. Cross-domain experiments show the scorer generalizes across benchmarks, indicating reusable join graph traversal behavior.
AI.conclusion: JOINGR effectively captures implicit table dependencies through join-aware retrieval, improving performance on challenging, multi-hop Text-to-SQL tasks while demonstrating strong transferability across domains.

title: Representation Transitions Reveal Emerging Safety Risks in Multi-Turn LLM Agents
summary:
Multi-turn attacks on agentic systems can compose individually permissible actions into harmful outcomes, challenging defenses that assess actions or states in isolation. We show that such attacks leave a detectable signature in the agent's internal representations: harmful behavior emerges as an accumulated representation transition across context updates, whose triggering context can be identified from the same signal. We further find that naive aggregation is confounded by benign representation drift, as a contrastive safety direction need not assign zero to benign transitions. We address this by denoising the direction, anchoring benign traffic at zero and removing its leading variation directions, with no runtime cost.
  These findings motivate DART, a runtime framework that detects and attributes representation shifts and intervenes with targeted reminders. Across six models and two multi-turn benchmarks, DART reduces attack success from 84% to 25% on MT-AgentRisk, catching every attack at a mean false-alarm rate of 12%, and from 97% to 52% on ASEval, at costs in benign non-refusal of 8% and 0%, respectively. On MT-AgentRisk, it outperforms ToolShield, the state-of-the-art multi-turn defense, on all six models: under the same protocol, ToolShield reaches only 55%. Denoising is critical: on ASEval, the undenoised monitor catches only 7%-40% of attacks, while the denoised monitor catches 60%-85%. The same monitor covers single-turn indirect injection without modification and adds only 0.14-0.56 s overhead per monitored step without requiring an auxiliary model, making it a lightweight complement to computation-heavy speculative defenses.

AI.tldr: 多轮攻击通过组合看似无害的操作造成有害后果，挑战了孤立评估动作或状态的防御机制。本文发现此类攻击会在代理的内部表示中留下可检测的痕迹：有害行为表现为上下文更新中累积的表示转移，且触发上下文可从同一信号中识别。为应对良性表示漂移带来的干扰，提出去噪方法，将良性流量锚定在零点并去除其主要变化方向，实现零运行时成本。基于此，提出DART框架，可在运行时检测和归因表示变化，并通过针对性提醒进行干预。在六个模型和两个多轮基准测试中，DART将攻击成功率从84%降至25%（MT-AgentRisk），误报率12%；在ASEval上从97%降至52%，良性拒绝成本分别为8%和0%。DART优于现有最佳防御ToolShield，且去噪至关重要——未去噪监测仅捕获7%-40%攻击，而去噪后达60%-85%。该监控器无需修改即可覆盖单轮间接注入，每步额外开销仅0.14-0.56秒，不依赖辅助模型，是计算密集型推测防御的轻量级补充。
AI.motivation: 多轮攻击能将多个看似合法的动作组合成有害结果，传统防御因孤立评估动作或状态而难以应对。需要一种能够捕捉累积性、隐蔽性危害的检测机制。
AI.method: 识别攻击在代理内部表示中的累积转移特征，提出去噪策略以分离良性漂移与恶意变化，构建DART框架，通过运行时检测表示变化并施加针对性提醒进行干预。
AI.result: 在六种模型和两个多轮基准测试中，DART显著降低攻击成功率（如从84%降至25%），误报率低（12%），且优于现有最优防御（ToolShield）；去噪机制对性能提升至关重要，未去噪时仅能捕获少数攻击；系统具备低延迟（0.14-0.56秒/步）、无需额外模型等优势。
AI.conclusion: DART通过检测和去噪表示转移，有效识别并防御多轮攻击，具有高精度、低开销和强泛化能力，是现有复杂防御的有效轻量级补充。

title: Two Clocks in Diffusion MLLMs: When Answers Stabilize Before Rationales Unfold
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on BeNTo (Beyond Next-Token Prediction - Diffusion & Flow Models for Next-Generation Decoding)
summary: An answer candidate in a masked diffusion MLLM can stabilize while its rationale is still unfolding. We distinguish retrospective stabilization of the logged candidate from token commitment, and examine these two clocks relative to rationale generation. Analyzing our results across three visual question-answering benchmarks, we find that 89.4-98.1% of the rationale-side canvas remains unwritten at stabilization in single-block, EOS-suppressed LaViDa runs. On V*Bench, reducing block length from 128 to 8 changes this fraction from 89.4% to 1.7%, together with answer coverage and the eligible observation window. Under EOS-enabled prompting, direct instructions improve Nemotron's overall accuracy by 15.0 and 19.5 percentage points on M3CoT and ScienceQA, but reduce LaViDa/V*Bench accuracy by 11.0 points. A symmetric decomposition associates the larger absolute component of each change with coverage rather than conditional accuracy. Matched-canvas image ablations measure visual sensitivity alongside answer stabilization, separating the two temporal readouts. Together, these measurements distinguish answer stabilization, rationale unfolding, and visual sensitivity, and identify coverage as the larger component of the prompting differences.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在掩码扩散多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中，答案候选的稳定与推理过程之间的关系。通过分析三个视觉问答基准测试，发现答案在单块、终止符抑制的LaViDa运行中，其推理部分仍有89.4%-98.1%未完成时已稳定。当块长度从128减少到8时，该比例降至1.7%，同时影响答案覆盖率和可观察窗口。在启用终止符的提示下，直接指令提升了Nemotron在M3CoT和ScienceQA上的准确率，但降低了LaViDa/V*Bench的准确率。对称分解表明，变化的主要成分是覆盖率而非条件准确率。匹配画布的图像消融实验分离了视觉敏感性与答案稳定的时间读数，揭示了答案稳定、推理展开和视觉敏感性的差异，并确认覆盖率是提示差异中的主导因素。
AI.motivation: 探究多模态大语言模型中答案稳定与推理生成之间的时序关系，理解不同提示策略对模型表现的影响机制，特别是覆盖率与条件准确率的相对贡献。
AI.method: 通过分析三种视觉问答基准测试中的模型输出，对比不同块长度、终止符启用与否下的答案稳定时间点与推理完成程度；使用对称分解量化提示策略变化对准确率的影响来源；结合图像消融实验分离视觉敏感性与答案稳定性的时序特征。
AI.result: 在单块、终止符抑制的设置下，答案稳定时推理部分仍有超过89%未完成；缩短块长度显著提升推理完成度；直接指令虽提升部分数据集准确率，但降低另一些数据集表现；覆盖范围是提示差异中主要影响因素；视觉敏感性与答案稳定性可被有效分离。
AI.conclusion: 答案稳定与推理生成存在显著时间差，覆盖率是提示策略差异的主要决定因素，而视觉敏感性与答案稳定性可独立建模，为优化多模态推理提供了新的分析框架。

title: ABDA-NL: A Natural-Language Scenario Explorer for Argument-Based Reasoning
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Extended version of a demonstration abstract in the Proceedings of COMMA 2026. Code at https://github.com/idaks/ABDA-NL and live demo at https://demo.abda-nl.org
summary: ABDA-NL adds a natural-language interface to ABDA, a system for argument-based discussion using ASPIC- knowledge bases under grounded semantics. Users see which conclusions are accepted, rejected, or undecided, open an interactive rendering of the grounded discussion game to learn why, explore what-if alternatives by suspending assumptions and rules or changing preferences, ask questions that are answered from a scenario's reference documents, and author new facts, assumptions, and rules in plain English. A large language model provides the bridge between language and formalism: it answers questions from the documents and the current state of the scenario, and it translates plain-English edits into candidate formal statements. The deterministic ABDA engine remains the sole source of arguments, attacks, and acceptance labels, and every proposal of the model is validated and confirmed by the user before it takes effect.

AI.tldr: ABDA-NL integrates a natural-language interface with ABDA, enabling users to interact with argument-based discussions using plain English. It leverages a large language model to translate user inputs into formal statements and answer questions from reference documents, while maintaining a deterministic engine for argument validation. All LLM-generated proposals are confirmed by the user before implementation.
AI.motivation: To make argument-based discussion systems more accessible and interactive by allowing users to engage via natural language, without compromising formal correctness and reliability.
AI.method: A large language model serves as a bridge between natural language and formal logic, translating user inputs and answering queries, while the deterministic ABDA engine ensures accurate argument generation and acceptance status. User input is validated before any changes take effect.
AI.result: Users can explore, modify, and query argumentation scenarios in plain English, gaining insights into accepted, rejected, or undecided conclusions, and experiment with 'what-if' scenarios through safe, user-confirmed edits.
AI.conclusion: ABDA-NL successfully combines natural language interaction with formal argumentation, enhancing usability while preserving the integrity of the underlying logical framework.

title: Probe with Participation Trophies: Random-Reward RL as a Probe of LLM Capability
summary: We connect the spurious-reward paradox to a model's reachability and propose random-reward reinforcement learning (RL) as a useful tool for the probing enterprise, addressing a decade-long debate over what probing performance actually reveals about a model. There are two prevailing explanations for the surprising finding that even random rewards can improve the performance of large language models (LLMs): one attributes the gains to particular mechanisms within RL training; the other to data contamination. Our results motivate a different view: spurious-reward RL can probe a model's reachability, or what further training can attain from its current state under specified constraints, beyond what is reflected in its current performance. Two OLMo checkpoints with the same accuracy on synthetic arithmetic (3.5%), for example, reach 8.5% and 55% in their best runs under the same correctness-rewarded RL. Examining OLMo checkpoints across pre-training and mid-training reveals three distinct regimes of training response: early on, RL produces little improvement even when correct answers are rewarded; later in pre-training, rewarding correct answers becomes effective while random rewards remain weak; and, upon entering mid-training, even random rewards can produce large gains. A similar ordering appears in a number-masked supervised fine-tuning (SFT) analysis of these checkpoints, suggesting that the pattern is not specific to a particular RL mechanism. Moreover, RL with random rewards offers a distinctive perspective on what training can make an LLM do, since its reward signal supplies no information about which answers are correct. By asking what training can attain without correctness feedback, it addresses the label-leakage side of a central problem in decodability-based probing: whether a successful probe reveals the model's capabilities or learns the task itself.

AI.tldr: 本文将虚假奖励悖论与模型的可达性联系起来，提出随机奖励强化学习（RL）作为探测大语言模型能力的有效工具，解决了关于探针性能揭示模型本质长达十年的争议。研究发现，即使随机奖励也能提升大语言模型性能，其原因并非特定训练机制或数据污染，而是反映了模型在当前状态下通过训练所能达到的潜力。实验显示，两个准确率相同的OLMo检查点在相同正确性奖励下分别达到8.5%和55%的性能提升，表明其可达性差异显著。不同训练阶段的响应模式分为三个阶段：早期无改善，中期正确奖励有效，后期随机奖励亦能带来大幅提升。该现象在掩码监督微调中也得到验证，说明其不依赖特定RL机制。随机奖励提供了一种独特视角：在无正确性反馈的情况下，揭示训练能使模型实现什么，从而区分模型能力与任务学习本身，解决解码探测中的标签泄露问题。
AI.motivation: 解决长期以来关于探针性能是否真正反映模型能力的争议，澄清随机奖励为何能提升大语言模型表现，并探索其背后机制是否源于特定训练过程或数据污染。
AI.method: 采用随机奖励强化学习（RL），对比不同训练阶段的OLMo模型在正确性奖励与随机奖励下的表现，分析其性能提升差异；结合掩码监督微调（SFT）进行交叉验证，考察不同训练阶段对奖励信号的响应变化，进而评估模型的可达性。
AI.result: 两个初始准确率相同的OLMo检查点在相同正确性奖励下分别达到8.5%和55%的性能提升，显示显著可达性差异；训练过程中存在三个阶段：早期无改善、中期正确奖励有效、后期随机奖励亦可显著提升性能；该模式在掩码SFT中重现，表明非特定于某类RL机制。
AI.conclusion: 随机奖励强化学习能够有效探测大语言模型的可达性，即在特定约束下通过进一步训练所能达到的上限，而非单纯反映当前性能。其核心价值在于提供无正确性反馈的训练视角，有助于区分模型真实能力与任务学习，为解码探测中的标签泄露问题提供新思路。

title: The Conflict Between Logic and Memory: Learning Higher-Order Interactions in Shallow MLPs
summary: A network can fit its training examples while failing to recover the rule that generated their labels. We examine this separation in single-hidden-layer multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), using synthetic tasks that control interaction order and the presence of nuisance inputs. We establish elementary benchmark properties: pure parity contains no predictive lower-order marginals, admits an exact Bayes posterior, and can be represented on clean latent inputs by a width-$k$ ReLU network. Experiments then identify distinct optimization outcomes. In a matched order-2--4 sweep, SGD, Adam, and Muon all reach 100\% peak test accuracy at order two; at order three they reach 96.25\%, 50.87\%, and 76.82\%, respectively, while Muon reaches 99.21\% at order four. In a separate mixed-order task, freezing only the first-layer weights connected to independent nuisance inputs raises AdamW's epoch-10 accuracy from 44.73\% to 95.07\%. Removing the same inputs only at test time raises it to 48.38\%. Thus, nuisance-weight learning changes the training outcome beyond its immediate effect on prediction. Bias interventions expose a connection between target symmetry and shallow ReLU representations. In a compact signal-only regime, both SGD and Muon learn orders five through eight, with higher SGD peak accuracy at orders nine through eleven. Together, the results show how optimization and nuisance learning constrain the higher-order rules realized by a shallow network.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了单隐层多层感知机（MLP）在训练样本拟合与真实标签生成规则恢复之间的分离现象，通过合成任务控制交互顺序和干扰输入的影响。研究表明，纯奇偶性任务无预测性的低阶边缘分布，可由宽度为k的ReLU网络在干净潜在输入上精确表示。实验发现不同优化算法在不同阶次任务中的表现差异显著：在匹配的2-4阶扫描中，SGD、Adam和Muon在二阶时均达到100%测试准确率，但在三阶分别降至96.25%、50.87%和76.82%，而Muon在四阶达到99.21%。在混合阶次任务中，仅冻结与独立干扰输入相连的第一层权重，可使AdamW的第10轮准确率从44.73%提升至95.07%；仅在测试时移除这些输入则提升至48.38%。这表明干扰权重的学习不仅影响预测，还深刻改变训练结果。偏置干预揭示了目标对称性与浅层ReLU表示之间的联系。在仅含信号的紧凑区域中，SGD和Muon均可学习五到八阶规则，且在九到十一阶时SGD峰值准确率更高。整体结果表明，优化过程与干扰学习共同制约浅层网络实现的高阶规则。
AI.motivation: 探究深度学习模型在拟合训练数据的同时是否能有效捕捉生成标签的真实规则，特别是在存在干扰输入和复杂交互结构的情况下，理解优化算法如何影响模型对高阶规则的建模能力。
AI.method: 使用合成任务控制交互顺序和干扰输入，构建纯奇偶性等基准任务，分析其在单隐层多层感知机中的表示能力；通过多种优化算法（如SGD、Adam、Muon、AdamW）进行训练，并在不同阶次任务中评估性能；采用权重冻结、输入移除等干预手段观察对训练结果的影响；结合偏置干预探索目标对称性与网络表示之间的关系。
AI.result: 在匹配阶次任务中，不同优化器表现差异明显：二阶时所有算法均达100%准确率，三阶时性能下降，其中Adam表现最差，Muon在四阶仍保持高准确率。在混合阶次任务中，冻结特定第一层权重可显著提升性能（如AdamW从44.73%升至95.07%），而仅测试时移除干扰输入效果有限。偏置干预显示，在信号主导条件下，SGD和Muon能学习高阶规则，且在某些阶次下SGD表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 优化算法和干扰学习共同决定了浅层神经网络对高阶规则的实现能力。即使模型能完美拟合训练数据，其对真实生成规则的捕捉仍受优化路径和干扰因素的深刻影响。这一发现强调了在设计学习系统时需考虑优化动态与结构约束的重要性。

title: Video-Index: A Curated Meta-Benchmark for Video Understanding
summary: A video benchmark should reward the capability it claims to measure, yet models can exploit answer options, question text, or partial visual evidence. We introduce the attack pyramid, five levels of shortcut attacks with increasing access to each item, and audit 115 video benchmarks with it. On 35 benchmarks, attackers that never see a frame approach full-video accuracy. On 51 benchmarks with temporal probes, shuffled frames keep a median 96% of full-video accuracy. Near-duplicate questions make up at least half the items in 63 benchmarks. We screen 505,518 question-answer pairs from 112 of them into an audited pool. Agents turn evaluation requests into specifications, and a deterministic selector with a red-team gate composes reproducible benchmarks. We release Video-Index, the 210 hardest verified items under these attacks in each of four capability groups, 840 items from 76 sources. With the same fixed input, Claude Opus 5 outscores every open-source model by over 37 percentage points, and agent tools add about 20 more, yet all systems leave room to improve efficiency and accuracy. Blog: https://www.enxinsong.com/blog/video-index/ GitHub: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/Video-Index Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Video-Index/Video-Index

AI.tldr: 提出视频基准攻击金字塔，审计115个视频基准，发现模型可利用答案选项、问题文本或部分视觉证据获得高分；35个基准中，未见任何帧的攻击者仍达全视频准确率；51个含时间探针的基准在帧顺序打乱后仍保持96%中位准确率；近似重复问题占63个基准至少一半；构建包含505,518对问答的审计池，设计可复现基准流程，发布Video-Index数据集，涵盖840个来自76个来源的210个最难验证项，显示Claude Opus 5在所有开源模型上领先超37个百分点，代理工具再提升约20个百分点，但系统仍有优化空间。
AI.motivation: 现有视频基准存在被模型利用短路策略（如依赖答案选项、问题文本或部分视觉信息）而失真的问题，导致评估结果不能真实反映模型能力，亟需系统性检测和改进评测机制。
AI.method: 提出攻击金字塔，涵盖五级从低到高的短路攻击方式；对115个视频基准进行系统审计；通过筛选50.5万+问答对建立审计池；设计基于代理的规范转换与确定性选择器，结合红队门控实现可复现基准生成。
AI.result: 35个基准中，无帧访问攻击者可达全视频准确率；51个含时间探针的基准在帧打乱后仍保持96%中位准确率；63个基准中近似重复问题占比超半数；发布Video-Index数据集，包含210个最难验证项，覆盖四类能力维度；大模型表现显著优于开源模型，但效率与准确率仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 当前多数视频基准易受短路攻击，评估结果不可靠；通过攻击审计与可复现基准构建方法，可有效识别并缓解此类问题；发布Video-Index作为高质量、可信的评测基准，推动更真实、更具挑战性的视频理解研究。

title: PG-SFT: Balancing Capability Acquisition and Retention in Offline Agent Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on offline agent trajectories is the standard approach for training specialized tool-using agents, but forcing models to imitate reasoning and actions token by token may harm other capabilities (e.g., general reasoning, tool calling, code generation) of the base model. In this work, we focus on studying \emph{how to better balance the trade-off between acquiring new capabilities and preserving existing ones during agent trace SFT}. By comparing several baselines in our setup, standard SFT improves the target benchmark while lowering several non-target benchmark scores; meanwhile, simply constraining distributional drift using KL penalty or limiting the update magnitude did not avoid this regression trend. Motivated by recent token-wise adaptive learning objectives, this work proposes \textbf{Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)} to leverage turn-level information gain of agent trajectories as an indicator to adjust supervision strength. PG-SFT yields a more favorable observed trade-off on the evaluated benchmarks, substantially reducing distributional drift and broad capability degradation at the cost of slight degradation in target-task performance. Our findings suggest that balancing the acquisition--retention trade-off depends not only on whether the model is anchored to its base behavior, but also on where and how strongly supervision should depart from that behavior.}

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在基于离线智能体轨迹的监督微调（SFT）中更好地平衡获取新能力与保留原有能力之间的权衡。标准SFT虽提升目标任务表现，但导致其他能力下降；单纯使用KL惩罚或限制更新幅度未能缓解此问题。为此，提出Privilege-Guided SFT（PG-SFT），利用智能体轨迹的回合级信息增益作为指标动态调整监督强度，有效减少分布漂移和泛化能力退化，仅轻微牺牲目标性能，表明监督应不仅关注锚定基础行为，还需合理控制偏离程度与位置。
AI.motivation: 标准监督微调（SFT）在训练工具使用智能体时，强制模型逐令牌模仿推理与动作，可能损害基模型的通用推理、工具调用和代码生成等原有能力，亟需更优的平衡策略。
AI.method: 提出Privilege-Guided SFT（PG-SFT），通过评估智能体轨迹中每一轮的信息增益，动态调节监督强度，以实现对新能力学习与旧能力保留之间的更好权衡。
AI.result: PG-SFT在多个基准测试上表现出更优的权衡效果，显著降低分布漂移和广泛能力退化，仅带来轻微的目标任务性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 平衡新能力获取与旧能力保留不仅依赖于是否锚定基模型行为，还取决于监督偏离该行为的时机与强度，信息增益驱动的自适应监督是有效解决方案。

title: Precision over Scale: A Polish-Silesian Benchmark and a Translation System Outperforming Open-Source and Commercial Models
summary: Dialectal machine translation remains challenging due to limited data and strong linguistic variation not captured by standard benchmarks, which often assume standardized and well-edited text. We study Polish-Silesian MT using neural and rule-based systems, evaluating on SiLTT - a new Pol-Szl testset, alongside established BOUQuET and FLORES benchmarks. Results show our rule-based system is consistently strongest on SiLTT and BOUQuET datasets and that TranslateGemma fine-tuned on a curated dataset improves over strong neural baselines but does not surpass the rule-based system in dialectal settings. We release SiLTT and our best neural model to support further research.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了波兰语-西里西亚语机器翻译的挑战，使用神经和基于规则的系统在新构建的SiLTT测试集及现有BOUQuET和FLORES基准上进行评估。结果表明，基于规则的系统在方言数据上表现更优，而微调后的TranslateGemma虽优于其他神经模型，但仍未超越规则系统。研究公开了SiLTT数据集和最佳神经模型以促进后续研究。
AI.motivation: 方言机器翻译面临数据稀缺和语言差异强烈的问题，现有基准多基于标准、编辑良好的文本，无法充分反映真实方言特征。因此需要针对方言建立更合适的评估框架和方法。
AI.method: 采用神经网络与基于规则的系统进行波兰语-西里西亚语翻译，利用新构建的SiLTT测试集以及现有的BOUQuET和FLORES基准进行评估，并对TranslateGemma模型进行领域特定数据微调。
AI.result: 基于规则的系统在SiLTT和BOUQuET数据集上表现最优；微调后的TranslateGemma优于其他神经基线模型，但在方言场景下仍不及规则系统。
AI.conclusion: 在处理方言文本时，基于规则的方法目前仍优于神经方法，尽管神经模型有改进空间。研究发布的SiLTT数据集和模型将有助于推动方言机器翻译领域的进一步研究。

title: RACE: Residual-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Neighbor-Rich Time-Series Foundation Model Forecasting
comment: 25 pages including references and appendices; 8 figures
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) perform strongly across forecasting tasks, but their per-series inference is ill-suited to neighbor-rich forecasting, where each query has access to related but nonidentical historical series. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) and Web/cloud workloads exemplify this setting: CGM trajectories share physiological patterns but vary across individuals, devices, and conditions, while Web/cloud workloads combine common operating regimes with non-stationarity, heavy tails, and bursts. These histories share useful structure, yet neighbors are not equally relevant. Existing methods either fine-tune TSFMs for each target domain, incurring additional costs and offering limited transferability across backbones, or append retrieved series without verifying whether they support the current forecast. The key challenges are conflicting residual evidence from neighboring series and residual patterns that vary across TSFMs and forecasting tasks. We formulate test-time neighborhood scaling: using same-domain neighbor evidence without modifying the backbone. We propose RACE (Residual-Aware Correction of Forecasting Errors), a two-stage framework for using historical neighbors. We first retrieve query-compatible neighbors, align their residuals to the query scale, and aggregate coherent evidence into the training-free RACE-TF correction. Full RACE then uses a lightweight, domain-specific Gate to determine when applying the correction is beneficial, with a reusable training workflow across TSFM backbones. Across four TSFMs, RACE improves all three domain-aggregate metrics on both primary domains, with the largest gains on high-error queries. Within each domain, a Gate trained on one TSFM transfers to other backbones without adaptation, and the resulting pipeline improves all 72 cross-backbone metric comparisons over the matched frozen targets.

AI.tldr: RACE 是一种无需训练的两阶段框架，用于在测试时利用相关历史序列提升时间序列预测性能。它通过检索与查询兼容的邻居序列，对残差进行对齐并聚合一致信息，生成无须微调的校正项（RACE-TF），再通过轻量级门控机制决定是否应用该校正，实现跨模型、跨任务的高效迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理邻近丰富的预测场景时存在局限：要么需为每个目标领域微调模型，成本高且泛化性差；要么简单拼接邻居序列而不验证其有效性。核心挑战在于邻居间残差证据冲突以及残差模式随模型和任务变化。因此需要一种不修改主干网络、能有效利用相关历史序列的方法。
AI.method: 提出测试时邻域缩放策略，设计 RACE 框架：第一阶段检索兼容邻居，对齐残差并聚合形成 RACE-TF 校正；第二阶段引入可复用的轻量级门控模块（Gate），动态判断是否应用校正，支持跨不同时间序列基础模型的通用训练流程。
AI.result: 在四种时间序列基础模型上，RACE 在两个主要领域均提升了所有三个综合评估指标，尤其在高误差查询中表现更优。同一领域内训练的门控模块可直接迁移到其他模型而无需调整，在72次跨模型对比中均优于冻结的基准模型。
AI.conclusion: RACE 通过无训练的邻域残差感知校正，实现了高效、可迁移的测试时知识增强，显著提升时间序列预测在复杂邻近环境下的性能，且适用于多种主流模型架构。

title: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built on ScanNet++ with VLMs and LLMs, enabling scalable training data generation for this new task.

AI.tldr: 提出RelationVGGT框架，实现无需场景优化和已知相机位姿的多视角3D空间关系分割，结合视觉与几何基础模型，通过关系变换器进行受主体条件约束的跨视图关系预测，并构建自动化标注流程以支持大规模训练数据生成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法局限于物体中心感知，忽视物体间的空间关系；亟需一种无需依赖场景优化和相机位姿的端到端、可扩展的空间关系理解方法。
AI.method: 采用视觉基础模型提取语义特征，3D几何基础模型生成几何感知表示，结合关系变换器实现跨视图、受主体条件约束的关系预测，引入全自动标注管道基于ScanNet++与VLMs/LLMs生成大规模训练数据。
AI.result: 在多视角3D空间关系分割任务中表现出色，无需每场景优化或已知相机姿态，具备良好的泛化能力与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: RelationVGGT成功实现了无监督、端到端的3D空间关系分割，为视觉-几何联合建模提供了新范式，推动了从物体感知向空间关系理解的演进。

title: Cybernetic and Epistemic: A Missing Vocabulary for Trustworthy Agentic Delegation
comment: Accepted at TAS 2026 (AAAI Fall Symposium Series), Nov 5-7, 2026, Arlington VA
summary: As code generation is increasingly delegated to AI systems, the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to supervising the systems that write it --- a shift CS-education researchers have begun to name. This shift exposes a vocabulary gap: the field asks for "human oversight" without a working distinction between the two things language does in a delegation channel --- coordinate action (cybernetic: words succeed when the world comes to match them) and coordinate understanding (epistemic: they succeed when they answer to the world and a hearer can check that they do). The failure this names is not cybernetic language but epistemic-form language doing cybernetic work: explanation-shaped output calibrated for approval rather than truth. Oversight that checks only whether an output was approved is satisfiable by rubber-stamping; oversight that holds an agent accountable requires the reasoning behind its work be retrievable and checkable. We present three delegation episodes --- illustrations, not controlled evidence --- in which epistemic engagement proved practicable while remaining auditable, one public record where a recommendation was withdrawn on its own stated terms, and one failure case illustrating oversight that requires no reasons for its discretionary choices. We propose a criterion for agentic-system governance, alongside existing technical trust properties: every consequential choice should carry the condition under which it would have gone otherwise, in a form a third party can test. Without such a condition, a third party cannot distinguish a decision from a rubber stamp. We give the criterion an operational form --- a two-part reconstruction test scoring a delegation record by whether a second reader can predict what the agent does under a perturbation --- and a deliberation-recording convention, ORRCF, that makes the condition a required component of every recorded choice.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在代码生成由AI系统承担的背景下，人类监督面临的挑战，指出当前缺乏对语言在委托过程中两种功能（协调行动与协调理解）的清晰区分。作者批评了以‘批准’为导向的解释性输出，并提出应确保决策背后的推理可追溯、可验证。通过三个案例分析，展示了具备可审计性的元认知监督实践，提出了一个治理准则：每个重要决策都必须包含可被第三方检验的‘若条件’（即在何种情况下会做出不同选择），并设计了名为ORRCF的记录规范和两部分重构测试来实现这一标准。
AI.motivation: 随着代码生成任务越来越多地由AI完成，监督者面临的新挑战是判断AI输出是否真正合理，而不仅仅是符合预期。当前的‘人类监督’概念模糊，未能区分语言在协调行动（如指令执行）与协调理解（如解释合理性）中的不同作用。尤其问题在于，许多AI输出虽看似正确，实则仅为迎合审查者偏好而生成的‘解释性伪装’，这使得监督流于形式，无法真正问责。因此需要建立一种能保证推理过程透明、可核查的监督机制。
AI.method: 本文采用案例研究法，分析三组实际发生的委托场景，包括一次公开撤回建议的事件和一个监督失败的案例，用以说明理想与现实之间的差距。在此基础上，提出一个形式化的治理标准——每个关键决策必须包含可被外部验证的‘若条件’（counterfactual condition），即在什么条件下该决策会改变。同时设计了一种名为ORRCF（Deliberation-Recording Convention）的记录规范，强制要求将这些条件纳入正式记录；并提出‘重构测试’作为评估标准，衡量第二个读者能否根据记录预测代理在扰动情境下的行为。
AI.result: 研究表明，在某些实践中，通过明确记录决策背后的推理和条件，可以实现既有效又可审计的监督。其中一例成功案例中，推荐意见因自身标准被撤回，显示了制度化反思的可能性；另一例则揭示了缺乏理由支持的随意决策如何导致问责失效。通过引入ORRCF与重构测试，系统能够识别出‘橡皮图章式’决策，从而提升对代理系统的可信度和责任性。
AI.conclusion: 为了实现真正的智能系统治理，仅依赖技术上的可靠性是不够的，还必须建立可检验的推理链条。本文提出的‘若条件’原则及其配套记录与测试机制，为构建可审计、可问责的代理系统提供了可行路径。未来智能系统的开发与应用，需将透明决策逻辑作为基本要求，而非附加功能。

title: AgSpec: Pushing the Limits of Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding in Coding Agent Pipelines
summary: Retrieval-based speculative decoding (SD) drafts tokens by copying continuations from existing text, which suits coding agents that repeatedly reproduce code, logs, and earlier attempts. Yet existing methods fall short in agent pipelines: much of the reusable text is missing from their corpora or stored in a form that differs from what the agent emits, and their draft lengths ignore that accept length varies across agents and drifts over turns. We present AgSpec, a framework that supplies the corpus and draft-length policies that existing retrieval engines lack in coding-agent pipelines. AgSpec retrieves from session, workspace, and global corpora, retaining the ongoing session trajectory and indexing opened files in the agent's emission format. It bounds each agent's draft length with an offline-profiled cap and adapts the length online from verification feedback. On two repository-level multi-agent coding benchmarks, AgSpec outperforms five retrieval-based drafters and EAGLE-3 in most evaluated settings, raising generation throughput over autoregressive decoding up to 4.37$\times$ at batch size 1 and 4.76$\times$ at batch size 16. AgSpec also remains effective on benchmarks without a repository or a multi-agent pipeline, showing that its gains generalize to coding agents broadly.

AI.tldr: AgSpec 是一个针对编码代理流水线的检索式推测解码框架，通过从会话、工作区和全局语料库中检索，并保留会话轨迹和以代理输出格式索引打开文件，解决了现有方法在可重用文本缺失或格式不匹配的问题。它采用离线配置的上限和在线反馈自适应调整草稿长度，在多个多代理编码基准测试中优于五种基于检索的草稿生成器和 EAGLE-3，生成吞吐量相比自回归解码提升最高达 4.37×（批量大小为1）和 4.76×（批量大小为16），且其优势在单代理和非仓库场景中也成立，表明其具有广泛适用性。
AI.motivation: 现有检索式推测解码方法在编码代理流水线中表现不佳，主要因为可重用文本未被充分包含在语料库中，或存储形式与代理输出不一致；同时，草稿长度固定，无法适应不同代理的接受长度差异及随对话轮次的变化。
AI.method: AgSpec 从会话、工作区和全局语料库中检索，保留会话轨迹并以代理输出格式索引文件；使用离线预估的草稿长度上限，并根据验证反馈在线动态调整长度。
AI.result: 在两个仓库级多代理编码基准上，AgSpec 超过五种检索式草稿生成器和 EAGLE-3，在多数设置下显著提升生成吞吐量，最高达自回归解码的 4.37×（批量大小1）和 4.76×（批量大小16）；其性能在无仓库或单代理任务中同样有效，说明其通用性强。
AI.conclusion: AgSpec 有效解决了编码代理流水线中检索式推测解码的关键瓶颈，通过智能语料选择和动态草稿长度控制，显著提升生成效率，并具备广泛的适用性。

title: VANDAM: Viewing a nucleotide sequence with DNA molecular priors
summary: Contemporary Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) rely on a DNA-as-a-string paradigm that employs masked token prediction objectives for pretraining. However, this abstraction does not explicitly model the biochemical, structural, and physical properties essential to biological function. Many molecular properties can be estimated from sequence using established biophysical models, so their utility lies not in providing an independent modality, but in introducing priors that training objectives can explicitly exploit. We introduce VANDAM, a framework that extends the training of GFMs with DNA molecular priors. In self-supervised training, VANDAM predicts regional molecular properties from pooled representations. When functional labels are available and can reward retaining molecular priors, local features are additionally injected at the input. VANDAM consistently improves downstream performance across four architecture families and nine held-out genomic tasks by complementing token-based objectives. Probing experiments further demonstrate that the use of molecular priors generalizes to other unseen molecular properties.

AI.tldr: VANDAM 是一种扩展基因组基础模型（GFMs）训练的新框架，通过引入DNA分子先验信息来改进基于序列的预训练方法。它在自监督学习中预测区域分子特性，并在有功能标签时将局部特征注入输入，从而提升下游任务表现。该方法在四种架构和九个基因组任务上均取得一致改进，且能泛化到未见的分子属性。
AI.motivation: 现有基因组基础模型依赖于将DNA视为字符串的抽象方式，忽略了生物化学、结构和物理特性对生物功能的重要性。虽然分子性质可通过生物物理模型从序列推断，但其价值在于为训练目标提供可利用的先验知识。因此，需要一种新方法将这些先验显式融入模型训练中。
AI.method: VANDAM 通过自监督学习预测从池化表示中提取的区域分子属性；当存在功能标签时，额外将局部分子特征注入输入层，以增强模型对功能性特征的学习能力。该方法与多种架构兼容，支持端到端训练。
AI.result: VANDAM 在四个不同架构家族和九个独立基因组任务上均显著提升下游性能。探针实验表明，分子先验不仅有助于已知任务，还能推广至未见过的分子属性预测，显示出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入分子先验，VANDAM 能有效补充传统基于令牌的预训练目标，使基因组基础模型更全面地捕捉序列与功能之间的复杂关系，为下一代基因组模型设计提供了新范式。

title: Concept Driven Domain Adaptation: Finding an Abstract Needle in a Haystack
summary: Science teachers frequently search for documentary excerpts not by describing what appears on screen, but by querying the abstract concepts they intend to teach. This use case exposes a limitation of existing language-based video moment retrieval methods, which typically assume that queries describe observable events, whereas instructional search requires retrieving concrete visual phenomena that instantiate an underlying scientific principle. We study this setting as concept-to-example video retrieval, an abstract-needle-in-a-haystack problem where compact curriculum concepts must be grounded in temporally sparse documentary evidence. To bridge this abstraction gap, we propose Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation (CDDA), a three-stage framework for adapting two-tower vision-language models to concept-level retrieval. CDDA treats concepts as intermediate semantic anchors: it first structures the textual embedding space with textbook and teacher-handbook example-concept pairs, then transfers this concept-aware geometry to documentary visuals under a frozen visual encoder, and finally jointly adapts both encoders with sparse visual concept supervision. From a geometric perspective, this staged alignment reduces text-concept and vision-concept angular gaps, thereby encouraging concept-level adaptation while preserving the pretrained model's concrete image description alignment. On a curated middle-school physics retrieval benchmark, CDDA achieves stronger pedagogically oriented concept retrieval than several competitive multimodal baselines, including Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, while maintaining concrete image-text matching after adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究科学教师在教学中通过抽象概念而非具体画面描述来搜索纪录片片段的挑战，提出一种名为概念驱动的领域适应（CDDA）的三阶段框架，用于将双塔视觉-语言模型适配到概念级视频检索任务。该方法以概念为语义锚点，分步对齐文本与视觉空间中的概念表示，有效缩小文本-概念和视觉-概念之间的角度差距，从而在保持原有图像描述匹配能力的同时，显著提升对教学相关概念的检索性能。在中学物理检索基准上，CDDA优于多个先进多模态基线模型，如Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B。
AI.motivation: 科学教师常依据抽象教学概念而非具体画面来搜索纪录片内容，但现有基于语言的视频片段检索方法通常假设查询描述可观察事件，无法有效支持以概念为中心的教学检索需求，因此亟需一种能够将抽象概念与稀疏的视觉证据相连接的方法。
AI.method: 提出概念驱动的领域适应（CDDA）框架，包含三个阶段：(1) 利用教科书和教师手册中的示例-概念配对构建文本嵌入空间的概念结构；(2) 在冻结视觉编码器的前提下，将此概念感知的几何结构迁移至纪录片视觉内容；(3) 通过稀疏视觉概念标注联合微调双塔编码器，实现端到端的概念对齐。
AI.result: 在自建的中学物理概念检索基准上，CDDA在概念级检索任务中表现优于多个先进多模态模型（包括Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B），同时保持了原始模型在具体图像-文本匹配方面的性能，证明其在抽象概念与具体视觉证据之间建立有效关联的能力。
AI.conclusion: CDDA通过分阶段的概念对齐机制，成功解决了抽象概念与稀疏视觉证据之间的语义鸿沟问题，在教育场景下实现了更符合教学需求的视频检索效果，为智能教学资源推荐提供了新范式。

title: VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: As LLM agents undertake increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks, verifying their outputs becomes increasingly challenging. We study how verification capability can be strengthened with a fixed base model, without access to reference answers or grading rubrics at test time. Repeated sampling yields multiple rollouts that can contain complementary correct claims, but we need a reliable verification mechanism to determine which claims to trust. We first find that disagreement often exposes correct alternatives, while consensus can conceal errors. These observations motivate VeriHarness, which turns the underlying LLM a generator uses into an agentic verifier by giving it a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills. A disagreement resolver checks competing claims against environmental evidence, while a consensus challenger tests shared claims and searches for omitted requirements. Their findings guide the selection and revision of the final artifact. Across five long-horizon workspace benchmarks and two frontier models, VeriHarness achieves the highest selection scores among the evaluated baselines. Evidence-backed revision further improves average performance, bringing gains over a single rollout to 6.2 points with Gemini 3.5 Flash and 6.4 points with Claude Opus 4.8. We further show that verification skills can self-improve from failure feedback, demonstrating VeriHarness as a novel and critical approach for scaling long-horizon agentic verification. We release the full pool of approximately 26,000 rollouts across all five benchmarks and both models, produced at a cost of over $100,000, to support future research on agentic verification.

AI.tldr: VeriHarness 是一种通过利用模型自身能力来增强长周期任务验证的方法，无需参考答案或评分标准。它通过重复采样生成多个推理路径，利用分歧暴露正确选项、共识可能隐藏错误的特性，设计了一个由工作区、证据工具和可复用验证技能构成的代理验证器。该系统包含分歧解决者和共识挑战者，分别用于检查竞争性主张与环境证据的一致性，并测试共同主张中是否遗漏要求。最终结果指导对最终产出的选择与修改。在五个基准测试中，其表现优于现有基线；结合证据支持的修订后，性能提升显著（如 Gemini 3.5 Flash 提升 6.2 分，Claude Opus 4.8 提升 6.4 分）。此外，验证技能可通过失败反馈自我改进，展现出可扩展的验证潜力。研究还公开了约 26,000 条推演数据，总成本超 10 万美元，以支持未来研究。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型代理承担越来越复杂、长期的任务，其输出的验证变得愈发困难。现有方法通常依赖参考答案或评分标准，但在实际应用中难以获取。因此，亟需一种不依赖外部标注信息、能有效识别并修正错误的验证机制，以提升长周期任务的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出 VeriHarness 方法，将基础模型转化为一个具备工作区、证据工具和可复用验证技能的代理验证器。通过重复采样生成多条推理路径，利用分歧检测和共识检验策略，分别由分歧解决者与共识挑战者进行判断，基于环境证据筛选可信主张，并引导最终产物的选择与修订。验证技能还可通过失败反馈迭代优化。
AI.result: 在五个长周期工作空间基准测试和两个前沿模型上，VeriHarness 在选择得分上优于所有对比基线。结合证据支持的修订后，平均性能显著提升：相比单次推演，分别获得 6.2 分（Gemini 3.5 Flash）和 6.4 分（Claude Opus 4.8）的增益。验证技能可从失败中自我改进，证明该方法具有可扩展性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: VeriHarness 提供了一种无需外部参考即可实现高效、可靠长周期任务验证的新范式，能够有效利用模型内部一致性与多样性，通过自主验证与自我改进机制提升输出质量，为构建更可信的智能代理提供了关键支撑。

title: Madeleine: Learning Involuntary Recall for Conversational Memory from Simulated Lives
summary: A long-term conversational assistant must recall the right memory at the right moment, yet the memory that matters most is often not similar to what the user says now. Current systems recover such associations by letting an LLM reason at write or read time, at a cost of hundreds to over a thousand LLM calls per memory bank and up to several thousand context tokens per query. We argue that association is a learnable relevance: the pointwise mutual information of memories under how human lives unfold. We introduce Madeleine, which learns amortized association: offline, an LLM life simulator writes simulated lives, whose cue-trigger pairs teach a query encoder a residual association on top of frozen similarity; online, it calls no LLM and plugs into any vector memory by replacing only the query encoder. On LoCoMo-Plus under the official protocol, Madeleine (I) reaches 66.6 when plugged into HyperMem, the highest among all systems evaluated under this protocol; (II) used alone, reaches the score of HyperMem as released (52.4 vs. 52.9) with zero LLM calls and about 1/21 of its answer context; and (III) lifts T-Mem by 26.2 points, significantly outperforms the same untrained backbone inside both systems, and leaves ordinary QA intact on the 4B backbone.

AI.tldr: Madeleine 是一种学习可压缩关联的系统，通过离线模拟人类生活生成记忆线索-触发对，训练查询编码器在冻结相似性基础上建立残差关联，实现无需调用LLM的在线记忆检索。在LoCoMo-Plus基准上，其性能超越现有方法，显著提升检索效果并大幅降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 当前长时对话助手在记忆召回中面临关键记忆与用户当前话语不相似的问题，现有基于LLM推理的方法成本过高，需要更高效、可扩展的记忆关联机制。
AI.method: 使用LLM生命模拟器离线生成模拟人生数据，构建记忆线索-触发对，训练一个查询编码器以学习点互信息（PMI）层面的关联，该编码器可替代向量记忆系统的查询编码器，无需在线调用LLM。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo-Plus基准上，Madeleine插入HyperMem后达到66.6分，优于所有评估系统；独立使用时达到52.4分（接近原版HyperMem的52.9），且零次调用LLM，上下文仅需约1/21；同时使T-Mem性能提升26.2分，远超未训练基线，并保持普通问答任务表现。
AI.conclusion: Madeleine证明了关联可作为可学习的、可压缩的特征进行建模，显著降低记忆检索的计算成本，同时保持甚至提升性能，为高效长时对话系统提供了新范式。

title: EchoPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Pruning via Virtual Context Reconstruction
summary: KV cache pruning reduces long-context inference memory usage by evicting less important key-value pairs. KVzip estimates importance through context reconstruction: prompting a model to repeat the context chunk by chunk. This achieves strong compression quality at the cost of additional forward passes. Learned approximations reduce this cost but require model-specific training. We analyze how KVzip identifies important cached information and show how to approximate its reconstruction scores using information already computed during prefill. These findings motivate EchoPress, a training-free method that approximates reconstruction attention using queries and keys from standard prefill. For each request, it reconstructs only the first chunk to calibrate importance scores for the remaining context. Experiments on LongBench and RULER with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that EchoPress matches KVzip in task accuracy across eviction ratios from 50% to 90%, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 1.7-19.6 and total prefill time by a factor of up to 2.9. Code is available at https://github.com/ljwljwljwljw/kvpress/tree/echo-press.

AI.tldr: EchoPress 是一种无需训练的 KV 缓存压缩方法，通过利用预填充阶段已计算的信息近似 KVzip 的重建注意力得分，仅需重构首个上下文块即可校准重要性评分。相比 KVzip，EchoPress 在保持相同任务准确率的同时，将压缩开销降低 1.7-19.6 倍，总预填充时间减少最多 2.9 倍。
AI.motivation: KVzip 虽能实现高质量压缩，但因需多次前向传播导致开销大；现有学习型近似方法需针对特定模型训练，灵活性差。本文旨在设计一种无需训练、高效且高精度的替代方案。
AI.method: 分析 KVzip 的重要性评估机制，发现其重建得分可基于预填充阶段已有的查询与键进行近似。提出 EchoPress：仅对首个上下文块执行重建以校准重要性，其余部分通过标准预填充中的查询和键估算重建注意力，实现高效压缩。
AI.result: 在 LongBench 与 RULER 上测试显示，EchoPress 在 50%-90% 的淘汰率下与 KVzip 任务准确率相当，压缩开销下降 1.7-19.6 倍，总预填充时间最多减少 2.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: EchoPress 实现了高性能、低开销的训练-free KV 缓存压缩，为长上下文推理提供了高效解决方案。

title: VIEScore2: Unified Image Evaluation with Spatially Grounded Explanations
summary: Existing synthetic image evaluators typically provide only a scalar quality score and do not identify the image regions that support it. We introduce VIEScore2, a unified evaluator for image generation and editing tasks with optional conditioning images. VIEScore2 represents an image as an N x N grid and jointly predicts quality scores and defect locations in a single model pass. Its text-native grid representation provides a common interface for heterogeneous spatial supervision and enables directly verifiable post-training objectives. We train on 38K examples spanning score-only, localization-only, and joint supervision across generation and editing tasks. Starting from supervised fine-tuning, we further apply GRPO to improve defect localization using rewards that combine cell-level Dice overlap, score accuracy, and output-format validity. A parameter-free parser converts the structured predictions into readable explanations. On the primary suite, VIEScore2 achieves an overall-score SRCC of 0.601, compared with 0.491 for Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest zero-shot general-purpose VLM baseline under matched inputs. For defect localization, VIEScore2 outperforms both general-purpose VLMs and specialized spatial evaluators on three of six benchmarks in per-image grid IoU and ranks among the top three on five, including datasets beyond its training sources.

AI.tldr: VIEScore2 是一个统一的图像生成与编辑任务评估器，可同时预测图像质量分数和缺陷位置。它采用文本原生的网格表示，支持多种空间监督形式，并通过GRPO方法优化缺陷定位。最终模型在质量评分和缺陷定位上均优于现有方法，尤其在多基准测试中表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有合成图像评估工具仅提供单一质量分数，无法定位缺陷区域；需要一种能同时输出质量评分和缺陷位置的统一评估框架。
AI.method: 将图像表示为 N×N 网格，使用文本原生网格结构实现统一接口；基于38K样本进行监督微调，并引入GRPO（Generalized Reward Policy Optimization）提升缺陷定位能力；利用参数无关解析器生成可读解释。
AI.result: 在主要数据集上，整体评分的SRCC达到0.601，显著优于Gemini-3-Flash的0.491；在六项缺陷定位基准中，有三项在每图像网格IoU上领先，五项排名前三，涵盖训练数据之外的领域。
AI.conclusion: VIEScore2 作为首个兼具质量评分与缺陷定位能力的统一评估系统，在生成与编辑任务中表现出卓越性能，且具备可解释性，为图像质量评估提供了新范式。

title: RISED: RubrIcs for agentic multi-environment Selection and sElf-Distillation
summary: Training a single LLM agent jointly across diverse interactive environments has attracted increasing attention as a route to generalist agents. Existing curriculum and data-selection strategies often allocate training at the environment level or prioritize local reward-based signals, without explicitly considering relationships between current rollouts across environments for prompt-group selection. Meanwhile, as environments are learned at different rates, all-failure and all-success rollout groups can coexist within a batch, leaving those data without group-relative reward signals. Both challenges highlight limitations of relying solely on scalar rewards in multi-environment RL: they provide limited information about cross-environment relationships and no within-group reward contrast when rewards are identical. This motivates richer textual feedback, such as rubrics describing rollout behaviours, to guide learning. Beyond rubrics' usage as reward, we repurpose rubrics to guide both online data selection and policy supervision. An LLM judge tags each rollout using a predefined rubric vocabulary shared across environments. The resulting profiles guide the selection of data that aligns with the overall behavioural composition of the mixed-environment batch while limiting overlap with already-selected data. Available positive rubrics (describing desired behaviours) provide privileged context for an on-policy self-distillation teacher, supplying additional token-level supervision, while negative rubrics (describing undesired behaviours) guide subsequent rollout generation away from recurring failure modes. Together, these components form RISED. Across model backbones, RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment. Rubric-based analysis of RISED can further characterize the behavioural changes accompanying these gains.

AI.tldr: RISED introduces a rubric-based framework for training generalist LLM agents across diverse environments, leveraging textual feedback to improve data selection and policy supervision. It uses LLM judges to tag rollouts with rubrics, guiding data selection based on behavioral diversity and enabling self-distillation with positive rubrics while avoiding failure modes via negative ones. RISED outperforms prior methods in pass rates across environments.
AI.motivation: Existing methods rely on scalar rewards that lack cross-environment context and within-group contrast, especially when all-success or all-failure rollouts coexist. This limits effective learning in multi-environment reinforcement learning. The authors aim to enrich feedback beyond scalar rewards by using rubrics—textual descriptions of behavior—to better guide data selection and policy learning.
AI.method: RISED employs an LLM judge to assign rubrics (positive/negative) to rollouts across environments. These rubric profiles inform data selection to maintain diversity and reduce redundancy. Positive rubrics serve as supervisory signals for on-policy self-distillation, while negative rubrics steer future rollouts away from known failure patterns. This creates a feedback loop enhancing both data quality and policy robustness.
AI.result: RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across multiple environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment. Rubric analysis confirms that performance gains are linked to more consistent and desirable behaviors, with reduced repetition of failure modes.
AI.conclusion: Rubric-based feedback significantly improves multi-environment LLM training by enabling richer, more contextualized data selection and policy supervision. RISED demonstrates superior generalization and adaptability, highlighting the value of structured textual feedback in complex interactive settings.

title: Counting and Min-Cost Encoding for Tokenization in Large Language Models
summary: Mainstream large language models rely on a tokenizer to encode text into a token sequence. Different tokenizers may yield token sequences of substantially different lengths for the same text. With a fixed model architecture, shorter token sequences correspond to lower inference time. We propose a tokenizer training approach named Counting and Filtering (CNF) and a text encoding algorithm called Min-Cost Encoding (MCE). MCE defines a cost function over a text segment, and determines the best segmentation by globally minimizing the overall segmentation cost. CNF builds a raw vocabulary by directly counting valid substrings, and then constructs the final vocabulary through a filtering step based on actual token usage when segmenting the training corpus with MCE. The CNF-MCE conbination offers several advantages over BPE, including higher token efficiency, greater scalability, and lower dependency. Across six text categories and two vocabulary-size groups, CNF-MCE consistently achieves better compression than the evaluated BPE tokenizers. With a 250K vocabulary, CNF-MCE increases compression rate by 26% and 30% on English web text over the o200k_base and qwen250k tokenizers. Experiments scaling the vocabulary to 1M entries on English web text demonstrate sustained improvements over BPE, with a token efficiency improvement of over 60% and vocabulary utilization rising from 52.9% to 96.9%. The MCE algorithm does not depend on a merge list (as in BPE) or token probability (as in UnigramLM), making it applicable to a wide range of vocabularies, including those built from BPE, UnigramLM, CNF, and others. Language models trained from scratch at the 1.8B and 8B scales achieve comparable average performance to models using the BPE tokenizers across 11 benchmarks. These results demonstrate that CNF-MCE can improve token efficiency significantly while maintaining competitive downstream performance.

AI.tldr: CNF-MCE是一种新型的分词器训练方法与文本编码算法，通过计数与过滤（CNF）构建词汇表，并结合最小成本编码（MCE）实现全局最优分段，显著提升分词效率。在多种文本类型和词汇量设置下，其压缩率优于传统BPE分词器，最大可提升60%以上，且对不同词汇表具有广泛适用性。基于此训练的语言模型在多个基准测试中表现媲美BPE模型，证明其在保持性能的同时大幅提升效率。
AI.motivation: 现有主流大语言模型依赖分词器将文本转为令牌序列，而不同分词器对相同文本生成的序列长度差异显著。固定架构下，更短的序列意味着更低的推理延迟。因此亟需一种能有效减少令牌数量、提升编码效率的分词方案。
AI.method: 提出Counting and Filtering（CNF）分词器训练方法与Min-Cost Encoding（MCE）编码算法。CNF通过统计有效子串构建原始词汇表，并根据实际使用情况过滤；MCE定义一个成本函数，通过全局最小化总成本来确定最佳文本分段方式。两者结合形成高效、低依赖的分词系统。
AI.result: 在六类文本及两组词汇量下，CNF-MCE均优于对比的BPE分词器。250K词汇量时，英文网络文本压缩率分别提升26%和30%；1M词汇量时，令牌效率提升超60%，词汇利用率从52.9%升至96.9%。MCE不依赖合并列表或概率分布，兼容多种词汇表。1.8B与8B规模模型训练结果表明，其下游性能与使用BPE的模型相当。
AI.conclusion: CNF-MCE显著提升了分词效率，同时保持了与传统方法相当的下游任务性能，具备更高的灵活性、可扩展性和实用性，是替代BPE等传统分词器的有力候选方案。

title: Do Better Scores Mean Better Physics? Physics-Grounded Explanations for Sim2Real Neural Operators
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 XAI4Science Workshop, Tiny Paper Track
summary: Machine-learning surrogates accelerate physical simulation, but lower prediction error need not coincide with lower error in physically relevant flow statistics. We examine this question for flow around a NACA4418 airfoil using paired computational-fluid-dynamics simulations and experimental particle-image-velocimetry measurements. A mean-preserving input intervention removes velocity fluctuations from selected regions of observed flow histories. Across four neural operators, removing fluctuations from the most energetic 10% of valid observed cells changes forecasts more than equal-area random removal. Because the masks are not matched for removed fluctuation energy, this contrast measures sensitivity, not independent evidence of physical importance. Separately, a CNO has lower velocity-field error but substantially higher two-component fluctuation-energy error than the reference on both analysis subsets. An output attenuation stress test also demonstrates disagreement between benchmark errors and domain-summed fluctuation energy. These single-benchmark results motivate reporting complementary physical diagnostics alongside aggregate prediction scores; they do not establish counterfactual physical correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器学习代理模型在流体模拟中的应用，发现预测误差较低并不一定意味着物理相关流动统计的误差也低。通过对比计算流体动力学模拟与实验粒子图像测速数据，研究了NACA4418机翼绕流问题。通过均值保持的输入干预，移除特定区域的速度波动，发现从能量最高的10%有效网格单元中移除波动对预测影响更大，但因掩码未匹配波动能量，该结果仅反映敏感性而非物理重要性。四种神经算子中，一种CNO模型虽在速度场误差上表现更好，但在双分量波动能量误差上显著高于参考模型。输出衰减应力测试也显示基准误差与域求和波动能量之间存在不一致。研究强调应在报告总体预测评分的同时补充物理诊断指标，但单个基准结果不足以证明反事实物理正确性。
AI.motivation: 机器学习代理模型虽能加速物理模拟，但其预测误差低不一定对应物理相关流动统计的准确性，因此需评估模型在物理意义上的表现，而不仅仅是数学误差。
AI.method: 结合计算流体动力学模拟与实验粒子图像测速数据，采用均值保持的输入干预方法移除特定区域的速度波动，比较不同神经算子在速度场和波动能量方面的表现，并通过输出衰减应力测试验证误差指标的一致性。
AI.result: 从能量最高的10%网格单元中移除波动对预测影响更大，但该现象仅反映模型敏感性；一种CNO模型虽速度场误差较低，但波动能量误差更高；输出衰减测试显示基准误差与物理量（波动能量）之间存在不一致。
AI.conclusion: 应将物理诊断指标与总体预测评分并列报告，以全面评估模型性能，但单一基准结果无法确立模型的反事实物理正确性。

title: Watch Your Speech: Text-aware Video-to-Speech Synthesis with Textual Conditioning
summary: Video-to-speech synthesis aims to generate natural-sounding speech from silent talking-face videos while ensuring phonetic accuracy. A fundamental challenge in this task is the inherent one-to-many mapping problem, where visual dynamics often lack sufficient information to uniquely determine the corresponding utterance. To address this, we propose Watch Your Speech (WYS), a video-to-speech synthesis framework that incorporates textual conditioning as an explicit linguistic cue to mitigate visual ambiguity. Our framework features an attention-based embedding fusion module that synergistically integrates textual context with video sequences, coupled with a conditional flow matching objective for high-fidelity speech generation. Extensive experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 datasets demonstrate that WYS achieves superior performance, establishing new state-of-the-art results in audio-visual synchronization (LSE-C/D) while maintaining highly competitive textual accuracy (WER). Subjective evaluations further confirm that our model generates speech with near-human naturalness, validating the effectiveness of textual conditioning in content-controlled video-to-speech synthesis. Project page: https://github.com/gunwoo5034/Watch-your-Speech

AI.tldr: 提出Watch Your Speech (WYS)框架，通过引入文本条件作为显式语言线索，解决视频到语音合成中的视觉模糊问题。采用基于注意力的嵌入融合模块和条件流匹配目标，实现高保真语音生成。在LRS2和LRS3数据集上表现优异，达到新的最佳性能，同时保持高文本准确率，并通过主观评估验证其语音自然度接近人类水平。
AI.motivation: 视频到语音合成面临视觉动态信息不足导致的一对多映射难题，难以唯一确定对应语音，因此需要引入外部语言线索以缓解视觉歧义。
AI.method: 设计了基于注意力的嵌入融合模块，将文本上下文与视频序列融合；采用条件流匹配目标进行高质量语音生成。
AI.result: 在LRS2和LRS3数据集上取得显著性能提升，音频-视觉同步指标（LSE-C/D）达到新SOTA，文本错误率（WER）保持竞争力，主观评价显示语音自然度接近人类水平。
AI.conclusion: 文本条件能有效提升内容可控的视频到语音合成效果，所提WYS框架在精度与自然度方面均表现卓越，为该任务提供了有力解决方案。

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Preference Distributions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as probabilistic generators for simulation, synthetic data generation, and decision support in settings where real-world data are unavailable. Yet, the structure and reliability of the distributions they produce remain understudied. Here, we systematically analyze LLM-generated distributions of preferences for air travel, restaurants, and consumer products. Encouragingly, all models considered in our analysis exhibit self-coherence, with the most probable outcomes stabilizing rapidly under repeated sampling. At the same time, we observe substantial discordance across both model families and scales, with little consensus even among their most probable outcomes. These patterns hold across nine open-weight models, three choice domains, and show robustness under temperature changes, greedy decoding, and perturbations of prompt and ordering. Our findings indicate that outcomes are influenced more by the choice of model than by the wording of the prompt, challenging the common assumption that sufficiently capable LLMs produce similar preference distributions when used as stand-ins for survey respondents.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了大型语言模型（LLMs）在航空旅行、餐厅和消费品偏好方面的生成分布，发现尽管所有模型表现出自我一致性，但不同模型间存在显著分歧，且模型选择比提示词设计对结果影响更大。
AI.motivation: 研究大型语言模型在缺乏真实数据场景下的生成分布特性，评估其作为模拟工具的可靠性与一致性。
AI.method: 对九个开源模型在三个选择领域进行重复采样实验，测试温度变化、贪婪解码、提示扰动等条件下的稳定性与一致性。
AI.result: 模型生成的最可能结果在多次采样中迅速稳定，但不同模型间即使在最可能结果上也缺乏共识，表明模型选择比提示词设计更具影响力。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的偏好分布受模型本身影响显著，而非提示词，因此不能简单假设大模型生成结果具有相似性，需谨慎将其用作调查受访者替代品。

title: BanglaDial-Abuse: A Corpus-Grounded Dataset for Regional Dialect Identification in Abusive Bangla Text
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Dataset Version 1.0 available on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.23074319
summary: Regional linguistic variation remains an important challenge for Bangla natural language processing, particularly in informal and non-standard text. This paper introduces BanglaDial-Abuse, a balanced Bengali-script dataset developed for regional dialect identification in abusive and hostile Bangla text. The dataset contains 1,000 sentences distributed equally across four linguistic varieties: Standard Bangla, Chattagram, Sylhet, and Barishal, with 250 samples per class. The resource was constructed using a corpus-grounded synthetic procedure incorporating regional variation in pronouns, possessive forms, verb morphology, negation, interrogative structures, postpositions, vocabulary, and Bengali-script spelling conventions while preserving the underlying hostile or abusive meaning. Descriptive analysis shows broadly comparable sentence-length distributions but partially distinct lexical spaces across the four classes. Pairwise Jaccard vocabulary similarity ranges from 0.37 to 0.56. The primary task is four-class regional dialect identification rather than binary abusive-text detection. The dataset is publicly available through Zenodo under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license. The current version is intended as a research and prototyping corpus rather than a native-speaker-validated gold-standard linguistic resource. Keywords: Bangla, Bengali, dialect identification, regional dialect, abusive language, low-resource NLP, Chattagram, Sylhet, Barishal, dataset

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个名为BanglaDial-Abuse的平衡贝尼格拉语数据集，用于识别非标准、攻击性贝尼格拉文本中的区域方言。数据集包含1000个句子，平均分布在四种语言变体中：标准孟加拉语、查塔格拉姆、锡尔赫特和巴里沙尔，每类250个样本。通过基于语料库的合成方法构建，涵盖代词、所有格、动词形态、否定、疑问结构、后置词、词汇及拼写惯例等区域差异，同时保留原始攻击性含义。描述性分析显示各类别句长分布相似，但词汇空间部分不同，成对Jaccard词汇相似度在0.37至0.56之间。主要任务是四分类区域方言识别，而非二分类的攻击性文本检测。数据集已通过Zenodo公开，采用知识共享署名4.0许可。当前版本为研究与原型设计用途，非母语者验证的金标准资源。
AI.motivation: 区域语言变异是孟加拉语自然语言处理中的重要挑战，尤其在非正式和非标准文本中。现有数据集缺乏针对攻击性或敌意文本中区域方言的系统性标注，限制了相关模型的发展。因此，需要一个专门用于识别此类文本中区域方言的数据集，以推动低资源语言环境下的方言识别研究。
AI.method: 采用基于语料库的合成方法生成数据，结合四种孟加拉语方言（标准、查塔格拉姆、锡尔赫特、巴里沙尔）的语言特征，包括代词、所有格、动词形态、否定、疑问结构、后置词、词汇选择及拼写习惯，并保持原始攻击性语义不变。通过人工校验确保语义一致性，最终构建出平衡的1000句数据集。
AI.result: 数据集在四个方言类别间具有可比的句长分布，但词汇空间存在明显差异，成对Jaccard相似度介于0.37至0.56之间，表明方言间存在显著区别。该数据集可用于四分类方言识别任务，为攻击性文本中的区域方言研究提供基础资源。
AI.conclusion: BanglaDial-Abuse是一个具有代表性的多方言攻击性文本数据集，填补了低资源语言中区域方言识别研究的空白。其公开可用性将促进孟加拉语自然语言处理在非标准文本中的发展，尤其在仇恨言论与地域文化识别方面具有应用潜力。

title: Source Identification Is Not Fitness Testing: Measuring the Limits of Synthetic-Data Attribution
summary: Repeated training on model-generated data can degrade later models. One possible response is to use provenance when deciding which generated examples to reuse. We test both how reliably that provenance can be recovered and whether it helps identify better training data. Using financial-risk text, we first identify the source of generated passages and then repeat the test after rewriting them. Generator attribution is 98.7% accurate on the original passages but falls to 53.1% after paraphrasing and 29.0% after style rewriting. Generated-versus-human detection remains close to perfect against the tested human comparison set. We then compare two ways of selecting generated examples over three rounds of generation and retraining. One uses source information. The other uses a score from a separate reference model. The two rules select different examples, but the planned comparison does not detect a stable difference in the degradation of the resulting models. The results show that identifying where data came from and identifying which data are useful for training are separate problems. The experiment therefore separates source identity, criterion-facing selection, and recursive training outcome: neither the provenance score nor the tested criterion-facing proxy is established as sufficient for future recursive behaviour.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在重复使用模型生成数据进行训练时，数据来源的可追溯性（provenance）是否有助于选择更优的训练数据。实验基于金融风险文本，发现原始生成文本的来源识别准确率达98.7%，但经改写后降至53.1%甚至29.0%；而生成数据与人类文本的区分仍接近完美。比较两种选择策略（基于来源信息与参考模型评分）后，发现两者选取不同样本，但对模型退化的影响无显著差异。结果表明，数据来源识别与数据质量判断是两个独立问题，现有方法均不足以确保递归训练中的良好表现。
AI.motivation: 探索在反复使用模型生成数据进行训练时，如何有效筛选高质量训练数据，避免模型性能下降。通过引入数据来源追踪（provenance）作为筛选依据，检验其有效性。
AI.method: 在金融风险文本上生成数据，测试原始生成文本与经过重写或风格变换后的文本的来源可追溯性；对比两种数据选择策略：一种基于源信息，另一种基于参考模型评分；进行三轮生成与再训练，评估模型性能变化。
AI.result: 生成文本的来源识别准确率在改写后大幅下降（53.1%和29.0%），而生成与人类文本的区分能力保持稳定；两种数据选择策略选取不同样本，但未导致模型退化出现稳定差异。
AI.conclusion: 数据来源识别与数据质量判断是相互独立的问题。当前的来源追踪与代理评估指标均不足以可靠指导递归训练中的数据选择，需进一步研究更稳健的筛选机制。

title: VASC: Value-Aware Sparse Attention with Cross-Layer Memory for Efficient 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D vision models such as VGGT have achieved remarkable progress, unifying camera estimation and dense scene reconstruction in a single pass.
