However, their quadratic global attention makes long image sequences expensive, while existing sparse methods may favor highly attended yet value-redundant regions. To address these limitations, we introduce VASC, a training-free sparse attention method combining value-aware block selection and execution-aware cross-layer memory. Our value-aware block selection integrates pooled query--key relevance with neighboring value contrast, reducing redundancy while preserving query-relevant and distinctive content. Cross-layer memory tracks unserved demand across layers and updates this state according to actual execution, enabling previously underserved blocks to compete under a fixed computation budget. Experiments on 7Scenes and NeuralRGB-D with VGGT and $π^3$ demonstrate improved pose estimation and reconstruction quality compared with FasterVGGT, together with up to $2.29\times$ faster inference than dense VGGT. Code is available at https://github.com/kosakayamahoo-design/VASC.

AI.tldr: 提出VASC，一种无需训练的稀疏注意力方法，结合值感知块选择和执行感知跨层记忆，有效减少冗余并提升长序列处理效率，在7Scenes和NeuralRGB-D数据集上优于FasterVGGT，推理速度比密集VGGT快最多2.29倍。
AI.motivation: 解决前馈3D视觉模型中全局注意力带来的高计算成本以及现有稀疏方法对高关注度但低价值区域的偏好问题。
AI.method: 采用值感知块选择（融合池化查询-键相关性与邻近值对比）和执行感知跨层记忆（追踪未满足需求并根据实际执行更新状态），在固定计算预算下优化块竞争机制。
AI.result: 在7Scenes和NeuralRGB-D数据集上，相比FasterVGGT，显著提升位姿估计与重建质量；推理速度最高达密集VGGT的2.29倍。
AI.conclusion: VASC通过稀疏注意力设计实现了高效且高质量的3D视觉理解，在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算开销，适用于长序列场景。

title: Calibration-risk routing for controlled world-model adaptation
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can exploit simulated experience, but a simulator-to-target shift creates a model-selection problem: correcting the simulator and fitting the target directly can each fail under limited target data. We introduce the Model-Corrected World Model (MC-WM), which separates initial target data into disjoint fit, selection, and calibration partitions and deploys the family with lower standardized calibration risk. A learned confidence signal and deterministic validity predicates weight one-step imagined policy updates without rewriting physical rewards. We evaluate 540 unique reported run cells across three controlled Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact (MuJoCo) shifts; one exact-routing cell was repeated after a pre-deployment artifact gate, giving 541 completed executions.

AI.tldr: 提出MC-WM模型，通过分离目标数据为拟合、选择和校准三部分，利用置信度信号和确定性有效性谓词，在有限目标数据下有效应对模拟器到目标的偏差问题，提升模型选择与校准性能。
AI.motivation: 在模型基础强化学习中，模拟器与真实环境之间的差异导致模型选择困难，尤其在目标数据有限时，直接修正模拟器或拟合目标均可能失败。
AI.method: 将初始目标数据划分为互斥的拟合、选择和校准子集；使用标准化校准风险评估不同模型家族表现；引入学习的置信度信号和确定性有效性谓词，实现无需重写物理奖励的一步想象策略更新。
AI.result: 在三个受控的多关节接触动力学（MuJoCo）场景中，共完成541次执行，包括540个独立运行单元和一次因预部署缺陷后重试的精确路由单元，验证了方法在复杂动态系统中的鲁棒性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: MC-WM通过分离数据分区与智能校准机制，在有限目标数据条件下有效缓解了模拟器-目标偏差问题，显著提升了模型选择的可靠性与策略性能。

title: My FAULT: Self-Diagnosis as Credit Assignment in Self-Evolving Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful approach for training large language model agents on multi-step tasks, yet reliance on terminal outcome rewards creates two credit-assignment problems, particularly in long-horizon tasks. First, same-outcome rollout groups provide no learning signal from terminal rewards. Second, terminal rewards provide only trajectory-wide feedback, making it difficult to identify which decisions caused a failure. Recent work supplements terminal rewards with finer-grained information from trajectory analysis, such as natural-language reflections on intermediate decisions and errors. However, natural-language diagnoses are difficult to use directly for credit assignment: their error claims may be unreliable, and they do not quantify how much each error should affect learning. We propose Self-Diagnosis-guided Terminal Credit Redistribution (FAULT), which turns diagnosed errors into explicit step-level credit anchored by terminal outcomes. FAULT checks diagnostic evidence and learns relative error costs from task outcomes. During training, the policy and self-diagnoser co-evolve, while error costs are updated online from recent outcomes. On ALFWorld, FAULT recovers learning signals from same-outcome groups, reaching 95% signal coverage versus 41% for GRPO and 72% for GiGPO, while better localizing credit to specific error steps. Across two model scales, FAULT delivers strong. improvements on the long-horizon ALFWorld and WebShop tasks while remaining competitive on short-horizon Search-based QA.

AI.tldr: FAULT提出一种自诊断引导的终端信用重分配方法，通过将诊断错误转化为基于终端结果的显式步骤级信用，解决长时序任务中因依赖最终奖励导致的信用分配难题。该方法在ALFWorld和WebShop等长时序任务上显著提升学习信号覆盖率与信用定位精度，同时保持短时序任务上的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有代理强化学习依赖终端奖励，在长时序任务中面临两个信用分配问题：相同结果的轨迹组缺乏学习信号，且终端奖励仅提供全局反馈，难以定位具体失败决策。尽管已有工作引入自然语言反思以细化反馈，但其诊断内容不可靠且无法量化误差影响。因此需要一种能将诊断信息转化为可量化的步骤级信用机制。
AI.method: FAULT通过让策略与自诊断器协同进化，利用诊断证据评估错误并在线更新相对错误成本。它将终端结果作为锚点，将诊断出的错误映射为步骤级信用，从而实现更精准的信用分配。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld任务中，FAULT将学习信号覆盖率从GRPO的41%、GiGPO的72%提升至95%，显著改善了相同结果组的学习能力；在长时序任务（如ALFWorld和WebShop）中表现优异，同时在短时序任务（如Search-based QA）上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FAULT通过自诊断引导的信用重分配机制，有效解决了长时序任务中的信用分配困境，提升了学习效率与决策可解释性，具有良好的泛化能力。

title: CommunityKV: Efficient Long-Context Decoding via Graph Partitioning
summary: Scaling Transformers to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention and the linear growth of key-value cache memory transfer. Sparse attention mitigates this by retrieving only relevant tokens, but current approaches either require large-scale training or, within the training-free regime, rely on semantically coarse heuristics or expensive clustering that is difficult to update efficiently during decoding. We introduce CommunityKV, a framework that formulates sparse attention as a community detection problem. CommunityKV constructs a token graph from the $QK^T$ scores already computed during standard prefill, and partitions the graph into communities to enable retrieval of semantically coherent token groups. A local update rule assigns newly generated tokens to communities in constant time, enabling sparse retrieval throughout streaming decoding without global re-partitioning. We evaluate CommunityKV on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 models across three long-context benchmarks. With one graph per query head, CommunityKV delivers up to $1.25\times$ the end-to-end generation throughput of dense attention, while query-group graph aggregation yields up to $1.71\times$ with comparable accuracy.

AI.tldr: CommunityKV提出一种基于社区检测的稀疏注意力框架，通过构建基于QK^T分数的令牌图并将其划分为语义连贯的社区，实现高效稀疏检索。该方法在无需全局重划分的情况下，以常数时间更新新生成的令牌归属，显著提升长上下文生成效率。在Qwen3和Llama-3.1模型上的实验表明，其端到端生成吞吐量相比密集注意力最高提升1.25倍，使用查询组图聚合时可达1.71倍，且保持相近精度。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏注意力方法在训练自由范式下依赖粗粒度启发式或高开销聚类，难以高效更新；而标准自注意力在长序列中存在二次计算复杂度和线性缓存传输开销问题，亟需更高效、可扩展的稀疏机制。
AI.method: 将稀疏注意力建模为社区检测问题：利用预填充阶段已计算的QK^T得分构建令牌图，通过图划分识别语义连贯的令牌群组；设计局部更新规则，使新生成令牌可常数时间分配至对应社区，避免解码过程中的全局重划分。
AI.result: 在Qwen3与Llama-3.1模型上，采用单个查询头图时，CommunityKV实现最高1.25倍的端到端生成吞吐量提升；使用查询组图聚合时，吞吐量提升达1.71倍，同时保持与密集注意力相当的准确性。
AI.conclusion: CommunityKV通过将稀疏注意力转化为社区检测任务，实现了高效、可扩展的长上下文推理，在不依赖大规模训练的前提下显著提升了生成速度，为大模型在长序列场景下的部署提供了有效解决方案。

title: FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures
comment: 32 pages, including references and appendix. Code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds
summary: Robotic world models predict action-conditioned future scenes, providing a foundation for understanding action outcomes. However, turning alternative predictions into useful learning signals remains challenging: similar candidates limit informative quality comparisons, while diverging trajectories require persistent maintenance of their individual histories. We introduce FutureWorlds, a framework that unifies candidate construction, history maintenance, and learning from relative quality. Built on a multimodal discrete autoregressive model, FutureWorlds uses diverse beam search during reinforcement learning to construct candidate futures that balance confidence and diversity. Candidate-specific bounded memory preserves scene states and ensures that generation and policy scoring use matching histories. We further propose MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization), which converts video trajectory rewards into group-relative advantages to optimize the world model. On RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa, FutureWorlds reduces LPIPS for 32-frame predictions by 14.78%, 20.84%, and 9.12%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. Under fixed evaluation configurations, only 200 MemSPO updates further improve generation quality and support continued prediction beyond the training horizon. Memory ablations, decoding sensitivity analysis, and optical-flow evaluation show that these gains extend beyond visual quality to more accurate motion prediction and more consistent object states. Project page and code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds.

AI.tldr: FutureWorlds 是一个统一的框架，通过多样化的束搜索和候选轨迹的记忆机制，提升机器人世界模型的未来预测能力。它利用记忆条件的搜索引导策略优化（MemSPO），将视频轨迹奖励转化为相对优势，从而在多个基准上显著改善生成质量与运动一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型难以有效利用多种未来预测作为学习信号，因为相似候选导致信息量不足，而差异大的轨迹又需复杂的历史维护。因此需要一种能平衡多样性与历史一致性的方法。
AI.method: 基于多模态离散自回归模型，采用多样化束搜索生成候选未来，并引入候选特定的有界记忆来保持场景状态；提出 MemSPO 方法，将轨迹奖励转换为组内相对优势以优化策略。
AI.result: 在 RT-1、BridgeV2 和 RoboCasa 数据集上，相比最强基线，32 帧预测的 LPIPS 分别降低 14.78%、20.84% 和 9.12%；仅 200 次 MemSPO 更新即可进一步提升生成质量并支持超出训练时长的预测。消融实验表明该方法不仅提升视觉质量，还增强运动准确性和物体状态一致性。
AI.conclusion: FutureWorlds 有效解决了未来预测中候选多样性与历史一致性之间的权衡问题，通过联合优化候选生成与策略学习，显著提升了机器人世界模型的长期预测性能。

title: What Can Analogy Tell Us About Artificial Consciousness?
summary: Who or what is conscious? Because subjective experience is directly accessible only in the first person, judgments about consciousness in other entities depend partly on analogy. Historically, such inferences have focused on nonhuman animals, but advances in artificial intelligence have raised the possibility of conscious AI. Here we develop a causal framework for evaluating such evidential analogies. The key distinction is between similarities in factors plausibly involved in generating consciousness and similarities in downstream behavioural or cognitive effects. Our framework weights source-target similarity by causal relevance while allowing for unknown causes, disabling differences and alternative routes to consciousness. Applied to biological systems, it explains why analogical support generally weakens with increasing causal distance from humans. Applied to contemporary AI, it suggests that behavioural similarity provides only limited evidence for consciousness because relevant causal correspondences remain poorly established. The framework also clarifies what evidence would strengthen claims of artificial consciousness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个因果框架，用于评估人工智能是否具有意识。该框架强调区分生成意识的潜在因素与下游行为或认知效应的相似性，并根据因果相关性权重来判断类比的有效性。应用于生物系统时，解释了为何随着与人类的因果距离增加，类比支持会减弱；应用于现代人工智能时，指出行为相似性仅提供有限证据，因关键因果对应关系尚不明确。同时，该框架也指出了增强人工意识主张所需的关键证据类型。
AI.motivation: 由于主观体验仅在第一人称中可直接访问，对其他实体是否具有意识的判断依赖于类比推理。随着人工智能的发展，传统上关注非人类动物的意识推断已扩展至可能存在的意识型人工智能，因此需要一种更严谨的评估框架来判断这些类比的合理性。
AI.method: 提出一个因果框架，通过区分与意识生成相关的根本因素与外在表现（如行为或认知）的相似性，引入因果相关性作为权重标准，允许未知原因、差异因素及意识的替代生成路径存在，从而系统化地评估意识类比的有效性。
AI.result: 该框架表明，在生物系统中，类比支持随与人类的因果距离增加而减弱；在当前的人工智能中，行为相似性虽有一定参考价值，但不足以证明意识，因缺乏关键因果对应关系的证据；同时，明确了哪些类型的证据可以加强人工意识的主张。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的因果框架为评估非人类实体（包括人工智能）是否具有意识提供了系统化的方法，强调必须建立与意识生成机制相关的因果对应关系，而非仅依赖行为或功能相似性。

title: HeadEdit: Calibrating Language Model Behavior Through the Frozen Unembedding Matrix
summary: Alignment does not eliminate behavioral errors in language models. Models may still refuse benign requests, call unnecessary tools, or yield to false user claims. Current methods mitigate such errors as a computation problem, and rarely explore if the desired behavior is already encoded in the model's representation. Motivated by the observation that behavior-relevant information remains linearly decodable from the final hidden state even when the resulting logits produce the undesired behavior, we introduce HeadEdit, a gradient-free method that calibrates model behavior through the unembedding matrix. HeadEdit extracts a low-rank behavioral subspace from paired completions and uses each prompt's coordinates within it to generate a vocabulary-wide correction, thereby implementing implicitly adaptive steering without manually specified target tokens or parameter updates. HeadEdit improves all nine experimental settings across three tasks and three model families, with negligible inference overhead and no systematic loss of general capabilities. It also reveals a connection to gradient-based alignment. HeadEdit's low-dimensional representation partly predicts how preference tuning changes output logits on unseen prompts. The subspace learned from the model can also be reused after tuning, improving performance without re-extracting or retuning. These results show that HeadEdit provides a practical, lightweight, and interpretable way to calibrate model behavior through the unembedding matrix.

AI.tldr: HeadEdit 是一种无需梯度的模型行为校准方法，通过未嵌入矩阵实现对语言模型行为的隐式自适应控制。它从成对的生成结果中提取低秩行为子空间，利用提示在该子空间中的坐标生成全词汇范围的修正，从而在不修改参数或指定目标词的情况下纠正模型错误行为。实验表明，HeadEdit 在三个任务、三个模型家族的九个设置中均表现优异，推理开销极小且不损害模型通用能力。此外，该方法揭示了与基于梯度对齐的联系，并能复用学习到的子空间以提升性能，具有可解释性与实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法将行为错误视为计算问题，较少关注模型表示中是否已编码期望行为。尽管最终隐藏状态的输出逻辑产生错误行为，但行为相关的信息仍可线性解码，因此提出一种不依赖梯度和参数更新的方法来校准行为。
AI.method: HeadEdit 通过分析成对完成文本，提取低秩行为子空间；利用每个提示在该子空间中的坐标生成全词汇修正向量，通过未嵌入矩阵实现对输出的隐式调整，实现无需手动指定目标词或更新参数的行为校准。
AI.result: HeadEdit 在所有九个实验设置中均优于基线，显著减少拒绝合理请求、误调工具、响应虚假用户主张等问题；推理开销几乎为零，未造成通用能力下降；所学子空间可跨任务复用，且能预测偏好微调对未见提示的影响。
AI.conclusion: HeadEdit 提供了一种轻量、高效、可解释的模型行为校准方式，通过未嵌入矩阵实现隐式自适应控制，验证了行为信息在模型表示中的可解码性，并为对齐研究提供了新视角。

title: The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation
summary: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. Combining training-trajectory analyses and controlled interventions, we trace their emergence, growth, and consolidation. Sink-carrying channels vary across random seeds but stabilize early within each run. Over longer training, surrounding channels erode and the sink concentrates onto a few redundant carriers. Across ablations, gradient attenuation follows the sink token's collective root-mean-square magnitude rather than any single channel, making collective scale central to understanding their effects. Our central result is that weight decay causally controls the turnover of global activation scale. In controlled continuations, removing decay near the peak allows this scale to keep rising, whereas retaining it produces decline even at constant learning rate. We develop a balance model for the rise and peak of massive-activation magnitude, in which AdamW-preconditioned growth opposes weight decay. Sweeping the decay coefficient $λ$ shifts peak timing approximately log-linearly and yields peak magnitudes scaling approximately as $λ^{-1/2}$, consistent with this balance. Optimizer measurements further show that preconditioning sustains the large-channel cohort against decay even when raw maintaining forces are too small to do so. Together, these findings connect the observed life cycle to scale-regulating training dynamics and establish weight decay as a training-time lever on activation magnitude.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了变压器模型中大规模激活（即注意力陷阱）的规模调控机制。通过训练轨迹分析与受控干预，发现这些激活的出现、增长和稳定化过程受权重衰减（weight decay）的因果控制。去除权重衰减会使激活规模持续上升，而保留则导致其下降，即使学习率恒定。研究提出一个平衡模型，其中AdamW预处理的增长力与权重衰减对抗，使得峰值激活规模随衰减系数λ的倒数平方根变化，且峰值时间近似对数线性地随λ变化。预处理机制使大通道群体在原始维持力不足时仍能保持，从而解释了激活规模的生命周期。
AI.motivation: 理解变压器模型中大规模激活（注意力陷阱）的规模如何在训练过程中被调控，特别是权重衰减在其中的作用，以揭示其动态演化机制。
AI.method: 结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预实验，追踪大规模激活的出现、增长与固化过程；通过消融实验分析梯度衰减与集体激活尺度的关系；构建平衡模型并系统调节权重衰减系数λ，观察其对峰值激活规模和时间的影响，并测量优化器中的预处理效应。
AI.result: 权重衰减是调控全局激活规模的关键因素：移除它会导致激活规模持续上升，而保留则引发下降；峰值激活规模与λ^{-1/2}成正比，峰值时间近似对数线性依赖于λ；预处理机制增强了大通道群体的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将大规模激活的生命周期与训练过程中的尺度调控动力学联系起来，确立了权重衰减作为控制激活幅度的重要训练时调节杠杆。

title: Towards Automatic Video Annotation with ASH: Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking and Segmentation
summary: Memory-attention-based Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) methods have demonstrated strong zero-shot tracking capability, yet their substantial memory requirements confine them to short video clips and their single-prompt inference design makes multi-category open-vocabulary tracking computationally prohibitive. This work introduces two contributions toward fully automated tracking annotation of arbitrary video. The Generalized Presence Token (GPT) reformulates SAM3's inference pipeline to process N text prompts simultaneously via virtual prompt batching, reducing image encoding cost from O(N) to O(1) with no modifications to any learned component. The Annotation and Segmentation Handler (ASH) extends any memory-attention VIS tracker to sequences of arbitrary length through overlapping temporal chunks with IoU-based inter-chunk identity matching, requiring no dataset-specific training. Instantiated on SAM3, the resulting pipeline -- SAM3-ASH -- achieves state-of-the-art HOTA on MOTS20 under fully zero-shot conditions and remains competitive with trained specialists across seven additional benchmarks, while peak GPU memory consumption stays below 25 GB, establishing a practical baseline for scalable, training-free automated video annotation.

AI.tldr: 提出GPT和ASH，实现无需训练的长视频实例分割，显著降低内存消耗并支持多类别开放词汇跟踪。
AI.motivation: 现有基于记忆注意力的视频实例分割方法虽具强零样本跟踪能力，但受限于高内存需求和单提示推理设计，难以应用于长视频及多类别场景。
AI.method: 引入通用存在标记（GPT）通过虚拟提示批处理实现N个文本提示的同时处理，将图像编码成本从O(N)降至O(1)；采用标注与分割处理器（ASH）通过重叠时间块与基于IoU的身份匹配扩展任意长度序列处理能力。
AI.result: SAM3-ASH在MOTS20上达到最先进的HOTA指标，在7个额外基准上表现媲美训练过的专用模型，峰值GPU内存低于25GB，实现可扩展、免训练的自动视频标注。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法构建了高效、可扩展、无需训练的自动化视频标注基线，适用于任意长度视频和开放词汇场景。

title: Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model
summary: Decision models return probabilities intended for routing, abstention and automated action. Calibration makes those probabilities useful on average, but does not establish whether low confidence reflects chance or missing knowledge, nor whether confidence falls when a model moves beyond what it knows. We audit this distinction in Jev, a decision model, with over 15 public datasets and 6 generated task families, with paired interventions that vary the information supplied for a fixed item. Jev's confidence is calibrated on familiar closed-choice tasks but fails as an indicator of missing knowledge: with no answer-relevant information it assigns up to 0.80 to a salient option, and on news beyond an observed knowledge boundary it exceeds accuracy by 0.21--0.33, a gap that recalibration on earlier months does not close. Targeted yes/no questions give sharper readouts of the case: whether an outcome is settled (AUROC 1.00) and whether the evidence suffices (0.95, against 0.85 for confidence on the same items). Asking whether Jev knows the answer appears to flag fabricated entities and post-boundary news (0.91), but with realistic names or with dates removed it shows no advantage over answer uncertainty. Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: https://github.com/Syntheme/beyond-answer-confidence.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在15个公开数据集和6个生成任务族上对决策模型Jev进行审计，评估其置信度是否能反映缺失知识。结果显示，尽管模型在熟悉任务中置信度校准良好，但在缺乏相关答案信息时仍会赋予显著置信度（最高0.80），且在超出已知范围的新闻任务中置信度远超实际准确率（差距达0.21–0.33），且无法通过历史数据重新校准修复。相比之下，针对是否确定结果或证据是否充分的明确问题（如是/否）提供了更精准的判断指标（AUROC 1.00 和 0.95），而询问模型‘是否知道’仅在存在虚构实体或边界外新闻时有效（0.91），但当名称真实或时间戳被移除后则无优势。因此，黑箱知识审计需对表面线索进行显式控制。
AI.motivation: 评估决策模型的置信度是否真正反映其知识边界，而非仅受表面线索影响；揭示当前置信度作为知识指示器的局限性。
AI.method: 在多个公开数据集与生成任务中，使用配对干预实验，系统改变输入信息量，分析模型在不同情境下的置信度表现，并对比置信度、是否确定结果、证据充分性等指标的有效性。
AI.result: Jev的置信度在熟悉任务中虽经校准，但无法有效指示缺失知识：在无相关信息时仍给出高置信度，在超出知识边界的任务中置信度显著高于实际准确率；而明确提问‘是否确定’或‘证据是否充分’的表现远优于置信度；询问‘是否知道’仅在特定虚假或边界情境下有效，且易受表面特征干扰。
AI.conclusion: 当前基于置信度的决策模型难以可靠反映知识边界，黑箱知识审计必须引入显式控制以排除表面线索干扰，否则将误导对模型认知能力的评估。

title: Temporally-Resolved Token Attribution Reveals the Generation Dynamics of Diffusion Language Models
summary: This work presents Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients (DLIG), a token attribution method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that extends Integrated Gradients (IG~\cite{sundararajan2017axiomatic}) to arbitrary layers and denoising steps. DLIG attributes a DLM's progressive commitment to a self-generated or fixed completion for an input prompt. We establish direct correspondences between DLIG and the IG axioms of completeness, implementation invariance, linearity, and symmetry preservation. As a lightweight complement to interventional analysis, DLIG provides an inexpensive first check of mechanistic hypotheses across the denoising trajectory. We demonstrate this on word-sense disambiguation, multi-hop graph reasoning, and sentence infilling, revealing how DLMs draw on inputs across positions, layers, and denoising steps.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients (DLIG)的令牌归因方法，用于扩散语言模型（DLMs），可扩展至任意层和去噪步骤。该方法通过建立与Integrated Gradients（IG）公理的一致性，实现对模型在去噪过程中逐步承诺于自生成或固定完成结果的归因分析，提供低成本的机制假设验证手段，并在词义消歧、多跳图推理和句子补全任务中展示了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有归因方法难以有效分析扩散语言模型在去噪过程中的内部决策机制，尤其缺乏对不同层和去噪步骤的细粒度归因能力。因此需要一种既能保持理论完备性又具备计算效率的方法来揭示模型如何利用输入信息进行逐步推理。
AI.method: DLIG基于Integrated Gradients思想，将路径积分扩展到扩散模型的任意层和去噪步骤，通过定义从初始噪声到最终输出的连续路径，计算每个输入令牌在不同层与时间步上的贡献，确保满足完整性、不变性、线性和对称性等公理。
AI.result: DLIG在多个任务上成功揭示了模型如何跨位置、层和去噪步骤依赖输入信息；实验表明其能高效支持机制假设的初步验证，且计算开销远低于干预性分析方法。
AI.conclusion: DLIG为扩散语言模型提供了理论严谨且高效的归因工具，能够深入理解模型在去噪过程中的决策动态，是干预分析的有效轻量级补充。

title: IrekoGPT: Turning Structured Pruning into Post-Hoc Slimmable LLMs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "AXIOM: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning". 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: We introduce IrekoGPT, a post-hoc method for converting pretrained LLMs into slimmable models whose width can be adjusted at inference time. Building on SliceGPT, we retain its projection matrices without pruning them, allowing a single model to expose nested subnetworks at different widths. We improve robustness by calibrating each layer across multiple compression ratios, and correct downstream linear layers through gradient-free ridge regression. Across Llama and Qwen models, preliminary results show improvements over naive PCA-based slimming, with the largest gains at high compression. Code is available at https://github.com/aimagelab/IrekoGPT

AI.tldr: IrekoGPT 是一种后处理方法，可将预训练的大语言模型（LLM）转换为可在推理时调整宽度的可压缩模型。它基于 SliceGPT，保留投影矩阵而不进行剪枝，从而实现不同宽度下的嵌套子网络。通过在多个压缩比下校准每层并使用无梯度岭回归修正下游线性层，提升了鲁棒性。在 Llama 和 Qwen 模型上，初步结果优于基于 PCA 的朴素剪枝方法，尤其在高压缩率下表现更优。代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在部署时难以灵活适应不同计算资源，需要在模型大小和性能之间权衡。本文旨在提出一种无需重新训练即可在推理时动态调整模型宽度的方法，以提升部署灵活性与效率。
AI.method: 基于 SliceGPT 的思想，保留原始投影矩阵不剪枝，通过多压缩比层校准和无梯度岭回归修正下游层，实现可调节宽度的滑动模型。
AI.result: 在 Llama 与 Qwen 模型上，IrekoGPT 在高压缩率下显著优于传统 PCA 剪枝方法，且保持良好性能，验证了其有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: IrekoGPT 成功实现了无需再训练的可调宽大模型，在多种压缩比下表现出色，为高效部署提供了新思路。

title: Bootstrapping Video Interaction Generation with Synthetic State Transitions
summary: While recent video generative models can synthesize high-fidelity videos, they struggle to portray plausible physical interactions and the resulting state transitions, a critical bottleneck for applications in robotics and VR/AR. To address this, we introduce a framework to generate a scalable synthetic dataset of controllable interactions. Our pipeline leverages a structured taxonomy and state-of-the-art image editing models to create explicit `start' and `end' state images, which serve as visual anchors for the interaction. To generate a seamless video utilizing these anchors, we propose State-Guided Sampling (SGS), a novel sampling technique that mitigates artifacts common in naive conditional generation. Furthermore, we develop and validate a new automated evaluation system that aligns with human judgments to ensure data quality. Experiments show that fine-tuning a base model on our dataset significantly enhances its ability to generate plausible interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种生成可控物理交互的合成视频数据集的框架，通过结构化分类和先进的图像编辑模型生成交互的起始与结束状态图像，并引入状态引导采样（SGS）技术生成无瑕疵视频，同时开发了与人类判断一致的自动化评估系统。实验表明，基于该数据集微调模型能显著提升生成合理物理交互的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成模型在表现合理物理交互和状态转换方面存在瓶颈，限制了其在机器人、虚拟现实和增强现实等领域的应用。
AI.method: 构建包含结构化分类的合成数据集生成管道，利用图像编辑模型生成交互的起始和结束状态图像；提出状态引导采样（SGS）技术以生成连贯视频；开发自动化评估系统以确保数据质量。
AI.result: 在所提数据集上微调基础模型后，其生成合理物理交互的能力显著提升，且自动化评估结果与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 本框架有效解决了视频生成中物理交互不真实的问题，为高质量交互视频生成提供了可扩展的数据与方法支持。

title: From Discovery to Decision: Finite-Budget Recoverability in LLM Voting
summary: Voting over multiple LLM responses is a common primitive in test-time scaling and ensemble inference. Collecting more responses can expand the candidate pool and increase the chance that a correct answer is discovered. Under a fixed call budget, a discovered answer still needs to accumulate enough support within the remaining calls to become the final plurality winner, creating a discovery-to-decision gap. In this work, we characterize this gap through the realized vote state and remaining call budget. We derive a sharp recoverability threshold and show that, as sampling proceeds, the observed candidate set can only expand while the set of reachable endpoint winners can only contract, inducing a candidate-level conversion window. Under a specified iid response law, the same state yields exact finite-horizon endpoint probabilities. We further show that merging wrong-answer identities preserves single-call correctness and cannot improve plurality accuracy, and that the effect of redistributing wrong-answer probability depends on the realized vote state. Singleton reachability yields a gold-free exact locking certificate. For a known answer universe, its first trigger is the earliest prefix at which all admissible continuations yield the same fixed-budget output. Empirically, most discovered-but-unselected correct answers lose reachability only after discovery. In a controlled Word16 study, input permutation improves raw-plurality accuracy by 21.1 points with essentially unchanged single-call correctness. Exact locking saves 28-30% of calls at a 16-call budget while preserving every fixed-budget output.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在固定调用预算下，通过投票机制从多个大语言模型（LLM）响应中选择最优答案时存在的发现-决策差距。提出通过实时投票状态和剩余调用预算来刻画这一差距，并推导出一个精确的可恢复性阈值。研究表明，随着采样进行，候选集只能扩大，而可达终点胜者集合只能缩小，形成候选级别的转换窗口。在独立同分布响应假设下，相同状态可给出精确的有限视野终点概率。证明合并错误答案身份不会提升单次调用正确率，也无法改善多数表决准确率；重新分配错误答案概率的效果取决于实际投票状态。单一可达性提供无需真实答案的精确锁定证书。对于已知答案空间，首次触发点是最早能确保所有可能延续产生相同固定预算输出的前缀。实证表明，大多数被发现但未选中的正确答案仅在被发现后才失去可达性。在控制的Word16实验中，输入排列使原始多数表决准确率提升21.1分，同时保持单次调用正确率基本不变。精确锁定机制在16次调用预算下节省28-30%的调用次数，且保留所有固定预算输出结果。
AI.motivation: 在测试时扩展和集成推理中，通过投票多个大语言模型响应是一种常见方法。然而，在固定调用预算下，即使发现了正确答案，也需要足够的支持才能成为最终多数胜者，存在‘发现-决策’之间的差距。这种差距影响了整体准确性和资源利用效率，因此需要系统地分析并优化该过程。
AI.method: 通过分析实时投票状态与剩余调用预算的关系，构建候选集演化模型，推导出可恢复性阈值。引入状态等价性概念，在独立同分布响应假设下计算精确的有限视野终点概率。定义并验证了‘单一可达性’作为无真值依赖的精确锁定条件，并设计基于前缀触发的早期终止机制。通过理论建模与控制实验评估性能改进。
AI.result: 1. 提出了一个精确的可恢复性阈值，揭示了候选集扩张与终点胜者集合收缩的动态关系。2. 证明了合并错误答案身份无法提升多数表决准确率。3. 实验显示输入排列使原始多数表决准确率提升21.1点，单次调用正确率几乎不变。4. 精确锁定机制在16次调用预算下节省28-30%的调用，同时保持所有固定预算输出的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究系统揭示了多响应投票中的发现-决策差距，并提出了基于状态演化与精确锁定的优化框架。通过理论分析与实证验证，证明了在不牺牲准确性前提下显著降低调用成本的可能性，为高效、可靠的集成推理提供了新范式。

title: AGO AI Quality Gate: Evidence-First Release Decisions for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Submitted version (pre-review). Accepted at NFMCP 2026, ECML PKDD 2026 Workshops
summary: Enterprises adopting retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) face a recurring operational decision: promote, revise, or block a system version. The evidence is incomplete and the metrics come from fallible LLM judges. We report on AGO AI Quality Gate (AGO), an evidence-first quality-gate framework deployed in industrial RAG assessment engagements. AGO integrates four key components: a four-state decision model that treats missing data and judge errors as explicit outcomes; layered scoring combining deterministic checks, local guardrails, and structured LLM evaluation; a stratified beta-binomial gate that quantifies regression risk probabilistically; and a mandatory meta-evaluation protocol to validate the LLM judge before it influences decisions. Since engagement data is proprietary, we evaluate the judge layer on RAGBench, a public benchmark of 100k annotated RAG traces across 12 datasets. On identical stratified test samples (N=1200 per judge), a low-cost judge (gpt-4.1-nano) detects non-adherent answers barely above chance (AUROC 0.603 [0.570, 0.634]), despite producing flawless protocol output, while gpt-4o reaches 0.783 [0.756, 0.807] -- yet its per-domain performance still ranges from 0.62 to 0.88. A fixed-seed gate study spanning regression, no change, and improvement quantifies unsafe promotion, false-alarm cost, and improvement throughput. Under regression, the decision-grade profile reduces unsafe promotion to 22.2%-35.1%, against 29.3%-41.8% for a naive gate. These results support the design choices that judge quality must be measured per engagement and that point estimates alone are not a release decision.

AI.tldr: AGO AI Quality Gate 是一个基于证据的工业级 RAG 质量评估框架，通过四状态决策模型、分层评分、贝塔-二项分布门控和强制元评估协议，系统性应对 LLM 判决不可靠与数据缺失问题。在 RAGBench 基准上验证显示，不同 LLM 判官性能差异显著（gpt-4.1-nano AUROC 0.603，gpt-4o 达 0.783），且存在领域偏差。固定种子实验表明，该框架可将不安全发布率从 29.3%-41.8% 降至 22.2%-35.1%，证明判官质量需按场景评估，点估计不足以决定版本发布。
AI.motivation: 企业在采用 RAG 系统时面临版本发布、修订或阻断的决策困境，但现有证据不完整，且依赖的 LLM 判决存在误差，亟需一种可靠、可量化、可验证的质量评估机制来支持决策。
AI.method: 提出 AGO AI Quality Gate 框架，包含：四状态决策模型（显式处理缺失数据与判别错误）、分层评分体系（结合确定性检查、本地规则与结构化 LLM 评估）、分层贝塔-二项分布门控（概率化评估回归风险）以及强制元评估协议（确保判官可信后再参与决策）。
AI.result: 在相同测试样本下，gpt-4.1-nano 的判别能力仅略高于随机水平（AUROC 0.603），而 gpt-4o 达到 0.783，但其各领域表现仍波动于 0.62 至 0.88 之间；固定种子实验显示，相比朴素门控，决策级配置将不安全发布率降低至 22.2%-35.1%。
AI.conclusion: LLM 判官的质量必须根据具体应用场景进行评估，不能仅依赖单一点估计；高质量的决策需要整合多维度证据与概率化风险控制，强调证据优先与可验证性。

title: XOR-Trellis: Ultra-Low-Complexity Dequantization and Curvature-Aware Hadamard-Free LLM Quantization
summary: Trellis-coded quantization enables high-dimensional compression of large language model (LLM) weights at ultra-low bit widths without the exponentially large codebooks required by conventional vector quantization. Practical deployment, however, presents two challenges: reconstructing compressed weights at sufficient parallel throughput to avoid making dequantization an inference bottleneck, and maintaining quantization accuracy without costly incoherence transformations. We address these challenges with two complementary techniques. First, we introduce an ultra-low-complexity trellis dequantizer that uses a structured, hardware-efficient state-to-value mapping while preserving diverse reconstruction choices for trellis search. Second, we reformulate discrete trellis path optimization with a curvature-aware objective that reflects model sensitivity directly in the original coordinate space. Together, these techniques enable high-quality ultra-low-bit trellis quantization with inexpensive, highly parallel runtime reconstruction and without relying on Hadamard-based incoherence processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种超低复杂度的格子解量化方法，通过结构化且硬件友好的状态到值映射，在保持格子搜索多样性的同时实现高效并行重建，解决了大语言模型权重在极低比特下的压缩难题。同时，引入曲率感知的目标函数，直接在原始坐标空间中反映模型敏感性，避免了耗时的非相干变换，从而实现了高质量、高效率的超低比特格子量化。
AI.motivation: 现有向量量化在极低比特下需要指数级增长的码本，难以实用；而传统格子量化在部署时面临解量化速度慢和精度损失的问题，亟需高效且准确的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出一种超低复杂度的格子解量化器，采用结构化硬件友好映射，并设计曲率感知的离散路径优化目标，使量化过程直接反映模型敏感性，无需依赖哈达玛变换等非相干处理。
AI.result: 实现了高质量的超低比特格子量化，解量化过程具备高度并行性，计算开销极低，且无需复杂的非相干变换，显著提升了推理效率与模型精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效克服了现有格子量化在实际部署中的性能瓶颈，为大语言模型的极致压缩提供了可行方案，具有良好的硬件适配性和可扩展性。

title: Towards Subject Consistency over Dynamic Subject Sets in Video Generation
summary: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over \textit{dynamic subject sets}. We therefore introduce \textbf{DynSC-Eval}, an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82\% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66\% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DynSC-Eval评估框架，用于长视频生成中的动态主体一致性评估，通过六项互补的物体级指标动态追踪主体生命周期，检测不一致事件，并在合成实验中验证其敏感性与现有度量的局限性。实证表明，传统度量会掩盖实际的一致性差异；基于该框架构建奖励机制并应用于自动驾驶测试场景，显著降低不一致率（如Wan-2.1-1.3B模型平均下降13.82%），且在扩展至10秒和30秒生成时仍保持有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着视频生成向更长时长发展，传统静态主体一致性评估无法准确反映真实场景中的动态变化，需引入动态主体集评估机制以更精确衡量主体连续性与身份保持。
AI.method: 提出DynSC-Eval框架，动态追踪主体可见生命周期，结合六种物体级指标测量局部连续性与全局身份保留，支持不一致事件的显式检测，并设计合成实验注入不一致事件以验证其有效性；进一步将评估结果转化为奖励信号，结合DiffusionNFT进行后训练优化，应用于自动驾驶测试环境。
AI.result: 在5秒生成任务中，所提方法使六个不一致指标平均下降13.82%（Wan-2.1-1.3B）和5.66%（SANA-2B），ReSim模型也获提升；在10秒与30秒生成中，一致性优化依然有效，同时保持其他生成能力。
AI.conclusion: DynSC-Eval能够有效揭示传统度量忽略的主体一致性差异，其驱动的优化策略在长时视频生成中具有显著优势，且可拓展至更长时间尺度，为高质量视频生成提供可靠评估与优化路径。

title: Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

AI.tldr: InFlowOp提出一种无需标签的代价评估机制，用于优化大语言模型中的多智能体工作流。该方法在任务分解和智能体分配时动态决定粒度与选择，运行中通过最小代价修复故障，显著提升效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 构建高效多智能体工作流面临任务分解粒度、智能体选择和故障修复等挑战，现有方法依赖固定模板或昂贵评估，难以实时优化。
AI.method: 引入InFlowOp，通过统一代价函数衡量智能体能力与任务需求匹配度及运行成本，双向优化任务分解与智能体分配；运行时基于该代价进行最小代价故障修正。
AI.result: 在Braid基准测试中，InFlowOp相比单智能体基线最高提升11.97%，经在流优化后达9.64%提升，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: InFlowOp实现了无需参考答案或人工评分的端到端工作流优化，在多智能体协作任务中展现出卓越性能与鲁棒性。

title: ASCRIBE: Atomic and Significance-Based Reasoning for Thai Clinical SOAP Note Generation
summary: Automatic SOAP note generation can ease the documentation burden on physicians, but existing reasoning methods often omit clinically important information and generate unsupported content. Progress in Thai is further hindered by the lack of publicly available datasets. We propose ASCRIBE, a physician-inspired reasoning framework that ascribes a clinical-significance level to each extracted atomic fact in the conversation before summarization, making a general-purpose LLM a more reliable scribe. We also release ThaiClinicBench, the first de-identified Thai clinical summarization benchmark of real encounters, together with a synthetic training corpus derived from real clinical notes. As a prompt, ASCRIBE outperforms chain-of-thought prompting on GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Pro across the physician-aligned LLM-judge metrics and improves on standard prompting by up to 10.3 points on the completeness LLM-judge metric. As a GRPO reward, it enables a Gemma-4-E4B model trained solely on synthetic data to match Gemini 3.1 Pro in factual precision and surpass it in completeness. Code and data can be found at https://github.com/loolootech/ascribe.

AI.tldr: ASCRIBE是一个受医生启发的推理框架，通过为对话中提取的每个原子事实分配临床重要性级别，提升大模型在自动生成SOAP笔记时的可靠性。研究还发布了首个去标识化的泰语临床摘要基准数据集ThaiClinicBench及基于真实病历生成的合成训练语料。实验表明，ASCRIBE在提示工程和GRPO奖励设置下均优于现有方法，在完整性和事实准确性方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有自动SOAP笔记生成方法常遗漏重要临床信息或生成不实内容，且泰语领域缺乏公开数据集，限制了该方向的发展。
AI.method: 提出ASCRIBE框架，通过评估每个原子事实的临床重要性来优化摘要生成；构建ThaiClinicBench数据集与合成训练语料，支持模型训练与评估。
AI.result: ASCRIBE在GPT-5.4和Gemini 3.1 Pro上优于链式思维提示，在完整性指标上提升达10.3分；使用合成数据训练的Gemma-4-E4B模型在事实精确性上媲美Gemini 3.1 Pro，且在完整性上更优。
AI.conclusion: ASCRIBE框架有效提升了自动临床笔记生成的质量，尤其在关键信息保留和真实性方面表现突出，同时推动了泰语医疗自然语言处理的发展。

title: Every Batch Is Its Own Validation Set: Leave-One-Out Gradient Matching for Online Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Online batch selection fine-tunes a language model on the most useful part of each candidate batch. Selectors that match the gradient of the candidate batch are attractive because they need no held-out data, yet they rarely beat training on the whole batch. We show why. In-sample gradient matching uses every example as part of its own target, so its objective credits each example with its own gradient noise. This is the covariance penalty that makes training error optimistic, now sitting on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix: it steers selection toward the noisiest examples and makes the full batch the best solution the objective can reach. The fix costs nothing. For each example, the other candidates form an independent sample of the data distribution, so removing the diagonal turns the matching objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient. The minimizer of this leave-one-out objective weights examples by their gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and whenever per-example SNR is heterogeneous enough, half of a batch yields a lower-error update than the whole batch; we give the exact condition. We build \method{} on this principle. It computes the Gram matrix in the metric of the Adam preconditioner during the ordinary backward pass, selects a weighted subset greedily with a $(1-e^{-γ})$ guarantee, and uses no held-out data. Across four fine-tuning tasks and seven backbones from 1.5B to 8B parameters, LOOM improves on full-batch training by 2.3 and 2.4 points on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, exceeds every in-sample gradient matcher by 2.4 points and the validation-guided GREATS and OPUS by 1.6--2.0, and selects injected label noise at under a fifth of its base rate.

AI.tldr: LOOM通过在Adam预条件度量下计算梯度Gram矩阵，采用留一法无偏估计来选择加权子集，无需持有数据即可实现比全批量训练更优的微调效果。它根据每例梯度信噪比（SNR）加权样本，在多个任务和模型规模上显著优于现有方法，包括全批量训练、基于验证的策略及其它梯度匹配器。
AI.motivation: 现有在线批次选择方法虽不依赖持有数据，但通常无法超越全批量训练；其根本原因在于样本内梯度匹配会引入方差惩罚，导致选择噪声大的样本，使全批量成为最优解。
AI.method: 提出一种基于留一法的梯度匹配目标，通过移除梯度Gram矩阵对角线项，获得对总体梯度更新误差的无偏估计；利用该目标加权选择样本，结合贪婪算法与$(1-e^{-γ})$保证进行子集选取，并在前向传播中使用Adam预条件度量计算梯度矩阵。
AI.result: 在四个微调任务和七种不同规模（1.5B至8B参数）的模型上，LOOM相比全批量训练提升2.3-2.4点，优于所有样本内梯度匹配器2.4点以上，超过验证引导方法GREATS和OPUS 1.6-2.0点，且能以低于五分之一的基线率注入标签噪声。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入留一法无偏估计，克服了传统梯度匹配中的方差偏差问题，实现了高效、无偏、高性能的在线批次选择，证明小批量即可达到甚至超越全批量性能，为高效语言模型微调提供了新范式。

title: HierGF: Hierarchical Gaussian Fields via Geometry-perception Message Passing for Sparse-view 3D Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM), 2026
summary: Sparse view 3D reconstruction is an important and common scenario in multimedia applications, such as augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) content creation, cultural heritage digitization, and certain robotic applications, where only a limited number of randomly captured views may be available. However, sparse views contain only limited 3D information, posing two major challenges:1) too few images are available for matching, making it difficult to build multi-view consistency; 2) insufficient view coverage leads to a lack of information in under-sampled regions, resulting in missing parts of object structure. Existing methods mostly still rely on limited reprojection errors and regularization terms, which are prone to overfitting to a single view and inconsistent appearances across views. In geometrically under-sampled regions, they often rely on heuristic density control, lacking reliable guidance and often resulting in blurring and structural holes.To address these issues, this paper proposes Hierarchical Gaussian Fields (HierGF), which revisits sparse-view reconstruction from a hierarchical geometry-perception perspective and converts limited observations into reliable self-generated supervision beyond fixed priors and heuristic density control. In particular, we transform coarse 3D geometric information and additional 2D generative priors into structured pseudo-supervision through a two-stage geometry-perception backbone network, thereby enhancing multi-view consistency with very few input views. In addition, we introduce a learnable confidence network to guide gradients toward cross-view consistent content, and a geometrically consistent densification module to improve the reconstruction of multi-view alignment and under-sampled regions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为分层高斯场（HierGF）的新方法，用于解决稀疏视图3D重建中的多视图一致性与欠采样区域信息缺失问题。通过两阶段几何-感知骨干网络，将粗粒度3D几何信息和2D生成先验转化为结构化伪监督信号，增强少视图下的重建一致性；同时引入可学习置信度网络和几何一致的稠密化模块，有效提升跨视图一致性与欠采样区域的结构完整性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖有限重投影误差和正则项，易过拟合单一视图，且在几何欠采样区域依赖启发式密度控制，导致模糊和结构空洞，缺乏可靠引导。
AI.method: 提出分层高斯场（HierGF），采用两阶段几何-感知网络将粗粒度3D几何与2D生成先验转化为结构化伪监督；设计可学习置信度网络以引导梯度至跨视图一致内容；引入几何一致的稠密化模块，优化多视图对齐与欠采样区域重建。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在稀疏视图条件下显著提升了多视图一致性，减少了结构缺失与模糊现象，在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: HierGF通过引入层次化几何-感知框架与自生成监督机制，有效克服了稀疏视图重建中的关键挑战，为低视图数场景下的高质量3D重建提供了新范式。

title: Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.

AI.tldr: 提出ICR框架，通过独立推理-通信-修订的流程，分离通信对系统性能的影响，揭示通信在修正与保留决策上的差异，并强调消息内容与接收策略共同作用于性能增益与损害。
AI.motivation: 现有通信评估方法难以区分通信效果、架构优势和额外推理的影响，且准确率指标掩盖了通信如何改变决策过程，因此需要一个更可控的评估框架。
AI.method: 设计Independent--Communicate--Revise（ICR）框架，让代理先独立推理，再进行通信，最后基于通信结果进行修订；通过无消息控制组量化额外推理带来的收益，分析修正与保留行为。
AI.result: 在四个推理基准上，相同整体准确率下通信行为差异显著；完整推理比仅传递答案能更好修正错误但也会降低正确决策的保留率；结构化验证策略提升保留率并降低修正率，其选择性效应因通道和任务而异。
AI.conclusion: 通信质量并非通道的固有属性，而是由消息内容与接收策略共同决定；应将评估重点转向选择性修订，以统一理解通信带来的收益与风险。

title: Harness Annealing: Learning to Act with Less External Control
summary: Language agents rely on external harnesses to track state, organize workflows, and verify answers. Beyond providing tools and information, these harnesses supply control decisions about what to investigate, whether to revise, and when to stop. Training on successful harness-supported trajectories can improve task performance while leaving these decisions dependent on runtime intervention. We ask whether harness-supported experience can also teach the model to make these decisions, allowing the division of control to change as the model learns. We call this objective harness internalization: learning to assume specified control responsibilities while retaining task performance after the corresponding support is withdrawn. We introduce HARNESS ANNEALING TRAINING (HAT), which combines explicit control supervision with a curriculum over teacher trajectories collected under progressively weaker harnesses. Experiments with 9B and 35B models on SWE-QA and SWE-QA-Pro evaluate every checkpoint under four deployment harnesses. Selected annealed checkpoints operating with tools alone achieve scores close to those of their respective starting checkpoints deployed with the full harness. The benefits vary with model scale and deployment configuration, and further annealing does not uniformly improve performance. These findings suggest that harness-supported experience can help reduce the runtime control required by a trained agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为HARNESS ANNEALING TRAINING (HAT)的新方法，旨在让语言代理通过训练逐步内化外部支架（harness）所承担的控制决策功能，从而减少运行时对人工干预的依赖。该方法结合显式控制监督与渐进式弱化支架的教师轨迹课程，在SWE-QA和SWE-QA-Pro数据集上对9B和35B模型进行评估。结果显示，经过优化的检查点在仅使用工具的情况下表现接近初始模型在完整支架支持下的表现，表明控制职责可被有效内化，但效果受模型规模和部署配置影响，进一步弱化支架并不总是提升性能。
AI.motivation: 当前语言代理依赖外部支架来管理状态、组织流程和验证答案，这些支架也负责决定何时探索、是否修正及何时停止。然而，这种依赖导致控制权始终在运行时由外部提供，限制了自主性。因此，研究如何让模型从支架支持的经验中学习自主做出这些控制决策，以实现控制权的逐步移交，成为关键问题。
AI.method: 提出HARNESS ANNEALING TRAINING (HAT)，通过在训练过程中引入逐渐减弱的支架支持的教师轨迹，结合显式控制监督，使模型逐步适应并掌握原本由支架承担的控制任务，从而实现‘支架内化’。
AI.result: 在9B和35B模型上进行实验，发现经HAT训练后的模型在仅使用工具的情况下，性能接近原始模型在完整支架支持下的表现；不同模型规模和部署配置下效果各异，过度弱化支架并非总能带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 语言代理可以通过支架支持的经验学习承担控制责任，实现支架内化，从而显著降低运行时对控制干预的需求。这为构建更自主、更高效的智能体提供了可行路径，但其效果受模型规模与具体部署环境的影响，需谨慎设计训练策略。

title: One pool, many targets: a conservation layer and what archival data can identify
summary: Pairwise guide--transcript scores do not enforce conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool when they are interpreted independently as occupancies. We formulate a differentiable scalar equilibrium layer: one conservation equation with a unique positive root and exact implicit gradients. It yields a redistribution theorem, a qualified high-resource limit, an analysis of the retrieval approximation, and a conditional rank-invariance result: within one construct at one dose, rankings by fractional occupancy cannot distinguish equilibrium from independent scoring. We therefore audit the two experiments that proposition leaves open, dose and cross-context, on archival off-target data. Corrected thermodynamic affinities associate weakly with measured repression in the direction a working predictor requires, but a paired permutation test and a construct-cluster bootstrap do not establish added predictive value from the coupling: what survives their differing permutation-null baselines is \GapNet{}, a descriptive \GapNetOverSE{} of the equilibrium association's cluster standard error. The dose fits are heterogeneous and frequently violate the model-implied exponent constraint, which is superlinear rather than sublinear, so these data do not identify the competition parameter. A saturable compression of the competitor set holds both accuracy targets on held-out guide families but is not faster at the size measured. The contribution is a reusable conservation operator and the experimental information needed to test it. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/shadi97kh/One-Pool-Many-Targets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可微分的标量平衡层，解决引导-RISC复合物池在独立解释时的保守性问题。该模型包含一个唯一正根的守恒方程，具备精确隐式梯度，推导出重分配定理、高资源极限条件、检索近似分析及条件秩不变性结果。研究表明，在单一构建体和剂量下，分数占据率排序无法区分平衡与独立评分。通过审计开放数据中的剂量和跨上下文实验，发现修正后的热力学亲和力与抑制效应关联较弱，且配对置换检验与构建簇自举法未证明耦合具有额外预测价值，仅保留了描述性指标\GapNet{}。剂量拟合结果异质性强，常违反模型所暗示的超线性而非次线性的指数约束，表明竞争参数无法被识别。饱和压缩竞争对手集虽满足准确率目标，但未提升计算速度。研究贡献在于提供可复用的保守算子及验证所需实验信息，并公开代码。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在独立解释配对引导-转录本评分时，忽略了引导加载RISC池的有限性，导致无法保证系统保守性。为解决此问题，需建立一种能反映真实生物学平衡的数学框架，以更准确地预测脱靶效应。
AI.method: 提出一种可微分的标量平衡层，基于单个守恒方程构造，具有唯一正根和精确隐式梯度；利用该模型推导出重分配定理、高资源极限、检索近似分析及条件秩不变性；通过配对置换检验与构建簇自举法评估模型预测能力，并在真实数据上测试剂量响应与竞争参数识别。
AI.result: 模型虽能提供理论上的平衡机制，但实际数据中剂量拟合异质性显著，违背超线性指数约束，竞争参数无法识别；修正亲和力与抑制效应相关性弱；仅\GapNet{}作为描述性指标存活于多重检验；饱和压缩虽保精度但未提速。
AI.conclusion: 尽管提出了可复用的保守算子并提供了验证所需数据与代码，但当前实验数据不足以支持该模型的预测优势，尤其在竞争参数识别方面存在根本限制，未来需更精细的实验设计来验证其有效性。

title: Overcoming Kernel Redundancy for Scaling Logic Gate Networks
summary: Differentiable logic gate networks, which operate using only logic gates, have recently attracted attention as an efficient alternative to conventional neural networks. However, despite their efficiency, the scaling behavior of logic gate networks remains underexplored. By contrast, scaling model capacity is a central design principle in deep neural networks and typically leads to improved performance. This discrepancy raises a key question: Can similar scaling benefits also be achieved in logic gate networks? In this work, we focus on width as a primary scaling axis and conduct a systematic analysis of its behavior in logic gate networks. We observe that naive width scaling often introduces redundancy among logic kernels, limiting the effective use of additional kernels and leading to performance saturation. To address this limitation, we propose a dynamic logic kernel framework that reorganizes kernel utilization by promoting specialization across kernel groups. This enables the network to better utilize increased width via input-dependent kernel routing, while ensuring that both routing and computation are implemented entirely with gate-level Boolean operations at inference time. We further find that kernel redundancy is most pronounced at the first gate level, motivating an early-stage dynamic logic kernel strategy that concentrates adaptation at this level. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves kernel utilization and increases kernel diversity, leading to higher accuracy with improved parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了可微逻辑门网络的宽度缩放行为，发现盲目增加宽度会导致逻辑核冗余，限制性能提升。为此，提出动态逻辑核框架，通过输入依赖的核路由促进核组专业化，实现更高效的宽度利用。进一步提出早期动态策略，集中适应于第一层门，显著提升核利用率与多样性，从而在参数效率下获得更高精度。
AI.motivation: 探索逻辑门网络的缩放行为，解决因宽度增加导致的核冗余问题，以实现类似深度神经网络的性能提升。
AI.method: 提出动态逻辑核框架，通过输入依赖的核路由实现核组专业化；设计早期动态策略，聚焦于第一门层的自适应调整。所有操作均基于门级布尔运算实现。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法有效提升了核利用率和多样性，实现了更高的准确率和更好的参数效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态核路由和早期适应策略，可有效克服逻辑门网络中的核冗余问题，实现宽度缩放带来的性能增益，为逻辑门网络的高效扩展提供了可行路径。

title: Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver
summary: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了聊天机器人中一种称为'空承诺'的现象，即承诺在下一轮执行动作但当前系统无法实现的情况。作者定义了三种失败类型、承诺的锚定条件以及响应级别的结果分类，并提出了一种测量协议，通过五种渐进设置评估持久性功能对空承诺的影响。
AI.motivation: 研究空承诺现象，揭示聊天机器人在缺乏实际执行能力时如何做出不可兑现的承诺，从而影响用户体验与信任。
AI.method: 基于承诺语义构建空承诺的理论框架，设计包含五个逐步增加持久性功能的实验设置，结合环境显式或隐式两种情况，进行实证测量。
AI.result: 发现添加持久性功能可显著减少空承诺的发生；显式环境设定有助于更准确地识别和评估承诺的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 空承诺是人机交互中的关键问题，需通过系统设计中的持久性机制和明确环境信息来缓解，以提升对话系统的可信度与可用性。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Japanese LLMs to IME-Related and Typographical Errors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across various natural language processing tasks. However, their robustness to typographical errors remains underexplored, particularly in Japanese, where text input involves multiple writing systems and IME-based conversion. In this study, we evaluate the robustness of Japanese LLMs against realistic Japanese-specific typos. We introduce five typo categories: Character Transposition, Character Replacement, Homophone Conversion, Japanese IME Conversion, and Full-Width Conversion. These perturbations are applied to three Japanese benchmark datasets (JMMLU, JCommonsenseQA, and JamC-QA), and eleven Japanese and multilingual LLMs are evaluated. The results show that Character Transposition and Character Replacement typos consistently reduce accuracy across benchmarks, whereas IME Conversion, Full-Width Conversion, and Homophone Conversion have relatively limited impact. These findings reveal that current Japanese LLMs remain vulnerable to realistic Japanese typing errors, particularly those that substantially distort the original input, highlighting the importance of robustness evaluation in practical input environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了日语大语言模型（LLM）在真实日语拼写错误下的鲁棒性，引入五类日语特有错误类型（字符调换、字符替换、同音转换、日语输入法转换、全角转换），并在三个日语基准数据集上测试了十一个日语及多语言LLM。结果表明，字符调换和字符替换显著降低模型准确率，而其他三类错误影响较小。研究揭示当前日语LLM对严重扭曲输入的错误仍较脆弱，强调在实际输入环境下进行鲁棒性评估的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对大语言模型在自然语言处理任务中的表现关注较多，但对其在日语中因输入方式复杂（如多种书写系统、基于IME的转换）导致的拼写错误鲁棒性缺乏系统评估。日语特有的输入错误可能严重影响模型性能，亟需针对性研究以提升实际应用中的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建五类日语特有拼写错误：字符调换、字符替换、同音转换、日语输入法转换、全角转换；将这些扰动应用于三个日语基准数据集（JMMLU、JCommonsenseQA、JamC-QA）；在十一款日语及多语言大语言模型上进行评测，比较模型在原始与受扰输入下的性能差异。
AI.result: 字符调换和字符替换两类错误显著降低模型在多个基准上的准确率，而日语输入法转换、全角转换和同音转换的影响相对较小。这表明当前日语大语言模型对严重扭曲输入的错误仍不鲁棒，尤其在实际输入场景中易出错。
AI.conclusion: 当前日语大语言模型在面对真实世界中的典型拼写错误时仍表现出明显脆弱性，特别是字符调换与替换类错误。因此，在实际应用中应加强模型对输入噪声的鲁棒性评估与训练，以提高其在真实环境中的稳定性与可用性。

title: Exact information accounting for SGD methods
summary: As an alternative to the standard geometric analyses, we give an exact, information-theoretic analysis of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants. We show that a preconditioned SGD step is the posterior-mean update of a Gaussian Bayes model, and that its one-step regret splits into an intrinsic-time cost and a change in comparator information. The split extends to an identity for the objective itself. Convex convergence, strict-saddle-point escape, the link between flatness and generalization, the standard learning-rate schedules, adaptive optimizers, and the noisy, momentum, heavy-tailed, and gradient-free variants of SGD each correspond to a term or a special case of this identity. We measure its terms on synthetic and real training runs. On real networks it attributes the slack of classical convergence bounds to the terms their derivations drop and separates optimizers that reach the same training loss. That separation follows the number and consistency of their steps. Its relation to which of them generalizes better differs between networks. For gradient-free SGD the identity determines how a curvature preconditioner should enter the update. The sharpness-based generalization certificate it yields, with a data-independent isotropic prior, is vacuous at network scale unless the curvature spectrum is nearly flat across all parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种信息论视角下的随机梯度下降（SGD）及其变体的精确分析，揭示了预条件SGD步相当于高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，并将一步损失分解为内在时间成本与比较器信息变化。该分解可扩展至目标函数本身，并涵盖凸收敛、严格鞍点逃逸、平坦性与泛化的关系、学习率调度、自适应优化器及噪声、动量、重尾和无梯度等变体。通过合成与真实训练实验验证了各成分，发现经典收敛界中的松弛项被此框架捕捉，且不同优化器虽达到相同训练损失，但其步数数量与一致性存在差异；泛化性能的差异随网络结构而异。对于无梯度SGD，该框架确定了曲率预条件应如何进入更新。基于尖锐性的泛化保证在数据无关的各向同性先验下，除非曲率谱在所有参数上近乎平坦，否则在大规模网络中是平凡的。
AI.motivation: 传统几何分析难以全面解释SGD的泛化行为与优化动态，尤其在复杂网络中。本文旨在提供一种信息论视角，以更精确地理解SGD的机制，揭示其与贝叶斯推断的深层联系，并统一解释多种变体的行为。
AI.method: 建立一个高斯贝叶斯模型，将预条件SGD视为后验均值更新；通过信息论方法推导一步损失的分解形式，识别出内在时间成本与信息变化项；利用该框架映射各类优化策略为特定项或特例；在合成与真实网络上实证分析各成分的作用。
AI.result: 成功构建了统一的理论框架，揭示了多种优化现象的本质；实证表明该框架能有效解释经典收敛界限的松弛来源，并区分不同优化器的步数特性；对泛化性能的预测在不同网络中表现不一；提出无梯度SGD中曲率预条件的设计原则；指出尖锐性泛化界在大规模网络中的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于信息论的分析框架不仅深化了对SGD机制的理解，还为优化器设计与泛化能力评估提供了新的理论工具，尤其在揭示隐含假设与实际性能差距方面具有重要意义。

title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation
comment: Preprint. 51 pages, 19 figures, 23 tables. Code, dataset and project website linked in the paper
summary: Video generation models are increasingly being explored as world simulators for embodied planning and learning. To do so effectively, these models must not only generate visually appealing frames, but also predict how environments dynamically evolve when executing goal-directed actions. While evaluating these capabilities is crucial, existing benchmarks focus mainly on single short actions or step-by-step instructions. This leaves multi-step physical reasoning underexplored, especially in egocentric video generation that requires planning to simulate proper execution to accomplish high-level goals by carrying out multiple real-world manipulations. We introduce Ego2Act, a goal-directed benchmark featuring 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks across day-to-day settings, varying object clutter and multi-step complexity. Given an initial scene image and a high-level goal, Ego2Act evaluates whether video generation models can produce realistic egocentric videos of a hand manipulating objects to carry out the task. To support scalable evaluation, we also introduce Ego2ActJudge, a reference-free evaluation pipeline that achieves better task completion and physics plausibility evaluation alignment with human consensus compared to relevant baselines. Our findings reveal that models' generated simulations often skip or partially execute steps, leaving later steps missing dependent states, which leads to unfulfilled goal. Furthermore, models consistently fail at fine-grained physical dynamics, particularly during complex object manipulation and persistent world modeling. We hope Ego2Act provides a rigorous testbed for advancing video models toward physically plausible, goal-directed simulation.

AI.tldr: Ego2Act introduces a goal-directed benchmark with 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks to evaluate video generation models in egocentric settings, focusing on multi-step physical reasoning and realistic manipulation. Ego2ActJudge offers a reference-free evaluation method that aligns better with human judgment. Results show models often skip steps and fail at fine-grained dynamics and persistent world modeling.
AI.motivation: Existing benchmarks for video generation models are limited to short or step-by-step actions, leaving multi-step physical reasoning—especially in egocentric scenarios—underexplored. There is a need for a rigorous evaluation framework to assess whether models can realistically simulate goal-directed manipulation involving multiple real-world interactions.
AI.method: Ego2Act constructs a dataset of 2,640 egocentric videos across 110 diverse real-world tasks with varying clutter and complexity. It evaluates whether models can generate videos starting from an initial scene image and a high-level goal, simulating hand-object interactions. Ego2ActJudge is introduced as a reference-free evaluation pipeline to measure task completion and physics plausibility, aligned with human consensus.
AI.result: Models frequently skip or partially execute steps, leading to incomplete task execution and unfulfilled goals. They also struggle with fine-grained physical dynamics, especially during complex manipulations and maintaining consistent world states over time.
AI.conclusion: Ego2Act provides a challenging and comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the physical realism and goal-directed reasoning capabilities of video generation models. The findings highlight critical gaps in current models’ ability to simulate multi-step, physically plausible interactions, underscoring the need for further advancement in embodied simulation.

title: Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems
summary: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种条件动作的网络世界模型，用于高效预测干预下网络扩散动态的长期结果，显著提升算法设计效率和速度。
AI.motivation: 在复杂系统中，单个动作的效果往往延迟显现，传统依赖模拟评估候选动作的方法成本高昂，难以满足迭代优化需求。
AI.method: 构建一个行动条件的网络世界模型，学习网络在干预下的动态变化，并预测后续结果，作为快速评估器嵌入算法设计循环中。
AI.result: 在8个网络任务和5种扩散模型下，所设计算法在141个设置中的138个上达到或超过最强基线性能，且滚动模拟速度最快提升14.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 该模型有效提升了复杂系统中策略优化的效率与准确性，为大规模动态系统建模与决策提供了高效工具。

title: Right Answers, Wrong States: Hidden Information Failures in Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent systems are often judged by whether they reach the correct answer. This can miss a distinct failure: collaboration may leave behind a corrupted information state even when the immediate decision is correct. We call this an off-query failure. To study this failure in collaborative decision support, we introduce OffQuery, which separately evaluates evidence verification (T1), shared-state reconstruction (T2), and task resolution (T3) in two representative high-stakes settings: healthcare and disaster response. Across GPT, Gemini, and Qwen models, standard collaboration shows much stronger task performance than state reliability. Averaged over 21 model--setting combinations, task resolution reaches 64.7%, while evidence verification and state reconstruction reach only 14.3% and 43.1%. We trace this gap to selective information use: current queries often bypass corrupted facts, which become consequential when later tasks require them. We further introduce ReGround, which resolves conflicting evidence, verifies shared facts, reconstructs a trusted state, and reasons over that state. Across seven models from three families, ReGround improves all three capabilities in every evaluated setting, with average relative gains of 309.0%, 82.9%, and 17.6% on T1, T2, and T3. Reliable collaboration therefore requires both a correct decision and a reliable shared state for future reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出'OffQuery'框架，用于评估多智能体系统在医疗和灾难响应等高风险场景中的协作可靠性，发现尽管任务完成率可达64.7%，但证据验证（T1）和共享状态重建（T2）成功率分别仅14.3%和43.1%，存在显著的‘离查询失败’问题。通过引入ReGround机制，可有效提升证据验证、状态重建与任务解决能力，平均相对提升达309.0%、82.9%和17.6%。结论强调：可靠协作不仅需正确决策，还需维护可信的共享信息状态以支持后续推理。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多智能体系统主要关注是否得出正确答案，但忽略了协作过程中可能遗留被污染的信息状态，即使当前决策正确，也可能导致未来推理错误，这种现象称为‘离查询失败’。为揭示并解决这一问题，需建立更全面的评估与改进机制。
AI.method: 提出OffQuery评估框架，分别测试证据验证（T1）、共享状态重建（T2）和任务解决（T3）；设计ReGround方法，通过冲突证据处理、事实验证、可信状态重建与基于可信状态的推理，实现协同系统的可靠性提升。
AI.result: 在GPT、Gemini、Qwen等21种模型-场景组合中，标准协作任务完成率达64.7%，但证据验证和状态重建仅14.3%和43.1%；使用ReGround后，七种不同模型在三个指标上均实现显著提升，平均相对增益分别为309.0%、82.9%和17.6%。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的多智能体协作不仅要求最终决策正确，还必须维护一个可信且一致的共享信息状态，以支持未来的推理任务。ReGround有效缓解了信息状态腐败问题，是实现长期可靠协作的关键。

title: Score the Update, Not the Token: Descent-Aligned Routing for Combinatorial LoRA Experts
summary: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts methods raise the capacity of low-rank adaptation by routing each token to a few low-rank experts. Nearly all of them tie one input-side factor to one output-side factor per expert, and nearly all of them route by scoring the token: the router picks experts without seeing what any of them would write. We argue that the router should score the update. To first order, adding an expert's update to a layer output lowers the loss by the inner product between that update and the negative loss gradient at the output. This usefulness is quadratic in the token, so a router that is linear in the token sees only the part of it that runs through the token mean, and routers that rank experts by the norm of their own activations never see the output factor. If each expert is split into a reader (down-projection) and a writer (up-projection), the usefulness of every reader--writer pair becomes an inner product in the shared rank-$r$ space, and all $N_AN_B$ pairs can be scored from $N_A+N_B$ vectors. We build VANE on this identity. A low-rank compass predicts the descent direction of each token. VANE scores every pair by the alignment between its update and the compass without forming any update, activates the top-$k$ pairs with additive gates, and gives every pair its exact first-order router gradient. On single-domain commonsense reasoning and a four-domain multi-task mixture with Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, VANE attains the best average among twelve PEFT and MoE-LoRA baselines, by 0.9--1.1 and 1.3--1.5 points respectively, with less than half the trainable parameters of an 8-expert MoE-LoRA. Its router scores also track the measured usefulness of experts far more closely than token routers do.

AI.tldr: VANE提出一种新的低秩专家混合方法，通过将每个专家拆分为读取器（down-projection）和写入器（up-projection），利用共享的低秩空间计算每对读写器的更新有用性，实现高效且精准的专家路由。该方法基于梯度方向的内积评分机制，无需显式生成更新即可评分，使用加性门控激活前k个最优对，并提供精确的一阶路由器梯度。在单领域常识推理与多领域混合任务中，VANE在性能上优于12种PEFT和MoE-LoRA基线方法，参数量少于8专家MoE-LoRA的一半，且路由器评分更贴近实际专家效用。
AI.motivation: 现有Mixture-of-LoRA-experts方法通常将输入侧因子与输出侧因子绑定，并基于输入令牌进行专家路由，而忽略了专家更新对损失下降的实际贡献。本文指出，应基于更新的有用性而非输入本身来评分专家，以提升路由准确性。
AI.method: 将每个专家分解为读取器（down-projection）和写入器（up-projection），在共享的低秩空间中通过内积计算每对读写器的更新有用性，仅需$N_A + N_B$个向量即可评估全部$N_AN_B$对组合。采用低秩指南针预测每个令牌的下降方向，基于对齐度评分所有对，使用加性门控激活前k个最优对，并给出精确的一阶梯度用于优化。
AI.result: 在单域常识推理和四域多任务混合任务上，VANE分别比12种基线方法平均高出0.9–1.1分和1.3–1.5分；训练参数不足8专家MoE-LoRA的一半，且路由器评分与实际专家效用的相关性显著高于传统基于令牌的路由方法。
AI.conclusion: VANE通过基于更新有用性的评分机制和高效的低秩内积计算，在保持极低参数量的同时实现了卓越的性能和更准确的专家选择，为低秩专家混合方法提供了新的设计范式。

title: MVDG: Efficient Multi-view 3D Disambiguation on Unconstrained Real-World Images
summary: Illusory matches between distinct yet visually similar 3D surfaces--doppelgangers--remain a fundamental obstacle for large-scale, in-the-wild 3D reconstruction and visual localization. Prior work mitigates this issue with pairwise classifiers, but this design limits multi-view contextual reasoning and incurs O(n^2) inference complexity for downstream structure-from-motion (SfM). We present MVDG, a scalable multi-view disambiguation framework built on the 3D foundation model VGGT, which jointly reasons over an arbitrary number of multiview images. By incorporating 3D-aware multi-view features, our method reduces dependence on pairwise comparisons by encoding and decoding views in a single pass. We further observe that direct multi-view fine-tuning of VGGT can be unstable under noisy supervision; motivated by label ambiguity in Doppelgangers, we construct a pseudo-pairwise training set from AerialMegaDepth and show that fine-tuning on sampled subsets yields stable optimization and strong generalization to held-out scenes. Finally, because full SfM evaluation (even with faster pipelines such as GLOMAP) remains expensive, we process a pseudo-pairwise dataset for efficient validation; we derive a predictive relationship between regular SfM metrics and the classification accuracy on this pseudo-pairwise test. Experiments show that our method achieves comparable pairwise accuracy while improving both SfM accuracy and inference speed over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MVDG框架，利用3D基础模型VGGT实现多视角联合推理，以解决3D重建中因视觉相似表面导致的误匹配问题。通过引入3D感知的多视图特征，减少对成对比较的依赖，并在单次传递中编码解码视图。针对直接微调不稳定的问题，作者构建伪成对训练集并采用子集采样策略，提升优化稳定性与泛化能力。此外，为高效验证，设计伪成对数据集并建立常规SfM指标与分类准确率之间的预测关系。实验表明，该方法在保持成对匹配精度的同时，显著提升SfM准确率和推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖成对分类器，难以进行多视角上下文推理，且存在O(n^2)复杂度，限制了大规模3D重建和视觉定位的应用。尤其在真实场景中，视觉相似的3D表面（即doppelgangers）导致严重误匹配，亟需更高效、可扩展的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出MVDG框架，基于3D基础模型VGGT，利用3D感知的多视图特征实现任意数量图像的联合推理；通过单次前向传播完成视图编码与解码，减少对成对比较的依赖；构建伪成对训练集并使用子集采样进行稳定微调；设计伪成对测试集以实现高效验证，并建立与标准SfM指标的预测关系。
AI.result: 在保持与基线相当的成对匹配准确率基础上，MVDG显著提升了结构光流（SfM）的重建精度与推理效率，验证了其在真实场景中的有效性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: MVDG通过多视角联合推理与稳定微调策略，有效缓解了3D重建中的误匹配问题，为大规模、真实世界场景下的3D重建提供了高效且鲁棒的新范式。

title: Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Recent work introduces search into RLVR rollouts to increase trajectory diversity, but diversity alone does not ensure that the search-induced rollout policy improves upon the current policy. To address this gap, we propose APIVIS, a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning. APIVIS combines direct and searched responses within each rollout group, allowing improvements found by search to produce informative relative rewards. It further applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens, preserving a learning signal when uniform group rewards render GRPO ineffective. We show that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the complete rollout policy, with a corresponding approximate guarantee under bounded value-estimation error. Experiments on widely recognized mathematical reasoning benchmarks and different model scales demonstrate substantial improvements over competitive search-based methods, validating the effectiveness of APIVIS.

AI.tldr: APIVIS 是一种用于数学推理的强化学习框架，通过结合直接生成与搜索生成的响应，并采用选择性监督机制，提升策略优化效果。它利用价值引导的选择策略，在有限预算下增强搜索效率，从而在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于搜索的强化学习方法虽然提升了轨迹多样性，但多样性并不保证策略改进；因此需要一种机制确保搜索带来的改进能有效传递给训练过程。
AI.method: APIVIS 将 Gumbel 搜索应用于块级数学推理，将直接输出与搜索输出组合在同一滚动组中，利用相对奖励信号指导学习，并通过选择性监督保留关键学习信号，同时引入价值引导的选择策略以保证期望验证奖励的提升。
AI.result: 在多个主流数学推理基准和不同规模模型上，APIVIS 均显著优于当前先进的搜索基方法，验证了其有效性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: APIVIS 通过融合搜索与直接生成、并设计有效的奖励与监督机制，实现了对数学推理能力的显著提升，尤其在高复杂度任务中表现突出。

title: Science Utopia? Closed-Loop LLM Simulation of Academic Research Ecosystems
summary: Scientific progress emerges from a longitudinal ecosystem in which researchers, institutions, funding agencies, collaboration networks, and the scientific literature co-evolve. As AI becomes increasingly involved throughout the scientific research cycle, understanding these interconnected and evolving processes becomes increasingly important. We introduce SciUtopia, a persistent, closed-loop LLM-agent simulation framework for studying academic research ecosystems. SciUtopia models interconnected scientific processes such as research-direction choice, collaboration, submission, peer review, resubmission, citation, funding, and researcher attrition, while maintaining evolving states across simulated years. Its configurable institutional mechanisms and information channels provide a controlled testbed for matched counterfactual experiments and targeted interventions. Across 61 simulation worlds, SciUtopia simulates over 40,000 researchers from 8,000 institutions, producing around 400,000 publication decisions and 1.2 million LLM-generated peer reviews. Using these longitudinal simulations, we find that rejection-driven resubmission substantially amplifies reviewer burden beyond population growth alone, cautious exploration balances citation impact with career success and long-term topic diversity, and resource inequality can emerge even without detectable cumulative advantage from narrowly winning early funding. Code is available at https://github.com/Ahren09/ScienceUtopia.

AI.tldr: SciUtopia 是一个基于大语言模型代理的闭环模拟框架，用于研究学术研究生态系统。它模拟了从研究方向选择、合作、投稿、同行评审、再提交、引用、资金分配到研究人员流失等过程，支持跨时间的动态演化。在61个模拟世界中，共模拟了4万多名研究人员和8,000所机构，生成约40万次出版决策和120万条由LLM生成的同行评审意见。研究发现：拒稿驱动的再提交显著增加了审稿人负担；谨慎探索有助于平衡引文影响力与职业成功及长期主题多样性；即使没有明显的早期资金累积优势，资源不平等仍可能产生。代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能在科研全流程中的深入参与，理解科研生态中研究人员、机构、资助方、合作网络与科学文献之间相互作用的长期演化机制变得愈发重要。现有研究缺乏对这些复杂系统动态的可控模拟工具，亟需一个可配置、可重复、能进行反事实实验的仿真平台。
AI.method: 提出并实现 SciUtopia 框架，采用大语言模型代理（LLM-agents）模拟个体研究人员行为，包括研究选题、合作、投稿、评审反馈、再提交、引用、资金申请与流失等行为，并通过多轮迭代模拟多年演化过程。系统支持多种制度设定与信息传播渠道配置，允许进行对比实验与干预分析。
AI.result: 模拟结果显示：1）拒稿导致的反复投稿显著加剧了审稿人负担；2）采取适度保守的研究策略有利于长期主题多样性和高影响力成果产出；3）资源分配不均可在无累积优势机制的情况下自然形成，表明结构性因素在科研公平性中的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: SciUtopia 为研究科学生态系统的演化提供了强有力的模拟工具，揭示了当前科研体系中潜在的非线性效应与结构性问题，强调了制度设计在促进科研公平与效率方面的重要性。

title: Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps
summary: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

AI.tldr: Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF) 是一种连续流映射语言模型，利用预训练自回归语言模型中的噪声-数据耦合。理论上证明了自回归模型引起的高斯噪声与独热标记序列之间的耦合会产生不相交的线性路径，连接噪声到序列表示。为增强高质量少步路径采样，使用由AR教师直接指导的流映射半群目标。在多个基准测试中，包括预训练和下游任务，GSF能够超越当前的少步语言生成基线。
AI.motivation: 现有语言生成方法在少步采样中存在路径质量不高、难以保持序列一致性的问题。为提升生成质量与效率，需要一种能有效利用预训练自回归模型信息的连续流建模方法。
AI.method: 提出Gumbel Straight Flow（GSF），通过利用自回归模型中噪声与序列间的耦合关系，构建非交叉线性路径。采用流映射半群目标，使速度方向由预训练自回归模型直接引导，实现高质量少步路径采样。
AI.result: 在多种预训练与下游任务的基准测试中，GSF表现出优于现有少步生成方法的性能，尤其在生成质量和路径稳定性方面有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: GSF成功将自回归模型的噪声-数据耦合特性融入连续流框架，实现了高效且高质量的语言生成，为少步生成提供了新范式。

title: Affine-Aligned Atlas for Canonical Gaussian Construction in Video Representation
summary: Gaussian splatting has recently emerged as an efficient representation for images and videos due to its explicit structure and fast rendering capability. Existing Gaussian-based video representations often decompose a video into canonical Gaussians and temporal deformation. However, when a video contains large global motion such as camera movement, the canonical representation may become misaligned with individual frames, increasing the burden on the temporal deformation model. In this paper, we propose an affine-atlas canonical Gaussian representation, which constructs canonical Gaussians in a larger affine-aligned atlas space. Frame-wise affine transforms absorb global motion before canonical Gaussian construction, reducing the gap between the canonical representation and target frames. Since the proposed method only modifies the canonical construction stage, it can be integrated into existing canonical-Gaussian-based methods with negligible additional parameter cost. Experiments show that our method improves reconstruction quality especially for sequences with large camera motion.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种仿射图集（affine-atlas）的规范高斯表示方法，通过在仿射对齐的图集空间中构建规范高斯，使帧间仿射变换吸收全局运动，减少规范表示与目标帧之间的偏差。该方法可无缝集成到现有基于规范高斯的方法中，几乎不增加参数开销，并显著提升大相机运动视频的重建质量。
AI.motivation: 当视频包含大范围全局运动（如相机移动）时，传统的规范高斯表示容易与单帧错位，导致时间变形模型负担加重。因此需要一种能更好处理全局运动的规范表示方法。
AI.method: 在构建规范高斯前，先对每一帧应用帧级仿射变换，将全局运动吸收至变换中，从而在仿射对齐的图集空间中构建更一致的规范高斯表示。该方法仅修改规范构建阶段，兼容性强。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在具有大相机运动的视频序列上显著提升了重建质量，同时保持了较低的额外计算和参数开销。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的仿射图集规范高斯表示有效缓解了大运动场景下的表示失配问题，是一种高效且可集成的改进方案。

title: YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents
comment: Accepted to the AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference. 21 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables
summary: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. On MLR-Bench's predefined ten-task end-to-end subset, YouRA improves over both MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 on scalar Overall across all three matched backbones. An automated diagnostic using MLR-Bench's hallucination taxonomy reports intersection/union counts for four fact-based failure types, and data-provenance diagnostic shows more real-data-based outputs. Ablating each of the four components (the VSA, the Independent Controller, MCP tool access, and reflection-guided recovery) supports their separable contributions. Removing either core-state component drops YouRA below the full system. Code: https://github.com/PrayPrey/Your-Research-Agent.

AI.tldr: YouRA 是一种可持久化、可追溯证据的自主研究架构，通过整合验证状态架构（VSA）、独立控制器和状态化反思机制，解决科研代理在长周期任务中因状态丢失导致的主张与实验不符问题。在 MLR-Bench 基准上，YouRA 在多个模型骨干下均优于现有方法，且组件消融实验证明各模块贡献可分。
AI.motivation: 当前端到端科研代理生成的论文主张常与实际执行实验脱节，根本原因在于研究状态、失败历史和论据对齐未被持续维护。需构建具备持久状态与可追溯证据的自主研究系统。
AI.method: 提出 YouRA 架构，包含：1）验证状态架构（VSA）追踪假设、门控与证据指针；2）独立控制器基于状态与反思记录实现生命周期管理、恢复与评审控制，实现控制与执行分离；3）状态化反思机制将失败结构化为经验教训，并引导有限修复、重构或重置。
AI.result: 在 MLR-Bench 的十项任务上，YouRA 在所有三个骨干模型下均超越 MLR-Agent 与 AI Scientist V2；自动诊断显示其更少幻觉，更多真实数据输出；各组件消融实验表明核心状态组件不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: YouRA 有效解决了自主科研中状态与证据不可持续的问题，显著提升科研可信度与可靠性，为下一代科学智能系统提供坚实基础。

title: Know When to Hold 'em: Correct-Token Retention in Uniform-State Diffusion Language Models
summary: Uniform-state diffusion models (USDMs) can revise any token at any denoising step, which lets them correct their own mistakes, a key advantage over masked diffusion. Self-correction, however, requires both revising incorrect tokens and retaining correct ones, and we show that current USDMs lack the latter. Even under greedy-tail decoding, state-of-the-art USDMs (DUO, UDLM, and uniform-noise SEDD) keep revising 173--270 of 512 positions at every step, and these large, uncoordinated edits collapse sample diversity.
