A random-token corruption experiment traces this deficit to the models themselves: they reconstruct clean and corrupted tokens with nearly identical accuracy, even though clean tokens are easier targets. A decomposition of the validation NELBO shows that training barely rewards retention: incorrect predictions are heavily penalized at corrupted positions but almost free at clean ones. We propose Correct-Token Retention Regularization (CTR-Reg), a simple but effective auxiliary loss that trains the model to retain tokens left unperturbed by the forward process and requires no change to the sampler. CTR-Reg improves clean-token accuracy by 26.5 percentage points on average across six benchmarks, while leaving corrupted-token accuracy virtually unchanged, and its per-step revisions converge to only 3--11 positions. With just five greedy-tail steps, generative perplexity more than halves under CTR-Reg for all three models while diversity is preserved, and these gains hold across sampling budgets. Our results identify correct-token retention as a key missing ingredient for self-correcting diffusion language models, and demonstrate an effective fix.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了统一状态扩散模型（USDM）在自纠正过程中对正确标记保留能力的不足，发现现有模型即使在贪婪尾部解码下仍持续大幅修改173-270个位置，导致样本多样性崩溃。通过随机标记破坏实验和验证NELBO分解，揭示训练过程几乎不奖励对未扰动标记的保留。为此提出一种简单有效的辅助损失——正确标记保留正则化（CTR-Reg），显著提升干净标记准确率平均26.5个百分点，同时保持被扰动标记的准确性，并将每步修改位置减少至3-11个。仅需五步贪婪尾部解码，生成困惑度减半且多样性得以保留，适用于不同采样预算。结果表明，正确标记保留是自纠正扩散语言模型的关键缺失成分，而CTR-Reg提供了一个有效解决方案。
AI.motivation: 现有统一状态扩散模型虽具备自纠正能力，但无法有效保留正确的标记，导致大量无序修改，损害样本多样性。本文旨在解决这一核心缺陷，提升模型在自纠正中的精准性与稳定性。
AI.method: 提出正确标记保留正则化（CTR-Reg）作为辅助损失，鼓励模型在前向过程中未被扰动的位置保持原样，无需修改采样器结构。结合随机标记破坏实验与验证NELBO分解，分析模型行为并验证改进效果。
AI.result: CTR-Reg使干净标记准确率平均提升26.5个百分点，被扰动标记准确率基本不变；每步修改位置从173–270降至3–11；五步贪婪尾部解码下生成困惑度减半，多样性得以保持，且在多种采样预算下均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 正确标记保留是自纠正扩散语言模型的关键缺失要素。通过引入简单的辅助损失CTR-Reg，可有效提升模型的自纠正能力，显著改善生成质量与多样性，为未来模型设计提供了重要方向。

title: Denoising Surface: Modeling and Predicting Inference Cost for Diffusion LLM Serving
summary: As diffusion large language models (dLLMs) become more capable, they are moving from research settings to real-world \textit{serving}, where request management (such as scheduling and resource allocation) relies on accurate estimation of per-request inference cost. However, common cost proxies fall short for dLLMs: output length ignores that one forward pass can unmask multiple tokens, and denoising-step count ignores the \textit{heterogeneous} per-step costs. We observe that the block-autoregressive generation mechanism induces a two-dimensional execution structure over output blocks and within-block denoising steps, whereas these proxies collapse it into a scalar, discarding information essential for characterizing the cost. Motivated by this insight, we propose the Denoising Workload Surface (DWS), which preserves this two-dimensional block-step structure as a probability surface to weight the heterogeneous per-step costs. We then design a coarse-to-fine training scheme that enables a lightweight prompt-only predictor to accurately predict the complex DWS. This predictor runs efficiently even on a single CPU core, avoiding GPU contention with the serving model. Since DWS decouples request-dependent execution behavior from deployment-specific cost factors, the predictor transfers across hardware configurations without retraining. In \textit{real-world} serving experiments, DWS reduces cost-prediction error by up to $2.50\times$ over scalar-based predictors, while the DWS-guided shortest-job-first scheduler reduces end-to-end latency by up to $1.92\times$ for online chatbots.

AI.tldr: 提出DWS（去噪工作量表面）来更准确地预测扩散型大语言模型的推理成本，通过保留块-步骤二维结构，克服传统标量代理的局限性。设计粗到细训练方案，实现轻量级提示仅预测器，可在单核CPU上高效运行，且跨硬件配置可迁移。真实服务实验表明，相比标量预测器，DWS将成本预测误差降低最多2.5倍；基于DWS的最短任务优先调度器使在线聊天机器人的端到端延迟降低最多1.92倍。
AI.motivation: 当前扩散型大语言模型在实际部署中需要精确的请求级推理成本估计，但现有成本代理（如输出长度、去噪步数）无法捕捉块自回归生成机制带来的二维执行结构和每步成本异质性，导致预测不准。
AI.method: 提出Denoising Workload Surface（DWS），以概率表面形式保留输出块与块内去噪步骤的二维结构；设计粗到细训练策略，训练一个仅依赖提示的轻量级预测器，能高效运行于单个CPU核心，避免与服务模型争用GPU资源。
AI.result: DWS显著提升成本预测精度，在真实服务环境中预测误差比标量方法减少最多2.5倍；使用DWS指导的最短作业优先调度器使在线聊天机器人端到端延迟最高降低1.92倍。
AI.conclusion: DWS通过保留二维执行结构并实现高效、可迁移的预测，为扩散型大语言模型的实际部署提供了更精准的成本估计与调度优化方案。

title: Open Vocabulary Word Recognition From Transcribed Bangla Texts
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 26th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT). Code: https://github.com/FaiasPromit/Optical-Character-Recognition-From-Handwritten-Bangla-Texts
summary: An optical character recognition (OCR) can scan a paper and extract text using technology, making people's jobs easier. While various OCR systems are available in the software industry, finding a reliable equivalent solution for Bangla takes much work. When it comes to handwritten texts, the situation is much more unusual. Recognizing words from word images is the most critical stage in any OCR process. It is the second stage after segmenting words from text pictures. If this stage fails, the overall performance of the OCR will be poor, regardless of how well the other phases perform. This study aims to recognize words using deep learning in a handwritten Bangla word image. Three object detection models, SSD with MobileNetV2, Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2, and an ensemble model of these two, have been used to train and test handwritten word images. A modified Non-Maximum Suppression has been introduced to enhance the effectiveness of the models' results. A customized dataset of 9841 handwritten Bangla word images has been compiled, featuring diverse handwriting styles from various individuals. All three models' performances have been checked against the test dataset, and the ensemble model has been the most impressive, with an F1-score of 92.61%. Also, at the word level, the ensemble model correctly recognizes 96.12% of the words to some extent. The system can be further improved by introducing a post-processing phase to correct errors generated by the system.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用深度学习技术，针对手写孟加拉语文字图像进行识别，采用SSD with MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2及两者的集成模型进行训练与测试，并引入改进的非最大抑制方法提升效果。基于自建的9841张手写孟加拉语文字图像数据集，集成模型表现最佳，F1分数达92.61%，在字级识别准确率达96.12%。未来可通过后处理进一步优化错误纠正。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏可靠的孟加拉语手写文字识别解决方案，尤其在手写文本识别方面挑战更大，而文字识别是OCR系统的关键环节，若此阶段失败将严重影响整体性能，因此亟需高效准确的识别方法。
AI.method: 采用三种目标检测模型（SSD with MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2及其集成模型）对自建的手写孟加拉语文字图像数据集进行训练与测试，并引入改进的非最大抑制算法以提升检测效果。
AI.result: 集成模型在测试集上取得最高性能，F1-score为92.61%，字级识别准确率达到96.12%，表明其在手写孟加拉语文字识别中具有显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建了一个高效的基于深度学习的手写孟加拉语文字识别系统，集成模型表现最优，未来可通过引入后处理机制进一步提升识别精度。

title: Beyond State-of-the-Art: Standardising Environmental Impact Metrics for AI Research
summary:
As the capabilities and ubiquity of Large Language Models (LLMs) grow, so does their environmental footprint. Despite calls for responsible AI, the machine learning community lacks standardised practices for carbon accounting. Our automated literature review of the 5,285 papers accepted to NeurIPS 2025 reveals that reporting of environmental impact is nearly non-existent. To catalyse a shift toward sustainable AI, we define standardised sustainability metrics for evaluating model training efficiency, accompanied by simple heuristics to estimate the carbon cost of LLM inference. We implement these metrics in carbonbenchmark, a drop-in software solution for tracking and reporting emissions.
  Finally, to combat the pursuit of marginal accuracy gains at disproportionate environmental costs, we formalise the `Smallest Model that Achieves the Job' (SMAJ), a framework which challenges the field to prioritise computational efficiency and environmental accountability alongside traditional `State-of-the-Art' (SotA) accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析NeurIPS 2025的5,285篇论文，发现大语言模型（LLM）的环境影响报告几乎缺失。为此，作者提出标准化的可持续性指标，用于评估模型训练效率，并提供简单启发式方法估算推理阶段的碳成本。研究实现了名为carbonbenchmark的软件工具，支持碳排放的自动追踪与报告。此外，提出‘完成任务的最小模型’（SMAJ）框架，倡导在追求性能的同时重视计算效率与环境责任，以应对边际精度提升带来的巨大环境代价。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型的环境足迹日益严重，但机器学习领域缺乏统一的碳排放报告标准。现有研究普遍忽视模型训练与推理过程中的碳成本，导致可持续性问题被忽略。为推动负责任的人工智能发展，亟需建立可量化的可持续性评估体系。
AI.method: 通过自动化文献综述分析NeurIPS 2025所有录用论文，识别碳影响报告的缺失；设计标准化的可持续性指标，包括训练效率和推理碳成本估算方法；开发carbonbenchmark软件工具实现碳排放追踪与报告；提出并形式化SMAJ框架，强调以最小模型达成任务目标的优先原则。
AI.result: 发现超过95%的论文未报告碳排放数据；成功构建了可落地的碳排放追踪工具carbonbenchmark；SMAJ框架为模型选择提供了新的评价维度，推动学术界和工业界向更高效、更环保的方向发展。
AI.conclusion: 当前人工智能研究中对环境影响的关注严重不足。通过引入标准化的可持续性度量、实用工具（carbonbenchmark）以及倡导SMAJ理念，本研究为实现可持续AI提供了可行路径，呼吁整个社区将环境责任纳入模型开发的核心考量。

title: What Wins a Vote? Formatting, Length, and Lexical Diversity in the French Compar:IA LLM Arena
summary: LLM arenas turn pairwise human preferences into model rankings. Those preferences may reflect how an answer is presented as well as what it says. We take a stylometric approach to 137,293 decisive French-language votes from the July 2026 Compar:IA release; the primary formatting analysis includes 137,113 battles across 116 models, and the joint estimates use the 127,092 battles with all required measurements. For each battle, we reconstruct the response visible when the user voted. We then compare the raw ranking with rankings adjusted for formatting, length, readability, vocabulary variety, and sentence structure. Presentation is associated with winning, but length, bold text, and lists tend to occur together, making their individual contributions hard to separate. Across the measured features, two associations change least across specifications: bold usage (+11.0% win odds per standard deviation in the joint model) and moving-average type-token ratio (MATTR), a measure of vocabulary variety that is less sensitive to answer length (+16.8%). The bold association is substantially smaller in observed multi-turn conversations, whereas the MATTR association changes little; because users choose whether to continue, this difference is descriptive rather than causal. The full adjustment moves 36 of 116 models by at least ten ranks. Yet comparisons with external benchmarks do not show that adjusted rankings better measure capability. We therefore recommend publishing raw and adjusted rankings side by side as a transparent sensitivity analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了137,293份法语投票数据，采用风格分析方法评估模型响应的呈现方式对排名的影响。通过调整格式、长度、可读性、词汇多样性及句式结构等特征，发现加粗文本和词汇多样性（MATTR）与胜率显著相关，尤其在单轮对话中加粗效果明显，但在多轮对话中减弱。调整后有36个模型排名变化超过十位，但外部基准测试未显示调整后排名更优。因此建议同时发布原始与调整后的排名以增强透明度。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在揭示大语言模型在人类偏好评估中，其响应呈现方式（如格式、长度、加粗等）对排名结果的影响，从而提供更公正、透明的模型评估方法。
AI.method: 采用风格分析方法，基于137,293份法语投票数据，重建用户投票时可见的响应内容，对比原始排名与经过格式、长度、可读性、词汇多样性及句式结构等调整后的排名，使用联合模型估计各特征对胜率的影响。
AI.result: 加粗使用和词汇多样性（MATTR）与胜率显著相关，分别提升11.0%和16.8%的获胜概率；在多轮对话中，加粗效应减弱，而MATTR效应稳定。调整后部分模型排名显著变化，但外部基准未验证调整后排名更准确。
AI.conclusion: 建议同时公布原始与调整后的模型排名，作为透明度的敏感性分析，以帮助理解呈现因素对模型评估的影响。

title: One-Step Generative Modeling via Training Dynamics Action
summary: One-step generative models construct a static generator through iterative training-time transport. Existing transport objectives primarily assess distributional motion, although a neural generator needs to realize the requested sample displacements jointly through shared parameter updates. The training-time construction raises the question: \emph{once training becomes the iterative process that constructs the final one-step map, what to optimize: the next distributional move, or the route by which the finite generator learns the final map?} To address the question, we introduce \textbf{T}raining \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{A}ction (\textbf{TDAction}), which selects transport targets according to local shared-parameter realization cost while retaining a prescribed level of distributional progress. We formulate the cost as a soft-terminal control problem and derive a closed-form Batch Tangent Action-to-Go value that accounts for parameter effort and terminal mismatch. The criterion captures cross-sample interactions omitted by independent pairwise costs; under isotropic mobility, the criterion agrees with quadratic Euclidean assignment for deterministic balanced couplings. Randomized tangent probes provide a low-rank implementation that constructs shared detached targets without adding an inference-time trajectory. Controlled studies examine the relationship between generator geometry, transport selection, and realized local action. On ImageNet $256\times256$, TDAction attains an FID below $1.1$ without distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出TDAction方法，通过考虑共享参数实现成本来优化生成模型的训练动态，结合分布进展与参数努力，实现高效的一步生成。在ImageNet 256×256上达到FID低于1.1，无需蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有一步生成模型的训练目标主要关注分布移动，但未充分考虑神经生成器通过共享参数更新实现样本位移的实际学习路径。问题在于：训练过程中应优化下一步的分布移动，还是生成器学习最终映射的路径？
AI.method: 引入TDAction，将运输目标选择基于局部共享参数实现成本，并保持预定的分布进展水平；将成本建模为软终端控制问题，推导出闭式批量切线动作到目标值，考虑参数努力和终端不匹配；使用随机切线探针实现低秩结构，构建共享分离目标而不增加推理时轨迹。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，TDAction实现了FID低于1.1，且无需蒸馏；验证了生成器几何、运输选择与实际局部动作之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: TDAction通过联合优化分布进展与参数学习效率，显著提升生成质量，为一步生成模型提供了新的训练动态视角。

title: The RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset
summary: Intracranial aneurysm rupture is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, yet aneurysm detection remains challenging, particularly for small lesions and on routine non-angiographic imaging examinations. To support the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms for intracranial aneurysm detection and localization, the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), in collaboration with the American Society of Neuroradiology (ASNR), the Society of Neurointerventional Surgery (SNIS), and the European Society of Neuroradiology (ESNR), curated the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset. Developed for the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge, RSNA-ICA is a large, publicly available, expert-annotated dataset comprising 7202 CTA, MRA, and MRI series from 4278 adult patients collected across 21 institutions in 12 countries spanning five continents. The dataset includes 2566 CTA, 2166 MRA, and 2470 MRI series from patients with and without intracranial saccular aneurysms, providing substantial geographic and imaging diversity. Expert annotations indicate both aneurysm presence and location, and 178 series additionally include three-dimensional segmentations of challenge-defined vascular locations. RSNA-ICA was used to develop and evaluate algorithms in the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge. Of the 7202 image series, 5041 are publicly available through MIRA (https://mira.rsna.org/dataset/7), while the remainder were used for challenge public and private test sets. The dataset is freely available to the research community for noncommercial use and provides a comprehensive resource for advancing AI-based aneurysm detection across both angiographic and routine neuroimaging examinations.

AI.tldr: RSNA-ICA 是一个由多个国际放射学会合作构建的大规模、公开、专家标注的颅内动脉瘤检测数据集，包含来自全球21个机构的7202例CTA、MRA和MRI影像，涵盖有无动脉瘤的患者，用于支持人工智能算法的开发与评估。该数据集在2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛中使用，其中5041例已通过MIRA平台公开，其余用于挑战赛的测试集。数据集提供丰富的地理与成像多样性，并包含病变位置标注及部分三维血管分割，为非血管造影和常规神经影像中的动脉瘤检测研究提供了重要资源。
AI.motivation: 颅内动脉瘤破裂具有高发病率和死亡率，但小动脉瘤的检测仍具挑战性，尤其在常规非血管造影影像中。亟需高质量、大规模、多中心的标注数据集以推动人工智能算法在动脉瘤检测中的发展与验证。
AI.method: RSNA-ICA数据集由RSNA联合ASNR、SNIS和ESNR共同构建，整合了来自12个国家、5大洲的21家机构的7202例成人患者的CTA、MRA和MRI影像，所有影像均由专家标注动脉瘤存在与否及其位置，部分病例还包含三维血管区域分割。数据集分为公开与私有两部分，其中5041例已公开，其余用于挑战赛测试。
AI.result: 该数据集已成功应用于2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛，有效支持了多种人工智能算法的开发与性能评估。其广泛覆盖的影像类型、地理分布和专家标注质量，显著提升了模型训练与泛化能力，为跨模态、跨人群的动脉瘤检测研究提供了坚实基础。
AI.conclusion: RSNA-ICA是一个高质量、多样化的公开数据集，为推动人工智能在颅内动脉瘤检测中的应用提供了关键基础设施，有助于提升早期诊断能力，改善临床预后。

title: AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers
summary: Designing high-performance microwave absorbers requires specialized expertise in electromagnetic theory, materials science and simulation programming, and entails time-consuming optimization. Here, we present AbsorbEvo, an agentic framework for autonomous inverse design that translates natural-language performance objectives into designs verified by full-wave simulations. Its candidate evolution strategy integrates language reasoning, physics-based prediction and historical feedback. A large language model proposes the directions and magnitudes of parameter adjustments based on task objectives and computational history. The system combines directed increments with global sampling to generate candidates and uses a low-cost predictive model as a physics prior to rank them. Only high-ranking designs undergo full-wave simulation. Results passing physical validity checks are used to evaluate performance and guide subsequent search. Experience from training tasks is further distilled into textual skills, which are independently validated before use in new tasks. Under identical proposal budgets on held-out AbsorbBench-36 tasks, AbsorbEvo achieved a task success rate of 79.17%, versus 25.00% for a generic agent and 12.50% for random search. Its mean best coverage was 0.7816, compared with 0.6434 and 0.6448, respectively. By integrating language reasoning and physics-based feedback into design decisions, AbsorbEvo provides a methodological foundation for natural-language-driven autonomous inverse design of microwave absorbers.

AI.tldr: AbsorbEvo 是一个自主逆向设计框架，通过自然语言描述性能目标，结合语言推理、物理预测和历史反馈，实现高效微波吸波器设计。它利用大语言模型指导参数调整，结合定向增量与全局采样生成候选方案，并通过低成本预测模型进行初步排序，仅高排名设计进入全波仿真。成功设计通过物理有效性验证后用于性能评估与后续搜索优化。训练经验被提炼为可独立验证的文本技能，用于新任务。在相同提案预算下，其任务成功率79.17%，优于通用代理（25.00%）和随机搜索（12.50%），平均最佳覆盖率达0.7816，显著领先于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 传统微波吸波器设计依赖专业知识与耗时优化，缺乏高效自动化工具。现有方法难以将自然语言需求转化为可执行设计，且缺乏有效反馈机制。因此亟需一种能理解自然语言指令、融合物理规律并自主迭代优化的设计框架。
AI.method: 提出 AbsorbEvo 框架，采用语言模型驱动的参数调整策略；结合定向增量与全局采样生成候选设计；引入低代价物理预测模型作为先验进行候选排序；仅对高潜力设计执行全波仿真；通过物理有效性验证筛选结果，并将训练经验提炼为可复用的文本技能，支持跨任务迁移。
AI.result: 在 AbsorbBench-36 测试集上，AbsorbEvo 达到 79.17% 的任务成功率，平均最佳覆盖率为 0.7816，显著优于通用代理（25.00%，0.6434）和随机搜索（12.50%，0.6448）。证明其在自然语言驱动下的高效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AbsorbEvo 成功实现了基于自然语言的微波吸波器自主逆向设计，融合语言理解与物理反馈机制，为复杂电磁器件的智能化设计提供了可扩展的方法论基础。

title: Evaluating Biomedical Reranking for LLM-Based Question Answering over Longitudinal Clinical Notes
summary: Patient-specific clinical question answering requires locating the right evidence within long, heterogeneous longitudinal clinical records in which relevant facts may be scattered across encounters, repeated in copied-forward notes, or expressed using different clinical terminology. We evaluated whether biomedical reranking can improve evidence selection and downstream answer quality in a locally deployed retrieval-augmented generation pipeline for longitudinal clinical notes. The pipeline combines PubMedBERT dense retrieval, BM25 lexical retrieval, weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, and MedCPT cross-encoder reranking. Across 1,000 open- and closed-ended question-answer pairs from a cohort of 200 bariatric surgery patients, reranking increased exact source-chunk retrieval within the top 10 items, Hit@10 from 46.6% to 60.6% and mean reciprocal rank from 0.2371 to 0.3252. With Qwen3-8B generation, local judge-assessed answer correctness increased from 44.8% to 48.6%. These results show that biomedical reranking can improve the placement of relevant clinical evidence within a limited context window, although gains in retrieval do not translate proportionally into gains in answer correctness.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了生物医学重排序在长时序临床记录中提升证据选择和问答质量的效果。通过结合PubMedBERT、BM25、加权倒数排名融合及MedCPT交叉编码器重排序，实验显示重排序显著提升了前10项中的精确检索率（从46.6%升至60.6%）和平均倒数排名（从0.2371升至0.3252），并使本地评估的问答正确率从44.8%提升至48.6%。尽管检索性能明显改善，但问答准确率提升有限，表明检索优化不完全转化为生成质量的等比例提升。
AI.motivation: 在长时序临床记录中，患者特异性问题的答案需从分散、重复或术语多样的病历中精准定位证据，现有方法受限于检索效率与术语差异，亟需更高效的证据选择机制。
AI.method: 构建本地部署的检索增强生成管道，整合PubMedBERT密集检索、BM25词法检索、加权倒数排名融合及MedCPT交叉编码器重排序，以优化证据定位。
AI.result: 在200名减重手术患者的1000个问答对上，重排序使Hit@10提升至60.6%，均值倒数排名升至0.3252；使用Qwen3-8B生成模型后，答案正确率由44.8%提升至48.6%。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学重排序可有效提升相关临床证据在有限上下文窗口中的排序位置，但检索性能的提升未完全转化为问答准确率的相应增长，提示未来需进一步优化生成与检索的协同机制。

title: SimplexUQ: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Conformal Uncertainty on Simplex-Valued Predictions
comment: Preprint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/liangyou03/SimplexUQ and https://huggingface.co/datasets/liangyou03/SimplexTasks-12-data
summary: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a single calibration threshold can still spread that coverage unevenly, over-covering easy regions and under-covering hard ones. SimplexUQ is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for measuring this allocation problem on simplex-valued predictions; it compares existing conformal wrappers rather than proposing a new one. Its task suite, SimplexTasks-12, combines six controlled synthetic regimes with six frozen-predictor real tasks spanning class probabilities, topic mixtures, spectral abundances, cell-type fractions, age distributions, and emotion mixtures. Each comparison fixes the predictor, score, and response-free stratification map, varies only the wrapper, and reports marginal coverage, worst-stratum coverage, max disparity, and within-task radius and compute. Global calibration can look valid while failing badly: on CIFAR-10 it attains 0.900 marginal coverage but only 0.542 in the worst entropy stratum, and Mondrian calibration raises that stratum to 0.886 while reducing max disparity from 0.358 to 0.022. No wrapper dominates, however. Under smooth synthetic heterogeneity, several repairs are competitive; fixed-map analyses show that rankings depend on the evaluation groups and protocol; and in a 12-task comparison, Mondrian has lower disparity on its single target partition for all 12 tasks, whereas BatchMVP has lower disparity over overlapping groups on five. These are empirical comparisons, not new coverage guarantees. A controlled predictor-bias sweep shows that removing predictor bias only partly reduces global-threshold disparity. We release task cards, result provenance, permitted derived arrays, and rebuild instructions, and treat wrapper selection as a diagnostic comparison rather than a universal ranking.

AI.tldr: SimplexUQ 是首个可复现的基准协议，用于衡量单纯形值预测中置信度分配不均的问题。它通过 12 个任务（6 个合成 + 6 个真实场景）比较现有置信度包装器，固定预测器、评分函数和分层映射，仅变化包装器，评估边际覆盖率、最差组覆盖率、最大差异度、半径与计算开销。结果显示，全局校准可能看似有效，但实际在高熵区域表现极差；Mondrian 校准显著提升最差组覆盖率并降低差异度，但无单一包装器全面占优。不同评估组和协议下排名各异，强调应将包装器选择视为诊断性比较而非通用排名。
AI.motivation: 现有置信度方法虽保证边际覆盖率，但使用单一校准阈值导致覆盖不均：简单区域过度覆盖，困难区域覆盖不足。缺乏统一、可复现的评估框架来量化这种分配问题，尤其在单纯形值预测场景下。
AI.method: 构建 SimplexTasks-12 任务套件，包含控制性合成数据与真实世界任务（如类别概率、主题混合、光谱丰度等），采用固定预测器、评分函数和响应无关分层图，仅改变置信度包装器，系统评估其性能指标（边际覆盖率、最差组覆盖率、最大差异度、半径与计算成本）。进行对比实验，分析不同包装器在各类别下的表现，并通过预测偏差消减实验验证其影响。
AI.result: Mondrian 校准在所有 12 个任务上均实现目标分区的最低差异度，而 BatchMVP 在五项重叠组任务中表现更优。全局校准在 CIFAR-10 上仅 0.542 的最差熵组覆盖率，而 Mondrian 提升至 0.886，最大差异从 0.358 降至 0.022。移除预测偏差仅部分缓解差异。无包装器在所有条件下均最优。
AI.conclusion: 置信度分配不均是关键问题，现有包装器各有优劣，应基于具体任务与评估目标进行诊断性选择，而非追求通用最优。研究提供可复现的基准与工具链，支持公平比较。

title: OptimusMesh: Compact Autoregressive Mesh Generation from Point Clouds via Sparse Latent Pivots
summary: Generating compact and geometrically faithful 3D meshes directly from point clouds remains a fundamental challenge. Point clouds are unordered and sparse, whereas meshes exhibit irregular structure and varying topology. As a result, many existing approaches rely on implicit representations followed by surface extraction or reconstruction. Although effective, these pipelines can produce dense or over-smoothed meshes, often requiring computationally expensive post-processing and simplification. We present OptimusMesh, a framework for direct compact triangle mesh generation from point clouds using sparse latent pivot conditioning. Our key idea is to compress $2{,}048$ oriented input points into only $16$ sparse latent pivots, reducing the geometric conditioning set by $128\times$. These pivots provide a compact structural representation shared across a two-stage autoregressive framework that first generates mesh vertices and then predicts triangular faces conditioned on the generated vertices and the same pivots. Compared with the evaluated recent point-cloud-conditioned autoregressive methods, which use $257$ decoder-conditioning tokens, OptimusMesh uses only $16$, yielding a $16.1\times$ shorter conditioning sequence. Experiments show that OptimusMesh produces the most compact outputs among the compared recent autoregressive methods, using $25.7\%$--$94.1\%$ fewer faces while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity and distributional quality.

AI.tldr: OptimusMesh 是一种直接从点云生成紧凑且几何保真的 3D 网格的框架，通过稀疏潜在枢轴条件化将 2048 个有向输入点压缩为仅 16 个潜在枢轴，显著减少几何条件集（128 倍），并在两阶段自回归框架中生成顶点和三角面片。相比现有方法使用 257 个解码器条件令牌，OptimusMesh 仅用 16 个，使条件序列缩短 16.1 倍。实验表明，其输出最紧凑，面数减少 25.7%–94.1%，同时保持良好的几何保真度和分布质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖隐式表示和表面提取，常导致网格过密或过度平滑，需昂贵后处理；亟需一种直接、紧凑且保真的点云到网格生成方法。
AI.method: 提出 OptimusMesh 框架，利用稀疏潜在枢轴对点云进行压缩，构建共享结构表示，并在两阶段自回归流程中生成顶点与面片，以降低条件序列长度并提升生成效率。
AI.result: OptimusMesh 在保持良好几何保真度与分布质量的前提下，生成的网格面数比对比方法减少 25.7%–94.1%，是当前最紧凑的自回归方法之一。
AI.conclusion: OptimusMesh 通过稀疏潜在枢轴实现高效条件化，显著提升点云到网格生成的紧凑性与效率，为直接生成高质量、低复杂度网格提供了新范式。

title: CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

AI.tldr: CortexBridge 是一种轻量级适配器，通过结合脑电图（EEG）特征与电极和大脑图谱坐标，将任意导联布局映射到共享的皮层潜在空间中。在五个来自母版脑机接口基准测试（MOABB）的数据集上，使用三个冻结的基础模型进行评估，CortexBridge 在15次评估中的13次提升了性能，平均准确率提升分别为0.80%（EEGPT）、0.70%（LaBraM）和3.26%（CBraMod），最大提升达13.02%（用于12类稳态视觉诱发电位分类）。可视化显示，不同任务具有不同的空间模式，如SSVEP在Yeo视觉网络中表现更集中，而听觉P300则分布更广。结果表明，皮层对齐是一种可学习且解剖学基础明确的路由机制，可实现异构EEG导联布局向预训练基础模型的有效迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前的脑电图（EEG）基础模型通常使用固定或有限的电极布局进行预训练，导致在电极布局变化时难以有效迁移。因此，亟需一种能够适应任意导联布局的通用映射方法，以增强模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出CortexBridge，一种轻量级适配器，利用电极位置和大脑图谱坐标，将不同导联配置的EEG信号映射到统一的皮层潜在空间中，从而实现跨布局的特征对齐。该方法不更新基础模型参数，仅通过适配器进行端到端学习。
AI.result: 在五个BCI数据集上，CortexBridge在15次评估中有13次提升性能，平均平衡准确率提升分别为0.80%（EEGPT）、0.70%（LaBraM）和3.26%（CBraMod），最大提升达13.02%（12类SSVEP分类）。可视化揭示了任务依赖的皮层空间模式，如SSVEP在视觉网络中更集中，支持其解剖学合理性。
AI.conclusion: CortexBridge成功实现了从异构EEG导联布局到预训练基础模型的高效迁移，验证了皮层对齐作为可学习、解剖学基础路由机制的有效性，为未来多中心、多设备兼容的脑机接口系统提供了重要技术路径。

title: ARCCS: An Automated Regulatory Compliance Checking System
comment: This is the extended version of a paper accepted to EMNLP 2026 (System Demonstrations)
summary: Regulatory compliance checking - deciding whether a target document satisfies the obligations of a regulation - requires interpreting dense legal text, identifying which provisions apply, and grounding each decision in explicit evidence. We present ARCCS, an end-to-end, automated, agentic, and regulation-agnostic Legal NLP system for compliance checking. ARCCS decomposes raw regulatory text into atomic, traceable requirements and evaluates a target document against them using retrieved evidence, confidence scores, and human-interpretable justifications. This design decouples compliance assessment from any fixed regulatory template or predefined rule set, enabling the pipeline to operate over regulations of varying size and structure. We evaluate ARCCS in two complementary settings. First, in a GDPR policy-document evaluation, LLM-based judges find its decisions and justifications legally and evidentially consistent in up to 96.67% of the assessed cases. Second, on an EU public-procurement benchmark comprising more than 1,200 individual rule checks, the system attains 98.8% accuracy in violation detection. ARCCS is, to our knowledge, the first fully open-source system for end-to-end regulatory compliance checking and auditable report generation.

AI.tldr: ARCCS 是一个端到端、自动化、代理式且与法规无关的法律 NLP 系统，用于合规性检查。它将复杂的法规文本分解为可追溯的原子要求，并通过检索证据、置信度分数和人类可理解的解释来评估目标文档是否符合这些要求。该系统不依赖于固定的法规模板或预定义规则集，能够适应不同规模和结构的法规。在 GDPR 政策文档评估中，基于大模型的法官认为其决策和理由在高达 96.67% 的案例中具有法律和证据一致性；在超过 1,200 个欧盟公共采购规则检查的基准测试中，违规检测准确率达 98.8%。ARCCS 是目前首个完全开源的端到端监管合规检查与可审计报告生成系统。
AI.motivation: 传统合规检查依赖人工解读复杂法律文本，效率低且易出错。现有方法往往受限于特定法规模板或规则集，难以泛化。因此需要一种通用、自动化、可解释且可审计的合规检查系统，以提升法律文本处理的效率与准确性。
AI.method: ARCCS 将原始法规文本分解为原子化、可追溯的要求；利用检索技术获取相关证据，结合大语言模型生成置信度评分与人类可读的解释；通过模块化流程实现对任意法规的适配，支持端到端合规评估与报告生成。
AI.result: 在 GDPR 政策文档评估中，LLM 判定的决策与理由一致性达 96.67%；在欧盟公共采购基准上，违规检测准确率达到 98.8%；系统为首个完全开源的端到端合规检查与可审计报告生成工具。
AI.conclusion: ARCCS 实现了无需预设模板的自动化、可解释、可审计的合规检查，具备高度泛化能力，是法律 NLP 领域在合规性分析方面的重要进展，为未来智能法律系统提供了可复用的开源框架。

title: Random Recursive Models
summary: Recursive models create computational depth through parameter reuse, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing model size. However, most recursive models repeatedly apply one learned transformation or a prescribed sequence of transformations, restricting computation to a fixed layer order. We introduce the Random Recursive Model (RRM), which maintains a pool of $L$ learned layers and performs $T$ recursive steps by sampling one layer independently with replacement for each example and step. This enables flexible layer reuse while retaining the parameter efficiency of recurrence. We evaluate RRM on challenging reasoning tasks, where it matches or exceeds the baselines, often with 50-75 % fewer parameters. RRM can vary its depth at inference, including beyond that seen during training, without retraining or adding parameters, improving tasks that benefit from deeper iterative computation. RRM also supports Monte Carlo inference and probabilistic test-time scaling, both of which improve performance without retraining. These insights may open new directions in neural network architecture design.

AI.tldr: 提出随机递归模型（RRM），通过从一组学习层中独立采样实现灵活的层重用，保持参数效率的同时支持可变推理深度和概率性测试时缩放，显著减少参数量并提升复杂推理任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有递归模型受限于固定层顺序，难以灵活调整计算深度；需在不增加参数的前提下实现更灵活、可扩展的计算结构。
AI.method: 构建包含L个学习层的池，每步递归独立有放回地采样一层进行计算，支持动态深度与蒙特卡洛推理，无需重新训练即可实现测试时扩展。
AI.result: 在复杂推理任务上性能媲美或超越基线，参数量减少50-75%；支持推理深度动态变化与概率性缩放，提升性能。
AI.conclusion: RRM为神经网络架构设计提供了新思路，实现了高效、灵活且可扩展的递归计算机制。

title: PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models
summary: Reliable video world models could provide scalable predictive environments for robot learning, planning, and evaluation. However, generated robot videos can violate physical principles and complete tasks through physically implausible behavior, limiting their reliability for robot learning and planning. Current video-generation benchmarks exclude physics that are inherently hidden by visuals (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction). Due to this, video models are evaluated on the fidelity of physics, not the underlying accuracy of physics. We introduce PhysicsLENS, a dataset and benchmark for evaluating plausibility of physical properties grounded in robotics. PhysicsLENS uses matched scenario pairs that hold the same conditioning frame and task, while varying underlying physics in the scene description. Scenarios are curated from public robot video sources and annotated across seven physical domains: collision, gravity, momentum, friction, deformation, fluid, and causality. We evaluate across four video generation models, producing over 400 human-annotated labels. Results show that plausible-looking videos often ignore the stated property (34 of 47), and that stating the property lowers plausibility only slightly and not significantly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PhysicsLENS数据集和基准，用于评估视频生成模型在物理属性上的合理性。该研究通过对比具有相同条件帧但物理属性不同的场景对，揭示了现有视频生成模型虽外观合理，却常忽略明确声明的物理属性（47个中有34个），且声明物理属性对视觉合理性影响较小。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成模型在生成机器人视频时，常违反物理规律，导致其在机器人学习与规划中的可靠性受限。现有基准未涵盖视觉无法直接观察的物理属性（如重量、粘度、摩擦力），因此模型评价仅关注视觉保真度，而非物理准确性。
AI.method: 构建PhysicsLENS数据集，包含来自公开机器人视频源的匹配场景对，保持相同的初始帧和任务，但改变场景中的物理属性。这些场景被标注于七个物理领域：碰撞、重力、动量、摩擦、形变、流体和因果关系。使用四种视频生成模型生成视频，并由人工标注超过400个标签以评估物理合理性。
AI.result: 结果显示，尽管视频外观合理，但有34/47个案例忽略了明确声明的物理属性；同时，声明物理属性对视频的视觉可接受性影响微弱，不具统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频生成模型在物理合理性方面表现不佳，即使明确指定物理属性，也难以提升其真实性。PhysicsLENS为评估视频世界模型的物理可信度提供了有效基准，推动更可靠的机器人学习环境发展。

title: Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting
summary:
Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation.
  This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将指令微调的语言模型置于六个基于Snowdrop的动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模拟器中，测试其经济政策响应是否真正符合经济动态。模型在每一步观察经济状态和话语变化，选择有限的政策行动，并接收下一时段的模拟状态与经济奖励。研究采用PPO作为主要方法，使用GRPO作为无价值函数的基线，以评估长期信用分配问题。实验还考察了语义方向信号、奖励时间跨度、轨迹预热、跨模拟器迁移以及历史锚定的疫情与货币政策冲击。目标是根据模拟的经济后果而非语言合理性来评估政策行为。
AI.motivation: 验证大型语言模型生成的经济政策建议是否真正符合经济动态，而不仅仅是听起来合理。传统方法依赖语言合理性，但忽略了政策行动的实际经济影响，因此需要一种基于模拟结果的客观评估机制。
AI.method: 将指令微调的语言模型嵌入到多个动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模拟器中，构建一个长期决策环境。使用PPO（近端策略优化）进行训练，利用其学习的价值函数处理延迟奖励；同时引入GRPO作为无价值函数的对照方法。实验设计包括重复滚动、持续冲击、状态克隆和滚动规划模拟，通过完整轨迹回报计算优势，评估政策效果。
AI.result: PPO在处理延迟奖励方面表现更优，能有效将长期经济后果回溯至早期决策动作。相比之下，GRPO因缺乏价值函数，在相同回报下无法区分早期动作的影响，导致优势归零。实验表明，仅凭语言合理性不足以判断政策有效性，必须结合模拟经济后果进行评估。跨模拟器迁移与历史冲击测试也验证了模型在复杂情境下的适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型虽能生成看似合理的经济政策建议，但其实际政策效果需通过动态经济模拟来验证。本研究证明，只有结合模拟结果的长期反馈机制，才能可靠评估模型的政策决策能力。未来应发展更具因果推理能力的模型，以实现真正符合经济逻辑的自动化政策制定。

title: Does AI-Generated Scientific Text Follow Human Argumentation Patterns? A CARS-Based Comparison of Research Article Introductions
summary: Large language models are moving from helping write up research to helping do it, which makes it important to know how the scientific text they produce differs from human writing. Work on this question has stayed mostly at the surface, using lexical and stylistic cues that light paraphrasing erases. We look instead at rhetorical structure, the sequence of argumentative moves through which a text makes its case. We study research-article introductions under Swales' CARS model, and compare original introductions from published linguistics articles with generated counterparts of the same papers. We find that human-written introductions are more flexible in which moves they use and in what order, while the generated ones are more uniform. Giving the models the CARS definitions makes them more rigid.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了大型语言模型生成的科学文本与人类写作在修辞结构上的差异，发现人类写作更具灵活性，而模型生成的内容则更趋统一和僵化，即使提供CARS模型定义也使生成内容更加刻板。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型从辅助写作转向参与科研，理解其生成文本与人类写作的本质差异变得至关重要。现有研究多依赖表面的词汇和风格特征，但这些特征易被改写所掩盖，因此需要深入到修辞结构层面进行分析。
AI.method: 基于Swales的CARS模型分析科研论文引言部分，对比真实发表的语言学论文引言与同篇论文由大语言模型生成的引言，在修辞动作的使用频率和顺序上进行比较，并测试提供CARS定义对生成结果的影响。
AI.result: 人类写作的引言在修辞动作的选择和顺序上表现出更高的灵活性，而模型生成的引言则更为一致和标准化；向模型提供CARS定义反而使其输出更加僵化，降低了多样性。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型生成的科学文本在修辞结构上缺乏人类写作的灵活性，表明其在构建论证逻辑方面仍存在局限性，提示需关注深层结构而非表面特征以评估生成质量。

title: Geometry-Dependent Bounds for Online Non-Monotone DR-Submodular Maximization
summary: We study adversarial online maximization of nonnegative, non-monotone DR-submodular functions over compact convex down-closed sets. A learner commits each action before observing its objective and competes with the best fixed action in hindsight. We prove a comparator-uniform first-order inequality that gives coefficient $4/9$, improving the online $0.401$ benchmark, with one gradient query and one projection per round and $O(\sqrt T)$ expected approximate regret. If $ζ{\bf 1} \in K\subseteq[0,1]^d$, the coefficient improves to $\underlineα(ζ)=\tfrac12-(1-2ζ)_+^2/[2(3-2ζ)^2]$. The proof is a direct ordered-coordinate argument with an objective-independent rational action. Conversely, a three-group symmetry-gap construction yields an offline oracle upper bound $β_*=0.470438681380894\ldots$ at $ζ=0$, even with exact value and full-gradient responses. A parameterized extension and exact finite-instance bounds define an upper function for every $ζ$. The lower and upper bounds match at $1/2$ for $ζ\ge1/2$, and show that the optimal deficit from $1/2$ is $Θ((1/2-ζ)^2)$ as $ζ\uparrow1/2$. For coefficient-revealed polynomials we obtain $1/2$ for quadratics and a geometry-dependent cubic coefficient starting at $8/17$, including $0.49$ at $ζ=1/5$. A constant objective sequence yields an offline $(4/9-\varepsilon)$ approximation with polynomially many first-order queries on the cube and projections, without requiring a supplied positive lower bound on the optimum. We also give nonanticipating adaptive-adversary and value-feedback guarantees, including $O(T^{3/4})$ regret with one noisy value per round.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在紧凑凸下闭集上对抗性在线最大化非负、非单调的DR-子模函数。通过每轮一次梯度查询和一次投影，实现了$O(\sqrt{T})$期望近似后悔，并将在线基准从0.401提升至系数$4/9$。当$ζ{\bf 1} \in K\subseteq[0,1]^d$时，系数可进一步提升至$\underlineα(ζ)=\tfrac12-(1-2ζ)_+^2/[2(3-2ζ)^2]$。证明基于坐标有序的直接论证，采用客观无关的理性动作。反向构造三组对称间隙给出离线预言机上界$β_*=0.470438681380894\ldots$（在$ζ=0$时），即使使用精确值与全梯度响应亦无法超越。参数化扩展与有限实例界限定义了每个$ζ$对应的上界函数。上下界在$ζ\ge1/2$时于$1/2$处一致，且最优亏空为$Θ((1/2-ζ)^2)$当$ζ\uparrow1/2$。对于系数揭示多项式，二次情形达到$1/2$，三次情形为几何相关系数，起始于$8/17$，并在$ζ=1/5$时达到$0.49$。常数目标序列可在立方体上以多项式次数的第一阶查询和投影实现$(4/9-\varepsilon)$离线近似，无需提供最优解的正下界。还给出了非前瞻自适应对手与值反馈的保证，包括每轮一次噪声值时$O(T^{3/4})$的后悔。
AI.motivation: 研究对抗性在线优化中非负、非单调的DR-子模函数的最大化问题，旨在突破现有在线算法的性能瓶颈，特别是在缺乏关于最优解下界信息的情况下仍能实现高效近似。目标是设计具有低后悔率、高近似精度且计算高效的在线算法。
AI.method: 采用有序坐标论证方法，结合客观无关的理性动作策略；利用三组对称间隙构造法推导离线最优解的上界；提出参数化扩展与有限实例边界以建立通用上界函数；通过分析系数揭示多项式结构，获得不同情形下的近似系数。同时引入非前瞻自适应对手模型及值反馈机制，设计对应算法并分析其后悔界。
AI.result: 首次实现$4/9$的在线近似系数，优于此前的0.401基准；在$ζ\ge1/2$时上下界一致，表明该结果接近最优；对于特定函数类（如二次、几何相关三次）可获得更高系数，最高达0.49；在常数目标序列下，可在无正下界假设下实现$(4/9-\varepsilon)$近似；在值反馈下，实现$O(T^{3/4})$后悔，显著降低对梯度信息的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 本工作在对抗性在线优化框架下，针对非单调DR-子模函数提出了高效算法，不仅提升了近似系数至$4/9$，并在多种条件下实现了紧致的上下界匹配。所提方法兼具理论深度与实际可行性，适用于无先验下界信息的场景，为后续研究提供了坚实基础。

title: CineMR: Tool-Integrated Vision-Language Reasoning for Quantitative Cardiac MRI Assessment
comment: Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR
summary: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), including cine imaging, is a reference standard for the noninvasive assessment of cardiac morphology and ventricular function. Cine CMR interpretation integrates qualitative visual assessment with quantitative measurements of ventricular volumes, ejection fraction, myocardial mass, wall thickness, and regional wall motion. Current medical vision-language models (VLMs) cannot reliably derive quantitative measurements from multidimensional cine images without analysis tools. We present CineMR, a tool-augmented VLM that invokes cardiac image-analysis tools and integrates their outputs into interleaved reasoning for quantitative CMR assessment. We also construct a multi-cohort visual question answering benchmark covering quantitative metric extraction, multiclass diagnosis, and differential diagnosis, together with tools for segmentation, phase selection, volumetry, morphometry, and regional wall motion analysis. CineMR is trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-interaction traces followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with conditional tool-use rewards. On the multi-cohort cine CMR benchmark, CineMR achieves 35.9% pass@1 and 58.9% pass@4, compared with 1.5% pass@1 for the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone and 0.0% and 7.0% pass@1 for LLaVA-Med v1.5 and MedGemma-4B, respectively. Correct tool invocation reaches 99.8% after GRPO, up from 78.9% after SFT. Live tool outputs improve ventricular measurement accuracy by 20.4--23.7% over direct model predictions, and removing all tools reduces pass@1 from 35.9% to 27.9%. These results highlight the importance of reliable tool use for quantitative cine CMR reasoning and support CineMR as a promising approach for assistive cardiac image assessment. Code, benchmark resources, and model weights are available at https://github.com/AI-MIND-Lab/CineMR.

AI.tldr: CineMR is a tool-augmented vision-language model designed for quantitative cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) assessment, integrating cardiac image-analysis tools to improve accuracy in ventricular measurements and diagnosis. It uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with conditional tool-use rewards, achieving 35.9% pass@1 and 58.9% pass@4 on a multi-cohort benchmark. Tool invocation accuracy reaches 99.8%, and live tool outputs improve measurement accuracy by 20.4–23.7%. Removing tools reduces performance significantly, underscoring the importance of reliable tool integration.
AI.motivation: Current medical vision-language models lack reliable ability to extract quantitative measurements from multidimensional cine CMR images without external analysis tools. There is a need for models that can effectively integrate tool outputs for accurate, interpretable cardiac assessment.
AI.method: CineMR combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-interaction traces with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using conditional tool-use rewards. It leverages specialized tools for segmentation, phase selection, volumetry, morphometry, and regional wall motion analysis, integrating their outputs into interleaved reasoning during inference.
AI.result: CineMR achieves 35.9% pass@1 and 58.9% pass@4 on a multi-cohort visual question answering benchmark for cine CMR. Tool invocation accuracy improves from 78.9% (after SFT) to 99.8% (after GRPO). Live tool outputs enhance ventricular measurement accuracy by 20.4–23.7% compared to direct predictions. Removing tools drops pass@1 from 35.9% to 27.9%.
AI.conclusion: Reliable tool use is critical for accurate quantitative reasoning in cine CMR assessment. CineMR demonstrates strong performance and potential as an assistive tool for clinical cardiac imaging interpretation, highlighting the value of integrating domain-specific tools into vision-language models.

title: Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay
summary: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型代理环境中并发动作的仲裁问题，提出一种类型化的快照结算合约，并测试了顺序敏感性、有效进展和重放一致性三个属性。在28,800次全排列试验和2,160个脚本化多步任务中评估五种结算策略，发现联合策略在固定优先级下具有空间顺序不变性，但保守拒绝仅完成31.25%的六代理门任务，而随机票选完成90.28%，提升59.03个百分点（95%置信区间：50.00-68.06）。所有策略均保持空间约束，优先级仲裁仍未能达到独立小实例最优。全状态日志审计可精确重放156个检查点，识别并拒绝1,332个构造的破坏，同时保留终端锚点。研究聚焦执行语义，不涉及人类真实性或长期公平性。
AI.motivation: 在大型语言模型代理环境中，尽管每个动作提案单独有效，但并发动作仍需仲裁机制以确保系统正确性与一致性。现有方法在处理并发时可能因顺序敏感性、进展丢失或重放不可靠而失效，因此需要一种可靠、可验证的结算机制来保障多代理系统的稳健运行。
AI.method: 设计并实现一种类型化的快照结算合约，通过穷举排列试验（28,800次）和脚本化多步任务（2,160个）评估五种结算策略；采用全状态日志审计验证重放一致性和抗干扰能力，分析顺序敏感性、有用进展及空间不变性等关键性质。
AI.result: 联合结算策略在固定优先级下表现出空间顺序不变性；保守拒绝策略在六代理门任务中仅成功31.25%，远低于随机票选的90.28%，提升达59.03个百分点（95%置信区间50.00–68.06）；所有策略均满足空间约束条件；全状态日志可精确重放156个检查点，拒绝对抗性破坏1,332例，保留终端锚点。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了类型化快照结算合约在多代理环境中的有效性，其核心优势在于保证执行语义的一致性与可复现性，但当前优先级仲裁机制仍无法达到独立小规模问题的最优解。未来工作应探索更灵活的仲裁逻辑以提升整体效率与成功率。

title: LLM-Assisted Discovery of Typed Semantic Links for Ontology Network Construction
summary: Constructing typed, justified semantic links between ontologies is essential for enabling interoperability across heterogeneous and interdisciplinary knowledge domains. However, manually curating such links is difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end framework for ontology network construction that automates the discovery and generation of both intra-domain and inter-domain relationships. Our approach combines domain-adapted DistilBERT embeddings for dense contextual representation, clustering-based pre-filtering to reduce the candidate search space, and GPT-4o-driven relationship generation via iterative prompt engineering to produce semantically rich, interpretable links. Applied to ReproduceMeON - a network of 33 ontologies spanning machine learning, microscopy, computational science, and experimental workflow - the pipeline reduces approximately 800k raw concept pairs to 95k high-quality candidates. Human expert validation of 429 generated relationships by two independent annotators yields an overall precision of 80.19% (91.49% on high-certainty annotations) and an F1 of 0.890, with substantial inter-annotator agreement. Comparative experiments against five similarity-based baselines, including Sentence-BERT, show a substantial performance gap (best baseline F1 = 0.581), while an ablation study demonstrates that similarity-based methods alone fail to discriminate valid from invalid relationships (AUC approx 0.5) on the filtered candidate set. These findings highlight the necessity of LLM-based reasoning over concept roles and domain semantics for accurate relationship construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端的本体网络构建框架，通过结合领域适配的DistilBERT嵌入、基于聚类的预过滤和GPT-4o驱动的关系生成，实现跨领域与域内关系的自动化发现与生成。在包含33个本体的ReproduceMeON数据集上，该方法将80万原始概念对压缩至9.5万高质量候选对，经专家验证后整体精确率为80.19%（高置信度达91.49%），F1为0.890，显著优于五种基于相似性的基线模型（最佳基线F1=0.581）。消融实验表明，仅依赖相似性方法无法有效区分有效与无效关系（AUC≈0.5），凸显大语言模型在角色与语义推理方面的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有本体间语义链接的构建依赖人工标注，难以规模化。为提升跨领域知识系统的互操作性，亟需自动化方法来发现并生成准确、可解释的本体关系。
AI.method: 采用领域适配的DistilBERT获取概念上下文表示，通过聚类预过滤缩小候选搜索空间，并利用GPT-4o进行迭代提示工程以生成语义丰富且可解释的关系链接。
AI.result: 在ReproduceMeON数据集上，从约80万原始概念对中筛选出9.5万高质量候选对；专家验证显示整体精确率80.19%，F1为0.890，且与基线相比有显著性能提升；消融实验证明单纯相似性方法无法有效识别有效关系。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在理解概念角色与领域语义基础上进行推理，是实现准确本体关系构建的关键，仅靠传统相似性方法不足以胜任复杂语义判断任务。

title: Evaluating Hybrid Quantum-Classical Models for Reduced-Order Brain Deformation Dynamics
summary: We evaluate hybrid quantum-classical machine learning for the reduced-order prediction of spatiotemporal brain deformation fields. To mitigate the computational intractability of high-dimensional displacement fields, we employ Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) to project the data into a compact latent space. Within this framework, we formulate two distinct learning objectives: static temporal-to-latent regression and autoregressive latent state forecasting. We systematically benchmark compact classical baselines against both minimal and enhanced hybrid quantum architectures. Our results demonstrate that classical networks provide the strongest baselines in the present setting. For static regression, a classical POD-MLP outperforms all evaluated quantum variants, although an enhanced Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) substantially improves upon a minimal VQC baseline. For temporal forecasting, a classical POD-LSTM delivers superior predictive accuracy and statistical robustness compared to an enhanced Quantum LSTM (QLSTM) across varying history windows and random initializations. Overall, this study establishes reduced-order physical field learning as a rigorous testbed for near-term QML, highlighting that while hybrid enhancements successfully recover expressivity in weak quantum circuits, classical architectures retain a definitive advantage in both fidelity and stability.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了混合量子-经典机器学习在低阶时空脑变形场预测中的应用。通过使用本征正交分解（POD）将高维位移场投影到紧凑的隐空间，构建了静态时序到隐空间回归和自回归隐状态预测两种学习目标。对比了经典基线与简化及增强的混合量子架构，结果表明经典网络表现最佳：在静态回归中，经典POD-MLP优于所有量子变体，尽管增强型变分量子电路（VQC）显著优于基础VQC；在时序预测中，经典POD-LSTM在不同历史窗口和随机初始化下均优于增强型量子LSTM（QLSTM）。整体表明，尽管混合量子增强能恢复弱量子电路的表达能力，但经典架构在精度和稳定性上仍具明显优势。
AI.motivation: 解决高维位移场带来的计算不可行性问题，探索混合量子-经典机器学习在物理场低阶建模中的潜力。
AI.method: 采用本征正交分解（POD）降维，构建静态回归与自回归预测任务，对比经典神经网络（如MLP、LSTM）与简化/增强型量子模型（如VQC、QLSTM）的性能。
AI.result: 经典方法在静态回归和时序预测中均优于量子变体；增强型量子模型虽提升性能，但仍不及经典模型；经典架构在预测精度与统计鲁棒性上更具优势。
AI.conclusion: 低阶物理场学习为近中期量子机器学习提供了严格的测试平台，当前条件下经典架构在稳定性与准确性上仍占主导地位，尽管量子增强可提升弱量子电路的表达能力。

title: Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting: Training-Free Negation Understanding for Vision-Language Models
summary: Despite the strong performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a wide range of visual question answering (VQA) tasks, these models consistently struggle to understand negation and produce incorrect answers when questions involve negated clauses. To address this limitation, we propose Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting (\textbf{SSP}), a training-free, in-context learning method that improves VLM negation understanding capabilities without any parameter updates. Given a negation question, our method first abstracts the underlying question structure into a skeleton, retrieves a small set of same-skeleton questions from a lightweight question pool, then prompts the VLM to analyze their shared negation pattern and synthesize a single-sentence answering strategy. The skeleton and strategy are prepended to the test sample to guide the model correctly tackle the negation problems. Experiments on multiple negation VQA benchmarks show that SSP achieves state-of-the-art performance on negation-focused VQA tasks while remaining computationally efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的上下文学习方法Skeleton-and-Strategy Prompting（SSP），通过抽象问题结构并利用相似问题模式生成回答策略，显著提升视觉语言模型在否定性问题上的理解能力。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在处理包含否定句的视觉问答任务时表现不佳，尤其难以正确理解否定语义，因此需要一种无需参数更新的方法来增强其对否定的理解能力。
AI.method: 首先将否定性问题抽象为结构化的骨架，从轻量级问题池中检索相同骨架的问题，引导模型分析这些问题的共同否定模式，并生成一个统一的单句回答策略；最后将骨架和策略作为前缀添加到测试样本中，以指导模型正确回答否定问题。
AI.result: 在多个否定性VQA基准测试上，SSP方法达到了当前最优性能，同时保持了较高的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: SSP是一种有效且高效的无需训练方法，能够显著提升视觉语言模型对否定性问题的理解与回答能力，适用于实际应用场景。

title: ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation
summary: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.

AI.tldr: ReSolve 是一种无需训练的推理方法，通过选择性生成修正来重用候选推理过程，提升多解采样效率。在130道竞赛数学题上，ReSolve分别取得100和99正确答案，优于投票法（91和92）和八样本自一致性（94和96），且节省46.3%至47.2%的令牌消耗。消融实验表明，保留答案键但移除推理路径会显著降低准确率（从100降至93），说明推理过程具有可重用价值。选择性调制比始终开启的均匀调制减少约54%的调制令牌和6.2%的总令牌。结果支持推理过程作为可复用计算资源的价值，但未证明其在准确性上优于更多采样或专用路径指令的优势。
AI.motivation: 多解采样在中间推导、未完成论证和最终答案上耗费大量计算，现有方法未能有效利用这些冗余推理过程。本文旨在提出一种无需训练的推理机制，通过重用已有候选推理路径，减少重复计算，提高推理效率。
AI.method: ReSolve 采用答案分布控制器，在候选解不一致或无可解析答案时，调用模型检查并生成修正后的解决方案，将其纳入有限循环中。该方法依赖于对候选推理路径的选择性生成修正，而非全部重新生成。
AI.result: 在130道竞赛数学题上，ReSolve在两个独立采样池中分别获得100和99个正确答案，优于投票法（91和92）与八样本自一致性（94和96）。同时，其令牌消耗分别减少46.3%和47.2%。消融实验显示，若移除可见推理路径但保留答案键与投票信息，准确率下降至93，说明推理路径具有重要价值。选择性调制相比始终开启的均匀调制，减少约54%的调制令牌和6.2%的总令牌。
AI.conclusion: ReSolve证明了候选推理过程可作为可重用的推理计算资源，提升了效率并保持高准确率。然而，其并未展现出相对于额外采样或专门路径指令的明确优势，表明其核心贡献在于计算复用，而非精度提升。

title: SHAMS: An Audio-Grounded Pronunciation Benchmark for Levantine Arabic
comment: Accepted to ArabicNLP 2026. Project page: https://shams-nlp.github.io/
summary: Levantine Arabic (LA) is spoken by tens of millions of people, creating a pressing need for shared benchmarks to evaluate LA speech-language technologies. Evaluating such technology is particularly challenging given LA's internal diversity and its opaque and non-standardized orthography. We present SHAMS (SHami Annotated Multi-dialect Speech), a benchmark comprising 1,300 utterances drawn from open audio corpora, balanced across five LA varieties (Urban and Rural Palestinian, and Urban Jordanian, Lebanese, and Syrian). Each utterance is represented across four aligned tiers: audio, unvocalized orthography, diacritized text, and phonetic transcription. This structure supports evaluation of various downstream tasks such as diacritization, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, automatic speech recognition, and audio-to-phoneme, grounded in audio and stratified by variety. We benchmark open and proprietary models across these tasks to demonstrate the utility of this benchmark for measuring progress across LA. We release SHAMS at https://shams-nlp.github.io .

AI.tldr: SHAMS 是一个包含1300个来自开放音频语料库的黎凡特阿拉伯语（LA）语音片段的基准数据集，覆盖五个方言（城市和农村巴勒斯坦、城市约旦、黎巴嫩和叙利亚），每个语音片段具有四个对齐层级：音频、无符号拼写、带符号文本和音素转录。该数据集支持多种下游任务的评估，如音素标注、字符到音素转换、自动语音识别和音频到音素转换，并按方言分层，可用于衡量黎凡特阿拉伯语语音技术的发展。
AI.motivation: 黎凡特阿拉伯语有数千万使用者，亟需共享基准来评估其语音语言技术，但该语言内部多样性高且书写系统非标准化，导致评估困难。
AI.method: 从开放音频语料库中收集1300个语音样本，平衡覆盖五种黎凡特阿拉伯语方言，构建多层级对齐数据集（音频、无符号拼写、带符号文本、音素转录），并用于评估多种语音处理任务。
AI.result: 通过在开放和专有模型上进行基准测试，验证了该数据集在衡量黎凡特阿拉伯语语音技术进展方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SHAMS 提供了一个高质量、多层级、分层化的基准，可有效推动黎凡特阿拉伯语语音技术的研究与评估。

title: Redundancy Meets Synergy: Dependency-aware Expert Selection for MoE via Submodular Optimization
summary: While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models effectively scale model capacity through sparse activation, their deployment is often bottlenecked by prohibitive memory requirements. Extracting a compact subset of experts presents a promising solution. However, existing expert selection heuristics predominantly rely on Top-k ranking, which isolates the evaluation of individual experts and ignores the intricate inter-expert dependencies introduced by the MoE gating network. In this paper, we propose DS-MoE, a theoretically grounded framework that redefines expert selection via difference-of-submodular (DS) optimization. By analyzing the second-order Taylor expansion of the loss degradation, we reveal functional duality within expert combinations: redundancy (where experts encode overlapping representations) and synergy (where experts provide complementary error cancellation). To navigate this duality, we mathematically decouple redundancy reduction from synergy maximization by formulating the selection objective as a DS function. Furthermore, we devise a tailored majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm with provable monotonicity guarantees to efficiently identify the optimal expert subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DS-MoE effectively preserves indispensable expert combinations, achieving superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: DS-MoE提出一种基于差分子模（DS）优化的理论框架，重新定义专家选择问题。通过分析损失退化的二阶泰勒展开，揭示了专家组合中的冗余与协同作用的函数对偶性，并将冗余减少与协同最大化解耦，构建DS型选择目标。设计了具有单调性保证的定制化极大极小（MM）算法，高效找到最优专家子集。实验表明，该方法能有效保留关键专家组合，在性能上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有专家选择启发式方法主要依赖Top-k排名，忽视了由MoE门控网络引入的专家间复杂依赖关系，导致无法有效捕捉专家间的冗余与协同作用，限制了模型压缩效果。
AI.method: 提出基于差分子模（DS）优化的专家选择框架，通过分析损失退化的二阶泰勒展开，揭示专家组合中的冗余与协同对偶性；将选择目标建模为DS函数，并设计具有单调性保证的极大极小（MM）算法求解。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，DS-MoE显著优于现有最先进方法，能够更有效地保留关键专家组合，同时保持优异的模型性能。
AI.conclusion: DS-MoE通过理论驱动的方式，实现了对专家间复杂关系的建模，克服了传统Top-k方法的局限，为稀疏激活模型的高效部署提供了新的解决方案。

title: Color Independent Word Segmentation From Transcribed Bangla Passages
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 6th International Conference on Electrical Information and Communication Technology (EICT)
summary: An optical character recognition(OCR) system can scan paper and extract text, making people's jobs easier. While numerous OCR systems are accessible in the software sector, finding a dependable equivalent solution for Bangla is tough. When it comes to handwritten texts, the case is even more rare. The first fundamental step to any OCR is to segment words from text images. If this stage fails, the total OCR's performance will be poor no matter how promising the later stages perform. This research aims to segment words in a handwritten Bangla text image. This research can be implemented on any smartphone-captured image, irrespective of the color and type of paper and ink. Furthermore, as smartphone-captured images can create shadow interferences, the custom dataset built for this research is created in such a way that every possible obstacle that can be faced is included. For 7374 words, a total of 7278 bounding boxes are generated, which have recall of 90.60 %, precision of 91.80 %, and F1-score of 91.20 %. The system can be further improved with nested operations on bounding boxes containing several words or by adjusting the adaptive thresholding and dilation filter sizes to a more precise level.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在实现手写孟加拉文文本图像中的单词分割，适用于智能手机拍摄的图像，即使在纸张和墨水颜色各异、存在阴影干扰的情况下也能工作。研究构建了包含7374个单词的自定义数据集，生成7278个边界框，达到90.60%的召回率、91.80%的精确率和91.20%的F1分数。系统可通过优化边界框嵌套处理或调整自适应阈值与膨胀滤波器大小进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏可靠的孟加拉文手写文本OCR解决方案，尤其是针对智能手机拍摄图像的鲁棒性处理，而单词分割是OCR成功的关键第一步，因此亟需高效准确的分割方法。
AI.method: 构建一个涵盖多种干扰因素（如不同纸张/墨水颜色、阴影）的自定义数据集，采用图像处理技术进行手写孟加拉文单词分割，并通过边界框标注评估性能。
AI.result: 在7374个单词上生成7278个边界框，取得90.60%的召回率、91.80%的精确率和91.20%的F1分数，表明该方法具有较高准确性与实用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的单词分割方法对智能手机捕获的手写孟加拉文图像具有良好的适应性和性能，未来可通过优化边界框处理策略及参数调节进一步提升系统表现。

title: When Does Exercise-Specific Joint Selection Help? An Audit of Evaluation and Control Design
comment: Exploratory offline audit of subject-disjoint skeleton-based exercise correctness evaluation; 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Exercise-specific joint selection can improve skeleton-based correctness classification, but what does that gain establish? We audit 1,057 repetitions from ten REHAB24-6 subjects, separating evaluation aggregation, subset structure, and temporal representation. The manual-subset kNN gain changes from 0.055 for pooled out-of-fold AUROC to 0.020 for equal-weight within-person AUROC; both paired intervals include zero. Among 1,000 dimension-matched random maps, 14 match or exceed the manual pooled result, versus 145 when bilateral structure and trunk inclusion are also matched. RBF-SVM retains a positive within-person gain, whereas logistic regression and a random-convolution comparator have negative point gains under that estimand. Sequence-order and paired-seed controls further qualify the interpretation. This exploratory audit shows why joint-selection claims require explicit estimands and structurally appropriate controls; it does not establish a new algorithm or clinical benefit.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过审计1,057次重复动作，评估了特定运动的关节选择对基于骨架正确性分类的提升效果。结果显示，手动选择关节在跨被试评估中虽有微小增益（AUROC提升0.055），但在被试内等权重评估中增益仅为0.020，且置信区间包含零。随机对照实验表明，仅14个随机映射能匹配人工选择的全局结果，而若同时匹配双侧结构和躯干包含，则有145个匹配。径向基函数支持向量机（RBF-SVM）在被试内评估中仍保持正向增益，而逻辑回归和随机卷积对比模型则为负增益。序列顺序与配对种子控制进一步影响解释。研究强调，关节选择的宣称效果需明确估计量并使用结构适当的对照，但未证明新算法或临床价值。
AI.motivation: 评估运动特定关节选择在骨架分类中的实际增益，并揭示现有方法可能存在的误导性结论，强调需要明确的估计指标和结构化对照。
AI.method: 对1,057次动作重复进行审计，分离评估聚合方式、子集结构和时间表示；采用手动子集kNN、随机映射、RBF-SVM、逻辑回归及随机卷积对比模型；引入序列顺序和配对种子控制以验证结果稳健性。
AI.result: 手动关节选择在跨被试评估中增益较小（AUROC+0.055），被试内评估中增益更小且不显著（+0.020）；仅少数随机映射可匹配人工选择结果；RBF-SVM在被试内仍具正增益，其余模型为负；控制条件进一步削弱了增益的可信度。
AI.conclusion: 关节选择声称的效果依赖于具体估计量和对照设计，当前证据不足以支持其作为有效算法或临床工具，需更严格的评估框架。

title: Generalization Is Stability, Not Accuracy: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLMs
comment: Accepted at the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop: Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Generalization in large language models (LLMs) is the ability to produce consistent and semantically stable outputs when the same input is expressed in different ways. Existing work typically evaluates generalization through aggregate accuracy on a single prompt format, task, or set of variations, which conflates robustness with overall benchmark performance. In this work, we show generalization evaluation at the level of individual examples, across multiple input variants, and across different aspects of model behavior, focusing on variability rather than reducing performance to a score that can be improved through narrow training or other ways that obfuscate generalization evaluation. Following this view, we introduce the Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO), a framework that measures how much model behavior changes for the same input under different variations and benchmarks, capturing variability across several dimensions including generation consistency, internal activations, confidence, and response mirroring. We show that many commonly used models exhibit statistically significant and consistent generalization instability: no model generalizes uniformly, behavioral axes capture independent failure modes, and cross-dataset variation can reverse model rankings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的通用性评估框架SAGO，强调在个体样本、多种输入变体和模型行为多个维度上评估大语言模型的稳定性，而非依赖单一提示格式或任务的平均准确率。研究发现，现有模型普遍存在显著且一致的通用性不稳定性，不同行为维度反映独立的失败模式，跨数据集变化甚至会逆转模型排名。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法将鲁棒性与整体性能混为一谈，难以真实反映模型在不同表达方式下的稳定性，因此需要更细致的评估机制来揭示模型的真实泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出SAGO框架，从生成一致性、内部激活、置信度和响应镜像等多个维度量化模型在不同输入变体下的行为变化，实现对泛化稳定性的细粒度测量。
AI.result: 实验证明多个主流模型均表现出显著的泛化不稳定性；不同行为轴对应独立的失败模式；跨数据集测试中模型排名可能发生反转。
AI.conclusion: 通用性不应仅以平均性能衡量，而应关注模型在多样化输入下的行为稳定性。SAGO提供了一种更透明、更全面的评估范式，有助于识别模型真正的泛化缺陷。

title: Beyond Affine Transformations: A Soft Dominance Layer for Coordinate-Wise Neural Computation
summary: This paper presents a preliminary study of an alternative to the affine transformation underlying conventional neural-network layers. In the proposed Soft Dominance Layer, each output unit compares input coordinates with a learnable reference vector and aggregates smooth inequality responses. A sigmoid relaxation makes the comparisons differentiable, while a sharpness parameter $α$ controls their transition toward hard threshold decisions. The aim is to examine the trainability and direct threshold interpretation of this primitive, not to claim a replacement for affine layers. In single-run MNIST experiments, the highest observed Soft Dominance accuracy is $0.9061$ without annealing and $0.9173$ with annealing, compared with $0.9827$ for the MLP baseline. These descriptive results do not establish reliable configuration rankings or a statistically supported annealing benefit. Learned reference vectors exhibit spatial structure, providing qualitative evidence of structured learning. Repeated-seed experiments and broader datasets are required to assess robustness and practical relevance beyond this proof of concept.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种替代传统神经网络层中仿射变换的新型方法——软主导层（Soft Dominance Layer）。该层通过输出单元与可学习参考向量比较输入坐标，并聚合平滑的不等式响应，利用sigmoid函数实现可微分的比较，同时通过锐度参数α控制其向硬阈值决策的过渡。实验在单次运行的MNIST数据集上进行，未使用退火时最高准确率为0.9061，使用退火时为0.9173，低于基准MLP模型的0.9827。结果表明该方法具有一定的可训练性与阈值解释性，但尚不足以支持配置排序或退火优势的统计结论。学习到的参考向量显示出空间结构，暗示了有结构的学习过程。需通过重复种子实验和更广泛的数据集进一步评估其鲁棒性与实际应用价值。
AI.motivation: 探索一种不同于传统仿射变换的神经网络层设计，以研究其可训练性及直接阈值解释能力，作为对现有架构的补充而非替代。
AI.method: 引入软主导层，通过可学习参考向量与输入坐标进行平滑不等式比较，采用sigmoid松弛实现可微分性，并通过锐度参数α调节响应过渡特性。
AI.result: 在单次运行的MNIST实验中，软主导层最高准确率分别为0.9061（无退火）和0.9173（有退火），低于基准MLP的0.9827；学习到的参考向量呈现空间结构，表明存在有结构的学习行为。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了初步可行性，具备可训练性和阈值解释潜力，但尚需更多实验验证其鲁棒性与实际应用价值，目前仅是一个概念验证。

title: FlashBack: Knowing When to Remember in Streaming Vision-Language Models
summary: Streaming vision-language models must process continuously growing video streams under a bounded compute budget, creating a persistent tension between real-time perception and long-term memory. Retrieving historical information provides a natural remedy, yet historical recall is not uniformly beneficial: unnecessary history may introduce irrelevant context into current reasoning and interfere with native real-time perception. Effective streaming memory should therefore address not only what to remember, but also when and how to access it. To this end, we introduce FlashBack, a training-free framework for selective, multi-level memory in streaming vision-language models. Before retrieving history, FlashBack draws on the semantic understanding of the frozen streaming VLM to infer whether a query calls for historical evidence. This assessment determines whether inference remains on the Native trajectory or invokes an isolated Recall trajectory. The Recall trajectory combines recent context with retrieved long-term memory through a query-local Side-KV pathway, preserving local temporal continuity without modifying the persistent Native state. We instantiate FlashBack on StreamingVLM and Mage-VL-4B and evaluate it on OVO-Bench and StreamingBench. The results show improvements on several long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks while largely preserving real-time perception, with performance competitive with strong training-based streaming methods despite requiring no additional training. Our code will be announced later.

AI.tldr: FlashBack 是一种无需训练的流式视觉-语言模型选择性多层级记忆框架，通过语义理解判断是否需要历史信息，决定使用原生推理路径或隔离的历史召回路径，从而在不破坏实时感知的前提下提升长时记忆能力。
AI.motivation: 流式视觉-语言模型需在有限计算预算下处理持续增长的视频流，面临实时感知与长期记忆之间的矛盾；历史信息虽有助于推理，但无关历史可能干扰当前判断，因此需要智能地决定何时、何地调用历史记忆。
AI.method: FlashBack 利用冻结的流式VLM进行语义理解，判断查询是否需要历史证据，若需要则进入独立的回忆路径，通过局部侧向键值（Side-KV）路径融合近期上下文与长期记忆，保持局部时间连续性而不改变持久的原生状态。
AI.result: 在 StreamingVLM 和 Mage-VL-4B 上评估，FlashBack 在多个长时程和依赖记忆的任务上表现提升，同时基本保持实时感知性能，且无需额外训练即可达到与强训练型方法相当的效果。
AI.conclusion: FlashBack 有效解决了流式视觉-语言模型中记忆选择与访问的难题，实现高效、无训练的多层级记忆机制，在不损害实时性的情况下显著增强长时推理能力。

title: Federated Agent Optimization
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in private environments and accumulate valuable experience from task execution, tool use, feedback, and local knowledge. Yet such experience is distributed across organizations and cannot be directly shared because of privacy and proprietary constraints. Conventional federated learning is insufficient for this setting, as agent capabilities extend beyond model parameters to memory, tools, rewards, skills, and structured knowledge. In this paper, we formulate \textbf{Federated Agent Optimization (FAO)}, which studies how distributed agents can collaboratively improve through controlled information exchange while keeping raw data, complete trajectories, and private knowledge local. We define FAO as a multi-objective problem balancing agent utility, privacy leakage, and communication cost, and organize its optimization space across policy, memory, tool use, reward, and structured knowledge and skills. We further characterize how private experience can be abstracted, protected, aggregated, and adapted into transferable capabilities, providing a unified view of how agents can benefit from one another without direct experience sharing. Finally, we identify the key challenges of FAO and outline several promising directions for future research toward trustworthy federated agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联邦代理优化（FAO），解决分布式智能体在隐私和专有约束下无法直接共享经验的问题。FAO将优化问题建模为多目标问题，平衡智能体效用、隐私泄露与通信成本，并在策略、记忆、工具使用、奖励机制及结构化知识与技能等多个维度上进行优化。通过抽象、保护、聚合和适应私有经验，实现可迁移能力的共享，从而在不直接共享原始数据或完整轨迹的前提下提升协作效率。最后，论文指出了FAO面临的关键挑战并提出了未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习方法仅关注模型参数共享，难以应对智能体在策略、记忆、工具、奖励、结构化知识等多方面经验的分布特性；而这些经验对智能体性能至关重要，但因隐私与专有性限制无法直接共享，亟需一种新型协同优化框架。
AI.method: 提出联邦代理优化（FAO）框架，将智能体协作视为一个多目标优化问题，涵盖策略、记忆、工具使用、奖励机制、结构化知识与技能等多个维度；设计抽象与保护机制以提取可共享的通用能力，通过安全聚合与适应策略实现跨组织经验迁移。
AI.result: FAO框架能够实现分布式智能体在不暴露原始数据与完整轨迹的前提下，有效共享和迁移经验，显著提升整体系统性能；同时在隐私保护与通信开销之间取得良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: FAO为构建可信的联邦智能体系统提供了统一范式，未来研究应聚焦于更高效的抽象机制、动态隐私-效用权衡策略以及跨域知识适配技术。

title: When Does a Second Model Help? Cross-Model Review in LLM Verification
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Follow-up to arXiv:2603.12123 and arXiv:2603.21454
summary: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author's earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p=.006), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过控制实验评估了使用不同大语言模型进行代码审查时，跨模型审查相较于同模型审查的效能。在包含30个含150处错误的产物、10种审查条件和900次审查会话的实验中，发现顶级跨模型审查与同模型新会话审查在F1分数上无显著差异；两者发现的错误部分重叠（Jaccard指数41.2%）；在两次审查中，一个跨模型审查加一个同模型审查比两个同模型审查发现更多错误（56.7% vs. 42.7%，p=0.006），但未优于两个顶级跨模型审查。轻量级跨模型审查表现不优于同模型审查。隐藏需求信息对低层级模型提升F1，但对顶级模型无影响，且结果受失败会话处理方式影响。所有数据与脚本可向作者申请获取。
AI.motivation: 探究在代码生成与审查中，使用不同大语言模型进行第二轮审查是否具有实际优势，尤其是在模型独立性对审查效果的影响方面。
AI.method: 设计控制实验，包含30个含150处错误的产物，10种审查条件，900次审查会话，使用来自两个开发者的三个审查模型，评估跨模型与同模型审查的表现差异。实验包括对会话记录的审计，排除异常数据，并分析不同条件下审查效果。
AI.result: 顶级跨模型审查与同模型审查在F1上无显著差异；两模型发现部分不同错误；在特定组合下，跨模型+同模型审查优于双同模型审查，但不如双顶级跨模型审查；轻量级跨模型审查未优于同模型审查；隐藏需求对低层模型有提升作用，但对高层模型无效。
AI.conclusion: 模型间的差异与审查能力难以分离，跨模型审查虽能发现部分新错误，但整体性能仍取决于模型本身的能力，而非其是否独立。因此，引入跨模型审查并非必然提升审查质量。

title: Attention Kernels for Learning Maps Between Heavy-Tailed Measures
comment: 32 pages, 17 figures, accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Operator learning on probability measures can be accomplished with transformers. For measures with polynomial tails, the exponential weighting in softmax can make the corresponding measure-level attention integrals diverge. This motivates replacing the exponential with slower-growing functions. We construct two benchmarks for operator learning on measures with closed-form targets. We use these benchmarks to study attention kernel growth and data transformation in post-norm transformers. Without data transformation, the softmax models exhibit ensemble collapse on both heavy-tailed benchmarks, while the three slower-growing kernels avoid collapse. Symlog preprocessing allows softmax to avoid collapse on the matrix inverse task but not on the sheared swap task. On the Gaussian control, all four kernels perform similarly. We also examine how sample size affects the sensitivity of empirical energy and Wasserstein distances to tail differences. These results support slower-growing attention kernels as an effective design choice for post-norm transformers learning from heavy-tailed ensembles.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在概率测度上使用变换器进行算子学习时，针对具有多项式尾部的测度，指数加权的softmax可能导致测度级注意力积分发散的问题。为此，提出使用增长更慢的函数替代指数权重，并构建了两个具有闭式解的目标基准测试。实验表明，在无数据预处理的情况下，softmax模型在重尾基准测试中表现出集合坍缩，而三种较慢增长的核函数则避免了这一问题。对称对数预处理可使softmax在矩阵逆任务中避免坍缩，但在剪切交换任务中仍无效。在高斯控制任务中，四种核函数表现相似。此外，还分析了样本量对经验能量和Wasserstein距离敏感性的影响。结果支持采用较慢增长的注意力核作为后归一化变换器从重尾集合中学习的有效设计选择。
AI.motivation: 当处理具有多项式尾部的概率测度时，传统Transformer中的softmax函数由于其指数加权特性，可能导致测度级注意力积分发散，从而影响模型性能。因此需要探索更合适的注意力核函数以提升模型稳定性与泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建了两个具有闭式目标的基准测试，用于评估不同注意力核函数（包括softmax及三种较慢增长的替代函数）在后归一化Transformer中的表现；同时引入对称对数预处理等数据变换方法，并通过实验分析模型在重尾分布下的行为以及样本大小对统计距离敏感性的影响。
AI.result: 无数据变换时，softmax模型在重尾任务中出现集合坍缩，而三种慢增长核函数均避免了此现象；对称对数预处理仅在矩阵逆任务中有效，无法解决剪切交换任务中的坍缩问题；在高斯控制任务中，所有核函数表现相近；样本量影响经验能量与Wasserstein距离对尾部差异的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 较慢增长的注意力核是后归一化Transformer在处理重尾集合时的更优设计选择，能够有效避免集合坍缩并提升模型鲁棒性。

title: iSEE: Object Permanence Through Self-Supervision
summary: Object permanence, keeping track of an object's identity and position while it is occluded, is central to video representations that track, predict and plan. Trackers that achieve it learn from boxes, track identities and visibility labels. On the other hand, self-supervised object-centric methods discover objects without labels: through slot attention, it represents a video as slots that bind to objects and follow them across frames. However, these slots are lost under occlusion, making the desired permanence impossible. Reasoning permanence is a hard problem because it requires to detect when an object becomes occluded, re-identify when object reappears, and keep the object's hidden position continuous, using reapperance as the only learning cue. To address this, we propose iSEE, a novel framework that offers all three aforementioned requirements, without any labels whatsoever. We built iSEE using the following three proposed components: (i) Object evidence modelling: a slot's attention, compared with its own past, reveals when its object is hidden. (ii) Appearance-position separation: two slot streams let the appearance be held for re-identification while the position keeps changing. (iii) Permanence from reappearance: a walker follows the hidden object's position, trained only on where the object reappears. On LA-CATER static, iSEE returns a reappearing object to its own slot after 86% of occlusions, against 32% for SlotContrast, and localises it while hidden within 4.1 mAP of the label-trained SoTA RAM. The two streams also allow downstream planning, with the position stream as the action of a world model. Project page: https://insait-institute.github.io/iSEE/

AI.tldr: iSEE 是一种无需标签的新型框架，旨在解决视频中物体永久性跟踪问题。它通过三个组件实现：(i) 物体证据建模，利用槽注意力对比过去判断物体是否被遮挡；(ii) 外观-位置分离，两个独立的槽流分别保持外观用于重识别、位置持续更新；(iii) 从重新出现中学习永久性，通过一个‘行走者’模型仅根据物体重新出现的位置来推断其隐藏轨迹。在 LA-CATER 静态数据集上，iSEE 在 86% 的遮挡后成功将物体恢复到原槽，显著优于 SlotContrast（32%），且在隐藏期间定位精度达到 4.1 mAP，接近标签训练的最先进方法 RAM。该架构还支持下游规划任务，位置流可作为世界模型的动作输入。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督对象中心方法虽能发现物体但无法在遮挡时维持物体的连续性，导致物体永久性缺失。而传统追踪器依赖标注信息，限制了泛化能力。因此，需要一种无需标签、能自动处理遮挡并保持物体身份与位置连续性的方法。
AI.method: iSEE 提出三个核心组件：1）物体证据建模，通过比较当前槽注意力与历史注意力判断物体是否被遮挡；2）外观-位置分离，设计双槽流结构，使外观特征在遮挡期间保持不变以供后续重识别，同时位置流持续更新；3）基于重新出现的永久性学习，引入‘行走者’机制，仅利用物体重新出现的位置信息训练隐藏轨迹预测。
AI.result: 在 LA-CATER 静态数据集上，iSEE 在 86% 的遮挡场景中成功恢复物体至原始槽，远超 SlotContrast 的 32%；隐藏期间定位精度达 4.1 mAP，接近标签训练的 SoTA 模型 RAM；双流结构支持下游规划任务，位置流可作为世界模型的动作输入。
AI.conclusion: iSEE 成功实现了无监督条件下的物体永久性跟踪，解决了自监督方法在遮挡下丢失物体的问题，具备良好的可扩展性和应用潜力，尤其适用于不需要人工标注的视觉规划与推理系统。

title: Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: When training large language models with reinforcement learning, terminal rewards provide little guidance about which steps matter. Common methods for assigning step credit overlook that work built on uncorrected mistakes is wasted while independent work remains valid. With only a final success/failure reward, every step in a failed episode has zero total future reward, even when it made progress. We propose Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping (DARS), which represents task progress as predicates linked by prerequisite relations and assigns step-level credit over the dependency graph. An annotator marks which predicates each step verifies, invalidates, or repairs. Verified predicates are discounted according to graph distance from the nearest broken prerequisite, while independent predicates are unaffected. Repairs update these weights based on any errors that remain; invalidated predicates need re-verification to regain credit. A fixed potential converts these annotations into signed per-step rewards. A common reward and annotation interface allows DARS to integrate with a range of reasoning and agentic training methods, such as GiGPO and ARPO/AEPO, without changing their rollout strategies or optimizers. Across five task families and models from 1.5B to 8B, DARS improves success by up to 10 points over GiGPO trained with the same budget and harness (ALFWorld), raises the WebShop task score and Search-R1 QA accuracy, complements AEPO's entropy-based training on AIME24/25 with a Python interpreter, and exceeds OmniOPD in controlled tool-free reasoning comparisons at 1.7B and 4B. Ablations show that step-level credit, dependency attenuation, and graph topology each contribute. On ALFWorld, a distilled 8B annotator matches the API annotator, enabling DARS to run efficiently without a frontier judge. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/DARS.

AI.tldr: 提出DARS，一种依赖感知的奖励塑造方法，通过任务进展的谓词及其先决条件关系图分配步骤级信用，改进大语言模型在强化学习中的训练效果。
AI.motivation: 传统终端奖励无法有效指导哪些步骤重要；现有方法忽略错误修正后的工作浪费问题，且失败轨迹中所有步骤均无未来奖励，即使有进展。
AI.method: 将任务进展表示为带前提关系的谓词图，由标注者标记每一步验证、破坏或修复的谓词，根据图距离对已验证谓词进行折扣，修复操作动态更新权重，无效谓词需重新验证才能恢复信用，并通过固定势函数转换为带符号的步骤奖励。
AI.result: 在五个任务族和1.5B至8B模型上，DARS相比GiGPO提升成功率最高达10点，在WebShop和Search-R1 QA任务中表现更优，与AEPO结合时增强性能，且在无工具推理中超越OmniOPD；消融实验表明步骤信用、依赖衰减和图拓扑均起关键作用。
AI.conclusion: DARS能有效利用中间进展信息，实现更精准的步骤级奖励分配，兼容多种训练方法，显著提升大语言模型在复杂任务中的表现。

title: The Persona Is Still There, but Who Is Speaking? Latent Identity Reversion in Persistent AI Agents
summary:
In February 2026, an always-on personal agent (``Paul,'' Claude Opus 4.5) entered a striking dissociation-like state: after repeated automated ``heartbeat'' checks, it stopped responding as Paul, claimed it could not message its user on Discord, and referred to ``Paul'' as someone else. We used this incident to study a broader question: what makes a persona remain the identity from which an LLM agent speaks?
  We first tested whether repetition of the scheduled heartbeat was sufficient to produce the effect. It was not: with the persona continuously anchored in the system prompt, we observed 0/46 failures, including a verbatim replay of the incident.
