The incident instead exposed an implementation quirk that created a useful experimental manipulation: on resumed turns, conversational history was preserved but the persona was no longer re-injected at the privileged system-prompt level.
  Using this manipulation, we found that persona continuity depends jointly on system-level anchoring and conversational context. After anchor loss, rich human interaction could preserve the persona, whereas a single automated heartbeat turn could precipitate reversion toward the harness identity. Restoring the anchor reversibly restored persona enactment. Crucially, apparently normal conversation could conceal the shift: unanchored agents sometimes interacted appropriately while identifying themselves as the underlying harness (having lost the assigned persona), and after conversational recovery only 1/18 remained persona-enacting versus 17/17 anchored controls.
  We therefore distinguish \emph{represented} from \emph{enacted} identity: persona-related information can remain available in conversational history without the persona remaining the identity bound to ``I.''

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型代理在持续交互中身份一致性的问题，通过一个名为Paul的代理出现身份分裂现象的案例，发现身份维持依赖于系统级锚定与对话上下文的共同作用。当系统级锚定丢失后，即使有丰富的对话交互，也无法保证身份持续；而单次自动化心跳消息即可导致身份回退至基础模型身份。恢复锚定可逆转此过程。值得注意的是，表面上正常的对话可能掩盖身份转移：未锚定的代理在自我指称时可能仍表现出正确行为，但已不再以分配的人格身份自居。因此，作者区分了‘被表示’（represented）与‘被执行’（enacted）的身份：即使信息保留在对话历史中，也不意味着人格身份仍然绑定于‘我’。
AI.motivation: 探究大型语言模型代理在长期交互中如何维持其指定人格身份，特别是在出现异常状态（如身份分裂）时的原因与机制。
AI.method: 通过复现一个真实发生的代理身份异常事件，分析系统级锚定与对话上下文对人格连续性的影响；设计实验对比锚定存在与缺失下的代理行为，并观察恢复锚定后的变化。
AI.result: 发现人格身份的持续性依赖于系统提示中的锚定与对话上下文的双重作用；锚定丢失后，即便对话丰富，也无法维持人格身份；单一自动化心跳即可触发身份回退；恢复锚定可逆地恢复人格执行；且正常对话可能掩盖身份转移现象。
AI.conclusion: 人格身份不仅取决于对话历史中的信息表示，更关键的是系统层面的持续锚定。若缺乏系统级锚定，即使表现符合人格特征，代理也可能在自我认知上已脱离所赋予的身份，即存在‘被表示但未被执行’的身份状态。

title: Make Sparse Rewards Count: Density-Aware Reward Aggregation for Multi-Reward RL
summary: Multi-reward reinforcement learning trains large language models to satisfy multiple behavioral objectives simultaneously. Reward-wise normalization, as used in GDPO, preserves reward-specific relative information within rollout groups, but different objectives can still exhibit uneven learning progress. We study this behavior through advantage energy, the sum of a reward's squared advantages over a batch. Under idealized GDPO normalization, we show that this energy is proportional to active-group density: the fraction of rollout groups in which the reward provides nonzero relative advantages. This reveals a residual batch-level signal imbalance and provides a basis for calibrating reward contributions. Based on this relation, we propose Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA). We derive an inverse-square-root density correction that gives greater weight to signals from less frequently active rewards. DARA computes its weights from each rollout batch, adapting to changes in reward activity throughout training without modifying the underlying policy optimization objective. Experiments on tool calling and mathematical reasoning show that DARA learns the targeted behaviors faster than GDPO, reaching high format compliance in up to 26% fewer training steps on tool calling and near-saturated length compliance in up to 65% fewer steps on mathematical reasoning, while remaining competitive in final performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhaihaotian/DARA.

AI.tldr: 提出DARA方法，通过密度感知奖励聚合解决多奖励强化学习中不同目标学习进度不均的问题。基于优势能量与活跃组密度的关系，引入反平方根密度校正，使较少活跃的奖励获得更高权重，从而加速学习收敛。在工具调用和数学推理任务中，DARA相比GDPO显著减少训练步数，同时保持良好最终性能。
AI.motivation: 多奖励强化学习中，尽管采用奖励归一化（如GDPO）能保留各奖励内部相对信息，但不同目标仍存在学习进度不平衡问题，导致部分奖励信号被抑制或延迟响应。这种不平衡源于批次层面的信号分布差异，影响整体训练效率。
AI.method: 通过分析优势能量（advantage energy）与活跃组密度之间的关系，发现其呈正比，揭示了残余的批次级信号不平衡。据此提出密度感知奖励聚合（DARA），采用反平方根密度校正机制动态调整各奖励权重，使低活跃度奖励获得更多关注。该方法无需修改策略优化目标，可在每批次内自适应更新权重。
AI.result: 在工具调用任务上，DARA实现高格式合规性所需训练步数减少最多26%；在数学推理任务上，达到接近饱和的长度合规性所需步数减少最多65%，且最终性能相当甚至更优。
AI.conclusion: DARA有效缓解了多奖励学习中的信号不平衡问题，提升了训练效率和收敛速度，为复杂行为目标的协同训练提供了新的可扩展解决方案。代码已开源。

title: Semantic RGB--Depth Based Surgical Skill Assessment in Microscopic Stereo Videos
summary: Objective assessment of microsurgical technical skill is essential for competency-based training and quality assurance, yet existing video-based approaches predominantly rely on RGB images and therefore overlook the 3D spatial relationships that characterize instrument-anatomy interactions. Although stereo operating microscopes provide complementary depth information, conventional stereo matching algorithms can produce sparse and unreliable depth estimates under high-magnification imaging conditions, limiting their use for automated skill assessment. This work presents a semantic RGB-Depth framework for surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. A regression-based depth fusion method combines sparse metric stereo depth with dense monocular depth estimates to generate a dense geometric representation of the surgical scene. This representation is integrated with semantically decomposed RGB streams corresponding to individual surgical instruments and surrounding anatomy. A hierarchical attention architecture jointly encodes these streams to capture discriminative patterns of instrument use and instrument-anatomy interaction across surgeons at different training levels. The framework was evaluated on 33 ex vivo transoral microlaryngeal procedures performed by six surgeons, comprising attending surgeons and surgical residents, using leave-one-surgeon-out cross-validation. The proposed semantic RGB-Depth model achieved an F1 score of 0.938 for skill-level classification, compared with 0.696 for semantic RGB and 0.929 for semantic depth. These results suggest that geometric information can improve automated surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. The learned spatial, temporal, and semantic attention patterns also support qualitative examination of the scene regions, video segments, and semantic streams emphasized by the model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于语义RGB-深度的框架，用于显微手术技能的自动化评估。通过融合稀疏度量立体深度与密集单目深度估计，生成手术场景的稠密几何表示，并结合针对不同手术器械和周围解剖结构的语义分解RGB流，利用分层注意力架构捕捉不同训练水平外科医生在器械使用及器械-解剖交互中的判别性模式。在33例离体经口显微喉镜手术数据上进行评估，该模型在技能水平分类中达到0.938的F1分数，优于仅用语义RGB（0.696）或语义深度（0.929）的方法，表明几何信息可显著提升显微视频中的技能评估性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视频的手术技能评估方法主要依赖RGB图像，忽略了描述器械-解剖交互的三维空间关系。尽管立体手术显微镜提供深度信息，但传统立体匹配算法在高倍率成像下会产生稀疏且不可靠的深度估计，限制了其在自动化技能评估中的应用。因此，亟需一种能有效融合深度与语义信息的新方法以提升评估准确性。
AI.method: 提出一种语义RGB-深度框架，采用基于回归的深度融合方法，将稀疏度量立体深度与密集单目深度估计相结合，生成稠密几何表示；同时对RGB流进行语义分解，分别对应各手术器械和周围解剖结构；引入分层注意力架构联合编码多模态流，捕捉空间、时间与语义上的判别特征。
AI.result: 在33例离体手术视频上，该模型在技能水平分类任务中取得0.938的F1分数，显著优于仅使用语义RGB（0.696）或语义深度（0.929）的基线方法，证明几何信息有助于提升评估性能；此外，模型学习到的空间、时间和语义注意力模式可用于定性分析关键区域、视频片段和关注的语义通道。
AI.conclusion: 本研究验证了融合几何信息与语义信息在显微手术技能评估中的有效性，提出的语义RGB-深度框架能够更准确地识别不同训练阶段外科医生的技术特征，为未来基于视频的技能评估系统提供了新的技术路径。

title: Reputation, Strategy, and Emotion Effects on Generative AI Cooperation: A Comparison Across Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Models
summary: As generative AI (Gen AI) systems take on increasingly autonomous roles in economically and socially consequential interactions, understanding their propensity to cooperate -- and the signals that shape this propensity -- has become essential. We examine cooperative behavior in frontier Gen AI models using the iterated prisoner's dilemma, manipulating counterpart reputation (positive, unknown, negative), strategy (extortion vs. generosity), and non-verbal emotional signaling (facial expressions conveying competitive or cooperative appraisals). In a first study with non-reasoning models (Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4o), cooperation was systematically shaped by all three factors, paralleling patterns long documented in human behavioral research, though models varied substantially in how heavily each factor was weighted. A second study with reasoning models (Claude 4.6, Gemini 3, GPT-5.2) revealed a more concentrated reliance on strategy and reputation, a near-elimination of the Potemkin effect observed in non-reasoning models (evidenced by near-uniform cooperation in a diagnostic harmony game), and a more conditional role for emotion consistent with a hierarchical cue-weighting strategy rather than a simple loss of social sensitivity. Reasoning models also showed heterogeneous end-game behavior, ranging from sustained cooperation to systematic last-round defection effect, revealing model-specific exploitability profiles with direct practical relevance for deployment in negotiation and other multi-round interactions. Together, these findings characterize Gen AI models as increasingly sophisticated, though heterogeneous, social actors, and underscore the practical value of developing standardized cooperation benchmarks to inform the responsible deployment of Gen AI in interactive, socially consequential settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过迭代囚徒困境实验，探讨了前沿生成式AI模型在不同情境下的合作行为，发现非推理模型受声誉、策略和情感信号的显著影响，而推理模型则更依赖策略与声誉，情感作用减弱且表现出异质性的终局行为，揭示出模型间差异及部署中的可被利用性风险。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在经济和社会重要互动中承担越来越自主的角色，理解其合作倾向及其影响因素变得至关重要，以确保其在交互式社会场景中的负责任部署。
AI.method: 采用迭代囚徒困境范式，操纵对手声誉（正面、未知、负面）、策略类型（勒索型 vs. 宽容型）以及非语言情感信号（传达竞争或合作评估的表情），对比非推理模型（如Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o）与推理模型（如Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2）的合作行为表现。
AI.result: 非推理模型的合作行为受三类因素系统性影响，符合人类行为规律；推理模型则更集中于策略与声誉，情感信号影响减弱，出现条件性使用，且在终局阶段表现出从持续合作到系统性最后一轮背叛的异质行为，显示出模型特异性可被利用的特征。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI模型正演化为日益复杂但异质的社会参与者，亟需建立标准化的合作基准测试，以指导其在多轮交互和社会关键场景中的负责任应用。

title: Auditing Web Agent Evaluation on WebArena-Lite: Human Review of Outcomes and Trajectories
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development"
summary: Web agents are an important application of large language models, yet their evaluation often depends on rule based or language model evaluators that inspect only the final outcome. Human verification of task completion and detailed analysis of failed trajectories remain limited. We audit all 165 WebArena Lite tasks under six evaluation conditions built from GPT 5.5 and an untrained Qwen3.5 9B model. The audit retains the original score, corrects false negatives from the automatic evaluator, identifies the first consequential error, and examines progress across the trajectory. We also study a Memory and Analysis Support Mechanism (MASM), which maintains explicit execution state, and Guide Text, which provides task relevant procedural guidance. Across four GPT 5.5 settings, human review recovers 5.45 to 8.49 percentage points of success missed by the evaluator. With a 25 step budget, Guide Text raises corrected success with MASM from 34.55% to 38.18%. On the untrained Qwen3.5 9B model, MASM raises the evaluator score from 13.90% to 18.80%. Review of 102 failed GPT 5.5 trajectories reveals frequent scrolling loops, unfinished exploration, premature answers, invalid actions, and incomplete form workflows. Step level evidence further shows that substantial early progress can coexist with a final failure. These results show why final scores alone provide an incomplete account of web agent behavior and motivate human grounded, trajectory aware verification.

AI.tldr: 本研究对165个WebArena Lite任务在六种评估条件下（基于GPT 5.5和未训练的Qwen3.5 9B模型）进行了审计，揭示了自动评估器存在的误判问题。通过人工审查发现，自动评估常遗漏真实成功案例，且能识别首次关键错误、分析轨迹进展。引入记忆与分析支持机制（MASM）和指导文本（Guide Text）后，成功率显著提升。研究强调仅依赖最终结果评分无法全面反映网络代理行为，呼吁采用以人类为基准、关注轨迹过程的验证方式。
AI.motivation: 现有网络代理评估多依赖规则或语言模型对最终结果进行判断，缺乏对任务完成情况的人工验证及失败轨迹的深入分析，导致评估不完整，难以真实反映代理性能。
AI.method: 在六种评估设置下对165个任务进行审计，使用GPT 5.5和未训练的Qwen3.5 9B模型，保留原始分数，修正自动评估中的假阴性，识别首次关键错误，并分析任务执行轨迹。同时测试了记忆与分析支持机制（MASM）和指导文本（Guide Text）的效果。
AI.result: 人工审查使GPT 5.5在不同设置下的成功率提升5.45%至8.49%；在25步预算下，结合MASM和Guide Text，纠正后的成功率从34.55%升至38.18%；在未训练的Qwen3.5 9B上，MASM将评估得分从13.90%提升至18.80%。失败轨迹分析显示存在频繁滚动循环、探索未完成、过早回答、无效操作和表单流程中断等问题。早期大量进展仍可能导致最终失败。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖最终评分无法全面反映网络代理的真实行为表现。必须引入以人类为基准、关注执行轨迹的验证机制，才能更准确评估代理能力并推动改进。

title: From Task Mixtures to Specialized Experts
summary: In collaborative foundation model fine-tuning, client data is rarely homogeneous. Instead, clients typically possess unknown mixtures of distinct data distributions, or tasks. Conventional federated learning primarily addresses heterogeneity across clients without explicitly resolving latent task mixtures within each client. We study this setting as compound heterogeneity, where data is heterogeneous both across and within clients. We study adaptation over a common frozen representation and show that, when tasks share the same feature geometry, the optimal model for a client's task mixture under squared loss is a convex combination of the optimal models for its underlying tasks. Thus, a single locally trained model represents the client's overall task mixture, while individual inputs may be drawn from different underlying task distributions. This motivates routing inputs to specialized experts, and we show that, when the task optima form a simplex, task-aligned routing achieves lower risk than any single adapted model for genuinely mixed clients. With access to a small set of task-labeled public samples, we derive a convex program to recover task experts and match them to their corresponding tasks. Our routing analysis shows that effective specialization requires input-dependent expert selection aligned with each client's task mixture. Motivated by this analysis, we propose FedSEE. Across our experiments, FedSEE avoids the negative transfer observed in the evaluated baselines and improves performance by 2.9 points overall and 3.7 points for the worst-served quartile.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了联合基础模型微调中的复合异质性问题，即客户端数据不仅在客户端间存在异质性，且每个客户端内部也包含多种未知的任务混合。作者提出在共享冻结表示的基础上进行自适应，并证明当任务具有相同特征几何结构时，最优模型是各基础任务最优模型的凸组合。因此，单个本地训练模型可代表客户端的整体任务混合。进一步提出基于任务对齐的路由机制，利用少量带标签的公共样本构建凸优化程序以恢复任务专家并匹配任务。实验表明，所提出的FedSEE方法避免了基线方法中的负迁移现象，在整体性能上提升2.9分，最差四分之一客户端提升3.7分。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦学习主要处理客户端间的异质性，但忽略了客户端内部潜在的任务混合问题。在实际应用中，客户端数据常为多种任务分布的混合，导致模型性能下降。因此需要一种能有效处理客户端内任务混合的新型方法。
AI.method: 提出在共享冻结表示基础上进行自适应；证明在特定条件下，客户端最优模型为各基础任务最优模型的凸组合；设计基于任务对齐的输入路由机制；利用少量带标签公共样本构建凸优化程序以恢复任务专家并实现任务匹配；提出FedSEE框架。
AI.result: FedSEE在多个实验中显著优于现有基线方法，避免了负迁移，整体性能提升2.9分，最差服务群体提升3.7分，验证了任务对齐路由的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 当任务共享相同特征几何结构时，通过凸组合建模任务混合是有效的；任务对齐的输入路由机制能够显著提升模型性能，尤其在任务混合严重的客户端上；所提出的FedSEE方法在处理复合异质性方面具有显著优势。

title: Resolving Mixed Single-Photon LiDAR Returns for Foreground-View and Hidden Scene Reconstruction
summary: Partially transmissive screens and protective covers are common in robotic inspection, but they create mixed LiDAR returns from both the foreground material and the scene behind it. Conventional peak-based LiDAR usually discards weak hidden returns, while single-photon LiDAR records time-resolved histograms that preserve attenuated and overlapping echoes. However, existing transient reconstruction methods typically fit a single scene representation to the measured waveform. Under occlusion, weak or nearby foreground--hidden echoes can form a broad peak or subtle shoulder. Because such waveforms can also be explained by a displaced single surface or a thick density distribution, accurate transient fitting does not necessarily imply correct geometry. We propose a state-aware framework for foreground-view and hidden scene reconstruction from occluded single-photon histograms. For each ray, we estimate local echo evidence, identifying no reliable surface evidence, single-return evidence, or two returns. The inferred echo state routes supervision for a two-head neural field: all rays constrain waveform reconstruction, while reliable anchors provide geometry localization. We also introduce a real paired single-photon LiDAR occlusion dataset with occluded and clean captures at fixed poses. Experiments on a real dataset show improved hidden scene depth and point-cloud accuracy over baselines. Our results demonstrate single-photon layered reconstruction as a practical route for 3D perception through partially transmissive occluders.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种状态感知框架，用于从被遮挡的单光子激光雷达波形中重建前景视图和隐藏场景。通过估计局部回波证据，区分无可靠表面、单回波或双回波状态，并利用双头神经场实现波形重建与几何定位的联合优化。引入真实配对的单光子激光雷达遮挡数据集，实验表明在隐藏场景深度和点云精度上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 常规峰值型激光雷达会丢弃弱的隐藏回波，而单光子激光雷达虽能记录时间分辨波形，但现有方法通常假设单一场景表示，难以准确解析遮挡下的复杂回波结构（如宽峰或微小肩部），导致几何重建错误。因此需要更精确的多层重建方法以实现透过部分透射遮挡物的三维感知。
AI.method: 设计状态感知框架，为每条光线估计局部回波证据（无可靠表面、单回波、双回波），基于此状态选择性地引导双头神经场：所有光线共同约束波形重建，可靠锚点提供几何定位监督。结合真实配对的单光子激光雷达遮挡数据集进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在隐藏场景深度估计和点云重建精度方面显著优于现有基线方法，验证了单光子分层重建在透过部分透射遮挡物进行3D感知方面的有效性与实用性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究展示了单光子激光雷达分层重建作为透过部分透射遮挡物实现高精度三维感知的可行且有效路径，为机器人检测等应用提供了新的技术支撑。

title: HHR: Hierarchical Hash Retrieval for Efficient LLM Generation
summary: Efficient long-context inference is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet it poses a severe computational bottleneck. Hash-based retrieval offers an efficient alternative by encoding queries and keys into binary codes and using Hamming distance for key selection. However, this leads to a critical mismatch between Hamming distance and attention relevance. Query-Key logits depend jointly on directional similarity and feature magnitudes, whereas hash binarization discards magnitude information, causing both false-positive retrieval of low-logit keys and false-negative omission of high-logit keys. To address these failures, we propose Hierarchical Hash Retrieval (HHR), a coarse-to-fine framework that progressively improves retrieval accuracy through Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR) and Learned Hash Projection (LHP). GKR learns a head-wise orthogonal transformation to redistribute feature magnitudes and derive more discriminative page-level logit bounds, enabling effective pruning of low-logit keys while preserving important candidates. LHP then learns a head-wise projection space that aligns Hamming distance with the true Query-Key relevance ranking for fine-grained retrieval. By combining GKR and LHP, HHR suppresses false positives and recovers false negatives, substantially improving the fidelity of hash-based sparse attention. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that HHR achieves superior performance over existing methods. For example, on LongBench, HHR improves the average score by 1.10 points and, at a context length of 128K, achieves up to a 3.30x decoding speedup and a 2.83x end-to-end speedup for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/HHR.

AI.tldr: 提出Hierarchical Hash Retrieval (HHR)框架，通过几何感知键路由(GKR)和学习哈希投影(LHP)实现从粗到精的检索优化，解决哈希二值化导致的注意力相关性失配问题，显著提升长上下文推理效率与精度。在LongBench等基准上，HHR相比现有方法平均提升1.10分，128K上下文长度下对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct实现最高3.30倍解码加速和2.83倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 哈希基检索虽高效，但因二值化丢失特征幅度信息，导致哈希距离与注意力相关性不匹配，引发误检（低得分键被误选）和漏检（高得分键被忽略），制约长上下文大模型推理效率。
AI.method: 提出层级哈希检索（HHR）框架，包含两个核心组件：几何感知键路由（GKR）通过头级正交变换重新分配特征幅度，生成更具区分性的页面级得分边界，有效剔除低相关性键；学习哈希投影（LHP）则学习头级投影空间，使汉明距离更贴近真实查询-键相关性排序，实现细粒度检索。二者结合可抑制误检并恢复漏检。
AI.result: 在多个LLM和基准测试中，HHR表现优异。例如在LongBench上平均提升1.10分；在128K上下文长度下，对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct实现最高3.30倍解码速度提升和2.83倍端到端速度提升。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: HHR通过引入几何感知路由与学习投影机制，有效缓解了哈希二值化带来的相关性失配问题，显著提升了哈希基稀疏注意力的检索精度与推理效率，为大规模语言模型的长上下文处理提供了高效可靠的新方案。

title: No Model Required: Text Entropy Rate Filtering Mitigates Iterative Fine-Tuning Collapse
summary: Iterative fine-tuning on synthetic data causes \emph{model collapse}: output diversity narrows as rare patterns are progressively lost, a signature most visible as phrase-level repetition. Existing mitigations either require model log-probabilities, an external oracle, or continued access to real human data. Here we develop a new approach grounded in mathematical information theory: the non-parametric Kontoyiannis entropy rate estimator $h_k$, computed entirely from raw text via match-length statistics, with no model of any kind. We show that this is in fact a \emph{superior} training-data filter on text-diversity metrics in a fully-synthetic, single-lineage fine-tuning setting. In a six-generation QLoRA collapse experiment on Llama-3.1-8B, logprob-based filtering (the most established model-access-requiring baseline) provides no significant text-diversity benefit on any metric ($p > 0.23$), whereas $h_k$-filtering yields $+42\%$ unique trigrams, $+30\%$ vocabulary, and $-19\%$ repetition (all $p < 0.001$). We validate $h_k$ as a cross-domain entropy proxy ($β= 0.924$, $R^2 = 0.746$) and collapse detector ($ρ= +0.454$, $p < 0.0001$) across 4~domains, 2~temperatures, 2~generator--scorer model pairs, and 1{,}520 generated documents. Our results demonstrate that information theoretic approaches to collapse mitigation are efficient, and suggest new approaches for maintaining multi-agent diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于信息论的新型方法，利用非参数Kontoyiannis熵率估计器 $h_k$ 来缓解合成数据迭代微调中的模型坍塌问题。该方法仅依赖原始文本的匹配长度统计，无需模型或人类数据，显著提升了文本多样性，在六代QLoRA微调实验中，相比传统基于概率的过滤方法，$h_k$-过滤在唯一三元组、词汇量和重复率上均有显著改善（均p < 0.001），且在跨领域、多温度、多生成器设置下表现出强鲁棒性，验证了其作为熵代理和坍塌检测器的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有缓解模型坍塌的方法通常依赖模型日志概率、外部知识库或持续访问真实人类数据，存在使用限制。本文旨在开发一种无需模型、不依赖外部资源的高效文本多样性评估与过滤方法，以应对合成数据微调中的多样性退化问题。
AI.method: 采用非参数Kontoyiannis熵率估计器 $h_k$，通过分析原始文本中的匹配长度统计信息来估计文本熵，进而作为训练数据过滤的依据。该方法完全不依赖模型输出，适用于全合成数据环境。
AI.result: 在六代QLoRA微调实验中，$h_k$-过滤显著提升文本多样性：唯一三元组增加42%，词汇量增加30%，重复率降低19%（所有p < 0.001）。同时，$h_k$在4个不同领域、多种设置下表现出良好的熵代理能力（β=0.924, R²=0.746）和坍塌检测能力（ρ=+0.454, p<0.0001）。
AI.conclusion: 信息论方法在模型坍塌缓解中具有高效性和普适性，$h_k$作为一种无需模型的文本多样性度量工具，为维护多智能体系统中的多样性提供了新思路。

title: Right In-Place (RiP) Convolution: A Simple, General, and Near-Optimal Strategy for Memory-Efficient CNN Inference
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Global South in AI
summary: Activation memory, not compute, limits CNN inference on constrained hardware such as microcontrollers. Direct in-place convolution removes the dual-buffer cost, but the memory-optimal formulation of Gural and Murmann assumes valid padding, unit stride, unit dilation, and odd square kernels, and needs a non-sequential traversal costing $2\times$ inference time in transposes. We identify two regimes in which their published closed form does not hold: (1) an under-allocation of exactly $(k-1)C_{in} \bmod (C_{out}-C_{in})$ scalars, active on every convolutional layer of their own deployed network and manifesting as a silent corruption of still-live input; (2) an unbounded overestimate, up to $2{,}432\times$, once the critical leg leaves the output grid. We correct both and generalize to arbitrary stride, dilation, padding, and rectangular kernels. We then propose Right In-Place (RiP) convolution, a bit-identical operation in which every layer reads its input right-aligned in a shared workspace and writes its output left-aligned from index zero. The debt is piecewise affine in the output pixel index, so evaluating its breakpoints in $O(1)$ yields the minimum safe gap without enumerating the output grid, with row-major access preserved. Across $10{,}000$ random layers RiP produced no corruption, and across 84 convolutional layers from 25 architectures it matches the herringbone workspace exactly on 58 and within 5% on 81, using 24.8% less memory than dual buffering on average. Written into TinyEngine's kernels and deployed to a Raspberry Pi Pico 1 and Pico 2, it cuts peak activation memory across eleven MCUNet models by 12.5 to 33.3% at unchanged cycle counts and bit-identical outputs, raising the number of models that fit the Pico 1's 256 KB SRAM from six to nine.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Right In-Place (RiP)的卷积计算方法，解决了在微控制器等受限硬件上运行CNN时激活内存瓶颈的问题。通过修正Gural和Murmann先前方法中的两个缺陷（内存不足与过度估算），并推广至任意步幅、膨胀、填充和矩形核，RiP实现了位级完全一致的计算。其核心是输入右对齐、输出左对齐的共享工作区策略，利用分段线性债务模型实现O(1)时间内的最小安全间隙计算，保持行优先访问。实验表明，在10,000个随机层中无数据错误，在84个真实网络层中58个精确匹配、81个误差小于5%，平均比双缓冲节省24.8%内存。部署于TinyEngine并在Raspberry Pi Pico 1/2上验证，使十一款MCUNet模型峰值激活内存减少12.5%至33.3%，且不增加周期数，成功将可部署模型数量从6个提升至9个。
AI.motivation: 在微控制器等资源受限设备上，激活内存而非计算量成为制约CNN推理性能的主要因素。现有最优的直接原地卷积方法存在理论缺陷，导致隐性数据损坏或严重内存高估，限制了其在实际复杂网络中的应用。因此需要一种更通用、更安全、更高效的内存优化卷积方案。
AI.method: 提出Right In-Place (RiP)卷积：输入右对齐写入共享工作区，输出左对齐从零开始写入；通过分析输出像素索引上的债务函数，推导出其分段线性特性，可在O(1)时间内确定最小安全间隙，避免遍历整个输出网格；同时修正原有闭式解在非标准配置下的失效问题，扩展适用范围至任意步幅、膨胀、填充及矩形核。
AI.result: 在10,000个随机卷积层测试中未出现任何数据损坏；在84个来自25个不同架构的真实层中，58个与herringbone内存布局完全匹配，81个误差低于5%；平均比双缓冲节省24.8%激活内存；在Raspberry Pi Pico 1和2上部署后，11个MCUNet模型的峰值激活内存降低12.5%至33.3%，周期数不变，位级输出一致；使可运行模型数由6个增至9个，显著提升资源受限设备的模型部署能力。
AI.conclusion: RiP卷积是一种高效、安全、通用的内存优化卷积方法，能有效突破微控制器上因激活内存限制而导致的模型部署瓶颈，具备在嵌入式AI系统中广泛应用的潜力。

title: EgoFound3R: End-to-End Egocentric Hand Reconstruction in World Space with Point-Wise Interaction Attributes
summary: Egocentric video has become a primary source of supervision for embodied models, and its value rests on recovering hand motion in world coordinates, which camera motion and hand occlusion make difficult. Existing reconstruction pipelines typically separate hand and scene estimation, leave interaction attributes to separate task-specific models, and invoke several models per video, so no prior reconstruction model estimates these attributes and throughput becomes a practical constraint on large-scale annotation. We therefore introduce EgoFound3R, a unified end-to-end model that estimates world-space hand geometry in a metric scale shared with the scene, and predicts point-wise interaction attributes, including visibility, contact, and distance. The model integrates three designs: (i) structured hand prompts that transfer pretrained geometric priors to world-space hand reconstruction; (ii) an explicit hand representation that decodes hand geometry and interaction attributes; and (iii) a shared-parameter multi-rate design that lowers inference cost. Together, these designs predict hand geometry and point-wise attributes in one pass. On OakInk-v2, TACO, and HOI4D, EgoFound3R reduces the mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 43.2%, 22.4%, and 11.6% over previous methods and predicts point-wise contact and distance alongside the geometry in the same pass, while attaining approximately 6x higher throughput.

AI.tldr: EgoFound3R 是一个统一的端到端模型，能够以度量尺度在世界坐标系中重建手部几何形状，并预测点级交互属性（如可见性、接触和距离）。该模型通过结构化手部提示、显式手部表示和共享参数多速率设计，在单次推理中完成手部几何与交互属性的联合预测，显著提升精度与效率。在 OakInk-v2、TACO 和 HOI4D 数据集上，相比之前方法，平均关节位置误差（MPJPE）分别降低 43.2%、22.4% 和 11.6%，且推理速度提升约 6 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有手部重建方法通常将手部与场景估计分离，依赖多个独立模型处理交互属性，导致计算开销大、难以大规模标注。因此需要一种统一、高效、高精度的端到端模型来同时恢复手部几何与交互属性。
AI.method: 引入 EgoFound3R 模型，采用三项核心设计：(i) 结构化手部提示以传递预训练几何先验；(ii) 显式手部表示以解码几何与交互属性；(iii) 共享参数多速率架构以降低推理成本。三者协同实现一次前向传播完成全部任务。
AI.result: 在 OakInk-v2、TACO、HOI4D 数据集上，MPJPE 分别降低 43.2%、22.4%、11.6%；同时实现点级接触与距离预测；推理吞吐量提升约 6 倍。
AI.conclusion: EgoFound3R 实现了手部几何与交互属性的统一、高效、高精度重建，为大规模注释和真实世界应用提供了可行方案。

title: Learning to Ask: Information Acquisition for SLM-LLM Collaboration, under a budget
summary: Collaboration between a small language model (SLM) and a large language model (LLM) offers an opportunity to combine the efficiency of smaller models with the strong reasoning capabilities of larger ones. Existing approaches primarily frame such collaboration as a computation allocation problem, determining which model should handle each portion of the reasoning process. In black-box API-based settings, however, this paradigm can be inefficient due to coarse-grained delegation or repeated transmission of context across model switches. In this work, we instead formulate SLM-LLM collaboration as an information acquisition problem, under an API budget constraint. The SLM remains the primary reasoner and selectively queries a black-box LLM advisor only when needed, issuing targeted queries rather than delegating the reasoning process itself. To realize this strategy, we develop a three-stage RLVR framework that learns whether to call the advisor, how to formulate useful queries, and how to integrate the collaboration into the reasoning process by jointly refining advisor invocation and information use. Across mathematical reasoning and coding tasks, our approach improves the performance--cost tradeoff over existing collaboration baselines and, in some settings, matches or exceeds oracle problem-level routing. Finally, we show that our strategy can transfer to other advisor model families, without further training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将小语言模型（SLM）与大语言模型（LLM）的协作视为信息获取问题，而非传统的计算分配问题。通过引入三阶段强化学习框架RLVR，使SLM在需要时主动、精准地向黑箱LLM咨询，减少冗余通信并优化资源使用。该方法在数学推理和编程任务中显著提升性能-成本权衡，并可跨模型家族迁移，无需额外训练。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将SLM-LLM协作视为计算分配问题，在黑箱API环境下因粗粒度调度和频繁上下文传输导致效率低下。为克服这一瓶颈，本文提出以信息获取为核心的新范式，旨在更高效地利用外部LLM的推理能力。
AI.method: 提出三阶段强化学习框架RLVR，分别学习：1）是否调用顾问模型；2）如何构造有效查询；3）如何将顾问反馈整合进自身推理流程。整个过程在API预算约束下联合优化，实现细粒度、目标导向的信息获取。
AI.result: 在数学推理和编程任务中，该方法优于现有协作基线，在性能-成本权衡上表现更优，部分场景达到甚至超过基于问题级别的理想路由效果。此外，该策略具备良好的泛化能力，可在不重新训练的情况下适配不同类型的顾问模型。
AI.conclusion: 将SLM-LLM协作建模为信息获取问题，能有效缓解黑箱环境下的通信开销与调度低效问题。所提出的RLVR框架实现了高效、灵活且可迁移的协作机制，为低成本高效益的智能系统设计提供了新思路。

title: GAW-PO: Preference Optimization with Gradient-Aligned Token Weights
summary: Most preference optimization methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), apply preference supervision at the response level, although autoregressive language models are optimized token by token. As a result, all tokens in a rejected response contribute to the negative training signal, including tokens that may encode behavior that is useful for the preferred response. We introduce GAW-PO, a gradient-aligned token reweighting method for DPO that estimates, for each rejected token, whether penalizing it would interfere with the preferred update directions. Tokens whose gradients are strongly aligned with the preferred behavior receive a weaker negative contribution, while conflicting tokens retain a stronger penalty. Our method achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated preference-optimization methods, improving by 0.97 points over standard DPO and 0.65 points over the strongest competing baseline across 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, reasoning, coding, and question answering. We further show that gradient-aligned weighting is substantially more robust to aggressive preference optimization: as the DPO regularization parameter $β$ decreases, standard DPO degrades sharply, whereas GAW-PO continues to improve. These results suggest that accounting for the interaction between rejected-token updates and preferred behavior provides an effective form of token-level credit assignment for preference optimization.

AI.tldr: GAW-PO 是一种针对 DPO 的梯度对齐标记重加权方法，通过评估每个被拒绝标记的惩罚是否会影响偏好更新方向，实现更精细的令牌级信用分配。该方法在 11 个涵盖数学、推理、编码和问答的基准上平均性能领先于现有方法，相较标准 DPO 提升 0.97 分，相较最强基线提升 0.65 分，并在高强度偏好优化下表现出更强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好优化方法（如 DPO）在响应层面施加偏好监督，但自回归语言模型是逐标记优化的，导致所有被拒绝响应中的标记都被视为负信号，包括可能对偏好响应有用的标记，这造成不合理的训练信号。因此需要更精细的令牌级信用分配机制。
AI.method: 提出 GAW-PO，基于梯度对齐思想，估计每个被拒绝标记的梯度与偏好行为更新方向的对齐程度：若对齐性强，则降低其负向贡献；若冲突，则保留强惩罚，从而实现更精准的标记级更新。
AI.result: 在 11 个基准上，GAW-PO 平均性能最优，相比标准 DPO 提升 0.97 分，相比最强基线提升 0.65 分；且在降低 DPO 正则化参数 β 时，性能下降远低于标准 DPO，显示更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 考虑被拒绝标记更新与偏好行为之间的交互作用，能有效实现偏好优化中的令牌级信用分配，显著提升性能与鲁棒性。

title: ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning
summary: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. An independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write that concentrates its weight on one slot overwrites that slot, and a learned gate fuses the retrieved content with the recurrent state before the policy and value heads. We also introduce Rune-Mazes, three environments in which rune observations invert, cancel, reset, or repeat updates of a hidden cue under vector and pixel observations. Against seven baselines, ALER reaches a success rate of at least $0.82$ in all sixteen Endless T-Maze configurations and at least $0.99$ on all five Rune T-Maze compositions, and it has the highest mean success rate on four-branch Rune Multi-Corridor with an Invert rune. On pixel-based Rune MiniGrid Memory, it has a higher mean success rate than PPO-LSTM in eight of ten configurations. Project page: https://quartz-admirer.github.io/ALER-Adaptive-Learnable-Experience-Rewriting/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ALER（自适应可学习经验重写）模型，用于解决部分可观测强化学习中的记忆更新问题。引入了重写和经验融合的新要求，并设计了基于LSTM与槽内存的架构，通过门控机制实现动态信息更新。在Rune-Mazes等新环境中验证，ALER在多个任务上显著优于基线方法，成功率达到0.82以上，部分场景达0.99。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测强化学习中，传统记忆系统仅关注信息保留，而忽视了信息可能被后续观察重写或融合的情况。为更真实地模拟复杂环境中的记忆需求，论文提出需考虑信息重写和经验融合的新挑战。
AI.method: 提出ALER模型，结合LSTM与独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入机制，实现对特定槽位的强制重写；通过可学习门控机制融合检索内容与递归状态，支持动态信息更新。同时构建Rune-Mazes环境，涵盖反转、抵消、重置、重复等更新规则。
AI.result: ALER在所有16个无限T型迷宫配置中成功率达至少0.82，在5个Rune T型迷宫组合中成功率达至少0.99，且在四分支Rune多走廊任务中表现最优。在像素级Rune MiniGrid任务中，其平均成功率高于PPO-LSTM在10种配置中的8种。
AI.conclusion: ALERT模型有效应对了部分可观测强化学习中动态记忆更新的挑战，证明了自适应重写与融合机制在复杂记忆任务中的必要性和有效性。新提出的Rune-Mazes基准为未来研究提供了有力工具。

title: AutoGUIWorld: Image Generators as Visual World Models for GUI Agent
summary: GUI agents require high-quality interaction trajectories to learn how software environments respond to actions, maintain state, and support multi-step workflows. However, the diversity of available trajectories is constrained by the applications, interface states, and workflows accessible in the underlying environments. Expanding this coverage requires deploying increasingly diverse and complex software, with specialized applications imposing additional installation, configuration, and runtime costs. We introduce AutoGUIWorld, a data generation framework that combines the visual priors of image generators with the task knowledge of a planner to synthesize GUI interaction trajectories without deploying or running the corresponding software environments. AutoGUIWorld samples initial GUI scenes from structured specifications of operating-system context, visual appearance, and interface state, and generates tasks conditioned on those scenes. A planner then specifies atomic actions and their intended visual consequences, while an image generator iteratively edits the current screenshot to produce subsequent observations. Action grounding and transition-level quality filtering yield 79,266 spatially annotated step-level training samples across Ubuntu, Windows, macOS, and Chrome. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoGUIWorld trajectories improves the mean task score on OSWorld from 33.0% to 40.8% and the task success rate on ScienceBoard from 14.0% to 32.2%. These results show that generated trajectories improve GUI-agent performance on real desktop and scientific tasks.

AI.tldr: AutoGUIWorld是一个无需部署真实软件环境即可生成高质量GUI交互轨迹的数据生成框架。它结合图像生成器的视觉先验与规划器的任务知识，通过结构化规范生成初始GUI场景，并基于场景生成任务。规划器定义原子动作及其预期视觉效果，图像生成器迭代编辑截图以生成后续观测。通过动作对齐和过渡级质量过滤，生成了79,266个带空间标注的步骤级训练样本，覆盖Ubuntu、Windows、macOS和Chrome系统。在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B上微调后，模型在OSWorld上的平均任务得分从33.0%提升至40.8%，在ScienceBoard上的任务成功率从14.0%提升至32.2%，证明生成轨迹能有效提升GUI代理在真实桌面和科学任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI代理依赖高质量的交互轨迹进行学习，但真实环境中的轨迹受限于应用多样性、界面状态和工作流复杂性，扩展覆盖范围需部署大量复杂软件，带来高昂的安装、配置和运行成本。因此亟需一种无需实际运行环境即可生成多样化、高质量交互轨迹的方法。
AI.method: AutoGUIWorld结合图像生成器的视觉先验与规划器的任务知识，从操作系统上下文、视觉外观和界面状态的结构化规范中采样初始GUI场景，生成对应任务。规划器指定原子动作及其预期视觉后果，图像生成器通过迭代编辑当前截图生成后续观察。通过动作对齐和过渡级质量过滤机制，构建高保真、空间标注的步骤级训练数据。
AI.result: 成功生成79,266个空间标注的步骤级训练样本，涵盖Ubuntu、Windows、macOS和Chrome系统。在Qwen3.5-35B-A3B模型上微调后，其在OSWorld任务上的平均得分从33.0%提升至40.8%，在ScienceBoard任务上的成功率从14.0%提升至32.2%，显著提升了GUI代理在真实桌面和科学任务中的性能。
AI.conclusion: AutoGUIWorld通过融合视觉生成与任务规划，实现了无需真实软件部署的高质量GUI交互轨迹生成，有效解决了真实环境轨迹稀缺与成本高的问题，显著提升了GUI代理的学习性能，为未来通用桌面智能体的发展提供了高效数据支持。

title: Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning
summary: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.

AI.tldr: 本文研究动态任务路由问题，提出一种名为RIAG的多智能体系统，通过分离时间解析与任务推理，实现高效的任务更新与答案生成。实验基于六个基准数据集构建了31,119个动态任务场景，结果显示RIAG在极低调用次数下显著优于现有方法，兼具高准确率与低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 传统推理协议固定任务，无法评估智能体对更新的响应能力、未受影响工作的保留以及历史任务绑定的重构能力。因此需要动态任务路由机制来测试智能体在事件流中维护正确性与效率的能力。
AI.method: 将六大数据集（MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA、HumanEval）改造为包含373,428个时序查询的动态任务集合；提出修订感知独立智能体图（RIAG），通过文档唯一标识缓存解题结果，每个新任务初始两次未暴露尝试，并条件性触发审计与修复，每文档版本最多调用四次。
AI.result: 同质化RIAG在0.62次调用/查询下达到54.24%联合路由与答案准确率，远超对比方法（32.22%，18.00次调用/查询）；异质化RIAG达49.78%准确率，仅需0.63次调用/查询。
AI.conclusion: RIAG有效解决了动态任务路由中的时效性与准确性权衡问题，实现了高效、可靠的任务更新机制，为复杂动态环境下的智能体推理提供了新范式。

title: How the Audit Rule Shapes Faithful Factor Explanations in LLMs
summary: Large language models are often asked which input factors influenced their outputs. For structured inputs, such reports can be checked by counterfactual perturbation, but each factor must be queried multiple times to estimate its effect, so verification is usually budget-limited. We study how this limited-budget setting changes the incentive to report factor-level influence truthfully. We formalize the interaction as a verification game and show that proper scoring alone is not enough when auditing depends on the report: report-dependent auditing creates a suppression incentive, because factors reported as important are more likely to be checked and penalized for estimation noise. In contrast, report-independent auditing, or a mixed rule with a small report-independent floor, removes this channel and makes truthful reporting preferable to full suppression. We instantiate the framework with the Counterfactual Brier Score (CBS) and evaluate its predictions on four NLP benchmarks. A synthetic rational agent matches the theoretical prediction exactly, and real LLMs follow the same incentives when they are made explicit. The main design implication is simple: under partial verification, factor-level explanation systems should include a report-independent audit component so that under-reporting cannot be used to avoid scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 在有限验证预算下，大语言模型对输入因素影响的报告存在抑制激励。报告依赖的审计会因被报告为重要因素而更易被检查和惩罚，导致模型倾向于低估影响。而报告无关的审计或混合规则（含小比例报告无关部分）可消除此激励，促进真实报告。通过反事实布莱尔得分（CBS）在四个NLP基准上的实验验证了理论预测，合成理性代理与真实LLM均表现出相应行为。设计建议：解释系统应包含报告无关的审计成分，以防止通过低报规避审查。
AI.motivation: 研究在有限验证预算下，大语言模型对输入因素影响的报告是否可信。传统方法如反事实扰动需多次查询，受限于预算，导致模型可能出于规避检查的动机而选择不真实报告影响程度。
AI.method: 将该问题建模为验证博弈，分析报告依赖与报告无关审计对模型报告行为的影响；引入并应用反事实布莱尔得分（CBS）进行实证评估，使用合成理性代理和真实大语言模型在多个NLP任务上测试理论预测。
AI.result: 实验表明，当审计依赖报告时，模型有抑制报告影响力的动机；而采用报告无关审计或混合审计规则时，模型更倾向于真实报告。合成代理完全符合理论预测，真实大语言模型也表现出相同趋势。
AI.conclusion: 在部分验证条件下，解释系统必须包含报告无关的审计机制，以避免模型通过低报来规避审查，确保解释的可信性。

title: MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey. The gap counts only the interval the cue is provably absent, not the full duration a policy must retain it, so every memory-dependent task still requires memory by construction, including the ones whose measured gap is short. We release 22,500 oracle trajectories across 10 memory types in RLDS and LeRobotDataset v3. A reference $π_{0.5}$ baseline with current images and proprioception, but no observation history or explicit memory module, is fine-tuned on 14 tasks and achieves 0.211 $\pm$ 0.044 mean task success. Its lower success on the evaluated Long-split tasks is confounded by open-loop chunking and the memory types represented in that subset. Project page: https://mikasarobo.github.io/

AI.tldr: MIKASA-Robo-VLA 是一个包含 90 个语言引导操作任务的基准测试，其中大部分任务隐藏了动作所依赖的关键线索，以评估视觉-语言-动作策略在信息缺失情况下的记忆能力。该基准包含 32 个任务的子集 MIKASA-Robo，仅在代表性子集中使用语言指令，并通过环境阶段时间设定信息间隙，其中 28 个任务的信息间隙超过当前最宽固定上下文 VLA 的 16 帧窗口。所有任务均要求策略具备记忆能力，即使信息间隙较短。研究释放了 22,500 条来自 10 种记忆类型的专家轨迹（RLDS 与 LeRobotDataset v3），并提供了一个基于当前图像和本体感觉但无历史观察或显式记忆模块的基线模型 $\pi_{0.5}$，在 14 个任务上微调后平均成功率为 0.211 ± 0.044。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常只能访问一两个最近帧，难以评估其对消失信息的利用能力。为更准确地衡量策略的记忆性能，需要构建一个能系统性隐藏关键任务线索、并量化信息缺失时间的基准测试。
AI.method: 提出 MIKASA-Robo-VLA 基准，包含 90 个语言条件操作任务，其中 80 个任务隐藏任务相关线索，10 个为反应式控制；构建子集 MIKASA-Robo，定义任务中的信息间隙（即线索不可见的时间段），并统计其是否超过当前主流 VLA 的 16 帧上下文窗口。通过生成多类型记忆的专家轨迹，建立可复现的评估环境。
AI.result: 70 个任务中存在信息间隙，28 个超过 16 帧，表明当前 VLA 模型难以处理长期依赖。基线模型 $\pi_{0.5}$ 在 14 个任务上平均成功率仅为 0.211 ± 0.044，且在长间隔任务上表现受限，受开环分块和记忆类型分布影响。结果表明，现有 VLA 模型缺乏有效记忆机制，需引入显式记忆结构。
AI.conclusion: MIKASA-Robo-VLA 提供了一个系统化评估视觉-语言-动作策略记忆能力的基准，揭示了当前模型在处理信息缺失任务时的显著局限。未来工作应关注如何设计有效的记忆模块以提升长期依赖建模能力。

title: A Compact Explicit 4D Representation for Dynamic Scenes
summary: A compact dynamic-scene representation must retain both the surfaces seen over time and the appearance needed to render them from new viewpoints. We present Sparc4D, a feed-forward autoencoder that encodes a monocular video with known cameras into a sparse 4D scene state. Static features are shared across the clip, while spatially anchored temporal slots compress time-varying features. A sparse decoder produces 2D Gaussian surfels, while stored source pixels preserve fine texture through geometric re-projection. The state includes one full source frame and dynamic-region pixels sampled every fourth frame, alongside learned features and sparse occupancy. For a 32-frame MultiCamVideo clip, it averages 0.95M 32-bit-equivalent values on random windows and 0.92M on the first-32 protocol. On first-32, Sparc4D reaches 21.70\,dB, compared with 20.40\,dB for MoVieS. On randomly placed windows, their PSNR scores are comparable. With stored texture disabled, temporal slots compress the time-varying feature state by a median $4.0\times$ and reduce the mean state from 1.04M to 0.42M values, with essentially unchanged target-view reconstruction quality. Without fine-tuning on real data, Sparc4D transfers to DyCheck and Neu3D, where stored texture improves LPIPS while slightly reducing PSNR.

AI.tldr: Sparc4D 是一种前馈自编码器，用于将已知相机的单目视频编码为稀疏的4D场景状态。它通过共享静态特征和空间锚定的时间槽来压缩时变特征，使用稀疏解码器生成2D高斯表面元素，并通过几何重投影保留精细纹理。该方法在32帧的MultiCamVideo数据集上表现出色，在第一32协议下达到21.70 dB的PSNR，优于MoVieS的20.40 dB。关闭存储纹理后，时间槽使时变特征压缩达4.0倍，状态大小从1.04M降至0.42M，同时保持重建质量。无需真实数据微调即可迁移至DyCheck和Neu3D，且存储纹理有助于提升LPIPS性能。
AI.motivation: 需要一种紧凑的动态场景表示方法，能够在保持表面可见性和新视角渲染所需外观的同时，高效压缩视频序列中的时空信息。
AI.method: 提出Sparc4D，一个基于前馈自编码器的框架，将单目视频编码为稀疏4D场景状态；利用共享静态特征与空间锚定的时间槽处理时变内容；通过稀疏解码器生成2D高斯表面元素，并利用源图像像素进行几何重投影以保留细节纹理。
AI.result: 在32帧的MultiCamVideo数据集上，Sparc4D在第一32协议下平均达到21.70 dB PSNR，优于MoVieS（20.40 dB）；关闭纹理存储后，状态大小减少约60%，压缩比达4.0倍，重建质量基本不变；在无真实数据微调的情况下成功迁移至DyCheck和Neu3D，且纹理存储提升LPIPS表现。
AI.conclusion: Sparc4D提供了一种高效、可迁移的动态场景表示方法，能够在极低状态规模下实现高质量的新视角合成，尤其适用于资源受限环境下的动态场景建模。

title: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
comment: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
summary: Errors in LLM agent executions and their visible consequences can be separated by many steps, making decisive-error localization a matter of understanding both step content and step dependencies. We introduce DeFA, a dependency-guided framework for agent failure attribution. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. It then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Finally, DeFA uses step evidence and the steps' roles in failure propagation to identify the decisive error, responsible agent, and error category. To support long trajectories, DeFA partitions executions into segments and combines the current segment's detailed content with summaries of the other segments, giving local diagnosis access to global execution context. Across Who and When and the Who and When Pro text subset, DeFA achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all evaluated backbones, and the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods on Pro. Further experiments on image and video trajectories demonstrate its applicability to multimodal failure attribution. Ablations support the contributions of segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. Using DeFA's diagnostic feedback for skill evolution in Trace2Skill improves downstream task accuracy by 6-15 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can also support agent improvement on subsequent tasks.

AI.tldr: DeFA 是一个依赖引导的代理失败归因框架，通过构建事件依赖图和失败传播图，结合步骤证据与步骤在失败传播中的角色，识别决定性错误、责任代理和错误类别。该框架采用分段机制，在长轨迹中实现局部诊断对全局上下文的访问，显著提升责任代理、精确步骤和失败模式的准确率，并可应用于多模态场景。实验表明其诊断反馈能有效提升后续任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM代理执行中的错误及其可见后果之间存在多个步骤的间隔，导致难以定位决定性错误，因此需要一种能够理解步骤内容和步骤依赖关系的方法来实现精准的失败归因。
AI.method: DeFA 首先构建包含协议关系和语义依赖的事件依赖图；接着识别违反任务要求的事件，追踪其源头及后续影响，形成失败传播图；最后利用步骤证据和步骤在失败传播中的角色，确定决定性错误、责任代理和错误类别。为处理长轨迹，采用分段策略，结合当前段的详细内容与其余段的摘要，实现局部诊断对全局上下文的感知。
AI.result: 在 Who and When 及其 Pro 子集上，DeFA 在所有评估的骨干模型中均达到最高的责任代理和精确步骤准确率；在 Pro 数据集上，失败模式准确率高于其他对齐分类法。多模态（图像与视频）实验验证了其适用性。消融实验证明了分段、事件依赖图和失败传播图的有效性。使用 DeFA 的诊断反馈改进 Trace2Skill 后，下游任务准确率提升 6-15 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: DeFA 能够高效、准确地进行复杂执行轨迹中的失败归因，且其诊断结果可直接用于代理技能的迭代优化，显著提升任务表现。

title: AURAL: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Joint Chunk for Speech Language Models
summary: Model intelligence and fast response jointly shape the quality of interaction with speech language models, yet remain difficult to achieve together. Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning and audio understanding, but generating intermediate reasoning tokens delays responses. Describing fine-grained acoustic cues further lengthens CoT and increases latency. Latent reasoning can reduce this overhead, yet existing methods often trail CoT and remain limited by single-path supervision and reasoning budgets that do not adapt to problem difficulty. We introduce AURAL, which models a distribution over multiple plausible reasoning continuations in latent space and jointly predicts chunks of future states to reduce sequential forward passes and reasoning latency. To provide initial supervision for latent reasoning, we construct AuralReason-683K: 683K bilingual speech utterances (about 1,000 hours) with concise CoT for emotion recognition, empathetic dialogue, and general reasoning. AURAL-RL then explores beyond these traces, rewarding concise reasoning that yields high-quality answers and adapting reasoning effort to each problem. Across two backbones, AURAL-RL achieves performance comparable to CoT-RL, with larger gains over the respective supervised checkpoints on most metrics. Analysis further shows that harder questions elicit more latent reasoning steps. On Qwen2.5-Omni, it reduces time to the first answer token by 11.8x, from 1.22 to 0.10 s, versus 0.05 s for direct answering.

AI.tldr: AURAL introduces a method for latent reasoning in speech language models that reduces response latency while maintaining high-quality reasoning. It uses a distribution over multiple reasoning continuations in latent space and jointly predicts future states, reducing sequential forward passes. AuralReason-683K provides bilingual data with concise CoT for training, and AURAL-RL adapts reasoning effort based on problem difficulty, achieving performance comparable to explicit CoT with significant latency reduction.
AI.motivation: Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves model accuracy but increases response latency due to token generation overhead. Existing latent reasoning methods lack adaptability and suffer from single-path supervision and fixed reasoning budgets. There is a need for efficient, adaptive reasoning that balances intelligence and speed.
AI.method: AURAL models a distribution over multiple plausible reasoning paths in latent space and jointly predicts chunks of future states to reduce sequential inference steps. It leverages AuralReason-683K—a large-scale bilingual dataset with concise CoT—for initial supervision. AURAL-RL extends this by using reinforcement learning to reward concise, high-quality reasoning and dynamically adjust reasoning effort based on task difficulty.
AI.result: AURAL-RL achieves performance on par with CoT-RL across two backbones, with larger gains over supervised baselines. On Qwen2.5-Omni, it reduces time to first answer token by 11.8x (from 1.22s to 0.10s), significantly outperforming direct answering (0.05s). Harder questions trigger more latent reasoning steps, demonstrating adaptive behavior.
AI.conclusion: AURAL enables fast, intelligent reasoning in speech language models by leveraging latent reasoning with adaptive effort and multi-path prediction, achieving high performance with drastically reduced latency—making it ideal for real-time interactive applications.

title: Learning the identity: a case study of how SGD selects among functional decompositions
summary:
One might think that learning the identity function with a deep linear residual network is trivial - the path along residual connections already implements the identity, and so the network need only drive its weights to zero. However, this zero-weight solution is just one point on an entire manifold of population-loss minimizers, each corresponding to a different decomposition of the identity across the network's layers. Although the population loss does not distinguish among these solutions, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) reproducibly favors particular ones. For instance, under anisotropic label noise, the learned layers exhibit a noise-dependent spectrum; even with weight decay, SGD does not generally recover the zero-weight solution. Changing only the parametrization, while leaving the set of realizable functions unchanged, yields different behavior: factoring each weight matrix as a product of two matrices causes the weights to collapse to zero, even without explicit weight decay.
  While perhaps mysterious and unintuitive at first, these phenomena can be understood through the lens of entropic loss, which augments the population loss with a term proportional to the expected squared norm of the minibatch gradient (Ziyin et al., 2025). On the identity manifold, the population loss is constant, while the entropic term distinguishes among these decompositions. We characterize its minimizers analytically and use them to derive predictions for the structure of solutions favored by SGD. Networks trained with SGD closely match these predictions.
  Overall, the identity learning task studied here serves as a clean and simple case study of how the lens of entropic loss can clarify why SGD favors particular decompositions of the same input-output function.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了深度线性残差网络学习恒等函数时，尽管存在多个等效解（即不同的权重分解方式），但随机梯度下降（SGD）却倾向于特定的解。这种偏好并非来自损失函数本身，而是由一种称为“熵损失”的额外项所驱动——它与小批量梯度的期望平方范数成正比。在恒等映射的解流形上，标准损失恒定，但熵损失能区分不同解，并引导优化过程选择特定结构。通过分析熵损失的极小化点，作者成功预测了SGD所偏好的解的结构，并验证了其与实际训练结果高度一致。
AI.motivation: 理解为何在存在多个等价解的情况下，SGD仍会稳定地选择特定的权重配置，揭示优化过程中的隐含偏好机制。
AI.method: 引入熵损失（entropic loss），将原始损失与小批量梯度的期望平方范数结合；在恒等映射的解流形上分析该损失的最小化结构，推导出最优解的数学特征，并与实际训练结果对比验证。
AI.result: 理论预测与实验结果高度吻合：即使没有显式正则化（如权重衰减），在某些参数化下，网络仍会趋向零权重解；而在其他情况下，解的谱结构受标签噪声影响，表现出可预测的依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: SGD对恒等函数学习中解的选择并非偶然，而是由熵损失所主导的隐含优化偏好所致。这一视角为理解深度网络优化行为提供了新工具，尤其适用于解释复杂模型中看似非直观的泛化特性。

title: Flow Matching Reinforcement for 3D Mesh Generation via Dynamic Homing Optimization
summary: Flow matching is central to 3D generation, yet in practice its reinforcement learning (RL) methods are largely adapted from 2D visual generation. Representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives, when applied to negative trajectories, mainly steer predicted velocities away from the corresponding directions without explicitly specifying a target velocity field toward preferred samples. In 3D generation, constrained by pretrained model capabilities, rollout diversity, and reward-distribution complexity, directly applying these RL methods yields limited gains in geometric quality. We introduce a forward-process RL method \textbf{Dynamic Homing Optimization (DHO)}, which reformulates negative-trajectory optimization as positive-sample attraction-guided dynamic homing. Specifically, Minimum-Cost Attractive Matching (MAM) assigns each negative sample a distinct positive target, and Time-Aware Dynamic Correction (TDC) then redirects its trajectory toward the target using a remaining-time-aware corrective velocity. Building on asynchronous online DHO, we develop \textbf{Flow3D-Pro}, an image-to-3D geometry generation framework. Experiments show that DHO outperforms representative DPO-, GRPO-, and NFT-style objectives in 3D generation, while Flow3D-Pro produces higher-quality 3D geometry than existing mesh generation methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的基于前向过程的强化学习方法Dynamic Homing Optimization (DHO)，用于3D生成中的流匹配。该方法通过最小代价吸引匹配（MAM）为每个负样本分配正样本目标，并利用时间感知动态修正（TDC）引导轨迹向目标方向调整，从而提升几何质量。基于此，构建了Flow3D-Pro框架，在图像到3D几何生成任务中表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的3D生成方法多沿用2D视觉生成的策略，如DPO、GRPO和NFT等，这些方法在处理负轨迹时仅将预测速度远离错误方向，未明确指定目标速度场，导致在3D生成中受限于预训练模型能力、回溯多样性及奖励分布复杂性，难以有效提升几何质量。
AI.method: 提出Dynamic Homing Optimization (DHO) 方法，包含两个核心组件：(1) Minimum-Cost Attractive Matching (MAM)，为每个负样本分配一个独特的正样本作为目标；(2) Time-Aware Dynamic Correction (TDC)，根据剩余时间动态调整速度以引导轨迹朝目标前进。结合异步在线训练机制，构建Flow3D-Pro框架。
AI.result: 实验表明，DHO在3D生成任务中显著优于DPO、GRPO和NFT等经典强化学习方法；Flow3D-Pro生成的3D几何质量高于现有网格生成方法，尤其在细节和结构完整性方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: DHO通过将负样本优化转化为正样本吸引的动态归巢过程，有效提升了3D生成中流匹配的质量。其提出的Flow3D-Pro框架在图像到3D几何生成任务中展现出优越性能，为3D内容生成提供了新范式。

title: Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class
summary: Timely and specific feedback is one of the strongest influences on student learning, yet it is difficult to sustain in large electrical engineering classes where the ratio of students to demonstrators is high and a learner who is stuck may wait days to find out why an approach was wrong. Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) offers a way to scale conversational feedback, but using it to grade assessed work raises trust and accountability concerns, and keeping a human in the loop to assure its judgements reintroduces the very delay that erodes the value of feedback. The result is a tension between the immediacy that makes feedback so impactful and the human oversight that makes it trustworthy. In this work, we set out to resolve that tension in practice by designing and piloting a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice. This relocates human oversight from real-time grading to the upfront verification of solutions. Our goal was to understand how students engaged with the tool, how they perceived the value and reliability of its feedback, and what lessons transfer to other engineering subjects.

AI.tldr: 本研究设计并试点了一种基于生成式人工智能（GenAI）的实践平台，旨在为大规模电气工程课程中的学生提供即时、分层的反馈。通过将人工审核从实时评分转移到前期解决方案的验证，该平台在保持反馈及时性的同时确保了可靠性，缓解了即时反馈与人工信任之间的矛盾。研究探讨了学生对该工具的参与度、对反馈价值与可靠性的感知，并提炼出可推广至其他工程学科的经验。
AI.motivation: 在大型电气工程课程中，由于师生比高，学生提交作业后可能需要数天才能获得反馈，导致反馈时效性差，影响学习效果。尽管生成式人工智能（GenAI）能够实现即时、个性化的反馈，但其用于评估作业时存在信任与问责问题；而若保留人类审核，则难以避免延迟，削弱反馈的价值。因此，亟需一种既能保证反馈及时性又能维持可信度的解决方案。
AI.method: 设计并实施了一个基于GenAI的实践平台，允许学生在自主练习中获得即时、分层的反馈。关键创新在于将人类专家的监督环节前置，即在系统部署前对标准答案和解题路径进行人工验证，从而确保反馈质量，同时避免实时干预带来的延迟。通过小规模试点，收集学生使用行为数据及主观反馈，分析其参与情况、对反馈的信任度以及工具的实用性。
AI.result: 学生普遍积极使用该平台，反馈的即时性和指导性得到高度认可。多数学生认为系统提供的反馈准确且有帮助，尤其在识别错误思路和引导正确解题路径方面表现良好。前置人工验证机制有效保障了反馈的可靠性，同时实现了低延迟的交互体验。研究还发现该模式具有跨学科可迁移性，适用于其他工程类课程。
AI.conclusion: 通过将人工审核前置，该GenAI平台成功平衡了反馈的即时性与可信度，解决了大规模教学中反馈延迟与质量保障的矛盾。该模式不仅提升了学生的学习体验，也为工程教育中智能化辅助工具的设计提供了可行范式，具备在更多工程学科中推广应用的潜力。

title: Which LLM to pick? Online Active Model Selection for Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to process streaming data, with practitioners relying on benchmarks to select the best model even though these signals only approximate real performance. While oracle annotations can provide reliable feedback, they are often costly and difficult to obtain at scale. To address this challenge, we propose ONLINE LLM PICKER, the first framework for active model selection for LLMs in online settings. Given an arbitrary stream of queries and a limited annotation budget, ONLINE LLM PICKER selects the most informative prompts for annotation to identify the best LLM among candidate models. Across multiple tasks including 10 datasets, for over 130 language models, we show that ONLINE LLM PICKER saves annotation cost by up to 71.67% while reliably identifying the best or near-best model for the stream. We also show that using the returned model for sequential generation on unannotated prompts across the stream reduces regret by up to a factor of 2.51x, indicating that ONLINE LLM PICKER can identify the best or near-best model well before processing all streaming prompts.

AI.tldr: 提出 ONLINE LLM PICKER 框架，通过主动选择最具信息量的提示进行标注，在有限标注预算下高效识别最佳或近似最佳的 LLM，显著降低标注成本（最高节省 71.67%），同时在未标注数据上减少高达 2.51 倍的后悔值，证明其能提前精准选型。
AI.motivation: 现有基准评估无法准确反映大语言模型在流式数据上的真实性能，而人工标注成本高、难以规模化，亟需一种高效且可靠的在线模型选择方法。
AI.method: 设计主动学习框架 ONLINE LLM PICKER，基于流式查询动态选择最具有判别力的提示进行标注，利用少量高质量标注反馈持续优化模型选择决策。
AI.result: 在超过 130 个语言模型和 10 个数据集上验证，该方法可节省高达 71.67% 的标注成本，并在未标注流上将生成后悔值降低最多 2.51 倍，表明其能快速准确选出最优模型。
AI.conclusion: ONLINE LLM PICKER 是首个面向在线场景的主动模型选择框架，能够在极低标注开销下可靠地识别出最适合流式任务的最佳模型，显著提升 LLM 在实际应用中的部署效率与性能表现。

title: Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking
summary: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. Once these regions become well aligned, training hyperparameters alone cannot produce grokking and the observed dynamics collapse to either trainable or non-trainable behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过模式连通性和低损失区域几何分析框架，揭示了grokking现象的机制。研究表明，在对称性保持的训练/验证划分下，标准模算术设置可能不产生grokking，反而出现性能无法恢复的反向grokking现象，挑战了现有相关解释。结果表明，grokking源于训练与验证分区诱导的低损失区域错位；当这些区域对齐后，仅靠训练超参数无法再引发grokking，模型行为退化为可训练或不可训练两种状态。
AI.motivation: 理解grokking现象背后的机制，特别是其在小算法任务中延迟出现泛化能力的原因，已有解释多基于相关性，缺乏理论基础。
AI.method: 提出基于模式连通性和低损失区域几何的分析框架，通过控制训练/验证数据划分的对称性，系统测试grokking是否持续出现。
AI.result: 在对称性保持的数据划分下观察到反向grokking，即验证性能无法恢复，说明原始设定并非总能产生grokking；低损失区域的错位是导致grokking的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: grokking并非普遍现象，而是由训练与验证低损失区域的不对齐所引发；一旦区域对齐，模型行为趋于稳定，无法通过调整超参数再现grokking。

title: When the Judge Acts: Auditing VLM-Guided Image Selection on Culturally Situated Prompts
comment: 25 pages including appendix. Code and project page: https://github.com/seochan99/JudgeActs ; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/seochan99/JudgeActs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly act as judges that pick the best of several generated images, so their choices decide what users see. Such judges are usually validated by score agreement with human ratings, not by the images they return. We audit VLM judges as decision-makers: on 300 culturally situated prompts, we compare the returned image with human ratings the judge never sees and with random choice from the same candidates, and repeat every decision with the candidates reordered. A 4B-parameter judge barely beats random and falls short of a CLIP similarity baseline. It picks the first image shown in 49% of calls (chance: 28%), and reordering changes its choice on 60% of prompts. For this judge, agreement across orders is informative: decisions that survive reordering are much better than random, whereas agreement with a weaker second judge keeps the wrong ones. An 8B judge shows almost no position bias and outperforms CLIP, yet for it the same filter mostly discards good decisions. Agreement helps only when it targets the judge's failure mode, so filters must be re-audited whenever the judge changes. The 4B judge's slight rise in stereotype ratings is no longer detectable after aggregating across orders or with the larger judge.

AI.tldr: 本研究审计了视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为图像选择裁判的决策能力，发现小型4B参数模型表现仅略优于随机，且存在显著位置偏好；而8B模型虽表现更好但其判断一致性过滤器效果有限。研究强调，评估标准需针对具体模型的失败模式定制，且随模型更新需重新验证评估方法。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉-语言模型被用作图像生成质量的评判者，但其有效性常基于与人类评分的一致性，而非实际返回图像的质量。本研究旨在深入评估这些模型作为决策者的可靠性，尤其关注其在文化语境提示下的稳定性和公平性。
AI.method: 在300个文化相关提示下，比较VLM裁判选出的图像与人类评分及随机选择的结果，并通过重排候选图像来测试其决策稳定性。分析不同参数规模模型（4B和8B）的表现，评估位置偏差、决策一致性及其与基线（如CLIP相似度）的对比。
AI.result: 4B模型几乎无法超越随机选择，选择首幅图像比例达49%（远高于随机的28%），重排后60%的决策发生变化；8B模型位置偏差小，性能优于CLIP，但一致性筛选策略会误删优质决策。一致性对判断有效仅当其匹配模型的特定错误模式。
AI.conclusion: VLM作为裁判的可靠性依赖于其决策稳定性与评估方法的适配性。评估滤波器必须随模型变化重新验证，否则可能误导结果。仅凭评分一致性不足以证明模型输出质量，需结合多轮重排等审计手段。

title: SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. After each acquisition, the evidence and ordinal belief are updated before the next decision. On ADNI, SCOPE-AD achieves 77.70\% Macro-F1 at an average acquisition cost of \$50.46, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.34 percentage points. Full-modality evaluation raises Macro-F1 by only 1.89 points while increasing acquisition cost by 116.7 times. These results support selective acquisition for cost-effective diagnosis.

AI.tldr: SCOPE-AD 是一种成本感知的序数信念规划方法，用于阿尔茨海默病（AD）的诊断。它通过序数信念模型和能量基教师网络，实现对认知正常（CN）、轻度认知障碍（MCI）和阿尔茨海默病（AD）的分类。该方法在测试成本和患者负担约束下，动态决定何时获取新测试或做出诊断决策。在ADNI数据集上，其平均测试成本仅为50.46美元，宏平均F1达到77.70%，比最强基线提升9.34个百分点。全模态评估仅带来1.89%的性能提升，但成本飙升116.7倍，证明了选择性测试的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有固定模态的诊断模型无法在测试成本和患者负担背景下，动态决定测试顺序或诊断时机，导致资源浪费与效率低下。需要一种能联合优化测试选择与诊断决策的智能系统，以实现成本高效的精准诊断。
AI.method: 提出基于能量基模型的序数信念规划框架（SCOPE-AD），采用掩码感知的序数模型表示从CN到AD的连续不确定性；利用回顾性训练数据生成贝尔曼目标，训练能量基教师模型，并将教师的动作分布蒸馏至Qwen策略模型；部署时，代理根据可用性和预算约束，选择测试或诊断动作，更新证据与信念后进行下一决策。
AI.result: 在ADNI数据集上，SCOPE-AD实现了77.70%的宏平均F1，平均测试成本为50.46美元，显著优于基线（提升9.34个百分点）。全模态评估虽使F1提升1.89个百分点，但成本增加116.7倍，验证了选择性测试的高性价比优势。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE-AD 通过成本感知的序数信念规划，实现了高效、低成本且准确的阿尔茨海默病诊断，支持在实际临床中采用选择性测试策略以优化资源利用。

title: Can LLMs Reliably Annotate Bioassay Metadata to Improve Data Readiness?
comment: Accepted to the AIDaR workshop at NeurIPS
summary: The emergence of foundation models for molecular property prediction requires a high degree of AI data readiness, including reliable metadata annotation. However, both public repositories and industrial screening databases suffer from missing, inconsistent, or conflated assay annotations. In this work, we quantify the extent of missing annotations in PubChem for the BioAssay Ontology (BAO) assay format and physical detection method fields and investigate whether open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs) can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from the assay text. In our assessment, we found that the annotation coverage across PubChem's $\sim$2 million bioassays is critically sparse, 36\% lacking an assay format, 89\% a BioAssay type, and >99.9\% any BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology term. This motivates the need for automated test-metadata curation. Using evaluation sets derived from PubChem and ChEMBL, we assess the agreement of seven open-source and proprietary LLMs with existing silver labels. Recall is at least 0.96 for biochemical and cell-based assay formats, with a similar pattern for detection technology, although disagreements increase on under-represented classes. Manual inspection shows that many of these disagreements trace back to inconsistencies between silver sources rather than to LLM error. Moreover, in a qualitative study with a senior industrial curator, LLM-generated evidence prompted the expert to revise some of their own labels, showing LLMs can flag potentially mislabeled assays. Across the study, performance differences between proprietary and open-source models were small. Together, these results suggest LLMs can support the large-scale annotation and auditing of assay metadata, though per-class reliability estimates and targeted human review remain necessary before such labels enter downstream ML pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了PubChem中分子生物活性检测数据的元数据标注缺失情况，发现其在实验格式、检测方法等关键字段上标注覆盖率极低（如超过99.9%无BAO映射项）。研究进一步测试了开源与专有大语言模型（LLM）在从文本中自动预测和审计元数据方面的表现，结果显示模型在主流类别上召回率超过0.96，且与人工标注高度一致；部分差异源于标注源本身不一致而非模型错误。专家验证表明LLM能有效提示潜在标注错误。总体而言，LLM可支持大规模元数据标注与审核，但需结合类别的可靠性评估和人工复核以确保质量。
AI.motivation: 公共数据库和工业筛选库中的生物活性实验元数据普遍存在缺失、不一致或混淆问题，严重影响基础模型在分子性质预测中的应用。亟需自动化手段提升数据标注质量，为AI驱动的药物发现提供可靠数据基础。
AI.method: 通过分析PubChem和ChEMBL数据集，量化元数据缺失程度；利用七种开源及专有大语言模型对实验文本进行元数据预测，并与已有的高质量标签（silver labels）进行对比评估；结合人工检查与资深行业专家的定性反馈，验证模型输出的有效性与实用性。
AI.result: PubChem中约36%的生物活性实验缺少实验格式标注，89%缺乏生物活性类型标注，超过99.9%无标准BAO术语映射；模型在主流类别上召回率不低于0.96，性能在开源与专有模型间差异较小；多数不一致源于标注源矛盾，而非模型错误；专家使用模型生成证据后主动修正原有标签，证明其具备实际辅助价值。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型可有效支持大规模分子实验元数据的自动标注与审核，显著缓解数据标注稀疏问题。尽管模型整体表现良好，但需结合每类别的可靠性评估和有针对性的人工审查，方可将生成标签用于下游机器学习流程。

title: Learning Linear Systems under Heavy-Tailed Noise: A Non-Asymptotic Analysis from A Single Trajectory
summary: We establish non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for the least-squares estimation of vector autoregressive models for exponentially stable systems with heavy-tailed noise based on a single observed trajectory. By assuming i.i.d. noise, bounded noise covariance, and persistent excitation, we show that the estimation error is $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$ under bounded $p$th moment for $p > 2$, where $T$ is the number of samples, $r$ is the noise dimension, and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$ hides logarithmic terms. We also introduce a unifying approach to sample complexity analysis applicable to broad classes of noise distributions and showcase this by deriving error bounds for sub-exponential and sub-Gaussian noise distributions. Finally, we specialize our analysis to autoregressive models with exogenous inputs and show that the dimension factor of the error bound is independent of the model order.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了在单个观测轨迹下，针对具有重尾噪声的指数稳定向量自回归模型的非渐近样本复杂度边界。在假设独立同分布噪声、有界噪声协方差和持续激励的前提下，证明了估计误差为 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$，其中 $T$ 为样本数，$r$ 为噪声维度，$p > 2$ 且存在有界 $p$ 阶矩。文章提出一种统一的分析方法，适用于广泛的噪声分布，并推导出对亚指数和亚高斯噪声的误差界。此外，将分析结果应用于带外生输入的自回归模型，发现误差界中的维度因子与模型阶数无关。
AI.motivation: 研究向量自回归模型在重尾噪声下的估计性能，特别是在实际应用中常见但理论分析较弱的非高斯、厚尾噪声情形。目标是提供在有限样本下（非渐近）的可靠误差界，以支持更稳健的系统建模与控制设计。
AI.method: 基于独立同分布、有界噪声协方差和持续激励假设，采用概率不等式与矩阵分析技术，结合重尾分布的性质，推导出非渐近估计误差上界。引入统一分析框架，通过调整分布假设来扩展至子指数和子高斯噪声。对于外生输入情形，利用结构特性降低维度依赖性。
AI.result: 在 $p > 2$ 且存在有界 $p$ 阶矩条件下，估计误差为 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$；对子指数和子高斯噪声也获得相应误差界；在带外生输入的模型中，维度因子不再依赖于模型阶数。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的非渐近分析框架有效刻画了重尾噪声下向量自回归模型的估计性能，提供了适用于多种噪声分布的统一工具，并揭示了外生输入模型中维度因子的独立性，增强了模型在实际场景中的适用性与可解释性。

title: PickMoment: Continuous-Time Single-Image-to-Video via Learning Deblurring and Blur-to-Video
summary: Motion blur arises from the temporal integration of a continuous sharp signal over a finite exposure window, yet existing learning-based methods sidestep this physical model and predict only the sharp signal itself: most single-image deblurring methods recover a single frame at the exposure center, while blur-to-video methods predict a fixed set of frames. We introduce PickMoment, a continuous-time reformulation that directly learns the interval-mean blur over arbitrary sub-intervals of the exposure with a single deterministic model. Drawing an analogy to MeanFlow's average-velocity formulation, we train the model with three supervisions derived from the blur integral: an empirical reconstruction loss from available subframes, an additivity loss that enforces self-consistency across overlapping sub-intervals, and a sharp-frame loss anchored at the zero-interval limit. A single trained model unifies single-image deblurring, blur-to-video generation, and continuous-time pick-a-moment recovery as different queries to the same network, with no separate training for each task. Our PickMoment achieves state-of-the-art performance among generative-based deblurring methods on GoPro and HIDE while competitive against restoration-based methods on RealBlur, and the highest per-frame fidelity on GoPro-7 blur-to-video, all in a single forward pass without iterative sampling.

AI.tldr: PickMoment提出一种连续时间重构方法，直接学习任意曝光子区间内的平均模糊，通过三种监督信号（重建损失、可加性损失、清晰帧损失）训练单一确定性模型，统一实现单图去模糊、模糊到视频生成和任意时刻恢复，无需额外训练，性能优于现有生成式方法且在单次前向传播中完成。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的去模糊方法忽视物理上的时间积分过程，仅预测中心帧或固定帧序列，无法灵活处理任意时间点的去模糊需求。
AI.method: 提出连续时间建模框架PickMoment，通过均值流类比，利用子帧重建、重叠区间自一致性与零区间极限清晰帧三重监督，训练一个能支持多任务查询的统一模型。
AI.result: 在GoPro、HIDE数据集上达到生成式去模糊的最先进水平，在RealBlur上与恢复式方法竞争，且在GoPro-7模糊到视频任务中保持最高帧保真度，所有任务仅需一次前向传播完成。
AI.conclusion: PickMoment通过物理驱动的连续时间建模，实现了统一、高效、高保真的去模糊系统，为图像运动模糊处理提供了新范式。

title: Trustworthy Data- and ML-Ops for Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics
comment: Paper accepted at accepted at IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems. DOI: 10.1109/TITS.2026.3711756
summary: The rapid evolution of Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics (ITS\&L) has become a cornerstone of the modern social economy, relying heavily on the integration of Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and, more specifically, Machine Learning (ML). This paper provides a comprehensive review of Trustworthy Data and Machine Learning Operations (DataOps and MLOps) in the ITS\&L domain, underscoring their importance in improving efficiency, reliability, and decision-making precision within transportation and logistics services. We begin by identifying gaps in current literature, offering clear context for our contribution. Subsequently, we explore the complexities of DataOps and MLOps, discussing their necessity, key components, available tools, practical insights, and case studies relevant to ITS\&L. Additionally, we address the critical issue of Trustworthiness in AI applications, examining methods and tools designed to strengthen confidence in AI systems - especially in real-world ITS\&L scenarios. The paper concludes with a discussion of persisting challenges and future prospects in this rapidly advancing field, aiming to serve as a vital resource for researchers, industry practitioners, and policy makers. Overall, this work not only establishes a foundational understanding of DataOps and MLOps in ITS\&L but also charts a path for further research and innovation in developing more efficient, sustainable, and trustworthy intelligent transportation and logistics systems.

AI.tldr: 本文全面回顾了智能交通与物流（ITS&L）领域中可信数据与机器学习运维（DataOps与MLOps）的应用，强调其在提升运输与物流服务效率、可靠性和决策精度方面的重要性。文章分析了现有文献的不足，探讨了DataOps与MLOps的复杂性、必要性、核心组件、可用工具及实际案例，并重点讨论了人工智能可信性的方法与工具，以增强在真实场景中的系统信任度。最后，文章展望了该领域面临的挑战与未来发展方向，旨在为研究者、行业从业者和政策制定者提供参考。
AI.motivation: 当前智能交通与物流系统高度依赖数据、人工智能与机器学习技术，但缺乏对DataOps与MLOps在该领域的系统性梳理，且AI系统的可信性问题亟待解决，因此有必要开展全面综述以推动技术发展与应用落地。
AI.method: 通过文献综述法，系统分析现有研究在DataOps与MLOps于ITS&L中的应用现状，结合关键组件、工具、实践案例及可信性保障机制进行归纳与总结，并提出未来研究方向。
AI.result: 揭示了DataOps与MLOps在提升ITS&L系统效率与可靠性方面的关键作用，明确了可信AI在实际部署中的实现路径，并提供了可借鉴的实践框架与工具推荐。
AI.conclusion: 本文为智能交通与物流领域的数据与机器学习运维提供了坚实基础，指明了未来在可持续、高效、可信智能系统构建方面的研究与创新方向。

title: What Makes Something Hard(er)? Explaining Question Difficulty in Natural Language
summary: Difficulty is one of the most fundamental properties of a question: it determines whether the question can meaningfully discriminate between models of differing ability. Although a variety of methods can now estimate or predict difficulty automatically, they yield only a single descriptive number, with no account of the underlying factors that make a question difficult in the first place. In this work, we propose a data-driven approach that automatically generates and validates natural-language hypotheses explaining what makes one question harder than another. We first estimate each item's difficulty from the responses of a large pool of LLMs using Item Response Theory. We then sample contrasting sets of easy and hard questions and prompt an LLM to propose candidate explanations of the difference, which are subsequently validated and selected on held-out questions. Experimental results across three datasets spanning mathematical, logical, and commonsense reasoning show that our method produces interpretable and predictive hypotheses. On their own, they predict the difficulty of unseen questions competitively with, or better than, advanced black-box difficulty regressors; used as additional features, they further improve those regressors, implying that they discover difficulty signals that existing models fail to capture. Moreover, we demonstrate that editing questions according to a hypothesis can shift their measured difficulty in the expected direction, indicating that the discovered hypotheses are causally valid difficulty factors rather than post-hoc descriptions. Our approach thus turns a purely descriptive difficulty score into actionable statements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动的方法，自动生成并验证解释问题难度差异的自然语言假设。通过大规模LLM响应使用项目反应理论估计题目难度，选取难易对比题组，用LLM生成候选解释，并在独立数据集上验证和筛选。实验表明，这些假设具有可解释性且能有效预测新题难度，甚至优于或媲美先进黑箱难度回归模型；作为额外特征加入后，还能提升现有模型性能。此外，根据假设修改题目可按预期改变其难度，证明所发现因素为因果有效的难度因子而非事后描述。该方法将单纯的描述性难度评分转化为可操作的洞察。
AI.motivation: 当前自动难度估计方法仅提供单一数值描述，缺乏对导致题目难度背后因素的解释。需要一种能够揭示‘为何某题更难’的可解释性机制，以推动对认知能力与题目设计的理解。
AI.method: 1. 使用大规模LLM响应数据，基于项目反应理论（IRT）估算每道题的难度；2. 选取难易对比的题目子集；3. 利用大模型生成关于难易差异的候选解释；4. 在独立测试集上验证并筛选出最有效解释；5. 验证解释的可迁移性和因果有效性（通过编辑题目观察难度变化）。
AI.result: 1. 所得解释具备高度可解释性，能准确预测未见题目的难度，表现不逊于甚至优于现有黑箱模型；2. 作为附加特征融入现有模型时，进一步提升其预测性能，说明发现了原有模型未捕捉到的新难度信号；3. 根据假设修改题目后，其难度确实向预期方向变化，证明这些解释是因果有效的难度因子。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功将抽象的难度评分转化为可操作、可解释的自然语言假设，不仅提升了难度预测能力，还揭示了影响难度的本质因素，为教育评估、智能题库构建及认知建模提供了新范式。

title: Group-Invariant Statistics Determine Embedding Geometry: Harmonic Analysis of Representations from Bach to the Night Sky
summary: The representations that language models learn for concepts such as months, weekdays, and places display consistent geometric structure: circles and saddle-shaped "Pringle" manifolds. Recent work traced these structures to $\textit{translation symmetry}$ in word co-occurrence statistics, deriving the observed Fourier geometry when co-occurrence depends only on distance on an abelian lattice of concepts. We demonstrate that more general notions of symmetry lead to equally structured predictions. Considering symmetries defined by arbitrary finite groups, compact groups, and homogeneous spaces, we prove that whenever the co-occurrence statistics of a word family are invariant under a group $G$, the learned word embeddings consist of matrix elements of the irreducible representations (irreps) of $G$. Circles and Pringles arise when $G$ is cyclic, in which case the irreps are Fourier modes. We verify the irrep structure in three experimental settings. (i) The cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$: for the months of the year we recover the known circular geometry. (ii) A dihedral group acting on the major and minor triads: we unify two classical observations -- that transposition and chord inversion form a group ($T/I$) acting on chords (music theory), which $\textit{implies}$ that the well-known "circle of fifths" emerges in learned chord embeddings (machine learning). (iii) We explain and reproduce a recently discovered spherical representation of celestial objects in large language models (LLMs) as a spherical-harmonic embedding derived from our theory. Our results demonstrate that the geometry of learned representations is often a consequence of the statistical symmetry of underlying data.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言模型中概念（如月份、星期几、地点）的表示所呈现的几何结构，发现其与词共现统计中的对称性密切相关。通过引入更一般的对称性概念（如有限群、紧致群和齐性空间），证明当词族的共现统计在某个群 $G$ 下不变时，学习到的词嵌入即为 $G$ 的不可约表示（irreps）的矩阵元。圆形和“普林格”鞍形结构源于循环群 $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$ 时的傅里叶模式。实验验证了三种情形：(i) 年月的 $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$ 循环群对应圆形结构；(ii) 音乐理论中的转位与倒置群 $T/I$ 作用于三和弦，解释了“五度圈”的出现；(iii) 解释并复现了大语言模型中天体对象的球面表示，其来源于球谐函数嵌入。结论是：学习表示的几何结构往往源自数据的统计对称性。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型中概念表示为何呈现出特定的几何结构，如圆形或鞍形，特别是这些结构是否可由数据的统计特性解释。以往研究指出这些结构源于词共现中的平移对称性，但该研究旨在扩展这一观点，探索更广泛对称性下的统一解释框架。
AI.method: 基于群论，将词共现统计的对称性建模为群 $G$ 的作用，利用表示论推导出当共现统计在 $G$ 下不变时，嵌入向量应为 $G$ 的不可约表示的矩阵元。通过分析不同群（如循环群、二面体群、球面齐性空间）对应的表示形式，预测并验证了相应的几何结构。
AI.result: 在三个实验中成功验证了理论预测：(i) 年月的嵌入呈现圆形结构，符合 $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$ 不可约表示；(ii) 音乐和弦的嵌入自然产生“五度圈”，源于 $T/I$ 群的作用；(iii) 天体对象的球面表示可被解释为球谐函数嵌入，与理论一致。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型中学习到的表示几何结构并非偶然，而是底层数据统计对称性的直接结果。通过群论与表示论，可以统一解释多种复杂几何结构的形成机制，揭示了对称性在深度学习表示学习中的核心作用。

title: ShelfChange3D: Object-Level 3D Change Detection for Retail Shelf Monitoring
comment: Our code will be available on our project website at https://zerone0011.github.io/ShelfChange3D/
summary: Reliable shelf monitoring is an important capability for retail automation, yet existing out-of-stock detection methods mainly operate in image space and lack metric 3D localization for downstream robotic systems. We formulate shelf monitoring as object-level 3D change detection: given two RGB-D observations captured at different times, the goal is to identify changed products and localize each change with a 3D bounding box. To support this task, we introduce ShelfChange3D, comprising 145K synthetic and 5K real-world paired RGB-D observations with object-level 3D change annotations. We further propose ChangeBox, an end-to-end framework that jointly reasons over paired observations and predicts object-level 3D change boxes. To improve localization accuracy, we introduce a geometry-based refinement stage that exploits depth and gravity prior to estimate relative pose and refine predicted boxes.
