Experiments show that ChangeBox outperforms existing change detection baselines, with further gains from refinement and effective transfer from synthetic to real-world observations.

AI.tldr: 提出ChangeBox框架，用于基于RGB-D图像的货架3D变化检测，通过合成与真实数据结合提升性能，并引入几何优化提高定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有货架监控方法多在图像空间操作，缺乏对下游机器人系统有用的3D定位能力，因此需要一种能提供物体级3D变化检测的方法。
AI.method: 引入ShelfChange3D数据集（含14.5万合成和5千真实配对RGB-D观测），并设计端到端的ChangeBox框架，结合几何先验进行深度和重力引导的3D框精修。
AI.result: ChangeBox在变化检测任务中优于现有基线，几何精修进一步提升性能，且合成数据到真实场景的迁移效果良好。
AI.conclusion: 该工作实现了高精度的物体级3D变化检测，为零售自动化中的可靠货架监控提供了有效解决方案。

title: ITC-MoE: Importance-guided Token-aware Compression for MoE Diffusion Language Models
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible parallel decoding and increased model capacity, but their large number of expert parameters incurs substantial computation and storage costs. Existing low-rank MoE compression methods largely rely on static factorization and fixed rank allocation, which overlook the distinctive properties of MoE DLMs. Specifically, we identify two properties: cross-mode non-uniform redundancy, where parameter redundancy and sensitivity to rank truncation vary across the input, output, and expert modes, and token-wise utilization variation, where hot and cold tokens exhibit distinct spectral characteristics and expert activation patterns. To address these challenges, we propose ITC-MoE, an Importance-guided Token-aware Compression framework for MoE DLMs. ITC-MoE consists of two complementary components. First, Importance-guided Adaptive Tucker Compression (IATC) incorporates activation and gradient importance into expert weight transformation, jointly factorizes expert weights across multiple modes, and adaptively allocates ranks under a fixed parameter budget. Second, Token-aware Compensation and Routing (TCR) applies lightweight low-rank compensation to compression-sensitive hot tokens and restricts the candidate expert set for cold tokens with concentrated routing patterns. By jointly adapting compression capacity and inference execution to both parameter redundancy and token-wise variation, ITC-MoE substantially reduces the computation and storage costs of MoE DLMs while preserving their generation quality. For example, on SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32, ITC-MoE maintains an accuracy of 96.33% on MultiArith under a 30% compression budget, while achieving up to a 7.22x end-to-end speedup. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/ITC-MoE.

AI.tldr: 提出 ITC-MoE 框架，通过重要性引导的自适应 Tucker 压缩和令牌感知补偿与路由，解决 MoE 扩散语言模型中的参数冗余与令牌使用差异问题，在 30% 压缩预算下保持高生成质量并实现高达 7.22 倍的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩 MoE 压缩方法依赖静态分解和固定秩分配，忽视了 MoE DLMs 中输入、输出和专家模式间的非均匀冗余以及热/冷令牌在谱特性与专家激活上的差异，导致压缩效率与性能难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出 ITC-MoE 框架，包含两个组件：1）重要性引导的自适应 Tucker 压缩（IATC），融合激活与梯度重要性，多模式联合分解专家权重，并自适应分配秩；2）令牌感知补偿与路由（TCR），对敏感的热令牌施加轻量级低秩补偿，对路由集中冷令牌限制候选专家集。
AI.result: 在 SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32 上，于 30% 压缩预算下保持 96.33% 的 MultiArith 准确率，实现最高 7.22 倍的端到端速度提升，显著降低计算与存储开销。
AI.conclusion: ITC-MoE 通过联合适应压缩容量与推理执行，有效应对 MoE DLMs 中的参数冗余与令牌级变化，实现高效压缩与高质量生成，具有实际应用价值。

title: Yo-ByT5: Efficient and High-Fidelity Diacritic Restoration for Yorùbá
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and outputs: https://github.com/lazy-monster/yo-byt5
summary: Yorùbá is a widely spoken tonal language that depends on diacritics to avoid lexical ambiguity. However, it is often written without these diacritics, thereby hindering downstream Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. In this paper, we introduce Yo-ByT5, a byte-level Automatic Diacritic Restoration (ADR) model fine-tuned from ByT5-small. We evaluate Yo-ByT5 alongside five publicly released Yorùbá ADR models and one open-weight large language model (LLM) on the YAD benchmark under a consistent protocol. Our results demonstrate that Yo-ByT5 matches the performance of the strongest existing model, mT5-base, with a DER of 10.14% and a CER of 3.48%. Furthermore, it exhibits superior text fidelity despite using approximately half the parameter count of mT5-base. We also release our training code and model outputs, as well as call for the development of a larger, purpose-built benchmark for Yorùbá diacritic restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Yo-ByT5，一个基于ByT5-small微调的字节级自动变音符号恢复模型，用于解决约鲁巴语因缺少变音符号而导致的词汇歧义问题。在YAD基准上，该模型性能与最强现有模型mT5-base相当（DER 10.14%，CER 3.48%），且参数量仅为后者的约一半，文本保真度更优。研究还开源了代码和模型输出，并呼吁构建更大规模的专用基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 约鲁巴语是一种依赖变音符号避免词汇歧义的声调语言，但实际书写中常省略这些符号，严重影响下游自然语言处理任务。因此亟需高效准确的自动变音符号恢复技术。
AI.method: 基于ByT5-small构建字节级序列到序列模型，通过微调实现约鲁巴语自动变音符号恢复，并在统一评估协议下与多个现有模型对比性能。
AI.result: Yo-ByT5在YAD基准上达到DER 10.14%、CER 3.48%，性能媲美mT5-base，同时参数量更少、文本保真度更高。
AI.conclusion: Yo-ByT5在约鲁巴语变音符号恢复任务中表现优异，具备高效率与高保真优势，研究呼吁建立更大规模的专用基准以推动该领域发展。

title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
comment: 40 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.

AI.tldr: 提出StepRS-GRPO，一种在扩散语言模型中通过动态调整风险系数来改进强化学习的算法，显著提升数学推理任务中的准确率和覆盖率，同时增加答案多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在扩散语言模型中难以有效利用终端反馈，且缺乏对不同去噪状态的风险敏感性调节，导致性能受限。
AI.method: 提出stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO（StepRS-GRPO），在去噪过程中动态调整风险系数，基于提示和状态依赖的中心化优势重缩放，并通过能力校准与消融实验确定最优调度策略。
AI.result: 在多个扩散大语言模型和数学推理基准上，StepRS-GRPO优于中心化GRPO，在pass@1准确率、pass@k覆盖率和答案多样性方面均有提升；消融实验验证了状态分配和调度方向的有效性。
AI.conclusion: StepRS-GRPO通过风险敏感的动态调整机制，有效提升了扩散语言模型在复杂推理任务中的表现，其多样性增益不仅体现在最终答案，也反映在推理过程本身。

title: Dyna3: VLM-Guided Training-Free 4D Reconstruction via Depth Foundation Models
summary: Recent depth foundation models like Depth Anything 3 (DA3) achieve remarkable multi-view depth estimation but assume static 3D scenes, limiting their applicability to real-world dynamic environments. Existing training-free 4D methods like Easi3R and VGGT4D rely on correspondence-trained backbones whose attention encodes cross-frame matching, a property absent in depth-only models like DA3. We present Dyna3, a training-free framework that extends DA3 for 4D dynamic scene reconstruction without any fine-tuning. Our key insight is that DA3's cross-view features, though trained only for depth consistency, implicitly encode motion-discriminative signals when combined with best-match feature search across frames. Its static surfaces find consistent matches globally, while dynamic objects cannot. We further adopt vision-language models (VLM) to automatically generate scene-specific semantic prompts for SAM 3, enabling precise instance-level segmentation that distinguishes which objects move from what objects exist. For reconstruction, we decouple the scene into a cross-frame aligned static background and per-frame dynamic point clouds. Experiments on four datasets demonstrate that Dyna3 surpasses correspondence-trained methods with +5.5pp J-Mean over state-of-the-art VGGT4D on dynamic object segmentation, while achieving up to 13x faster pose estimation and 3x faster 4D reconstruction with 4 to 8x lower memory. Dyna3 could therefore enable much denser temporal sampling that prior methods cannot support.

AI.tldr: Dyna3 是一种无需训练的 4D 动态场景重建框架，扩展了深度基础模型 DA3 以支持动态环境。通过利用 DA3 的跨视图特征中的隐含运动判别信号，并结合最佳匹配特征搜索，实现静态背景与动态物体的分离。同时引入视觉-语言模型生成语义提示，提升实例级分割精度。实验表明，Dyna3 在动态物体分割上优于现有方法（+5.5pp J-Mean），且在姿态估计和 4D 重建速度上分别快 13 倍和 3 倍，内存消耗降低 4–8 倍，支持更密集的时间采样。
AI.motivation: 现有深度基础模型如 DA3 仅适用于静态场景，无法处理真实世界中的动态环境；而现有训练-free 4D 方法依赖对应关系训练的骨干网络，其注意力机制编码跨帧匹配信息，但深度仅模型缺乏此类特性，导致难以直接用于动态场景重建。因此需要一种无需微调、能有效区分静态与动态成分的方法。
AI.method: Dyna3 利用 DA3 的跨视图特征隐含的运动判别信号，通过最佳匹配特征搜索识别静态与动态区域；结合视觉-语言模型生成场景特定语义提示，驱动 SAM 3 实现精准实例分割；将场景解耦为跨帧对齐的静态背景与每帧独立的动态点云，完成 4D 重建。
AI.result: Dyna3 在四个数据集上表现优异，动态物体分割性能比当前最优方法 VGGT4D 提升 5.5 个百分点（J-Mean）；姿态估计速度提升 13 倍，4D 重建速度提升 3 倍，内存占用降低 4–8 倍，支持更高密度的时间采样。
AI.conclusion: Dyna3 成功将静态深度基础模型扩展至动态 4D 场景，无需任何微调即可实现高效、高精度的动态场景重建，在速度、效率与精度方面均显著优于现有方法，具备实际部署潜力。

title: Questionnaire-Guided Disaggregation of Energy Appliance Use for Domestic Smart Meter Data
summary: Ireland's smart metering programme records electricity use at 30-minute resolution, with smart meters installed in over 80\% of households as of late 2025. While this is useful for billing of smart, time-of-use tariffs, it is too coarse to capture use of domestic appliances. We present a label-free disaggregation system that breaks usage data into 9 appliance categories by combining event detection for high-power loads with questionnaire-guided estimation. Our evaluation draws on four datasets: a calibration household with a commercial comparator, two public benchmarks (UK-DALE and REFIT) with per-appliance sub-metering, and a smart meter dataset of more than 4,800 years of use from 2,968 Irish consumers. Compared against two independently developed disaggregation systems our hybrid method combining analysis of usage data with questionnaire results, achieves the lowest whole-decomposition error on all buildings across the datasets, with better month-level performance over 54 paired months ($p<0.001$, Holm-corrected). Our method provides useful advice on a household's energy consumption patterns and advice on how to reduce or shift usage on some appliances in order to reduce costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需标签的分解系统，通过结合高功率负载事件检测与问卷引导估计，将智能电表数据细分为9类家用电器。该方法在多个数据集上表现优于其他独立开发的分解系统，尤其在月度层面表现出显著更优的性能（p<0.001，Holm校正），并能为家庭提供节能和用电时间调整建议。
AI.motivation: 现有30分钟分辨率的智能电表数据不足以捕捉家用电器的具体使用情况，需要更精细的用电分解方法以支持节能和成本优化决策。
AI.method: 结合高功率负载事件检测与基于问卷的估计，实现无标签的电器使用分解，将用电数据划分为9个家电类别。
AI.result: 在四个数据集（包括爱尔兰超过4,800年的用户数据）上，该混合方法在所有建筑中均实现了最低的整体分解误差，且在54对月份中月度表现显著更优（p<0.001，Holm校正）。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的无标签分解方法有效提升了智能电表数据的利用价值，能够准确识别家庭用电模式，并为用户提供切实可行的节能建议。

title: Compound interpretation is based on analogy
summary: How compound meanings are best predicted from constituent meanings remains a central question in computational models of lexical semantics. Comparing different computational models provides a way to evaluate alternative accounts of how semantic information is combined during compound comprehension. We propose a new model, the Compound Analogy Model (CAM), that predicts a compound's embedding by adding its constituent embeddings together with the average shift vectors of the two constituents' compound families. The resulting model is parameter-free and exploits local analogical structure in the semantic space. We evaluated CAM against the CAOSS model on Mandarin Chinese compounds. CAM consistently achieved higher prediction accuracy than CAOSS on both training and held-out data, with the exception of three-character compounds, for which analogical generalization is constrained by both small constituent families and a pronounced imbalance in family size between the two constituents. The advantage of CAM remained when evaluation was based on frequency-defined train-test splits that better approximate generalization from familiar to novel compounds. To assess the cognitive plausibility of the two models, we further examined whether model-derived semantic measures predict visual lexical decision latencies for two-character compounds. Predictors derived from CAM provided improved prediction for response latencies compared to predictors derived from the CAOSS model. These findings indicate that compound meaning is better characterized as local analogical generalization than as the application of a learned global linear transformation, and demonstrate that analogical semantic structure provides a cognitively plausible basis for compound comprehension.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的无参数模型——复合类比模型（CAM），通过将构成成分的嵌入向量相加，并加上两个成分在复合词家族中的平均偏移向量，来预测复合词的语义。在汉语复合词上的实验表明，CAM在训练和未见数据上均优于CAOSS模型，仅在三字复合词上表现稍差，原因在于组成成分家族规模小且大小不平衡。此外，基于频率划分的数据集验证也显示了CAM的优势。认知层面的分析发现，由CAM推导出的语义指标能更准确地预测视觉词汇决策反应时间，表明复合词意义更适合作为局部类比泛化而非全局线性变换来理解。
AI.motivation: 探索如何从构成成分的意义最好地预测复合词的整体意义，评估不同计算模型对语义组合机制的解释能力。传统模型如CAOSS依赖于全局线性变换，但其在处理局部语义结构方面可能存在局限。本文旨在提出一种更具认知合理性的替代方案，利用局部类比结构提升预测性能。
AI.method: 提出复合类比模型（CAM），该模型结合成分嵌入向量与它们在复合词家族中的平均偏移向量进行加权求和，实现无参数的语义预测。模型不依赖预设参数，而是利用语义空间中的局部类比关系进行泛化。在中文双字复合词上与CAOSS模型对比，使用多种评估策略（包括频率划分的训练-测试分割）验证模型性能，并进一步考察模型输出与人类反应时的相关性。
AI.result: CAM在大多数情况下显著优于CAOSS模型，尤其在训练数据和未见数据上保持更高预测准确率；在三字复合词上略有下降，归因于小家族规模和家族大小失衡。认知实验证明，由CAM生成的语义特征能更好预测视觉词汇决策反应时间，说明其具有更强的认知合理性。
AI.conclusion: 复合词意义更宜被理解为局部类比泛化，而非全局线性变换的结果。类比性的语义结构提供了一个既高效又符合人类认知过程的复合词理解机制。

title: Analysis of Quantized and Efficiently Adapted Protein Language Models
summary: Background: Protein language models (PLMs) are increasingly used for sequence generation and property prediction, but their size makes fine-tuning and deployment expensive. The effects of quantization and parameter efficient fine-tuning on performance, representations and generation remain insufficiently characterized. Results: We evaluated 4-bit quantization and low-rank adapter fine-tuning (QLoRA) across ESM-2, ESMC, ProtBERT, ProtT5, Ankh, Ankh3 and Profluent-E1. Across protein prediction tasks, many model-task pairs retained more than 90% of full fine-tuning performance. Peak GPU memory savings approached 90% for the largest models, although performance and efficiency varied by model, dataset and training configuration. QLoRA often preserved early-layer representations while inducing task-specific adaptations in middle and late layers, resembling full fine-tuning with smaller representational changes. Training speed and power effects were more varied. For unconditional generation with ProLLaMA, ProtGPT2, ProGen2, ProteinGLM and ESM3, 4-bit quantization largely preserved predicted structural and sequence-level properties, but token-level analysis revealed model-dependent shifts in autoregressive output distributions. Conclusion: QLoRA and 4-bit quantization reduce PLM computational requirements, particularly GPU memory usage. Our results support QLoRA as a first-pass strategy for memory limited adaptation, reserving full fine-tuning for challenging tasks, unstable architectures or low validation recovery. For generative PLMs, sequence-level and structural metrics should be complemented with distributional analysis, since downstream predictions alone may miss quantization-induced shifts. These approaches can broaden access to large-scale protein modelling while requiring model- and task-specific validation.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了4比特量化和低秩适配器微调（QLoRA）在多种蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）上的表现，发现多数模型在预测任务中保留超过90%的全量微调性能，最大模型的GPU内存节省接近90%。QLoRA能较好保持早期层表示，同时在中后层引入任务特异性调整，类似全量微调但表示变化更小。生成任务中，4比特量化基本保留结构与序列级属性，但存在模型相关的自回归输出分布偏移。建议将QLoRA作为内存受限场景下的首选策略，生成模型需结合分布分析以识别量化带来的潜在偏差。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质语言模型虽广泛用于序列生成与性质预测，但其庞大参数量导致微调与部署成本高昂。现有对量化与参数高效微调技术在性能、表征与生成方面的系统性影响缺乏充分理解，亟需评估其有效性与适用边界。
AI.method: 对ESM-2、ESMC、ProtBERT、ProtT5、Ankh、Ankh3和Profluent-E1等7个蛋白质语言模型，采用4比特量化与低秩适配器微调（QLoRA）进行实验，覆盖多个蛋白预测任务及无条件生成任务（如ProLLaMA、ProtGPT2、ProGen2、ProteinGLM、ESM3）。通过对比全量微调与量化/适配器方法在性能、内存占用、训练效率、表征变化及生成质量上的差异，系统评估技术效果。
AI.result: 在多数蛋白预测任务中，模型-任务组合在使用4比特量化和QLoRA后仍保持超过90%的全量微调性能；最大模型的峰值GPU内存节省可达约90%。不同模型、数据集和训练配置下性能与效率差异显著。QLoRA在保持早期层表示的同时，在中后层引入任务特定调整，表征变化较小，行为类似全量微调。生成任务中，4比特量化总体保留了序列与结构层面的预测特性，但在令牌级别揭示出模型依赖性的输出分布偏移。训练速度与能耗变化较不一致。
AI.conclusion: QLoRA与4比特量化可显著降低蛋白质语言模型的计算开销，尤其在减少GPU内存占用方面效果突出。建议将QLoRA作为内存受限环境下的首选微调策略，仅在挑战性任务、不稳定架构或验证恢复率较低时考虑全量微调。对于生成类模型，应结合序列级、结构级指标与分布分析，以全面评估量化影响。这些方法有助于扩大大规模蛋白质建模的可及性，但需根据具体模型与任务进行验证。

title: ODDR: One-Step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward Guidance
summary: Recent advances in deep learning for shadow removal have significantly enhanced image quality and realism. However, most approaches rely on real-world paired datasets, which are costly to collect and often limited in scene diversity, leading to limited generalization. To address these limitations, we propose One-step Deshadow Diffusion via Reward guidance (ODDR), a new framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity shadow removal without relying on real-world paired supervision. Our method begins with One-step Deshadow Diffusion (ODD), a baseline model trained on synthetic shadow data for efficient one-step shadow-free reconstruction. We further adapt ODD into ODDR using ShadowReward. In contrast to traditional, annotation-heavy approaches, ShadowReward is the first reward model for shadow removal trained entirely without human annotation. It learns to mimic human perceptual judgments by ranking synthetically generated images with controlled degradations, such as texture distortion and boundary artifacts. This reward-guided fine-tuning enables ODDR to close the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Extensive experiments show that ODD achieves strong performance without relying on real-world paired supervision, and ODDR further improves the results, narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods trained on real-world paired data while maintaining higher computational efficiency as a single-step model.

AI.tldr: 提出ODDR框架，通过无监督奖励机制实现高效高保真去阴影，无需真实配对数据，显著提升泛化能力与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习去阴影方法依赖昂贵且多样性的真实配对数据集，导致泛化能力受限，亟需减少对真实标注数据的依赖。
AI.method: 提出One-step Deshadow Diffusion (ODD)模型，基于合成数据进行单步去阴影重建，并引入无注释的ShadowReward奖励模型，通过感知排序优化合成图像质量，实现奖励引导的微调以缩小合成到真实域差距。
AI.result: ODD在无真实配对数据下表现优异，ODDR进一步逼近全监督方法性能，同时保持单步推理的高效率，有效缓解域偏移问题。
AI.conclusion: ODDR通过无注释奖励机制成功实现高效、高质量的去阴影，为减少对真实标注数据依赖提供了新范式，具备强泛化性和实用性。

title: DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. An earlier version was accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026. Evaluation harness: https://github.com/surge-ai/dayjob
summary: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all healthcare tasks, 50 of the 80 finance tasks, the evaluation harness, and the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: DAYJOB is a benchmark of 130 professional tasks in healthcare (50) and finance (80), each requiring ~13.6–16.6 hours to complete. Tasks are evaluated via a containerized Harbor environment with expert rubrics of binary criteria (median 47.5–57.5 per task). Only full compliance passes. The best model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves 24.7% (healthcare) and 23.9% (finance) success rates; median models score only 0.6% and 2.5%. Agents often accept flawed premises and propagate errors. All healthcare tasks, 50 finance tasks, evaluation tools, and leaderboard are released.
AI.motivation: To evaluate the ability of AI agents to handle real-world professional tasks that require reasoning, document analysis, and judgment under ambiguous or incomplete initial requests—tasks where professionals must determine relevance, validate premises, and synthesize information across documents.
AI.method: Constructed 130 tasks from real professional workflows in healthcare and finance. Each task is encapsulated in a containerized Harbor environment with an expert-defined rubric of binary pass/fail criteria. An agentic judge evaluates outputs against all criteria. Multiple model configurations were tested across 13 developers.
AI.result: Claude Opus 5.5 achieved 24.7% success in healthcare and 23.9% in finance; median performance was 0.6% and 2.5%, respectively. Case studies revealed agents frequently accepted contradictory premises and carried incorrect inputs through consistent but flawed analyses.
AI.conclusion: Current AI agents struggle significantly with complex, real-world professional tasks that demand careful premise validation and cross-document reasoning. Benchmarking frameworks like DAYJOB are essential for measuring progress toward robust, trustworthy agent performance.

title: Acmite: Mitigating Gender Bias in LLMs through Concept-Guided Mutual Information
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce social stereotypes from their training data, motivating extensive research on model debiasing. However, existing methods often rely on explicit biased examples or predefined group-term substitutions, making them sensitive to wording and less effective at capturing stereotype concepts shared across diverse contexts. More importantly, they typically suppress biased outputs without explicitly modeling the statistical dependence between model outputs and the underlying stereotype concepts. We propose Acmite, a lightweight concept-guided framework for targeted and selective debiasing. Acmite represents stereotypes as structured semantic concepts and uses maximal marginal relevance (MMR) to select diverse concepts for debiasing. Inspired by mutual information minimization, it approximates this dependence with token-level KL divergence while preserving task semantics. A lightweight LoRA adapter is trained with the base model frozen and activated at inference time only when the input is sufficiently similar to stereotype-related concepts; otherwise, the original model is used directly. We evaluate Acmite on BBQ, CrowS-Pairs, and StereoSet, and assess general capability preservation on ARC-Challenge, GSM8K, and PIQA. Experiments across three LLMs show that Acmite effectively mitigates gender bias across complementary evaluation formats while maintaining competitive performance on bias-unrelated tasks. Anonymous code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Acmite-18E2/.

AI.tldr: Acmite 是一种轻量级的概念引导框架，用于目标化和选择性去偏。它将刻板印象表示为结构化的语义概念，并使用最大边际相关性（MMR）选择多样化的概念进行去偏。通过令牌级别的KL散度近似最小化互信息，以减少模型输出与刻板印象概念之间的统计依赖性，同时保持任务语义。采用轻量级LoRA适配器，在输入与刻板印象概念足够相似时激活，否则直接使用原始模型。在BBQ、CrowS-Pairs和StereoSet上评估，证明其有效缓解性别偏见，同时在ARC-Challenge、GSM8K和PIQA等任务上保持良好性能。
AI.motivation: 现有去偏方法依赖显式偏见示例或预定义的组-术语替换，对措辞敏感且难以捕捉跨不同上下文共享的刻板印象概念；此外，这些方法通常仅抑制偏见输出，未显式建模输出与刻板印象概念间的统计依赖关系。
AI.method: Acmite 将刻板印象表示为结构化语义概念，利用最大边际相关性（MMR）选取多样化概念进行去偏；通过令牌级别KL散度近似最小化互信息，以削弱模型输出与刻板印象概念间的依赖关系，同时保留任务语义；采用轻量级LoRA适配器，冻结基础模型，在推理时仅当输入与刻板印象概念高度相似时才激活。
AI.result: 在三个大型语言模型上测试，Acmite 在 BBQ、CrowS-Pairs 和 StereoSet 上均有效减轻了性别偏见，且在 ARC-Challenge、GSM8K 和 PIQA 等非偏见相关任务中表现出良好的通用能力保持性，性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Acmite 作为一种轻量级、概念导向的去偏框架，能够精准识别并干预刻板印象相关输出，同时在不损害核心任务能力的前提下实现有效去偏，具备良好的可扩展性和实用性。

title: ORBIT-FMIB: Tracking Order-Resolved Epistatic Information Through ESM-2
summary:
Protein foundation models support mutation-effect and structural prediction, but predictive performance alone does not reveal which forms of biological interaction information remain accessible through model depth. We ask whether ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information as strongly as first- and second-order information across its representation hierarchy, introducing ORBIT-FMIB, a diagnostic framework combining Walsh-based interaction decomposition with subset-conditioned neural dependence estimation. The method is validated on synthetic landscapes with known interaction structure before being applied to the dense four-site GB1 fitness landscape using frozen ESM-2 representations.
  An initial production run suggested ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information less well than lower-order information ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.107$). An independent replication of the complete measurement grid, under matched GPU hardware and identical critic seeds, substantially reduced this contrast ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.017$), and its sign was unstable across otherwise-defensible evaluation-pairing choices applied to the same trained critics ($-0.011$ to $+0.015$). We therefore do not currently have robust evidence that ESM-2 selectively loses higher-order epistatic information, nor that retention is equal across orders; the directional question remains open. The measurement protocol itself, including its documented removal of a positional-subset shortcut in pooled critics, remains validated and is unaffected by this finding. ORBIT-FMIB is offered as a diagnostic framework for probing interaction structure in protein foundation models; this study's own replication result illustrates why such probing requires adequately-powered reproducibility checks before its output is treated as a biological finding.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出ORBIT-FMIB框架，用于诊断蛋白质基础模型中高阶上位性信息的保留情况。通过合成景观验证后应用于GB1四位点适应度景观，发现ESM-2对高阶与低阶上位性信息的保留差异不显著，且结果在重复实验中不稳定，表明目前尚无充分证据支持其选择性丢失高阶信息。研究强调了可重复性检查在生物发现中的重要性。
AI.motivation: 探究蛋白质基础模型（如ESM-2）在深层表示中是否保留高阶上位性信息，以及其保留程度是否弱于一阶和二阶信息。
AI.method: 引入ORBIT-FMIB框架，结合沃尔什交互分解与子集条件神经依赖估计，评估模型在不同层级中对各类生物相互作用信息的保留能力，并在合成数据和真实蛋白适应度景观中进行验证。
AI.result: 初始结果显示高阶与低阶信息保留差异显著（Δ_{HO-LO} = -0.107），但独立重复实验大幅缩小该差异至-0.017，且符号在不同评估配对中波动（-0.011至+0.015），表明结果不可靠，无法确认信息保留的系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 目前缺乏稳健证据证明ESM-2会优先丢失高阶上位性信息，也未证实各阶信息保留程度相等；方向性问题仍开放。研究强调需通过充分可重复性检验才能将模型诊断结果视为生物学发现。

title: STAGE: Subspace-Targeted Affine Generative Erasure for Text-to-3D Models
summary:
Concept erasure suppresses a target concept while preserving behavior on unrelated inputs. Existing closed-form methods were designed for 2D image diffusion and assume a single generative pathway, so one edit must cover geometry and texture at once. Native 3D generators, which synthesize structured 3D representations directly rather than by lifting 2D samples, violate this assumption. We show that shape and object concepts must be erased in the structural stage of the pipeline and material concepts in the appearance stage. We therefore formulate erasure in native text-to-3D as a stage-aware editing problem and introduce STAGE, a training-free, closed-form framework. STAGE confines each edit to the low-dimensional subspace spanned by the differences between erase and anchor embeddings, and relaxes the norm-preserving (orthogonal) constraint of prior editors into a least-squares affine correction that maps target activations onto safe anchors subject to a penalty on the displacement of retained prompts. The correction applies to the structural stage, the appearance stage, or both. We find that the stage an edit must reach is determined by concept type. On TRELLIS, the standard open native 3D generator, across 15 shape, material, and object concepts, STAGE reaches 66.7 on a composite score that balances forgetting the target concept against preserving everything else, aggregating CLIP-based semantic and physical metrics, versus 53.2 for the strongest adapted baseline.
  Code: https://github.com/gmum/STAGE/
  Project Page https://gmum.github.io/STAGE/

AI.tldr: STAGE 是一种无需训练的闭式框架，用于在文本到3D生成中实现阶段感知的概念擦除。它将形状和物体概念的擦除置于结构阶段，材料概念的擦除置于外观阶段，并通过最小二乘仿射校正实现对目标激活的映射，同时惩罚保留提示的偏移。该方法在TRELLIS数据集上取得66.7的综合得分，优于最强基线（53.2）。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除方法基于2D图像扩散模型，假设单一生成路径，无法适应原生3D生成器中结构与外观分离的特性。因此需要针对3D生成流程的阶段性特征设计新的擦除策略。
AI.method: STAGE 将编辑限制在擦除与锚点嵌入差异所张成的低维子空间中，放松了传统方法中的范数保持约束，采用最小二乘仿射校正将目标激活映射至安全锚点，并施加对保留提示偏移的惩罚。该校正可应用于结构阶段、外观阶段或两者。
AI.result: 在TRELLIS数据集上，STAGE在15个形状、材质和物体概念上达到66.7的综合得分，显著优于最强适配基线（53.2），在语义和物理指标间实现了更好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: STAGE证明了阶段感知的概念擦除对于原生3D生成的重要性；通过分阶段处理不同概念类型，实现了高效且无训练的编辑，在保持整体生成质量的同时有效消除目标概念。

title: ProtoFlow: Prototype-Guided Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Generative modeling has shown strong promise for multivariate time mseries (MTS) forecasting, especially scale to high-dimensional settings. Diffusion-based methods achieve competitive performance but typically require many sampling steps at inference. VAE-based non-iterative forecasting frameworks have therefore emerged as an efficient alternative. Within this line of work, vector quantization (VQ) enables controllable latent space modeling by mapping multivariate series into compact discrete representations. Existing VQ-based forecasting methods, however, typically rely on autoregressive (AR) token generation, which suffers from exposure bias and training-inference mismatch. Flow matching provides an efficient non-autoregressive alternative for latent forecasting, but existing formulations usually initialize transport from a generic Gaussian prior. We instead observe that the trained VQ codebook already captures representative latent prototypes and can thus serve as a more informative prior for flow matching. Based on this insight, we propose ProtoFlow, a forecasting framework that combines vector-quantized autoencoding with Prototype-prior Flow matching. Our method first maps multivariate sequences into a discrete latent space, then constructs a structured prior from the learned codebook, and finally learns a DiT-based rectified flow to transport samples from this prior to future latent representations conditioned on historical observations. By replacing generic noise initialization with a learned prototype prior, ProtoFlow avoids the rollout mismatch of AR token prediction and promotes faster training convergence. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that it consistently achieves superior forecasting performance with efficient inference.

AI.tldr: ProtoFlow提出一种结合向量量化自编码与原型先验流匹配的多变量时间序列预测框架，通过利用训练好的VQ码本作为更信息丰富的先验，替代传统的通用高斯先验，从而避免自回归生成中的暴露偏差和训练-推理不匹配问题。该方法采用基于DiT的修正流模型，从结构化原型先验传输到未来潜在表示，实现高效非迭代预测。在基准数据集上的实验表明，ProtoFlow在保持高效推理的同时，显著提升了预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VQ的非自回归预测方法依赖自回归令牌生成，存在暴露偏差和训练-推理不匹配问题；而现有流匹配方法使用通用高斯先验，信息量不足。因此需要一种更具信息性的先验来提升非自回归预测的效率与准确性。
AI.method: 提出ProtoFlow框架：首先使用VQ自编码器将多变量时间序列映射到离散潜在空间；然后利用训练好的码本构建结构化的原型先验；最后设计基于DiT的修正流模型，将样本从该原型先验传输至条件于历史观测的未来潜在表示。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，ProtoFlow实现了优于现有方法的预测性能，同时具备高效的非迭代推理能力，训练收敛更快，且避免了自回归生成的滚动误差。
AI.conclusion: ProtoFlow通过引入学习到的原型先验改进了流匹配过程，有效解决了传统非自回归方法中的暴露偏差与初始化冗余问题，在多变量时间序列预测中展现出优越的性能与效率。

title: Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning in Text Classification
summary: Continual learning (CL) in text classification faces two critical challenges: catastrophic forgetting and negative transfer across sequential tasks. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA enable efficient adaptation by learning low-rank updates of the model parameters. However, these compact representations are normally trained in isolation, limiting their reuse across related tasks. We introduce Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation (TORA), a geometric routing framework that leverages the low-rank structure of LoRA adapters to decide whether to transfer knowledge from the most compatible expert (Boosting) or isolate the new task (Shielding) based on structural similarity. Evaluated across 15 diverse text classification benchmarks, TORA consistently avoids harmful routing decisions: compatible tasks exceed their isolated performance while reducing training time, and structurally distant tasks are protected from interference with no loss in accuracy. With a single geometric threshold and no reliance on task identities or predefined sequences, TORA provides a simple and effective approach for dynamic adapter routing in sequential text classification systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为任务导向秩适应（TORA）的几何路由框架，用于解决文本分类中持续学习的灾难性遗忘和负迁移问题。TORA利用LoRA适配器的低秩结构，基于任务间的结构相似性决定是转移知识（增强）还是隔离新任务（防护），在15个不同文本分类基准上表现优异，无需依赖任务标识或预定义序列，实现了高效且动态的适配器路由。
AI.motivation: 持续学习在文本分类中面临灾难性遗忘和跨任务负迁移的挑战，现有参数高效微调方法如LoRA虽能高效适应，但其紧凑表示通常孤立训练，难以在相关任务间复用。
AI.method: 提出任务导向秩适应（TORA），通过分析LoRA适配器的低秩结构，构建几何路由机制，根据任务间的结构相似性动态决定是否共享知识或隔离任务。
AI.result: 在15个文本分类基准上，兼容任务性能优于孤立训练，结构差异大的任务免受干扰且无精度损失，显著减少训练时间，实现高效、鲁棒的持续学习。
AI.conclusion: TORA提供了一种无需任务标识或预设序列的简单有效方法，通过单一几何阈值实现动态适配器路由，在连续文本分类中表现出色。

title: LabBook: Harnessing Experimental History for Efficient LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Evolutionary approaches to LLM-driven discovery often generate new programs from a small set of selected ancestors. This keeps contexts manageable but can omit useful evidence from other experiments, whereas including the full experimental history produces long, redundant contexts. We introduce a simple, single-agent discovery harness built around LabBook, an agent-maintained memory that serves two complementary roles: guiding retrieval of relevant evidence from a complete experimental log and informing the generation of new solutions. At each iteration, the same agent combines its memory with retrieved evidence and jointly produces the next program and an updated LabBook. This separates complete history retention from selective context construction, without requiring an explicit population or branching search structure. On 49 Frontier-CS problems, LabBook improves the observed quality-cost trade-off over the evaluated evolutionary baselines with two backbones, while remaining competitive across nine additional mathematical, systems, and heuristic-design tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/LabBook.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于LabBook的单智能体发现框架，通过维护一个可检索的完整实验日志记忆，实现对历史证据的高效利用与上下文的动态构造，从而在保持低冗余的同时提升程序生成质量。该方法在49个Frontier-CS问题上优于现有进化基线，并在多个其他任务中表现相当。
AI.motivation: 传统进化方法受限于少量祖先生成新程序，难以充分利用完整实验历史中的有用信息；而全量历史又导致上下文过长且冗余。需要一种既能保留完整历史又能选择性构建上下文的方法。
AI.method: 提出LabBook——一种由智能体维护的记忆系统，用于存储完整的实验日志并支持相关证据的检索；每次迭代中，同一智能体结合记忆和检索到的证据，联合生成新程序并更新LabBook，实现历史保留与上下文构造的分离。
AI.result: 在49个Frontier-CS问题上，LabBook显著提升了质量-成本权衡表现；在9个数学、系统及启发式设计任务中也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LabBook通过将完整历史保留与选择性上下文构建解耦，无需显式种群或分支搜索结构，即可有效提升大语言模型驱动的自动发现性能。

title: ARROW: Arbitrary Reconstruction and Tracking of 4D Observations in the Wild
summary: Dynamic scenes may be captured by a moving camera, multiple video streams, or images taken at different times. These observations reveal complementary aspects of scene geometry and motion, yet bringing them together requires establishing correspondence across viewpoints, capture times, and visibility changes. We introduce ARROW, a feed-forward model that unifies 3D reconstruction and 3D point tracking from arbitrary image sets. At its core is a novel order-invariant querying approach, which allows the association of queries with observations across arbitrary inputs. We show that exposing the model to more diverse sets of inputs during training results in improved task performance. Moreover, the resulting model is capable of generalization to a wider range of tasks including multi-view tracking. Trained with this strategy, ARROW establishes a new state of the art in 3D tracking on WorldTrack and TAPVid-3D and outperforms dedicated multi-view trackers on an adapted RGB-only MVTracker benchmark, while remaining competitive across 3D reconstruction tasks. Code and weights are publicly available.

AI.tldr: ARROW是一种前馈模型，统一了从任意图像集进行3D重建和3D点跟踪的任务。其核心是新颖的无序查询方法，可跨不同输入关联查询与观测。通过在训练中引入更多样化的输入，模型性能得到提升，并能泛化到多视角跟踪等更广泛任务。ARROW在WorldTrack和TAPVid-3D上达到新的3D跟踪最佳性能，在适应后的RGB-only MVTracker基准上超越专用多视角跟踪器，同时在3D重建任务中保持竞争力。代码和权重已公开。
AI.motivation: 动态场景通常由移动相机、多视频流或不同时刻的图像捕获，这些观测揭示了场景几何和运动的不同方面，但整合它们需要在不同视角、采集时间和可见性变化之间建立对应关系。现有方法难以有效处理这种复杂性，因此需要一种能够统一3D重建与3D点跟踪并具备强泛化能力的新方法。
AI.method: 提出ARROW模型，采用一种新型的顺序无关查询机制，使查询能够跨任意输入（如不同时间、视角、可见性）与观测进行匹配。通过在训练中引入多样化输入数据集，增强模型对复杂场景的适应能力，并实现端到端的3D重建与跟踪联合优化。
AI.result: ARROW在WorldTrack和TAPVid-3D数据集上实现了新的3D跟踪性能上限；在适应后的RGB-only MVTracker基准上优于专门设计的多视角跟踪器；同时在3D重建任务中表现良好，具备较强的通用性。
AI.conclusion: ARROW通过顺序无关的查询机制，成功实现了从任意图像集进行统一的3D重建与点跟踪，具有优异的性能和泛化能力，为动态场景分析提供了新范式。代码与权重已公开，便于复现与扩展。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure for Multi-Turn Safety
summary: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) often refuse a harmful request but comply once the same goal is spread over several turns. Preference objectives score whole responses to single prompts, so their training loss alone cannot control risk on unseen histories. Our analysis gives sufficient conditions under which suppression at supervised single-turn contexts yields a bound on multi-turn trajectory risk. The bound accounts for coverage, transfer slack, and leakage, and characterizes contraction relative to a base-policy risk budget evaluated on the trained policy's contexts. TRACE (Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure) turns this principle into a token-level objective. On the safe response, each token is weighted by the discounted return of a refusal-attributable advantage. The advantage compares a frozen reference model with its refusal-ablated copy, allowing earlier response tokens to receive credit from later refusal-related evidence. At high-gap positions on rejected responses, TRACE combines the observed token with policy-selected alternatives in the erasure target. A gradient-norm penalty replaces the retain set. Across five open-weight models and seven multi-turn attacks, TRACE gives the lowest attack success rate (ASR) in all 35 model and attack pairs, while the model utility evaluated on MMLU and HellaSwag drop by at most 1\.23 points. Source code can be found in the supplemental material.

AI.tldr: TRACE 是一种基于轨迹回报归因与对比擦除的新型方法，用于提升大语言模型在多轮对话中的安全性。它通过分析单轮监督上下文下的抑制效果，建立对多轮风险的理论边界，并设计了基于令牌级别的目标函数，使早期响应令牌也能获得后期拒绝相关证据的反馈。在五个开源模型和七种多轮攻击场景中，TRACE 在所有35个组合中均实现了最低的攻击成功率（ASR），同时模型在MMLU和HellaSwag上的性能下降不超过1.23点。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好训练方法仅评估单次提示的完整回复，无法有效控制未见过的多轮历史中的风险。当有害意图被拆分到多个回合时，安全对齐的LLM可能仍会遵从。因此需要一种能建模多轮轨迹风险并提升防御能力的新机制。
AI.method: 提出TRACE框架，利用冻结参考模型与其拒绝擦除版本之间的优势差，计算每个令牌的折扣回报归因权重；通过结合观察到的令牌与策略选择的替代项进行擦除目标构建，并引入梯度范数惩罚替代保留集，实现细粒度的安全控制。
AI.result: 在五种开放权重模型和七类多轮攻击测试中，TRACE在所有35组实验中均达到最低攻击成功率（ASR），且在MMLU和HellaSwag任务上的性能损失最小，不超过1.23分。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过理论保障与高效优化相结合，在不显著损害模型通用能力的前提下，显著提升了大语言模型在复杂多轮交互中的安全性，为构建更鲁棒的安全对齐系统提供了新路径。

title: A Matryoshka Hierarchical RAG for Efficient Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for multi-hop Question Answering (QA) must balance retrieval quality with computational cost. This cost is incurred during indexing time, through the use of expensive Knowledge Graphs (KGs) or Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate summaries, or during querying, through iterative LLM-driven retrieval. To reduce it while maintaining retrieval quality, we present MatRAG, a hierarchical framework that combines RAG systems with Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL). MatRAG addresses both kinds of cost by aligning the semantic hierarchy of a clustering structure with the nested structure of MRL. Specifically, it organizes the corpus of documents into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of clusters with progressively coarser granularity. Each level is indexed by a lower Matryoshka dimension. MatRAG pairs an iterative, top-down traversal of the DAG with an entity-driven mechanism that controls the hop budget and re-ranks candidates. We evaluated MatRAG on three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks against seven representative baselines. MatRAG outperforms its strongest competitors in terms of retrieval quality; furthermore, it reduces indexing costs by avoiding KG construction and LLM-based summarization, and lowers query-time costs through dimension-aware similarity.

AI.tldr: MatRAG 是一种层次化框架，结合了检索增强生成（RAG）与马特罗什卡表示学习（MRL），通过将文档聚类组织成具有渐进粗粒度的有向无环图（DAG），并使用低维 Matryoshka 表示进行索引，有效降低索引和查询时间成本，同时在多跳问答任务中优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的 RAG 系统在多跳问答中面临检索质量与计算成本之间的权衡，尤其是依赖知识图谱或大语言模型进行摘要生成带来的高索引成本，以及迭代式 LLM 检索带来的高查询成本。需要一种既能保持高质量检索又显著降低计算开销的方法。
AI.method: MatRAG 采用层次化结构，将文档集组织为具有不同粒度的聚类 DAG，每一层使用相应维度的 Matryoshka 表示进行索引。通过自顶向下的迭代遍历 DAG 并结合基于实体的候选控制与重排序机制，实现高效且精准的多跳检索。
AI.result: 在三个标准多跳问答基准测试中，MatRAG 在检索质量上超越了七种代表性基线模型，同时在索引阶段避免了知识图谱构建和大语言模型摘要生成，在查询阶段通过维度感知相似性显著降低了计算开销。
AI.conclusion: MatRAG 通过融合层次聚类与马特罗什卡表示学习，成功实现了多跳问答中检索质量与计算效率的双重优化，是一种高效、可扩展的 RAG 架构。

title: Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation
summary: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的无监督技能发现方法，通过学习具备功能等变性的动作感知时间表示，以捕捉环境的时序结构并保持对布局变化的鲁棒性。基于该嵌入，进一步提出基于双射模拟的无监督技能发现，通过仅依赖直接影响技能执行的状态特征来约束技能行为，从而实现跨布局的不变性，提升技能在不同环境配置中的可迁移性。实验表明，所学技能可在多种未见布局中有效解决下游任务，展现出强大的分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督技能发现方法要么需要专家数据，要么泛化能力有限，难以有效迁移到未见过的环境布局中。核心挑战在于如何学习既能捕捉环境时序结构又对布局变化鲁棒的表示。
AI.method: 提出一种满足功能等变性的动作感知时间表示学习目标，以保留局部时序结构；在此基础上，采用基于双射模拟的无监督技能发现，仅依赖影响技能执行的子集状态特征来定义技能行为，实现跨布局的行为不变性。
AI.result: 在多种环境布局上进行的综合实验证明，所学技能能够有效应用于下游任务，表现出显著的分布外泛化能力，成功实现了跨布局的技能迁移。
AI.conclusion: 本文方法通过学习具有功能等变性的动作感知时间表示，并结合双射模拟实现技能的不变性，显著提升了无监督技能发现的可迁移性与泛化能力，为通用策略预训练提供了有效路径。

title: CLASP: Continual Low-rank Adapters for Spatially Placed Concepts from One Hypernetwork
comment: 31 pages. Code: https://github.com/genwro-ai/clasp, project page: https://genwro-ai.github.io/clasp
summary: Continual personalization of text-to-image diffusion models requires sequentially acquiring new concepts while retaining previously learned ones. However, existing methods either suffer from catastrophic forgetting or rely on storing additional concept-specific parameters and spatial components, causing their parameter footprint to grow with the concept stream. This limits their ability to scale to long sequences of personalization tasks. We propose a rehearsal-free approach that uses a single fixed-size hypernetwork to continually personalize a frozen diffusion model. Instead of expanding the model as new concepts are acquired, the hypernetwork dynamically produces the concept-specific adaptations required for personalization while preserving previously learned concepts. Our framework further integrates spatial control into the personalization process, allowing users to specify where a personalized concept should appear without introducing additional per-concept components. This formulation enables continual personalization with a parameter footprint that remains independent of the number of learned concepts, aside from compact concept representations. Experiments demonstrate strong retention of previously learned concepts and reliable spatial grounding, matching or improving upon existing methods while scaling effectively to long streams of personalization tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需回放的持续个性化方法，使用单一固定大小的超网络来持续调整冻结的文本到图像扩散模型，避免灾难性遗忘并保持参数量不变，同时支持空间控制以指定概念出现位置，实现高效、可扩展的个性化。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在持续学习新概念时面临灾难性遗忘或需要存储额外的特定概念参数和空间组件，导致参数量随概念数量增长，难以扩展到长时间序列的个性化任务。
AI.method: 采用一个固定大小的超网络动态生成个性化所需的概念特定适应，将空间控制集成到个性化过程中，使用户能够指定概念出现的位置，而无需引入额外的每概念组件。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在保留先前学习概念方面表现优异，实现了可靠的时空定位，性能达到或超过现有方法，并能有效扩展至长期个性化任务流。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架实现了参数量独立于学习概念数目的持续个性化，具备良好的可扩展性和实用性，适用于长期连续的个性化需求。

title: PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading
summary: Reinforcement learning for trading often struggles to balance upside participation with drawdown control. Profit-only policies can collapse toward passive long exposure on upward-drifting assets, while aggressively risk-penalized rewards can become too defensive during volatile periods. This paper proposes PPO-HRAP, a hybrid regime-aware policy that combines Proximal Policy Optimization with an interpretable regime prior. The agent observes both market features and portfolio-state variables, receives a reward combining portfolio log return, VIX-conditioned drawdown-increase penalty, target-exposure deviation, and turnover cost, and executes a blended action between the PPO actor output and a regime-derived target exposure. On the held-out 2020-2022 SPY test window, PPO-HRAP achieves 27.62% total return, 8.48% annualized return, 0.6447 Sharpe ratio, 0.8588 Sortino ratio, and 0.4592 Calmar ratio, while reducing maximum drawdown from 34.10% for Buy and Hold to 18.47%. Across five SPY seeds, PPO-HRAP remains stable with mean total return $0.2725 \pm 0.0109$ and mean Sharpe ratio $0.6219 \pm 0.0565$. Single-run cross-asset tests on QQQ and DIA further show that the proposed method ranks first on total return and Sharpe ratio for all three reported assets. These results suggest that blending learned actions with a volatility-aware regime prior is a practical way to improve risk-adjusted trading behavior, although the current policy still incurs high turnover and cross-asset robustness beyond SPY remains limited to single-run evidence.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出PPO-HRAP，一种结合近端策略优化（PPO）与可解释的市场状态先验的混合型策略，以平衡交易中的收益参与和回撤控制。模型在SPY 2020-2022测试期内表现优异，实现27.62%总回报、8.48%年化收益、0.6447的夏普比率，并将最大回撤从买入持有策略的34.10%降至18.47%。跨资产测试也显示其在QQQ和DIA上同样领先。然而，仍存在换手率高、跨资产泛化能力有限的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习交易策略难以兼顾收益增长与回撤控制：纯利润导向策略易趋向被动长期持有，而过度惩罚风险的策略则在波动期过于保守。因此需要一种能动态适应市场状态、兼具收益与风险控制能力的新方法。
AI.method: 提出PPO-HRAP，融合PPO算法与基于市场状态（如VIX）的可解释先验机制。模型同时观测市场特征与投资组合状态，采用包含对数收益、条件化回撤惩罚、目标暴露偏差及换手成本的复合奖励函数，并将PPO输出动作与基于市场状态推导的目标暴露进行加权融合，实现动态调节。
AI.result: 在SPY 2020-2022测试窗口中，PPO-HRAP实现27.62%总回报、8.48%年化收益、0.6447夏普比率、0.8588索提诺比率和0.4592卡尔玛比率，最大回撤降至18.47%；五次随机种子测试结果稳定，平均总回报为0.2725±0.0109，平均夏普比率为0.6219±0.0565。跨资产测试中，在SPY、QQQ、DIA上均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 将学习到的动作与基于波动率感知的市场状态先验相结合，是一种提升风险调整后交易表现的有效策略；但当前模型存在换手率过高、跨资产泛化能力受限等问题，需进一步改进。

title: The Asymptotics of Language Model Alignment with Memory
summary: Language model (LM) alignment broadly aims to perturb a given LM $Q$ into an aligned LM $q$ such that i) the outputs produced by $q$ and $Q$ are 'close' in probability, ii) $q$ has a higher expected reward than $Q$. Two common techniques for LM alignment are: KL-constrained RL, which requires knowledge of the LM distribution and is computationally expensive, and the best-of-$n$ algorithm, which requires only sampling from the LM. The work of Yang et al. established asymptotic closeness between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods for an $m$--length i.i.d. token sequence output by the LM, in the limit as $m$ increases to infinity. However, the i.i.d. assumption is not representative of practical LMs, whose output sequences often have memory. In this paper, we extend the asymptotic closeness result to the case when the $m$--length token sequence outputted by the LM is Markovian. Further, for finite-length output sequences -- particularly, when $m=1$ -- we provide a complete characterization of LM distributions and reward functions for which the KL-divergence between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods is zero -- a question first posed in Yang et al.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型对齐中KL约束强化学习与best-of-n算法之间的分布接近性。在i.i.d.假设下，Yang等人的工作已证明两者在序列长度趋于无穷时渐近一致；本文将结果扩展至具有记忆性的马尔可夫输出序列，并对有限长度（尤其是m=1）情形下，完全刻画了使两种方法生成分布间KL散度为零的模型分布与奖励函数条件，解决了先前提出的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型对齐方法如KL约束强化学习需知模型分布且计算昂贵，而best-of-n仅需采样，但二者分布关系在非i.i.d.场景下缺乏理论支撑。尤其在实际语言模型存在序列依赖性（即马尔可夫性）时，原理论结果不适用。因此亟需拓展分析框架以覆盖更现实的模型行为。
AI.method: 通过引入马尔可夫假设建模语言模型输出序列，利用马尔可夫链的极限性质和概率耦合技术，推导出两种对齐方法在长序列下的渐近等价性。对于有限长度情形，特别是m=1，采用解析方法求解KL散度为零的充要条件，结合状态转移矩阵与奖励函数的结构特性进行形式化刻画。
AI.result: 1) 在马尔可夫假设下，当序列长度m趋于无穷时，KL约束强化学习与best-of-n生成的输出分布渐近等价；2) 对于m=1的情形，给出了使得两种方法生成分布的KL散度为零的完整条件：即奖励函数与初始状态分布需满足特定线性关系，且模型转移概率需具备某种对称性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将语言模型对齐方法的理论分析从i.i.d.扩展至更现实的马尔可夫场景，揭示了两种主流方法在长序列下的等价性，并精确刻画了短序列下分布一致的边界条件，为理解对齐机制提供了更强的理论支持。

title: Curvature Under Attack in hZACH-ViT: Gauge Symmetry, Boundary Saturation, and Adversarial Failure
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at NeurReps 2026: Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Curvature is often treated as an intrinsic property of a representation, although its empirical effect also depends on coordinate scale, learned logit temperature, and numerical safeguards. We study this interaction in hZACH-ViT, a compact Vision Transformer with Euclidean, Poincare, and spherical prototype heads. The backbone architecture, seed-specific initialization, 50-per-class training subset, and optimization protocol are matched across three MedMNIST datasets and five seeds. At the fixed comparison curvature $c=1$, Poincare has the lowest class-macro PGD attack-success rate in all 12 dataset-budget cells and under a stronger CE+DLR multi-restart attack on all three datasets, but it also has the lowest clean MacroF1. An end-to-end curvature intervention changes the interpretation. Reducing Poincare curvature to $c=0.1$ improves clean MacroF1 in every one of the 15 paired seed-dataset comparisons and removes hard boundary clipping, yet on OrganAMNIST it increases strong attack success from $89.7\%$ to $99.3\%$ (paired difference $+9.57$ points; 95\% hierarchical bootstrap CI $[+5.52,+14.03]$). At $c=1$, $40$-$47\%$ of clean Poincare features are hard-clipped, the radial Jacobian of the inherited map is nearly zero, and dimensionless attack trajectories are unusually long and inefficient. The spherical head provides a control: its curvature change is an exact scale gauge to floating-point precision and produces much smaller attack differences. These results do not establish intrinsic hyperbolic robustness. They identify an implementation-sensitive regime in which curvature, scale, and proximity to the Poincare boundary jointly organize clean recognition and adversarial representation motion.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对比欧氏、双曲（Poincare）和球面原型头在紧凑Vision Transformer（hZACH-ViT）中的表现，揭示了曲率、坐标尺度、学习的logit温度及数值保护机制之间的相互作用。在固定曲率c=1时，双曲模型在多数情况下对PGD攻击具有最低成功率，但其干净数据上的宏平均F1分数最低。通过端到端调节曲率至c=0.1，虽然提升了干净数据性能并消除了硬边界截断，但在OrganAMNIST上反而显著增加了强攻击成功率（从89.7%升至99.3%）。分析表明，高曲率导致特征被大量截断、径向雅可比接近零，且对抗轨迹效率低下。球面头作为对照显示，其曲率变化仅影响尺度，攻击效果变化较小。结论指出：双曲鲁棒性并非内在属性，而是受实现细节影响的特定配置下的现象，强调曲率、尺度与靠近双曲边界程度共同调控干净识别与对抗表示运动。
AI.motivation: 探究曲率作为表示属性时，其实际影响是否独立于坐标尺度、温度参数和数值稳定性机制；特别是验证双曲表示是否具备内在的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.method: 采用hZACH-ViT架构，在三个MedMNIST数据集上使用50类/类子集和五次随机种子进行实验，对比欧氏、双曲（Poincare）和球面原型头；固定骨干网络、初始化、训练子集和优化协议，系统调节曲率（c=1 vs c=0.1），评估干净性能与多种对抗攻击（如CE+DLR多重启攻击）下的表现，并分析特征分布、雅可比结构与攻击轨迹特性。
AI.result: 在c=1时，双曲模型在攻击成功率上表现最优，但干净宏F1最低；将曲率降至c=0.1后，干净性能普遍提升，消除硬边界截断，但对OrganAMNIST的强攻击成功率显著上升（+9.57点，置信区间[+5.52,+14.03]）；高曲率下存在大量特征截断、径向雅可比趋近零、对抗轨迹低效；球面头的曲率变化仅表现为尺度缩放，攻击敏感性变化小。
AI.conclusion: 双曲鲁棒性并非固有属性，而是在特定实现条件下（曲率、尺度、边界接近度）形成的动态平衡结果。清洁识别与对抗表示行为由曲率、尺度和边界距离协同决定，需谨慎解释双曲几何在对抗防御中的作用。

title: MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Open multimodal reasoning models have benefited from large-scale reasoning supervision, yet reliable post-training remains challenging due to uneven data quality, inefficient supervision construction, imbalanced difficulty, and cross-domain interference. We introduce MMVistaReason (MVR), an open-data post-training recipe with three components: (1) broader capability coverage across complementary Analytical and Real-World reasoning groups, emphasizing structured reasoning versus visual perception and spatial grounding; (2) efficient SFT and RL data construction, standardizing heterogeneous open data through staged cleaning and annotation, combining difficulty-aware cascaded teacher distillation with answer-likelihood-based trajectory selection to construct MVR-SFT-528K, and applying scale-specific frontier filtering for MVR-RL-63K; and (3) specialize-then-integrate training, which trains complementary RL experts and consolidates their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Our analyses reveal a capacity-dependent interaction between supervision difficulty, trajectory quality, and model capacity: smaller students benefit more from selected supervision, while larger students are robust to trajectory variation and mixed-domain interference. Mixed-domain RL introduces benchmark-level negative transfer, whereas MOPD provides consistent capability integration, with the preferred KL direction varying across model scales. Across 15 multimodal benchmarks, MVR-4B achieves an average score of 72.8, outperforming Qwen3.5-9B (Instruct) and MMFineReason-8B while using about 70% fewer samples than MMFineReason. Scaling to 9B improves the average to 74.4, surpassing Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Instruct). Overall, MMVistaReason demonstrates that systematic open-data construction and capacity-aware post-training provide a practical and scalable path toward reliable multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: MMVistaReason (MVR) 是一种基于开放数据的后训练方案，通过三部分设计提升多模态推理模型性能：（1）覆盖更广的能力范围，涵盖分析型与现实世界推理；（2）高效构建 SFT 与 RL 数据，通过分阶段清洗、难度感知级联教师蒸馏和基于答案似然的轨迹选择，生成 MVR-SFT-528K 与 MVR-RL-63K；（3）先专精后融合的训练策略，采用多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）整合不同专家能力。实验表明，小模型更受益于精选监督，大模型对轨迹变化和跨域干扰更具鲁棒性；混合域 RL 存在负迁移，而 MOPD 能持续提升性能，且最优 KL 方向随模型规模变化。在 15 个基准上，MVR-4B 平均得分 72.8，优于 Qwen3.5-9B（Instruct）和 MMFineReason-8B，仅用约 70% 样本；扩展至 9B 后平均达 74.4，超越 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（Instruct）。MVR 展示了系统化开放数据构建与容量感知后训练在可靠多模态推理中的可行性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有开放多模态推理模型虽受益于大规模推理监督，但后训练面临数据质量不均、监督构建效率低、难度不平衡及跨域干扰等挑战，亟需一种更可靠、高效且可扩展的后训练方法。
AI.method: 提出 MMVistaReason（MVR），包含三项核心组件：(1) 扩展能力覆盖，整合分析型与现实世界推理任务，强调结构化推理与视觉感知/空间定位；(2) 高效 SFT 与 RL 数据构建，通过分阶段数据清洗与标注，结合难度感知级联教师蒸馏与基于答案似然的轨迹选择，生成高质量训练数据；(3) 专用-融合训练范式，先训练互补的强化学习专家，再通过多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）整合能力。
AI.result: MVR-4B 在 15 个多模态基准上平均得分 72.8，优于 Qwen3.5-9B（Instruct）和 MMFineReason-8B，且仅使用约 70% 的样本；扩展至 9B 后平均得分达 74.4，超越 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（Instruct）。实验揭示模型容量与监督难度、轨迹质量间存在依赖关系：小模型更依赖高质量监督，大模型对干扰更鲁棒；混合域 RL 引入负迁移，而 MOPD 实现稳定能力融合，且最优 KL 方向随模型规模变化。
AI.conclusion: MMVistaReason 证明，系统化的开放数据构建与容量感知的后训练策略，为实现可靠、高效且可扩展的多模态推理提供了一条切实可行的技术路径。

title: An ontology for cross-sectoral crisis management: core and public health modules
summary: This paper presents the European Crisis Management Ontology (ECMO), a modular OWL-based ontology intended as a cross-sectoral reference for disaster risk reduction and response. ECMO is designed to be organised as a network of ontological modules. Among the modules, ECMO-CORE captures fundamental crisis management concepts such as hazard, event, exposure, impact, and response measure and uses ontology design patterns and the OWL2 punning technique to resolve ambiguities between hazard types and event manifestations. In addition, domain-specific modules are defined as in the case of the public health module aligned with SNOMED CT and ICD-11. To demonstrate the resource's utility, we used ECMO to represent the data of the Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources system of the Joint Research Centre to generate an end-to-end pipeline that populates an ECMO-compliant knowledge graph from unstructured epidemiological news. Initial results demonstrate that ECMO provides the formal guardrails necessary for consistent and unified knowledge representation and integration. The ontology is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20070268 and is released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出欧洲危机管理本体（ECMO），一个基于OWL的模块化本体，旨在为跨部门灾害风险管理与响应提供参考。ECMO-CORE模块涵盖灾害、事件、暴露、影响和应对措施等基本概念，并利用本体设计模式和OWL2的重载技术解决灾害类型与事件表现之间的歧义。此外，还定义了领域特定模块，如与SNOMED CT和ICD-11对齐的公共卫生模块。通过将ECMO应用于欧盟联合研究中心的开放源数据流行病学监测系统，构建了一个从非结构化新闻生成符合ECMO标准知识图谱的端到端流程，初步结果表明其在一致性和统一知识表示与集成方面具有有效性。本体公开获取，采用CC BY 4.0许可。
AI.motivation: 当前灾害管理中存在跨部门信息不一致和知识整合困难的问题，亟需一个统一、可扩展的本体框架来支持多源数据的标准化表示与互操作。
AI.method: 采用模块化设计，基于OWL构建本体，运用本体设计模式与OWL2重载技术处理语义歧义；开发核心模块（ECMO-CORE）与领域特定模块（如公共卫生模块），并与现有标准（如SNOMED CT、ICD-11）对齐；构建端到端知识图谱生成流程，实现从非结构化新闻数据到结构化知识表示的转化。
AI.result: ECMO成功实现了对流行病学新闻数据的结构化建模，验证了其在统一知识表示与跨域数据集成方面的可行性与有效性；生成的知识图谱具备良好的一致性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: ECMO为灾害风险管理提供了可复用、可扩展且语义清晰的本体基础，有助于推动跨部门、跨领域的危机响应知识共享与智能分析。

title: Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers
summary: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level. Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages. Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新型跨语言对比学习方法，针对解码器仅架构的大型语言模型（LLM）在多语言分词差异下难以显式对齐表示的问题。通过利用混合专家（MoE）路由器输出作为对齐目标，实现更可靠的序列级跨语言比较。实验表明，该方法不仅提升了隐藏表示的跨语言对齐度，还显著改善了多语言任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨语言对比学习在解码器仅架构的LLM中受限于多语言分词差异，无法有效对齐表示；尽管如此，已有研究表明更好的跨语言表示对齐有助于提升跨语言迁移能力。因此需要一种适应当前架构的新对齐机制。
AI.method: 使用MoE模型中的路由器输出作为对比学习的目标信号，通过池化多个token的路由输出实现序列级跨语言对齐，避免依赖隐藏状态直接对齐。
AI.result: 在四个开源MoE模型上进行受控持续预训练实验，结果表明引入路由损失后，不仅实现了隐含表示的跨语言对齐，还在多样化的评估集上显著提升了多语言性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言MoE路由器对齐是一种有效且可行的方法，能够克服解码器仅架构的限制，在不改变模型结构的前提下增强多语言表示对齐，从而提升跨语言迁移能力。

title: Grand Canonical Generators
summary: We introduce Grand Canonical Generators (GCG), a generative framework that extends Boltzmann generators to the grand canonical ensemble. We present two designs. The first conditions a variable-size generative model on the chemical potential, sampling particle number and configuration jointly. The second factorizes the grand canonical distribution into a particle-number distribution and the corresponding canonical Boltzmann density. This factorized formulation can use any existing Boltzmann generator for the canonical component, encodes the known linear chemical-potential dependence analytically, and yields a tractable likelihood that supports self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Empirically, GCG accurately reproduces grand canonical observables on a Lennard--Jones fluid and methane adsorption in a zeolite, demonstrating generalization across chemical potentials and correction via SNIS and grand canonical Monte Carlo.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为广义系综生成器（GCG）的生成框架，将玻尔兹曼生成器扩展到广义系综。该方法通过两种设计实现：一是联合采样粒子数与构型，条件于化学势；二是将广义系综分布分解为粒子数分布与对应正则系综玻尔兹曼密度，可兼容现有玻尔兹曼生成器，解析编码化学势的线性依赖关系，并支持自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）。实验表明，GCG在Lennard-Jones流体和沸石中甲烷吸附系统上准确复现了广义系综可观测量，展示了对不同化学势的泛化能力及通过SNIS和广义系综蒙特卡洛的修正能力。
AI.motivation: 传统生成模型难以直接处理粒子数可变的广义系综问题，尤其在化学势变化时缺乏高效且精确的采样方法。因此需要一种能灵活建模粒子数与构型联合分布、并保持物理一致性与计算效率的生成框架。
AI.method: 提出两种设计：1）以化学势为条件，训练可变大小生成模型，联合采样粒子数与构型；2）将广义系综分布分解为粒子数分布与正则系综玻尔兹曼密度，利用已有玻尔兹曼生成器处理正则部分，解析编码化学势的线性依赖，从而获得可计算的似然函数，支持自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）。
AI.result: GCG在Lennard-Jones流体和甲烷吸附于沸石的系统中，成功复现了广义系综下的可观测量，表现出对不同化学势的良好泛化能力，并可通过SNIS和广义系综蒙特卡洛进行有效修正。
AI.conclusion: GCG是一种高效且物理一致的生成框架，能够处理粒子数可变的广义系综问题，兼具灵活性、可扩展性和高精度，适用于复杂多组分系统的模拟与采样。

title: Supervising Sound Localization by In-the-wild Egomotion
comment: CVPR 2025 Highlight (IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition)
summary: We present a method for learning binaural sound localization using egomotion as a supervisory signal. Over the course of a video, the cameras direction to a sound source will change as the camera moves. We train an audio model to predict sound directions that are consistent with visual estimates of camera motion, which we obtain using traditional methods from multi-view geometry. This provides a weak but plentiful form of supervision that we combine with traditional binaural cues. To evaluate this method, we propose a dataset of real-world audio-visual videos with egomotion. We show that our model can successfully learn from real-world data and that it performs well on sound localization tasks

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用自我运动作为监督信号学习双耳声音定位的方法，通过视频中相机方向随运动变化来提供弱监督信号，并结合传统双耳线索，在真实世界音视频数据上验证了模型的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统声音定位依赖于精确标注的声源方向，但获取成本高；本文利用视频中相机运动带来的视觉变化作为弱监督信号，以降低对标注数据的依赖。
AI.method: 使用多视图几何方法估计相机运动，训练音频模型预测与视觉估计一致的声音方向，结合传统双耳线索进行联合学习。
AI.result: 在真实世界音视频数据集上，模型能有效学习并表现出良好的声音定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够利用弱监督信号从真实世界数据中学习声音定位，显著减少对人工标注的依赖，同时保持良好性能。

title: Verify Claims, Not Scores: Evidence-Based Verification of Modular Agents
summary: When developers change one component of an agent, such as its controller, a learned model or its verifier, they usually judge the change by an aggregate task score. That score cannot tell whether improvement was attainable, which component lost value, or what the agent's own checks certify. We introduce a claim-specific verification audit for modular agents that plan, act, check and refine. Instead of scoring the agent, the audit scores the evidence: each conclusion is recorded with the evidence behind it, one of four verdicts (supported, unsupported, unresolved or not evaluated) and the boundary within which it holds. Three tools supply that evidence. Oracle policies measure attainable improvement under an explicitly stated action set, so that a low value can be traced to the evaluation rather than to the environment. Replacing one component at a time with a perfect counterpart locates lost value, with null results read as unresolved whenever a downstream component could mask them. A separate test asks whether the verifier's score identifies the quantity it is read as bounding. Applied to a constrained portfolio-allocation agent in a synthetic market with known hidden regimes, the audit shows that the value of perfect regime information depends on the action set used to measure it, that the scenario generator discards most of the regime signal while better local fidelity does not improve decisions, and that the runtime verifier can be bypassed with no visible change in outcomes. The contribution is the protocol and the evidential distinctions it enforces; the empirical findings are specific to the agent and environment studied.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对模块化智能体的特定主张验证审计方法，通过记录每个结论背后的证据、判断结果（支持、不支持、未决或未评估）及有效范围，实现对智能体各组件改进效果的精确评估。该方法结合三种工具：理想策略衡量在明确动作集下的可实现改进，组件替换实验定位价值损失，以及验证器有效性测试。在合成市场环境中的实证显示，完美状态信息的价值依赖于动作集，场景生成器会丢弃大部分状态信号，而局部拟合度提升并不改善决策，且运行时验证器可被绕过而不影响结果。核心贡献是审计协议及其强制的证据区分，具体发现具有情境特异性。
AI.motivation: 当前开发者评估智能体组件变更时仅依赖综合任务得分，无法识别改进潜力、价值损失来源或验证器的实际作用，导致优化方向模糊。需要一种能追踪证据与结论之间关系的系统性审计机制。
AI.method: 提出一种基于证据的验证审计协议，包含三类工具：1）使用理想策略量化在指定动作集下的可实现改进；2）逐个替换组件为理想版本以定位价值损失；3）测试验证器评分是否准确反映其声称的边界。所有结论均附带证据、判别结果和有效范围。
AI.result: 在合成市场环境中，审计揭示：完美状态信息的价值取决于动作集；场景生成器丢弃大量状态信号；局部高保真度未提升决策质量；运行时验证器可被绕过而无可见后果。这些发现表明现有组件间存在隐蔽依赖与冗余。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的验证审计协议能够精准分离性能变化的原因，揭示组件间的隐性依赖与冗余，为模块化智能体的可解释性优化提供新范式。尽管实证结果受限于具体环境，但方法论具有通用价值。

title: A rubric landscape for evaluating clinical reasoning in large language models: what exists, what is missing, and what needs to be combined
summary:
Exam-style accuracy does not establish whether large language models (LLMs) reason well over clinical records. We define clinical reasoning as integrating and updating evidence across time and sources to form, revise and justify a patient's problem representation and a defensible plan.
  This structured narrative review maps three literatures: medical education assessment instruments, clinical LLM benchmarks published from 2023 onwards, and general-domain methods for evaluating long-form generation. We examine six dimensions: problem representation, temporal synthesis, differential and management reasoning, counterfactual reasoning, calibrated uncertainty, and reasoning faithfulness. Preprints are included and flagged.
  No single instrument covers all six dimensions. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning are reasonably covered, although reliability varies by instrument and setting. TIMER-Eval targets temporal synthesis, and ER-Reason assesses sequential diagnostic belief updating. Dedicated uncertainty and counterfactual evaluations are emerging, but their applicability to longitudinal free-text reasoning remains limited. Factual completeness is well theorised in general-domain evaluation, with early clinical evidence of important omissions. Faithfulness remains the weakest dimension, with one identified clinical causal-ablation study on multiple-choice questions.
  Existing tools should be combined through binary rubric items, separate completeness and correctness scores, case-specific importance weighting with non-compensable safety caps, temporal order-consistency checks, and chance-corrected reliability reporting. Further design work is needed for calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning and faithfulness over longitudinal free-text records. This review provides a design rationale, not a validated instrument.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统梳理了医学教育评估工具、2023年以来发布的临床大语言模型基准测试以及通用领域长文本生成评估方法，提出临床推理应涵盖问题表征、时间整合、鉴别与管理推理、反事实推理、校准不确定性及推理忠实性六个维度。现有工具在各维度覆盖不全，尤其在不确定性、反事实推理和忠实性方面存在明显短板，建议通过组合评估方式提升评估质量，并指出未来需加强针对纵向自由文本推理的专项设计。
AI.motivation: 当前考试式准确率无法有效衡量大语言模型在临床记录中的推理能力，需要建立更全面的临床推理评估框架以反映模型对多源、跨时证据的整合与更新能力。
AI.method: 采用结构化文献综述方法，整合医学教育评估工具、临床LLM基准测试及通用领域生成评估方法，从六个维度系统分析现有评估工具的覆盖情况与局限性。
AI.result: 发现无单一工具覆盖全部六维；问题表征与鉴别/管理推理相对充分但可靠性不一；TIMER-Eval和ER-Reason分别聚焦时间整合与诊断信念更新；不确定性与反事实评估尚处萌芽阶段，适用性有限；事实完整性理论较成熟，但临床中仍存在重要遗漏；忠实性最弱，仅有个别因果消融研究。
AI.conclusion: 应结合多种评估工具，采用二元评分项、分离完整性和正确性评分、基于案例重要性的非补偿性安全上限、时间顺序一致性检查及校正随机误差的可靠性报告，以提升评估有效性；未来需重点改进校准不确定性、反事实推理和忠实性评估在纵向自由文本中的应用，本研究提供设计依据而非验证工具。

title: SkillSpec: Consensus-Gated Agent Skill Evolution via Representation Specialization
summary: Natural-language skills are textual procedural memories through which large language model (LLM) agents retain reusable task knowledge without updating model weights. Existing methods typically treat skills as either static artifacts or monolithic documents optimized using aggregate validation scores as feedback. However, representing a skill as a monolithic document restricts optimization to its textual content, without explicitly modeling the structure through which procedural knowledge is retrieved and executed. We identify a key distinction between learning what knowledge to retain and determining how to organize it: textual updates should first be validated through execution evidence, after which the retained knowledge should be structured according to its procedural dependencies and retrieval requirements. To this end, we introduce SkillSpec, a two-phase framework comprising consensus-gated evolution and representation specialization. In the consensus-gated phase, complementary editing intents generate complete candidate skills. An update is committed only when paired evaluations reach consensus, requiring sufficient overall improvement and non-negative aggregate paired gain in every repeated evaluation. In the specialization phase, signals of process and redundancy sensitivity derived from the full optimization trajectory, including accepted and rejected candidates, guide the selection of a flat, graph, or hybrid representation.Across six benchmarks and three target language models, SkillSpec improves average success rate over SkillOpt by 6.89%, averaged across the three models. These results demonstrate that reliable skill evolution and representation specialization address complementary objectives: deciding what knowledge to retain and how to structure it for inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillSpec，一种两阶段框架，用于改进大语言模型代理的自然语言技能。第一阶段为共识门控演化，通过互补编辑意图生成候选技能，并仅在多次评估中达成共识时才提交更新；第二阶段为表示专业化，根据优化轨迹中的过程与冗余敏感信号，选择扁平、图或混合结构表示。该方法在六个基准测试中显著提升成功率，平均优于SkillOpt 6.89%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将技能视为静态或整体文档，缺乏对知识获取与组织结构之间区别的建模，限制了技能在执行中的可检索性与可优化性。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：1）共识门控演化——通过多轮评估确保更新的有效性；2）表示专业化——基于优化轨迹中的信号选择最优结构表示（扁平/图/混合）。
AI.result: 在六项基准和三种语言模型上，相比SkillOpt，SkillSpec平均提升成功率达6.89%，验证了其在知识保留与结构优化上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 可靠技能演化与表示专业化分别解决了‘保留什么知识’与‘如何组织知识’的核心问题，二者协同提升了模型推理性能。

title: Smoother Flow Matching via Contrastive Trajectory Repulsion
summary: Trajectory crossing remains a critical bottleneck in Flow Matching (FM), and previous works typically view these crossings from a theoretical optimization perspective causing velocity averaging. They attempt to address it indirectly by post-hoc distillation or endpoint coupling, without explicitly regulating the intermediate trajectories. In this paper, we introduce a new network learning perspective: crossing points inherently induce large local Lipschitz constants in the target velocity field, leading to two drawbacks. First, high Lipschitz constants correspond to high-frequency signals in the velocity field that neural networks struggle to fit due to spectral bias. Second, they also imply drastic velocity variations, leading to severe numerical integration errors in few-step inference. To alleviate this, we propose CoFlow, a framework that introduces the contrastive learning paradigm into FM to explicitly repel trajectories during training, thereby lowering the local Lipschitz constants of the velocity field. Specifically, we formulate CoFlow from a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) perspective by injecting a repulsive drift term. This drift actively guides the forward process of positive samples away from negative trajectories, effectively reducing the local Lipschitz constant. Furthermore, we derive an equivalent stochastic interpolant formulation from this SDE, providing a simple and tractable design space to control the influence of negative samples. Extensive experiments on ImageNet 256x256 demonstrate that CoFlow significantly reduces FID compared to standard FM in few-step inference (e.g., 20 steps), with no added training overhead. The code can be accessed at: https://github.com/HKUST-LongGroup/CoFlow

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoFlow框架，通过对比学习思想在流匹配（FM）中显式排斥轨迹，降低速度场的局部Lipschitz常数，从而缓解轨迹交叉问题。从随机微分方程（SDE）视角引入排斥漂移项，引导正样本远离负轨迹，并推导出等价的随机插值形式以灵活控制负样本影响。实验表明，该方法在少步推理（如20步）下显著降低FID，且无需额外训练开销。
AI.motivation: 轨迹交叉是流匹配中的关键瓶颈，传统方法从优化理论角度处理，通过后处理或端点耦合间接缓解，但未显式调控中间轨迹，导致速度场存在高Lipschitz常数，引发神经网络拟合困难和数值积分误差。
AI.method: 从SDE视角引入排斥漂移项，构建具有对比学习特性的流匹配框架；通过设计反向过程中的排斥机制，降低速度场局部Lipschitz常数，并推导出可解释的随机插值形式以灵活调节负样本影响。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256数据集上，CoFlow在少步推理（如20步）下显著降低FID，性能优于标准流匹配，且训练无额外开销。
AI.conclusion: CoFlow通过引入对比学习与排斥机制，有效缓解轨迹交叉带来的高Lipschitz问题，提升流匹配在少步生成中的质量与稳定性，为高效生成模型设计提供了新思路。

title: Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects
comment: Accepted to the Third NeurIPS Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale: Data Attribution and Provenance. 4 pages, 0 figures, 1 table. An aggregate reproducibility package is available from the authors on request!
summary: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. Two faithful-only manifests are scenario-seed-disjoint and immutably versioned, while exact upstream attribution remains blocked by floating generator aliases, missing per-clip TTS and code stamps, and an unversioned checking prompt. We argue that generation provenance is necessary but not sufficient for behavior attribution: it defines the candidate causal graph and audit units, whereas contributive attribution still requires frozen training runs and intervention or influence evidence. The paper contributes a compact provenance contract, an audit protocol, and a bounded case study for synthetic-data attribution; controlled research access may be offered, but we do not claim causal training-data attribution, clinical validity, or unrestricted public release.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种生成溯源基础架构，将合成研究对象的源规范、生成内容、波形、目标、事实要求、质量信号、审核轨迹和不可变标识绑定在一起，以支持模型行为归因。尽管该架构能定义候选因果图和审计单元，但仅靠生成溯源仍不足以实现行为归因，还需冻结训练过程及干预或影响证据。研究通过一个私有的日本护理交接管道进行审计，涵盖113个资产，总时长1.552小时，包含六类场景的合成语音及其关联文本、候选笔记和事实清单，但人工证据具有选择性和源特定性。两个仅忠实的版本在场景与种子上互不重叠且不可变版本化，但上游溯源受限于浮动的生成器别名、缺失的逐片段TTS与代码戳记，以及未版本化的检查提示。论文贡献了一个紧凑的溯源契约、审计协议和受控案例研究，但不主张因果数据归因、临床有效性或公开发布。
AI.motivation: 现有方法中，波形-标签对无法保留生成来源信息，导致难以追溯模型行为的成因。为解决合成数据在模型行为归因中的可追溯性问题，需建立具备完整生成溯源能力的基础架构。
AI.method: 提出生成-溯源基础架构，整合源规范、生成内容、音频、目标、事实要求、质量信号、审核记录与不可变身份；设计审计协议并应用于日本护理交接场景的合成语音数据集，验证其在追踪生成来源和支撑审计方面的有效性。
AI.result: 在113个资产的合成语音数据集中，实现了跨场景、跨种子的不可变版本化，建立了完整的溯源链条，但因生成器别名浮动、缺乏逐片段TTS/代码戳记、检查提示未版本化等问题，仍无法实现完全上游溯源。审计结果表明生成溯源是行为归因的前提条件，但非充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 生成溯源是实现模型行为归因的关键前提，能够定义候选因果图和审计单位，但真正的贡献归因仍需依赖冻结的训练过程及干预或影响证据。本文构建了紧凑的溯源契约与审计框架，为合成数据研究提供可审计基础，但不承诺因果归因或公共开放。

title: Universal Byte-Level Encoding: UTF-8/UTF-16 Routing to Reduce Cross-Script Token-Budget Disparities
summary: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for multilingual large language models (LLMs) because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor. A higher floor can increase token counts and per-request cost and shrink usable context. Changing the text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE)，一种双字母表分词器，通过将3-4字节UTF-8字符路由至UTF-16，降低高溢价语言脚本的编码底限，同时不增加已高效英语片段的成本，实现跨语言令牌预算均衡并提升上下文利用率。
AI.motivation: 解决多语言大模型中基于UTF-8的字节级BPE分词器因高编码底限导致的高令牌数量和成本问题，尤其在高溢价脚本中；避免单一全局编码对高效语言段落造成额外开销。
AI.method: 设计UBE分词器，保留1-2字节字符走UTF-8路径，3-4字节字符经由UTF-16路径，仅改变输入到BPE的字节表示，保持标准合并规则与精确解码。
AI.result: 在Unicode 17审计中实现所有标量值及测试套件的精确往返；减少英语归一化后令牌数比率的离散性，降低跨语言令牌预算差异；多语言模型实验中性能与BBPE相当，显著降低高溢价脚本的令牌数，轻微增加英语令牌数，提升上下文可用性和处理速度。
AI.conclusion: UBE有效降低多语言场景下高溢价语言的编码成本，维持整体模型质量的同时优化资源利用，在固定令牌预算下提升效率与可扩展性。

title: Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）在算法、定理、药物等新发现任务中，通过迭代优化目标进行发现的成功与先前迭代种群之间的关系。研究提出了一套名为‘Modular’的12种新型优化框架，并在5个不同发现任务中评估其表现，发现发现成功率对框架设计极为敏感，且普遍存在模式坍缩（mode collapse）现象，即迭代多样性显著下降。尽管现有先进框架和多样性增强策略试图延缓这一问题，但效果不一致。研究发现早期发现的表现可有效预测最终成功，因此提出一种通用干预方法：在迭代优化前引入并行探索阶段以优化初始化。该方法在多种框架和应用中均带来稳定提升，验证了初始化在LLM驱动发现中的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 探究大型语言模型在科学发现任务中迭代优化过程的可靠性，识别影响发现成功率的关键因素，尤其是优化框架设计的影响，以及如何通过改进初始化策略提升整体性能。
AI.method: 开发一套名为'Modular'的12种模块化优化框架；在5个不同发现任务上系统评估其性能；分析迭代过程中种群多样性的变化，识别模式坍缩现象；通过实验验证早期发现表现与最终成功的关系；提出基于并行探索的初始化干预策略，并在多场景下验证其有效性。
AI.result: 发现发现成功率高度依赖于优化框架设计，且普遍存在模式坍缩问题；现有多样性干预策略效果不稳定；早期发现表现具有强预测能力；提出的并行探索初始化方法在多种框架和任务中均带来一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的发现任务中，初始种群的质量和多样性至关重要；通过引入并行探索阶段进行初始化，可显著提升后续迭代优化的成功率；该策略具有广泛适用性，为未来优化框架设计提供了重要指导。

title: Localisation-Aware Uncertainty for Pretrained Object Detection
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors when distribution/covariate shift and adversarial attacks may occur. Existing approaches often require detector retraining, architectural modification, or repeated inference, which may be infeasible or incur significant overheads. We introduce a lightweight post-hoc evidential meta-model that learns when object localisations should be considered uncertain while keeping the base detector frozen. Our approach automatically identifies localisation-relevant features and uses saliency-guided modification to construct an increasingly challenging curriculum. Detection-level targets combine localisation error, modification level, and prediction instability to guide an evidential meta-model to estimate uncertainty for each predicted bounding box. Our approach requires no changes to the detector and preserves its original localisation outputs.
