AI.method: 提出SourceLearn框架，包含两个互补机制：1）自导向源学习（识别理解不充分部分并主动重访源）；2）任务引导源学习（利用下游任务经验发现局部表征缺陷与组织需求），并通过权威源进行持续更新。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试和三种LLM后端上，SourceLearn在13/15设置中表现最佳，相比Hybrid RAG最高提升22.6分，显著优于静态源表示和基于经验的记忆基线。
AI.conclusion: SourceLearn有效实现了对持久性外部知识源的渐进式学习，使模型能够构建并持续改进对源内容的深层理解，为复杂任务中的知识利用提供了新范式。

title: Scalable Multi-Task Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: By learning transferable rewards, inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) enables counterfactual evaluation of agents under modified environments. Such transfer places strict requirements on coverage since target environments affect agents' state occupancy. We propose a multi-task IRL method that pools data across multiple agents with different rewards in the same environment under a low-rank assumption. In addition to alleviating coverage requirements, so each task need not visit every state as long as others do, the method offers scalable evaluation of multiple tasks under new environments as computationally intensive planning scales with rank rather than the number of tasks. We provide finite sample guarantees on reward recovery and on policy learning in new environments. Experiments show our method is robust to limited coverage, recovers rewards on and off of each task's support, transfers to target environments at lower regret than baselines, with its computational advantage over per-task methods widening as tasks grow.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多任务逆强化学习方法，在低秩假设下跨多个具有不同奖励的代理共享数据，降低对状态覆盖的要求，并实现可扩展的多任务评估。该方法在新环境中能以更低遗憾值转移，且计算优势随任务数量增加而扩大。
AI.motivation: 传统逆强化学习在环境改变时面临严格的覆盖要求，因为目标环境会影响代理的状态占用。为解决此问题，需减少对每个任务完整状态覆盖的需求，并提高多任务评估的可扩展性。
AI.method: 基于低秩假设，通过多任务学习将多个代理在相同环境中的数据进行聚合，从而共享信息，降低对单个任务状态覆盖的要求。同时利用低秩结构使计算复杂度与任务数无关，仅依赖于秩，提升计算效率。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在有限覆盖条件下仍具鲁棒性，能够恢复任务支持内和外的奖励；在目标环境中的转移遗憾低于基线方法；随着任务数量增加，相比逐任务方法的计算优势愈发明显。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的多任务逆强化学习方法有效缓解了状态覆盖限制，实现了高效、可扩展的多任务策略评估与迁移，具备良好的理论保证和实际性能。

title: SuperMotion: Source-Preserving Denoising for Text-Driven Human Motion Editing
summary: Text-driven human motion editing aims to realize a requested change while preserving compatible source content. Existing diffusion editors rely largely on learned conditioning for preservation of the unedited part, yet their outputs can lose temporal detail as denoising proceeds. We propose the \textbf{Source-Preserving Denoising framework (SuperMotion)}, which explicitly reuses the source at each reverse step for source preservation. We first align the source motion to the output timeline and predict a preservation gate that controls reuse across frames and feature dimensions. A clean-space source anchor then utilizes the learned preservation gate to blend the predicted clean motion with the aligned source and passes the corrected estimate directly to the sampling posterior. Because the aligned source is a realized motion rather than a regression output, the anchor injects sample-level temporal detail that a reconstruction-trained denoiser tends to smooth away. To learn effective source reuse, we supervise the anchored estimate against the editing target and match its second temporal differences through a temporal high-frequency loss. These objectives require no explicit edit masks. Extensive experiments show that SuperMotion improves editing accuracy, reaching 33.20\% full-pool R@1 on MotionFix, while reducing temporal-detail attenuation and preserving motion dynamics as it realizes the requested changes. Ablations confirm that the learned preservation gate is responsible for the gain and that it reuses the source to retain the unedited content properly.

AI.tldr: SuperMotion提出一种源保持去噪框架，通过在每个反向步骤中显式重用源运动来保留未编辑部分的时序细节。该方法通过时间对齐源运动、预测保留门控，并利用干净空间中的源锚点融合预测的干净运动与对齐源，从而注入样本级时序细节。通过针对编辑目标和高阶时间差分的监督学习，无需显式编辑掩码即可实现精确编辑，显著提升编辑准确性并减少时序细节衰减。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散编辑方法依赖于学习到的条件来保持未编辑部分，但在去噪过程中容易丢失时序细节。为解决这一问题，需要一种能够显式保留源运动信息的方法，以维持动作的动态性和时序精细度。
AI.method: SuperMotion框架包括：1）将源动作对齐至输出时间线；2）预测一个控制跨帧和特征维度重用的保留门控；3）使用干净空间中的源锚点，结合保留门控将预测的干净运动与对齐源融合，生成修正估计，并直接传递给采样后验。
AI.result: 在MotionFix数据集上达到33.20%的全池R@1，显著提升编辑准确性，同时有效减少时序细节衰减，更好地保留运动动态。消融实验表明，学习到的保留门控是性能提升的关键，能正确重用源内容以保持未编辑部分。
AI.conclusion: SuperMotion通过显式重用源运动并在反向过程中注入样本级时序细节，实现了更准确且保真的文本驱动动作编辑，解决了传统扩散模型中因去噪导致的时序信息损失问题。

title: Rethinking Probability-Based Reinforcement Learning From Posterior Concentration
summary: Verifier-free reinforcement learning with probability-based rewards offers a promising way to train LLMs on general reasoning tasks where external verifiers are unavailable. Yet the reliability of these rewards, especially in long-horizon reasoning, remains underexplored. This work identifies a length-dependent failure mode of probability rewards, which we call the Posterior Concentration Phenomenon (PCP). We show that the probability of a reference answer conditioned on a reasoning trace often collapses to a low-variance interval as the trace becomes lengthy. This phenomenon results in nearly indistinguishable rewards, which, under GRPO-based settings, makes probability-based policy optimization unstable and inefficient. Motivated by this, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Concentration-aware Posterior Rewards (RLCPR), a verifier-free RL framework to explicitly account for PCP for better optimization stability and token efficiency. It has two components: uncertainty-aware data sampling, which reduces concentration-prone rollouts before generation, and concentration-aware regularization, which penalizes unnecessarily long traces when posterior rewards collapse. Extensive experiments show that, alongside higher token efficiency, RLCPR outperforms the state-of-the-art verifier-free RL baseline by up to 4.0% on six of seven benchmarks, including general-domain and mathematical reasoning challenges.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为RLCPR的无验证器强化学习框架，以应对概率奖励在长序列推理中因后验集中现象（PCP）导致的奖励不可区分问题。通过不确定性感知的数据采样和集中度感知正则化，显著提升了策略优化的稳定性和生成效率。实验表明，RLCPR在多个基准测试中优于现有最优方法，最高提升达4.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于概率奖励的无验证器强化学习在长序列推理中面临奖励不可区分的问题，源于后验概率随推理长度增加而趋于集中，导致优化不稳定与低效。
AI.method: 提出RLCPR框架，包含两个核心组件：1）不确定性感知数据采样，减少高集中风险的生成轨迹；2）集中度感知正则化，惩罚过长且后验奖励已集中的推理路径。
AI.result: 在七个基准任务中，包括通用领域和数学推理，RLCPR在保持更高生成效率的同时，性能优于当前最先进的无验证器强化学习基线，有六项任务提升最高达4.0%。
AI.conclusion: 后验集中现象是影响概率奖励可靠性的关键因素，而提出的RLCPR框架能有效缓解该问题，显著提升无验证器强化学习在复杂推理任务中的稳定性与效率。

title: AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on coding tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, summaries, and actions after compaction. Flawed outputs are replaced with corrected ones before being executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then jointly optimize coding and compaction through reinforcement learning with task-success rewards. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show that AutoCompact improves pass rates over the base model by an absolute 9.2\% and 5.0\%, respectively. The improvements hold across all evaluated inference budgets, with a 256K context window that never overflows and with a 16K window whose overflow triggers fallback compaction.

AI.tldr: AutoCompact 是一种训练编码代理在执行软件工程任务时自主决定何时压缩、保留何种工作状态并从中继续的机制。通过结合监督微调与强化学习，该方法显著提升了任务成功率，尤其在有限上下文窗口下表现优异。
AI.motivation: 在长轨迹的代码编辑任务中，早期探索信息会随时间变得过时，传统上下文管理仅避免溢出不足以应对动态需求，因此需要智能决策机制来判断何时压缩、保留什么状态以及如何恢复。
AI.method: 使用裁判评估基础代理在任务中的压缩决策、摘要和压缩后的操作；将错误输出替换为修正版本，并让轨迹从修正点继续执行以生成高质量训练数据；采用监督微调和联合强化学习优化编码与压缩策略。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-PolyBench Verified 数据集上，AutoCompact 相较于基线模型分别提升绝对 9.2% 和 5.0% 的通过率，且在不同推理预算下均表现稳定，包括 256K 无溢出和 16K 溢出触发回退压缩的场景。
AI.conclusion: AutoCompact 成功将上下文管理纳入编码代理的决策过程，实现高效的状态压缩与延续，显著增强复杂软件任务的完成能力，尤其适用于受限上下文环境。

title: Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints
summary: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Grafting的新方法，用于在不重新训练模型的情况下高效实施预训练干预。该方法通过在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，然后将学习到的权重更新添加到已后训练的模型中，从而近似于忠实的中期训练过程。实验表明，Grafting在安装目标信念方面效果与后训练SDF相当，同时显著减少现实漂移和偏好一致性损失，且无需重新训练，支持快速迭代。
AI.motivation: 现有合成文档微调（SDF）方法通常应用于已后训练的模型，导致残留物、能力下降及现实漂移问题。由于每次修改预训练语料库都需要完整的后训练流程才能评估效果，迭代成本高且效率低。因此需要一种更高效、低成本的替代方案来实现有效的预训练干预。
AI.method: 提出Grafting方法：先在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，再将学习到的权重更新注入已后训练的模型中，实现对预训练干预的近似模拟，而无需重新进行后训练。
AI.result: Grafting在安装虚假事实、训练错误对齐模型以及宪法式中期干预等任务中表现优异；相比传统SDF，其平均减少超过一半的现实漂移和偏好一致性损失，并更接近真实的中期训练结果；且可复用于任意后续检查点，大幅提高迭代效率。
AI.conclusion: Grafting提供了一种高效、低成本的预训练干预方式，能够在不进行后训练的前提下实现强效信念植入，有效缓解现实漂移问题，显著提升研究迭代速度与模型行为可控性。

title: Synthetic training for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation in data-scarce settings
summary: Cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) and cortical superficial siderosis (cSS) are imaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease, but their automated segmentation is limited by the scarcity of positive cases and voxel-level annotations. We propose a synthetic training framework for long-tail haemorrhagic lesion segmentation that requires no real lesion annotations for training and leverages radiological description of the lesions. Starting from anatomical brain parcellations, the framework applies spatial augmentation and voxel resampling, procedurally inserts cSS and CMB labels using clinical priors on lesion location and morphology, and synthesises images through randomised intensity assignment, blurring, and Rician noise simulation. Models were trained on dynamically generated image-label pairs and evaluated against manual delineations in 10 cSS cases and 13 CMB cases. The proposed configurations outperformed classical filter baselines. For cSS, the hypointensity constrained model achieved higher AUPRC and AUROC than the Frangi filter (AUPRC: 0.284 vs 0.083; AUROC: 0.907 vs 0.731). For CMBs, explicit synthesis of blood vessels as lesion mimics improved performance over the classical baseline (AUPRC: 0.538 vs 0.004; AUROC: 0.999 vs 0.968). These results support our proposal as a feasible strategy for data-scarce haemorrhagic lesion segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需真实病灶标注的合成训练框架，用于长尾出血性病灶分割，利用临床先验知识生成cSS和CMB的模拟图像与标签，通过空间增强、体素重采样及随机强度分配等方法实现数据合成，模型在少量真实标注上表现优于传统滤波方法。
AI.motivation: 现有脑微出血（CMBs）和皮层表浅铁沉积（cSS）的自动化分割受限于阳性病例稀缺和体素级标注不足，亟需无需真实病灶标注的训练方法。
AI.method: 基于解剖脑分区，结合空间增强、体素重采样，利用临床先验知识（位置与形态）程序化插入cSS和CMB标签，通过随机强度分配、模糊处理和瑞利噪声模拟生成合成图像，动态构建图像-标签对进行模型训练。
AI.result: 在10例cSS和13例CMB的真实标注上评估，所提方法性能显著优于经典滤波基线：cSS任务中，受抑制的低信号模型在AUPRC（0.284 vs 0.083）和AUROC（0.907 vs 0.731）上更优；CMB任务中，显式合成血管作为假病灶模仿物使AUPRC（0.538 vs 0.004）和AUROC（0.999 vs 0.968）大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 该合成训练框架为数据稀缺的出血性病灶分割提供了可行解决方案，具备良好泛化能力与临床应用潜力。

title: NextMe-800: Anticipating Personal Behavior from Months of Egocentric Video
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Dataset and benchmark: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mmm8383/NextMe-800 ; project page: https://kkkkawayi.github.io/nextme-800/
summary: We often plan ambitiously yet act habitually and wonder, in retrospect, whether we would have planned differently had we known what we would actually do. Hindsight offers a valuable perspective on past decisions, although we often wish we could have simulated hindsight at the moment of choosing. If a system could generate plausible trajectories from one's personal history, such previews might help people formulate more realistic plans and make better informed decisions. We introduce NextMe-800, an approximately 800-hour first-person dataset from one volunteer over 126 days with 1 Hz images, gaze, and audio, captioned at five hierarchical abstraction levels from atomic actions to major activities. We formulate personalized action anticipation as open-vocabulary K-step sequence prediction and construct NextAct, a 1,500-point benchmark combining NextMe-800 with the multi-person EgoLife dataset. Using an embedding-based soft edit distance as the metric, we evaluate how well different models can anticipate personal behavior across abstraction levels and prediction horizons. NextMe-800 and NextAct provide a months-long resource and evaluation framework for studying how far ahead personal behavior can be anticipated from egocentric observation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了NextMe-800，一个约800小时的一人视角数据集，涵盖126天内每秒的图像、注视和音频，并在五个层次上进行标注。研究提出个性化行为预测作为开放词汇的K步序列预测任务，并构建了包含NextMe-800与多人群体EgoLife数据集的NextAct基准测试（1,500个点）。通过基于嵌入的软编辑距离评估不同模型在不同抽象层级和预测范围下的表现，验证了从第一人称观察中预测个人行为的能力。
AI.motivation: 人们常制定雄心勃勃的计划，却按习惯行动，事后常后悔若能预知实际行为会做出不同选择。若系统能生成基于个人历史的合理行为轨迹，将有助于制定更现实的计划并做出更明智决策。因此，需要一种能模拟“事前洞察”的机制，以提升决策质量。
AI.method: 将个性化行为预测建模为开放词汇的K步序列预测任务；利用嵌入表示计算软编辑距离，评估模型在不同抽象层次与预测时间跨度下的表现；结合NextMe-800与EgoLife数据集构建跨场景、多抽象层级的基准测试NextAct。
AI.result: NextMe-800和NextAct为研究长期个人行为预测提供了长达数月的数据资源与评估框架，证明了从第一人称视角可实现一定程度的未来行为预测，且模型性能随抽象层级和预测时长变化而异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一个大规模、多层次的第一人称行为数据集与评估体系，展示了通过个人历史数据预判未来行为的可行性，为未来智能辅助决策系统的发展提供了重要基础。

title: Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为分层连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM）的新方法，通过将离散标记生成与连续潜在轨迹耦合在一个统一的去噪过程中，解决了现有离散和连续扩散语言模型在并行解码时缺乏统计依赖性和有效性的问题。该方法利用变分界推导训练目标，使潜在状态成为唯一的持续生成状态，每次迭代中从潜在状态读取标记，并作为下一次更新的支架。在结构化推理（如数独）、数学规划（如计数游戏）和语言建模任务上，相比同规模基线模型，性能均有提升。
AI.motivation: 现有离散扩散语言模型在并行解码时独立采样每个词元，导致词元间的统计依赖被切断；而连续扩散模型虽然能通过共享连续状态避免此问题，但其去噪器仅看到潜在状态，直到最终解码才与有效词元配置关联。因此需要一种既能保持全局依赖性又能确保生成有效性的一致框架。
AI.method: 提出分层连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM），将离散词元生成与连续潜在轨迹联合建模于同一去噪过程中，使用变分下界作为训练目标。潜在状态是唯一持久的生成状态，每一步从中读出词元，并反馈作为下一阶段潜在状态更新的引导信号。
AI.result: 在数独、计数游戏等结构化推理任务及语言建模任务（LM1B）上，HC-DLM 在相同模型规模下优于离散和连续扩散基线，在数独和计数游戏上的谜题准确率以及在LM1B上的生成困惑度均取得改进。
AI.conclusion: HC-DLM 通过将离散词元生成与连续潜在轨迹深度融合，实现了更有效的并行生成，克服了现有方法的结构性瓶颈，为需要双向推理和全局约束满足的任务提供了更强有力的生成框架。

title: Localizing Transfer Between Memorization Tasks
comment: 17 pages, 10 figures. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
summary: A central puzzle in transfer learning is why pre-training on one task can accelerate training or improve performance on another task, and what mechanisms underlie this transfer. In this work, we examine the transfer between memorization tasks of random input-output mappings. We find two surprising transfer patterns: equivalent transfer, where each additional pre-training epoch saves approximately one downstream fine-tuning epoch; and non-equivalent transfer, where pre-training on a mismatched task can be even more efficient than directly training on the downstream task itself. Through ablation experiments, we decompose and localize the transfer into two separate effects: a "trivial" magnitude-driven transfer in the last layer, and a "non-trivial" structure-driven transfer, partially attributable to the covariance of the other layers. These results advance our understanding of the underlying mechanisms of transfer learning and have the potential to lead to principled pre-training strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务之间迁移学习的现象，发现两种意外的迁移模式：等效迁移（每多一个预训练轮次可节省约一个微调轮次）和非等效迁移（在不匹配的任务上预训练可能比直接在下游任务上训练更高效）。通过消融实验，作者将迁移分解为两个独立效应：最后一层的‘平凡’幅度驱动迁移，以及由其他层协方差导致的‘非平凡’结构驱动迁移。这些发现深化了对迁移学习机制的理解，并可能推动系统性预训练策略的发展。
AI.motivation: 理解为何在某一任务上进行预训练能够加速或提升另一任务上的训练表现，揭示迁移学习背后的机制。
AI.method: 研究随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务间的迁移，通过消融实验分解并定位迁移效应，分析最后一层的幅度影响与其他层的结构影响。
AI.result: 发现等效迁移与非等效迁移现象；识别出平凡的幅度驱动迁移与非平凡的结构驱动迁移，后者部分归因于中间层的协方差。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习的机制可被分解为幅度与结构两方面的影响，其中结构驱动迁移具有显著潜力，有助于设计更有效的预训练策略。

title: Revisiting Cross-Reconstruction for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
summary: Existing image forgery detectors often suffer from generalization to unseen manipulation methods due to the limited ability to capture transferable forensic cues. Recent cross-reconstruction based methods attempt to improve generalization through semantic-artifact disentanglement, but typically align heterogeneous artifacts across generators and exclude artifact representations during reconstruction, which may overlook the inherent diversity and visual cues of manipulation artifacts. In this work, we revisit cross-reconstruction and introduce an artifact-oriented disentanglement framework for robust image forgery detection. We argue that \textbf{artifact diversity}, i.e., the intrinsic variations of manipulation artifacts introduced by different generation processes, contains complementary forensic cues rather than undesirable domain variations. Instead of enforcing explicit artifact alignment, our framework preserves diverse artifact characteristics through semantically aligned cross-generator reconstruction. Furthermore, we incorporate artifact representations into the reconstruction process and introduce a masked frequency-aware reconstruction strategy to emphasize manipulation-related residuals while reducing semantic interference. This design enables the model to learn transferable forensic representations from diverse artifacts. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate improvements under both cross-dataset and cross-generator evaluation settings. Further analysis and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of artifact diversity preservation and artifact-aware cross-reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向伪造图像检测的基于艺术特征的解耦框架，强调保留不同生成过程引入的伪造痕迹多样性，通过语义对齐的跨生成器重建和掩码频率感知策略，增强模型对可迁移取证特征的学习能力。在多个基准数据集上验证了其在跨数据集和跨生成器设置下的优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图像伪造检测方法在面对未见过的篡改方法时泛化能力不足，主要因为难以捕捉可迁移的取证线索。尽管近期基于跨重建的方法尝试通过语义-伪影解耦提升泛化性，但通常强制对齐异质伪影并排除伪影表示，可能忽略伪造痕迹的内在多样性和视觉线索。
AI.method: 提出一种以伪影为导向的解耦框架，不强制对齐伪影，而是通过语义对齐的跨生成器重建保留伪影多样性；将伪影表示融入重建过程，并采用掩码频率感知重建策略，突出与篡改相关的残差，减少语义干扰。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在跨数据集和跨生成器评估设置下均取得显著性能提升。消融实验和分析进一步验证了保留伪影多样性及伪影感知跨重建设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 伪影多样性包含互补的取证线索，而非有害的域差异。通过保留伪影特性并引入伪影感知重建机制，模型能更有效地学习可迁移的取证表示，从而提升伪造检测的鲁棒性。

title: Auditing Routing Entropy as an Uncertainty Signal in Attention-Residual Transformers
summary: Dynamic architectures leave a per-example routing trace beside each prediction, and diffuse routing is easy to read as a sign that the prediction is unreliable. We audit that reading for routing entropy in Attention-Residual (AR) variants of Swin-Tiny and DeiT-Small, trained from scratch on CIFAR-10/100 with a soft-binned calibration auxiliary loss, asking whether the trace carries information about correctness beyond what the model's own confidence already reveals. Three checks probe this increment: does a routing signal appear at fixed confidence, does it replicate across training seeds, and can a held-out predictor exploit it against output-only and shuffled-trace controls? A sensitivity audit then injects effects of known size and measures the fraction of each that the probes recover. No test in the fixed 30-test binned family survives multiplicity correction, and neither the nominal hit nor a borderline result recurs in its sibling seeds. Across 24 paired runs a scalar routing probe yields no pooled improvement in routing-stratified calibration, and an entropy-profile probe predicts correctness better than the same probe given shuffled profiles yet worse than a confidence-only predictor in both binary log-loss and Brier score: a gain over shuffled traces does not become a gain over the output. Conditioning on the complete logit vector leaves the corresponding comparison unresolved. The audit bounds how far these non-detections can be read: at an injected effect of 0.010 nats the profile probe recovers 24-59% of the oracle gain, and a reference-preserving correction probe recovers 8% and 23% in the two CIFAR-100 settings, below the threshold we fixed for applying it to real labels. The results establish control-dependent gains and incomplete estimator recovery, not the absence of conditional routing information.

AI.tldr: 该研究审计了Attention-Residual (AR) 变体（Swin-Tiny 和 DeiT-Small）在 CIFAR-10/100 上从头训练时，路由熵是否携带超出模型置信度的信息。通过三重检验和敏感性分析发现，路由信号在固定置信度下不显著，跨训练种子不可复现，且无法在保留输出或打乱路由轨迹的对照中取得优势。尽管熵轮廓探针在打乱轨迹上表现优于随机，但整体仍劣于仅基于置信度的预测器。结果表明，当前方法无法有效检测到条件路由信息，但不能排除其存在；同时揭示了控制依赖性增益与估计器恢复不完全的问题。
AI.motivation: 探究动态架构中路由熵是否提供额外的正确性判断信息，以评估模型对自身不确定性的表达能力，并验证路由痕迹是否可作为可靠可信度指标。
AI.method: 采用三重检验：1）在固定置信度区间内检验路由信号是否存在；2）跨不同训练种子检验结果可复现性；3）使用保留输出与打乱路由轨迹的对照测试路由信号的可利用性。进一步进行敏感性审计，注入已知大小的效应并测量探针的恢复能力。使用标量路由探针和熵轮廓探针比较校准性能，在二元对数损失和Brier分数下评估预测效果。
AI.result: 所有固定30个测试分箱的检验均未通过多重检验校正；无显著结果在不同种子间重复出现。24次配对运行中，标量路由探针未提升分层校准性能；熵轮廓探针虽优于打乱轨迹，但劣于仅基于置信度的预测器。当注入效应为0.010 nats时，轮廓探针仅恢复24-59%的理论增益，参考保持修正探针恢复8%和23%，低于应用阈值。
AI.conclusion: 当前实验未能检测到路由熵提供超越置信度的可靠性信息，但不能断言不存在条件路由信息；结果强调控制依赖性增益和估计器恢复不完全的局限性，提示未来需更精细的方法来挖掘潜在路由信号。

title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://risys-lab.github.io/KaliBench/ | Github: https://github.com/RISys-Lab/KaliBench
summary: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KaliBench，一个针对Kali Linux的自然语言到命令行接口（CLI）转换的细粒度基准和数据集，包含8,504个查询-命令对，覆盖1,642个工具和23个能力维度。通过确定性归一化和别名感知评估，结合多阶段验证流程（LLM验证、沙盒执行、人工修正），实现对工具选择与参数构造的精确评估。该基准支持无需运行时的可验证奖励机制，用于模型训练。在多种配置下，无提示的开放权重模型最高准确率仅42%，表明直接生成可执行命令极具挑战性；而使用基于KaliBench的监督微调与强化学习后，8B模型性能显著提升，接近685B MoE模型水平。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法侧重知识或端到端代理任务，缺乏对大模型生成真实网络安全工具可执行命令能力的直接衡量。由于网络安全操作依赖严格的命令行接口，微小语法错误或参数错误即导致失败，因此亟需一个能精准评估自然语言转CLI能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建KaliBench数据集，采用基于手册的生成管道，进行确定性归一化和别名处理；设计多阶段验证流程，融合LLM验证、沙盒终端执行与人工修正；开发无需运行时的可验证奖励机制，支持模型训练优化。
AI.result: 在三种评估模式和24种模型配置中，无提示条件下所有开放权重模型最高仅达42%的精确命令准确率，说明直接生成正确命令难度极高；经监督微调与强化学习后，8B模型性能大幅提升，接近685B MoE模型表现。
AI.conclusion: KaliBench为评估大模型在真实网络安全场景中生成可执行命令的能力提供了可靠、细粒度且可复现的基准，证明了基于可验证奖励的训练策略对提升模型实际应用能力的有效性。

title: Learning Goal-Reaching Quasimetric Geometry From Finite-Time Reachability
summary: In goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), quasimetric learning models goal-reaching costs as quasimetric distances, connecting local constraints to global value geometry. Its local constraints, however, should reflect the direction- dependent effects of control composition over a finite horizon together with environmental feasibility. We propose ReQRL, which constrains the critic's value gradients through finite-horizon reachability. Drawing on state-constrained optimal control, we decouple dynamical reachability from boundary geometry, estimating both from data. On OGBench, our method outperforms or rivals existing quasimetric approaches and other offline GCRL methods.

AI.tldr: ReQRL 提出一种基于有限时域可达性的新方法，通过解耦动力学可达性与边界几何，改进了目标条件强化学习中的度量学习，提升了在 OGBench 基准上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有目标条件强化学习中的度量学习方法未能充分考虑控制组合的方向依赖效应和环境可行性，因此需要更精确的局部约束建模。
AI.method: 基于状态约束最优控制，通过数据估计动力学可达性和边界几何，并利用有限时域可达性约束评论家的价值梯度。
AI.result: 在 OGBench 上，ReQRL 在性能上优于或媲美现有的度量学习方法及其他离线目标条件强化学习方法。
AI.conclusion: ReQRL 有效结合了有限时域可达性与数据驱动估计，显著提升了目标条件强化学习中价值函数的几何建模精度和整体性能。

title: PAGER: Partial-to-global Alignment via Geometric and Relational Distillation
summary: Pretrained 3D encoders are typically developed on globally reconstructed scenes expressed in a consistent world coordinate frame, whereas embodied systems must reason from partial, viewpoint-dependent observations in camera coordinates. We show that this shift from globally learned 3D feature spaces to realistic partial observations exposes a severe representation mismatch, which we find consistently across representative state-of-the-art encoders, including Sonata and Concerto. A frozen Sonata encoder with a global linear probe achieves 72.47 mIoU on full ScanNet scenes, but 2.57 mIoU on single-frame camera-coordinate inputs. Training-free gravity alignment recovers performance to 41.64 mIoU, showing that coordinate-frame mismatch is a dominant source of degradation but cannot be fully resolved through canonicalization alone. We introduce PAGER, a label-free adaptation method that aligns partial-view features with a frozen global 3D semantic space using only paired partial/global geometry. It learns lightweight adaptation modules while keeping the pretrained encoder and global segmentation probe frozen. Matched-point feature alignment anchors partial features to their global counterparts, while relational supervision preserves their similarity structure with respect to the global representation. Global geometry provides supervision only during training. Inference operates directly on the partial observation. Without partial-view labels, PAGER outperforms label-supervised PEFT on both Sonata and Concerto, and in zero-shot ScanNet$\rightarrow$ScanNet++ transfer surpasses fully fine-tuned Sonata ($53.93$ vs.\ $48.09$ mIoU), suggesting that preserving the frozen global representation can improve cross-dataset transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了预训练3D编码器在全局重建场景与真实机器人系统局部视角观测之间的表征不匹配问题。发现即使最先进的编码器（如Sonata、Concerto）在全局坐标下表现良好，但在相机坐标下的单帧输入中性能急剧下降。提出PAGER方法，一种无需标签的自适应方法，通过配对的部分/全局几何信息，将局部特征对齐到冻结的全局语义空间，仅学习轻量级适配模块。该方法利用对应点特征对齐和关系监督来保持局部特征与全局表示的一致性。实验表明，PAGER在无标签情况下优于有监督的参数高效微调（PEFT），并在零样本跨数据集迁移任务中超越全微调的Sonata模型，证明保持冻结的全局表示有助于提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练3D编码器通常在全局一致坐标系下训练，但实际应用中机器人系统只能获取部分、视角依赖的局部观测，其坐标系为相机坐标，导致表征不匹配，严重影响性能。这种不匹配成为制约实际部署的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出PAGER（Partial-view Alignment with Global Representation），一种标签自由的自适应方法。利用配对的局部与全局几何数据，在训练阶段通过对应点特征对齐和关系结构监督，将局部特征映射至冻结的全局3D语义空间。模型仅学习轻量级适配模块，保持预训练编码器和全局分割探针不变。推理时直接处理局部观测，无需额外标签。
AI.result: PAGER在单帧相机坐标输入下显著提升性能：相比冻结的Sonata编码器（2.57 mIoU），经重力对齐后达41.64 mIoU；而PAGER进一步达到53.93 mIoU，优于全微调的Sonata（48.09 mIoU）。在零样本从ScanNet到ScanNet++迁移任务中表现最优，验证了保留全局表示对泛化的重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 表征不匹配是预训练3D编码器在局部观测下性能下降的核心原因。PAGER通过无需标签的几何引导对齐，有效缓解该问题，且在性能与泛化能力上均优于现有方法，强调了保持冻结全局表示在跨场景迁移中的价值。

title: OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation
comment: Accepted for oral presentation and publication at the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB) 2027
summary: Molecular tumor boards integrate genomic findings, clinical context, and therapeutic evidence to support precision oncology. As AI enters this workflow, a key safety challenge is distinguishing truly unsupported recommendations from evidence-supported options that still require oncologist review because of incomplete information, poor ECOG performance status, or other clinical caveats. We introduce OpenMTB-Audit, an open-source benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels: Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, and Insufficient Information. Across eight large language model configurations, we identify pervasive over-refusal: all LLM configurations failed to retain the Partially Supported label in 83.3-100% of true Partially Supported cases, achieving high aggregate safety scores through label collapse rather than clinically calibrated reasoning. To address this limitation, we developed MTB-AuditAgent, a deterministic seven-module framework separating evidence verification, missing-information detection, safety classification, and abstention. It reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%). A two-oncologist annotation study found disagreement concentrated at the boundary between information sufficiency and treatment optimization, underscoring the need to preserve clinically meaningful distinctions.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenMTB-Audit基准，评估大语言模型在肺癌精准治疗中的安全性表现，发现普遍存在过度拒绝问题；开发MTB-AuditAgent框架，通过模块化设计减少过早拒绝，提升准确率至91.2%。
AI.motivation: 在分子肿瘤委员会中，AI需区分真正无支持的建议与因信息不全或临床因素需医生审慎判断的建议，但现有大语言模型常出现过度拒绝，影响临床可用性。
AI.method: 构建包含500个合成非小细胞肺癌病例的OpenMTB-Audit基准，涵盖五类对抗性错误和四类安全标签；测试八种大语言模型配置，并设计MTB-AuditAgent——一个七模块确定性框架，实现证据验证、缺失信息检测、安全分类与拒答分离。
AI.result: 所有大语言模型在83.3%-100%的‘部分支持’案例中丢失该标签，导致标签坍塌；而MTB-AuditAgent将过早拒绝降至6.7%，准确率达91.2%（95%置信区间：88.6-93.6%），且两肿瘤科医生标注研究显示分歧集中于信息充分性与治疗优化边界。
AI.conclusion: 当前大语言模型在临床决策支持中存在显著过度拒绝缺陷，需通过结构化、可解释的框架如MTB-AuditAgent来保留临床意义区分，提升可信度与实用性。

title: Trajectory-Aware Clinical Risk Prediction via Severity-Grounded Knowledge Graphs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: While Electronic Health Records (EHRs) offer a wealth of clinical data, effectively augmenting a patient's records with heterogeneous external knowledge to predict the patient's clinical risk remains a significant challenge. Existing methods fail to capture disease severity, treatment responses, and nuanced clinical progression, due to data sparsity and the underutilization of unstructured clinical notes. To address these challenges, we propose TRACER (a trajectory-aware and clinically grounded prediction framework) that (1) constructs a medical knowledge graph enriched with severity information from medical literature, (2) retrieves clinically relevant, severity-weighted paths of a patient's progression from the knowledge graph, (3) extracts clinically relevant events from unstructured clinical notes, and (4) augments patient context with similar peer cases. Experiments on the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets demonstrate large gains over state-of-the-art baselines, with up to 28.5% increase in Macro F1 score for the mortality prediction task, and 19.7% increase for the readmission prediction task.

AI.tldr: TRACER是一个轨迹感知且基于临床的预测框架，通过构建带严重程度信息的医学知识图谱、检索患者进展的临床相关路径、从非结构化临床笔记中提取事件，并用相似同行病例增强患者上下文，显著提升了临床风险预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在利用异构外部知识增强电子健康记录以预测临床风险时，无法有效捕捉疾病严重程度、治疗反应和细微临床进展，主要受限于数据稀疏性和对非结构化临床笔记的低利用率。
AI.method: TRACER通过四个步骤实现：(1) 利用医学文献构建含严重程度信息的医学知识图谱；(2) 从知识图谱中检索与患者病程相关的、带严重程度权重的路径；(3) 从非结构化临床笔记中提取临床相关事件；(4) 通过相似同行病例增强患者上下文。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上的实验表明，TRACER在死亡率预测任务上相比最先进基线模型，宏F1分数提升高达28.5%；在再入院预测任务上提升19.7%。
AI.conclusion: TRACER通过融合结构化知识图谱、非结构化文本信息及同行病例上下文，显著提升了临床风险预测的准确性，为复杂临床决策支持提供了有力工具。

title: Training-Aware Target Coverage for Synthetic Data Selection
summary: Synthetic data are increasingly used to scale LLM training, yet more synthetic data do not necessarily produce better models. Useful synthetic data must add information relevant to the target task without introducing errors that offset their benefit, and the value of an example can change as the training set grows. We develop a linear theory that characterizes this tradeoff and determines where synthetic data are useful, how much should be added, and the marginal value of adding one example to an existing set. The analysis shows the conditions when input coverage alone is sufficient and when synthetic errors must also be considered. Guided by these results, we introduce \emph{Training-Aware Target Coverage} (TATC), a synthetic data selection method for LLM fine-tuning. TATC identifies candidates whose training effects are beneficial to the target task and selects among them to expand coverage of target-relevant directions not already represented by the available data. Experiments on text and image data verify the linear theory. With mathematical reasoning tasks, TATC selects synthetic solutions for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and outperforms alternative synthetic-data selection methods on GSM8K across selection budgets. In summary, we provide a principled approach to synthetic data selection by quantifying and maximizing its value to the target task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于线性理论的合成数据选择方法TATC，用于大语言模型微调。该方法通过量化合成数据对目标任务的价值，识别出能有效扩展目标相关方向覆盖的样本，从而在避免引入错误的同时提升模型性能。实验表明，TATC在数学推理任务上优于现有方法，尤其在不同预算下均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 合成数据虽广泛用于扩大大模型训练规模，但并非越多越好；其价值取决于是否带来与目标任务相关的有效信息，同时避免因错误抵消收益。因此需要一种能衡量和最大化合成数据价值的方法。
AI.method: 提出线性理论以分析合成数据的增益与误差之间的权衡，并据此设计了训练感知的目标覆盖（TATC）方法。TATC通过评估候选样本对目标任务的训练影响，选择那些能补充已有数据未覆盖的目标相关方向的样本。
AI.result: 在文本和图像数据上的实验验证了线性理论的有效性；在数学推理任务中，TATC显著提升了Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct模型在GSM8K基准上的表现，且在多种选择预算下均优于其他合成数据选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了一个基于量化价值的合成数据选择原则，能够有效提升合成数据对目标任务的贡献，实现更高效、更精准的大模型微调。

title: Before It Fades: Reinforcing Temporal Representations at Inference Time in VideoLLMs
summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) receive frames in sequential order and interpret how visual content evolves along the temporal axis, yet temporal reasoning remains a persistent weakness across architectures. Reversing the frame order of a video, a transformation that should invert temporal answers, often leaves the final prediction unchanged. We investigate where this failure originates by defining the temporal divergence vector $τ_l$, the layer-wise representational difference induced by reversing temporal order. Tracking its magnitude across layers reveals a consistent temporal divergence profile where the divergence peaks at intermediate layers and progressively diminishes toward the output. We confirm this peak is specific to temporal reasoning and functionally critical for predictions, establishing that VideoLLMs acquire temporal information at intermediate layers but fail to maintain it to the output. This progressive fading motivates our method, Temporal Activation Injection (TAI), which extracts $τ_l$ at the peak of the profile for each input and reinjects it into subsequent layers following the measured decay. TAI requires no training and consistently improves temporal reasoning across three VideoLLMs and four benchmarks with negligible impact on non-temporal tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/Youngwoo-git/Before-It-Fades.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究视频大语言模型（VideoLLMs）在时间推理上的弱点，发现反转视频帧顺序后预测结果不变，源于中间层的时间表征在传播过程中逐渐衰减。提出Temporal Activation Injection（TAI）方法，通过提取并重注入时间表征的峰值信息，在不需训练的情况下显著提升时间推理性能，且对非时间任务影响极小。
AI.motivation: VideoLLMs在处理视频时依赖帧的顺序，但其时间推理能力仍然薄弱，即使反转帧序，预测结果往往不变，表明模型未能有效保持和利用时间信息。
AI.method: 定义时间分歧向量τ_l，追踪其在各层的变化；识别出时间表征在中间层达到峰值并随深层传播而衰减；提出TAI方法，从峰值层提取τ_l并按衰减模式重注入后续层。
AI.result: TAI在三种VideoLLMs和四个基准上均显著提升时间推理性能，且对非时间任务几乎无负面影响，无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: VideoLLMs在中间层获取时间信息，但未能维持到输出层；通过TAI重注入关键时间表征可有效解决此问题，显著增强时间推理能力。

title: MCRI: A Four-Dimensional Framework for Analyzing and Evaluating Agent Skills
summary: As agents evolve from single-tool systems into modular, composite architectures, skills are becoming an important mechanism for capability development and distribution. However, the academic community lacks a structured framework for systematically analyzing and evaluating skills. Drawing on information gain and behavioral constraint, we propose the four-dimensional MCRI Framework and operationalize it as MCRI-Eval, a large language model-based evaluation method. We evaluate MCRI-Eval using 63,812 public skills from the OpenClaw skill Hub, with 58,275 skill-conditioned model executions across BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web. MCRI-Eval scores are positively associated with community popularity signals and achieve the highest downstream ranking agreement among the evaluated methods. MCRI-Eval also improves top-1 skill selection across all three benchmarks: compared with the strongest baseline on each benchmark, the skills selected by MCRI-Eval advance by 17.7, 22.8, and 19.6 percentile points in downstream performance rank on BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web, respectively. These results indicate that MCRI-Eval provides a useful pre-execution signal for prioritizing promising skills before costly execution-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出四维MCRI框架及其评估方法MCRI-Eval，基于大语言模型对63,812个公开技能进行评估，在三个基准上验证其有效性。MCRI-Eval得分与社区流行度正相关，并在下游排名一致性上表现最佳，显著提升技能选择的性能排名，证明其可作为低成本预执行信号用于优先筛选有潜力的技能。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体从单工具系统演变为模块化复合架构，技能成为能力发展与分配的关键机制，但学术界缺乏系统分析与评估技能的结构化框架。
AI.method: 基于信息增益与行为约束，提出四维MCRI框架，并构建基于大语言模型的评估方法MCRI-Eval，通过大规模技能条件下的模型执行进行验证。
AI.result: MCRI-Eval得分与社区流行度正相关，在三个基准上均实现最高下游排名一致性；相比最强基线，其选中的技能在性能排名上分别提升17.7、22.8和19.6百分点。
AI.conclusion: MCRI-Eval能有效提供预执行信号，帮助在高成本执行前优先筛选有前景的技能，具有实际应用价值。

title: Quantifying the Impact of Ambulance Ramping: A Multi-Year Analysis of Victorian Emergency Medical Services Cases
summary: Ambulance ramping, the delay between hospital arrival and patient handover, is a critical operational bottleneck in Emergency Medical Services (EMS), yet its systemic magnitude and dynamics remain inadequately characterised at scale. This paper quantifies the scale, trajectory, and operational correlates of ramping across an entire statewide EMS system, analysing 2,850,575 ambulance attendances in Victoria, Australia from January 2020 to March 2024 using an Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). After systematic preprocessing, an analytical cohort of 2,026,569 Emergency Department (ED) transports across 59 hospitals with ED and 79 Local Government Areas (LGA) was examined through interval decomposition, Pareto concentration, hourly cross-correlation, hospital arrival concurrency and priority-stratified operational comparisons. Cumulative Ambulance Hours Lost (AHL) totalled 1,491,127 hours, equivalent to approximately 96 ten-hour ambulance shift lost every day of the study window. Ten of 59 hospitals account for 57.8% of lost hours from 50.9% of cases. Annual losses rose 57% to a 2022 peak while transported demand fell 3.7%, indicating deterioration in per-case handover rather than growth in demand. Handover duration varies little with patient acuity, but rises monotonically with the number of ambulances arriving at the same hospital in the preceding hour, an effect persisting within every hour of the day. Hourly demand is moderately associated with ramping two to four hours later (r = 0.365). These findings establish the empirical preconditions for hospital-state aware ambulance routing.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过探索性数据分析（EDA）对澳大利亚维多利亚州整个州级急救医疗系统中的救护车滞留问题进行了大规模量化分析，涵盖2020年1月至2024年3月期间的285万次救护车出勤。研究发现，累计救护车延误时间达149万余小时，相当于每天损失约96个十小时救护车班次。仅10家医院就贡献了57.8%的延误时间，且手头交接时间随同一小时内到达的救护车数量增加而单调上升，与患者病情严重程度关系不大。需求量与后续2-4小时内的滞留存在中等正相关（r=0.365）。研究结果为实现基于医院状态的救护车调度提供了实证基础。
AI.motivation: 救护车滞留（ambulance ramping）是急救医疗服务中的关键运营瓶颈，但其在全州范围内的规模和动态特征尚未得到充分描述，亟需系统性量化以支持优化决策。
AI.method: 采用探索性数据分析（EDA），对维多利亚州2,850,575次救护车出勤数据进行系统预处理，构建包含59家有急诊科的医院和79个地方政府区域的分析队列，运用区间分解、帕累托集中度分析、小时级交叉相关性、医院到院并发性及按优先级分层的运营比较等方法进行分析。
AI.result: 累计救护车延误时间达1,491,127小时，相当于每日损失约96个十小时救护车班次；10家医院贡献了57.8%的延误时间，尽管它们处理了50.9%的病例；年度延误时间增长57%至2022年峰值，而转运需求下降3.7%，表明每例交接效率恶化；手头交接时间与患者病情严重程度关联小，但随前一小时内到达救护车数量增加而上升，且该趋势全天持续；小时级需求与2-4小时后的滞留呈中等正相关（r = 0.365）。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了救护车滞留的系统性规模与动态规律，为开发基于医院实时状态的智能救护车路由策略提供了坚实的实证依据。

title: Hob-VL: A Benchmark for Visually Grounded Boolean Reasoning
summary: Reliable visual reasoning requires composing multiple visual observations and returning consistent answers to logically equivalent questions. We introduce Hob-VL, a benchmark for visually grounded Boolean reasoning. Hob-VL comprises two tasks: (1) evaluating whether a Boolean rule holds in an image, and (2) identifying the (unique) object satisfying a Boolean description. Hob-VL contains 6,000 human-verified balanced Yes/No questions, each defined by a Boolean combination of ten visual statements, across 1,000 generated scenes and 46 diverse labeled photographs, along with 1,000 object-identification questions over the same photographs. Our question families are deliberately constructed to challenge reasoning through misleading local cues and nested logical operations, and include symbolic and structured natural-language presentations. Across eight model configurations with thinking disabled or minimized, Boolean accuracy ranges from 48.52% to 50.57%, while the identification accuracy reaches at most 43.0%. A thinking-enabled GLM configuration achieves uneven gains while retaining substantial errors and inconsistencies. Hob-VL exposes these failures through executable reference answers and matched evaluations.

AI.tldr: Hob-VL 是一个用于视觉基础布尔推理的基准测试，包含两个任务：判断图像中布尔规则是否成立，以及识别满足布尔描述的唯一对象。该基准涵盖6,000个经人工验证的平衡问答对，基于10个视觉陈述的布尔组合，在1,000个生成场景和46张标注照片上构建，并包含1,000个对象识别问题。题目设计挑战误导性局部线索与嵌套逻辑操作，支持符号化和结构化自然语言表达。在八种模型配置下，布尔准确率仅为48.52%至50.57%，对象识别最高仅达43.0%；启用思维能力的GLM模型虽有提升但仍有显著错误与不一致。该基准通过可执行参考答案与匹配评估揭示模型缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉推理模型在处理复杂布尔逻辑和多步推理时表现不佳，尤其在面对误导性视觉线索和嵌套逻辑时缺乏一致性。需要一个严格、可验证的基准来系统评估模型在视觉基础布尔推理方面的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建Hob-VL基准，包含两类任务：布尔规则验证与对象识别；设计6,000个平衡的Yes/No问题，基于10个视觉陈述的布尔组合；使用1,000个生成场景和46张真实照片；问题形式包括符号化与结构化自然语言；通过可执行参考答案进行精确评估。
AI.result: 在八种模型配置下，布尔推理准确率仅为48.52%~50.57%，对象识别准确率最高为43.0%；启用思维机制的GLM模型虽有提升，但仍存在显著错误与不一致性。
AI.conclusion: Hob-VL成功揭示了当前视觉推理模型在布尔逻辑与多步推理中的根本局限，强调需发展更强大的推理机制以实现可靠、一致的视觉理解。

title: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training
summary: An emerging hypothesis about reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs) is that it merely sharpens existing behaviors of a base model, improving single-shot accuracy at the cost of solution coverage. Although this trade-off has been observed in math and coding tasks, it need not extend to agentic tasks, where multi-turn tool use and interaction may require capabilities newly acquired during post-training. Our surprising finding is that pre-trained LLMs, equipped with a light inference harness, can serve as capable agents. Despite far lower accuracy (pass@1), they often surpass their post-trained counterparts in solution coverage (pass@K) given a sufficient test-time budget. We further analyze the underlying mechanism and show that post-training pushes tasks toward two extremes, always solved or never solved, and thereby improves sampling efficiency and consistency at the cost of solution coverage. To measure this cost, we propose Sharpening Tax, a diagnostic metric that quantifies the loss in test-time scalability after post-training. Across 14 base/post-trained model pairs from four families and three agentic benchmarks (42 cases in total), the tax is prevalent in most settings, can be estimated from a few rollouts, and correlates well with other metrics. Finally, we present posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS), a simple plug-and-play Bayesian sampler that adapts the sampling temperature per prompt to its estimated difficulty. Applied during RL training in two agentic environments, PTGS pays a smaller tax than the fixed-temperature baseline, solving more tasks under repeated sampling while also improving single-shot accuracy.

AI.tldr: 预训练的大语言模型在轻量推理框架下即可作为高效智能体，尽管单次采样准确率（pass@1）较低，但在足够测试预算下反而比后训练模型具有更高的解题覆盖率（pass@K）。后训练使任务趋向二元化：要么总能解决，要么永远无法解决，提升了采样效率和一致性，但牺牲了解题覆盖范围。为此提出“锐化税”（Sharpening Tax）作为诊断指标，量化后训练带来的测试时间可扩展性损失。在42个案例中，该现象普遍存在，且可通过少量推演估算，并与其他指标高度相关。最后提出后验温度组采样（PTGS），一种简单插件式贝叶斯采样方法，根据提示的难度动态调整采样温度，在两个代理环境中应用后，相比固定温度基线，显著降低锐化税，提升多轮采样下的任务求解率，同时改善单次采样准确率。
AI.motivation: 探究后训练对大语言模型在代理任务中表现的影响，特别是其是否真的提升了整体能力，还是仅强化了已有行为而牺牲了解题多样性与覆盖范围。
AI.method: 通过对比预训练与后训练模型在多个代理基准上的表现，分析后训练对任务解决模式的影响；提出‘锐化税’作为量化指标；设计并验证后验温度组采样（PTGS）方法以缓解后训练带来的负面效应。
AI.result: 预训练模型在充足测试预算下往往优于后训练模型，表现出更高的解题覆盖率；后训练导致任务两极分化，降低解题可扩展性；‘锐化税’可有效衡量此损失；PTGS方法能减少锐化税，兼顾解题覆盖率与单次准确率。
AI.conclusion: 后训练虽提升单次采样准确率与一致性，却损害了模型在多轮交互中的解题覆盖能力。采用如PTGS等自适应采样策略，可在不牺牲性能的前提下缓解这一问题，为未来代理系统的设计提供新思路。

title: On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D
comment: Published (Spotlight) at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
summary: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从少量示例中直接生成专用模型参数的方法，利用超网络根据上下文生成小型专用模型的参数，在ARC-1D测试中展示了结构化的权重空间和部分组合泛化能力，且无需显式任务标识即可实现对未见变换的泛化，验证了少样本上下文可编译为紧凑可执行参数，并支持函数复用与泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有通用模型虽能适应多任务，但专用模型在特定任务上表现更优，而构建专用模型通常需任务特定训练或微调。本文旨在探索是否可通过少量示例直接生成专用模型，从而避免繁琐训练过程。
AI.method: 采用ARC-1D作为受控测试平台，使用超网络根据上下文生成小型专用模型的参数；通过分析生成参数的结构化权重空间，评估其在已知及未见变换上的泛化性能。
AI.result: 生成的专用模型参数具有结构化特性，展现出部分组合泛化能力，并能在未见过的变换上实现泛化；移除显式任务标识进一步提升了泛化效果。
AI.conclusion: 少样本任务上下文可被实时编译为紧凑的可执行模型参数，生成的权重空间支持跨任务复用与超越已有函数的泛化，为高效、灵活的专用模型生成提供了可行性证明。

title: Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models
summary: Generative video world models can now synthesize open-ended environments that agents can navigate and interact with in simple ways. Yet open-ended generation does not imply full interaction: as a generated world expands, newly created content through navigation should expand what the agent can act upon, and as the agent changes the world, those changes should become persistent parts of the environment rather than transient visual effects. We characterize these two requirements as Open-World Interactivity, where newly generated or encountered entities are incorporated into the actionable world, and Persistent State, where interaction outcomes are committed to the world state and continue to influence subsequent observations and interactions. We present Oneira, an interactive video world model that closes the loop between generation and interaction through an explicit, extensible world state managed by a coding agent. Given the current observation and an action or high-level goal, the agent reads the world state, grounds the relevant entities, plans the interaction, and writes its outcome back into a world state table. When exploration reveals new objects, the agent incorporates them from generated observations, allowing the interaction space to expand with the generated world. Meanwhile, previously induced state changes are carried across video segments, making the consequences of interaction persistent parts of subsequent world evolution. The updated world state is rendered along the camera action trajectory into a coarse conditioning video, from which a video generator fills in the appearance, motion, and interaction details not represented in the state. Experiments show that Oneira enables direct and consistent interaction with newly generated objects, while preserving the effects of prior interactions over long horizons. Project page: https://madaoer.github.io/projects/oneira

AI.tldr: Oneira 是一个交互式视频世界模型，通过显式的、可扩展的世界状态管理，实现了开放世界交互与持久状态。它利用编码代理读取、规划并更新世界状态，使新生成的对象可被交互，且交互结果在长时间内保持持久。结合条件视频生成，实现从抽象状态到细节丰富的视觉输出。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式视频世界模型虽能合成开放环境，但缺乏真正的交互性：新内容无法持续纳入行动空间，交互效果也常为瞬时视觉变化。因此需要实现开放世界交互（Open-World Interactivity）和持久状态（Persistent State），以支持长期一致的交互体验。
AI.method: Oneira 采用编码代理管理显式世界状态表。基于当前观察与动作或目标，代理读取世界状态，定位相关实体，规划交互，并将结果写回状态表。新对象通过探索发现并加入状态；先前交互的影响跨视频片段保留。世界状态驱动粗略条件视频生成，再由视频生成器填充外观、运动与交互细节。
AI.result: 实验表明，Oneira 能够实现对新生成对象的直接且一致的交互，同时在长时程中保持先前交互的效果，显著提升了生成世界的可交互性与一致性。
AI.conclusion: Oneira 通过显式世界状态与编码代理的协同机制，成功构建了一个具备开放世界交互与持久状态能力的动态视频世界模型，为智能体在生成环境中进行长期、一致的交互提供了新范式。

title: Decision Titan: Test-Time Training for Long-Term Memory in Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-term dependencies remain a major challenge for sequential decision-making in the field of AI: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and the limited expressivity of vector-based hidden states, whilst Transformer-based models are limited by the quadratic scaling of attention. Recent work has proposed tackling this problem with the Test-Time Training (TTT) framework, which stores episodic memories in the parameters of a neural network through gradient descent at both train and test-time. This approach has seen success in the domain of Natural Language Processing, however, to the best of our knowledge it has not yet been applied to the domain of Reinforcement Learning (RL), nor has there been a study analysing how this memory practically functions. In this paper, we study the potential of the TTT framework for offline RL by augmenting a Decision Transformer with TTT layers, dubbed the Decision Titan. We analyse performance and properties of the model in the X-Maze environment, an extension of T-Maze designed to test sequential memory, and investigate how the memory mechanism learns by visualising gate values over time. Our key findings are that Decision Titan can learn long-term dependencies with ranges 20x longer than the context window, generalises to lengths 1.7x the training data, but crucially temporal generalisation depends on the time embeddings used, and the ability to learn long-term dependencies depends on how the relevant information is encoded.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在离线强化学习中使用测试时训练（TTT）框架的潜力，通过将TTT层引入决策变换器，提出名为Decision Titan的模型。在X-Maze环境中评估其性能，发现该模型可学习长达上下文窗口20倍的长期依赖关系，并在1.7倍于训练数据长度的情况下实现时间泛化，但泛化能力取决于时间嵌入方式及信息编码方式。
AI.motivation: 长期依赖是序列决策中的主要挑战，传统RNN存在梯度消失问题，Transformer则受限于注意力机制的二次复杂度。尽管TTT框架在自然语言处理中表现良好，但在强化学习领域尚未被应用或深入研究。
AI.method: 将TTT层集成到决策变换器中，构建Decision Titan模型，并在X-Maze环境中进行实验，通过可视化门控值分析记忆机制的工作原理。
AI.result: Decision Titan能够学习20倍于上下文窗口的长期依赖，实现1.7倍训练数据长度的时间泛化；时间泛化效果受时间嵌入方式影响，长期依赖的学习效果取决于信息编码方式。
AI.conclusion: TTT框架在离线强化学习中具有潜力，但其性能高度依赖于时间嵌入设计和信息编码策略，未来工作应聚焦于优化这些因素以提升泛化能力。

title: AnyJev Technical Report
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Early report on work in development. Code: https://github.com/nokia-applied-research/AnyJev
summary: A typed decision is a choice among a fixed set of options, returned as a probability rather than as text. Systems that need typed decisions today use models trained for that purpose. This report describes AnyJev, which reads a typed decision from one prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned language model. The readout restricts the next-token distribution at the answer position to the option tokens. It has two defects: the model assigns higher probability to some labels whatever the input, and to some positions in the option list. AnyJev corrects both with no gradient steps and no parameter changes: it divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, and it averages log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list. On two 20-option tasks the rotations lower the order-flip rate from 0.33 to 0.14 and from 0.33 to 0.18, and raise accuracy on 11 of 11 models on both. Reading every rotation requires K prefills. A stopping rule selected against the full-rotation decision on unlabelled states cuts that. Selecting the threshold on one unlabelled split and bounding its disagreement on a second, it reads 10.6 rotations of 18 at a verified 0.008 bound on two of four cells; selected and bounded on one split, as our serving run did, it reads 7.3 and serves 2.2 times as many decisions per second on vLLM. The code is open source.

AI.tldr: AnyJev 通过在预训练指令微调语言模型的一次预填充中读取类型化决策，利用标签先验和选项列表的K个循环旋转平均对数概率来纠正模型固有的偏差，从而提升决策准确性。该方法无需梯度更新或参数调整，且可通过停止规则减少计算开销，在多个任务上显著降低顺序翻转率并提高准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有系统依赖专门训练的模型进行类型化决策，但效率较低。本文旨在提出一种无需额外训练即可从预训练模型中高效、准确地读取类型化决策的方法。
AI.method: AnyJev 通过限制答案位置的下一个标记分布为选项标记，并使用未标注输入估计标签先验来修正偏见；同时通过对选项列表的K个循环旋转平均对数概率，减轻位置依赖性。结合停止规则减少所需预填充次数。
AI.result: 在两个20选项任务上，旋转策略将顺序翻转率从0.33降至0.14和0.18，11个模型中全部提升准确率；在实际部署中，采用阈值选择与边界控制后，每秒可处理2.2倍于传统方式的决策请求，且保证0.008的误差边界。
AI.conclusion: AnyJev 提供了一种高效、无训练成本的类型化决策读取机制，适用于大规模部署场景，具有良好的准确性和性能优势。
